jobs.occupation: Clinical Trial Supply Manager/ Senior Clinical Trial Supply Manager
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about clinical trial supply management? Do you have experience within GMP/GDP-regulated environments and managing complex clinical trial supply chains?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Clinical Trial Supply Manager.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

As Clinical Trial Supply Manager at Ascendis Pharma, you will be responsible for managing selected areas of the Clinical Trial Supply Chain in collaboration with internal and externally stakeholders. The Clinical Trial Supply (CTS) department comprises three closely collaborating teams: CTS - Coordination, CTS-IRT and CTS - Preparation & Handling.

We are seeking a passionate Clinical Trial Supply Manager to join our growing team. As a key member of the Ascendis Pharma team, you will play a crucial role in managing the clinical trial supply activities across Phase 1-3 studies. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment and collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to achieve extraordinary results.

You will be part of a dedicated and highly experienced Clinical Trial Supply department comprising 12 colleagues. The position is based in Hellerup, Denmark.

Your key responsibilities will depend on your experience and may include:

• Coordinating internal CTS trial meetings and activities and collaborating with internal departments incl. CMC, Trial Management, QA, IT, and Regulatory Affairs

• Forecasting, planning, and facilitating the supply of IMP for clinical trial supplies, including managing IMP Packaging and Labelling activities, packaging design, label text development, and planning of packaging runs

• Managing IRT setup, incl. IRT specification, UAT preparation and execution, Go-live and close-out, as well as managing IRT system changes after Go-live

• Managing IMP distribution from CMOs to clinical sites incl. direct-to-patient (DtP) shipments and management of temperature excursions during storage at depots and clinical sites and during shipments

• Managing drug accountability activities, including returns, reconciliation and destruction

• Participating in meetings with CMOs, suppliers and vendors, trial teams and Investigator Meetings

• Maintaining documentation in the QMS and eTMF, including reviewing and preparing trial-related instructions and manuals

Qualifications and Skills:

Ideally, you hold a relevant academic degree in pharmacy or a related field and have at least 5 years of relevant experience in clinical trial supply management or a GMP/GDP-regulated environment.

Furthermore, you have:

• Proven experience in managing complex projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders

• A strong understanding of regulatory requirements

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office

• Fluency in written and spoken English and Danish

Key competencies:

You are a collaborative and quality-focused team player with a structured and analytical approach to your work. You are adaptable, take ownership, and have a can-do attitude. You thrive in a fast-paced, informal environment where priorities may change and close collaboration is key.

Travel: 2–10 days per year

Office: Denmark, Hellerup, Tuborg Havn

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the position or the company, please contact Sara Østergaard, Director Clinical Trial Supply PM Team at sbo@ascendispharma.com.

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

A note to recruiters:

We do not allow external search party solicitation. Presentation of candidates without written permission from the Ascendis Pharma HR team (specifically from: Talent Acquisition Partner or Human Resources Director) is not allowed. If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged.

Job Title: Senior Director, Corporate Procurement

Department: Corporate Procurement

Location: Bagsværd, Denmark

**Your impact begins here

**Shape the future of a diverse, business-critical portfolio, strengthen an experienced leadership team and raise the bar for global category excellence. You will challenge established approaches, unlock cross-category opportunities and use commercial judgement, strategic partnerships and AI-enabled insights to make our procurement decisions smarter, faster and more valuable.

As our new Senior Director, you will set the global procurement direction for the services and technologies that enable Novo to operate, innovate and grow. You will lead one of our three global category clusters called Corporate Services. The cluster covers Professional Services, External Workforce and Digital Solutions with approximately DKK 20 billion in annual spend.

**What You’ll Do

**Reporting to the Vice President, Corporate Procurement (reporting to CFO), you will join Corporate Procurement Management and lead the Corporate Services cluster through three experienced team leaders (two Directors and one Associate Director) and their 23-person teams in Denmark, who drive category management and strategic sourcing. You will work closely with our Category Management Support function and our Global Business Services teams in Bangalore (India), which manage tactical sourcing.

**You Will

**

• Lead through others: Set direction, empower your leaders and build a culture of accountability, honest feedback, development and constructive challenge.

• Drive global category excellence: Set the cluster’s strategic direction, connect business priorities with market opportunities and enable ambitious category strategies that deliver measurable value.

• Unlock cross-category opportunities: Find synergies across the three categories and challenge how we access expertise, deploy technology and partner externally to strengthen competitiveness, flexibility and innovation.

• Shape demand and business opportunities: Anticipate evolving needs, challenge established commercial and delivery models, and build the senior partnerships and sponsorship to turn opportunities into results.

• Advance AI-enabled category excellence: Use technology, data and AI to deepen market intelligence, accelerate decisions, automate lower-value work and raise the impact of category management.

• Strengthen strategic supplier ecosystems: Build partnerships that bring innovation and critical capabilities while improving commercial value, performance, sustainability and resilience.

**Who You’ll Work With

**Corporate Procurement is a global strategic function with an ambitious cost, innovation and value agenda. We manage Novo’s indirect spend, supplier base and global Source-to-Pay processes and systems, with teams in Bagsværd, Bangalore and Boston and category and sourcing managers across the globe.

We bridge business priorities with market opportunities and supplier capabilities, using market intelligence, AI and automation to move faster, decide better and deliver greater enterprise value.

You will partner with colleagues across Corporate Procurement and senior stakeholders Enterprise IT, People & Organisation, Legal, Finance and other business areas, as well as regional procurement colleagues and senior executives at strategic suppliers.

As part of Corporate Procurement Management, you will also help shape the wider procurement agenda, build and grow the future leadership of the organisation, strengthen cross-category collaboration and build a more intelligent, agile and high-performing organisation.

**What You’ll Bring

**You are an accomplished procurement and people leader with deep domain expertise, strategic perspective and strong business partnering skills. Above all, you succeed through others: setting clear direction and enabling experienced leaders and experts to make sound decisions, grow and deliver together.

You have a clear view of how procurement creates enterprise value and use market insight, supplier capabilities and internal expertise to shape opportunities with the business.

**To Succeed, You Will Bring

**

• Solid experience in category management and global strategic procurement.

• A strong record as a leader of leaders, delivering results, developing experienced category leaders and experts, and driving high engagement organisations.

• Deep category expertise across complex indirect spend, with strong credibility in at least one of Professional Services, External Workforce or Digital/IT and sound understanding of the others.

• Proven ability to partner with and constructively challenge senior executives, aligning a global matrix organisation around shared outcomes.

• Experience leading complex negotiations, strategic supplier relationships and transformation, balancing value, quality, innovation, agility and risk.

• Experience leveraging shared services and specialist capabilities in global procurement operating models to maximise strategic capacity and performance.

• Strong analytical judgement and financial acumen, with an understanding of how AI, automation and advanced analytics improve procurement intelligence, productivity and decisions.

You combine curiosity, courage and commercial judgement, and coach others through difficult decisions with clarity, care and integrity.

**What You Can Expect

**You will lead one of our most diverse and strategically important global portfolios, influencing how Novo accesses critical expertise, technology and supplier innovation. With ~DKK 20 billion in annual spend, an experienced leadership team and direct access to senior decision-makers, you will have the scale and mandate to make a real difference.

Our Corporate Procurement organisation has high ambitions for category excellence and enterprise value, and we value leaders who bring new perspectives, challenge conventional thinking and raise the bar for themselves and their teams.

Guided by the Novo Way, we create focus and speed through clear priorities, simple ways of working and decisive action. We care for our people, show respect and never compromise on safety and ethics.

As part of a strong procurement leadership community, you will broaden your enterprise perspective, develop other leaders and keep growing as a senior executive.

**Start now

**Ready to shape global category excellence, develop outstanding leaders and connect business ambition with market opportunity?

Apply for the Senior Director, Corporate Procurement role by November 22, 2026.

You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV.

For further information, please contact Executive Search Advisor Kristoffer Baadsgaard at +45 30 77 56 05.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

**Position, purpose & impact:

**We're looking for an experienced Senior People & Culture Business Partner to be the main P&C partner for our Go-To-Market organization, with a special focus on our US team. You'll be the go-to HR expert for the US, so you need solid, hands-on experience with US HR practices, benefits and systems.

Working closely with our CRO and GTM leaders, you'll strengthen performance, leadership and engagement across the business. You'll also support organizational development, talent decisions and change initiatives. You'll be based in our Copenhagen office, support US colleagues across time zones and travel to the US about every second month. Your work will help build the high-performing, trust-based culture that drives Queue-it's growth.

**Your toolkit:

**

• Several years of experience as an HR Business Partner in a senior role, including organizational. development and performance management.

• Previous hands-on HR experience supporting employees and leaders in the US.

• Solid knowledge of US employment practices, employee relations, benefits and HR administration.

• Practical experience with US HR systems and providers, such as TriNet or similar.

• Confidence to coach and challenge leaders while building trusted advisory relationships.

• Strong facilitation and communication skills across diverse stakeholder groups.

• Experience with stakeholder, project and change management.

• An analytical mindset that turns people insights into clear business recommendations.

• Experience supporting global organizations across cultures and time zones.

• Willingness to work US hours when needed and travel to the US about every second month.

**The role in action:

**

• Partner with our CRO and GTM leaders on performance management, talent development and organizational effectiveness.

• Act as the go-to HR expert for our US organization, advising on employment practices, benefits, employee relations and HR administration.

• Give practical guidance on policies and compliance, and bring in external legal experts when needed.

• Coach and support managers through people decisions across the whole employee lifecycle.

• Facilitate performance dialogues, feedback processes and development conversations that lift individual and team performance.

• Run leadership development initiatives and employee development programs across GTM.

• Drive engagement initiatives and help leaders act on employee feedback, together with the wider P&C team.

• Support organizational changes and make sure communication and stakeholder alignment stay strong throughout.

• Contribute to P&C projects and strategic initiatives that support business priorities.

• Spend regular time with our US team, both remotely across time zones and on-site in the US.

**Why join the Queue

****Your Copenhagen base

**Most of your time will be at our Vesterbro office in Copenhagen, Queue-it's largest office and global headquarters. The space is designed for both teamwork and focus, with open work areas, quiet rooms and dedicated spaces for deep work. You'll also spend regular time in the US, travelling there about every second month to work side by side with our US team. In between visits, you'll stay closely connected to them across time zones.

**How We Work

**At Queue-it, you’re trusted to work in a way that suits you best, supported by a strengths-based approach and a flat hierarchy inspired by Danish work culture. You’ll be part of a global team with colleagues from 40+ nationalities, where diverse perspectives, open dialogue, and cross-cultural collaboration are part of everyday work.

**Community and everyday life

**We make time to connect, with regular social activities, ping pong, foosball, daily snacks, fresh fruit, great coffee, and access to a subsidized canteen in the building. It’s a workplace that balances professional growth with a strong sense of community.

**What We’re About

**At Queue-it, we help leading brands like Ticketmaster, Sky Mobile, and Peach Aviation navigate their busiest days with confidence. Our virtual waiting room keeps websites running smoothly during high-traffic events, creating fairer, more reliable online experiences for billions of users.

We’re also a global team of 40+ nationalities working across Denmark, the U.S., South Korea, Australia, and Japan. We believe in trust - in the digital experiences we protect and in the culture we build together.

Here, we take a strengths-based approach, encouraging people to do what they naturally do best. You’ll join a supportive environment where individuality is valued and collaboration matters.

And yes, we like to have fun. From monthly events to cultural celebrations and learning initiatives, we make time to connect, recognize one another, and enjoy the Queue.

We are empowered by trust and strengthened by people.

Do you enjoy turning complex business requirements into clear, practical software solutions? Join Keylane as a Business Analyst and help shape the pension processes that support people through important life events, from retirement to disability and the loss of a loved one.

Key about your team

Key About you

Using AI

What we offer

• Flexibility in the working environment. We offer a combination of working from home and from the office. We value seeing colleagues in person to stay connected and collaborate effectively.

• The Danish office is located a 10-minute walk from Islands Brygge Metro station.

• We believe that strong employee relations are key to maintaining well-being in the workplace. To support this, we offer a variety of social activities that all employees can participate in, such as yoga, padel tennis, running, outdoor bathing, and fitness in the basement.

• Salary: For this role, the Monthly Base Salary ranges from 50.000-60.000 (DKK), corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

*Please submit your application, including your CV. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

*A criminal record and reference check are part of the application process. Each employee within Keylane must follow training on information security and irrespective to the role basic information security responsibilities apply.

If you have any questions about the job, you are very welcome to Martin Bo Heiberg, manager martin.bo.heiberg@keylane.com

If you have any questions, please send an email to manager of the team, or Talent Acquisition Specialist, Lykke Kæstel Alsgren at lykke.alsgren@keylane.com.

**About OrderYOYO

**We help takeaways and restaurants succeed online by providing them with personalised branded mobile apps, websites and personalised marketing. We are here to ensure that small to medium-sized restaurants and small chains are not subjected to high commissions, and giving the restaurant the ownership of their success!

We serve restaurants across multiple markets, including the UK, Ireland, DACH, the Netherlands and the Nordics, and acquisitions are one part of how we grow. Each business we acquire brings its own platform, data and restaurant partners, and bringing them onto OrderYOYO safely is how we protect and build on that value.

**Purpose of the role

**You will lead the technology integration and migration of businesses that join OrderYOYO, from technical due diligence and integration planning through migration, stabilisation and the retirement of legacy platforms.

You will own the integrated programme plan across engineering, product, data and customer-facing teams, protecting restaurant continuity and tracking delivery costs and agreed benefits.

You will coordinate dependencies with Finance, People, Commercial and other functional owners, rather than owning every aspect of corporate integration.

**Key Responsibilities

****Programme leadership

**

• Own end-to-end programme plans and a consolidated view of scope, timelines, dependencies, budget forecasts and risks.

• Lead workstream owners, agree priorities and capacity with functional leads, and run governance, escalating unresolved trade-offs to the CTPO.

• Embed lessons learned into a repeatable migration and integration approach.

**Pre-completion and Day 1

**

• Inform due diligence with assessments of migration complexity, product gaps, dependencies, effort, costs and delivery risks.

• Prepare integration plans before completion and coordinate Day 1 access, environments, tooling and working practices with incoming teams, engineering, IT and security.

• Coordinate early technical and compliance assessments with specialists and track follow-up actions.

****Data and systems

• Coordinate data migration and integration into our data platform and business systems with data and engineering teams, agreeing mappings, quality checks and reporting requirements.

**Customer migration

**

• Segment customers by size, value, product usage and complexity; lead platform gap analysis and scope decisions.

• Recommend migration waves and sequencing based on customer impact, technical readiness and capacity, adapting plans as capabilities mature and lessons emerge.

• Agree product, data, operational and customer-readiness criteria; coordinate testing and reconciliation of order flows, payments and key integrations, securing accountable-owner sign-off.

• Coordinate wave runbooks covering preparation, cutover, validation, rollback and support; lead go/no-go recommendations for approval by accountable business and technical owners.

• Own operational handover, including named support owners, stabilisation exit criteria and business acceptance; plan controlled legacy retirement after migration.

****Stakeholders

• Align engineering, product, customer-facing and finance teams around one plan and timeline, working with customer-facing teams to keep restaurant partners informed and supported.

**Commercial outcomes and reporting

**

• Partner with Finance to establish and track business cases, covering migration and parallel-running costs, revenue at risk, legacy-retirement savings and forecast cost to complete.

• Verify realised benefits with business owners and report progress, customer experience and value delivered to the CTPO and leadership team.

**Skills And Experience Required

**

• 5+ years of programme management experience in a technology organisation, including at least 3 years leading platform migrations, customer migrations or post-acquisition integrations.

• Demonstrated ownership of complex, customer-facing platform migrations, including readiness assessment, cutover, post-migration stabilisation and transition into normal operations.

• Strong technical literacy: comfortable discussing APIs, data pipelines, CRM migrations, cutover plans and infrastructure decommissioning with engineers.

• Experience segmenting large customer bases into migration waves, with detailed run books, rollback, hypercare and clear go or no-go criteria.

• Commercial judgement: you can weigh the cost of a feature gap against the revenue at risk and drive a decision.

• Excellent stakeholder management across engineering, product, commercial and executive audiences, with a proven ability to secure commitments, resolve competing priorities and lead delivery without relying on direct line-management authority.

• Clear, concise written and verbal communication, including executive-level reporting.

• Comfortable working across countries, cultures and time zones.

**Nice to have

**

• Experience in SaaS, restaurant technology, food ordering, payments or marketplaces.

• Experience with data platform and CRM migrations.

• Direct post-acquisition integration experience, and running a repeatable migration approach across multiple programmes.

• A recognised programme management qualification such as MSP, PRINCE2 or PgMP.

**What We Offer

**

• A senior role with direct visibility to the executive team and real influence on how OrderYOYO grows.

• Ownership of our migration and integration capability from day one, with the autonomy to shape how it works.

• Room to grow: as the portfolio expands, the opportunity to build this capability into a dedicated function and lead it.

• Work across nine European markets alongside engineering, product, data and commercial teams.

jobs.occupation: Senior Principal Program Manager – Product Development
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US, US

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

Product Development at SimCorp is building a Strategic Program Management capability from the ground up. We are a 3,000-person fintech on a mission to be the world's leading investment management platform, and Product Development, our largest organizational unit with around 1,600 people, is where the work gets done. Programs and projects of real strategic consequence are already in motion.

This role sits within the Strategy & Transformation team, working directly alongside the Senior Director of Strategy & Execution. You will help drive a portfolio of cross-functional programs and projects spanning AI strategy execution, engineering tooling, process transformation, compliance, and platform migration. The work is varied, consequential, and visible at the most senior levels.

If you are a hands-on program manager who thrives on complexity, builds structure in ambiguous environments, and gets things done across a matrixed organization by building trust and collaborating across teams, this is your role.

WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

• Own delivery of a defined set of cross-functional programs and projects from the Product Development portfolio, with full accountability for outcomes, milestones, risks, and stakeholder communication.

• Role model, define and drive how Strategic Program Management operates inside Product Development, with regard to standards, tools, and ways of working.

• Coach and assist colleagues leading programs and projects in PD.

• Coordinate across Product Management, Platform, and Application Engineering to resolve cross-functional dependencies and keep delivery on track and aligned to our strategic goals.

• Partner with Change & Organizational Development and the wider organization where programs require shifts in ways of working or organizational behavior.

The current portfolio of initiatives spans AI transformation, platform migration and tooling, delivery model transformation, change of ways of working, and compliance and risk governance. These are live initiatives with delivery pressure, cross-unit dependencies, and direct visibility at CPTO and senior leadership level. Initiatives vary in scale and complexity, and the mix evolves with Product Development's strategic priorities.

WHO YOU ARE

You are an experienced, hands-on and pragmatic program manager who combines structured thinking with the interpersonal confidence to drive accountability in a matrixed organization. You know that getting things done in a matrixed organization depends on understanding what other teams need, not just what you need from them. That takes investment in relationships, not just process, and you invest in both.

You are comfortable holding multiple programs or projects simultaneously, switching between strategic and operational thinking as the situation demands. You produce crisp updates and governance material, and you escalate early rather than late.

The combination of technical tooling, AI strategy, process optimization, and compliance work in this portfolio does not intimidate you. You do not need to be the subject matter expert. You need to be the person who ensures the right people are in the room and the work moves forward in a collaborative way. Ambiguity and competing demands do not unsettle you. You find the practical path and bring people with you.

WHAT WE VALUE

• 6+ years in program or project management roles, ideally with some years within a technology or product development organization.

• Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional initiatives with multiple workstreams and senior stakeholder engagement.

• Experience across both structured program management (governance, planning, risk management) and delivery-focused project execution.

• Experience building or improving program management practices, governance, and ways of working that teams and senior leaders use.

• Familiarity with engineering tooling environments and the ability to coordinate technical migrations or platform implementations without being the technical lead.

• Experience with compliance-related programs (GDPR, RoPA, ERM) is a plus.

• Outstanding written and verbal communication. You produce crisp executive material and inspire confidence in senior leadership forums.

• A direct, structured, and collaborative working style. You build alignment without softening the hard conversations.

• Degree in business, engineering, computer science, or a related field. Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) is a plus.

BENEFITS

Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work and work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. And opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually**. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.** At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on a positive growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are focused on continually improving our talent acquisition process and making everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**Your impact begins here

**As Safety Surveillance Principal Specialist, you will lead the safety surveillance strategy for responses to Health Authority questions across Novo’s incretin portfolio, mainly within diabetes and obesity treatment. You will drive benefit–risk thinking, influence critical decisions and represent Safety Surveillance in Health Authority meetings. Your judgement helps ensure the safety of treatments for people living with serious chronic diseases is understood clearly and communicated on time.

**What You’ll Bring

**You are an experienced, scientifically driven colleague who thrives on complex safety challenges and turns data into meaningful insight.

**We Imagine You Have

**

• A master’s degree in Life Sciences (e.g. Pharmacy, Medicine, Veterinary Medicine or Biology).

• Extensive experience within drug safety, pharmacovigilance, drug development processes, global regulatory requirements, GxP standards and medical concepts.

• Demonstrated ability to identify challenges, shape strategies and translate them into clear, actionable steps.

• Strong stakeholder management and the ability to influence decisions through clear, concise communication.

• Solid experience with Health Authority negotiations, including meetings.

• The ability to communicate clearly, in writing and verbally, and to turn complexity into clear recommendations.

• A self-driven, ethical and adaptable approach: you work independently, address issues proactively and stay flexible when situations or priorities change.

• A team-player mindset: you show empathy, take care of colleagues, build effective connections and collaborate seamlessly with internal and external stakeholders.

**What You’ll Do

**You will lead high-impact activities across the incretin portfolio, help set the direction for safety surveillance, and act as a trusted safety leader for key stakeholders. Clear communication, sound judgement and taking ownership will be part of your everyday work.

• Act as the safety surveillance lead for strategic, scientific responses to safety Q&A from all Health Authority interactions.

• Maintain overview of activities, including studies, submissions and questions and answers from Health Authorities.

• Represent Safety Surveillance in Health Authority meetings.

• Maintain overview of safety contributions to study reports, regulatory submissions, protocols and other key documents, and ensure relevant input to continued development activities.

• Contribute to benefit–risk communication and ensure clear, aligned and timely safety messaging for internal stakeholders and Health Authorities.

• Drive governance and decision-making across cross-functional areas and senior fora, and mentor colleagues by setting standards for scientific quality, decision-making and collaboration.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Post-Marketing Cardiometabolic III team in Safety Surveillance Post-Marketing, an area within Global Patient Safety based in Søborg, Denmark, with a department in Bangalore, India. The area has global responsibility for the portfolio of marketed products and consists of 7 teams across Denmark and India.

As a team, we are the bridge between clinical development and post-marketing. We handle clinical studies and submissions and lead strategic, scientific responses to safety Q&A from Health Authorities around the world on our GLP-1 portfolio.

You will work both independently and through others, building strong partnerships with colleagues across Clinical Development, Medical & Science, Regulatory Affairs, Biostatistics and other functional areas. Medical & Science will be a particularly close partner, and together you will keep decisions timely and scientific quality high. The environment is dynamic, collaborative and highly science driven. We value diverse perspectives, because the strongest outcomes emerge when people with different experiences and expertise work together.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will be trusted to take ownership, make your voice heard and lead from the front, while informally guiding junior colleagues and growing alongside highly skilled, enthusiastic colleagues. You will work at the intersection of science, drug development and regulatory strategy, with room to keep building your expertise through relevant learning offerings and experience across functions.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 847,000.00 to 1,245,100.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to shape how safety is understood and communicated for treatments that matter to millions of people, apply for the Safety Surveillance Principal Specialist role by **15 November 2026.

**We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

What we offer

**Role and impact

**

• Software engineering discipline across CI/CD, testing, and code review.

Leading the commissioning strategy, team and schedule from mobilisation to integrated systems testing.

**Role Overview

**The Commissioning Manager leads Sensori's commissioning function on a project, ensuring mechanical and electrical systems are started, tested and proven safely, in the right sequence and to the client's acceptance criteria. The role develops the commissioning plan and schedule, manages commissioning engineers and vendor resources, controls the interface with the client's commissioning agent, and integrates commissioning requirements into the construction program so that handover is predictable and fully documented.

**Principal Duties And Responsibilities

**

• Develop and own the project commissioning plan, including strategy, organisation, level definitions, sequences, acceptance criteria and documentation requirements.

• Build and maintain the commissioning schedule; integrate it with the construction program and drive readiness of systems and areas to support it.

• Lead, allocate and develop the team of commissioning engineers; coordinate vendor and subcontractor commissioning resources.

• Chair commissioning coordination meetings with construction, quality, Authorised Persons, vendors and the client's commissioning agent.

• Oversee development and approval of method statements, checklists, test scripts and integrated systems test procedures.

• Manage the energisation and start-up sequence in conjunction with the Senior Authorised Person, ensuring permits, isolations and safety controls are in place.

• Monitor test execution, witness critical tests and ensure results are recorded, reviewed and accepted in the commissioning management system.

• Manage the commissioning issues log; drive closure of deficiencies with construction teams, subcontractors and vendors.

• Plan and lead integrated systems testing, including failure scenarios and redundancy demonstrations, with the client and third parties.

• Ensure complete, accurate turnover packages, training and documentation are delivered for handover.

• Report commissioning progress, risks and constraints to project leadership weekly; contribute to lessons learned and improvement of Sensori's commissioning standards.

• Support pre-construction and tenders with commissioning strategies, durations and resource plans.

**Selection criteria / person specification

**

• Degree in Mechanical, Electrical or Building Services Engineering, or a trade qualification with extensive commissioning leadership experience.

• At least seven years in commissioning, including several years leading commissioning teams on data centre, pharmaceutical or mission-critical projects.

• Strong understanding of both mechanical and electrical systems, sequences of operation and integrated testing.

• Experience working with client commissioning agents and formal level-based commissioning processes.

• Proven ability to plan and schedule commissioning within a construction program and to manage readiness across trades.

• Familiarity with commissioning management software and structured documentation.

• Strong leadership, coordination and communication skills; able to chair meetings and influence senior stakeholders.

• Sound knowledge of safe systems of work for energisation and live testing.

• Willing to travel and to be site-based for extended periods.

Location: Aarhus, Hamburg, Malaga, Oslo or Copenhagen

Type: Hybrid & Full-time

About the Job

We are looking for a Senior Security Architect to shape and strengthen security across Stibo DX products, platforms, and cloud services. You will join a small, senior architecture team at the center of Stibo DX's transformation from self-hosted and hybrid deployments to a standardized, cloud-native SaaS platform.

This is a hands-on, embedded role. You will work with engineering, product, platform, operations, customer-facing teams, and legal to ensure security is built into our solutions by design, not added afterwards. You will turn security strategy and risk into practical architecture, reusable patterns, and controls that teams can implement.

Your goal is to establish a consistent security architecture across Stibo DX and give teams clear standards, patterns, and guardrails to make secure architecture decisions. Early priorities will include establishing a security architecture baseline, identifying key security gaps across our SaaS platform, strengthening security architecture reviews and threat modelling, and defining reusable security patterns for engineering teams.

The role is primarily focused on security architecture, product and platform security, and secure engineering practices. You will also drive the technical aspects of security governance and support compliance activities when needed, including security certifications, customer security requirements, regulatory obligations, risk assessments, policies, and audit preparation.

You will work alongside peer architects covering Software, Platform/Infrastructure, and Data/Integration, reporting to the Director of Solution Architecture. Our governance model is based on minimum necessary control: decisions close to teams, with oversight proportional to risk and impact.

Security remains a shared responsibility. The Senior Security Architect owns the security architecture direction, standards, patterns, and cross-cutting guidance, while Software, Platform/Infrastructure, and Data/Integration architects continue to consider and address security within their respective domains. Engineering teams remain responsible for implementing and operating the required controls.

What You'll Do

• Define security architecture strategy across Stibo DX products, platforms, and cloud services, including principles, standards, target architectures, guardrails, and roadmaps.

• Embed secure-by-design practices into product discovery, solution design, delivery, and operation, working with teams early rather than reviewing security only at the end.

• Lead security architecture reviews and threat modelling for product, platform, customer, and technology initiatives; identify risks and align on practical mitigation with accountable teams.

• Shape identity and access management covering authentication, authorization, federation, privileged access, service identities, secrets, and Zero Trust principles.

• Strengthen cloud and platform security for AWS, Kubernetes, networks, workloads, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, data, and shared SaaS platform capabilities.

• Define reusable security patterns and controls for APIs, integrations, multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, encryption, key management, logging, monitoring, vulnerability management, and secure configuration.

• Embed security in the software development lifecycle by defining practices and guardrails and helping teams integrate security into engineering practices, automation, architecture decision records, and delivery pipelines.

• Lead security governance and compliance work when needed including security policies, control design, risk assessments, evidence coordination, audit preparation, and remediation planning.

• Translate external requirements into technical action including customer security expectations, contractual commitments, privacy requirements, and relevant frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, and CRA.

• Raise security maturity across Stibo DX through coaching, practical guidance, cross-team collaboration, and clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What we're looking for

Experience

• 10+ years of experience across software engineering, cloud/platform engineering, or cybersecurity, with 4+ years in a senior security architecture or technical security leadership role.

• Proven experience designing and securing cloud-native, distributed, and microservices-based systems in production.

• Practical experience with SaaS and multi-tenant architectures, including tenant isolation, identity, data protection, and shared platform controls.

• Experience leading threat modelling, security architecture reviews, risk assessments, and remediation planning across multiple teams or product areas.

• Experience defining security standards, patterns, reference architectures, and governance that teams can apply in practice.

• Experience working with security and compliance frameworks and translating them into proportionate technical and organizational controls.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to influence engineers, architects, product leaders, operations, customers, legal, and senior stakeholders.

Technical expertise

• Cloud security, preferably AWS, and Kubernetes/container security.

• Identity and Access Management, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, federation, privileged access, and service identities.

• Application, API, integration, and event-driven security.

• Network security, workload protection, secrets management, encryption, certificates, and key management.

• Secure software development lifecycle, DevSecOps, infrastructure as code, CI/CD security, and software supply-chain security.

• Security logging, monitoring, detection capabilities, vulnerability management, and incident preparedness.

• Threat modelling, security risk analysis, Zero Trust, and defense-in-depth principles.

Nice to have

• Experience leading or materially supporting ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR security controls, CRA, or similar initiatives.

• Experience with enterprise customer security assessments, contractual security requirements, and audit evidence coordination.

• Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience helping an organization establish or mature a security architecture and governance capability.

Personal qualities

• Hands-on and credible with engineers, while able to communicate security clearly with product, customers, legal, and leadership.

• Pragmatic and risk-based: able to balance security, usability, operational complexity, cost, and delivery speed without compromising critical controls.

• Collaborative and influential, using expertise, evidence, and trust rather than creating unnecessary gates.

• Structured and decisive, able to make risks, responsibilities, and architectural decisions explicit.

• Curious, adaptable, and motivated by building long-term security maturity while helping teams deliver now.

What We Offer

• Real influence on the security foundations of Stibo DX's cloud-native SaaS transformation.

• Ownership of security architecture and a central role in shaping security governance and compliance maturity.

• Hands-on work on real product, platform, customer, and operational challenges, not security from an ivory tower.

• A small, senior architecture team with trust, autonomy, and meaningful responsibility.

• High visibility across product, engineering, operations, customer-facing teams, legal, and leadership.

• The opportunity to create reusable security practices and patterns with lasting impact across Stibo DX.

Interested?

Apply at your earliest convenience. Short-listed candidates will be invited for an interview. Applications are processed as they are received until the right candidate is found.

For any questions, please reach out to hiring manager Safdar Aqeel Safdar on safs@stibodx.com.

jobs.occupation: Newbuilding Project Manager | Senior Naval Architect
jobs.description:
Take a leading role in delivering Maersk’s next generation of vessels!

You will combine naval architecture expertise with hands-on project management, steering complex newbuilding activities from early design and specification through construction and delivery.

Maersk is transforming its fleet through new technologies, new fuels and ambitious requirements for safety, efficiency and sustainability. You will join Fleet Technology in Copenhagen and work directly with shipyards, designers, classification societies, equipment makers, site teams and specialists across Maersk.

At Maersk, we believe in the power of diversity, collaboration and continuous learning, and we work hard to ensure that the people in our organisation reflect and understand the customers we exist to serve.

About the role

This is a project delivery role with a strong naval architecture foundation. You will lead and coordinate engineering work across disciplines, turn technical findings into clear recommendations and help mature key matters towards timely project decisions. Your judgement will influence vessels from the drawing board until they enter service.

What you will do

• Lead naval architecture and newbuilding project activities from concept development and specification through detailed design, construction and delivery.

• Plan, coordinate and follow up engineering activities, interfaces, risks and decisions across project teams, shipyards and site offices.

• Drive design reviews, plan approval topics, technical evaluations and trade-off studies with internal and external partners.

• Continuously challenge how we can make our vessels safer, smarter, more efficient and more sustainable.

• Translate technical analyses into clear recommendations that enable well-informed decisions.

• Act as a naval architecture subject matter expert while building alignment across disciplines and organisations.

• Contribute to major conversions, fleet optimisation and strategic technology initiatives alongside our newbuilding portfolio.

• Support and share knowledge with colleagues in a collaborative environment with flat team structures and a strong sense of shared ownership.

What we are looking for

• A degree in Naval Architecture and 5+ years of relevant experience in ship design, newbuilding or maritime engineering.

• Proven project management experience from ship newbuilding or major conversion projects, gained with a shipowner, shipyard, designer, consultancy or classification society.

• Experience taking engineering work from concept and specification into detailed design and execution.

• A solid understanding of vessel design, ideally including areas such as stability, structural, statutory or classification requirements.

• Experience with technical specifications, design reviews and/or plan approval.

• The ability to coordinate multidisciplinary work, manage technical risks and keep complex activities moving forward.

• Sound engineering judgement, a collaborative working style and clear written and spoken English.

It is an advantage if you also have

• Direct experience working with shipyards during newbuilding design and construction.

• Experience with design optimisation and technical trade-off studies balancing performance, cost and project constraints.

• Knowledge of container vessel hull structure, lashing and cargo systems, outfitting or accommodation design.

• Experience coordinating, supporting or mentoring other engineers.

Why join us?

Few roles offer this combination of technical depth, project ownership and direct influence on large newbuilding programmes.

You will see projects develop from an initial idea into vessels operating in global service, working in an international engineering environment where technical discussion, collaboration and ownership are valued.

If you enjoy solving ship-design challenges and want to take an active role in delivering Maersk’s future fleet, we would like to hear from you.

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing  accommodationrequests@maersk.com.

Opportunity

Are you interested in turning complex business needs into data products that make a real difference?

As a Product Owner within our Commercial Data Products and Reporting team, you will own and develop data products that help our Commercial and Commercial Finance teams make better, faster and more consistent decisions.

You will manage a portfolio of data products, including datasets and data cubes used for commercial analysis and reporting. Sitting between business and technology, you will translate stakeholder needs into clear requirements, shape solutions with our technology teams, and ensure we focus our efforts on the work that creates the greatest value.

Our team brings together Product Owners based in Copenhagen and reporting colleagues in Pune, and you will collaborate with colleagues across business, data and technology.

Please note that this role is based in Copenhagen and requires onsite presence in the office five days per week.

What you’ll be doing

• 
Own the vision, roadmap and backlog for your assigned commercial data products.

• 
Work closely with Commercial, Commercial Finance and other stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into clear requirements and user stories.

• 
Act as a trusted sparring partner and bridge between business and technology, translating business needs into technically informed requirements while constructively challenging assumptions and proposed solutions.

• 
Prioritise the backlog based on business value, technical feasibility and delivery capacity.

• 
Partner with technology teams to shape scalable data solutions and support delivery through Agile ways of working.

• 
Apply your understanding of data models, data sourcing and transformation processes to ask the right questions and constructively challenge proposed solutions.

• 
Support the development and evolution of datasets, data cubes, KPIs and reporting foundations.

• 
Identify and shape opportunities to embed AI and automation into our data products, while also using AI to improve how we explore, design and deliver solutions.

• 
Collaborate closely with our reporting team and other Product Owners to ensure our data products work effectively across the wider organisation.

• 
Promote consistent KPI definitions, strong data quality and trusted reporting in line with our One Set of Numbers principle.

• 
Drive adoption, monitor product performance and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

What we’re looking for

You combine strong product thinking with enough technical understanding to work confidently across business, data and technology teams.

You do not need to be a hands-on data engineer, but you should understand how data is sourced, transformed, structured and delivered well enough to engage with and challenge technical colleagues when needed.

Your background could be in product ownership, data engineering, business intelligence, analytics, finance, commercial performance or another related field. We welcome different career paths and are interested in the capabilities and experience you bring.

We’re looking for someone with:

• 
Approximately 5+ years’ experience working with data products, BI, analytics, data engineering, reporting or product ownership.

• 
Experience translating business needs into user stories, requirements and prioritised backlogs.

• 
A good conceptual understanding of data models, datasets and data-transformation processes such as ETL.

• 
AI-enabled product development: Experience or a strong interest in delivering AI-enabled products and using AI tools throughout the product lifecycle, from exploring requirements and shaping solutions to improving delivery and ways of working. You bring curiosity about emerging AI capabilities and can identify where they can create meaningful business value.

• 
Experience working with technical teams using Agile principles and tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps or similar.

• 
Strong stakeholder skills and the ability to communicate technical concepts in a clear and accessible way.

• 
Good business acumen and curiosity about how data can improve commercial decisions.

• 
A proactive mindset and the confidence to ask questions, challenge assumptions and identify opportunities for improvement.

Experience within commercial, sales, finance, logistics or shipping would be beneficial, but is not essential.

Ready to make an impact?

If you enjoy bringing business and technology together and want to shape data products that support decision-making across a global organisation, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply to join the team and help us turn data into meaningful business value.

_As our new Test Manager, you will play a key role in delivering our SitaWare and Iris suites, an integrated, ultra-modern command-and-control toolset that helps Defence customers make critical decisions wherever they need it. You will apply your broad test and engineering skills in an agile environment with highly skilled colleagues, as part of our growing Defence Services team in Copenhagen.

**The job

**Our SitaWare and Iris suites give armed forces an integrated, ultra-modern command-and-control toolset spanning radio, mobile, vehicle, web and application-based solutions, with real-time reporting back to command HQ. As our new Test Manager, you will be involved in everything from the start of a feature, writing test cases and managing the process, through to verifying the final testing before we deliver the solution to our Defence customers.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Planning and conducting acceptance tests (FAT and SAT) with customers, both at our own facilities and at customer sites

• Conducting integration tests with third-party software and hardware

• Challenging solution design against risks, based on system context, customer requirements and security

• Taking part in military exercises to support the use of our solutions and find new ways of testing that reflect real-life use

• Establishing and maintaining test environments, and contributing to tender and proposal work on test and test management approach

You should expect travel within the Nordics, and potentially elsewhere in Europe, several times a year.

**Joining the team

**You will join a small but growing team in a brand-new office in the heart of Copenhagen, working closely with your Nordic colleagues while also collaborating with other teams across our global constellations. Testing is an integral part of our development process, and you will be part of a wider community of testers and test managers, with knowledge-network events to exchange ideas, hear lectures, share best practice and get to know your colleagues. It is an agile, fast-moving environment with flexible, trust-based working hours and plenty of room for personal responsibility.

**Your Qualifications

**To succeed in this role, you bring:

• A technical degree, Bachelor's or Master's

• Solid experience as a Test Manager or in a similar role, with strong technical skills

• Experience with test management tools such as TestRail and Jira, including the Xray and R4J plugins

• Hands-on experience with test execution in close cooperation with stakeholders, and the ability to analyse and communicate technically complex solutions

• Solid knowledge of Windows and Linux environments, SQL/MS SQL Server, Active Directory, and networking fundamentals (IP, TCP, UDP, multicast, routing, firewalls), along with scripting skills in PowerShell or Bash

• Fluent Danish and English

• The ability to understand product requirements and translate these into effective tests

Alongside this, we value:

• Enjoys working in a changing environment, eager to step outside your comfort zone to make a difference

• Highly motivated to develop and apply your technical skills in a broad, technical role

• Enjoys customer-facing activities such as presentations, technical support, training and testing, building the trust that drives customer satisfaction

• Self-motivated and committed, with a hands-on approach

ISTQB or TMAP certification, automated testing experience, or experience with testing standards such as ISO/IEEE 29119, ISO 25010 or ISO 9001 are an advantage.

Experience with radio networking (e.g. VHF, HF) or tactical communications systems is a strong plus.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

**Welcome to Systematic Copenhagen

**When you join us in Copenhagen, you're not just getting a desk at one of the city's best locations—you are stepping into a workplace where community matters. Our Employees Club keeps things lively with monthly social events, and our office catering makes sure you are always well taken care of. Whether you are into casual games or just good company, you will find both at our foosball table or during our relaxed Friday bar gatherings.

**Never stop developing

**Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

jobs.occupation: Data Center Facilities Technician II, Electrical
jobs.description:
**Minimum qualifications:

**

• Associate's degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of electrical experience (e.g., electrical testing equipment or electrical distribution) in industrial or commercial environment.

• Ability to participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying or moving up to 50 lbs (23 kg) of equipment, the required use of safety equipment such as limited weight bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools and personal protective equipment (PPE) like safety harnesses in accordance with safety and ergonomic guidelines and assessments.

• Ability to work non-standard hours and work rotations/shifts.

**Preferred qualifications:

**

• Experience in data centers, hospitals, or power plants.

• Experience in electrical maintenance in critical large scale facilities (Data Center, Pharma, Medical or Electrical) including UPS, generators, LV/MV switchgear Strong electrical safety awareness and ability to develop switching procedures and RAMS.

• Knowledge of electrical systems used in a data center environment (e.g., Feeders, Transformers, Generators, Switchgear, UPS systems, ATS/STS units, PDU/PMM units).

• Knowledge of meters, devices, sensors, and troubleshooting utilizing standard hand tools, digital metering, or calibration/diagnostic equipment.

• Ability to communicate with contractors who perform maintenance or upgrade work on the data center systems.

**About The Job

**The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facilities Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some of these duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems. You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components). You provide daily assistance to senior technicians as you read blueprints/schematics, conduct tours of systems and assess their working order.

As an advocate for best practices, you develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly. In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures.

As a Facilities Technician, you will operate, monitor, and support physical facilities conditions for our data centers.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Denmark: kr.600000 - kr.615000 (DKK) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

**Responsibilities

**Learn more about benefits at Google .

• Inspect, maintain, and repair various data center systems.

• Provide daily assistance to technicians as you read blueprints/schematics/sequence of operations, conduct tours of systems, and assess their working order.

• Manage the uptime and maintenance of UPS, generators, electrical distribution, and control and monitoring systems.

• Operate, monitor, maintain, and respond to abnormal conditions in the data center facilities systems and equipment.

• Support startup, commissioning, and integration of new electrical equipment and systems into facilities infrastructure.

Senior Global Leadership Development Manager

**People, leadership & performance

****Bagsvaerd, Denmark

**Are you passionate about leadership development and organisational growth? Do you have the skills to design and deliver impactful leadership initiatives on a global scale?

If you are ready to make a difference and collaborate with diverse stakeholders across the globe, we want you to join our team as a Senior Global Leadership Development Manager.

Read more and apply today!

Your new role

As a Senior Global Leadership Development Manager, you will :

• Deliver and execute leadership development priorities within assigned EVP/SVP areas or geographies through interventions for leadership teams and larger groups of leaders.

• Design and facilitate interventions using sparring, facilitation, coaching, and consultation to build leader capability in line with enterprise expectations.

• Act as the primary point of contact for designated EVP areas or geographies to support Lines of Business (LoB) and local People & Organisation (P&O) teams in developing and delivering contextualised leadership development solutions.

• Implement global processes, development offerings, and standards locally, adapting global content to local contexts while maintaining alignment with global leadership frameworks.

• Collaborate with HR Business Partners and business leaders to identify leadership capability gaps and co-create targeted interventions.

• Lead innovation in leadership development by identifying, piloting, and scaling new learning approaches.

Your new department

You will be part of Novo Nordisk’ Global Leadership & Learning Center of Excellence, joining the GlobalLeadership Execution team, which consists of 9 dedicated colleagues situated both in our HQ and in different locations around the world. Based in a dynamic and collaborative environment, our team works closely with global stakeholders to shape Novo Nordisk's leadership; equipping leaders at all levels to champion change, turn strategy into real results and build an engaging learning environment for all.

**Your Skills And Qualifications

**We are looking for a candidate with the following qualifications :

• A Master’s degree in business, HR, Psychology, or a similar field.

• +10 years of proven HR experience in two or more specialised HR functions (e.g., talent development, leadership development, learning & development, performance management, HRBP).

• Strong expertise in partnering with HR business partners and line leaders to design and implement solutions.

• Experience in leadership development and/or business HR consulting.

• Effective communication skills, including written, oral, and presentation skills.

• Strategic thinking, stakeholder influence, and relationship-building skills.

• Cultural intelligence and adaptability in a global and matrixed environment

**Nice To Have

**Experience from geographical areas other than your home country. - Knowledge of industry best practices and trends in learning science, talent strategy, and effective measurement of leadership development. - Leadership experience and experience leading organisational transformation work across stakeholder matrices. - Strong coaching skills, process facilitation skills, and practical experience working with team development. - Data-driven decision-making and evaluation skills.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,600 to 1,091,600 DKK.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Working at Novo Nordisk

Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with an unconventional spirit, a rare determination and a constant curiosity. For over 100 years this unordinary mindset has seen us build a company unlike any other. One where a collective passion for our purpose, mutual respect and a willingness to go beyond what we know delivers extraordinary results

**What We Offer

**There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

More information

For further information please contact, Associate Director, Louise Brinkmann at +45 34485069

**Deadline

**13 November, 2026.

**About Kanpla

**Kanpla helps contract caterers create better dining experiences while cutting food waste. What started as a school project now serves more than 800,000 users across 5,000+ locations in 14 countries.

We're a team of 70+ and are growing aggressively across both Europe, UK & the US.

Our revenue comes from three places: software subscriptions, card payments on our platform, and the hardware and services we sell alongside our software. All of that runs through three legal entities (Denmark, the UK and the US) and three accounting systems. That's a lot of moving parts. So far, our VP of Finance has built and run the accounting setup, with support from our external partner ScaleUp Finance. As we grow, we want a dedicated person to take full ownership of the accounting & monthly close. That's where you come in.

**About The Role

**This is an ownership role. You'll be responsible and accountable for Kanpla's accounting function: the close, the numbers and the processes behind them.

The setup is up and running today, so you won't be starting from scratch. Our VP of Finance will onboard you and hand over the accounting, so you can take full ownership as quickly as possible. From there, the function is yours to run. ScaleUp handles day-to-day bookkeeping, payroll and VAT for our Danish parent company, and Karl, our part-time Finance Associate, supports you on the daily tasks.

Your job is to make sure everything going into the books is complete and correct, and that everything coming out of them is accurate and on time. Over time, we want to bring more of the work in-house and use external partners where it actually makes sense. You'll drive that, together with our VP of Finance.

You'll own finance operations end to end: what we invoice, what we collect, what we pay, what we pay our people, how we close the books and what we owe in VAT. That covers Denmark (e-conomic), the UK (Xero) and the US (QuickBooks).

We're also tidying up our structure across countries and investing heavily in automation, AI and data across the company, including a move to a new group-wide accounting / ERP system down the line. So there's plenty to build, not just to maintain.

This is a hands-on role, not a pure reporting job. You'll be accountable for making sure our numbers can be trusted, and you'll keep improving the processes behind them.

What you'll do

• Run the group close (monthly, quarterly and year-end) and lock the numbers on time, reviewing ScaleUp Finance's work along the way.

• Own AR and AP end to end: invoicing, collections, bank reconciliation and supplier payments.

• Make sure revenue matches across CRM, billing and accounting.

• Own VAT reporting across our markets, working with our external advisers.

• Manage payroll in Denmark, the UK and the US, including Employer of Record setups.

• Keep hardware margins on budget and sales in line with Incoterms and VAT, together with our Head of Hardware.

• Prepare financial statements and support budgeting and variance analysis.

• Be the main point of contact for our auditors.

• Keep improving controls and processes, and cut manual work.

What you'll bring

There's more than one route into this role. Strong candidates will probably bring most of the following:

• 4+ years in accounting or finance or finance operations, in a growing international company or an audit or accounting firm.

• Solid knowledge of Danish accounting rules, as our parent company operates under Danish law.

• Hands-on experience owning a month-end close, ideally with an external accounting partner.

• Solid AR, AP and European VAT experience.

• Experience with e-conomic, Xero or QuickBooks, and the confidence to learn the others fast.

• Precision with reconciliations, and the habit of finding the root cause.

• The judgement to push back, and the pragmatism to find a way that works.

• Clear written English.

**Nice to have

**

• Experience from an international scale-up.

• Payroll experience, ideally across countries.

• UK or US accounting (or you'll pick it up on the job).

• ERP implementation or migration experience.

• Experience with hardware or Incoterms.

• Danish language skills.

What we offer

• Real ownership, with a direct line to the VP of Finance.

• A broad role across three countries, software, hardware, payments and payroll.

• The chance to shape our finance function, and grow with it.

• A competitive salary and real support for your development.

• Remote-first working and two off-sites or workcations a year.

Practical details

This is a full-time, permanent role, ideally based in Copenhagen, where our VP of Finance and the rest of the finance team sit. It covers our entities in Denmark, the UK and the US.

You'll report to Felix, our VP of Finance, and be part of a small finance team that also includes Karl, our part-time Finance Associate, who helps with accounts receivable, accounts payable, VAT and billing. Day to day, you'll work with Customer Success, Sales and Operations on invoicing and collections, and with our Head of Hardware on hardware. Externally, you'll work with ScaleUp, our auditors, tax advisers, payroll and Employer of Record providers, and payment partners.

We review applications on a rolling basis and aim to fill the role as soon as possible.
