**Turn our existing client base into our biggest growth engine, and kick-start your career in account-based sales!

**As a fulltime Account Development Representative at Relesys, you will play a pivotal role in unlocking the growth potential within our existing client portfolio. Where the Business Development team focuses on opening new doors, you focus on going deeper - identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities across our already strong client relationships with brands like Salling Group, COOP, Carlsberg, Vestas, Specsavers, Joe & the Juice, and many more.

In this role, you will work closely alongside our Account Manager and Client Success Managers, reporting to the Director of Sales based in Copenhagen. Together you will map white space, spot expansion signals, and book qualified meetings for our Account Managers and CSMs to take forward. It is a unique position at the intersection of sales and client relationships - and a powerful stepping stone towards becoming an Account Manager, Account Executive, or Client Success Manager 🚀

This is an exciting and transformative time to join Relesys. In strategic partnership with Private Equity fund Copilot Capital, the coming years will bring extensive growth and opportunities along the way. You'll get a unique chance to make a tremendous impact - not just on new business, but on the clients who are already trusting us to power their frontline workforce every single day.

**What You'll Be Doing

**

• Account-Based Outreach Generate qualified upsell and cross-sell pipeline, and execute structured, targeted outreach to contacts within existing client accounts - across cold calling, email, and LinkedIn. Engage new stakeholders, reactivate dormant contacts, and expand your footprint within each account.

• Expansion Opportunity Identification Map organizational white space and work with internal data and client insights to spot signals of growth potential - new departments, new markets, leadership changes, or product gaps - and translate these into qualified conversations.

• Pipeline Qualification & Meeting Booking Understand the current state of each client relationship, map out decision-makers and influencers, qualify expansion opportunities, and book meetings directly with the relevant Account Manager or CSM - handing off with context and confidence.

• Sales & CS Collaboration Partner with Business Development Consultants, Account Managers, and Client Success Managers to align on account health, priorities, and timing. Share insights from outreach to sharpen targeting and messaging.

• Market & Product Knowledge Become an expert with the Relesys solutions, our value proposition, and how different modules and use cases apply across industries. Stay current on trends in retail & hospitality, and connect it to our product releases and roadmap to articulate ROI to existing clients.

• Sales Discipline Own your activity metrics, pipeline targets, and weekly sales rhythm. Continuously improve outreach quality, conversion rates, and stakeholder mapping.

We invest heavily in training, coaching, and structured development to help you grow.

**Who are you?

**

• 6+ months of experience in outbound sales development, account development, or a client-facing commercial role - B2B SaaS experience is a strong advantage

• Comfortable with proactive outreach including cold calling, and building relationships in an account-based context - you know how to add value from the first conversation

• Strong desire to understand clients deeply: their business, their challenges, and where Relesys can help them grow

• Outstanding communication skills across phone, email, and LinkedIn - you engage stakeholders at multiple levels with confidence and clarity

• Thrive in a fast-paced with a target-driven environment and manage multiple priorities

• Experience from or genuine interest in the retail, hospitality, or frontline workforce industries is a plus - especially if you've worked as a frontline employee yourself

• Experience with MEDDPICC or Command of the Message is an advantage

• Preferred qualifications include a bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field

• Fluent in English, both spoken and written 🇬🇧 and one of the Scandinavian languages.

• Based in or near Copenhagen

**What do we offer?

**

• "Once in a lifetime" growth opportunity in an aspiring unicorn business that will 5x over the coming 4-5 years backed by the Private Equity fund, Copilot Capital

• Career path towards becoming specialist within your field, Account Executive, Account Manager or similar

• Occasional travels to Relesys global offices in line with onboarding, QBRs, Company events etc.

• A collaborative and thriving office-first culture where team spirit and fun are at the heart of everything we do

• Delicious lunch scheme with cake every Thursday

• Homemade buns every Wednesday made by our lovely Piccoline

• Free barista coffee, tea, and a fridge filled with soda

• Massage sessions every second Monday

• Our stylish Nordhavn office, just 100 meters from Orientkaj Metro, offers easy access to public transport and stunning ocean views

• Thriving Culture Club that plans Friday bars, running club, Tuesday fitness w. professional instructor, Wednesday bathing club, Summer parties, Christmas Parties and many other social events!

**When and where do you start?

**We are looking for a colleague to start **in November - December 2026!

**We are welcoming applications from candidates based **in or near Copenhagen.

**Apply for the position by sending your CV through the Apply button.

**We can't wait to hear from you!

****Who are we?

**Relesys isn't just another SaaS company; we are a dynamic force revolutionizing communication and performance management platforms. Established in 2014, we set out on a mission to bridge the gap between HQ and non-desk workers, fostering a thriving workforce.

What value do we bring? People are the heartbeat of our client's business. When employees are thriving and successful, businesses flourish and retention rates increase. Relesys enables our clients to achieve this through an all-in-one app that streamlines communications, training, and daily operations into their own customized and ever-evolving app 📱

With clients such as Salling Group, COOP, Carlsberg, and Vestas - to name just a few - Relesys serves clients in 15 different countries, supporting them in 40 languages with +500,000 licenses across 20,000 stores and users in +100 countries. We have a strong presence in the Nordics and EMEA, and we continue to increasingly attract clients from across the globe, as we are breaking into new, dynamic markets.

At Relesys, we're shaping the future for frontline workers across various industries: Retail, Hospitality, Production/Manufacturing, and Transportation – while having FUN, as our rule number one! Join us on this thrilling journey as we grow and venture into new horizons.

**Our Culture

**Building a world-class organization and culture is our highest priority. We believe in the talent of our people and in long-term collaborations where we value an informal yet highly professional culture. We always go 'the extra mile' for our colleagues and clients, but rule number one - Have fun! This rule is always at the forefront of our minds when we come to work, creating an environment that is filled with passion, energy, and inspiration. We are eager to see what exciting contributions you, as our new colleague, will bring, as we believe that each and every individual has a tremendous influence on the whole 🌍

**Our Tech Stack: https://stackshare.io/companies/sedna

**About Sedna:

**Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising the operating system for shipping. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. As we continue to grow and innovate, we are looking for exceptional talent to join our journey and contribute to our mission of transforming the shipping industry .

You can find out more about us on our website: https://sedna.com/

**About the role

**This role focuses on contributing to the design, development, and evolution of Sedna’s VMS (Voyage Management System). It's a mature, highly specialised platform that shipowners, operators and charterers use to run chartering, voyage operations, cargo and freight/hire invoicing.

VMS has a Java backend exposing a REST API used by our own web client (React) and directly by customers' integrations. Data lives in Oracle, including a significant amount of business logic in PL/SQL. It runs on AWS and builds through GitLab CI/CD.

Sedna VMS is in use 24/7 by shipping companies worldwide. Customers run their daily operations and invoicing on it, so correctness, performance and reliability directly affect their business.

You will play a key part in raising standards and delivering new features. You'll take real ownership of features and of how they behave in production, on a product customers run their business on, and help shape how the platform evolves. You'll work with modern AI-assisted development tools as part of everyday engineering.

**How you’ll make an impact

****Engineering and feature development

**This role contributes to both backend and frontend development. Day-to-day responsibilities include understanding requirements, shaping technical approaches, writing code, and contributing to automated tests. Development work spans a mix of new features, improvements, and maintenance, driven by both customer and product needs.

**System architecture and modernisation

**The role includes participating in ongoing efforts to refine and modernise the platform. This involves contributing to technical upgrade work, improving system structure, and supporting longer-term architectural direction as the product grows. Opportunities exist to participate in design discussions and help shape solutions that improve system performance, reliability, and extensibility.

**Quality, testing, and delivery practices

**The team maintains a focus on software quality. We combine unit tests, API regression tests (Postman) and UI tests (Playwright) with peer code review on every merge request. Releases are built and tested through GitLab CI/CD. We're actively improving here: getting more of our test suites running automatically in CI and making them reliable. Engineers who want to drive that, will have room to do it.

**Collaboration with product and customer-facing teams

**The role involves close collaboration with product managers through refinement, planning, and solution discussions. Engineers also interact with Customer Support on cases that need engineering input, and, for larger projects, join customer conversations to validate technical approaches.

**Continuous improvement and documentation

**We treat documentation, including API references, design decisions and runbooks, as part of delivering a change. Much of VMS's knowledge still sits with experienced team members, and capturing it in written, searchable form is an active priority. We also reserve time for technical debt and internal improvements.

**In your first 90 days, you can expect

**

• Month 1: Build your understanding of Sedna’s architecture and our products. Get set up with the VMS codebase, your dev environment and the release process, and ship your first changes. Meet your team, product manager and key customer-facing colleagues. Learn the maritime workflows our customers depend on.

• Month 2: Take ownership of a well-scoped piece of work from refinement with product through to release. Contribute to design discussions, give timely and constructive code review feedback. Shadow the on-call rotation and get familiar with runbooks and production tooling.

• Month 3: Lead the technical approach on a complex feature or improvement within your team, working independently and raising risks and dependencies early. Join the on-call rotation. Contribute improvements to tests, runbooks or documentation based on what you found hard to learn, and support technical validation in a customer conversation where relevant.

**What we're looking for:

****Essential experience

**Candidates typically bring three+ years of professional engineering experience from a comparable environment. Experience working on production systems where quality and reliability are important. Familiarity with a JVM language (Java, Kotlin, Scala) or a similar backend language, React or another modern frontend framework. Strong SQL and relational database skills, ideally Oracle or PostgreSQL, including query performance. Experience supporting production systems: diagnosing incidents from logs and metrics. Prior on-call experience is a plus.

**Critical skills

**A strong grasp of building and maintaining features within a larger system is helpful. Confidence with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and code review workflows is expected. Clear thinking, good problem-solving ability, and the capacity to work with domain-heavy logic contribute to success in the role. Experience with enterprise or workflow-driven applications is an advantage.

**Traits and mindset

**Curiosity and a willingness to learn the maritime domain are appreciated. A collaborative working style, comfort sharing ideas in cross-functional settings, and the ability to work independently when needed all support strong performance. Adaptability is important as the product and architecture continue to evolve.

**Core competencies

**Systems thinking, ownership of outcomes, strong communication skills, and effective collaboration are central to this role. A motivation to create value for customers and contribute to a stable, evolving platform is essential.

**What’s In Store for You

**

• A strong team. You’ll join a global team of senior and staff engineers who set a high bar and will help level you up.

• A generous salary and benefits package (depending on experience) + private medical, equity, health and wellbeing benefits, home internet contribution

• Scalability challenges. You’ll be a part of evolving our VMS system as we further develop in to a product led company.

• Customer impact. Real customers use our products everyday, you'll see your work impacting real people.

• Collaboration & autonomy. Plenty of heads-down technical work, but also close partnership with product engineers and engineering leadership.

**Our Values:

**Finally, culture is important to us, so we also look for candidates who share our values:

**Stay Ahead, Stay Agile

**

• We don’t just adapt-we anticipate change and act with confidence.

• Curiosity, data, and customer insights help us stay ahead of the curve.

• We embrace challenges as opportunities and remain resilient under pressure.

• By staying open to new ideas and ways of working, we lead the future.

**Execute With Focus

**

• We turn strategy into action, delivering measurable results that matter.

• Every initiative counts-discipline and ownership drive business impact.

• We make smart decisions with speed, balancing pace and precision.

• Clear priorities keep us focused on what moves the needle.

**Work Together, Win Together

**

• Collaboration is our superpower-we succeed as one team, internally and with customers.

• We co-create solutions, seek feedback, and build the future of Sedna together.

• Strong relationships are built on trust, respect, and shared goals.

• By aligning across teams and with customers, we unlock greater impact.

jobs.occupation: Backend Tech Lead with SRE responsibility
jobs.description:
Are you a senior backend engineer who wants to combine hands-on development with technical leadership, cloud architecture and operational responsibility?

For our client Lattec, we are looking for a hands-on Backend Tech Lead / SRE (Site Reliability Engineering) to help shape, build and operate their AWS-based backend platform. This is a key technical role in Lattec’s R&D Software organisation, where you will provide day-to-day technical leadership within the backend/SRE domain while remaining close to the code, architecture and production systems.

Lattec, based in Allerød, Denmark, has achieved significant international success with its advanced solutions for modern dairy farming. The company develops proactive analytical and sensor systems that monitor the health of dairy cows on farms, serving customers worldwide. Lattec has a strong multidisciplinary team of approx. 60 employees, around 30 in R&D including software developers, hardware, electronics and mechanical engineers, as well as chemical engineers, veterinarians and biologists.

The role as Backend Tech Lead / SRE

In this role, you will take technical ownership of the backend/SRE domain and translate overall technical direction into daily engineering execution. You will guide backend developers, contribute directly to development and strengthen the reliability, observability and operational maturity of the platform.

Lattec’s Tech Leads collaborate closely across Device, Backend/SRE and Frontend, recognising cross-team collaboration as essential to sharing priorities, managing dependencies and aligning technical decisions. This ensures a common direction and helps identify integration risks early.

What you will do

• Lead the day-to-day technical work within the backend/SRE domain.

• Actively contribute to backend development and remain close to the code and technology.

• Provide technical direction, support architectural decisions and help resolve complex technical challenges.

• Take technical ownership of SRE, reliability, observability and operability.

• Improve monitoring, incident handling, CI/CD, automation and deployment practices.

• Drive good engineering practices, code quality, maintainability and documentation.

• Work with AWS-based backend technologies, focusing on scalable, secure and reliable solutions.

• Work closely with the R&D Software Lead to translate overall R&D priorities into clear backend/SRE priorities, ensuring that incoming tasks are understood, assessed and handled in line with the wider R&D direction.

Tech stack and your experience

We expect you to bring strong, hands-on experience with several of the core technologies used in the AWS backend platform, including:

• Python for backend services, automation, data processing and AWS Lambda development.

• TypeScript for modern backend services, tooling, infrastructure definitions and integrations where relevant.

• AWS Lambda and serverless architecture, including event-driven design, scalability, security and operational robustness.

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC), such as AWS CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform or similar tools, to ensure repeatable and maintainable cloud infrastructure.

• GraphQL for new APIs, including schema design, resolver implementation, API versioning, performance considerations and alignment with frontend consumers.

• AWS services commonly used in backend platforms, such as API Gateway, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, CloudWatch and IAM.

• CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, deployment automation and production monitoring in an AWS environment.

About you

You are a senior backend engineer who enjoys combining hands-on development with technical leadership. You are comfortable making technical decisions, guiding other developers and taking responsibility for systems that need to run reliably in production.

You likely bring:

• Strong backend engineering experience, preferably in cloud-native or serverless environments.

• A practical understanding of SRE, observability and operating production systems.

• Experience designing APIs and integrations, ideally using GraphQL.

• A pragmatic approach to guiding technical decisions, fostering open collaboration and keeping momentum high.

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to work across frontend, backend and device boundaries.

• A focus on quality, security and maintainable solutions.

Fluency in English and Danish is essential.

What makes this role different

This is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position. You lead through technical expertise, collaboration and active involvement in development, staying close to the code while providing the direction needed to ensure the backend/SRE domain evolves in line with the wider platform.

The Lattec mindset

• Be curious, experiment and take pride in making things work better.

• Ask “What is the system actually doing?” — not just “Is this a software problem?”

• Work across disciplines and take responsibility for the whole solution.

• Deliver precise data that helps farmers make better decisions.

• Build reliable systems that reduce downtime and give peace of mind.

• Make advanced technology simple, so customers get the value without the hassle.

Why join Lattec?

At Lattec, you will work on technology that supports modern dairy farming and contributes to better animal welfare through advanced digital solutions. You will join a focused engineering environment where backend, frontend and device development work closely together to create robust and scalable products.

Product development at Lattec is a shared, creative journey where Product Managers, R&D specialists and engineers combine domain knowledge and technical expertise to create real value for farmers.

Lattec offers a high degree of flexibility and excellent employee benefits, including five weeks of annual holiday, five additional days off, four extra Lattec days off, a pension scheme, health insurance and a lunch scheme with themed lunch days.

More about the company

Lattec I/S was founded in 2001 and employs approx. 60 people in Allerød, with a few additional employees based in Fredericia. The company is owned by the Swedish company DeLaval, which has more than 4,500 employees worldwide.

You will become part of a company with dedicated employees, a flat organisational structure and an informal working environment, where teamwork, collaboration and professional excellence are highly valued.

Read more at www.lattec.com.

Are you interested in joining Lattec?

Please do not hesitate to apply by sending your CV and a short application. If you have any questions, you are most welcome to contact Director Sara Juhl at Bloom via sj@bloom.dk or phone +45 20 86 08 65.

We look forward to hearing from you!

If you want a hands-on technical leadership role where you can strengthen connected device development and bridge software and hardware, this could be the right opportunity for you!

For our client Lattec, we are looking for a hands-on Device Tech Lead to help shape, build and integrate software for connected devices and embedded systems. This is a key technical role in Lattec’s R&D Software organisation, where you will provide day-to-day technical leadership within the Device domain while staying close to the code, hardware and architecture.

Lattec, based in Allerød, Denmark, has achieved significant international success with its advanced solutions for modern dairy farming. The company develops proactive analytical and sensor systems that monitor the health of dairy cows on farms, serving customers worldwide. Lattec has a strong multidisciplinary team of approximately 60 employees, around 30 of whom work in R&D, including software developers, hardware, electronics and mechanical engineers, as well as chemical engineers, veterinarians and biologists.

The role as Device Tech Lead

In this role, you will take technical ownership of the Device domain and translate overall technical direction into daily engineering execution. You will guide device software developers, contribute directly to development and strengthen the reliability, maintainability and integration of connected devices.

Lattec’s Tech Leads collaborate closely across Device, Backend/SRE and Frontend, recognising cross-team collaboration as essential to sharing priorities, managing dependencies and aligning technical decisions. This ensures a common direction and helps identify integration risks early.

What you will do

• Lead the day-to-day technical work within the Device domain.

• Actively contribute to device software development and remain close to the code, products, hardware and technology.

• Provide technical direction, support architectural decisions and help resolve complex technical challenges.

• Take technical ownership of hardware/software integration, ensuring robust interaction between embedded systems, connected devices and physical hardware.

• Drive good engineering practices, code quality, maintainability, testability and documentation.

• Strengthen device-level reliability, diagnostics, deployment practices and operational confidence.

• Work across our technology stack, including:

• Linux-based IoT systems

• Python

• C#/.NET on Linux

• C for MPU-based embedded systems and precise hardware control

• Work closely with Hardware and Mechanical engineering on device-level solutions and troubleshooting.

• Work with the R&D Software Lead on overall architecture, technical direction and engineering priorities.

Tech stack and your experience

We expect you to bring strong, hands-on experience with several of the core technologies and challenges in our Device domain, including:

• Linux-based IoT systems, including device software, connectivity, diagnostics and operating close to the hardware.

• Python for device software, tooling, automation, testing or data handling.

• C#/.NET development for device applications, tooling or integrations where relevant.

• C development for microcontrollers such as STM32, AVR, PIC or similar embedded platforms.

• Hardware/software integration, troubleshooting and practical debugging across software, electronics and physical device behaviour.

• Designing reliable software for physical devices where timing, robustness, maintainability and recovery matter.

• Experience with automated testing, release practices, diagnostics and maintainable development workflows for device software.

About you

You are a senior software engineer who enjoys combining hands-on development with technical leadership. You are comfortable working close to the hardware while understanding the broader software architecture, cloud/backend dependencies and user-facing product needs.

You likely bring:

• Strong device, embedded, IoT or systems software experience.

• A pragmatic approach to guiding technical decisions, fostering open collaboration and keeping momentum high.

• The ability to work across frontend, backend/SRE, device, hardware and mechanical boundaries.

• A strong focus on quality, maintainability, reliability and practical engineering trade-offs.

• The ability to communicate device constraints and risks clearly so the wider software team can make informed decisions.

Fluency in English and Danish is essential.

What makes this role different

This is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position. You lead through technical expertise, collaboration and active involvement in development, staying close to the products and technology while guiding the Device domain forward.

The Lattec mindset

• Be curious, experiment and take pride in making things work better.

• Ask “What is the system actually doing?” — not just “Is this a software problem?”

• Work across disciplines and take responsibility for the whole solution.

• Deliver precise data that helps farmers make better decisions.

• Build reliable systems that reduce downtime and give peace of mind.

• Make advanced technology simple, so customers get the value without the hassle.

Why join Lattec?

At Lattec, you will work on technology that supports modern dairy farming and contributes to better animal welfare through advanced digital solutions. You will join a multidisciplinary engineering environment where software, hardware and device development come together to create robust and useful products.

Product development at Lattec is a shared, creative journey where Product Managers, R&D specialists and engineers combine deep domain knowledge and technical expertise to create real value for farmers.

Lattec offers a high degree of flexibility and excellent employee benefits, including five weeks of annual holiday, five additional days off, four extra Lattec days off, a pension scheme, health insurance and a lunch scheme with themed lunch days.

More about the company

Lattec I/S was founded in 2001 and employs approximately 60 people in Allerød, with a few additional employees based in Fredericia. The company is owned by the Swedish company DeLaval, which has more than 4,500 employees worldwide.

You will become part of a company with dedicated employees, a flat organisational structure and an informal working environment, where teamwork, collaboration and professional excellence are highly valued.

Read more at www.lattec.com.

Are you interested in joining Lattec?

Please do not hesitate to apply by sending your CV and a short application.

If you have any questions, you are most welcome to contact Director Sara Juhl at Bloom via sj@bloom.dk or phone +45 20 86 08 65.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**Your impact begins here

**As Sr Accounting & Digitalisation Partner, you will shape how accounting works across Business Area(BA) West. You will spot where processes can be simpler, more standardised and more automated, then work with colleagues in Accounting, Finance and IT to make those changes real. You will be the Accounting expert in the team, providing guidance on complect accounting issues. Across nine affiliates in 11 countries, your work will give colleagues better tools, a smoother user experience and more time for high-quality financial management.

**What You’ll Bring

**

• A master’s degree in business, finance, economics or a similar field.

• 8–10 years of relevant experience from finance, consulting or a related environment, including accounting, finance transformation, process management or digitalisation.

• A strong understanding of accounting processes and the needs of internal stakeholders.

• Experience driving process improvement, standardisation or digitalisation initiatives.

• Project experience and the ability to work across functions and organisational levels.

• Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder-management skills.

• A structured, proactive approach, with the ability to turn business needs into practical improvements.

• A collaborative mindset and the confidence to challenge existing ways of working constructively.

• Experience in emerging technologies, including how AI and automation can improve finance processes, decision support and ways of working.

**What You’ll Do

**

• You will be the link between central initiatives, accounting expertise and what the business needs day to day. Your focus will be on:

• Finding opportunities to digitalise, automate and simplify accounting processes, and proposing improvements that raise efficiency, quality, compliance and user experience.

• Driving standardisation and alignment of processes, tools and ways of working across Business Area West.

• Supporting the implementation of central initiatives as a strategic partner, and leading projects that draw on your accounting and process expertise.

• Providing process and accounting sparring to colleagues.

• Taking ownership, governance and continuous development of your assigned area.

• Be the link between Accounting Manager, Controller and out Global Shared Service centre in Bangalore

• Building strong relationships with stakeholders across Accounting, Finance, IT and the wider business.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Accounting & Taxation Centre of Excellence for BA West, based in Ørestad, Copenhagen, and report to the Associate Director Accounting & Taxation COE. The team is responsible for accounting and taxation for the nine affiliates and provides expertise, governance and support across accounting, tax, compliance and process excellence.

The team includes Accounting Managers and controllers who work as dedicated finance partners to individual affiliates. You and one colleague focus on Business Area West as a whole. Your affiliates cover Denmark & Iceland, Sweden, Norway, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Belgium & Luxembourg, Finland, Ireland and Portugal.

You will work closely with colleagues in Accounting, Finance, IT and the wider business to turn ideas into standardised, efficient ways of working. Challenging the status quo constructively, and speaking up when things are stalling, is part of how this team moves forward.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will be trusted to own your area and make your voice heard, with real scope to shape how accounting works across eleven countries. You will build new skills by working across finance, IT and the business, and by exploring how AI and automation can improve finance processes. You will be supported to perform at your best and grow alongside your colleagues.

• Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,560.00 to 1,091,600.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to be a trusted accounting partner and to make accounting simpler, smarter and more digital across Business Area West, apply for the Sr Accounting & Digitalisation Partner role by 19.11.2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Are you passionate about leading IT compliance in a modern, regulated environment?

Do you combine deep knowledge of GxP, SOX, validation, and emerging regulatory frameworks with the ability to set direction, help people grow, and enable pragmatic delivery?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Head of IT Compliance.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking an experienced and people-focused Head of IT Compliance to lead our IT Compliance competency team and shape how compliance enables innovation and delivery across Global IT. You will set direction for the area, guide a team of trusted compliance specialists, and partner closely with IT product and platform teams to translate regulatory requirements into practical, risk-based ways of working.

As Head of IT Compliance at Ascendis Pharma, you will combine strategic leadership with hands-on execution. You will lead and develop the team while also working alongside them, shaping the direction of the function while actively contributing to its delivery and success.

At Ascendis Pharma, we take a modern approach to IT compliance. Our ambition is to enable continuous compliance through modern IT tools, shift-left testing principles, and agile ways of working. As a leader and senior role model, you will champion critical thinking and a strong quality mindset, challenge unnecessary complexity, and create clarity and confidence for both your team and stakeholders.

You will join Global IT and report directly to Henrik Aagaard Linnemann, Global Head of Digitalization. You will be based at our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Lead and further develop the IT Compliance function, including setting direction, developing team capabilities, and fostering a culture of quality, learning, and critical thinking.

• Partner with IT Product and Platform teams operating in GxP-regulated environments to enable compliant, efficient, and business-focused delivery.

• Serve as a trusted advisor to leaders and stakeholders on IT compliance, quality management, computer system validation, testing, and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Drive the continuous evolution of the IT Quality Management System (IT QMS), governance frameworks, and related compliance processes, including SOX controls.

• Monitor and assess emerging regulatory requirements, ensuring that relevant changes are reflected in IT policies, standards, procedures, and ways of working.

• Promote modern compliance practices by advancing continuous compliance principles, shift-left testing approaches, and agile methodologies across Global IT.

• Build compliance capabilities across the organization through training, coaching, knowledge sharing, and awareness initiatives

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a relevant academic degree and bring extensive experience from regulated pharmaceutical or life-science environments, ideally including 10+ years within IT compliance, quality, validation, or related disciplines.

You have leadership experience and can combine strategic direction with practical support to teams and stakeholders.

Furthermore, you have:

• Strong experience with GxP, pharmaceutical IT compliance, computer system validation, validation planning, testing, test execution, and quality assurance

• Solid knowledge of SOX controls and regulatory frameworks such as 21 CFR Part 11, EudraLex Volume 4 Annex 11, GAMP 5, the EU AI Act, NIS2, and European data privacy regulations

• A strong technical understanding and the ability to translate complex regulatory expectations into clear, practical guidance for highly skilled IT professionals

• Experience supporting agile product and platform teams while maintaining appropriate regulatory oversight and a risk-based approach

• Experience developing people through leadership, coaching, training, and knowledge sharing, and the ability to build trusted relationships across functions and geographies

Key competencies:

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

To succeed in this role, we expect you to be pragmatic, collaborative, and self-driven. You are capable of managing priorities independently, build trusted relationships across stakeholders, and enjoy coaching and developing colleagues through knowledge sharing and guidance.

You possess a strong technical understanding and can communicate effectively with highly skilled IT professionals.

You naturally act as a role model, demonstrating a strong quality mindset, sound judgement, critical thinking, and risk-based decision making. Furthermore, you maintain an up-to-date understanding of evolving regulatory expectations and thrive in environments where continuous improvement, innovation, and practical problem solving are valued.

Travel: Approx. 5-10 days per year.

Office: Ascendis Pharma, Tuborg Havn, Hellerup, Denmark. Global IT is a global function with presence in Denmark, Germany, and the United States, and flexibility is expected when collaborating across time zones.

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform. Applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the position or the company, please contact Henrik Aagaard Linnemann, hal@ascendispharma.com

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

A note to recruiters:

We do not allow external search party solicitation. Presentation of candidates without written permission from the Ascendis Pharma HR team (specifically from: Talent Acquisition Partner or Human Resources Director) is not allowed. If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged.

**ORDERYOYO – Senior Data & AI Platform Engineer

**Remote

• Quarterly team gatherings in one of our global offices

Join OrderYOYO’s Data team to build the data pipelines and lakehouse that power executive reporting and merchant insights across our platform, and automate how we deliver finance data and AI-driven data products to the rest of the business.

You’ll own complex changes from technical design through release and production operation, working closely with the leadership team, Finance, Product and fellow engineers. Your work will improve the accuracy and reliability of our reporting, merchant insights and finance data, while reducing routine manual Finance work.

Our data platform runs in a Microsoft Azure cloud environment, and we’re moving it to Microsoft Fabric. We value transferable experience: strong Azure Databricks or Synapse engineers who can quickly develop deep Fabric expertise are encouraged to apply. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a pure architecture, BI or people-management position, and you’ll regularly design, code, troubleshoot and operate production data solutions.

**Role Mission

**Build and evolve OrderYOYO’s data platform into a single source of truth for executive reporting, merchant insights, finance automation and AI, leading the move to a modern Microsoft Fabric lakehouse. You’ll help strengthen the reliability and quality of our data in production while building AI into how we deliver data products and supporting our growing international restaurant platform.

**Core Responsibilities

**

• Design, build and operate production-grade data solutions in Microsoft Fabric across Lakehouse, Warehouse, notebooks, pipelines and related platform capabilities.

• Build and run production pipelines in Fabric, Python and PySpark that are tested and maintainable, not just notebooks.

• Design ingestion and transformation patterns that scale across multiple source systems, databases and business domains while controlling source impact, concurrency and platform cost.

• Manage Fabric capacity and cost, and retire redundant legacy layers.

• Lead migrations from legacy to modern platforms with metric parity, stakeholder sign-off, change control and safe decommissioning.

• Run the platform in production: monitoring, alerting, incident triage, root-cause analysis, data-quality checks, lineage and runbooks.

• Diagnose and resolve production issues across SQL, Spark, pipelines and semantic models, including performance degradation, data failures and capacity/resource constraints.

• Support and evolve governed semantic models and reusable metric definitions, working closely with analytics and business stakeholders to ensure performance, consistency and reliability.

• Build AI into the platform and our delivery: RAG, Azure OpenAI and agents, with prompt and version management.

• Deliver applied data science such as churn, recommendations, personalisation, fraud or risk models, and show the results.

• Work with executives, Finance, Product and engineering, and judge when to move fast, standardise, automate or hold.

**Must-have Requirements

**

• 6+ years of relevant data experience, including substantial recent hands-on data engineering or data-platform engineering responsibility in production environments.

• Demonstrated ability to independently take a data-engineering problem from requirements and technical design through implementation, production deployment, monitoring and ongoing operation.

• Deep hands-on Microsoft Fabric, or strong Synapse, Databricks or Delta experience with a clear path to Fabric.

• Strong understanding of lakehouse architecture and Delta-based data engineering, including partitioning, schema evolution, file optimisation and performance considerations.

• Expert SQL and T-SQL, including complex modelling and tuning.

• Production-grade Python or PySpark.

• Strong experience designing and implementing incremental data ingestion patterns, including approaches such as CDC, change tracking or watermarks, with reliable merge/upsert, replay and idempotent processing.

• Experience with analytical and semantic data modelling, ideally with Power BI/Fabric semantic models, including performance optimisation, governance and reusable business metrics.

• Working knowledge of Azure platform fundamentals including Azure SQL, ADLS/OneLake, Entra ID, managed identities, RBAC and Key Vault.

• A track record of leading a legacy-to-modern migration.

• Real, hands-on AI engineering beyond out-of-the-box Copilot.

• Concrete data science or ML models you delivered, with results.

**Strong-to-have Experience

**

• Strong Power BI/Fabric experience, including Direct Lake, DAX, semantic model performance tuning, incremental refresh and capacity considerations.

• Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Terraform, Bicep or equivalent tooling.

• Data platform experience in SaaS, marketplace, fintech, payments, e-commerce or multi-region businesses.

**Who We Are

**At OrderYOYO, company culture comes first. We create a positive, inclusive environment where people are trusted to do their best work and take ownership of what they build. We look for engineers who take ownership, raise risks early, explain decisions clearly, collaborate respectfully and follow through on commitments.

Our values describe what that looks like day to day:

• Passion: Adaptable and positive in a fast-moving environment, proactive about improving how things work.

• Action: Leads by example and takes the initiative rather than waiting to be asked.

• Compassion: Supports colleagues and considers the impact of decisions on merchants and teammates.

• One Team: Communicates clearly in writing and in person, stays calm under pressure and shares information openly.

We help restaurants succeed online by providing branded websites, mobile apps and tailored marketing solutions, giving them full control of their business. By removing high commission fees charged by third-party platforms, we empower restaurants to grow sustainably.

**What We Offer

**

• A salary of up to £80,000 per year (or local equivalent).

• A remote role, with quarterly in-person gatherings at one of our global offices.

• Ownership of a business-critical data and AI platform.

• A collaborative, international engineering team.

**Your impact begins here

**As Associate Project Portfolio Manager, you will give Novo’s investment (CAPEX) projects the overview they need to move forward. Working across projects rather than inside one, you will make sure governance is followed, turn project data into clear dashboards and visuals, and spot obstacles early. Your work supports the teams decisions at every gate, helps project managers deliver, and keeps investments in production capacity on track for people who rely on Novo’s treatments.

**What You’ll Bring

**

• Experience from project coordination, project support or a junior or associate project role, or from a finance setting that follows investment projects, with a clear understanding of what it means to work to a defined project model.

• Comfort with numbers: you enjoy collecting, checking and consolidating schedules, budgets and forecasts, and presenting them in Excel and PowerPoint in a way others can act on.

• A structured, systematic way of working. You like seeing how systems and processes fit together, and you tackle problems with method rather than improvisation.

• The persistence to stay with a task until it is finished, month after month, and keep the routine running.

• The ability to influence without formal authority and to explain complex topics clearly to different stakeholders.

• Relevant education in engineering, business administration, finance, project management or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Experience as an Associate Project Manager.

• Experience with CAPEX or other investment projects.

• A track record of creating overviews of complex systems and processes.

• Manufacturing or regulated-industry experience, including awareness of GxP, and project management training.

**What You’ll Do

**You will be the managers right hand in project governance, working across the investment portfolio to make progress visible and decisions easier.

• Support the gatekeeper role by checking that deliverables for each project gate are in place, of the right quality and on time, and that decision material is ready for approval.

• Collect, consolidate and quality-check schedules, budgets, forecasts and status updates with project managers and Finance.

• Build dashboards and visuals that show priorities, budgets, milestones, risks and dependencies, so the manager can quickly judge whether a project is ready to move on.

• Anticipate obstacles across projects, such as shared resources, overlapping timelines and dependencies, and support project managers before they become problems.

• Connect project managers who are at similar stages or share equipment or resources, so they can help each other and align early.

• Prepare analyses and scenarios for the half-yearly portfolio prioritisation, and improve templates, reporting and working practices with the team.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join a Project Management Office for investment projects in Global Manufacturing & Supply, where colleagues work across the value chain to scale and deliver Novo products for the people who need them. The office is responsible for executing investment projects at a finished product site and for managing the portfolio, including which projects to prioritise and whether resources are in place to deliver them.

You will report to Sebastian, who leads a team of 15 and acts as gatekeeper for governance in project management. You will work side by side with them and present your analyses together. Your closest partners will be the project managers, project owners and sponsors, and Finance and controlling colleagues. You will also draw on input from site management, engineering, operations and Quality, and prepare material for the leadership forums that approve each gate.

The role is a stepping stone. By seeing how projects run and how the factory works, you can grow towards portfolio manager or project manager.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will have real responsibility from the start, with a hiring manager who wants to develop you and share what they know. You will learn how investment projects are governed and delivered, build skills across portfolio management, project controls and data visualisation, and get a close view of how a production site works. Your voice will be heard, and your ideas for improving how the PMO works will be welcome.

Expect clear performance expectations, honest feedback and colleagues who share knowledge and help each other grow.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 570,200 to 838,100 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to bring clarity and momentum to Novo’s investment projects, apply for the Associate Project Portfolio Manager role by 9 November 2026.

For further information, please contact Sebastian Wagner-Crafack, Associate Director, on SNWC@novonordisk.com

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.description:

Are you an experienced product management leader who thrives in complex, international environments and enjoys turning category strategy into action? Do you have a passion for building high-performing teams, driving organisational change, and creating clarity across a diverse portfolio of products and brands? Then this Senior Director, Global Product Management might spark your interest.

Shape the future of global diagnostics product management

We are looking for a Senior Director, Global Product Management to lead and further develop our Global Product Management function within Demant Diagnostics. In this role, you will set the strategic direction for our product categories, strengthen category management capabilities across the organisation, and play a key role in shaping the future of a business undergoing significant transformation.

The role reports to Jacob Torpe Winter, Head of Global Strategic Marketing, and is based at our Diagnostics headquarters in Smørum, Copenhagen, with the opportunity to work from home when tasks allow.

Make a visible impact on a growing global business

As Senior Director, Global Product Management, you will lead a team of category managers and be responsible for building a best-in-class product management organisation across our diagnostics portfolio. You will ensure that category strategies, product roadmaps, and brand positioning support our long-term growth ambitions while creating alignment across brands, functions, and geographies.

The role combines strategic leadership, organisational development, stakeholder management, and change leadership. You will work closely with leaders across our global brands, Global Strategic Marketing, R&D, and Operations to establish strong ways of working and deliver greater strategic focus across the portfolio.

Join a business in transformation

Demant Diagnostics is a global provider of diagnostic solutions within hearing and balance assessment. As part of an evolving organisation, we are strengthening our global product management capabilities and creating a more structured and data-driven approach to category management.

This role offers a unique opportunity to influence both the future of our product portfolio and the way we work as an organisation. You will join a highly collaborative leadership environment where your experience, perspective, and leadership will help drive meaningful change across the business.

Lead strategy, people and transformation

Your key responsibilities include:

• Define and execute the global category management strategy across the Diagnostics portfolio aligned with the Diagnostics multi brand strategy.

• Lead, coach, and develop the team and global product management organization

• Establish effective ways of working, governance, and collaboration across brands and functions.

• Drive category-level strategies and category-level initiatives, product roadmaps, and lifecycle management plans across multiple brands ensuring adoption of strategic priorities.

• Partner with brands, R&D, Commercial Excellence, and Operations leadership to translate customer needs into portfolio decisions.

• Lead organisational change initiatives and ensure adoption of strategic priorities across stakeholders.

• Build strong relationships with senior leaders, customers, and key industry stakeholders.

You Are An Experienced Product Management Leader

Success in this role requires a strong combination of strategic thinking, commercial acumen, leadership capability, and change management experience. You are comfortable navigating complexity, influencing senior stakeholders, and creating alignment in a matrix organisation.

We imagine that you have:

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in business, marketing, engineering, or a related discipline combines with extensive experience with product & category management.

• A proven track record of leading high-performing teams and organisational change while delivering sustainable business transformation

• Solid experience from a global MedTech, Life Sciences, healthcare, diagnostics, or similarly complex B2B environment. Experience with audiology or diagnostics products is highly desirable.

• Strong commercial understanding and an ability to translate market insights into strategic decisions

• Experience leading senior specialists or leaders within a matrix organisation

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills

The ideal candidate has built their career within product management and understands how to combine strategic direction with practical execution. You are a confident and approachable leader who knows how to challenge constructively, develop people, and create followership through credibility, collaboration, and clear communication. You bring humility, curiosity, and a genuine interest in helping others succeed while driving ambitious change.

Want to join the team?

If you are motivated by the opportunity to lead a strategically important function, develop a high-performing team, and help shape the future of Demant Diagnostics, we would love to hear from you.

Please submit your application no later than 18th of November. Please note we only accept applications submitted via our application system in accordance with the GDPR legislation.

• We aim to conduct 1st round of interviews on Monday the 20th of November

• We aim to conduct 2nd round of interviews on Thursday the 26th of November

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion (DE&I) and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is part of our cultural DNA. Women in STEM areas are particularly encouraged to apply, as Demant supports United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality.

About Demant Diagnostics

Demant’s diagnostics business is a trusted diagnostic solutions provider in the field of hearing and balance assessment. This group of international companies develops, manufactures, and markets a wide variety of technological solutions globally, delivering instruments, software, training, and services that support the entire diagnostic journey – from early screening to advanced clinical assessment and balance treatment. Our portfolio includes well-known brands such as Maico, Interacoustics, E3, Amplivox, GSI Grason-Stadler, MedRx, Audioscan, and Inventis.

Our products are sold in more than 100 countries through an extensive network of sales companies and distributors.

For more information, please visit: www.demant.com.

jobs.occupation: Senior Engineering Specialist – Drug Substance Manufacturing
jobs.description:
**Shape the engineering solutions behind vaccines that protect lives every day

**Are you an experienced bioprocess engineer who combines deep technical expertise with the ability to set direction and bring people together?

Join Bavarian Nordic and take a leading role in shaping the processes and systems that support our Drug Substance manufacturing.

From major capital projects and technology transfers to solving complex manufacturing challenges, you will help ensure our processes are robust, scalable, and ready for reliable operation.

**Your impact

**As Senior Engineering Specialist, you will serve as a technical authority for integrated bioprocess systems across process engineering, automation, filtration, and equipment design.

You will guide critical technical decisions throughout the manufacturing lifecycle—from concept and scale-up through qualification, validation, and continuous improvement.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with broad technical responsibility and influence across functions and projects. You will lead technical workstreams and mentor experienced engineers without formal line-management responsibility.

**What You Will Do

**Working closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Automation, Quality, Validation, and external partners, you will:

• Lead bioprocess design and optimization: Set the technical direction for upstream and downstream processes, purification, bulk formulation, and sterile transfers. Use process knowledge, modelling, and manufacturing data to improve yield, capacity, reliability, and product quality.

• Shape automation and control strategies: Translate process needs into requirements for PLC/DCS and SCADA systems, recipes, sequences, interlocks, and alarms. Ensure solutions support effective process control, data integrity, and reliable operation.

• Provide technical leadership for filtration: Define filter selection, sizing, validation, and integrity-testing strategies for liquid and gas systems. Lead investigations into filter failures, pressure deviations, and performance issues.

• Guide equipment and system design: Review and approve tanks, piping, pumps, valves, and instrumentation, including hydraulic calculations, pressure distribution, and pressure-testing strategies. Lead technical decisions for Cleaning-in-Place and Sterilization-in-Place (CIP/SIP) systems.

• Deliver projects and technology transfers: Lead process engineering activities from concept and vendor selection through factory and site acceptance testing, commissioning, qualification, process validation, and handover to operations.

• Strengthen technical standards and compliance: Resolve complex investigations, support change controls and CAPAs, and represent engineering during audits and inspections. Establish reusable design standards and share knowledge across projects and teams.

**What You Bring

**You have a master’s degree or PhD in Bioengineering, Biochemical or Chemical Engineering, Biotechnology, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related discipline.

You bring substantial industrial experience, typically 15 years or more, including at least 10 years within pharmaceutical, biotechnology or vaccine manufacturing.

Your experience includes:

• Leading complex engineering projects as a lead engineer or technical authority, with hands-on expertise in bioprocess development, scale-up, commercial manufacturing, and lifecycle management.

• Integrating process equipment with automation and SCADA systems, including control strategies, computerized-system validation, and data integrity.

• Designing and validating filtration systems, including filter integrity testing and pressure/flow troubleshooting.

• Working with hygienic tanks and piping, hydraulic calculations, pressure testing, CIP/SIP, and contamination control.

• Leading commissioning, qualification, process validation, Process Performance Qualification, and technology transfer, supported by a strong understanding of GMP and quality risk management.

• Setting technical standards, mentoring experienced engineers, and influencing decisions across functions without relying on formal authority.

**How You Work

**You combine scientific depth with practical engineering judgement. You can move from detailed technical analysis to clear recommendations that help colleagues and leaders make informed decisions.

You take ownership, challenge assumptions constructively, and remain focused when problems span multiple systems or disciplines. Whether working with operators, specialists, suppliers, or senior stakeholders, you communicate clearly and build trust through sound decisions and consistent follow-through.

You also enjoy developing others. Sharing expertise, coaching colleagues, and creating common standards are natural parts of how you work.

**Why join Bavarian Nordic?

**At Bavarian Nordic, we work to protect lives through vaccines. In this role, you will help build and improve the manufacturing capabilities that make that purpose possible.

You will have the opportunity to influence major technical decisions, strengthen engineering practices, and see your work translate into measurable improvements in manufacturing performance and reliable supply.

Our values—Persisting Pioneers, Embracing Change, and Boosted by the Team—shape how we collaborate and solve challenges. For the right candidate, sustained performance may open opportunities for broader engineering leadership or formal people management.

**Ready to shape the future of our Drug Substance manufacturing?

**We look forward to receiving your application and learning how your technical expertise and leadership could strengthen Bavarian Nordic.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

_Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

_Bavarian Nordic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

For more information, visit _www.bavarian-nordic.com

Are you a skilled Refrigeration Technician passionate about securing high-quality technical support?

Advansor is looking for an Aftersales Engineer to join an international team driven by climate action and delivering the best customer support.

We strive to design and produce the world’s best sustainable CO2 climate solutions. We know CO2 by heart, having gained rock-solid experience from designing and producing more than 20,000 racks.

We proudly share our expertise, best practices, and training with our customers through webinars, online training, and 2-day courses at our state-of-the-art training centre.

Your role

Working from our facilities in Brabrand, you will become part of our Aftersales Team. We handle support, warranty, training, and commissioning support of our sustainable CO2 refrigeration and heating systems. Technical Support is one of our core businesses, and your main responsibility will be securing high-quality support for our customers.

We support customers across Europe and LATAM, and the team is represented both at our HQ in Brabrand and locally in these regions.

Your key responsibilities will include

• Providing technical support via phone and email, guiding customers through optimization, fault diagnosis, and daily operations.

• Participating in our 24/7 support setup to ensure our customers always have a technical lifeline.

• Collaborating across the organization to solve complex issues and deliver the best possible customer experience.

Your background

We offer

You will become part of a highly ambitious company that values a good working environment, diversity, and teamwork.

Salary is decided based on your qualifications.

Please contact Martin Toft, Technical Support Manager, Aftersales at mto@advansor.com or by phone: +45 51 27 54 96 if you have any questions about the position or Advansor as a workplace.

Advansor is a part of Dover Corporation – please apply on Dover’s website:

Sustainable CO2 climate solutions

As a market-leading manufacturer, we have designed and produced more than 20,000 CO2 systems for sustainable commercial and industrial cooling and heating around the world since 2006.

**About The Job

**Do you thrive when working a dynamic group function in an international organisation with likeminded passionate people? And would you like to be a key player in Saxo’s financial and regulatory reporting? Then we have the right job for you.

We are looking for a Financial Controller to join our skilled, dedicated and energetic reporting team of five employees, which is overall responsible for our IFRS Annual Report, including the group controlling and consolidation of more than 10 companies and regulatory reporting. You will be reporting directly to the Head Financial Controlling.

A few words from our Hiring Manager, Head of Financial Controlling, says about the position as Financial Controller:

“If you enjoy working in a dynamic area, are ambitious in terms of taking on new challenges and developing your financial reporting skills alongside a strong team, this is the position for you. You will work together with a fantastic team. “

The Financial controlling team are responsible for monthly group consolidation and reporting processes, IFRS Group Annual Report, regulatory reporting to the Danish authorities. Further, we are responsible for coordination with the external auditors. We are working together with Head of Financial Compliance who is our IFRS expert and further we work closely with the Commercial Finance team.

**Responsibilities

**In this role you will be a key player in Saxo’s external reporting procedures spanning from external reporting, optimisation of processes and working with our consolidation system.

To succeed in this role you should be curious, eager to learn and motivated to develop your controlling and reporting skills while contributing to the solving of complex accounting issues with support from experienced colleagues. You will be able to engage in close collaboration with the rest of your team as well as with our many stakeholders throughout the organisation.

**Your profile

**

• 2+ years of experience from an auditing firm or working with financial controlling

• Relevant degree in Finance or Accounting (e.g. Bachelor's degree or HD, including candidates currently pursuing an HD degree).

• Experience in the financial sector is not needed

Furthermore, we are looking for a candidate who is structured, analytical and self-motivated. Someone with focus on effective problem solving while working with tight deadlines. You are a team player who enjoys collaborating with others and contributing new perspectives.

Additionally, you have a proactive mindset, and are comfortable taking on unfamiliar tasks.

**We get curious people invested in the world

**When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

**How To Apply

**Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

_Are you passionate about financial planning and analytics? Do you want to shape financial performance insights and facilitate strategic decision‑making for the world’s largest jewellery brand? … If so, then we have an exciting opportunity for you!

_**Help shape the financial future of one of the world’s most iconic brands!

**The Group FP&A function has ownership of managing and steering the financial performance of Pandora. The function plays a vital role in defining and enforcing the global performance management framework and policies across Global Finance and within the business – including being the driver of planning, budgeting and forecasting, defining KPIs and management reporting towards CFO and CEO. The function is therefore key to Pandora’s ability to provide the right guidance on expected future performance to the capital markets.

As our new Senior FP&A Manager, you will lead Pandora’s long‑term planning process and provide the analysis our executive team relies on to make informed decisions. You will translate strategic priorities into clear financial insights, build a strong understanding of our value drivers, and help ensure that the company is set up for long‑term success. To succeed, you must bring a strong financial background, excellent analytical capabilities and the ability to collaborate effectively across a wide, global stakeholder landscape.

This role requires deep expertise in financial planning, reporting, and modelling, along with solid knowledge of cash flow and balance sheet mechanics. You should be able to manage multiple priorities independently and perform effectively in a fast‑paced, constantly evolving environment.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Lead the long‑term financial planning process across the PANDORA Group, ensuring alignment with corporate strategy and supporting the translation of strategic priorities into financial outcomes

• Conduct and interpret detailed financial analyses to help the organization understand deviations from long‑term plan.

• Develop robust financial models to simulate business scenarios, assess risks and opportunities, and support strategic decision-making

• Act as a strategic finance partner, helping shape financial targets and performance expectations across a wide range of stakeholder groups

• Prepare and deliver high-impact presentations and reports for executive leadership meetings, distilling complex financial information into clear, actionable insights

• Drive long‑term cash flow and balance sheet forecasting, ensuring alignment with overall financial plans and supporting capital allocation decisions

• Independently manage ad hoc strategic and financial analyses for senior stakeholders up to the CFO level, ensuring timely and accurate responses to critical business questions

**Required Skills

**

• Strong ability to understand complex ideas and simplify them

• Ability to manage multiple tasks and work under tight deadlines

• Ability to build high‑level financial models and scenarios

• Advanced Excel and solid financial modelling skills

• Experience with planning/reporting systems

• Strong written and verbal communication in English

**Required Experience

**

• 5-8+ years of experience in FP&A, commercial finance or finance transformation

• Experience working in a global or regional role

• Strong background in financial modelling, reporting, and scenario analysis

• Experience driving cross‑functional projects and process improvements

**Did we get your attention?

**If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible.

You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

At Pandora, we believe that creating an inclusive and diverse workplace and reflecting societal diversity in our customer engagement is essential to delivering on our company purpose: to give a voice to people’s loves. We dedicate ourselves to fostering, cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion and diversity where everyone feels respected and valued

We are looking for a Software Engineer who wants to build and ship new features that quickly reach customers, on top of an engine that already runs at scale. You join our platform team, which owns several live domains that our customers depend on every day. The foundations are solid and well maintained, so your time goes into new use cases and features rather than firefighting. Whether you have a couple of years of experience or a few more, we would like to see your application.

**What's in it for you?

Where they own the systems that keep Skatteguiden running, you'll own the shared application-layer services that the rest of engineering depends on.

The team treats these services as a product, with engineers distributed across several product teams as their users. Every product team touches payments, identity, and integrations. Your job is to make those services reliable, well-designed, and genuinely easy to build on, across a microservices architecture that favours low coupling and event-driven communication over direct dependencies.

We operate on a simple principle: you build it, you own it. That means end-to-end accountability, from design and implementation through to what happens when something goes wrong. Incidents aren't escalated to someone else's queue; they're yours to understand, resolve, and learn from.

What you'll do

Own the shared application platform. Design and build the core backend services underpinning payments, identity, authorisation, and third-party integrations — the shared foundation that product teams rely on every day.

Build and maintain payment services. Design payment flows that are reliable, observable, and compliant. Work with product teams to support new features and providers without coupling concerns or creating fragility in the critical path.

Own identity and authorisation. Design the systems that manage who our users are and what they can do — from OAuth flows and token management to fine-grained permission models and audit trails.

Integrate security and privacy into the application layer. Work with our Head of Security & Privacy to translate requirements into technical controls — particularly in identity, authorisation, and data handling — with GDPR and ISO 27001 in mind.

Integrate third-party systems. Own the integration layer connecting messaging, payment providers, and others. Ensure resilience, observability, and clear contracts.

Improve the developer experience. Build shared libraries, abstractions, and internal tooling that make it easier for product engineers to build on top of platform services correctly and confidently. Reduce the cognitive load on teams that shouldn't need to think about auth or payment internals.
