The conference floor is where deals start. The dinner is where trust is built. The clip is what 10,000 people see the next morning. Own all three.

**About The Job

**GetWhy is the end-to-end AI-powered human insights platform trusted by the world’s most influential brands, including eBay, Arla, Warner Brothers and The Coca Cola company, to understand their customers at scale. We’re backed by $40M in Series A funding and scaling aggressively into the enterprise market.

In our category, events aren’t a nice-to-have. They are a strategic weapon. Industry conferences, hosted experiences, executive dinners and brand activations are where relationships form, pipeline is built, and GetWhy cements its position as the category leader in AI-powered qualitative research.

We’re hiring our first Lead, Global Events & Community to own how GetWhy shows up in the world. This is a high-ownership role for someone with taste, commercial instinct and relentless execution. You’ll design experiences enterprise buyers actually want to attend, turn every event into content that travels far beyond the room, and build the playbook that lets GetWhy show up brilliantly on every continent.

What you’ll do

Own the global event strategy

• Set GetWhy’s global events strategy with the marketing leadership, from tentpole industry conferences (IIEX, ESOMAR, Quirk’s) to hosted events, executive roundtables and product showcases.

• Plan, produce and execute 15–20+ events per year across Europe, the US and beyond, each tied to clear pipeline, brand and customer goals.

• Own the global events budget, sponsorship negotiations, and relationships with agencies, venues and production partners.

Make GetWhy unmissable at every conference

• Have a strong point of view on world-class conference presence, from booth concept and spatial design to merch and the small details people remember.

• Replace badge-scanning booths with live experiences: let attendees run a real GetWhy study, see AI-moderated interviews in action, and leave with an insight.

• Secure speaking slots and sponsorships that put GetWhy at the centre of the industry conversation.

Put customers on stage

• Build a flagship GetWhy-hosted event where customers present the work they’ve done with GetWhy and show other brands how to do the same.

• Recruit and prepare customer and executive speakers, and make sure every GetWhy representative on stage or on the floor is briefed and on message.

Own the side events and intimate moments

• Design VIP dinners, executive roundtables and side events around major conferences, where the real relationships are built.

• Partner with Sales and Customer Success on account-based events that move specific deals and expansions forward.

Run the content machine

• Capture on-site content at every event, including video, photos and short clips that show GetWhy’s presence on the ground.

• Turn events into social media content, such as live posts, recaps, reels and LinkedIn stories, working with the wider marketing team.

• Conduct on-site interviews with customers, speakers and industry leaders, creating content for social, the website and sales enablement.

• Make sure every event keeps working for weeks afterwards through recaps, clips and follow-up campaigns.

Turn events into revenue

• Build the pre- and post-event engine: invitations, promotion, lead capture, qualification and a seamless handoff to Sales.

• Track and report on pipeline, ROI, reach and brand impact for every event, and double down on what works.

Build the playbook

• Create scalable playbooks and “event in a box” toolkits so local teams and partners can host on-brand GetWhy events anywhere.

• Grow the events function over time, including freelancers, agencies and future hires.

• Stay ahead of new event formats and technologies, and bring the best of them to GetWhy first.

Who you are

You’re not looking for an event coordination role. You’re a builder who sees events as the highest-leverage channel in a B2B enterprise sale, and you want to prove it on a global stage.

• 3–6+ years in event marketing, field marketing or experiential marketing for B2B SaaS, enterprise tech or a high-growth scale-up.

• A portfolio of standout events, with a track record that ties them directly to pipeline and revenue.

• Real taste. You know what makes a booth, a dinner or a keynote memorable, and you can explain why.

• Commercially minded. You think about pipeline and impact, not just logistics.

• A poster, not a scroller. Social media is second nature, and you know what makes an event clip worth watching.

• Comfortable behind a camera and in front of people. You can film, run an interview and do basic editing on the fly.

• A strong operator who can run several events in parallel across time zones without dropping quality.

• An excellent communicator who can brief a designer, negotiate with a venue and pitch an executive audience.

• Comfortable with CRM and marketing automation tools such as HubSpot or Salesforce.

• A willing traveler. You go where the events are and you bring the energy.

Bonus points

• Experience from the insights, market research or MarTech industry. You know the conferences, the audience and the culture.

• Experience at an AI-native research company or a frontier AI or tech company known for its events.

• You’ve built an events function from scratch, including playbooks, processes and measurement.

• You’ve produced a flagship owned event or customer conference.

• A network of event organisers, venues and production partners across Europe and the US.

What we offer

• A fast-scaling, ambitious company where events are a core growth engine, not an afterthought.

• The chance to build GetWhy’s global events function from the ground up and define how a category leader shows up in the world.

• Real ownership, a seat close to leadership, and the budget and trust to try bold ideas.

• Work with some of the world’s most influential brands as customers, speakers and partners.

• Annual company retreats and Friday bar events. We work hard, and we celebrate hard.

How to apply

Click apply and upload your CV, LinkedIn profile, and a link to a portfolio of events you’ve produced. Event photos, clips or social posts you’ve made are a big plus.

If we see a match, we’ll invite you to a conversation online or at our office. The process includes a short creative assignment, where you’ll pitch how GetWhy should show up at one of our key industry conferences.

This isn’t the easiest events job out there. It’s the one that will define how a category leader shows up in the world. Let’s build GetWhy together.

jobs.occupation: Specialist/Senior Specialist Pharmacometrician - Translational and Clin Dev
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about pharmacometrics and model-informed drug development? Do you have experience with translational and clinical population PK/PD modeling and support of regulatory submissions?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Specialist/Senior Specialist Pharmacometrician.

We are looking for a hands-on pharmacometrician who combines scientific excellence with strategic thinking and wants broad ownership across programs.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

Our Pharmacometrics Department supports every asset in the Ascendis portfolio and acts as a strategic partner throughout development, from innovation and early research through translational and clinical development, regulatory submissions, and life cycle management. Each pharmacometrician contributes directly to development strategy and portfolio decisions.

We are seeking an experienced hands-on Specialist/Senior Specialist Pharmacometrician who can address complex development questions and translate quantitative insights into actionable recommendations. You will apply model-informed drug development in rare diseases, where quantitative methods can directly inform trial design, dose selection, and evidence generation in small patient populations. You will gain exposure across translational and development stages and contribute to projects throughout the portfolio, providing broad visibility and influence within the company.

This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results. You will work both independently and in close collaboration with colleagues in Pharmacometrics, global project teams, external partners, and consultants. You will be joining the growing Pharmacometrics Department and report directly to Kristin Carlsson Petri, Senior Director and Head of Pharmacometrics, who is based in Hellerup. You will also be based in Hellerup. The team includes in-house pharmacometricians, a pharmacometrics programmer, and external consultants working remotely.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

• 
Develop model-informed drug development strategies for translational and clinical-stage projects and ensure optimal use of pharmacometric methods to inform trial and program design

• 
Shape regulatory strategy and represent pharmacometrics in global health authority interactions

• 
Inform dose selection, trial design, regulatory strategy, and lifecycle decisions through population PK/PD modeling, simulation, exposure-response analysis, and quantitative benefit-risk assessment

• 
Translate quantitative results into clear recommendations to project teams, senior management, health authorities, external partners or organizations

• 
Plan, document and report pharmacometric analyses in accordance with internal quality standards and global regulatory submission requirements

• 
Strengthen departmental methods, standards and capabilities through peer reviews, knowledge sharing, and continued development of the department's modeling and reporting environment

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a PhD, MSc, or equivalent qualification in pharmacometrics, pharmaceutical sciences, pharmacokinetics, mathematics, engineering, or another relevant quantitative discipline. You have relevant experience with PK/PD modeling and model-informed drug development.

Furthermore, you have:

• Hands-on experience with NONMEM and R applied to population PK/PD model development, simulation, and model-informed drug development

• Strong programming skills and technical expertise to organize, perform, document, and report pharmacometric analyses to submission standard

• Experience with translational and clinical-stage analyses, including population PK, PK/PD, exposure-response, dose selection, and trial-design questions

Additional experience that would be an advantage:

• Industrial experience supporting regulatory interactions or submissions, including knowledge of relevant FDA, EMA, and ICH expectations for pharmacometric analyses

• Familiarity with LaTeX, Git and reproducible reporting workflows, or experience applying machine learning, artificial intelligence, or automation to pharmacometric workflows

Key competencies:

• You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude

• You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key

• You communicate complex quantitative findings clearly, work effectively across disciplines, and balance analytical detail with broader development objectives

• You combine a strong quantitative background with biological and clinical understanding and collaborate effectively with scientists, clinicians, regulatory colleagues, and external partners. Your ability to share knowledge and contribute to common goals will be valued among colleagues

Travel: 5-10 days per year.

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, Hellerup, Denmark.

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform—applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For further information about the position, please contact Kristin Carlsson Petri, Senior Director and Head of Pharmacometrics at kcp@ascendispharma.com.

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com.

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

A note to recruiters:

We do not allow external search party solicitation. Presentation of candidates without written permission from the Ascendis Pharma HR team—specifically a Talent Acquisition Partner or Human Resources Director—is not allowed. If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged.

We're now looking for a Chief Product & Technology Officer to lead our next chapter.

One accountable leader for what we build, why we build it and how we release it.

The Role:

The role translates the company’s growth ambition into an AI-first portfolio built on a scalable, secure and coherent platform, and ensures that it reaches customers predictably and at a high quality bar. The CPTO is both the architect of the portfolio and its foremost ambassador, internally and externally.

You'll own product strategy, technology, architecture and release cadence across our full product portfolio, leading an international product and R&D organization globally.

Reports to Chief Executive Officer; member of the Executive Management Team.

Direct reporst - VP of Technology Engineering; VP Product Management.

📍 Copenhagen HQ preferred

• international role, approx. 40–50 travel days a year.

What You'll Drive:

• Scale Retail platform solution for global enterprise customers and lead our entry into the US market.

• Set the direction for our next-generation hospital platform.

• Take AI from roadmap to recurring revenue, built into the core platform and delivered responsibly.

• Bring several legacy systems together into one coherent, secure cloud platform.

• Build a predictable release rhythm and a data-driven, AI-first engineering culture.

• Shape build, partner or buy decisions and lead product and technical due diligence.

Strategic Priorities:

Three agendas connect directly to growth along two vectors: winning more clinics and customers (points of sale) and expanding what each customer uses and pays for (product depth and ASP). Platform consolidation underpins all three.

• Manage: Global Scaling to Enterprise & US Market Evolve Manage for enterprise scalability, security, integrations and governance, with standardised workflows across clinics and regions. Sequence market entry deliberately rather than opportunistically.

• Next-Generation Hospital Software: Set direction for and deliver a modern, future-proof hospital platform. Define the product configuration needed for broader global expansion without compromising the depth hospital customers require.

• AI: From Roadmap to Recurring Revenue Move planned AI categories from build to commercial launch on time and to a high quality bar. Drive attachment until AI is a differentiator in every deal and a recurring contributor to ARR.

• One Coherent Platform: Reduce the number of legacy systems and build the shared foundation that makes the three agendas above deliverable.

Success Criteria:

First 6–12 Months:

• A clear, prioritised and communicated product and technology roadmap addressing 2 main Goals; Enterprise Expansion & US Market Entry, understood and supported by the Executive Management Team and the Board.

• A decided and initiated plan for next-generation hospital software, built on one coherent foundation.

• A defined target architecture and a legacy consolidation plan with milestones.

• A defined AI approach across the portfolio, with concrete initiatives linked to customer value and ARR potential.

• Clear build-versus-buy principles and a product-led view on M&A opportunities.

• A product and technology organisation with clear roles, one planning rhythm and agreed delivery metrics to increase velocity and throughput.

What You Bring:

• Senior leadership of both product management and engineering (CPTO, CPO, CTO or SVP level) in B2B SaaS or vertical software.

• A record of turning market insight into a portfolio strategy that grows ARR, including pricing and packaging.

• Experience building and leading multinational, distributed teams and developing strong leaders.

• Platform modernisation, legacy consolidation and M&A integration experience.

• Hands-on understanding of where AI creates real customer and business value.

• Credibility with engineers and in C-level customer conversations.

• PE-backed or high-growth experience is a clear advantage; healthtech or regulated industries a plus.

Personal Qualities:

• Strategic: Think in wholes, long horizons and business value, and turn this into concrete, prioritised choices.

• Technology fluent: Credible with architects and engineers, and able to explain technical trade-offs in business terms.

• Commercial: Understand the link between product, sales and earnings, and drive growth through the product.

• Execution-strong: Balance ambition with pragmatic delivery and measurable results.

• Clear communicator: Explain product and technology choices simply and convincingly, and builds buy-in from the Board to the team.

• Empowering leader: Build strong teams and develop people, in line with our values: Cutting-edge, Attentive, Resourceful, Ethical/Transparent.

• Purpose-driven: Motivated by improving access to hearing healthcare.

• Robust: Collaborative, and able to make clear choices when priorities compete.

How We Work:

Agile, direct and non-political. We say it like it is, make the tough calls and like to see people grow and deliver results. Our values are all about C. A. R. E. - Cutting-edge, Attentive, Resourceful, Ethical/Transparent.

What We Offer:

A central value-creation role in an Insight Partners-backed software company with an ambitious growth plan and a clear purpose. The CPTO owns the full product and technology agenda, takes a defining role in the growth journey, and has access to Auditdata’s Management Incentive Programme.

Your journey with us:

We want you to get to know us as well as we get to know you.

• Introductory call (online) with our Talent Partner;

• Value fit meeting (online) with our Chief People Officer, followed by a behavioural profile (such as DISC);

• Executive interview (online) with our Chief Executive Officer;

• Copenhagen visit (in-person): meet the team at our HQ and present a case on a real challenge we’re tackling;

• Final interview (online) with the Board.

Throughout, you’ll get timely feedback and plenty of room to ask your own questions.

We look forward to your application! (please submit your CV in English and why this role interests you)

Auditdata is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to create diverse work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills.

PanTarg is a Danish biotechnology company developing novel anti-cancer therapies in the form of antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) for the treatment of aggressive cancers with high unmet medical need.

Our work is based on more than 30 years of research conducted at Rigshospitalet and University of Copenhagen, and our vision is to enable novel treatment options for cancer patients via a novel first-in-class approach to targeted therapy.

We are currently incubated at the BioInnovation Institute (BII), a Copenhagen-based incubation hub for biotech startups in Europe. Here, we are currently progressing through preclinical development, aiming to reach a stage of clinical testing within a few years.

The position

We are looking for a Staff Scientist to join our team on site at BII. We are looking for a candidate with robust experimental experience with both in vivo xenograft studies as well as in vitro methods such as assay development, ELISA, flow cytometry and dose-response studies of drug candidates in cell culture. The selected candidate will generate data that supports our early translational activities, our non-clinical safety studies, and business decisions.

Qualifications

In vivo experience – Xenograft models

• Robust (5+ years) of hands-on experience with xenograft models of cancer, including CDX, PDX and orthotopic models.

• Strong practical experience with standard in vivo procedures, including I.V. injection via tail vein (must-have), blood collection, tissue collection, necropsy and general animal monitoring. Experience in preparing drug formulations and dosing solutions for administration, including appropriate handling and preparation of injectable drug candidates, is also required.

• Experience in the context of pharmacokinetic (PK) studies will be considered an advantage.

• Experience in planning, conducting and monitoring in vivo studies, as well as managing external CROs conducting such studies.

In vitro experience – Laboratory assays and protein characterization

• 5+ years of hands-on laboratory experience, with a strong focus on assay development, optimization and protocol troubleshooting.

• Experience with relevant assays and techniques, including ELISA, flow cytometry (multicolor panels) and dose-response studies of drug candidates in standard cell culture models.

• Good understanding of antibody biology and properties, as well as protein characterization, antibody concentration determination and purity assessment using techniques such as UV-Vis spectrophotometry, SDS-PAGE and Western blotting.

• Experience with additional laboratory methods and assay platforms is also relevant.

Data analysis and reporting

• Experience in analyzing, interpreting and presenting experimental data from both in vivo and in vitro studies.

• Ability to perform relevant statistical analyses, generate graphs and visualize experimental results.

• Experience in preparing clear and structured experimental reports and presenting study results and conclusions.

Other qualifications

• The optimal candidate will have obtained a PhD degree and have at least 4-5 years of experience from either pharma or biotech, or as a post doc.

• Good scientific project management and communications skills, and the ability to clearly and precisely present data to a professional audience.

• Good interpersonal skills, and the ability to thrive in a startup environment where flexibility and a can-do attitude is part of everyday work life.

• Fluent in the English language, written as well as spoken.

• On-site presence at the BioInnovation Institute in Copenhagen will be required.

General information and how to apply

• 
You will be reporting to the Chief Scientific Officer.

• 
The position is full time.

• 
Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, and the selected candidate will start as soon as possible.

• 
Application takes place via the application system here at LinkedIn.

• 
Please provide and combine, in a single file (PDF), a one-page CV, as well as a short, motivated application letter (also one page), summarizing your relevant experience, key responsibilities in previous roles, and motivation for applying for the position. Note that the application system only allows uploading of a single document.

• 
Questions about the open position should be addressed to the e-mail address jobs@pantarg.com

jobs.description:
**Market Director Health and Public Institutions – Buildings & Industry

**__**Lyngby or Aarhus, Odense or Vejle

**_

_**Do you want to help shape some of Denmark's and the Nordic region's most important healthcare, education and public building projects? Can you build trusted relationships with key clients, grow business opportunities, and lead complex pursuits in a market with significant societal impact? And do you combine solid commercial acumen with deep insight into the health and public institutions sector? Then join COWI as our new Market Director for Health & Public Institutions within Buildings & Industry and apply your knowledge and curiosity to enable a better tomorrow.

**_

_**Shape the future of healthcare and public buildings

**_To strengthen COWI’s customer-centric approach, we are looking for a Market Director to drive business development and coordinate sales efforts within Health & Public Institutions in our Buildings & Industry sector.

This is a key role in one of COWI’s strategic growth markets, covering healthcare, education, research, cultural facilities and public development projects across Denmark and the Nordics. You will help position COWI on major hospital developments, universities, public institutions, refurbishment programmes and other complex projects that contribute to the development of society.

What makes this role unique is its pure focus on market leadership, where success is defined by customer value, business growth, and a strong market presence. Working closely with specialists, project managers and technical experts, you will build relationships, identify opportunities and grow COWI’s presence in the market. You will also become part of an experienced business development community that shares best practices and drives commercial excellence across COWI.

As part of a team of 25 experienced market professionals across COWI and Arkitema, you will work at the forefront of our business development efforts. Reporting to the Senior Market Director, you will collaborate closely with colleagues across the organization to deepen client relationships, unlock strategic opportunities, and lead pursuits from early engagement through to project win, contributing directly to the continued growth of our business.

With increasing investments in healthcare, public buildings and sustainable transformation, the market offers significant growth potential. Your sector insight, commercial mindset and customer understanding will help position COWI as a preferred partner for public clients and healthcare organisations across the Nordic region.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Grow business development and growth across the Health & Public Institutions market segment by identifying, prioritizing, and converting strategic opportunities.

• Build and maintain close relationships with key customers, partners, and decisionmakers, acting as a trusted advisor and Key Account Manager for selected clients.

• Develop and manage a healthy sales pipeline, manage Go/No-Go decisions, and drive capture planning for major pursuits and tenders.

Lead and support complex proposal processes, ensuring compelling value propositions and effective collaboration across disciplines and business units.

• Provide direction and coordination for the Business Development team supporting the market segment, ensuring effective collaboration and delivery of market priorities.

• Monitor market trends, upcoming investments, and customer needs to help shape market strategies and long-term growth initiatives.

• Represent COWI externally through customer meetings, industry networks, conferences, and strategic partnerships.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**Like us, you believe that successful business development is built on trust, collaboration and long-term relationships. You are motivated by creating opportunities, understanding customer needs and bringing together the best teams to deliver value for clients and society. You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working closely with fellow Market Directors and multidisciplinary teams to achieve shared goals.

To perform well in this role, it is essential that you bring solid market insight and a well-established network within healthcare, public institutions or the built environment sector. Equally important is your ability to build internal alliances and leverage the collective expertise of the organisation rather than acting alone.

On top of that, you will have:

• A relevant educational background such as engineering, architecture, business or a related discipline.

• Extensive experience in business development, client management, or market leadership within healthcare, public institutions, architecture, construction, or engineering consultancy.

• Deep knowledge of public-sector customers, procurement processes, and market dynamics, combined with a well-established professional network.

• Demonstrated skill in building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and converting opportunities into long-term partnerships.

• Experience contributing to large and complex tenders, proposals, and commercial negotiations.

• Demonstrated ability to provide leadership, direction, and coordination across Business Development teams, account managers, and framework agreement holders, ensuring a shared focus on market growth and client development without formal personnel responsibility.

• Solid communication and stakeholder management skills, with professional proficiency in both Danish and English.

**A place to work and so much more

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability and strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices. We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and collaboration – because that is what brings out the best in you, both at work and at home. With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people bringing expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

**Got more questions?

**If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Senior Market Director Mikael Voldborg, Buildings & Industry, at mivo@cowi.com, or Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist, Janne Nielsen, at jane@cowi.com.

Get to know us better on our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we aim to achieve, and what it is like to be part of COWI.

**Before you apply

**All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or cover letter required. Please add a short motivation for the role (4–5 lines) at the top of your CV. When it comes to photos, we prefer to form our first impression face to face rather than from a picture. If relevant, please also attach your portfolio.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI – inclusion is key

**We are committed to creating a respectful and fair working environment where all employees feel a sense of belonging and have equal opportunities to thrive and develop. Our leaders act as role models for inclusive leadership and contribute to a culture where diverse perspectives and professional approaches are seen as a strength. We integrate diversity and inclusion into relevant decisions and processes, and when forming teams across architecture and engineering disciplines. We do this because it is part of our values – and simply because it is the right thing to do.

**Job Description

**

Manager, Strategy & Execution

Posting Start Date: 10/26/26

Alcântara, PRT, 1300‑001, | Gentofte, DNK, 2820,

**Manager, Strategy & Execution

**

• Location: Copenhagen / Lisbon

• Work model: Hybrid / Full time

• Contract type / duration: Permanent

Do you want to lead projects that influence the future direction of global business? Are you curious about how to keep a strategy alive across a global organization? Are you excited by working closely with experienced leaders to solve the most challenging problems in our business? Then you might be who we are looking for!

You will be part of our Strategy & Execution team and work on high-impact, cross-functional projects that help drive STG's strategy forward. You will work directly with the Head of Strategy and the rest of the team, partnering closely with business leaders and subject matter experts across the organization. You can expect to spend your time both supporting the Executive Board decision-making, and working with the business to drive execution. Your contributions will drive strategic initiatives, bring new clarity to complex problems, align stakeholders through challenging trade-offs and ultimately help STG deliver our strategic ambitions. Our team are the stewards of the Focus2030 strategy, and you will play a core part in keeping the strategy alive in the business while remaining responsive to market changes and execution learnings.

This would be an ideal role for an associate-manager level consultant looking to transition into a corporate role so they can take longer term ownership of their projects and see them come to life.

**What Your Day Will Look Like

**As a Manager in the Strategy & Execution team, you can expect to work across a wide range of projects and initiatives. Example projects could include:

• Preparing materials for the Board of Directors strategy days

• Developing a methodology to define future market roles

• Building a business case to optimise our product portfolio to maximise growth and operational efficiency

• Supporting a business team to prioritise their focus areas for the strategy period

• Reviewing our progress to delivering our strategy for the Exec Board

• Creating a new Exec Board KPI dashboard to continuously monitor the success of strategy execution

jobs.occupation: Associate Director, GCP Inspection Office, R&D Quality
jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**R&D Quality encompasses four teams GCLP/GLP Quality, PV Quality, Audit Calibration, Quality and GCP Quality. R&D Quality has a large range of stakeholders, and we have an important role in delivering our 2030 vision to transform the future of cancer treatment.

In the role as AD GCP Inspection Office you will be driving day-to-day GCP Quality activities including audit together with a dedicated and highly skilled team. Furthermore, you will be taking up the role as GCP Inspection QA lead.

The role requires profound understanding of how the GCP requirements are applied into practice, especially with focus on the European requirements and interpretation of ICH GCP R3 and Computerized Systems in Clinical Trials.

The role includes hands on GCP Quality activities such as support to our many stakeholders as well as performing audits alone or together with own team members or with support from neighbouring teams. You become a key member of the R&D Quality leadership team that together drives people engagement, setting strategies and ensuring R&D Quality deliverables.

The role requires strong collaboration capabilities in an international setting across various QA departments as well across the company with target stakeholders such as Clinical Trial Operations, Clinical Data, Integration & Reporting, Digital Development, Medical, GDS&PV, and Regulatory Affairs.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Reporting to Director and Team Lead Inspection Office R&D Quality

• It will ensure GCP inspection readiness across cross functional clinical -study team.

• The role oversees end-of-end inspection planning and execution including logistics and stakeholder coordination.

• Lead and oversee GCP inspection readiness/preparation activities and serve as an inspection lead for regulatory health authority inspection including but not limited to US FDA, MHRA, EMA, CFDI, PMDA etc.

• Collaborate with the cross functional clinical study teams to develop and execute and integrated risk-based inspection readiness/preparation strategy ensuring consistent alignment across functions.

• Manage end to end inspection readiness/preparation activities, including development and maintenance of inspection storyboards with the SMEs, proactive identification and mitigation of the inspection related risk and planning, facilitation.

• Lead the mock inspections for high-risk trials across Genmab locations.

• During the inspection coordinate and assign inspection requests to appropriate SMEs providing oversight and appropriate SME, also guide to ensure timely and effective responses.

• Create/revise appropriate tools / SOPs for inspection readiness/preparation and management.

• Ensure Veeva records are updated for inspection records or related records.

• Demonstrate ability to solve complex problems requiring in-depth evaluation of various factors.

• Fulfill inspection commitments and respond to the inspection and carry out post inspection activities.

• Maintain a central repository of global inspection status and updates

• Meticulous attention to detail, excellent review skills and ability to independently manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

• Support/manage site inspection in collaboration with GCP Quality.

• Lead and facilitate post-inspection lessons learned session to trends, share best practices and drive sustainable process improvements.

**Requirements

**

• MS, or BS or similar in Natural Science

• 10+ years of experience in a GCP Quality function or similar

• Deep expertise in GCP processes and the EMA, PMDA and FDA requirements.

• Demonstrated leadership in regulatory inspections and health authority interactions.

• Considered to be a Domain Expert within GCP by peers with a strong interest and ability to educate others

• Experience as Lead Auditor within GCP is an advantage

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK732.768,00---1.099.152,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Our Quality Systems team is looking for a new colleague to strengthen our Supplier Quality Management team at AGC Biologics in Søborg.

Are you interested in supplier quality, GMP compliance and working with internal and external partners in a complex pharmaceutical environment? Do you enjoy working with quality processes, assessments and continuous improvement? Then you may be the colleague we are looking for.

About The Role

As a Supplier Quality Management Specialist, you will join a dedicated team currently consisting of a Scientist and a Senior Scientist. The team supports site manufacturing of clinical and commercial drug substances and is responsible for ensuring that our suppliers meet the required quality standards and regulatory expectations.

You will work with different aspects of Supplier Quality Management, including supplier qualifications, assessments and evaluations, supplier audits, and Supplier Quality Agreements. You will also support the site as a subject matter expert during client audits and regulatory inspections.

We are looking for someone who is interested in supplier management, willing to learn and motivated to contribute to a busy and complex environment. The role requires attention to detail, a pragmatic approach to quality and the ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.

Depending on your experience and qualifications, the position may be filled at Specialist or Senior Specialist level.

Your Responsibilities

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Supplier Management: Participate in and manage supplier qualification, assessments and ongoing performance evaluations to ensure suppliers meet AGC Biologics' quality requirements.

• Supplier Audits: Support the planning, preparation and execution of supplier audits. If you are already a trained or certified lead auditor, you may take a leading role in conducting audits. If not, auditor training and development can be part of your development plan.

• Quality Agreements: Prepare, review, negotiate and maintain Supplier Quality Agreements with internal and external partners.

• Audit and Inspection Support: Support the site as a subject matter expert on supplier quality matters during client audits and regulatory inspections.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Material Science, Quality Control, Supply Chain Management and other functional areas at the site, as well as colleagues across AGC's global network.

• Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the development and improvement of supplier quality processes and the site's quality management system.

About The Quality Systems Department

Supplier Quality Management (SQM) is part of the Quality Systems department and plays an important role within the site's Quality organisation.

You will join a diverse team of highly qualified colleagues with extensive experience in Quality Assurance. The team works closely with Material Science,

Quality Control and Supply Chain Management, as well as partners across all functional areas at the site.

We also collaborate with other AGC sites globally to ensure that quality-related activities are carried out effectively, efficiently and in compliance with cGMP requirements.

We value open communication, professionalism and a collaborative approach. Our goal is to provide high-quality support to colleagues across AGC Biologics, our customers and our suppliers.

You will report to the Manager of the Supplier Quality Management team.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a colleague who is detail-oriented, pragmatic and comfortable working with quality requirements in a regulated environment.

As a Person, You Have

• The ability to be pragmatic and still ensure compliance.

• Proven technical writing skills.

• Skills in verbal communications. Ability to respond to complex inquiries from customers, co-workers, and suppliers.

• Skilled in time and priority management.

• Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively to accomplish deadlines and objectives.

You Also Have

• Minimum 2 years prior working experience in a Biotech/Pharmaceutical environment, with a focus on supplier quality.

• Master’s degree in pharmacy, biochemistry, or related life sciences field.

• Strong knowledge of GMP guidelines, as well as international regulations, pertaining to the production of biopharmaceutical products (including, but not limited to 21 CFR Parts 11, 210, 211, 600, and 610; EU GMP Parts I, II, and III, and relevant ICH guidelines).

• Experienced lead auditor (e.g.: ISO 9001, GMP) is an advantage but not a requirement.

If you do not have lead auditor training or certification, this can be part of your professional development.

What We Offer

At AGC Biologics, you will become part of an international organisation where quality, collaboration and continuous improvement are essential to what we do.

We Offer

• An international working environment with opportunities for professional development and collaboration across global sites.

• Competitive employment conditions, including salary, bonus schemes, pension and health insurance.

• Opportunities for training, development and cross-functional knowledge sharing.

• A strong focus on work-life balance, employee well-being and a supportive working environment.

• A variety of company and Employee Club activities in Copenhagen.

• A flexible and trust-based working culture with an open and collaborative approach.

• The opportunity to contribute to our purpose: Bringing Hope to Life.

How To Apply

Please submit your application and CV through the AGC Biologics career site. We do not accept applications by email.

Deadline: 29 November.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the vacancy before the application deadline if a suitable candidate is identified.

_Please note that AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark or the Greater Malmö area in Sweden.

_We look forward to receiving your application!

Who We Are

AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager, Campaign Design - Store Creative
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly creative and experienced Campaign Design Manager to join our Campaign Creative team in Copenhagen.

In this role, you will transform global campaign ideas into immersive and engaging retail experiences. From windows and in-store creative to activations, installations and pop-ups, you will shape how campaigns come to life across the physical customer journey, ensuring every touchpoint feels connected, inspiring and unmistakably on brand.

You will combine strategic creative thinking with hands-on leadership, guiding projects from concept to implementation-ready toolkits while collaborating with cross-functional teams, external partners and creative specialists.

**What You Will Do

**_Drive retail campaign experiences

_

• Translate global campaigns and brand direction into compelling retail concepts.

• Create cohesive experiences across windows, stores, activations, installations and pop-ups.

• Develop concepts that balance creativity, customer engagement and commercial impact.

• Explore new formats, materials and creative collaborations that elevate brand storytelling.

_Lead global campaign toolkits

_

• Develop and define creative direction for global retail campaign toolkits.

• Create clear, inspiring guidance that supports local adaptation and execution.

• Partner closely with key stakeholders to ensure creative intent is maintained from concept through implementation.

_

• Lead projects through concept development, prototyping and production handover.

**Who You Are

**You are a creative leader with a passion for physical retail and experiential design. You understand how to turn campaign ideas into engaging customer experiences and are equally comfortable defining the big-picture vision and refining the details that make execution exceptional.

You thrive in a global environment, build strong relationships across diverse stakeholder groups and know how to bring people together around a shared creative direction.

**We imagine you bring

**

• Significant experience, typically gained over 8+ years, in retail design, visual merchandising, spatial design, experiential design, or a related creative discipline.

**A portfolio that demonstrates how you have transformed ideas into compelling physical experiences, connecting storytelling, product, space and customer interaction.

We're looking for someone who can combine creative vision, leadership and execution, bringing bold ideas to life at a global scale.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

You will join a global brand known for combining creativity, craftsmanship and innovation, helping shape inspiring customer experiences that connect people with the stories behind our jewellery. As part of Pandora's Campaign Creative team, you will have the opportunity to influence how our campaigns come to life in stores around the world, creating meaningful moments for millions of customers every day.

Do you want to lead 10 engineers building a Legal-Tech SaaS platform on .NET and Azure?

At Epona in Vejle, you will lead the engineering organization behind our Legal-Tech SaaS platform, used by more than 800 law firms and corporate legal departments worldwide. Our platform is built with .NET 10, C#, Azure services, REST APIs and semantic search.

You will combine people leadership with accountability for reliable delivery, engineering quality and continuous improvement, while helping Epona transition from its existing solution to the next-generation SaaS platform.

Your teams

You will be responsible for 10 engineers in Vejle, organized in three teams:

• Two agile product development teams, one working on our new SaaS platform and one on the on-premise solution it replaces

• One platform team of two DevOps engineers, owning CI/CD, infrastructure (Terraform) and cloud operations

How we work with AI

AI is part of how we work, both as product capabilities and as tooling in our engineering workflow. We use Claude as a coding companion to accelerate product delivery and improve quality. We expect you to drive effective and critical use of AI tools across your teams.

Promote responsible AI adoption, including security, code review, testing and appropriate human oversight. Assess its impact on delivery speed, quality and developer effectiveness rather than measuring usage alone.

Your role

As the Head of Engineering, your primary focus is on people leadership and delivering results through your teams. You bring a strong technical background that enables you to challenge technical decisions, contribute to architectural discussions and ensure engineering quality. You report to the CTO.

• Lead, coach and develop 10 engineers through 1:1s, feedback and career development

• Set clear expectations, provide regular performance feedback, address underperformance and develop succession and capability plans.

• Make AI tools like Claude part of how the teams work, and measure the effect on delivery

• Ensure predictable, high-quality delivery with Product Management, including AI-powered capabilities in our platform

• Translate agreed product priorities into realistic engineering commitments; make risks, dependencies, trade-offs and capacity constraints visible early.

• Use relevant indicators such as lead time, delivery predictability, defect trends, reliability and incident resolution to drive improvement, not reporting for its own sake.

• Drive technical direction and engineering quality together with architects and senior engineers

• Strengthen automated testing, security, scalability, maintainability, CI/CD and management of technical debt.

• Collaborate with international colleagues and shape team structure and ways of working across product and platform teams

• Partner with Operations and Support to identify recurring customer issues, reduce avoidable incidents and feed insights into engineering and product improvements.

• Communicate decisions, progress and risks transparently and follow through on agreed actions across teams.

• Own how and how well we deliver, including technical trade-offs and delivery commitments. The Project Manager owns what we deliver and why. Timelines are agreed jointly by trading off scope, time and quality, with escalation to CPO and CTO.

• Stay technically involved through occasional code reviews and technical contributions, while playing a key role in architectural decisions alongside architects and senior engineers. The primary focus remains on leading the engineering teams rather than individual coding.

Measuring success

Success will be measured through improvements in AI adoption and impact, engineering delivery and quality, team engagement and retention, and collaboration with Product Management and Operations.

Within the first 60 days, you will establish baselines and agree measurable 6- and 12-month improvement targets with the CTO.

How you lead – Epona values

Epona’s five values guide how we lead, make decisions and work together. The Engineering Manager is expected to demonstrate them through visible behaviour, not just words.

• One Team — Build a shared identity across Engineering, Product, Operations and Support. Break down silos, actively help colleagues, and put shared outcomes ahead of “them and us” thinking.

• Customer First — Make quality and delivery central to engineering decisions. Understand customer impact, address recurring issues and prioritise reliable outcomes for customers.

• Transparency — Explain the why behind decisions, priorities and trade-offs. Communicate progress, risks and changes openly so teams understand both the direction and the reasoning.

• Responsible — Deliver on promises, take ownership of mistakes, and make responsibilities and follow-up explicit. Combine flexibility and autonomy with clear accountability.

• Respect — Respect cultural differences and individual perspectives. Give feedback respectfully, invite constructive challenge and build an inclusive, supportive team environment.

Tech stack

• Backend and data: .NET 10, C#, MS SQL Server / Azure SQL, Entity Framework Core

• Cloud: Azure (Functions, Web Apps, API Management, Front Door, Entra ID, etc.)

• AI and search: Claude as coding companion, AI-powered product capabilities, Azure AI Search (semantic/vector search)

• DevOps and testing: Azure Pipelines, Terraform, xUnit

• Integrations: SharePoint

What we’re looking for

• 3+ years as an Head of Engineering or Team Lead with direct reports

• A background as a software engineer, preferably in .NET/C# and Azure

• Daily use of AI coding tools, and experience getting a team to adopt them

• Knowledge of how AI features are built and run in production

• Experience building teams that ship SaaS reliably

• Fluent in English (Danish is a plus, not required)

• Proven people leadership, including coaching, performance management and building accountable, collaborative teams.

• Ability to balance technical excellence with business priorities and customer outcomes; communicate trade-offs constructively.

• Nice to have: experience with Terraform and Azure Pipelines, semantic search, SharePoint integrations, Legal-Tech or other regulated industries.

What we offer

• Flexible hybrid setup: 3 days on-site in Vejle, 2 days remote

• Competitive salary matching your experience

• International environment

• Leadership and professional development through sparring, courses and conferences

• An opportunity to shape the next-generation SaaS engineering organisation and its ways of working.

About Epona

Epona is a global Legal-Tech company delivering intelligent document, email and case management solutions built on Microsoft and .NET technology. With offices in the Netherlands, Portugal, USA and Denmark, we serve more than 800 clients worldwide.

How to apply

You can apply via 'Apply' below, but in case you have questions, feel free to reach out to HR via the email address: hr@epona.com.

Application deadline: No fixed deadline. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

Epona is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Your impact begins here

As Project Director, you will lead the most complex sourcing projects in Drug Substance, from category strategy through to signed contracts with CMOs, where commitments can exceed DKK 1 billion. You will shape strategies for areas of growing importance to Novo, such as synthetic peptides, and negotiate partnerships that are strong commercially and sustainable over time. Your work helps keep the supply of treatments for people living with serious chronic diseases reliable.

What you’ll bring

You are a senior sourcing and project leader who combines a strategic mindset with an eye for contractual detail.

**You Have

**

• A university master’s degree in pharmacy, biology, engineering, supply chain management, law or business.

• Around 15+ years of relevant pharmaceutical experience, in manufacturing, manufacturing development and/or CMO environments. The role may suit candidates with around 20 years of experience.

• A strong background in strategic sourcing, contract negotiation and external partner management.

• Solid experience leading complex, cross-functional projects, as project and/or line manager.

• In-depth knowledge of pharmaceutical manufacturing, CMOs, quality and regulatory requirements.

• Excellent negotiation and contracting skills, and the ability to engage with senior management and CMO executives, up to CEO level.

• The ability to lead and influence without formal authority, with resilience, autonomy, a sense of urgency and strong execution skills.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Supplementary training in areas such as cGMP, project execution or personal development.

• An existing network within Novo, CMOs and pharmaceutical engineering companies.

• Experience in Drug Product or Devices sourcing.

What you’ll do

You will own sourcing projects from the first idea to final implementation, and you will keep strategy, contract and delivery pointing in the same direction.

**In Practice, You Will

**

• Develop category strategies for areas of strategic importance, such as synthetic peptides, by pairing market insight, including global players and trends, with Novo’s strategic outlook.

• Lead critical CMO negotiations independently until signature, securing outcomes within mandate that balance value, cost, flexibility, speed and risk.

• Drive projects end-to-end: set up governance and Steering Committees, build business cases and plans, define deliverables and manage risk.

• Bring together specialists from MSAT, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Finance and Legal, and raise bottlenecks early so work keeps moving.

• Keep SVP and EVP-level stakeholders informed and aligned on progress, and give input to business plans and budgets.

• Raise the standard for how Drug Substance Outsourcing works by sharing your approach with category managers and developing sourcing standards.

Who you’ll work with

You will be a senior individual contributor in GSOD Drug Substance Outsourcing, reporting to the Senior Director of the department. The role has no direct reports, but you will lead through influence: category groups and project teams with specialists from MSAT, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Quality, Finance and Legal, as well as colleagues in Global Contract Manufacturing DS, Supply Chain Design, GMS Management and country affiliates.

Externally, you will work with CMOs across the US, Europe and Asia, so you should expect to spend significant time abroad. You will balance partnership and long-term collaboration with the best possible commercial terms for Novo, and you will be at ease handling cross-cultural discussions when tension runs high.

In Global Manufacturing & Supply, colleagues work across the value chain to scale molecules, processes, devices and products for the people who need them. Your primary focus will be Drug Substance, with potential involvement in Drug Product and Devices.

What you can expect here

You will be trusted to take decisions independently and to give strategic guidance to senior leaders on the project portfolio. You will build new skills through cross-functional and cross-border work, and you will be recognised for results through clear performance expectations.

You will also have room to challenge convention: to find faster, better ways to run projects and to shape new processes and standards for CMO partnerships.

The pay range for this role is 940,800 – 1,448,700 DKK per year. The final offer reflects your experience and qualifications.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to lead Novo’s most strategic CMO partnerships from strategy to signature, apply for the Project Director role by 19st November 2026 . We review applications on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

For further information, please contact [insert hiring manager name and contact details].

jobs.occupation: Senior Contract Management Specialist (Senior Contract Counsel)
jobs.description:
**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**The Senior Contract Management Specialist / Senior Contract Counsel (CM) is a key role in the Contract Management team, which is part of Legal & Compliance. The CM supports all SimCorp offerings, including on-premises, SaaS, Professional Services and BPaaS. The CM is responsible for drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and executing various contracts with clients, as well as providing legal advice and guidance on contract and commercial matters. The CM also ensures that the contracts are compliant with the law and the business objectives, and that SimCorp performs its obligations under the Contract Assurance & Performance framework.

The CM works closely with the Legal team, Customer Success Management, Service Delivery Management, Project Management Office, and other internal stakeholders to understand the business and technical requirements, and to align the contracts with the best practices and standards of SimCorp. The CM also collaborates with Client Services to monitor and optimize the commercial performance and quality of the contracts.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**The CM is involved in the entire contract lifecycle, from the pre-contractual phase and support to Customer Success Management, to the onboarding project, to the contract change management, to the obligation management and quality assurance, to the exit handling.

The CM also manages and maintains together with the team the contract repository and the contractual database and supports the further implementation of contract management processes and relevant tools within SimCorp, including the upcoming Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) Platform.

The CM will be part of a self-organizing and cross-functional team that delivers value to the clients and the business.

As a CM, some of the daily or weekly tasks that you can expect are:

• Drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and executing client contracts, and ensuring that they are aligned with the legal, commercial and technical requirements

jobs.description:
Location: Søborg, Copenhagen, Denmark. AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark.

Working hours: 08:00–19:04

**About The Job

**Are you quality-minded, reliable, and motivated by working in a structured production environment where accuracy and compliance are essential? Do you take pride in your work and understand the importance of following procedures, even when working under time pressure? Then you may be our new Technician in Buffer Solution Preparation at AGC Biologics.

You will join our Solution Preparation team in SYD22, a new, state-of-the-art facility currently in the ramp-up phase. Production supports preclinical, clinical, and commercial manufacturing for a wide range of international clients.

The team consists of three skilled technicians who work closely together and collaborate with key stakeholders, including QA and Manufacturing Product Support. As part of the team, you will contribute to reliable, high-quality buffer preparation while ensuring compliance with cGMP requirements and minimizing the risk of deviations.

In this role, you will be responsible for planning and preparing the buffers used in protein purification processes. The position requires a strong quality mindset, attention to detail, a sense of urgency, and the ability to maintain an overview of your tasks while ensuring that established procedures and quality standards are never compromised.

**Your Work Will Include

**

• Planning and executing daily buffer preparation activities according to approved production records, recipes, and procedures.

• Ensuring buffers are prepared and delivered on time to support production schedules.

• Completing batch documentation accurately and promptly, ensuring that all activities are documented in accordance with GMP requirements.

• Following cGMP requirements, Manufacturing Production Records (MPRs), and approved procedures at all times.

• Working in compliance with regulatory and quality systems, including TrackWise, where relevant.

• Supporting daily production planning and coordinating activities to ensure timely delivery.

• Assisting with troubleshooting, production-related challenges, and ad hoc tasks.

• Identifying opportunities for continuous improvement and contributing to their implementation.

• Working independently and reliably while maintaining close collaboration with colleagues and relevant stakeholders.

• Maintaining a strong focus on safety, quality, and compliance, including when working under time pressure.

**About You

**We imagine that you:

• Preferably hold an education as a Process Operator, Process Technologist, Industrial Operator, or a similar relevant qualification.

• Have preferably at least two years of experience in the biopharmaceutical industry and experience working in a cGMP-regulated environment.

• Have experience preparing buffers according to recipes and instructions defined in production records.

• Have a good understanding of GMP documentation and the importance of accurate, timely documentation.

• Have an understanding of LEAN, 5S, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Can speak, read, and understand English fluently.

• Work systematically and consistently, including when performing repetitive tasks.

• Communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders.

As a person, you take pride in your work and understand that quality and compliance are essential in pharmaceutical manufacturing. You remain calm and maintain an overview when priorities change or time pressure increases. You know when to act with urgency and when to stop and seek clarification rather than compromise established standards or procedures.

You are positive, flexible, and willing to take on new assignments and responsibilities. You work independently when needed but also value teamwork and contribute to a professional and supportive working environment.

**Working Hours

**The position follows a defined shift schedule, with working hours from 08:00 to 19:04. Production operates 24/7, including weekends and public holidays, and flexibility to work during these periods is required according to the assigned shift plan.

**What We Offer

**

• A hands-on operational role in a modern production facility supporting preclinical, clinical, and commercial manufacturing.

• An international working environment at AGC Biologics, with close collaboration across functions such as QA and Manufacturing Product Support.

• A strong focus on safety, quality, and compliance, supported by structured processes and clear expectations in a cGMP environment.

• On-the-job training and opportunities to develop your technical skills within buffer preparation.

• A professional and collaborative team culture with experienced colleagues and a strong emphasis on teamwork, accountability, and reliability.

• A structured shift-based work model supporting round-the-clock production operations.

• Competitive employment terms, including salary, pension, health insurance, and employee benefits in accordance with local agreements.

• Access to a paid canteen arrangement with meals prepared by professional chefs.

• An active Employee Club offering social events and activities throughout the year.

• Opportunities to receive discounts on a variety of leisure activities and experiences throughout the year.

**Application and Contact

**We are eager to welcome a new colleague as soon as possible.

Please submit your application no later than 22 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the vacancy before the deadline if a suitable candidate is found. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

_Please note that AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark.

_**Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.
