Spirii develops world-class charging products and digital solutions for electric vehicles. Our Digital Development department fosters a listen, learn, and lead culture — allowing us to continuously improve how we work. We're looking for a hands-on Data Engineer to build and evolve Spirii's data platform and pipeline infrastructure. Working closely with our Data Lead and domain teams, you'll design and maintain reliable ELT pipelines, ensure data arrives in Amazon Redshift correctly and on time, and support the analytics layer that powers insights across EV charging events, subscriptions, and financial transactions. We actively explore AI tooling to make our data workflows smarter and our team more productive. This is a unique opportunity to shape Spirii's data infrastructure from an early stage — establishing standards for ingestion, orchestration, and data reliability as we scale.

**Your Responsibilities

****Pipeline & Ingestion

**

• Design, build, and maintain scalable ELT pipelines that bring data from product backends, third-party services, and operational systems into Amazon Redshift.

• Own ingestion reliability: monitoring, alerting, and incident response for pipeline failures.

• Evaluate and improve orchestration tooling and scheduling.

**Data Platform & Infrastructure

**

• Evolve Spirii's data platform architecture: storage, compute, access control, and cost optimisation in Redshift.

• Implement and maintain infrastructure-as-code practices for data workflows (Terraform/CDK or similar).

• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for data infrastructure and transformations.

**Data Quality & Governance

**

• Implement data quality checks, freshness monitoring, and anomaly detection across ingestion and transformation layers.

• Work with Analytics Engineers and domain teams to define and enforce data contracts and schema standards.

• Ensure GDPR-compliant data handling: PII identification, access control, and data retention policies.

**Collaboration & Stakeholders

**

• Partner with Engineering and Product teams to instrument events correctly at the source — schemas, identifiers, and change management.

• Collaborate with Data team to ensure the analytics layer is built on reliable, well-modelled foundations.

• Contribute to a strong data culture by creating and enhancing documentation, runbooks, data lineage, discoverability and incident response capabilities.

**About The Team

**You'll be joining Spirii's Data Enablement Team, a small, early-stage team formed in January 2026, so you'll have real influence over how things get built from here. The team consists of an Engineering Manager for Data (who you’ll report to), a Data Lead, a Product Manager for Data, and two Analytics Engineers who partner closely with our domain teams. We're in the middle of migrating from Redshift to Databricks and getting our first data products live in production on the new platform: you'll help shape ingestion, orchestration, and reliability standards as we scale.

**About You

**

• You care deeply about data reliability and building pipelines that teams can depend on.

• You're hands-on: you build, test, and ship pipelines and infrastructure improvements yourself.

• You think of data pipelines as products — you care about uptime, observability, and the downstream consumers who depend on them.

• You embrace using AI tools to improve data engineering workflows, whether that's using LLMs to accelerate transformation authoring, anomaly detection, or documentation.

• You're pragmatic: you know when to engineer robustly and when to keep things lean.

• You collaborate well across teams and communicate clearly about trade-offs and status.

**Qualifications

**

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

• 3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related role with a strong data focus.

• Strong SQL skills and solid experience building production data pipelines.

• Hands-on experience with a modern data warehouse (Redshift preferred; BigQuery/Snowflake/Databricks also relevant).

• Experience with orchestration tools (Apache Airflow or similar).

• Proficiency in Python for data work (pipeline scripts, transformations, tooling).

• Solid understanding of ELT/ETL concepts, including incremental loading, CDC, and idempotency.

• Familiar with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK, or similar).

• Familiar with data governance concepts: access control, PII handling, GDPR-minded practices.

**Nice to Have

**

• Experience with data observability tooling.

• Experience with event/data contract patterns in product analytics (schemas, versioning, instrumentation).

• Experience with finance data and/or subscription/transaction domains.

• Experience with dbt (understanding of transformation layer and how it interfaces with pipelines).

• Experience using AI/LLM tools in a data engineering context

• Machine learning infrastructure experience is a plus, but not required for this role.

**Benefits

• Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

**Role

**The Senior Manager, Global Regulatory Labeling Operations plays a key role in leading labeling operations for the EU and Rest of World (RoW) markets, while providing support for U.S. labeling activities. The role is responsible for the timely delivery of compliant, high-quality, submission-ready labeling documents and packaging components, including mockups and artwork, across assigned markets. As a subject matter expert in Regulatory Labeling Operations, the Senior Manager provides strategic and operational guidance on labeling requirements, oversees complex labeling activities, and works closely with cross-functional stakeholders and external partners to support regulatory submissions, product launches, and lifecycle management.

The Senior Manager also contributes to the continued development and optimization of Genmab’s global end-to-end labeling processes, systems, and capabilities, helping ensure they remain efficient, scalable, compliant, and aligned with evolving regulatory requirements and industry standards. This is an individual contributor role at Senior Manager level. The role reports to the Director, Global Regulatory Labeling Operations and is based in Denmark.

**Responsibilities

**

• Serve as a Regulatory Labeling Operations Subject Matter Expert (SME) for EU and RoW markets, providing guidance on regulatory requirements and operational strategy, and acting as a key SME in driving the resolution of complex labeling issues and escalating significant compliance, business, or strategic risks to functional leadership.

• Lead the planning and delivery of compliant, high-quality, submission-ready labeling documents and packaging components, including prescribing information, patient leaflets, mockups, and artwork.

• Manage EU Linguistic Review activities and coordinate the review and approval of translated labeling documents.

• Ensure labeling deliverables meet applicable regulatory requirements and Genmab standards for quality, accuracy, consistency, and compliance.

• Support labeling operations for regulatory submissions, including new marketing applications and lifecycle submissions, as well as product launches and ongoing product maintenance.

• Oversee external vendors and partners responsible for labeling deliverables, monitoring quality, compliance, timelines, and performance and driving improvements where needed.

• Monitor and interpret evolving EU and RoW labeling requirements and industry standards, assess their operational impact, and communicate relevant changes to key stakeholders.

• Utilize labeling, artwork, and electronic document management systems to support content lifecycle management, review and approval workflows, version control, and inspection readiness.

• Partner closely with Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, and other internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective planning and execution of labeling activities.

• Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of global end-to-end labeling processes, tools, systems, infrastructure, SOPs, and work instructions.

• Identify opportunities to improve labeling processes and operational efficiency and influence implementation across functions and geographies.

• Represent Global Regulatory Labeling Operations in cross-functional initiatives, governance forums, and strategic discussions that impact labeling processes, systems, and capabilities.

• Mentor and provide guidance to junior team members, supporting knowledge sharing and capability development within the function.

**Requirements

**

• Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences or a related discipline preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.

• 5+ years of relevant experience within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, with demonstrated experience in regulatory labeling and/or regulatory operations.

• Strong knowledge of EU labeling requirements and experience supporting labeling activities across international or RoW markets.

• Working knowledge of CTD format and content for EU regulatory submissions.

• Experience managing labeling documents, packaging components, artwork, and/or translation and linguistic review activities.

• Experience working with electronic document, labeling, or artwork management systems; experience with Veeva or similar platforms is an advantage.

• Demonstrated ability to manage complex deliverables, priorities, vendors, and timelines in a global, cross-functional environment.

• Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across functions and geographies.

• Knowledge of U.S. labeling requirements is an advantage.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with strong attention to detail and a quality- and compliance-focused mindset.

• Payroll reconciliations, including three-way reconciliations between the payroll system, finance, and statutory reporting/eIncome, as well as reconciliations of accrued and outstanding payroll-related balances

• Preparing audit documentation and delivering ad hoc reporting

• Contributing to process optimization and continuous improvement initiatives, including ensuring best practices across payroll processes

You will report to the Director, Group Finance, while working closely with HR Operations.

Who are you?

We are looking for someone who has:

• Experience with payroll systems (SAP Payroll and SAP SuccessFactors are considered an advantage)

• Strong Excel skills and a solid understanding of systems in general. You are comfortable working analytically with large datasets, identifying patterns and connections in data, and applying a strong technical understanding

• A keen eye for detail and a high degree of data accuracy

• Knowledge of payroll legislation and, ideally, collective agreements for blue collar employees

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate professionally with HR, Finance, and employees across the organization, including responding to payroll-related inquiries from employees

• The ability to work independently and take ownership of your responsibilities, while also enjoying close collaboration with a colleague on shared tasks

• A proactive and curious approach to processes, along with a desire to contribute to continuous improvements

• The ability to work in a structured and reliable manner, as our payroll processes require a high level of accuracy and quality

• Fluency in Danish and strong English language skills

Who are we?

In Group Finance, you will become part of a dedicated team focused on quality, knowledge sharing, and collaborative problem-solving. In addition to Payroll, the department includes Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, Cash and Bank Management, Controlling, as well as process owners and system specialists who work closely together across Finance and other key functions.

The team has an informal and supportive culture, deep professional expertise, and a strong commitment to helping one another while continuously developing and improving processes together.

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are 2,300 employees united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense, Denmark in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of making affordable healthcare accessible.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

Are you passionate about developing advanced microwave oscillator systems for world-class Doppler radar solutions?

At Weibel, you will become part of a growing, technology-driven company where curiosity, innovation, and dedication are the foundation of our global success. We develop and manufacture high-performance radar systems at our in-house production facilities, enabling us to explore new solutions while maintaining uncompromising quality. Our greatest asset is our talented employees, who work in a modern environment and continuously advance our market-leading radar solutions for applications such as air surveillance and precision tracking.

We are strengthening our Antenna R&D Group and are looking for a Senior Microwave Engineer to join us as we enter a new growth phase.

About the position

As our new colleague, you will drive the development of microwave oscillators from early concept through design, integration, and deployment into our radar systems. You will collaborate closely with colleagues across analog, digital, and mechanical engineering disciplines. In addition, you will contribute to architectural improvements in collaboration with our system architects.

Your primary responsibilities include:

• Designing, developing, and optimizing oscillator modules and circuitry for high-performance radar applications.

• Researching and evaluating new oscillator technologies to improve phase noise, frequency stability, and overall system performance.

• Serving as the technical subject-matter expert for oscillator designs and their integration.

• Supporting prototype assembly, testing, and DFM reviews to ensure successful transfer to production.

• Providing technical support to in-house production and customers through engineering guidance, root-cause analysis, and documentation.

This is an exciting opportunity to shape the frequency-generation foundation of Weibel's radar portfolio and enhance the performance of our next-generation radar systems.

About you

You thrive in an Agile environment, where you work both independently and in close collaboration with your team and cross-functional stakeholders. You value continuous learning and are comfortable operating in a dynamic R&D setting with multiple parallel activities, some requiring immediate attention and others progressing through structured project plans.

Your qualifications include:

• An M.Sc. or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related field, preferably with a specialization in RF or microwave hardware design.

• Hands-on experience with oscillator and frequency-generation design, e.g., VCOs, DROs, or PLL-based synthesizers, including optimization of phase noise, frequency stability, and spectral purity.

• A strong background in RF, microwave, or mixed-signal systems development, combined with a solid understanding of the full product development lifecycle.

• Familiarity with regulatory requirements (e.g., radio and EMC) and military standards applied in mission-critical industries.

• Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

Furthermore, you are comfortable leveraging AI-assisted tools to improve engineering efficiency and quality.

Your new team

Our team consists of over 10 engaged colleagues, with experience ranging from a few years to more than 35 years in radar engineering. The team is part of our cross-functional Antenna R&D Group, bringing together architects and design specialists across RF, analog, digital, and mechanical domains to deliver cutting-edge radar technology.

Contact and application

Please submit your application via our website using the “Apply” button. If you have any questions about the position, you are very welcome to contact Engineering Manager, Adin Kanlic, at adk@weibel.dk.

The application deadline is 16 November.

Please note that we review applications on an ongoing basis.

Employment in this role is subject to the ability to provide a clean criminal record and to obtain the required security clearance.

We look forward to receiving your application.

Become part of a Danish company

Weibel Scientific A/S is a Danish-owned engineering company experiencing strong growth. We develop and manufacture high‑technology radar systems for use in areas such as space research, aviation, defense, and the protection of critical infrastructure. We are a world leader in the development of Doppler radars and, since our establishment in 1977, we have delivered more than 4,500 state‑of‑the-art radar systems to over 40 countries.

Our headquarters are located in Allerød and employ nearly 600 people.

At Weibel, you can look forward to an exciting and challenging position in a dynamic and forward‑looking company with in‑house production and advanced technological development.

Read more about us on our website.

Do you have experience with planning and testing complex systems?

At Weibel you will join a truly technology driven company that delivers excellent Doppler Radars across the world. Weibel is recognized as a world-leader in radar technology, with our radars performing with a precision largely unmatched by competitors. Applications for our radars include Space Research, Missile Defence, Instrumentation Systems and lately for drone and UAS detection. Our radars are produced at our HQ in Allerød, north of Copenhagen.

Increasing customer demand means that the company is experiencing rapid growth. As part of this, we are extending our leadership team in our System Integration, Test & Verification team with one more experienced System Test Manager.

Oversee the system test of our state-of-the-art radars

As System Test Manager you take ownership of system test activities across the development lifecycle of our advanced radar products. In this leadership role you will plan, prioritize, and drive the work of one or maybe a few Scrum teams of test engineers, ensuring that integrated hardware and software meet system requirements, performance targets, quality standards, and customer expectations.

You will be part of a test leadership team comprising four System Test Managers. Each manager supports a dedicated program with deliveries based on our radar platforms and owns the test plan for the projects in the program. Coordination with the other three test managers is therefore also relevant to inspire and maximize reuse to continuously improve testing and execute as efficiently as possible.

Key responsibilities:

• Plan and drive the execution of integration, functional, performance, robustness, environmental and regression testing through one or more Scrum teams of test engineers.

• Define test scope and methods and translate program priorities and test needs into clear team objectives, backlogs, milestones, dependencies, and delivery expectations.

• Align with the other System Test Managers on shared methods, mechanisms and specialist resources.

• Establish test readiness criteria, and communicate product maturity, coverage, results, and residual risks to the Technical Project Manager in the Program

• Drive automation, repeatability, data quality, and continuous improvement in test processes.

• Support customer demonstrations, qualification activities, and formal acceptance testing when required.

• Act as a technical lead and mentor for a team of System Test Engineers, and be part of creating a culture with focus on quality and continuous improvement

• Collaborate with Mechanical, Hardware and Software development teams to define test requirements and ensure seamless integration

• Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements

About you

You thrive in an environment that requires you to work independently on some tasks and in close collaboration with your colleagues across the entire company on others. You have excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a detailed-oriented mindset. You show initiative and drive, take responsibility, have strong communication skills, work effectively across teams and dare to challenge the team to ensure high quality. You understand how the Scrum methodology applies in a system test context.

Your CV include:

• A relevant engineering degree

• 10+ years of experience in system testing of complex integrated HW and SW systems

• Proven technical leadership experience, managing test teams in an agile development environment

• Experience working with Requirements and Test management tools (we use Helix)

• Strong understanding of test automation tools, frameworks, and methodologies

• Experience with systems engineering in relation to complex systems

• Relevant certifications (e.g. ISTQB) is an advantage

• Fluent in English both written and spoken

• Experience with radar systems or complex systems for military use, is considered an advantage

Your new team

You will be joining our team of more than 25 colleagues in the Integration, Test & Verification team. Our responsibilities span across system integration and testing as well as qualification of our products and we are divided into two competency domains. Each domain is represented by an Engineering Manager in the Test Leadership team, which also has four System Test Managers, where you will be one.

The level of experience in the team spans from newly graduates to more than +20 years of experience. Our team members have different educational backgrounds that vary from satellite, aerospace, earth and space physics to mechanical and electrical engineering. We have created it in this way, because we believe that bringing people with different competences together will generate the best solutions.

Contact and application

Please apply at our website using the ”Apply” button. If you have any questions, you are very welcome to contact Director Integration, Test & Verification, Lars Boye on lrb@weibel.dk.

The deadline is the 22nd of November 2026.

Please be aware that it is a requirement for this position that you can provide a criminal record with no remarks and obtain a security clearance.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Become part of a Danish company

Weibel Scientific A/S is a Danish-owned engineering company experiencing strong growth. We develop and manufacture high‑technology radar systems for use in areas such as space research, aviation, defense, and the protection of critical infrastructure. We are a world leader in the development of Doppler radars and, since our establishment in 1977, we have delivered more than 4,500 state‑of‑the‑art radar systems to over 40 countries.

Our headquarters are located in Allerød and employ nearly 600 people.

At Weibel, you can look forward to an exciting and challenging position in a dynamic and forward‑looking company with in-house production and advanced technological development.

Read more about us on our website.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

We are looking for an enthusiastic and proactive Student Worker with an interest in corporate communications, storytelling and digital channels to join Genmab’s global Communications & Corporate Affairs (C&CA) team.

Based in our Copenhagen office, you will work closely with another Student Worker in Copenhagen and collaborate with Communications colleagues across our global organization, including Denmark, The Netherlands and the United States.

You will contribute to a broad range of internal communications activities, supporting global initiatives as well as local employee engagement and communications activities in Denmark and the Netherlands, including corporate and R&D-related communications.

This role offers an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in corporate communications within an innovative, international biotechnology company. The position reports to the Senior Director, Communications, based in Princeton, New Jersey, USA.

This position is intended for students currently enrolled in academic programs and is approximately 15-20 hours per week, with flexibility around studies.

**About The Enterprise Internal Communications Team

**Our purpose is to strengthen internal communications across Genmab as the company grows, ensuring colleagues receive clear, consistent and engaging communication that connects them to our strategy, scientific innovation and extra[not]ordinary® culture.

We coordinate communications across our anchor sites in Denmark, the Netherlands and the United States.

The **Role

**You’ll help plan and deliver our editorial content, coordinate digital channels, plus support events and office communications in Copenhagen.

You will support the planning, creation and delivery of internal communications editorial content, help coordinate our digital channels and contribute to employee engagement activities across Genmab.

Working with colleagues in Copenhagen and across our global team, you will gain experience in communications planning, content creation, digital engagement and event support.

You will also have opportunities to contribute to communications highlighting Genmab’s innovative R&D activities, scientific achievements and the people behind our science, particularly in collaboration with our teams in the Netherlands.

**Responsibilities

**

• Internal communications and storytelling: Support the execution of Genmab’s global internal communications strategy by creating engaging content for our corporate intranet, Viva Engage and other internal channels.

• R&D and scientific storytelling: Collaborate with communications colleagues and R&D teams, particularly in the Netherlands, to develop accessible, people-centric stories highlighting scientific innovation, research milestones, team achievements and employee experiences.

• Digital communications: Support the coordination and management of digital communications channels, including digital signage across our global offices, from content requests through publication.

• Corporate branding: Collaborate with our Corporate Branding team to refresh reception-area content and other visual communications materials.

• Employee engagement and events: Plan and execute employee events, town halls, leadership meetings and engagement activities, both globally and locally, with a particular focus on Copenhagen and virtual support for the Netherlands.

• Content creation: Assist with interviews, writing, editing and producing various deliverables including articles, presentations, visuals and short-form video content.

• Analytics and continuous improvement: Track the performance of our content, identify opportunities for improvement and contribute creative ideas to enhance employee engagement.

• Cross-functional collaboration: Work with colleagues across C&CA, R&D and other functions to coordinate communications activities and ensure timely delivery of content.

**Requirments

**

• You are currently studying Communications, Marketing, Business and Administration, or a related field as a bachelor or master’s student with an interest in digital communication

• You are interested in the pharma/biotech industry and the unique role that Corporate Communications plays across various internal and external audiences.

• You are confident communicating in English and interested in writing and storytelling

• You are organized, detail-oriented and take ownership of your work and your relationships with stakeholders.

• You have strong digital skills and are familiar with tools such as Microsoft 365 and PowerPoint. Experience with SharePoint, video editing, digital analytics or emerging AI tools is an advantage.

• You are proactive, curious and eager to learn, with a flexible and solution-oriented mindset

• You are a generous collaborator who enjoys working in an international team, both on-site and virtually, and you like to have fun along the way.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK180,00---180,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

**The Impact You'll Make

**As a Production Engineer at Danfoss Silkeborg in our plastic moulding department, you will play a key role in developing, maintaining, and improving our plastic injection moulding processes that produce plastic components for some of Danfoss' most iconic products - the radiator thermostats and its valve - made right here in Silkeborg.

You will be instrumental in ensuring that our plastic injection moulding processes remain capable, reliable, and ready to meet future customer demands.

You will work alongside a team of 11 skilled Production Engineers, where you will take part of the ownership of our plastic injection moulding processes and related production equipment. Working closely with operators, tool technicians, maintenance, quality, and product development teams, you will drive process optimization, troubleshoot complex production challenges, validate new products and materials, and implement robust solutions that ensure stable and efficient production.

This role offers the opportunity to combine hands-on engineering, problem-solving, and continuous improvement in a fast-paced manufacturing environment where new technologies, products, and materials are continuously introduced and your will have a direct impact on product quality, process capability, equipment uptime and productivity.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**You'll work closely with operators, tool technicians, maintenance specialists, quality engineers, and product development teams to improve process performance and support the introduction of new products, materials, and technologies.

**You Will

**

• Own and continuously improve plastic injection moulding processes, ensuring safe, stable, and efficient production performance

• Optimize moulding parameters, cycle times, material utilization, and process capability to increase productivity, capacity, and reduce waste

• Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis of process deviations, quality issues, scrap, and equipment downtime, implementing sustainable solutions

• Introduce and validate new products, materials, tooling, and equipment, ensuring smooth implementation and integration into production

• Strengthen process and quality control through structured methods such as APQP, process validation, PFMEAs, control plans, and maintenance strategies

**What We're Looking For

**To succeed in this role, you'll combine technical expertise with a practical, hands-on approach to solving manufacturing challenges.

**Essential Qualifications

**

• Technical background within plastic processing, injection moulding, production engineering, mechanical engineering, toolmaking, polymer engineering, or a related field

• Strong understanding of injection moulding processes, tooling, polymer materials, and production optimization

• Ability to combine analytical thinking with practical problem-solving on the shop floor

• Strong collaboration and communication skills, with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset when working across functions and with external partners

• Fluency in Danish and English, both written and spoken

Experience with APQP, PFMEA, process validation, continuous improvement methodologies, or quality management systems will be considered an advantage.

**What You'll Get From Us

**At Danfoss, you'll join an experienced and collaborative engineering environment where you'll have the opportunity to influence products manufactured in high volumes and used in homes around the world.

You'll work with advanced injection moulding technologies and play a key role in introducing new products, materials, and manufacturing solutions, while being supported by knowledgeable colleagues who value teamwork, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.

We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you!

Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

For information about the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner, Gerd Veierskov, +45 3057 1882

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

jobs.description:
**Senior Development Engineer, VELUX Products & Innovation – Maintenance Free Window Modules – LKR Innovation House - Østbirk

****Join a team of passionate engineers and technical specialists with end-to-end responsibility for critical window modules. If you thrive on solving complex technical challenges, driving product development, and creating value across the entire product lifecycle, you could be our next Senior Development Engineer.

****Meet your future team

**You will become part of the Maintenance Free Window Modules team based in Østbirk. The team has end-to-end responsibility for VELUX sash and frame mo-dules made from polyurethane and other polymers, as well as our Insulating Glass Unit (IGU) modules.

Working across the full product lifecycle, the team supports everything from concept creation and new product introduction to continuous optimization of cost, performance, sustainability, and quality. We collaborate closely with Product Management, Production, and other development teams to ensure our products continue to create value for customers and the business.

As our new Senior Development Engineer, you will act as the Module Owner of the IGU module area, driving development activities, shaping future module roadmaps, and ensuring strong cross-functional alignment across the organization.

**What We Offer

**This is an opportunity to take on a highly influential technical role with significant impact across products, processes, and stakeholders. You will work with experienced colleagues in an international environment where innovation, knowledge sharing, and collaboration are valued and encouraged.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Hold technical ownership and end-to-end responsibility for Insulating Glass Unit (IGU) modules.

• Drive module development activities across new product launches, performance improvements, cost optimization, upgrades, sustainability initiatives, and quality enhancements.

• Conduct module health assessments to evaluate performance, value creation, business relevance, and future opportunities.

• Identify, qualify, and drive opportunities that create value across the product lifecycle and value chain.

• Lead design, concept development, and resolution of complex technical challenges.

• Define and secure technical requirements, module performance, and robust engineering solutions.

• Build strong relationships with stakeholders and ensure alignment across Product Management, Production, Supply Chain, and Product Development.

• Support management decision-making through technical expertise and insights.

• Act as a knowledge leader by developing technical capabilities, facilitating learning activities, and promoting effective knowledge sharing throughout the organization.

**What You Will Bring

**You enjoy navigating complex technical environments and are motivated by combining deep technical expertise with cross-functional collaboration. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and are able to balance technical excellence with business value.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Hold a Master’s degree in Engineering or another relevant technical discipline.

• Have experience working with product development or complex technical products.

• Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured approach to technical challenges.

• Have experience with CAD tools, preferably CREO and Windchill.

• Communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.

• Demonstrate the ability to engage and align stakeholders across functions and disciplines.

• Take a proactive approach and can independently drive activities from concept to implementation.

• Have experience or knowledge into systems engineering, which is considered an advantage but not a requirement.

• Have experience or knowledge within insulating glass, glazing solutions, or related technologies, which is considered an advantage but not a requirement.

**Ready to apply?

**Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have found the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

**About VELUX

**In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, courage and mutual respect define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

**Equal Opportunity Employer

**At VELUX Residential, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX Residential. That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

**The Impact You'll Make

**Are you curious about how products go from idea to market in a global technology company? As a Student Worker in Product Management, you will help shape solutions for the international air-conditioning and refrigeration industry while gaining hands-on experience in a business-critical function.

In this role, you will support product development, market analysis, product launches, and supplier collaboration. Your work will help transform customer and market insights into actions that create value for customers around the world.

You will join Danfoss Climate Solutions and work closely with experienced colleagues across functions and geographies. This is an opportunity to develop both your commercial and technical understanding while building a strong professional network in an international environment.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Support product development and launch activities by coordinating inputs, documentation, and follow-up actions to help projects move forward successfully.

• Research market trends, customer needs, and competitor developments to identify insights and business opportunities.

• Collaborate with colleagues and suppliers to align activities and ensure smooth execution across functions.

• Prepare presentations, business analyses, and product information that support decision-making and communication.

• Contribute to portfolio and product-management activities by organizing information and helping drive key initiatives.

**What We're Looking For

**

• You are currently enrolled in a relevant bachelor's or master's program and can combine your studies with approximately 12-15 working hours per week.

• You have a strong interest in product management, technology, business development, and international markets.

• You have an analytical and structured approach and enjoy working with data, information, and business insights.

• You communicate clearly in English and can collaborate effectively with different stakeholders.

• You take initiative, follow through on commitments, and are comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.

**What You'll Get From Us

**At Danfoss, you'll gain practical experience in an international product management environment where your contributions have real impact.

You will have the opportunity to learn about product development, product launches, portfolio management, supplier collaboration, and business development while working alongside experienced professionals. We believe in learning through responsibility, and you will gradually take ownership of your own tasks and projects.

This position is based in Copenhagen, Denmark, with flexible working arrangements that support your studies and provide additional flexibility during examination periods.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you're excited about combining business, technology, and market insights in a global organization, we'd love to hear from you. Even if your experience doesn't match every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply and share how your skills and perspective can contribute to the team.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Are you ready to kickstart your career in Insurance and Broking in a global organization and join a dynamic, international team? Marsh Denmark is seeking a Student Assistant for our Risk Management (RM) Placement team in Copenhagen.

**About The Team

**Our Copenhagen team is part of Marsh’s global network, collaborating with colleagues across the Nordics and Europe to deliver market-leading solutions in Property, Construction and Liability insurance. We work with a variety of clients, from mid-size to large multinationals, providing innovative support tailored to each client’s unique challenges.

You will be part of a team where you have the opportunity to work together with highly skilled brokers on daily tasks, client presentations, data preparation towards insurance tenders etc., while you learn about the role as a specialized broker. Join a passionate team that understands the importance of delivering fast and efficient quality service to our clients.

We place great emphasis on a flat organizational structure and an informal work environment that prioritizes open and efficient communication.

The position requires approximately 15 hours of work per week at our office for a minimum of two years.

**What You Will Do

**

• Supporting brokers with daily tasks

• Analyze and assess complex property and business interruption risks

• Data collection from clients and insurers

• Create presentations in collaboration with brokers

• Support with overviews of quotations from insurance markets

• Support standards, templates, and best practices for the team

**Your profile

**We are looking for a colleague currently pursuing a higher education degree. In addition, you should:

• Have an aptitude for IT and AI systems

• Take pride in delivering high-quality work

• Have strong written and verbal communication skills in both Danish and English

• Enjoy learning new things and be able to handle tasks independently to ensure brokers and clients receive excellent service.

**What Makes You Stand Out

**

• Strong analytical skills and ability to transform data into actionable recommendations

• Effective, positive, and solution-oriented communicator

• You are curious and enjoy learning new things

• You thrive on varied tasks and not always knowing what tasks await you when you arrive at work

You can read more about Marsh Denmark here: www.marsh.com

Please submit your CV in English.

**Why join our team:

**

jobs.occupation: Research Assistant in Artificial Intelligence for Power Electronics Design
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a fixed-term position as Research Assistant in Artificial Intelligence for Power Electronics Design, is open for appointment from January 1, 2027, or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is 2 years.

Your work tasks
Your work will include developing, training and evaluating machine-learning models based on circuit data, board geometries, simulation results and design images. You will develop surrogate models that approximate thermal and electromagnetic solvers, enabling faster evaluation of design alternatives. The position may also involve computer vision for recognizing circuit structures, component placements and printed circuit board geometries from photographs or other images. In addition, you will investigate graph-based methods for representing circuit relationships, evaluating design rules and generating or testing hypotheses for circuit designs. You will contribute to the development and verification of agentic workflows, where artificial intelligence systems combine models, tools and design rules to reason through and support electronics design tasks. You will prepare datasets, document computational workflows, validate model performance and share results with colleagues working in artificial intelligence, power electronics, semiconductors and software development.

The position is offered within the research field of Artificial Intelligence for Power Electronics Design and contributes to AAU Energy’s focus areas of Digital Transformation and Artificial Intelligence, and Energy Efficiency in Components and Systems. The Research Assistant will be affiliated with the Section of Power Electronics System Integration and Materials.

Your competencies
You have a relevant master’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, electronics, artificial intelligence or a related field, and you are interested in working at the intersection of machine learning and power electronics design. You have a solid foundation in applied machine learning. Familiarity with electronic systems, including printed circuit boards, circuit topologies, components and the physical principles that influence electrical, thermal and electromagnetic performance, will help you engage with the engineering context of the role.

You have practical experience developing, training and evaluating machine-learning models, and you can translate complex engineering challenges into data-driven methods suited to a research environment. You are comfortable working with structured and unstructured engineering data, including circuit representations, board geometries, simulation data and images. Experience with computer vision, graph-based machine learning or graph neural networks will support your work with methods that interpret circuit layouts and geometries, reason about relationships between components, and generate or assess design hypotheses.

You are interested in developing surrogate models that approximate thermal and electromagnetic simulation tools while maintaining sufficient accuracy for use in electronics-design workflows. You work systematically with model validation, data quality and reproducible experiments, and you understand that artificial intelligence methods for engineering need to be technically robust as well as useful to domain specialists.

You communicate clearly in English, both in writing and dialogue, and you work well in a multidisciplinary environment where colleagues with expertise in artificial intelligence, power electronics and software development collaborate closely. You take responsibility for your tasks, ask constructive questions when assumptions need clarification, and contribute with curiosity and sound technical judgement to the development of new methods for intelligent electronic-system design.

Who we are
AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real-world energy challenges.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk

Qualification requirements 
Appointment as a research assistant requires academic qualifications at master's degree level.

How to apply  
Your application must include the following: 

• Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position. 
• Curriculum Vitae (CV). 
• Diplomas (master's degree diploma and potential PhD diploma). 
• Documentation of teaching qualifications (optional). 
• Additional qualifications in relation to the position. 
• References/recommendations. 
You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. International staff are encouraged, with support from the university, to learn Danish during their employment in order to support their integration into the workplace and Danish society. 

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment. 

Do you have any questions? 
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.    

Selected candidates will be invited for an interview. Interviews are expected to be held during December 2026

Further information 
Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Research assistant”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Are you passionate about renewable energy and eager to work at the forefront of the global energy transition? PEAK Wind is seeking an AI Engineer to help shape our AI roadmap and to build and orchestrate the agents our colleagues and clients will use every day. At PEAK Wind, AI is moving from prototypes into production, and renewable energy operations produce exactly the kind of complex, high-volume data where AI can deliver significant value.

Introducing the Data & Intelligence Team

You will become part of our Data & Intelligence (D&I) team, where we work within PEAK Wind’s asset management service offering and manage full value chain data management for our clients. We support renewable energy assets worldwide through data management, reporting solutions, analytics, and AI capabilities, helping deliver data-driven solutions that support our clients and renewable energy projects. Our team consists of highly motivated professionals who bring diverse backgrounds and a strong commitment to excellence. We support one another, share knowledge, and celebrate both individual and collective achievements.

You will report to the Head of Data & Intelligence and work day-to-day with our small team of engineers who have been building internal AI products at PEAK Wind for several years. You will work closely with colleagues across different areas, bringing your perspective to a collaborative and purposeful team environment.

How You Will Make an Impact

As an AI Engineer, you will take AI solutions from idea to production and keep them there. You will co-own our AI roadmap: helping decide which agents we build, in what order, and what “working” means for each of them. Then you will build them.

Our agent portfolio serves two audiences. Internally, our agents give colleagues across PEAK Wind a well-governed way to work with company knowledge, generate reports, and analyse wind farm performance. Other internal agents help our own engineers specify and build new features faster. Externally, we provide agent-driven capabilities in our client-facing products.

On smaller initiatives you may be the engineer primarily responsible for taking the solution from first conversation to deployment. On larger initiatives, you will work closely with Product Owners, data engineers, and domain experts in asset management. Either way, the distance from an idea to something running is deliberately short. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Co-develop and maintain the PEAK Wind AI roadmap with the AI team, turning business needs into scoped, sequenced deliverables

• Design, build, and deploy agentic systems for internal colleagues, from reporting and wind farm analysis to engineering-productivity agents

• Design, build, and deploy AI-driven features and agents in our client-facing products, working with SCADA, operations, and asset management data

• Orchestrate multi-agent workflows: tool use, memory, retrieval over company and client data, and integration with our platform through APIs

• Build the evaluation systems that tell us whether an agent works, before and after it reaches production

• Own the data and infrastructure work behind your own agents on the cloud.

• Implement responsible-AI practices for operational energy data: access control, data isolation between clients, logging, and guardrails

• Ship early and iterate put prototypes in users’ hands fast and feed what you learn back into the roadmap

• Collaborate with Product Owners and stakeholders to understand what they need, and push back when AI is not the right tool

• Document what you build so others can maintain, extend, and trust it

What Will Make You Successful in This Role

At PEAK Wind, we know success comes in many forms. What matters most is your mindset, curiosity, and drive to make an impact. The following qualities and experiences will help you succeed in this role:

• A degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or similar, or an equivalent track record of shipping software

• Hands-on experience in software development, ML, data engineering, or AI Engineering, including AI applications you have helped take into production

• Strong Python and/or TypeScript, and hands-on experience with at least one agent framework

• Experience building or extending evals for LLM and agent behaviour, or an interest in developing deeper expertise in this area

• Experience building in cloud environments, preferably Microsoft Azure; familiarity with PostgreSQL, APIs, and modern web stacks is an advantage

• You code with AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor as a matter of course

• Professional experience in the energy industry or another complex technical environment; renewable energy or SCADA experience is an advantage but not required

• Clear and effective communication skills in English, both spoken and written, with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike

• A go-doer mentality: you would rather ship something real this week and improve it next week than perfect it in a document

• A structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to take initiative, including owning a product from idea to delivery

• The ability to stay calm and constructive in a high-paced environment

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive in an international, cross-functional team

This role is designed for an engineer who has already gained some hands-on experience building AI solutions and is now looking to deepen that expertise in a highly practical, production-focused environment and enjoys building and learning.

Why Join PEAK Wind

• A real mandate to build with AI: an existing roadmap, internal users who want what you build, and clients ready to adopt it

• An international, inclusive, and diverse workplace where differences are valued

• The opportunity to work on leading renewable energy projects alongside experienced industry professionals

• Flexible working arrangements that support both your career and personal life

• A flat organisational structure where your ideas are welcomed and your contributions matter

• A strong focus on your learning, development, and professional growth

• A culture that values commitment, meaningful contributions, and having fun

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Fair Hiring

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace drives innovation, creativity, and stronger results. At PEAK Wind, we are committed to fair and transparent hiring processes, welcoming candidates from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our hiring decisions focus on what each person brings to the role and our team, and we are committed to ensuring transparent salary structures, with pay decisions based on clear, objective, and gender‑neutral criteria. Salary information, including the relevant salary band, will be shared with candidates when they are invited to a first interview.

How to Apply

We look forward to receiving your application. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been found. Please apply directly through our website. If you have any questions or would like to know more about the position, please contact People & Development at recruitment@peak-wind.com.

About PEAK Wind

PEAK Wind is an independent renewable energy specialist in commercial, financial, and technical operations, delivering advisory, intelligence, and asset management services to investors and developers around the world. From onshore and offshore wind generation to Power-to-X, we work across the entire energy lifecycle to optimise operations and maintenance, enhance asset performance, and provide a holistic view of renewable infrastructure portfolios.

Our values - Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity - are reflected in everything we do, from how we support our clients to how we collaborate as a team. At PEAK Wind, you will be able to apply your professional skills in a dynamic environment and experience a meaningful responsibility and involvement.

Working hours: Primarily afternoon and evening shifts, including at least every other weekend. Shifts typically fall between 11:00 and midnight, depending on the schedule. Being able and keen to work more is a welcome plus.

• 
Questions: Contact Gobo Hansen, F&B Manager, at gobo.hansen@hobohotel.dk.

• 
Application deadline: November 16th

We review applications and meet candidates on an ongoing basis, and positions may be filled before the application deadline.

_Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant or outsourcing company.

_**Deliver with focus. Scale with intent 🚀

**Are you a delivery leader who knows how to guide enterprise customers through complex set-ups without over-engineering the journey? Do you care deeply about building scalable, repeatable SaaS delivery rather than one-off custom projects?

At Performativ, we’re building the infrastructure layer for modern wealth management. As our Engagement Manager, you’ll lead the enterprise rollout of our SaaS platform helping customers onboard successfully through structured delivery, clear communication, and lightweight technical engagement.

This is not a professional services consulting role. You won’t be buried in endless customer-specific code or heavy customizations. Instead, you’ll work cross-functionally to help customers adopt our product the right way: cleanly, securely, and in line with platform best practices so they can scale on top of us, not around us.

**What You Will Do

**

• 
Own enterprise set-up programs end to end (kick-off through go-live and hyper-care) against an agreed plan and scope (Statement of Work).

• 
Enable customers to integrate Performativ via standard platform patterns (APIs, SSO, configuration) without custom buildouts, working with product and engineering to flag gaps early and advocate for scalable paths.

• 
Own plan, scope, and change control, keeping scope tied to contract and change visible and decided rather than quietly absorbed, and support the Technical Program Lead on requirements, design documents, and acceptance-criteria sign-off.

• 
Run customer communication, cadence, and governance with reporting that keeps meetings short, and manage risk, dependency, and issue tracking (including customer-side).

• 
Lead a clean handover to Customer Success at go-live or hyper-care exit, including train-the-trainer sessions and supporting materials.

• 
Represent the program in internal capacity and exception reviews, bringing requests the plan cannot absorb back as options rather than committing on the spot.

• 
Build repeatable playbooks, documentation, and artefacts that make the next program faster. You will be measured on this, not only on your own delivery.

**How You Will Work

**You will run multiple programs at once, in a delivery pod alongside the Technical Program Lead, Integration Engineers, Data Migration Specialists, and Product Engineers. None report to you. Rather you get things done through clarity and relationships, not authority. You will report to the COO. This is an in-office role based at our Copenhagen office.

**What We're Looking For

**

• 
7+ years in program or engagement management, consulting, product management, or another delivery-facing role, with a track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder implementations end to end.

• 
Comfort being firm with customers on scope and timeline while keeping the relationship stronger for it.

• 
Any industry background welcome. Experience with enterprise customers (banks, asset managers, regulated industries), balancing urgency against long-term maintainability highly advantageous.

• 
Structured and highly organized, producing written plans, governance cadences, and reporting that stakeholders can act on.

• 
Broad technical literacy across enterprise SaaS delivery: API-based integrations, SSO and security configuration, and data migration and mapping, including enough SQL to read and question a mapping. You do not build the integration, but you understand it well enough to scope it, question it, and know when something does not add up.

• 
Ability to build working fluency in the customer's business domain fast: within 90 days, able to discuss topics such as advice and suitability workflows and customer reporting without a subject-matter expert in the room.

• 
ITIL Foundation, PMP or PRINCE2 Certification would be beneficial.

**Technical Fluency

**

• 
You’re not, necessarily, a developer, but you’re comfortable with APIs, data structures, auth flows (OAuth/SAML), and deployment models.

• 
You can dive into logs, payloads, and basic SQL or Python when needed to unblock yourself or a customer - but you prioritize scalable fixes over tactical workarounds.

• 
You advocate for platform-aligned solutions, not special cases.

**What This Role Is Not

**This role sits in operations, not engineering or commercial, and is project-based: once delivery is complete, you roll on to the next engagement. As a SaaS provider, we do not build bespoke software; delivery works within the bounds of the product.

**We Can Offer

**

• 
Trust and responsibility to shape how Performativ delivers for its largest customers.

• 
A competitive salary and benefits package.

• 
A fast-growing, VC-backed fintech scaleup, working alongside professionals from leading institutions (Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, BCG, Amazon and others).

• 
Career acceleration through professional development and leadership opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Intern auditor til informationssikkerhed i Region Midtjylland - tidsbegrænset stilling
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at styrke informationssikkerheden i en af Danmarks største offentlige organisationer?

I Region Midtjylland søger vi en intern auditor, der skal bidrage til at evaluere og videreudvikle regionens ledelsessystem for informationssikkerhed. Du får en central rolle i arbejdet med at sikre, at krav til informationssikkerhed efterleves, og at regionens politikker, procedurer og sikkerhedsforanstaltninger fungerer efter hensigten.

Som intern auditor skal du planlægge og gennemføre interne audits på tværs af organisationen og medvirke til at skabe overblik over styrker, risici og forbedringsmuligheder, som understøtter ledelsens beslutningsgrundlag. Du bliver samtidig en vigtig sparringspartner, der understøtter en kultur, hvor audit opleves som et redskab til læring, udvikling og løbende forbedring af informationssikkerheden.

 

Dine primære opgaver

Du får ansvar for at etablere og videreudvikle regionens proces for intern audit samt udarbejde og vedligeholde et risikobaseret auditprogram.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

• Udarbejde regionens auditprogram
• Planlægge og gennemføre interne audits i overensstemmelse med auditprogrammet og gældende krav til informationssikkerhed
• Fastlægge auditmål, auditkriterier og auditomfang
• Indsamle og vurdere dokumentation, interviewoplysninger, observationer og øvrige revisionsbeviser
• Vurdere efterlevelsen af ISO 27001 samt regionens politikker, retningslinjer og procedurer
• Identificere afvigelser, risici, forbedringsmuligheder og eksempler på god praksis
• Udarbejde rapporter og præsentere auditresultater for ledelse og relevante interessenter
• Bidrage til opfølgning på identificerede forbedringsområder
• Sikre, at eksisterende audits, tilsyn, it-revisioner og øvrige kontrolaktiviteter inddrages aktivt, så allerede tilgængelig viden udnyttes bedst muligt
 

Om dig

Vi søger en intern auditor, der er tillidsvækkende i dialogen med andre og formår at skabe gode og konstruktive samarbejdsrelationer på tværs af organisationen. Du møder medarbejdere og ledere med en anerkendende og respektfuld tilgang og udviser tålmodighed i auditprocessen. Samtidig har du modet til at identificere og påpege fejl, mangler og forbedringsmuligheder på en saglig og konstruktiv måde. Du ser intern audit som et redskab til læring og kvalitetsudvikling frem for kontrol.

Vi forestiller os derudover, at du:

• Er analytisk stærk og kan omsætte komplekse problemstillinger til klare konklusioner
• Har gode skriftlige og mundtlige formidlingsevner
• Arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt
• Evner at skabe samarbejde og tillid på tværs af forskellige fagområder
• Har kendskab til informationssikkerhed og ISO27001
 

Hvem er vi?

Du bliver ansat i informationssikkerhedsteamet i Digital Forvaltning, som er en del af Region Midtjyllands samlede informationssikkerhedsfunktion. Funktionen er et samarbejde mellem Sikkerhed og Compliance, som er en del af Digitalisering og It samt Juridisk Kontor og Digital Forvaltning, som er en del af Regionssekretariatet. 

Digital Forvaltning arbejder for at fremme digitalisering og sikre en systematisk, fælles ramme for informationssikkerhedsarbejdet i hele regionen. Vi er en del af Regionssekretariatet, der også varetager sekretariatsbetjening af regionsråd og direktion samt en række tværgående opgaver.

Arbejdssted: Regionshuset Viborg, Skottenborg 26, 8800 Viborg

 

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår 

Stillingen er tidsbegrænset frem til den 31. december 2028 med evt. mulighed for forlængelse.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Ansøgningsfrist den 5. december 2026. 

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt den 15. december 2026.  

Tiltrædelse: 1. februar 2027 eller efter aftale. 

Løn– og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til gældende overenskomst. 

 

Yderligere information om stillingen

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte Rikke Stein, Kontorchef i Digital Forvaltning, på telefonnummer 21359030 eller på mail rikke.stein@rm.dk.

 

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

**The Preferred - You Might Also Have
