jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly motivated and ambitious postdoc researcher for a 20-months position commencing 1 February 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

  The Department of Geosciences and Natural Resource Management invites applicants for a postdoc position, dealing with the impact of sea-level rise and coastal squeeze on tidal flat evolution and sediment characteristics in coastal wetlands. The project is part of the research project ‘WadProof - Future-proofing the intertidal resource capital of the Danish Wadden Sea World Heritage Site’, funded by the Aage V. Jensen Charity Foundation.

  The research project

  The postdoc is part of the multidisciplinary ‘WadProof’ project focusing on advancing knowledge on the effects of sea-level rise and coastal squeeze on coastal wetland tidal flats sediment characteristics, the benthic fauna and the feeding opportunities for migratory birds in the Wadden Sea. The primary focus of the research will be to explore recent and historical changes in tidal flat development and texture, assess the effects of dikes and evaluate controlling drivers and forcing of tidal flat sediment characteristics and dynamics.

  The applicant will be collecting and analysing tidal flat surface sediment and core data, collect hydro- and sediment dynamic data and test remote sensing techniques using unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) and orthophoto to map intertidal marine sediment type distributions. During the fellowship there will be periods with fieldwork in the Wadden Sea, laboratory and course work, teaching and dissemination.

  Who are we looking for?

  We are looking for candidates within the fields of physical geography, marine geology or other geosciences. Applicants should have a PhD degree and interest in estuarine and coastal geomorphology and good communication skills in spoken and written English. Experience with collection and analysis of empirical data, including processing of satellite and UAV data is considered an advantage.

  Our group and research - and what do we offer?

  The postdoctoral  researcher will be a member of the research group ‘Geomorphology, processes and landscapes’ in the Section for Geography. The research group studies processes that shape coastal, estuarine, marine, fluvial and glacial landscapes. We work at multiple temporal and spatial scales ranging from grains to landscapes and from seconds to millennial. The group uses quantitative methods with a strong focus on empirical data collection to map, analyse and understand the physical processes that shape the earth surface. Our group currently comprises two professors, two associate professors, postdocs and PhD students.

  The group is a part of Department of Geosciences and Natural Resource Management, Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen. We are located in Copenhagen. In the project you will be collaborating with researchers from Aarhus University and from the coastal department of the Danish Environmental Agency

  The postdoc’s duties will include research as well as teaching. The post may also include performance of other duties.

  Further information on the Department is linked at https://ign.ku.dk/english/. Inquiries about the position can be made to Associate Professor Mikkel Fruergaard at email: mif@ign.ku.dk

  The position is open from 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

  Terms of employment

  The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.

  Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

  You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  The application, in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

  Please include 

   	
• Cover letter, including the candidate’s motivation and a brief outline of suggested research contribution to the project (max 1,000 words). 	
• Curriculum Vitae, including a complete publication list, conference presentation list, and overview of teaching experience. 	
• Documentation: Diplomas for Master’s and PhD degrees. If the PhD is not yet awarded, please specify the expected date of submission and/or defence in the CV. 	
• Publications: Up to five selected articles (published or unpublished). The selected articles must be uploaded as attachments and marked with an asterisk (*) on the publication list.   The deadline for applications is 29 November 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee. 

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  Interviews will be held during week 1 in 2027.

Research Associate in Next Generation Sequencing

Job Description

At Traitomic, we help companies unlock the potential of biology to create better-performing crops and microbes. Across agriculture, food and biotech, companies need biological solutions that deliver higher impact and reach the market faster. Whether starting from a genetic target, a desired phenotype or a commercial objective, Traitomic bridges the gap between biological potential and market-ready traits. Combining gene discovery, a proprietary non-GM/non-GE trait development process and deep scientific expertise, we accelerate the development of tailored crop and microbial improvements with unprecedented speed and specificity.

As part of our next phase of growth and long-term goals, we are expanding our in-house Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) and Data analysis platform in Copenhagen to support our Trait Development projects across microbial, plant, fungi and algae projects. This is a unique and challenging entry level position covering molecular biology, and more specifically, sequencing. You will be working with DNA isolations, long-read sequencing and automation, across a variety of species including microbial, fungi and plants.

As our new Research Associate in NGS, you will conduct NGS experiments and develop ownership of end-to-end sequencing projects. This will include sample reception, DNA extraction, QC and library preparations as well as other molecular biology work. You are not required to work independently from the beginning, and you will be specifically trained, but independent work is expected after a learning period.

Who Do We Imagine You Are

We’re looking for someone who wants to grow into a DNA sequencing specialist and build expertise and experience in genomics with us over time. Maybe you just graduated from your BSc. or MSc. program, and maybe you have already built some solid hands-on laboratory experience through a thesis, student job or similar. You enjoy being in the lab, getting things done and are motivated to continuously learn, rather than doing the same thing every day. Most importantly, you are curious, reliable and get motivated from dynamic environments where no two days look the same.

What You Will Do

• Extract plant and microbial DNA using commercial kits and liquid handlers

• Perform DNA quality checks, including DNA concentrations and DNA integrity tests

• Prepare manual and automated multiplexed nanopore libraries for whole genome and amplicon sequencing

• Set up, load and monitor sequencing runs for GridION and PromethION platforms, including flow cell tracking (pore QC, usage, wash and storage)

• Ensure traceability of samples from start-to-end of their sequencing life cycle, and proper documentation

• Maintenance and care of our sequencing devices and liquid handlers

• Support in lab organization, sample and reagent inventory

What We Are Looking for

• A B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in biology, biotechnology, or a related field

• Hands-on experience in molecular biology work, specifically in DNA or RNA research. This can come from an academic thesis (BSc. or MSc.), internships and/or student jobs

• Ability to independently execute day-to-day experimental work within project objectives and priorities

• A structured approach to data recording and documentation

• A team-spirited approach to working with others, openly sharing progress and challenges, seeking input when troubleshooting, and supporting colleagues when needed

• Strong communication and organizational skills. English is the working language of the company

It would be an advantage if you have experience with:

• Academic specialization in genetics or molecular biology

• Direct exposure with sequencing workflows and protocols, ideally with Oxford Nanopore (MinION, GridION or PromethION)

• Experience in any of these: magnetic bead purification of nucleic acids, phi29 amplification of DNA, PCR and its variants, lab automation

• Data analysis in genomics

The Traitomic team

As a Research Associate at Traitomic, you will become part of a small, but highly dedicated and motivated start-up team, that unlocks the natural genetic diversity of plants and microbes with cutting-edge trait development technology. With a proactive approach and entrepreneurial mindset, you will have the possibility to help us shape, strengthen and grow Traitomic further.

Learn more about us and what we do here: https://www.traitomic.com

The deadline for applying is 22 of November 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the deadline, so we encourage you to apply as early as possible. A cover letter is not required. However, we would appreciate a few lines in your CV outlining your motivation for applying.

We are committed to an equal and fair recruitment process for all applicants, and we aim to guide our hiring decisions by diversity and transparency. We welcome applicants from a broad range of backgrounds and experiences, regardless of ethnicity, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, age or disability. jobs.occupation: Senior Reliability Engineer, Equipment Maintenance & Calibration
jobs.description:
Location: _Søborg, Denmark. Please note that AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark or the Greater Malmö area in Sweden.

_Are you the type of person who enjoys understanding how things work, questioning assumptions, and solving complex technical problems?

We are looking for a Sr Reliability Engineer to help shape the future of our maintenance, calibration and asset management programs. This is not a traditional maintenance role. Instead, you will focus on understanding equipment risks, analysing failure mechanisms, evaluating maintenance effectiveness, and developing data-driven maintenance and calibration strategies.

Some days you will be deep in equipment data, conducting component-level risk assessments and reliability analyses. Other days you will be presenting your recommendations, challenging established practices, and facilitating discussions with stakeholders across Manufacturing, Quality, Compliance, Engineering, and Maintenance.

Whether you are an experienced reliability professional or an exceptional early-career engineer with strong analytical abilities, we are interested in hearing from you.

**What You'll Be Doing

**Risk Assessment & Reliability Engineering

• Perform detailed equipment, instrument and component-level risk assessments.

• Identify failure modes and evaluate their impact on safety, compliance, reliability, and operational performance.

• Conduct FMECA, criticality assessments, root cause analyses, and other reliability studies.

• Support a risk-based approach to maintenance decision-making.

Maintenance & Calibration Strategy Development

• Evaluate existing maintenance and calibration programs and challenge activities that do not deliver value.

• Redesign and optimize preventive, predictive, corrective, and condition-based maintenance and calibration strategies.

• Build maintenance and calibration programs based on risk, data, and equipment criticality.

• Develop practical recommendations that improve equipment reliability while optimizing resource utilization.

Data Analysis & Continuous Improvement

• Analyse maintenance and calibration history, failure data, asset performance trends, and reliability metrics.

• Identify patterns, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities.

• Convert complex data into actionable recommendations.

• Support the development of KPIs and performance monitoring tools.

• Support digitalization initiatives that improve data visibility, decision-making, and maintenance effectiveness across the organization.

• Develop and maintain reporting and analytical tools, including Power BI dashboards and visualizations, to support reliability, risk, and maintenance strategy decisions.

Stakeholder Collaboration

• Work closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Compliance, Engineering, and Maintenance teams.

• Facilitate discussions where priorities may differ and help build alignment around technical decisions.

• Present findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Support internal and external audits by presenting maintenance strategies, risk assessments, and technical rationales, and by clearly communicating decisions to auditors and regulatory stakeholders.

• Act as a subject matter expert during audits and inspections, presenting risk assessments, maintenance strategies, and technical justifications to auditors, Quality, and Compliance stakeholders.

**What We're Looking For

**We are less interested in the number of years on your CV and more interested in how you think.

**You Are Likely Someone Who

**

• Enjoys analysing complex technical problems.

• Is naturally curious and asks "why" before accepting a conclusion.

• Can work independently and stay focused on difficult problems.

• Is comfortable challenging established ways of working when supported by facts and data.

• Can communicate confidently with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

• Is persistent, resilient, and comfortable navigating disagreement.

• Can balance technical rigor with practical business realities.

**Qualifications

**You may be an experienced engineer or a recent graduate.

**We'd Like To See

**

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related technical discipline.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

• Interest in asset reliability, maintenance optimization, risk management, or data analysis.

• Ability to work with complex datasets and draw meaningful conclusions.

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, P&IDs, User Requirement Specifications, Technical Specifications, and equipment manufacturer manuals.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Fluency in English.

Experience with the following is considered an advantage but is not required:

• FMECA

• FMEA

• RCM (Reliability Centred Maintenance)

• Root Cause Analysis

• Asset Criticality Assessments

• Reliability Engineering

Who Will Thrive in This Role?

**

• Prefer solving root causes rather than treating symptoms.

• Enjoy building new solutions instead of simply maintaining existing processes.

What We Offer

**Join our team

We look forward to receiving your application!

**Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Turn vulnerability data into actionable cyber risk intelligence

Cyber Defense is transforming how TDC Brands identifies, prioritises and manages cyber risk across one of Denmark's largest digital environments.

We are building a mature, risk-based Vulnerability Management capability spanning infrastructure, cloud, end-user devices, applications and third-party services.

To strengthen this capability, we are looking for a Vulnerability Intelligence & Analytics Manager who can turn complex vulnerability and asset data into trusted insights, meaningful reporting and measurable risk reduction.

You will be responsible for the data, analytics and platform foundation that enables Vulnerability Management across TDC Brands.

Your role

As Vulnerability Intelligence & Analytics Manager, you will take the lead on Vulnerability Management platforms, data, analytics and reporting within Cyber Defense.

Where our Senior Vulnerability Manager primarily drives the technical assessment and remediation discipline, you will ensure that we have the right data, tooling and intelligence to understand our exposure and measure how effectively risk is being reduced.

Together, the two roles form the core of our Vulnerability Management capability and will work closely together and provide mutual coverage when required.

You will work across Cyber Defense, infrastructure and application teams, technology partners and management to create transparency around vulnerabilities, remediation performance and cyber risk.

Key responsibilities

You will:

• Own and continuously develop Vulnerability Management platforms, reporting and analytics across TDC Brands

• Develop dashboards and reporting that provide clear visibility of vulnerabilities, exposure and remediation performance

• Define and maintain Vulnerability Management KPIs, KRIs, SLAs and other performance metrics

• Create operational, management and executive-level cyber risk reporting

• Integrate and correlate vulnerability, asset, threat and business-context data from multiple sources

• Monitor data quality and work with technology teams to improve asset coverage, accuracy and completeness

• Analyse trends, recurring vulnerabilities, risk concentrations and remediation effectiveness

• Develop and automate data flows, reporting processes and platform integrations

• Support governance processes including remediation follow-up, risk acceptance and exception management

• Work closely with the Senior Vulnerability Manager to continuously improve risk-based vulnerability prioritisation

• Support audit, compliance and regulatory reporting requirements

What we are looking for

You combine an understanding of cyber security with strong capabilities in analytics, platforms and data.

You are comfortable working with complex datasets but can also turn them into simple, credible insights that enable both technical teams and senior leaders to make better risk decisions.

Experience with technologies such as Power Query, SQL, KQL, APIs, Python or PowerShell will be an advantage.

Experience with Vulnerability Management platforms such as Rapid7, Microsoft Defender or similar, as well as knowledge of ITSM/CMDB is also valuable.

Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls or ISO 27001 is welcome but not required.

Why Cyber Defense at TDC Brands?

You will have the opportunity to:

About TDC Brands

TDC Brands is home to YouSee, TDC Erhverv, Telmore, Hiper, eesy and Relatel — around 3,000 employees and roughly 6 million consumer and business customer relationships in Denmark. We are the commercial and service side of Danish telecom; TDC NET owns and runs the physical network.

We are putting AI to work across customer service, digital channels, sales and our own internal operations. Doing that in a company millions of Danes rely on means doing it carefully.

Why this role exists

AI governance fails in one of two ways. It becomes a review gate that slows everything down, or it becomes a document nobody reads. We want neither.

This role keeps governance close to the work. You’ll own the practical machinery — the use-case inventory, the risk assessments, the evaluation and testing — and you’ll sit inside the proof-of-concepts as they are built, not review them afterwards. It is a rare combination of skills, and a good place to build a career: governance people who can actually build are scarce, and getting scarcer.

What you’ll do

• Own the agent inventory. Maintain a live picture of every AI agent we run, and of the copilots, RAG applications and embedded model features around them — what each one does, what data and systems it can reach, what it is allowed to do without a human, who owns it, and where it sits against EU AI Act risk categories.

• Run the assessments. Work through risk, privacy and security reviews with Legal, Privacy and Security colleagues, and turn their requirements into something an engineering team can act on.

• Test what we build. Design and run evaluations: accuracy, hallucination, bias, prompt injection, tool misuse and failure behaviour. Build the test sets and keep them current as models and agents change.

• Help build the proof-of-concepts. Work hands-on alongside the AI Evangelist and delivery teams — preparing data, writing and refining prompts, wiring up APIs, measuring whether the thing actually works.

• Document it properly. Model cards, decision records and system documentation that stand up to an audit and are still readable by the people who have to use them.

• Watch the horizon. Track regulation, guidance and tooling as they evolve, and translate them into short, practical checklists rather than long policy documents.

Your first year

• A complete, trusted inventory across the six brands — agents and the AI applications around them — with risk classifications and ownership everyone agrees on.

• A working evaluation approach applied to at least two production or near-production systems.

• Assessment and documentation templates that teams reach for because they save time, not because they are mandatory.

• A reputation as the person engineers invite into a project early rather than call at the end.

What we’re looking for

• Around 4 years’ experience in data, AI, technology risk, compliance or a closely related field.

• Enough hands-on ability to be useful in a prototype: Python at a practical level — notebooks, scripts, calling APIs — and comfort with how LLM applications are put together. You do not need to be a software engineer.

• A working understanding of GDPR, and genuine interest in the EU AI Act and what it means in practice.

• Clear, structured writing. Much of this job is making complicated things legible to someone who has fifteen minutes.

• The confidence to ask an uncomfortable question in a room of senior people, and the judgement to know which questions are worth asking.

If you meet most of this and the rest is learnable, we’d still like to hear from you.

Also useful, not required

• Experience in a regulated industry — telecom, finance, health or public sector.

• Familiarity with evaluation tooling and frameworks for LLM applications.

• Experience with Azure AI, AWS or Google Cloud AI services.

• Exposure to ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF or similar management frameworks.

• Danish language skills — useful for stakeholder work, but not a requirement.

What you’ll get out of it

• Direct mentoring from senior AI and architecture colleagues, and close work with Legal, Privacy and Security.

• Visibility across six brands and both consumer and business markets — unusual breadth for an early-career role.

• A seat at the table while an enterprise AI practice is being built, rather than inheriting one already built.

Practical details

• Location: Teglholmsgade 1, Copenhagen. Hybrid, with four days a week on site.

• Team: You’ll join Data & AI, a team of around 40 people, working alongside the Senior AI Evangelist.

• Language: English is our main language of communication. Danish is an advantage.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short note - half a page is plenty - on one AI risk you think companies currently underestimate, and what you would do about it. No formal cover letter needed.

**

**

If you care about doing full-stack development the right way – through clean architecture, automation, CI/CD, IaC, observability, golden paths, and engineering foundations – you’ll feel right at home at the Tech Collective, where we combine deep technical skills with real client impact.

**What You’ll Do

**Life as a consultant is different from a typical in-house role. At the Tech Collective, consulting means working on a wide range of projects with various clients – so you'll regularly encounter new challenges and have plenty of opportunities to grow your skills quickly.

We believe AI and agentic coding accelerate great developer practices – they do not replace them. That’s why solid architecture, quality, security, maintainability, and sound technical judgement matter more than ever.

In this senior role, you’ll help us understand client needs and turn them into real outcomes by taking technical ownership, guiding teams, and delivering robust solutions from idea to production.

• Build, test, and deliver software using modern engineering practices such as everything-as-code, CI/CD, GitOps, automation, and open-source principles

• Act as a trusted advisor to clients, helping them make great decisions and turn ideas into practical solutions

• Work across frontend and backend technologies, taking part in architectural decisions, system design, containerised environments, and clear, maintainable documentation

• Improve developer and user experience by shifting quality left, applying strong design principles, mentoring others, and delivering minimum viable products with a clear path to scale

• Design, build, and operate platforms and infrastructure, including APIs, CLIs, platform engineering, immutable infrastructure, and internal developer platforms

• Collaborate, teach, and lead through effective communication, technical writing, code reviews, lean principles, and strong data and security practices

• Lead technical workstreams and collaborate closely with clients, translating business needs into pragmatic technical solutions

**What You’ll Bring

**One thing that can be said of all your future colleagues is that we’re curious by nature, have a team-first mindset, a good sense of humour, and clear opinions on how tech can create value for our clients. If this sounds like you, you’ll be a great fit at The Tech Collective.

We’re looking for people with a relevant M.Sc. (this is mandatory and could be, for example, in computer science or software engineering) who are based within commuting distance of our office in Copenhagen.

**We’re looking for someone with a minimum of 5 years of professional experience in full-stack software development or similar engineering roles.

**On top of that, the ideal candidate is someone who brings senior engineering experience and:

• Communicates clearly in both written and spoken English

• Shares our values around software quality and delivery

• Enjoys working closely with clients and building trusted relationships with them

• Is tool-agnostic and chooses the right tool for the job

• Is comfortable with complexity and able to break problems down into manageable pieces

• Has solid experience building and operating modern software systems in production

• Understands software architecture, system design, testing, security, and maintainability

• Can guide technical decisions, challenge assumptions, and communicate trade-offs clearly

• Has experience mentoring or supporting other developers through code reviews, pairing, or technical sparring

Please note that you don’t need to meet all the criteria. The most important thing is that you have an engineering foundation, a senior mindset, consulting skills and curiosity to keep learning and growing.

**What We Offer

**When you step into our office, you step into a world of nerdery – and we love it and intend to keep it that way. You’ll become part of a low-ego, high-trust team of sharp engineers who you’ll work closely with from day one.

**Working With Us Means

**

• Real autonomy, real impact: you’ll own features end to end and lean into the tech you care most about.

• Growth that matters: a learning programme, mentoring, and plenty of peer knowledge sharing.

• Community and craft: strategy trips, meetups, and events across The Tech Collective/Implement Consulting Group.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? Let us know why and how in your cover letter and apply ASAP.

We’re on holiday during July, so please expect slightly longer response times.

At Eriksholm Research Centre, we are looking for a technically strong and practically minded Senior Research DSP Engineer to join our scientific team. You will help mature promising research ideas into robust concepts, demonstrators, and technical solutions that can move closer to adoption by R&D.

About the position

Eriksholm generates scientific insights and explores new technologies with the potential to improve future hearing care. We work closely with scientists, engineers, and Oticon R&D to ensure that promising ideas can be translated into solutions with meaningful impact for people with hearing loss.

In this position, you will bridge scientific exploration and engineering implementation. You will combine strong digital signal processing and acoustics expertise with hands-on experimental work, modelling, and prototype development.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Building models and tools for analysing and validating technical concepts.

The ideal candidate

You are curious, analytical, and motivated by solving complex technical problems. You enjoy moving between theory, modelling, implementation, and hands-on laboratory work. You are comfortable working with early-stage ideas where the path forward is not always fully defined.

You take ownership of your work, communicate technical topics clearly, and collaborate well with colleagues from different scientific and engineering disciplines. You also understand the importance of balancing scientific ambition with the practical requirements needed to bring a concept closer to product development.

We expect that you have:

• Strong knowledge of digital signal processing and acoustics.

• Experience with acoustic measurements, laboratory setups, modelling, and technical validation.

Your workplace

The position is based on our site in Snekkersten, where you will work closely with Eriksholm’s multidisciplinary scientific community.

Eriksholm Research Centre is part of Oticon’s R&D organization. We pursue audiological discoveries with the potential to enhance customer and end-user benefits in future hearing care and work to ensure that scientific insights can be applied in solutions supporting people with hearing loss.

We are a multicultural and multidisciplinary team that values scientific integrity, collaboration, mutual respect, and openness. Our informal environment provides room to explore new ideas, challenge assumptions, and take considered technical risks.

Electro Acoustic Development Engineer

If electro acoustic development of hearing instruments throughout the spectra form concept to finial product seems interesting, and if having fun at work makes you smile, then read on! We may just have the job for you.

In the Device Hardware area, we are looking for an Electro Acoustic engineer to expand our team. You will work with product development using cutting-edge tools in well-equipped modern facilities with the goal of developing the best hardware for our hearing instruments.

Join the Hardware development team

As an electro acoustic developer, you would be part of an agile development team with responsibility for design and verification of the electroacoustic concepts. We focus on delivering solutions that enable us to deliver high-quality hearing instrument solutions, including in-depth transducer knowledge and development of new acoustic concepts for future products. We are depending on, and facilitating, in-depth knowledge about vibroacoustic behavior of subsystems and complete hearing aid solutions.

We participate in product development as well as maturation of concepts, before they are used in product development. Sometimes we participate in after launch activities as well.

Building, documenting and sharing knowledge is key to our success. Communication of key findings and results gained in is cross functional cooperation with mechanical and electronics developers in our Agile Release Trains are sessional.

Building innovative Electro Acoustic Solutions

In collaboration with skilled team members within your own Agile Release Train, you will work to innovate electro acoustic and mechanical solutions that elevate the experience of both end-users and customers. The excitement this group faces daily is the development of highly complex platforms, due to the high degree of functionality that hearing instruments offer. Furthermore, we focus on developing our platforms to fit multiple brands, adding to the complexity. The team works closely together with other professionals, i.e., audiologists and engineers specializing in amplifiers and embedded systems.

The biggest hardware challenge is to develop a platform that provides the needed acoustical gain and at the same time securing a good mechanical and acoustic feedback margin. Here a close cooperation with the mechanical engineers and the pre-production team is crucial for a good result.

You will be involved in:

• Acoustic systemdesign and Development

• Platform calibration/settings

• Design specifications

• Selection of components i.e. transducers – microphones, receivers/speakers

• Testing, verifying and documenting electro-acoustical performance of HW platforms

• Effort estimation and planning done in an agile framework

Apart from working together with motivated colleagues you will experience that we have great focus on your skills development, the department’s professional skills and in Work-life balance.

You can expect 1-5 travel days a year, visiting suppliers and our production site in Poland.

We expect you to hold a degree in Engineering, focusing specifically on electro acoustics. We anticipate that you possess strong qualifications in Sound Quality, Acoustic measurements, vibro-acoustics, and sound path design. Knowledge from working with electro acoustic or magnetic designs of hearing instruments or other smaller products such as cell phones, headsets or similar is an advantage.

You perform best in a vibrant atmosphere and enjoy partnering with experienced coworkers to make the most of your skills. We offer further development opportunities and believe Oticon is a good place to develop your career further.

As a person, you are proud of your profession, curious and a team player by heart. You have good communication skills and enjoy networking and navigating in a delivery driven, cross-functional organization with several parallel development tracs.

jobs.occupation: Head of Europe Financial Control and Governance
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about? Do you have experience within financial control and governance?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Head of Europe financial control and governance.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a passionate Head of Europe financial control and governance to join our growing team. As a key member of the Ascendis Pharma team, you will play a crucial role in Europe regional oversight, assurance and coordination across European entities. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment, collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results.

You will be joining the finance operations team consisting of 33 colleagues, and report directly to Cicek Wrabetz, Head of Europe Finance Operations who is based in Munich, Germany. You will be based in Hellerup, Denmark.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Lead regional governance and assurance. Maintain oversight of material accounting, reporting, control and compliance matters across Europe. Identify gaps, clarify ownership and coordinate resolution across teams and countries

• Oversee financial reporting and accounting. Coordinate statutory reporting and external audits across European jurisdictions and provide assurance over close, financial reporting and internal controls

• Navigate local requirements. Bring structure to country-specific requirements, including withholding tax, statutory obligations and invoicing, working closely with Tax, Legal, Compliance, Treasury and relevant process owners

• Drive launch and change readiness. Represent the European financial-control and governance perspective in new-market and entity launches, identifying local requirements and impacts across processes, systems, data and controls

• Simplify and strengthen ways of working. Challenge unnecessary complexity, country variations and manual workarounds. Identify root causes, clarify ownership and help implement compliant, scalable and sustainable solutions

• Leverage technology, AI and automation. Partner with Finance Systems and process owners to translate business needs and pain points into well-defined, controllable and scalable solutions, using technology where it creates meaningful value

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a relevant academic degree - preferably a MBA or Bachelor of Management /Economics/ business administration or equivalent - and 10+ years of experience including meaningful responsibility for accounting, financial operations, monthly close, managing external accountants, auditors and controls.

Furthermore, you have:

• 5+ years of experience within external or internal audit, controllership, financial control, Finance Operations, transformation, or a related field in an international environment

• Strong knowledge of accounting, IFRS, internal controls, audit, and European statutory and regulatory requirements

• A professional qualification such as CPA, Cand.merc.aud., ACCA, Wirtschaftsprüfer, or equivalent is preferred

• Demonstrated experience in strengthening controls, redesigning processes, and simplifying ways of working

• Experience working across countries and functions, including O2C, P2P, R2R, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Compliance, and Finance Systems

• Interest in and hands-on experience with ERP systems, analytics, automation, AI, or digital finance initiatives. Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 is an advantage

Key competencies:

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

To succeed in this role, we also expect you to

• Challenge complexity and has evidence of making processes simpler, stronger or more scalable

• Collaborate across functions and geographies and influences without relying on formal authority

• Balance control, compliance, business needs and practical implementation

Travel: 10-20 days per year.

Office: Ascendis Pharma A/S Tuborg Boulevard 12, 2900 Hellerup, Denmark

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

In this role, you will combine on-site quality inspections with technical follow-up and documentation. You will work closely with installers, project managers, and other members of the project team to ensure that installations meet the required quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

•         Conduct regular QA/QC inspections of passive fire protection and insulation works on-site.

•         Verify that installations comply with approved drawings, installation instructions, project specifications, and applicable requirements.

•         Identify non-conformities and follow up on corrective actions to ensure proper close-out.

•         Prepare and maintain quality documentation, inspection records, and reports, including the registration and follow-up of quality-related issues in Dalux and BIM models.

•         Provide technical guidance to installers on approved installation methods and demonstrate correct workmanship when required.

•         Coordinate with the project team regarding technical clarifications, site activities, and quality-related matters.

About You

We are looking for a responsible, structured, and solution-oriented individual with strong attention to detail. You are comfortable working both on construction sites and in a site office, and you can communicate effectively with different trades and project stakeholders.

We expect you to:

•         Have a good technical understanding and a strong interest in quality assurance and quality control.

•         Be able to read and interpret construction drawings and technical documentation.

•         Work independently, systematically, and take ownership of your tasks.

•         Communicate effectively in English or Danish, both verbally and in writing.

•         Be comfortable using digital tools for inspections and quality documentation.

•         Be confident in guiding installers and following up on the quality of completed work.

 

It would be an advantage if you have:

•         Previous experience in QA/QC, quality inspections, or construction site supervision.

•         Knowledge of passive fire protection, insulation, or similar construction activities.

•         Experience working with Dalux and BIM.

•         Hands-on construction site experience, including providing technical guidance to installers.

•         Good Danish language skills and knowledge of additional languages.

A specific educational background is not required. We value relevant practical experience, technical understanding, and the right attitude.

What We Offer

•         A permanent, full-time position with a minimum of 37 working hours per week.

•         Start date as soon as possible or by agreement.

•         Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience, including pension and other employment benefits in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and employment contract.

•         Company phone and the possibility of a company vehicle, depending on project requirements.

•         A varied workday combining on-site inspections with office-based QA/QC activities.

•         A supportive and informal working environment with opportunities for professional development.

Firesafe Danmark A/S specialises in passive fire protection and related technical services within the construction industry.

Our work contributes to protecting people, buildings, and assets by ensuring that fire protection systems are correctly installed, inspected, and documented in accordance with project specifications and applicable requirements.

You will become part of a team where quality, teamwork, and accountability are at the core of our daily operations.

**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the bar by creating great guest experiences, and use every shift as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of Juicers who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You will learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path, our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**JOE & THE JUICE is on an ambitious global growth trajectory - scaling toward 1,000+ bars, preparing for an IPO, and building the infrastructure of a world-class public company. As Senior Analyst in JOE Insights, our analytics function within FP&A, you will report to the Head of BI and turn raw data into sharp, commercially relevant insights for senior management. Your analysis will directly inform decisions from same store sales performance to new launches and commercial initiatives.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Build detailed, high quality insights pieces that inform decisions made by senior management, translating data into clear commercial narratives

• Own, build and support financial modelling and analytics work related to JOE's growth journey

• Partner with FP&A, BI, and business stakeholders to answer priority questions with structured, rigorous analysis

• Work with SQL, BI, and AI tools to pull, shape, and validate the data behind every insight, and know it well enough to defend every number

• Support strategic initiatives, contributing analysis and insight that enable well informed decision making across the organization

• Conduct competitor and macroeconomic analysis, including tracking input price developments across the business

• Challenge and sanity check numbers before they reach leadership, ensuring every insight is accurate, defensible, and decision ready

• Turn open ended, loosely defined questions into structured analyses with a clear point of view on what the business should do next

• Build and maintain analytical frameworks and templates that make future insights pieces faster and sharper to produce

• Contribute to building JOE Insights into a best in class analytics function, helping shape how the team works as it grows

**WHO YOU ARE

**

• You are curious and thorough, and you do not settle for the first answer a dataset gives you

• You take pride in producing analysis that holds up to scrutiny, not just analysis that is directionally right

• You are as comfortable in a spreadsheet as you are explaining what it means to a stakeholder

• You filter complexity down to the insight that matters, hold yourself to a high standard, and take ownership of your work from first question to final slide

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• 2-4 years of experience from investment banking, transaction advisory, strategy consulting, corporate finance, or FP&A

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a similarly quantitative field

• Strong analytical depth combined with a genuinely commercial mindset - you connect numbers to what they mean for the business

• High work ethic and ownership, comfortable moving from an open ended question to a sharp, structured answer with limited guidance

• Strong PowerPoint and Excel skills are required; experience with SQL and BI tools is a significant plus

• Excellent communication skills, able to distill complex analysis into insights that senior leaders can act on quickly

• Fluency in English, and a base in Copenhagen or willingness to commute daily

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience

Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

**ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

Would you like to become part of a dynamic and innovative environment and contribute to the green energy transition? Then have a look at this exciting job opportunity at DEIF A/S!

At DEIF A/S, we develop advanced control solutions that keep power stable and efficient – whether from wind, solar, or traditional sources. With more than 700 employees worldwide, we set new standards in energy efficiency and power conversion, working every day to become the market leader in intelligent energy control. Together, we create solutions that Improve Tomorrow.

**About The Job

**DEIF A/S is a global leader in power management solutions, committed to innovation and sustainability. As Project Manager within Product Development, you will drive development projects from idea to implementation, working closely with software, hardware, mechanical, and test teams. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on creating momentum, turning plans into action, and ensuring projects move forward according to plan. You will manage projects of varying sizes and complexity, from smaller specialist-driven initiatives to larger cross-functional development programs.

"In this role, you will be the driving force behind day-to-day project execution. **What You’ll Bring

You have a natural ability to communicate and collaborate across all levels of the organization, creating alignment, follow-through and ensuring that plans are translated into action. Most importantly, you are someone who takes ownership and gets things done.

**Product Manager, data & AI – SitaWare Insight

**_What if your operational experience could shape the data and AI capabilities behind better decisions in the battlefield? Join SitaWare Insight as Product Manager, and turn real-world defence and intelligence needs into product features, compelling customer demonstrations and meaningful improvements for soldiers, staff officers and NATO customers.

_**The job

**As Product Manager for SitaWare Insight, you will work alongside our Business Product Manager and development teams to turn operational needs into concrete product features. You will be the voice of the customer and end-user, guiding the team’s day-to-day work and helping us to show what our data and AI platform can do for command and control (C2).

In short, you can look forward to:

• guiding the development team’s day-to-day work, translating operational requirements into concrete features for SitaWare Insight

• representing the voice of the customer and end-user, including prioritising fixes and change requests through our change control boards

• using Insight’s own toolset – dashboards, data import and agents – to build examples that show customers and colleagues what is possible

• supporting the sales team with product expertise, customer visits and proposal input while helping the marketing department to create product collateral

• representing Systematic at conferences, trade shows and user forums, and presenting to customers on-site

The position requires regular international travel to customers and Systematic offices, approximately 20–30 days each year.

**Joining the team

**Based in Copenhagen, you will be close to the development teams building SitaWare Insight, while collaborating closely with Product Management colleagues in Aarhus. Alongside our Business Product Manager, who owns the product roadmap, you will provide operational input for the team’s daily implementation and help keep development aligned with user needs and product priorities. Together, you will be part of a collaborative team committed to turning data and AI into solutions that make a tangible difference across the defence sector from staff at headquarters to decision-makers in the field.

**Your Qualifications

**You bring a solid background from the armed forces or intelligence services – for example as an officer, NCO or in a role such as an information manager – or several years of hands-on experience working directly with defence or intelligence customers as a supplier of data or information products or systems. This operational experience is essential, as it enables you to understand the realities our end-users face and to translate their needs into concrete product decisions.

We are also looking for:

• a genuine interest in how data and AI support C2, and the ability to translate this into product direction. You do not need to be able to write code, but you must be able to engage confidently in technical dialogue with data engineers and architects

jobs.occupation: Student Assistant, S&OP/IBP - Global Supply Chain Planning & Analytics
jobs.description:
Are you analytical, detail-oriented, and eager to gain hands-on experience in global supply chain planning? Do you enjoy working with data, generating insights, and supporting business decision-making?

Pandora is currently looking for a Student Assistant to join our S&OP/IBP team within Global Supply Chain. In this role, you will contribute to the monthly planning cycle and metal hedging process through data consolidation, analysis, reporting, and stakeholder coordination.

You will take ownership of selected recurring deliverables and support the improvement of planning tools, inventory management, data quality, and processes across Global Supply Chain.

This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience with Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP), Integrated Business Planning (IBP), supply chain analytics, inventory planning, and process improvement in one of the world's leading jewellery brands. Working closely with stakeholders across Pandora's global organization, you will gain valuable insight into how data, planning, and cross-functional collaboration drive operational and commercial decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

• Consolidate data and prepare reports, analyses, and meeting materials for the monthly S&OP/IBP cycle.

• Take ownership of selected recurring reports and data-consolidation activities.

• Develop and maintain planning tools, dashboards, KPIs, and inventory projections with guidance from the team.

• Support the metal hedging process by consolidating forecasts, conducting analyses, preparing decision materials, and coordinating stakeholder input.

• Analyze inventory, production, and supply chain performance and translate data into clear business insights.

• Coordinate meeting agendas, materials, stakeholder input, action tracking, and follow-up.

• Contribute to improvements in planning processes, reporting, automation, and data quality.

• Support ad hoc analyses and tasks as required.

Your Team

You will join the S&OP/IBP team within Global Supply Chain and report to the S&OP/IBP Manager. The team collaborates closely with stakeholders across Crafting & Supply, Global Treasury, and other areas within Global Supply Chain to support planning, decision-making, and business performance.

As part of the team, you will gain first-hand experience with how integrated planning processes connect demand, supply, inventory, and financial considerations across a global organization.

Qualifications

• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree within Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, Data Science, Business Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.

• Ideally have at least one year remaining of your studies.

• Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, Power Query, and working with large datasets.

• Comfortable working with data and translating it into meaningful insights.

• Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken.

• Experience with BI, ERP, MRP, WMS, reporting, or planning tools is considered an advantage.

• Previous full-time work experience is not required. Relevant experience gained through student employment, internships, university projects, or similar activities is considered an advantage.

• An interest in automation, digitalization, and AI-enabled planning processes is considered a plus.

Personal Competencies

• Analytical and curious, with a strong interest in supply chain planning, S&OP, and Integrated Business Planning.

• Structured and detail-oriented in your approach to tasks and problem-solving.

• Proactive and eager to learn, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

• Comfortable working independently and taking responsibility for assigned deliverables.

• A clear and confident communicator.

• Collaborative and confident working with stakeholders across different functions and markets.

• Able to balance attention to detail with an understanding of the bigger picture.

You Will Get

• Hands-on experience with S&OP, Integrated Business Planning, and global supply chain processes.

• Opportunities to work with data consolidation, reporting, analysis, and inventory planning.

• Insight into the metal hedging process and the coordination of forecasts and stakeholder input.

• Exposure to cross-functional collaboration across Global Supply Chain, Crafting & Supply, and Global Treasury.

• Opportunities to develop your Excel, analytical, and business communication skills.

• Experience taking ownership of recurring reports and deliverables.

• The opportunity to contribute to improvements in planning processes, automation, reporting, and data quality.

Additional Information

• You are expected to work approximately 15-20 hours per week on average (less during exam periods and more when possible).

• The role is based at Pandora's Global Office in Copenhagen and requires physical presence.

• You must be a current student to apply.

• Start date: As soon as possible.

Did We Get Your Attention?

We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you would like to become part of Pandora's future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site at Pandora Group.

Icing on the Cake

You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world’s largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores. Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Do you want to work on some of the most complex bridge, immersed tunnels and underground structures in Denmark and internationally? Are you motivated by structural engineering, advanced analysis and developing innovative solutions? Do you want to be a part of an international frontrunner in major structures? Then this could be your next opportunity at COWI.

At COWI, we are seeking a Junior Structural Engineer to support our team on major infrastructure projects. You will join a highly skilled group of engineers delivering solutions for bridges, immersed tunnels, underground structures and other complex civil engineering projects. Working alongside experienced specialists, you will contribute to projects that improve how people and societies connect.

Turn challenges into sustainable solutions

As a Junior Structural Engineer, you will contribute to the design and analysis of complex infrastructure projects from early concept development through detailed design and construction support. You will work closely with colleagues across disciplines and geographies, gaining practical experience and developing your technical skills and engineering judgement.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Performing structural analysis and design of civil engineering structures

• Working with FEM and structural analysis tools

• Preparing calculations, technical documentation and design deliverables

• Collaborating with structural, geotechnical, BIM and other engineering disciplines

• Contributing to digital engineering initiatives, including automated workflows and parametric design solutions

• Participating in technical discussions, reviews and knowledge-sharing activities within the team and structural engineering community

Your skills. Our team. Together, we design the future.

We are looking for a motivated engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges and is eager to develop within a collaborative and international environment. You combine a strong interest in structural engineering with curiosity about new technologies, digital tools, and innovative ways of solving engineering problems. Knowledge of design of bridges, tunnels, underground structures or other complex concrete structures will be highly relevant.

On top of that you have:

• A Master degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related discipline

• 0-5 years of professional experience in structural or civil engineering.

• Knowledge with finite element modelling (FEM) and structural analysis

• Knowledge of concrete design principles and relevant design standards such as for instance Eurocode 2

• Interest or experience in automated workflows and parametric design tools, such as Grasshopper

• Interest or experience in AI, programming or engineering automation is an advantage

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to organise own work while contributing actively to a team

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility, and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide for our customers. We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home. With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America, and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy, and environment into play.

Got more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Talent Acquisition Specialist Shruti Gupta at srgu@cowi.com, or Head of Discipline Major Structures, Konrad Bienko, at kobi@cowi.com. Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key.

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting up teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV - no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

Why join COWI?

• Work on complex Bridge, Tunnel and Underground structures that push the boundaries of engineering, technology and sustainability.

• Get the opportunity to contribute to major international projects with global impact.

• Access international Master Classes and learning opportunities to support your professional development.

• Join a strong international network of 30+ countries, sharing knowledge and expertise across borders.

• Work in an office in collaborate with 100+ highly skilled colleagues from the Major Structures unit. The office is located in Kgs. Lyngby, Denmark.

• Become part of the COWI community through clubs, events and professional networks.

• Enjoy a strong social culture with activities such as Friday bars, Summer Parties and Christmas lunches.

You will join experienced colleagues and gradually take responsibility for designing, securing, testing, and maintaining technical solutions for critical infrastructure. The role gives you practical experience with system architecture based on the Purdue model, network troubleshooting, firewalls, switches, and secure-by-design principles. You will contribute to projects from engineering and documentation through testing, installation, and commissioning. You will also work closely with customers and colleagues across project management, supply chain, manufacturing, testing, and engineering.

• Supporting the design and hardening of system architectures according to the Purdue model.

• Identifying and resolving network issues affecting operational technology equipment.

• Configuring rules for firewalls and network switches with guidance from experienced colleagues.

• Supporting updates and patching of installed systems while equipment remains in operation.

• Providing technical support for testing, installation, and commissioning activities.

• Preparing project documentation and updating engineering deliverables as built.

• Participating in project and customer meetings to follow up on technical issues.

• Using ABB engineering processes, checklists, and tools while sharing lessons learned with colleagues.

Qualifications for the role

• A relevant technical education within IT, network engineering, cybersecurity, automation, electrical engineering, or a related field.

• Basic knowledge of network architecture, firewalls, switches, system hardening, or operational technology.

• Ability to analyze technical issues and contribute to practical and reliable solutions.

• Willingness to work at customer sites where safety, quality, and continuous operation are essential.

• Skilled communication and the ability to collaborate with customers and colleagues across disciplines.
