jobs.occupation: PhD fellowship in cerebral interoception at Center for Translational Neuromedicine
jobs.description:
We are offering a PhD fellowship in cerebral interoception commencing 15 February 2027 or after agreement.

  Our group and research
 Center for Translational Neuromedicine focuses on developing new approaches for examining and treating neurological diseases, primarily using the tools of physiology and imaging coupled with cell and gene therapy. Our emphasis is on using these technologies to enable neural and glial cell replacement in the adult brain and spinal cord, as a means of both disease modeling and therapeutic repair.

  Center for Translational Neuromedicine currently has 55 employees and students and is divided into five labs. CTN is characterized by a highly ambitious research environment. The Center is highly interdisciplinary and has many international collaborators. The PhD-student will be part of the Kaag Rasmussen lab, Division of Pain Volume Transmission. Being part of the Kaag Rasmussen lab offers an opportunity to work in an in vivo lab engaged in the neuroscience of pain signalling, focusing on transgenic animal models, behaviour, in vivo imaging and omics technologies. 

  Project description
 In this PhD project we will characterize the functional and molecular characteristics of meningeal sensory neurons. In all the body, different sensory neuron classes project to various targets and are fine-tuned at a functional and molecular level to detect and transmit sensory information from the target organ to the central nervous system. The sensory neurons projecting to dura mater and pia mater have been known to play a role in headache pathology, yet very little is known regarding their functional and molecular properties. This PhD project will dissect out which sensory neuron subtypes project to dura and pia mater, what stimuli they respond to, and define their molecular identity. The aim is to identify what subclasses of meningeal sensory projection neurons are involved in headache experience, and to identify new molecular targets within these sensory neurons that could provide basis for headache therapeutics in the future. To achieve this we will use a combination of in vivo imaging of transgene animals expressing various fluorophores that be used as indicators of neuronal activity and single cell transcriptomics.

  Principal supervisor is Martin Kaag Rasmussen, Center for Translational Neuromedicine, martin.rasmussen@sund.ku.dk.

  Start: 15 February 2027 or after agreement

  Duration: 3 years as a PhD student

  Job description
 Your key tasks as a PhD student at SUND are:

   	
• Carrying through an independent research project under supervision.    	
• Completing PhD courses or other equivalent education corresponding to approximately 30 ECTS points. 	
• Participating in active research environments including a stay at another research team. 	
• Obtaining experience with teaching or other types of dissemination related to your PhD project 	
• Teaching and disseminating your knowledge. 	
• Writing a PhD thesis on the grounds of your project   PhD Programme Description
 The PhD programme is a three-year full-time research education within the framework of the 5+3 scheme, intended for candidates holding a relevant academic degree within the project’s subject area (e.g., Neuroscience).

  Qualifications
 If you have completed your academic education in Denmark, the admission to the PhD programme requires a relevant Master’s degree (equivalent to 180 ECTS BSc + 120 ECTS MSc).

  If you have an academic education from abroad, you must have either a degree equivalent to a Danish master's degree (180 ETCS + 120 ECTS MSc), or at a minimum, a bachelor’s degree equivalent to a Danish bachelor's degree (180 ECTS) and be academically qualified at master's level.

  As part of the assessment of whether you meet the educational requirements, you must also achieve a positive academic evaluation and be assessed as the best qualified for the position.

  Other important criteria are:

   	
• The grade point average achieved 	
• Professional qualifications relevant to the PhD project 	
• Previous publications 	
• Relevant work experience 	
• Other professional activities 	
• A curious mind-set with a strong interest in pain and headache as well as basic neuroscience 	
• Language skills   Place of employment
 The place of employment is at the Center for Translational Neuromedicine, Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and state-of-the-art equipment

  Terms of employment 
 The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

  The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 3 years. The start date is 15 February 2027 or after agreement.

  The employment is conditioned upon the applicant’s successful enrolment as a PhD student at the Graduate School at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. This requires submission and acceptance of an application for the specific project formulated by the applicant. The PhD study must be completed in accordance with The Ministerial Order on the PhD programme (2013) and the Faculty’s rules on achieving the degree. 

  Salary, pension and terms of employment are in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. Depending on seniority, the monthly salary starts at approximately 31,800 DKK/Roughly 4,250 EUR (August 2026 level) plus pension.

  You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  Questions
 For specific information about the PhD fellowship, please contact the principal supervisor.

  General information about PhD studies at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences is available at the Graduate School’s website.

  Application procedure
 Your application must be submitted electronically by clicking ‘Apply now’ below. The application must include the following documents in PDF format: 

  1. Motivated letter of application (max. one page)

  2. CV incl. education, experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position

  3. Certified copy of degree diploma(s) relevant to a Danish master’s or bachelor’s degree depending on whether you completed your education in Denmark or abroad (read more under Qualifications). If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted. We encourage you to read more in the assessment database. Please note that we might ask you to obtain an assessment of your education performed by the Ministry of Higher Education and Science.

  4. Publication list (if possible)

  Application deadline: 17 November 2026, 23.59 CET

  We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

  The further process 
 After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor.

  The assessor makes a non-prioritized assessment of the academic qualifications and experience with respect to the above-mentioned area of research, techniques, skills and other requirements listed in the advertisement.

  Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself.

  You find information about the recruitment process here.

  The applicants will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

   

  The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

jobs.occupation: Drive Technical Excellence, Lead with Confidence, and Make an Impact as Team Lead for our Hardware Automation team - Gram Equipment A/S
jobs.description:
Are you a technically strong and decisive leader who sets high standards, takes ownership, and drives results?

At Gram Equipment, we are looking for a Team Lead – Hardware, Automation who combines solid electrical engineering expertise with a strong leadership presence and the determination to make things happen.

We are looking for someone who is confident in their technical decisions, comfortable taking responsibility, and motivated by delivering high-quality results. Someone who brings structure, challenges the status quo when needed, and has the courage to set clear expectations and follow through.

In this role, you will lead our Hardware Team within the Automation department, ensuring that we deliver safe, reliable, and production-ready electrical hardware solutions.

This is a hands-on leadership position where you will combine technical expertise with team leadership. Approximately 80% of your time will be dedicated to technical and operational activities, while 20% will focus on leadership, planning, and employee development.

Your role – technical excellence meets strong leadership

As our new Team Lead, you will take responsibility for the daily coordination, technical quality, and performance of a team of six skilled employees in Denmark and one in Turkey.

You will be expected to provide clear direction, establish priorities, and ensure that decisions are translated into action. At the same time, you will remain actively involved in engineering activities, contributing your own technical expertise to complex challenges and important projects.

An important part of your role will be to drive standardization, increase automation of engineering processes, and identify opportunities for cost optimization, helping us create more efficient, scalable, and competitive hardware solutions.

You will work closely with colleagues across Automation, Engineering, Project Management, Procurement, and Production, where your ability to communicate clearly, challenge constructively, and stand firm on technical quality and safety will be essential.

You will report to the Global Head of Automation and play an important role in strengthening the performance and capabilities of our Global Engineering & Automation organization.

Your key responsibilities

• Lead with clarity and accountability: Set clear expectations, establish priorities, make decisions, and ensure that commitments are followed through.

• Drive technical execution: Take an active role in electrical design, panel engineering, component selection, BOM development, and technical problem-solving.

• Ensure high technical standards: Review and challenge electrical solutions, maintain compliance with safety requirements, and ensure consistent engineering quality and documentation.

• Drive standardization and engineering automation: Develop and implement standardized electrical designs, components, and documentation practices. Promote automated generation of electrical drawings to reduce manual engineering effort, improve consistency, and increase efficiency.

• Focus on cost optimization: Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities through smarter design solutions, component standardization, efficient engineering processes, and close collaboration with Procurement and Production, without compromising safety, quality, or reliability.

• Take ownership of planning and delivery: Allocate resources, monitor capacity and progress, address obstacles, and proactively manage delivery risks.

• Make sound technical decisions: Evaluate complex engineering challenges, balance quality, cost, safety, and delivery requirements, and make well-founded decisions, even under pressure.

• Develop and challenge your team: Provide constructive feedback, coach employees, encourage accountability, and support the development of technical competencies.

• Strengthen cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and panel builders to resolve issues and ensure effective project execution.

• Drive continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to improve standards, processes, tools, and working methods, and take the initiative to turn improvements into measurable results.

What we are looking for

We are looking for an experienced electrical engineering professional with a strong technical foundation and a natural ability to take the lead.

You enjoy responsibility, have a structured and analytical approach, and are comfortable making decisions and standing behind them.

Ideally, you bring:

• A relevant technical or engineering background within electrical engineering, automation, or a related field.

• Solid experience with electrical design and panel engineering for industrial machinery.

• Strong knowledge of electrical safety, technical standards, and regulatory requirements, including CE and DS/EN/IEC 60204-1.

• Experience with electrical components, BOM structures, technical documentation, and engineering standards.

• A strong understanding of standardization and an interest in automated engineering processes, including automated generation of electrical drawings.

• A commercial mindset with the ability to identify cost optimization opportunities while maintaining technical quality and compliance.

• The ability to analyze complex technical challenges and make clear, well-founded decisions.

• Experience coordinating technical work, managing priorities, and ensuring delivery against commitments.

• Previous experience in technical leadership, team coordination, or people management, or demonstrated leadership potential combined with a strong desire to take responsibility.

Your personality makes the difference

For this position, your personal drive and leadership approach are just as important as your technical qualifications.

We are looking for someone who brings a strong personality, clear direction, and high professional standards to the team.

You are likely to recognize yourself in the following:

• Decisive and confident: You are comfortable taking the lead, making decisions, and addressing challenges directly rather than waiting for others to act.

• Analytical and detail-oriented: You approach technical challenges systematically, question assumptions, and base your decisions on facts and sound engineering judgment.

• Results-driven and accountable: You set ambitious but realistic expectations, take ownership, and follow through to ensure that objectives are achieved.

• Structured and quality-conscious: You value precision, consistency, and well-defined processes and are unwilling to compromise on safety or critical quality requirements.

• Assertive and constructive: You are willing to challenge ideas, address difficult issues, and stand by your professional assessments while respecting different perspectives.

• Demanding but supportive: You set high standards for yourself and others, provide clear feedback, and help your team develop the skills and confidence to succeed.

• Proactive and improvement-oriented: You identify opportunities, challenge inefficient ways of working, and drive improvements that increase efficiency, standardization, and cost competitiveness.

You have the confidence to lead experienced technical specialists, the credibility to earn their respect, and the ability to create an environment where clear expectations, professional discussions, and shared accountability lead to strong results.

What you can expect from us

At Gram Equipment, you will have the opportunity to combine your technical expertise with leadership responsibility in an engineering environment where quality, reliability, and continuous improvement are essential.

You can look forward to:

• A challenging and varied role combining hands-on engineering with people leadership.

• Responsibility for a team of skilled technical specialists.

• The opportunity to influence technical decisions, engineering standards, and ways of working.

• The opportunity to drive standardization, engineering automation, and cost optimization initiatives.

• Close collaboration across engineering disciplines and other business functions.

• The opportunity to make a visible impact on team performance, technical quality, and project delivery.

• A working environment that values ownership, professional expertise, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

• A flexible working approach, with the position primarily based in Kolding and opportunities for hybrid working.

Ready to take ownership and make a difference?

If you are a technically strong engineer who enjoys taking the lead, making decisions, and driving high standards while improving engineering efficiency and cost competitiveness, this could be your next career opportunity.

Join Gram Equipment and take the lead in developing our Hardware Team and delivering high-quality, efficient, and competitive automation solutions.

Deadline:

Ongoing

Job area:

Mechanic/Product Design/Automation/Quality/Project Management, Engineering

Job type:

Full-time Position

About us

At Gram Equipment, we foster an inclusive, supportive, and innovative workplace where every individual can grow and contribute. Our core values of trust, respect, and dedication guide us in creating a culture of collaboration and excellence.

• People Focus: We prioritize the development and well-being of our team.

• Dedication: We go the extra mile to support our customers and colleagues.

• Innovation: We embrace new technologies to drive sustainable progress in the ice cream industry.

• Ambition & Performance: We strive for excellence, constantly evolving.

• Trust & Respect: We nurture a diverse, respectful environment where collaboration thrives.

Founded in 1901, Gram Equipment is the global leader in sustainable ice cream equipment. Our commitment to innovation and quality helps our customers succeed while minimizing environmental impact. Our mission is clear: to lead the industry with sustainable solutions that benefit both our customers and the planet.

jobs.occupation: PhD Student in PHA Processing and Modification by Reactive Extrusion - DTU Chemical Engineering
jobs.description:
If you are excited by doing reactive extrusion, online monitoring and materials characterization for renewable polymer systems such as PHAs, this could be the PhD project for you.

Responsibilities and qualifications
The objective of this PhD project is to develop next-generation polyhydroxyalkanoate (PHA) compounds through advanced polymer processing, formulation, and reactive extrusion. The project will focus on improving processability and performance while establishing relationships between formulation, processing history, polymer structure, and final material properties. 

As a PhD student, you will prepare and process new PHA formulations using extrusion-based methods, investigate reactive processing and novel additive concepts, and evaluate compounds for injection moulding, extrusion, and blow moulding. You will combine offline polymer characterization with online and in-line analytical methods to monitor changes during processing and support adaptive control of composition and process conditions. 

We are therefore looking for candidates with: 

• Practical experience in polymer processing, preferably extrusion or reactive extrusion, obtained through MSc studies or equivalent research activities. 
• A strong interest in biopolymers (natural polymers), polymer formulation, compounding, and structure-property-processing relationships. 
• Hands-on experience with polymer characterization, particularly FTIR, rheology, DSC, TGA, and NMR. 
• Experience with Raman spectroscopy, online analysis, or process monitoring, which will be considered an advantage. 
• Experience with injection moulding, film or profile extrusion, or blow moulding, which will be considered an advantage. 
• The ability to plan experimental work independently and collaborate effectively across polymer chemistry, processing, and analytical disciplines. 
• An interest in teaching and supervising student projects as part of the PhD programme. 
The project is expected to generate new knowledge on the processing and stabilization of PHA-based materials and to deliver high-performance compounds designed for safe handling, demanding processing routes, and environmentally benign end-of-life scenarios. 

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

Assessment
The assessment of the applications will be conducted immediately after the deadline, and we expect to call for interviews in November.

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms 
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures. 

The period of employment is 3 years.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information 
Further information may be obtained from Anders E. Daugaard, adt@kt.dtu.dk. 

You can read more about DTU Chemical engineering at www.kt.dtu.dk.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 24 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
• A table providing an overview of your prior experience in processing and synthesis (method and application) and characterization methods you are familiar with (both in practice and theory)
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Chemical Engineering conducts experiments at microscale, at laboratory scale, in pilot facilities and at industrial scale. The department enjoys a very close and mutually beneficial relationship with Danish-based industrial enterprises as well as leading universities and enterprises from all over the world.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.occupation: Staff Scientist in Antipathogenic Drug Research
jobs.description:
The Department of Immunology and Microbiology is looking for a highly motivated and independent Staff Scientist in Antipathogenic Drug Research. The position is expected to commence on 1st of February 2027 and its duration is limited to two years.

  Our research
 The Department of Immunology and Microbiology at University of Copenhagen is a unique interdisciplinary research flagship exploring the biology of pathogenic microbes and our immune system, with the aim of improving population health.

  Your job
 The Staff Scientist will work on a project concerning the development of chemical compounds that inhibit production of toxins in Staphylococcus aureus and impede the pathogenic effects of the bacterium in atopic dermatitis. This entails:

   	
• Plan, prioritize and carry out the project in accordance with its scientific objectives, milestones, budget and reporting requirements. 	
• Coordinate project activities with laboratory technical staff and internal and external collaborators and supervise students or junior researchers where relevant. 	
• Maintain research documentation and data-management practices and ensure compliance with laboratory safety, research-integrity and relevant institutional requirements. 	
• Prepare scientific publications, conference presentations, seminars, workshops, reports and relevant outreach activities. 	
• Develop follow-up research directions, collaborations and applications for further competitive research funding.   Because the work is research-driven, its detailed timing and sequence cannot be fully predetermined. Within the agreed scientific and institutional framework, the Staff Scientist will independently determine day-to-day priorities, experimental design and methods, the sequence of experiments and analyses, and the coordination of collaborations.

  Profile
 We are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic Staff Scientist with the following competencies and experience:

  Qualifications and Expectations 

   	
• A MSc/PhD degree in molecular microbiology or a closely related field. 	
• Experience in antipathogenic drug research. 	
• Experience in working with Staphylococcus aureus. 	
• Experience with diverse molecular biology techniques. 	
• Experience with transcriptomics and bioinformatic tools and workflows. 	
• Experience with preparing scientific reports, manuscripts and presentations. Previous scientific publications are considered an advantage.  	
• Experience in supervising students, junior researchers and technical staff. 	
• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a research environment within agreed milestones and budgets. 	
• Good written and oral communication skills in English.   Place of employment
 The place of employment is the Costerton Biofilm Center, Department of Immunology and Microbiology, University of Copenhagen, Copenhagen, Denmark. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment, with access to facilities and expertise in molecular medical microbiology.

 The average weekly working time is 37 hours.

 Your application should be submitted in English and include:

 Questions
 For further information regarding the position, please contact Tim Tolker-Nielsen at ttn@sund.ku.dk.

Board Intelligence is a technology and advisory firm on a mission to make boards more effective, and through them, build better businesses and benefit society.

Over twenty years we have established ourselves as the market leader in governance and board effectiveness, trusted by more than 80,000 directors, executives, and governance professionals globally, including across the Fortune 500, FTSE 100, and OMX 30. That trust has been earned through depth of insight, rigorous advisory work, and a track record that newer entrants simply cannot replicate.

We have invested in applied AI since 2020, well ahead of the market, and that early conviction has paid off. Our AI-powered platform and smart board advisor give us a competitive advantage that is widening, not narrowing. In 2024, K1 Investment Management, the leading B2B Enterprise SaaS investor, backed us to accelerate that position further. We are now growing fast, with a proven commercial model spanning both mid-market and enterprise, and a product suite that has become a necessary addition in high-stakes board environments.

The people joining us now will shape how we scale. We are deliberate about how we do that. Our founders and leadership team are deeply invested in keeping the culture that got us here: thoughtful, high calibre, and genuinely human. Ambition and balance are not in competition at Board Intelligence.

If you want to work at the intersection of AI and governance, on problems that matter at the highest level, this is a strong place to be.

Our Mission

We unleash the potential of organisations through the science of board effectiveness, building better businesses and benefitting society.

**The Role

**Juristic is a Danish legal tech company, founded in 2021 and headquartered in Copenhagen. Our platform brings four tools together on the same case data: Structure, Timeline, Flow and JuristIQ, our legal AI in chat and tabular formats.

Clients include PwC, Bird & Bird and Bech-Bruun. Juristic is now part of Board Intelligence, and we are bringing a new product to market. The work is led by our CTO, and we are looking for an AI Engineer to build it with them from the first line of code.

This is a zero-to-one role in a small team of four full-stack developers, a machine learning engineer and the CTO. You will write the code, sit in front of customers, and help decide what we build next.

**Main Responsibilities

**

• Design, build and ship the AI capabilities at the core of a new product, from first prototype to production

• Own LLM-powered workflows end to end, such as document understanding, data extraction and agentic assistants

• Choose and integrate models and providers, and own the prompting, retrieval, evaluation and guardrails that make AI output reliable enough for legal and governance work

• Work directly with customers and the CTO to turn real problems into product decisions, and help own the product roadmap

• Lay the engineering foundations for the new product, including architecture, testing, observability and deployment, so it can scale

• Work with the wider Juristic and Board Intelligence engineering teams, and contribute to AI tooling shared across the suite

**Person Specification

**We are looking for a builder: an experienced AI engineer who has been a technical founder or an early employee at a startup, and who is ready to do it again.

Required Skills and Experience:

• At least four years of professional software engineering experience

• Experience as a technical founder or early employee at a startup, having built a product from the first line of code

• A track record of building and shipping AI or LLM-powered products to real users

• Practical experience with LLM APIs, prompt design, retrieval and evaluating model output in production

• Strong engineering fundamentals across backend and frontend, with the judgement to move fast without leaving a mess behind

• A strong product mindset: you have worked directly with customers and owned a product roadmap

• Hungry, motivated and ready for another zero-to-one journey

• Fluent written and spoken English

Nice to haves:

Experience with our stack: TypeScript (Node.js and React) and Python

Experience with document processing, such as PDF parsing and extraction from unstructured text

Experience building agentic systems, tool use or MCP integrations

Experience with search and retrieval infrastructure, such as Elasticsearch or vector databases

A background in legal tech, governance or B2B SaaS for professional users

What good looks like in this role:

• After three months: you know our customers, the product vision and the codebase, and you have shipped AI features that real users rely on

• After six months: the core AI capabilities of the new product are in production, backed by evaluations that show they are reliable, and you are acting on customer feedback

• After twelve months: the product is in market with paying customers, you are a trusted voice on the roadmap, and the AI foundations you built are reused across the Juristic and Board Intelligence suite

**How We Work

**We hire people who are expert at what they do. Once you join, you have the autonomy to shape how you work and the space to do it well. That doesn’t mean working in isolation. You’ll have colleagues who know their craft, regular collaboration across functions, and easy access to senior leadership when you need it.

We keep our structure flat. We work at pace in an agile, nimble environment where good ideas don’t wait for permission. If you spot something that could work better, we encourage you to say so. If you want to run with an idea, we’ll back you to do it.

We work with people who take pride in their output, back their team through the hard parts, and leave things better than they found them.

**What Happens Next

**Once you apply, our Talent team will review your application. If there’s a fit, they’ll be in touch to discuss the role and next steps.

**How We Use AI In Our Hiring

**We use AI responsibly, both in the software we build for governance teams and in how we hire. Our Talent team may use AI to support application review, CV analysis, or identifying areas that need further verification.

But hiring decisions are made by people. AI surfaces signals; people make the call on whether to progress a candidate or extend an offer.

If you’d like details on how your data is handled during recruitment, contact our Talent team.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

**We’re an equal opportunities employer. We’re building a team that works because it reflects a breadth of experience, background, and perspective.

Apply even if you don’t tick every box on the job specification. If the role excites you and you think you could make an impact, we want to hear from you.

We don’t discriminate on the basis of age, disability, ethnicity, gender, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of recruitment, or if there’s anything else we can do to make the process more accessible, tell our Talent team. We’ll sort it.

**Your Safety Matters

**Be cautious of unexpected messages claiming to be from Board Intelligence. We will never ask you for fees as part of recruitment. If you’re unsure whether a communication is genuine, contact our Talent team through our official channels before sharing information or clicking links.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professor in Black Hole Astrophysics
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and accomplished Postdoc scientist to work at the intersection of theory, simulation, and data analysis in black hole astrophysics for a four-year position, commencing on 1 March 2027.

  Information about the Department can be found at: The Niels Bohr International Academy – University of Copenhagen

  Your job

  The Assistant Professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations with regard to publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within Assistant professorship. To a limited extent this may also include performance of other duties

  Specifically, the chosen applicant is required to work on the following problems

  1) Are extragalactic jets seen throughout the Universe really powered by black hole spin energy and can we prove it with polarimetric observations?

  2) How do gravity, radiation, and high-energy particles interact to determine the structure and dynamics of accretion disks and the jet launching region around low luminosity AGN?

  3) What is the best way to use sparse and noisy observations from Very Long Baseline Interferometry (VLBI) arrays to precisely measure the properties of black holes and their astrophysical environments?

  Profile

  We are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic scientist with the following competencies:

  Essential experience and skills:

  In order to pursue these questions, the chosen candidate must have a substantial record of leadership in the global Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) collaboration as well as a role in the project team for the proposed NASA Black Hole Explorer (BHEX) mission.

  The chosen candidate must have a proven track record in the analysis of VLBI data, running and interpreting General Relativistic Magnetohydrodynamic (GRMHD) simulations, and building semi-analytic models of black hole accretion and jet launching for comparison with extremely high-resolution EHT data. This position is for four years.

   

  Assessment of applicants will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory, but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered.

  
 General criteria apply to the appointment of Assistant Professors at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.

  For Assistant professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5a_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Assistant_professors.pdf.
 
 Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here

   

  Questions

  For further inquiries about the position can be made to: phdamg@nbi.ku.dk

  The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 4 years. The starting date is 1 of March, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  Terms of employment
 The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Salary, pension and other conditions of employment are set in accordance with the Agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and AC (Danish Confederation of

  Professional Associations) or other relevant organisation. Currently, the monthly salary starts at 39,900 DKK/approx. 5,300 EUR (August 2026-level). Depending on qualifications, a supplement may be negotiated. The employer will pay an additional 18,07 % to your pension fund.

  Foreign and Danish applicants may be eligible for tax reductions, if they hold a PhD degree and have not lived in Denmark the last 10 years.

  Application procedure
 Your online application must be submitted in English by clicking ‘Apply now’ below. Furthermore, your application must include the following documents/attachments – all in PDF format:

   	
• Motivated letter of application (max. one page) 	
• CV incl. education, work/research experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position. 	
• A certified/signed copy of a) PhD certificate and b) Master of Science certificate. If the PhD is not completed, a written statement from the supervisor will do. 	
• Research plan – description of current and future research plans 	
• If available, description and documentation of teaching and supervision experience and qualifications - please describe and document: 	 		
• Experience with supervision of BSc and MSc students 		
• Teaching experience 		
• Formal pedagogical training 	 	 	
• Complete publication list 	
• Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers   Deadline for applications:  17 November 2026, 23:59 GMT +1. 

  We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

  The further process 

  After the expiry date of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor. Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself.

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

   

  Interviews/trial lectures will be held from 9 December 2026.

  The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

Do you enjoy writing C++ software that interacts directly with hardware and makes complex systems perform reliably in the real world?

At Robotto, we build advanced autonomy and software solutions for drones and unmanned systems. Our work brings together computer vision, embedded software, control, electronics and real-world product development.We are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer with strong C++ experience to develop software close to the hardware layer of our drone platform. Experience with motor control and Field-Oriented Control (FOC) is highly preferred.This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of software, electronics and control systems, where performance, reliability and real-world behaviour matter.

The role
You will work on embedded software that supports the control and operation of Robotto’s drone and unmanned systems.Your work will involve developing reliable C++ software that interfaces with hardware, sensors, motors and other system components. You will work closely with colleagues across control, electronics, computer vision and flight testing to take software from development through integration and into real-world operation.For candidates with motor-control experience, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of our motor-control capabilities, including Field-Oriented Control (FOC).

What you will do

• Develop and maintain embedded software in C++ for drones and unmanned systems.
• Build software that interfaces with motors, sensors, actuators and other hardware components.
• Work with real-time and performance-sensitive software.
• Contribute to motor-control software, including Field-Oriented Control (FOC), where relevant to your experience.
• Develop and integrate communication between embedded components and wider product systems.
• Debug complex software and hardware interactions and identify root causes of issues.
• Collaborate closely with control, electronics, flight-test and software engineers.
• Contribute to software architecture, testing, documentation, code quality and technical decisions.
• Support integration and testing on real hardware and drone platforms.

What success could look like in your first 3–6 months

• You have developed a strong understanding of Robotto’s embedded architecture, hardware and control systems.
• You are contributing production-quality C++ code to our embedded platform.
• You are successfully integrating and debugging software on real hardware.
• You are contributing to improved reliability and performance across our embedded systems.
• If you have motor-control experience, you are actively contributing to our FOC and motor-control development.
• You have become a trusted technical partner for colleagues across software, control, electronics and flight testing.

What we are looking for
We are looking for an engineer who is comfortable working close to hardware and enjoys solving complex technical problems where software and physical systems meet.

• At least 3 years of professional software engineering experience, ideally within embedded or real-time systems.
• Experience with motor control, particularly Field-Oriented Control (FOC), is highly preferred. Experience with BLDC/PMSM motors, control loops, PWM, encoders or related motor-control technologies would also be highly relevant.
• Strong C++ programming skills.
• Hands-on experience developing software that interfaces with hardware.
• Experience with embedded systems, real-time systems, microcontrollers or similar low-level environments.
• Good understanding of debugging, testing, software architecture and version control.
• Experience with communication protocols such as CAN, UART, SPI, I²C or similar is an advantage.
• Experience with robotics, drones, autonomous systems or other complex electromechanical products is an advantage.
• Professional fluency in English.
• A degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, robotics, mechatronics or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience is equally welcome.

Who you are
You are practical, curious and comfortable getting close to both the software and the hardware when solving a problem.

• You take ownership of your work and care about software quality and reliability.
• You enjoy understanding how systems behave beyond the code itself.
• You approach debugging methodically and are comfortable solving difficult software/hardware problems.
• You collaborate well across software, electronics and control disciplines.
• You are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities.
• You communicate technical trade-offs, progress and risks clearly and pragmatically.

Minds and makers forging ahead together.
At Robotto, we value people who do. People who take ownership, are willing to try new things just to see if they work, and are comfortable asking for forgiveness rather than permission. We want people who are curious, proactive and excited about turning ideas into something real.

Our hiring process
Our process is designed to be straightforward, practical and conversational:

1. Introductory conversation with our Talent Acquisition & Recruitment Partner
A chance to learn more about Robotto, the role and what you are looking for, while giving us an opportunity to understand your background and motivation.

2. Meeting with the Hiring Manager / Principal Engineer
A deeper conversation about your technical background, C++ and embedded experience, motor-control experience where relevant, and your approach to solving engineering problems.

3. In-depth Technical Evaluation & Meeting with our COO
A hands-on technical session where you will receive a short assignment to prepare in advance and then work through it together with members of our technical team, similar to a pair-programming exercise. The focus is on understanding your technical approach, problem-solving and how you collaborate.Following the technical evaluation, you will meet with our COO for a conversation about the role, Robotto and mutual fit.

4. Offer
If there is a strong mutual fit, we will move forward with an offer.

Why join Robotto?
Robotto is building advanced autonomy technology for drones and unmanned systems, working at the intersection of software, hardware, computer vision, control and real-world operations.You will join a highly technical and ambitious team at an exciting point in the company’s journey. As we continue to scale our engineering team and work on challenging new projects, you will have the opportunity to influence how our embedded and control software develops.This is a role where your software will not remain behind a screen. You will see it integrated with real hardware, tested on real systems and used in demanding real-world environments.You will work closely with talented engineers, take meaningful technical ownership and help shape the next generation of Robotto’s technology.

Equal Employment Opportunity
Robotto is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace. We recruit based on skills, experience and potential. Please note that certain positions may require specific nationality or eligibility for security clearance in accordance with applicable laws and the nature of our work.

Want to build C++ software that helps power the next generation of autonomous and unmanned systems?At Robotto, we build advanced autonomy and software solutions for drones and unmanned systems. Our technology brings together computer vision, C++ software, autonomy, embedded systems and real-world product development.

We are looking for a C++ Software Engineer to join our engineering team and contribute to the software that connects and powers different parts of Robotto’s technology platform.This is a hands-on software engineering role for someone who enjoys building reliable systems, solving complex technical problems and seeing their software move beyond development into real-world operation.

The role
You will develop and maintain C++ software across Robotto’s software ecosystem, working on applications and services that support the operation, communication and coordination of our unmanned systems.Depending on the project, your work may span different parts of our platform—from software running alongside our autonomous systems to applications used to configure, control and interact with them.You will work closely with engineers across computer vision, autonomy, embedded software, electronics and testing to develop new capabilities, integrate components and continuously improve the reliability and performance of our systems.

What you will do

• Design, develop and maintain high-quality software primarily in C++.
• Build software used across our drone and unmanned-systems platform.
• Develop reliable communication and data flows between different software and hardware components.
• Work on performance-sensitive and potentially real-time or near-real-time applications.
• Integrate software with APIs, networking components, sensors and wider system infrastructure.
• Debug complex issues across interconnected software systems and identify root causes.
• Contribute to software architecture and technical design decisions.
• Write maintainable, testable and well-structured production code.
• Participate in code reviews, testing, documentation and continuous improvement of our engineering practices.
• Collaborate closely with computer vision, embedded, autonomy and hardware engineers.
• Support integration and testing on real systems and drone platforms..

What success could look like in your first 3–6 months

• You have developed a strong understanding of Robotto’s software architecture and how the different parts of our platform work together.
• You are contributing production-quality C++ code to our products.
• You have taken ownership of features or components from development through integration and testing.
• You are successfully debugging and solving issues across interconnected systems.
• You are contributing to improved reliability, maintainability and performance of our software.
• You have become a trusted technical partner within the engineering team.

What we are looking forWe are looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and building software that interacts with real systems.

• Strong professional experience developing production-quality software in C++, with a solid understanding of modern software engineering practices.
• Solid understanding of software architecture, data structures, algorithms and object-oriented design.
• Experience developing multi-component or distributed software systems.
• Experience with networking, inter-process communication, APIs or communication protocols is highly relevant.
• Good understanding of concurrency, multithreading and performance considerations in C++.
• Experience with debugging, testing, version control and modern software development practices.
• Experience with Linux-based development environments is an advantage.
• Experience with robotics, drones, autonomous systems, defence technology or other complex technical products is an advantage, but not a requirement.
• Experience working with software that interfaces with hardware or real-world systems is an advantage.
• Professional fluency in English.
• A degree in computer science, software engineering, robotics or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience is equally welcome.

Please apply even if you don't meet every single point. We are interested in what you can bring to the team, your ability to learn and your motivation to work on the challenges we are solving.

Who you are
Beyond your technical or professional experience, we care about how you work and collaborate.You:

• Are curious and enjoy solving complex problems.
• Take ownership and follow things through.
• Communicate openly about progress, challenges and risks.
• Are comfortable in a growing company where priorities can evolve.
• Enjoy collaborating with people across different disciplines.
• Value testing, learning and continuous improvement.
• Want to contribute rather than simply execute a predefined set of tasks.

Why join Robotto?
Robotto is building advanced autonomy technology for drones and unmanned systems, working at the intersection of software, hardware, computer vision, autonomy and real-world operations.You will be joining Robotto at an exciting stage of our journey as we continue to grow our team, technology and products.

Our teams work across software, computer vision, control, electronics, hardware and real-world testing. This means you will work closely with people from different technical disciplines and see how your work contributes to the wider product.

We are an ambitious and collaborative team, and we value people who take ownership, challenge ideas constructively and want to help build both great technology and a great company.This is not a role where everything is already defined. You will have the opportunity to:

• Work on challenging technology with real-world applications.
• Have meaningful ownership and influence over your area.
• Work closely with talented colleagues across multiple disciplines.
• See your work move from an idea or prototype into real-world use.
• Help shape how we work as the company continues to grow.

Our hiring process
We want our hiring process to be straightforward, transparent and conversational.

1. Introductory conversation with People & Culture
A chance for us to learn more about you and for you to learn more about Robotto, the role and what we are looking for.

2. Meeting with the Hiring Manager
A deeper conversation about your experience, skills and approach to the role

.3. Technical / Role-specific discussion
Depending on the position, this may include a technical discussion, practical exercise, case or live scenario relevant to the work you would be doing at Robotto.

4. Leadership meeting
A conversation with a member of our leadership team to explore mutual fit and give you another opportunity to learn about Robotto and where we are going

.5. Offer
If there is a strong mutual fit, we will move forward with an offer.The exact process may vary slightly depending on the role.

Interested?
If this sounds like an opportunity you would like to explore, we would love to hear from you.Apply through our careers page and tell us a little about yourself, your experience and why Robotto interests you.

Equal opportunity
At Robotto, we want to build a team where different experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.We welcome applications from qualified candidates regardless of gender, age, nationality, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or other characteristics protected by applicable law.

jobs.occupation: Senior Business Analyst with interest in IT and Pension
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy turning complex business requirements into clear, practical software solutions? Join Keylane as a Senior Business Analyst and help shape the pension processes that support people through important life events, from retirement to disability and the loss of a loved one.

Key about your team

You will join Life Events, an area of approximately 70 colleagues working at the heart of Plexus, our pension platform. We are organised into three teams that support pension processes related to retirement, death and disability, as well as premium and benefit calculations. You will be part of Life Events B, a team with 30 colleagues across Denmark, Netherlands and India. Our developers, testers and business analysts work closely together throughout the development process, from planning to delivery. Guided by client needs, we combine business knowledge and technical expertise to deliver a standardised, consistent solution across clients and countries.

Key about your role

As a Senior Business Analyst in the Life Events department, you will work closely with our Product Owner, Development team, and and Delivery to ensure our products continue being the leading solutions. You will analyse and elaborate requirements coming in from our customers via Delivery and help evolve and design a standard solution to support customer’s needs.

You will have responsibility of tasks that include:

• Analysing business requirements for pension processes and translating them into clear development and test tasks.

• Shaping functional solutions and guiding developers throughout implementation within Life Events— Ranging from supporting brand new processes within the system, to help defining the implementation of new calculations.

• Demoing new features and enhancements to stakeholders.

• Supporting in quality assurance, through testing and bug intake.

Requirements

We are looking for someone who enjoys working with complex systems, customers and calculations, and thrives on collaborating across international teams.

Ideally, you have:

• An educational background in pension, math, IT or a related field.

• At least +5 years experience with software projects.

• Experience with or knowledge of the pension industry – this is a strong advantage.

• Experience with SQL or are comfortable working with databases and data analysis is a plus.

• Have a hands-on mindset, take ownership, and are comfortable driving tasks and issues forward.

• Strong numerical and analytical skills, as many of the tasks involve working extensively with data and calculations.

• Experience gathering and breaking down complex requirements into actionable tasks within IT projects.

• Communicate confidently in English.

Using AI

• You have used AI-assisted development tools, such as Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, GitHub Copilot or Cursor, in your work or your own projects.

*Please submit your application, including your CV. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

*A criminal record and reference check are part of the application process. Each employee within Keylane must follow training on information security and irrespective to the role basic information security responsibilities apply.

If you have any questions about the job, you are very welcome to Martin Bo Heiberg, manager martin.bo.heiberg@keylane.com

If you have any questions, please send an email to manager of the team, martin.bo.heiberg@keylane.com or Talent Acquisition Specialist, Lykke Kæstel Alsgren at lykke.alsgren@keylane.com.

Benefits

• A flat and informal organization with a professional and supportive working environment.

• A profit share.

• Inclusion days where you decide when to hold your public holidays.

• Five weeks of vacation and five Keylane days.

• A pension scheme where 13.25% is paid by Keylane and the individual contribution is 3%.

• Flexibility in the working environment. We offer a combination of working from home and from the office. We value seeing colleagues in person to stay connected and collaborate effectively.

• The Danish office is located a 10-minute walk from Islands Brygge Metro station.

• We believe that strong employee relations are key to maintaining well-being in the workplace. To support this, we offer a variety of social activities that all employees can participate in, such as yoga, padel tennis, running, outdoor bathing, and fitness in the basement.

• Salary: For this role, the Monthly Base Salary ranges from 50.000-60.000 (DKK), corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Are you ready for a Keylane career? At Keylane, we are transforming the insurance and pensions industry with innovative SaaS solutions. But that's not all – at Keylane, we believe that work should be more than just a job. It's about leveraging your unique self, developing your potential through our acclaimed Keylane Academy, and having fun both in and out of the office. Let us show you how we do things differently!

With offices in the Netherlands, Germany, Norway and Denmark, Keylane plays a very important role in the European insurance and pension industry, providing highly configurable and customer-centric SaaS platforms. By optimizing business processes, we empower our customers to be future-ready and agile, driving innovation across the sector.

What sets us apart?

That is our people. At Keylane, we foster a culture where everyone can be themselves, develop themselves and connect with each other. We are a diverse community of individuals, united by our commitment to delivering exceptional results for our customers.

At Keylane, we stand for equality and inclusivity. We believe that everyone should be treated as equals, and our 'flat hierarchy' approach to management reflects this core value. We embrace diversity as a driving force, knowing that our differences make us stronger. Together, we build a workplace founded on trust, openness, and knowledge sharing – a place where every voice is heard and valued.

By the way, did you already know that we have exchanged the fixed national holidays for inclusion days? This means it is no longer mandatory to take days off on national holidays. These days can instead be taken whenever a Keylaner wishes to take them.

Keylane Academy: our personal development and fun factory

But it doesn't stop there. We prioritize your growth and personal development, providing you with ample opportunities to excel, not only in your career but also as an individual. Welcome to the Keylane Academy, where learning is infused with a fun factor. Discover a range of services designed to unleash your potential:

• 
Learning Journeys: We map out your career path and development opportunities, ensuring you always know the exciting steps that lie ahead.

• 
Expert Talks: Immerse yourself in captivating learning sessions, where industry experts share their knowledge and insights on cutting-edge topics.

• 
Playgrounds: welcome the fun factory! Engage with your colleagues, forge connections, and create unforgettable memories through our amusing events like sport events, game board nights or the weekly after work drinks

At Keylane, your journey with us is about more than just a job – it's about growth, fulfilment, and a sense of belonging. Join us in shaping the future of the insurance and pension industry while enjoying an enriching and vibrant workplace.

Ready to embark on this special adventure? Visit our careers page to explore our open positions and be a part of something special.

D’ANGLETERRE IS LOOKING FOR A SUPERVISOR FOR OUR BANQUET TEAM

Are you a natural leader who knows how to bring people together, communicate clearly and create memorable guest experiences?

At d’Angleterre, we are looking for a Banquet Supervisor with strong leadership and communication skills who enjoys taking responsibility and leading from the front. You know how to create structure in a busy environment, motivate your team and collaborate effortlessly across departments, always with the guest experience at the centre.

If you are passionate about luxury hospitality and thrive in an environment where attention to detail, teamwork and personal service matter, we would love to hear from you.

WE OFFER

You will become part of an international and ambitious environment where no two days are the same. Together with a dedicated team, you will create personal, stylish and elegant experiences for everything from intimate meetings to larger events and celebrations.

Through our internal d’Anglecademy, you will also have access to training and development opportunities designed to support your professional and personal growth.

ABOUT THE JOB

As our Banquet Supervisor, you will play a key role in the daily operation of the Banquet department. You will lead and support a team of dedicated waiters and ensure that meetings, events and celebrations are executed to the high standards our guests expect from d’Angleterre.

A central part of your role will be communication and coordination. You will work closely with colleagues across the hotel, communicate directly with meeting and event guests, and ensure that everyone involved has the information they need.

You will be expected to take ownership, remain calm when plans change and set the standard through your own presence and behavior.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

We are looking for someone who is confident in taking the lead while still being approachable and supportive.

You are a strong communicator who can give clear direction, listen to your team and build positive working relationships across different departments. You understand that great leadership is not only about managing the operation, but also about creating trust, motivating others and bringing out the best in your team.

We imagine that you:

• Have experience from a similar role within hotels, restaurants, events or luxury hospitality

• Have strong leadership skills and enjoy taking responsibility

• Are an excellent communicator who can communicate confidently with guests, colleagues and management

• Know how to motivate, guide and support a team during both busy and quieter moments

• Are structured, proactive and attentive to detail

• Stay calm and solution-oriented when priorities change

• Lead by example and take pride in creating exceptional guest experiences

• Enjoy working closely with other departments and understand the importance of teamwork

• Are flexible and comfortable working evenings, weekends and varying shifts

Above all, we are looking for someone with presence, energy and a genuine interest in people. Someone who can combine operational excellence with warm leadership and who wants to contribute to both the guest experience and the development of the team.

ABOUT D’ANGLETERRE

At d’Angleterre, we believe that people are at the heart of true luxury hospitality. Our history, surroundings and traditions are important, but it is our colleagues who bring the experience to life every day.

That is why we look not only for experience and professional skills, but for people with the right attitude: individuals who are passionate, pragmatic, flexible and genuinely committed to delivering personal five-star service.

What if developers could spend less time navigating complexity and more time building great technology?

Join Pandora as our Lead Engineer, Developer Experience and help shape how engineering teams build, deliver and operate software at scale.

You will lead the implementation and evolution of our Developer Experience platform and Developer Portal strategy, using Port.io as the foundation for a simpler, more connected and increasingly self-service engineering environment.

This is an opportunity to influence Developer Experience across a global technology organisation. You will help reduce friction throughout the software development lifecycle, improve visibility and ownership of software assets, and create practical standards and capabilities that enable engineering teams to move faster and with greater confidence.

Help Write Our Next Chapter

As a technical leader within our DevOps & Operational Excellence team, you will:

• Lead the implementation, configuration and continued development of Pandora’s Developer Portal, built on Port.io.

• Own the architecture of our software catalogue, including metadata, service ownership and portal governance.

• Design engineering scorecards covering operational readiness, security, reliability, documentation and architecture standards.

• Establish and maintain Golden Paths that simplify and standardise software delivery.

• Drive adoption of self-service capabilities across development, deployment, observability and operational excellence.

• Integrate Port.io with platforms including GitHub, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Datadog, Splunk, Azure and Kubernetes.

• Build greater visibility into engineering health, service quality and operational readiness.

• Use DORA metrics, flow metrics and Developer Experience frameworks to support measurable improvements.

• Identify friction across the software development lifecycle and turn this into focused improvement initiatives.

• Influence engineering leaders and teams to adopt shared platform standards and self-service ways of working.

• Facilitate communities of practice and knowledge sharing across engineering teams.

• Evaluate emerging developments across Developer Experience, Internal Developer Platforms and Platform Engineering.

What Makes You Shine:

You are passionate about improving the day-to-day experience of engineers and understand that great Developer Experience is about more than tooling. It brings together thoughtful platform design, automation, clear ownership, effective governance and a deep understanding of how developers work.

We would love to hear from you if you bring:

• 8+ years of relevant experience across Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Internal Developer Platforms or a closely related engineering discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience will also be considered.

• Experience implementing or evolving a developer portal, software catalogue or comparable self-service engineering platform.

• Knowledge of software catalogue architecture, service ownership and engineering governance.

• Experience designing Golden Paths, engineering scorecards or reusable self-service capabilities.

• A strong understanding of CI/CD, cloud platforms, Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code.

• Experience integrating engineering tools and platforms such as GitHub, Azure DevOps, Azure, ServiceNow or observability solutions.

• Familiarity with DORA metrics, flow metrics or other approaches to measuring engineering effectiveness.

• Professional fluency in English.

• Experience with Port.io would be particularly valuable. However, we are also interested in people who have built relevant experience through comparable developer portals, Internal Developer Platforms or service catalogue technologies.

We know that great talent comes from different backgrounds and experiences. If this opportunity excites you and you can see yourself bringing many of these skills to the team, we would love to hear your story.

Crafting What’s Next, Together

You will join Pandora’s DevOps & Operational Excellence team within Digital & Technology and report to the Director of DevOps & Operational Excellence.

Your work will connect you with colleagues across Platform Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, Software Engineering, Product Engineering, Service Management and Cloud Platforms. You will have the opportunity to shape solutions across organisational boundaries and help create a more consistent, productive and developer-centred engineering environment.

This role is a Lead Engineer, individual contributor role.

The Impact You Will Make

Your impact will be visible through the adoption of the Developer Portal and Golden Paths, increased use of self-service platform capabilities, broader coverage of the software catalogue and clearer service ownership.

The role will also contribute to reducing developer onboarding time, strengthening engineering standards, improving developer satisfaction and reducing manual governance activities.

The Additional Sparkle

You’ll be based at our Digital & Technology building at Havneholmen in Copenhagen, working alongside talented colleagues in an international and collaborative environment.

Our LEED Gold-certified building is designed to bring people together and provides a modern workplace where you can connect, collaborate and share ideas. It’s a great base from which to help shape Pandora’s Developer Experience and influence how our engineering teams work globally.

Ready to Craft Your Next Career Chapter?

If you can see yourself improving how engineers build, deliver and operate technology, while helping Pandora advance its Platform Engineering and Operational Excellence journey, we would love to hear from you.

Please submit your application in English. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Let’s Craft the Incredible

Pandora is the world’s largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, helping people share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Pandora brings together craftsmanship, innovation and responsible business practices. Join us and bring your expertise, ideas and unique contribution as we continue to craft what comes next

Join a fast-growing international MedTech company and take a central role in turning AI ambitions into practical, adopted solutions across the organisation.

Turn AI ambitions into practical business impact

Contura International has been named a Gazelle company two years in a row and has experienced significant growth over the past five years, increasing revenue fivefold and its number of employees tenfold.

As AI Lead, you will join Contura's IT & Projects organisation and report to the Head of IT.

In this newly established role, you will take ownership of the AI roadmap and use-case portfolio and help move AI initiatives from pilot to production.

Working across business and IT, you will drive adoption, build internal AI capability and ensure that initiatives create business value while meeting relevant quality and compliance requirements.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Own and drive Contura's AI roadmap, use-case portfolio and implementation plan.

• Translate business needs into qualified use cases, requirements and solution proposals.

• Take successful AI and digital solutions from pilot into controlled production.

• Build internal AI capability through training, workshops and an AI community of champions and key users.

• Coordinate external specialists and contribute to pragmatic AI governance together with IT, Quality and Regulatory Affairs.

Business-minded AI profile with strong implementation skills

We are open regarding your professional background and previous job title. What matters most is your ability to understand business needs, turn them into relevant AI or digital solutions and create momentum from idea through implementation and adoption.

We imagine that you bring:

• Experience taking AI or digital solutions from pilot to production and driving user adoption.

• Experience translating business needs into solution proposals, requirements and priorities.

• Practical understanding of data foundations, data quality and integrations.

• Experience with AI and data solutions, preferably within the Microsoft ecosystem.

• Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to make AI understandable and relevant across the business.

You are pragmatic, curious and delivery-oriented and comfortable creating structure and direction in an area that is still developing. You work well across functions and combine a strategic perspective with practical execution and a clear focus on business outcomes.

Turn AI into lasting business capability

This is an opportunity to take a central role in how Contura develops and applies AI as the company continues its growth and digitalisation journey.

The recruitment process is carried out by Venaris Executive Search (www.venaris.dk). For more information regarding the position, please reach out to Fares Almas at fa@venaris.dk. All requests will be handled confidentially. If this position is for you, do not hesitate to apply by uploading your CV.

Contura International

Contura is a fast-growing international MedTech company that develops, manufactures and commercialises innovative hydrogel-based products for treatment in areas including female urinary incontinence, orthopaedics and veterinary applications. The company has more than 20 years of experience in the development and manufacturing of therapeutic hydrogels and has experienced significant growth in recent years. Learn more about Contura at http://www.contura.dk/

Are you a passionate jewellery designer with extensive experience creating iconic products and collections?
