Would you like to shape the future of Pandora's Modern Classics & Diamonds category by creating innovative designs that combine timeless elegance with modern expression?

Lead creative projects that define the future of Pandora's most iconic collections

As our new Senior Designer, Modern Classics & Diamonds, you will work closely with the Design Director to lead creative projects from initial concept generation through design execution and prototype development. Utilizing your strong creative skills, technical expertise, and deep understanding of Pandora's brand DNA, you will play a key role in developing compelling collections that inspire customers around the world.

Your Role

Design & Collection Development

• 
Partner with the team to create and develop new collections within the Modern Classics & Diamonds category.

• 
Translate creative briefs into innovative product concepts, designs, and sketches that align with Pandora's brand identity.

• 
Lead individual design projects from initial research and concept development through CAD and prototype stages.

• 
Propose original and future-thinking product ideas that support the strategic direction of the category.

• 
Ensure projects are developed and launched within agreed timelines and project requirements.

•

Brief products to Design Operations & Development (DoD) and collaborate closely to ensure successful prototype execution.

Support prototype reviews and creative evaluations when required.

Collaborate with Creative Sourcing to explore new materials, techniques, and innovation opportunities.

Partner with Creative Merchandising to align category and collection structures.

•

Research & Innovation

•

•

• 
Ensure all research, concept development, reviews, and launches are delivered according to agreed timelines and processes.

A Creative Visionary with a Passion for Jewellery Design

You might be the person we are looking for if you combine exceptional creativity with strong technical expertise and an eye for commercial product design. You are skilled at transforming inspiration into compelling jewellery concepts and are comfortable working across all stages of the design process, from initial idea generation to final product execution.

You understand how to balance innovation with brand consistency and have a proven ability to create products that strengthen and evolve an established global brand. You enjoy working collaboratively in a fast-paced international environment and thrive when bringing new ideas to life.

Requirements

• 
Extensive experience designing jewellery within a fashion, luxury, or jewellery brand.

• 
Strong creative portfolio demonstrating concept development, mood boards, sketches, and finished products.

• 
Proven experience leading design projects from concept to prototype.

• 
Advanced knowledge of jewellery design and manufacturing processes.

• 
Strong hand-sketching and visual communication skills.

• 
Experience working with CAD development and cross-functional product development teams.

• 
Ability to translate creative direction into commercially successful products.

• 
Strong communication and collaboration skills.

• 
Experience mentoring or supporting junior designers is an advantage.

• 
Proficiency in relevant design tools such as Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign.

Important

Please include a portfolio showcasing your design work, creative process, technical skills, and collection development experience as part of your application.

Your New Team

As a key member of Pandora's Product Design team, you will join an international group of passionate, ambitious, and highly skilled designers dedicated to creating beautiful and innovative jewellery. You will report to the Design Director and collaborate closely with colleagues across Creative Direction, Design Operations & Development, Creative Merchandising, Creative Sourcing, and Product Development.

Additional Information

This role is based at Pandora's Global Office in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Did We Get Your Attention?

If you see yourself in this position and would like to become part of Pandora's future, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please submit your CV and portfolio through our online application system. We look forward to hearing from you.

We process applications on an ongoing basis and therefore encourage you to submit your application at your earliest convenience. You can read more about Pandora on our corporate website Pandora Group.

Icing on the Cake

You will be working from our beautiful Global Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Alongside our inspiring work environment, we are proud to hold LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design, reflecting our commitment to sustainability and responsible use of resources.

The result is a professional and dynamic workspace that is unique, comfortable, and inspirational, delivering a true Pandora experience to everyone who works here and visits our offices.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Do you love designing clean game architecture, building multiplayer systems that run smoothly, and helping a team of programmers make the right technical decisions? Great! Let’s talk.

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

We're building something unannounced, exciting, thoroughly goofy, and built to be played together online. We're now looking for a Lead Game Programmer to help building the underlying systems that make it all work, from the core architecture to the multiplayer tech that connects our players. You'll stay hands-on in the code and the Unity editor while helping the programming team make good technical decisions, stay aligned, and build systems that support creative experimentation. And just to be very clear: this is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.

Here’s what that looks like day to day

• 
In collaboration with game designers, artists, and other programmers, you’ll build new features and systems and continuously iterate on improvements. We all work in Unity with C#, with every team member hands-on in the editor

• 
You’ll set and communicate the project’s technical direction, turning creative goals and production needs into clear technical priorities

• 
You’ll help the programming team make architectural decisions, align around shared patterns, and navigate trade-offs between long-term code health and short-term needs

• 
You’ll review and improve technical solutions, share best practices, and support other programmers without becoming a gatekeeper or bottleneck

• 
You’ll proactively identify technical risks, messy systems, and missing foundations, and take responsibility for addressing them at the right time

• 
Overall, you’ll make sure the project is technically healthy and maintain the codebase in a way that makes it easy for others to build on

This includes things like...

• 
Designing an architecture that allows for easy gameplay implementation and flexibility

• 
Implementing and maintaining online features such as matchmaking, invites and friends

• 
Profiling and improving network performance, bandwidth and latency, and making sure the game holds up on real-world connections

• 
Breaking down complex technical challenges, helping decide what to prioritise, and ensuring important decisions are understood by the people they affect

• 
Staying close to the actual game: writing production code, debugging difficult problems, and improving systems as the project evolves

You’re a great match if

• 
You have at least ten years of professional game development experience across multiple shipped games and different stages of development, including significant technical ownership or leadership on a project

• 
You have experience setting technical direction and helping a programming team make and implement architectural decisions, with strong judgment in balancing flexibility, maintainability, performance and the needs of a creative production

• 
You're highly proficient in C# and have deep knowledge of the Unity engine and editor

• 
You've shipped at least one online multiplayer game, had real ownership of its networking/online systems, and have hands-on experience with a Unity multiplayer framework (e.g., Coherence)

• 
You communicate clearly and can explain technical decisions and trade-offs to programmers and non-programmers alike

Nice to haves

• 
You have experience shipping iOS and macOS apps, including hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and the Game Controller framework using Xcode and Swift

• 
Experience with backend services, dedicated servers or cloud hosting for online games

• 
Interest in multiplayer game design and social features

• 
Experience working with automated build pipelines such as Jenkins

• 
Experience building systemic or open-world games

What always matters to us at Triband

• 
You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

• 
You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness and creativity while actively contributing to sustaining that culture

• 
You believe games are made by teams, not rockstars and that great ideas can come from anyone

• 
You bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test them

• 
You love exploration and experimentation but don’t get too precious when the evidence tells you you’re wrong

• 
You value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place to be

Practicalities

• 
We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

• 
For this role we also consider people located outside of Denmark and provide financial (and moral!) support with visa application and relocation.

• 
We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

• 
Our working language is English.

We offer

• 
Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.

• 
A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.

• 
Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.

• 
A professional development budget to invest in your growth.

• 
Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.

• 
Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

• 
Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).

• 
Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.

• 
Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.

• 
Pension plan and private health insurance.

• 
Endless amounts of Faxe Kondi.

WHAT THE TRIBAND?
Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. jobs.occupation: Technical Solution Designer - Clinical Trial Mgmt & Clinical Trial Supply in IT
jobs.description:
Are you a Technical Solution Designer with deep understanding of Clinical Trial Management and Clinical Trial Supply? Do you think holistically, act with ambition, and find technical solutions to accelerate clinical trial oversight?

Can you design and implement configurations for SaaS applications to support trials?

If so, you may be our new T_echnical Solution Designer._

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

Our context

This position is based in our Global IT organization. In Global IT, we have spent the past five years building and maturing a product-driven organization. We operate with a strong focus on product management and lifecycle thinking, where long-lived teams take full ownership- from problem discovery to solution delivery and continuous improvement - ensuring we address real business needs.

Our structure combines clear leadership intent with empowered teams: each team member is supported by both a People Leader focused on development and a Functional Leader guiding strategy and delivery. We foster autonomy and self-organization to enable fast flow, clear accountability, and minimal dependencies.

The Clinical domain currently consists of three product teams and a data team, supporting our Clinical Operations, Clinical Development, Biometrics, Clinical Data Management and Clinical Trial Supply functions.

We are seeking a passionate Technical Solution Designer who will be responsible for designing and implementing technical solutions to support CTM and CTS. Practically speaking, you will be the technical expert in how our CTMS, eTMF, and IRT are configured. All of these are SaaS solutions. When our SaaS solutions fall short, you will find ways to deliver functionality in collaboration with our Automation, Integration, AI and Analytics teams.

Together with the IT product team, you will ensure that the solutions, including the documentation packages we deliver, are GxP compliant and sustainable.

You will report to Simon Rønne Kümmel, Clinical Domain Lead, and Jakob Thrane, People Leader. You will be based in Hellerup, Denmark.

Your key responsibilities will be to

• Design and implement technical configuration and solutions to support CTM and CTS.

• Engage with stakeholders to understand business needs.

• Either implement the configurations yourself, or work with the managed services provider or vendor to implement the configuration.

• Oversee system support and act as escalation point for tickets.

• Assist with documentation and validation of solutions.

• Be visionary in improving our CTM and CTS supply technical capabilities and suggest and implement improvements for automation, integration and seamless data flows.

• Ensure systems are in a validated state and are inspection-ready.

• Maintain operational oversight over vendors.

Qualifications and experience

You hold a relevant academic degree – preferably a Master’s degree, with a background as an Engineer, Technical Business Analyst, Configuration Manager or an equivalent technical role.

You have solid experience with eTMF and CTMS in a GxP context, minimum +3 years of relevant experience across complex organizations.

Furthermore, you have:

• Strong understanding of Clinical Trial Management and Clinical Trial Supply and related systems.

• Experience working with SaaS vendors.

• Ability to connect people and create shared understanding and direction.

• Is good at collaborating with business in complex and ambiguous settings, handling conflicts constructively and helps groups move forward.

Key competencies:

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

To succeed in this role, we also expect you to be good at collaborating with business in complex and ambiguous settings, handling conflicts constructively, and helping groups move forward.

What we offer

We offer an exciting and challenging position in an entrepreneurial and international company with short decision paths. You will work with highly skilled colleagues and play a key role in shaping how Global IT delivers sustainable value to Ascendis Pharma and, ultimately, to patients.

Travel: 10-15 days per year

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, 2900 Hellerup

Flexibility: Some of the Clinicial organization is located in the US, and meetings in the afternoon and evening will occur.

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the position or the company, please contact Jakob Monajemzadeh Thrane, People Leader, jmt@ascendispharma.com.

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website,

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

As the summer holiday period approaches, you may experience a longer response time than usual. We truly appreciate your patience and thank you for your understanding. We look forward to reviewing your application as soon as possible.

A note to recruiters:

We do not allow external search party solicitation. Presentation of candidates without written permission from the Ascendis Pharma HR team (specifically from: Talent Acquisition Partner or Human Resources Director) is not allowed. If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged.

**Product Strategy & Development Manager – shape wound care innovation

**Passionate about improving care for people in need while making a meaningful difference for healthcare professionals?

Join Coloplast and help shape the next generation of wound and tissue repair solutions.

Here, you will move between market insight, portfolio strategy, innovation and hands-on execution – turning insights and ideas into solutions that help make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs.

**Working together to move wound care forward

**You will join us at our HQ in Humlebæk. Here, you will become part of Wound & Tissue Repair, working with products and solutions that support healthcare professionals in wound management and patient care.

That takes more than one function or one perspective. You will work closely with colleagues across Sales, R&D, Operations and many other functions, with plenty of room to share ideas, learn from each other and have fun along the way.

**From “what if?” to “what next?”

**This is not a role where you spend all your time making strategies about strategies. You will work across the product and portfolio journey – spotting opportunities, figuring out which ones make sense and helping turn the right ones into reality.

Sometimes you will facilitate a workstream from beginning to end. At other times, you will have several things moving at once. That flexibility is very much part of the job.

More specifically, you will:

• Explore customer needs, market trends, competitors, technologies, access, reimbursement and regulatory developments to identify opportunities

• Turn market, clinical, technical and financial insights into business cases, portfolio choices and clear recommendations

• Lead or support innovation and product development from opportunity assessment through concept, feasibility, development and transfer

• Shape launch, market expansion and lifecycle plans based on strategic fit, unmet needs and commercial potential

• Bring cross-functional teams together around clear objectives, responsibilities, decisions and next steps

With a global scope comes the opportunity to get out and meet the people you work with, with approximately 10-15% travel.

**A strategic mindset with a hands-on approach

**You have a strategic and analytical mindset, but you are not afraid to roll up your sleeves when an idea needs moving forward. You are curious, collaborative and comfortable when there is not a ready-made answer – and you know how to bring people with you when priorities, perspectives and possibilities compete for attention.

We also imagine that you:

• Have a master’s degree in business, marketing, economics, healthcare, science, engineering or a related discipline

• Bring approximately 3+ years of relevant experience in product strategy, product development, portfolio management, business development, consulting or a related role, preferably within regulated healthcare

• Have successfully led complex cross-functional initiatives and developed business cases

• Can translate market, clinical, technical and financial information into recommendations

• Have strong English and Microsoft Office skills

**Interested?

**If you would like to know more about the position, please e-mail Senior Director of Strategy & Development

Wound & Tissue Repair, Thomas Kondrup Hardahl, on dktkha@coloplast.com

We will take candidates into the recruitment process continuously, so do not hesitate to apply. This position will remain open until a suitable candidate has been found.

_Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

__Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

jobs.occupation: IoT Services Manager, Nordics, UK & Benelux
jobs.description:
Trackunit is a fast-growing company and a leading supplier of IoT solutions, operating out of many offices worldwide. Trackunit specializes in digital solutions that connect machines, people, and systems in the global construction industry. The construction industry is the least digitalized industry of all. This lack of digitalization has left construction far behind a global economy on the rise and placed the industry as one of the least productive industries too.

We are looking for an IoT Services Manager to own end-to-end customer-facing project management, and IoT technical account management for their region. You'll be the primary technical point of contact for device, fleet, and IoT solution health to our customer as a trusted technical advisor, guiding them from installation through fleet-health optimization and ongoing device lifecycle support.

With locations in Denmark, The UK and The Netherlands, we offer you a flexible setup with the possibility to work from one of our locations or remotely. No relocation assistance is offered for this position.

**What’s in it for you?

**

• A place in an agile growth SaaS business, with possibilities to grow internally in the company. We are moving quickly, so fasten your seat belt and prepare to adjust. Back in 2020 we were 150 employees at Trackunit and we have just passed 450 employees.

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and we support them through training, coaching and mindfulness as well as with an open feedback culture to enable you to identify your strengths and opportunities. We do this by touching upon your impact on our triple focus: impacting yourself, impacting teams/relations and impacting the organisation/strategy.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us or something we state in a job posting. We do offer you a flexible setup and believe that you best can structure how your routines look like. And once you have chosen how you work best, let us know what you need: we got you covered with the IT equipment you need for your work.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. And this priority starts with our hiring - we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We only assess candidates on their qualifications and merit. Learn more about TIDE and other DE&I initiatives on our career site.

**Who are you ideally?

**

• Technical account management or technical advisory experience in an IoT, telematics, or hardware environment.

• Comfortable consulting customer and interpreting fleet-health and technical data to advise customers and benchmark performance against peer accounts.

• Working knowledge of device and firmware management (CAN, MODbus, firmware/FOTA, BLE sensors) sufficient to guide configuration, validation, and troubleshooting.

• Experience in customer-facing project management, installation, or deployment operations.

• Strong organizational skills — comfortable working with multiple concurrent programs at once.

• Skilled at building trusted relationships with both customer technical stakeholders and internal sales, account, and support/engineering teams.

• Professional fluency in either one of the Nordics languages or Dutch, besides English.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries - this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're super excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Build trusted customer partnerships: Serve as the primary technical contact for IoT accounts, understand customer goals and document agreed solutions and priorities.

• Present insights and recommendations: Lead monthly fleet and device health reviews, translating technical findings into business impact, recommended actions and measurable outcomes for operational and executive audiences.

• Own technical configuration: Manage CAN/Modbus profiles, firmware—including FOTA—and device operating modes to keep customer fleets healthy and reporting accurately.

• Drive proactive fleet health: Monitor fleet and device health, investigate non-reporting devices, and proactively identify and resolve risks before they affect customer operations.

• Support quality deployments: Partner with deployment and technical teams to align requirements, validate installation quality and establish reliable data from day one.

• Lead technical escalations: Coordinate resolution across Support, Engineering and delivery teams, maintaining clear accountability, customer communication and follow-through.

• Enable adoption and growth: Guide customers on relevant IoT capabilities, partner with Sales and Customer Success on improvement opportunities, and bring customer feedback into product and service discussions.

**Our hiring process

**Don't waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with the Talent Acquisition Partner.

• A deeper conversation: We'll go into your experience and how you work, and you'll get a clearer picture of the team, the challenges, and what the role looks like day to day.

• Assignment-specific interview. We want you to get an insight into some of the concrete work tasks or projects related to the role. You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job.

• If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We’re lucky to have you!

**The question is: Are you in?

**_Trackunit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

__Trackunit also prioritizes providing reasonable accommodations for qualified people with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let our People & Talents team know.

_**About Trackunit

**Trackunit is the leading operating data platform connecting people, assets, and processes in construction.

A global technology company connecting the construction industry - by orchestrating data and infrastructure - to build the most useful industry for the world.

We connect construction through one platform to create a living, evolving ecosystem that delivers data and insights to the off-highway sector. With more than 2 million assets connected and more than 2 billion data points collected each day, we use technology to eliminate downtime, improve safety, and help customers improve the bottom line in a sustainable, cost-effective way

Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure investments? If so, CIP Fund Solutions is looking for an Associate to join our skilled and dedicated Valuation team in Copenhagen.

The team

The Valuation team is responsible for financial modelling, valuation framework, applied valuations, and supporting investment decisions through business case reviews with reporting to senior management.

The role

You will be responsible for handling and developing the valuation methodologies applied across CIP funds, working with corporate and regional teams to enhance your financial and valuation skills in a varied portfolio of renewable investments.

As part of the final investment decision process, you will be responsible for engaging with the investment teams, providing detailed financial model assumption reviews to ensure consistent and well-documented business cases, and being accountable for delivering key inputs such as discount rate assumptions to become a trusted business partner, supporting our global investment strategy for the investments and funds managed by CIP.

Furthermore, you will participate in ad hoc analyses on, e.g., power markets, hedging strategy, currency swaps, and other financial products.

Responsibilities will consist of, but are not limited to:

• Develop internal valuation methodologies for new types of investments

• Advising the business on valuation issues and methodologies and maintaining CIP’s valuation framework in collaboration with senior stakeholders

• Participating in various ad hoc financial analyses related to, e.g., financial hedging, benchmarking, factor analysis, mean-variance analysis, risk mitigation, etc.

• Developing and reviewing financial models to ensure consistent implementation of best practices

• Participating in the FID process for new assets by conducting assumption review of underlying business cases

• Preparing and coordinating analysis and communication material for decision-makers at the senior management level

You

The ideal candidate holds a university degree in economics, finance, or a similar field and approximately one year of experience in financial analysis and valuation, with solid skills from private equity firms, top consulting firms, or multinationals, ideally within renewables.

You have a very strong theoretical understanding of complex valuation methodologies and can present complex financial and valuation methods simply and clearly to CIP's senior management.

We look for the following in a candidate:

• The ability to navigate and thrive in a high-intensity environment

• Well-developed interpersonal and communication skills

• Hands-on experience using AI tools to enhance analysis and modelling, with the judgment to verify outputs and protect confidential information

• Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills

• Used to working in an international setting

• Fluent in English

The process

Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

---

CIP Fund Solutions’ commitment to diversity and inclusion

CIP Fund Solutions is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.

A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.

CIP Fund Solutions

CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy-period - supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M&A.

For more information, please visit CIP Fund Solutions.

Transaction Banking is changing fast, and the way customers connect with their bank is becoming more sophisticated. Danske Bank is bringing its Customer Implementation and Integration areas together under one unit, and we are looking for a leader who can create a shared direction, build a strong leadership team, and make complex customer journeys simpler and more consistent across five markets.

What you will be doing

You will lead a newly unified organisation spanning Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland and Lithuania, bringing together experienced leaders, specialist teams and distinct capabilities. Reporting directly to the Head of TxB Sales Enablement, you will work closely with colleagues across Sales, Product, Technology, IT and Tribe organisations to shape end-to-end customer experiences. Your role sits at the intersection of business, operations and technology, and the decisions you make will shape how corporate customers and financial institutions connect with Danske Bank.

More specifically, you will:

• Set the strategic direction and priorities across all five markets

• Build and develop a leadership team grounded in clarity, empowerment and accountability

• Connect Customer Implementation and Integration to create more seamless customer journeys

• Partner with IT and Tribe teams to shape customer-facing solutions and internal tooling

• Use client insights to inform implementation journeys, integration solutions and commercial priorities

• Encourage the responsible adoption of AI to simplify processes and build employee capabilities

About you

• Solid experience leading organisations through other leaders

• Genuine commitment to developing people, teams and leadership cultures

• Ability to create direction across countries or complex organisational structures

• Skilled at translating strategy into clear priorities and tangible outcomes

• Strong customer and commercial orientation

• Comfortable at the intersection of business, operations and technology

• Able to bring structure and clarity to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder situations

You do not need to come from a traditional banking background. Experience from financial services, consulting, technology, transformation, customer implementation, integrations, APIs, cash management or similar environments is equally relevant and welcome.

What we offer you

This is a rare opportunity to shape a newly formed organisation and leave a lasting mark on how Danske Bank delivers for its customers. You will work in a hybrid model, typically three to four days per week in the office, alongside talented colleagues across multiple markets. We invest in our leaders and offer genuine scope to grow, both in the role and across the wider organisation.

Are you ready for the next step?

If this sounds like the right move for you, we encourage you to apply. You are also welcome to reach out to Natasha Rajovic, Head of TxB Sales Enablement, at nkuz@danskebank.dk with any questions before applying.

Location: Aarhus or Copenhagen.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Senior Software Engineer, Digital Assets

Danske Bank's Digital Assets team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer with strong C#/.NET experience. You will build dependable backend services, connect systems and contribute to our technical decisions and engineering practices.

The role

Your work will include designing and developing an orchestration layer linking core banking systems with custody, wallet and blockchain services. Secure APIs, messaging, data handling and reliable transaction processing will be central to the role.

Working closely with the Technical Lead and Product Owner, you will take solutions from design through implementation, testing, deployment and ongoing support. You will also collaborate with specialists in architecture, security and operations across the bank.

What you bring

• Proven C# and modern .NET skills, demonstrated through backend software you have delivered and supported in production.

• Good API design and integration skills, covering REST, service authentication and asynchronous communication.

• Experience with relational data modelling and SQL, including transaction handling and query performance.

• Practical knowledge of automated testing, containers, CI/CD and diagnosing services in production.

• The judgement to turn incomplete requirements into testable delivery steps, explain trade-offs, seek feedback and take ownership of your work.

• Clear spoken and written English, with the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.

We encourage continuous learning and thoughtful use of development tools, including AI, alongside sound review and testing habits.

Your day-to-day work

• Develop and maintain C#/.NET backend services with clear interfaces and maintainable code.

• Build the orchestration services connecting core banking systems to external digital-asset platforms.

• Design relational data models and use SQL for consistent, efficient data handling.

• Implement integrations through REST APIs, SDKs, webhooks and messaging, using authentication such as OAuth 2.0 and mutual TLS.

• Build idempotent transaction workflows with clear status tracking, retry behaviour and operational exception handling.

• Work with security specialists to integrate established signing and key-management services, applying least privilege, separation of duties and secure credential handling. Ensure signing operations remain auditable.

• Write unit and integration tests and contribute to peer reviews.

• Help automate builds and releases through CI/CD and containerised deployment.

• Instrument services with logs, metrics and alerts, investigate issues and improve reliability and performance.

• Document design decisions, share knowledge and support colleagues through mentoring.

Useful additional experience

Previous blockchain experience is not required. Any of the following would be an advantage:

• Cloud and delivery: infrastructure as code, container platforms, performance testing, monitoring or recovery planning.

• Wallet and custody connectivity: working with provider APIs, SDKs and webhooks for wallet provisioning, transaction submission and status updates.

SmallClaims is a legal tech company that recovers small, valid claims of up to €25,000 through the courts. Claims that businesses write off today because pursuing them costs more than they are worth. Our AI agents run the whole process, from legal assessment and settlement to filing, judgment and enforcement, while our in-house lawyers quality-assure the work and appear in court. That has cut manual case handling from over 15 hours to about 1.5 hours per case. We have handled 5,000+ cases, win 90%+ in court and serve 500+ Danish customers. Case intake has grown more than 370% since 2023, and we have just raised €2M from Vendep Capital to grow in Europe. Now we are growing the engineering team.

**THE ROLE

**Full-time, in-house. You take ownership of your own areas within our AI service (Python/FastAPI, LLM pipelines) and our back-office platform, the tool our case managers and lawyers run the operation on. Ideas take form together with the team, product specialists and the CTO. You take them from there, end to end across the stack: shape, build, ship, verify, follow up.

**What You’ll Work On

**

• Own parts of and build features in our AI service: LLM orchestration with structured outputs, tool calling, and complex agentic workflows.

• Build the back-office platform our case managers and lawyers use every day, and talk to them to find out what they really need.

• Set up and improve evals and observability, so we know our agents are right before we scale them.

• Ship and run what you build, from staging to production on AWS, with tests and CI as a habit.

**What We Work With

**

• Stack: Laravel/PHP, Next.js, Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL, AWS, Google.

• How we build: Coding agents are part of daily work here. We expect you to be ahead of the curve on building with AI, not catching up to it.

**Who You Are

**

• 3+ years building and operating software in production, from a startup, a bigger company, open source or other serious project.

• You think like a product owner. You want responsibility and ownership, and you take a complicated problem to a shipped feature.

• You are good with data: you understand complex data sets and data pipelines, and you can build with them, visualise them and explain them.

• You hold strong opinions lightly. You are direct in disagreement, but easy to work with after the decision.

• You communicate directly and are honest about mistakes. You can talk to real users and are comfortable with shifting priorities.

• You love building, love learning, and are curious about the domain itself: the legal process, not just the tech.

**Experience And Skills

****Must have

**

• Strong backend development, incl. background jobs, auth models and API design.

• Solid relational database experience (Postgres/SQL or similar): schema design, migrations, performance.

• Hands-on LLM building in production, not just demos: orchestration, structured outputs, tool calling, evals, tracing, prompt design, injection.

• Works daily with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, opencode or similar), knows their strengths and limits, and stays up to date.

• Testing as a habit: feature and end-to-end tests, CI, verifying your own work through staging to production.

• Cloud and deployment literacy (AWS or similar, Docker, CI/CD). You can operate what you ship.

**Nice to have

**

• Python/FastAPI, Laravel/PHP or Next.js specifically.

• Production migration: third-party service changes, database moves, major-version upgrades, data backfills.

• Operating AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch) and Linux servers hands-on.

• Eval or observability tooling for agentic workflows.

• Integrations where no documented API exists: webhooks, browser extensions, automation, scraping.

• Legaltech, fintech or another regulated domain.

**What We Offer

**

• Real ownership of core parts of the AI platform in a small team that ships every week.

• Close work with the CTO, product specialists and the lawyers who use what you build.

• Our base is the office in Copenhagen, but regular remote work is fine

**How To Apply

**Apply via The Hub with a short intro, your CV, GitHub and links to things you have built: apps, side projects, something you shipped at work. Next, we send you our skills checklist as a self-assessment plus a few short written questions, then interviews with the team, then an offer. We keep the process short and give you a clear answer at every step.

As Senior Data Engineer, you will build the data foundations that bring Supply Chain AI Solutions to life. You will turn complex requirements into scalable, compliant, production-ready data products and pipelines that power strategic AI use cases for the Supply Chain organisation. Are you eager to influence the future direction of Arla Foods? Do you envision yourself as a future leader?

How will you make an impact?

The Arla F15 Graduate Programme is a two-year, international development programme designed for graduates who want to learn quickly, explore different areas of a global business and grow into future leadership opportunities.`

Through three eight-month rotations, you will work on meaningful business projects, build an international network and develop the confidence, skills and experience to make an impact at Arla. We will match you with a suitable department based on business needs and your profile, offering you the chance to learn and make a difference. Your F15 Graduate journey begins on 1st September 2027.

• Second rotation (8 months - Outside Denmark) You will have more influence over your second project assignment, which will give you the opportunity to continue growing in a meaningful way whilst adding real value to Arla.

• International experience gained from working, studying or volunteering abroad is an advantage.

• Preferably at least one year of relevant work experience from student jobs or a minimum of six months of internship experience.

• One-to-one mentoring and sparring from senior leaders

Your main focus will be delivering customer-tailored Bespoke software solutions that extends SitaWare Headquarters, Frontline and Edge – from software add-ons to system, tactical radio and military equipment integrations. You will take ownership of delivery on schedule, within budget and to the agreed quality. Alongside this, you will act as Project Manager for non-Defence business units in Systematic connecting them with Defence expertise, coordinating and delivering the services they need.

You can look forward to:

• Managing and driving software projects forward by setting priorities, aligning capacity and schedules, tracking progress and budgets, and managing stakeholders, risks and issues

• Developing your team across Aarhus and Warsaw through 1:1s, development talks, creating opportunities for professional and personal growth and recruitment

• Contributing your team's expertise to Defence bids for Bespoke software and representing Defence services in bids across other business units

• Building strong internal partnerships and coordinating communication on SitaWare releases, change requests, defect handling and hotfixes

• Shaping better ways of working, from processes and guides to the use of AI and agentic AI throughout the software development life cycle

You should expect 5–15 travel days a year.

Your team: Bringing SitaWare expertise together

You will lead 8–10 software architects, software engineers and test engineers across Aarhus and Warsaw, including interns and student workers, with a team lead already in place in Warsaw.

You will be part of a wider international network of colleagues across Defence Services, Product Development and other Systematic business units. The Adjacent Markets function draws on specialist expertise from other teams as needed, giving you a broad technical network and connections across the organisation.

You bring: Technical depth, people leadership and the drive to deliver

Over several years as a project manager or software engineering manager, you have delivered medium to complex software projects or commercial off-the-shelf software products. You also bring some years of people management experience, an understanding of commercial customer contracts and experience providing services to other business units.

We are also looking for:

• Fluent English and the ability to bring clarity to technical discussions and collaboration across teams

• A proactive, decisive approach with strong ownership and follow-through, combined with the ability to motivate and involve people, put customers first, embrace change and communicate clearly with stakeholders at every level

**Join Our Team

**We are looking for three Automation Engineers who are eager to develop their expertise and make an impact within a dynamic and supportive team. DESMI is a dynamic and innovative company where your ideas matter. We're building a culture that values collaboration, continuous learning, and making a difference. As an employee at DESMI, you'll have the opportunity to work on challenging projects, develop cutting-edge skills, and connect with a diverse team of talented individuals. If you're looking for a workplace where you can grow, contribute, and be inspired, DESMI is the place for you.

**Ideally, We Are Looking For Someone Who Is

**

• Curious and eager to explore new technologies and solutions

• Driven by solving technical challenges and delivering high-quality results

• Collaborative and motivated by working across disciplines to create robust solutions

**A glimpse into the role

**As an Automation Engineer, you will become part of a global Automation team with 8 colleagues in Denmark and 2 colleagues in China. Automation is a key strategic focus at DESMI, and you will play an important role in further developing and strengthening our automation solutions.

We are expanding our team and are looking for engineers with different strengths and interests. Whether your expertise lies in PLC and software development, electrical and hardware design, system integration, or technical leadership, you will help develop robust and reliable automation solutions across DESMI's product portfolio. Working closely with colleagues across Product Development, Engineering, Production, Service, and Sales, you will contribute to delivering high-quality solutions that create value for our customers.

**Depending on your strengths and interest, your main responsibilities could include:

**

• Development and maintenance of automation solutions for DESMI products and systems

• Design and implementation of PLC and HMI software

• Development and integration of electrical, control, and communication systems

• Participation in system testing, commissioning, and technical verification

• Preparation of technical documentation and support material

• Technical support for DESMI's global organization

• Driving continuous improvements of products, processes, and technical quality

• Ensuring solutions can be efficiently handed over to Production and Service

**Your next opportunity starts here

**As someone who will join our Automation Team, we are looking for a skilled engineer who is a self-driven individual with expertise in automation technology, electrical engineering, or a related field.

**We Also Imagine That You

**

• Have an educational background within Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Software Engineering, or a related technical field

• Have experience with automation systems, PLC programming, electrical systems, or a combination of these disciplines

• Enjoy solving technical challenges and turning complex requirements into practical solutions

• Have a structured approach to your work and take ownership of your tasks

• Thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working with colleagues across functions and locations

• Communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken

It would be an advantage if you have experience with:

• PLC platforms such as Siemens Step 7 and TIA Portal

• Hardware design, electrical schematics, and documentation in SEE Electrical or similar CAD tools

• Industrial communication protocols such as OPC UA, MQTT, Modbus TCP/IP, or Profinet

• Pumping systems, water treatment systems, or other industrial applications

• Marine, defense, or other highly regulated industries

**The perks of being at DESMI

**At DESMI, we want you to feel supported, valued and motivated. That’s why we offer a range of benefits that make a difference – from flexibility and career opportunities to security.

Here are some of the benefits we offer our employees:

• Flexible working hours With the option to work from home two days a week, supporting a hybrid work environment that fosters productivity and teamwork.

• Global career prospects Be part of DESMI’s global team. Working with dedicated colleagues across Europe, Asia and USA.

• Skills development and career growth Opportunities for training, job rotation and internal mobility.

• Pension With employer contributions up to 10% depending on your contract type.

• Private healthcare and life insurance Your well-being is important to us. We provide comprehensive private healthcare coverage, giving you access to quality medical treatment when needed.

• On-site canteen Including a light breakfast, lunch buffet and fruit snacks throughout the day, with a focus on healthy and varied meals.

• Company sports & social activities Join events like badminton, bowling, summer parties, art clubs and more.

**What We’re About

**But we’re more than just pumps. At DESMI, we believe teamwork and innovation drive success.

**When You Join DESMI, You Can Expect

**

• A collaborative and supportive team environment.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.

• A chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact.

• A company that values sustainability and innovation.

We are a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together, and ideas are always welcome. Here, doers thrive – if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.

As innovators in reliable and sustainable flow solutions, we serve a wide range of industries from Aquaculture and Defense to Green Technologies – the list goes on. Sustainability is highly appreciated while developing high-performance and long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

**Ready to apply?

**If you're a motivated individual seeking a challenging and rewarding career where you can contribute to a more sustainable future, we encourage you to apply through the platform!

To learn more about this opportunity please contact Søren Flummer at sorf@desmi.com . We are reviewing applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

As a Senior Service Engineer at DESMI, your primary responsibility is to install, service, maintain, and repair our customers’ products and equipment, primarily related to pumps. You will be responsible for ensuring that the products are serviced correctly, operate reliably, and meet the customers’ needs. Your role also involves delivering excellent customer service and maintaining strong relationships with our customers.

**Work Tasks

jobs.occupation: 171819 Clinical Associate Professor (Research) of Paediatrics (Fixed-term, 5 years)
jobs.description:
Clinical Associate Professor (Research) of Paediatrics (Fixed-term, 5 years)

  Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
 University of Copenhagen

   

  The University seeks to appoint a clinical associate professor (research) of Paediatrics to the Department of Clinical Medicine to commence as soon as possible.

  The clinical research professorship (research) is combined with a clinical position at Zealand University Hospital, Department of Paediatric and Adolescent Medicine.

  It is a requirement for appointment that the applicant is accepted for both the clinical associate professorship (research) and the clinical position. In order to be considered the applicant must send an application to both the Faculty (the clinical associate professorship (research)) and to the hospital (the clinical position) cf. the simultaneously advertised clinical position. This also applies to applicants who are already employed at the Hospital. Applicants should only apply for a clinical position at one of the hospitals. The advertisement for the clinical position is available from 

  Sundhedsjobs.dk - Clinical position as staff specialist combined with a clinical associate professorship (research) in Paediatrics- Børn og Unge, Sjællands Universitetshospital

  Information on the Department of Clinical Medicine, University of Copenhagen can be found at: Institut for Klinisk Medicin – Københavns Universitet

  Job description

  The clinical associate professors’ (research) duties will primarily consist of:

   	
• Research - Conduct and lead research on the development, treatment, and outcomes of diabetes in children and adolescents. The research is anchored in the Clinical Research Unit, Department of Paediatric and Adolescent Medicine, and carried out in collaboration with departments at Zealand University Hospital, other hospitals, and regional and national research partners. Responsibilities include dissemination of research findings through peer-reviewed publications, presentations, and other academic activities. 	
• Research-based teaching – Deliver pregraduate teaching and examinations as part of the Clinical Course in Paediatrics for medical students, including lectures and student-centred learning activities such as tutorials. Supervise bachelor’s, master’s, and PhD students, and contribute to teaching within the mandatory Research Training Programme for Doctors in Specialist Training. 	
• Research leadership - Co-leadership of the Clinical Research Unit in the Department of Paediatric and Adolescent Medicine. Conduct independent research and development activities, and provide academic leadership, mentorship, and supervision for early-career researchers. 	
• Obligation to share knowledge with the rest of society – Contribute to the dissemination of scientific knowledge to healthcare professionals, patients, policymakers, and the wider public. 	
• Academic assessments – Participation in academic assessment and evaluation activities as a member of the assessor group within the Department of Clinical Medicine.   The division between the different tasks may vary over the 5-year period of employment. Teaching obligations are equivalent to a previous external clinical associate professorship rate B.

  Any current employment as clinical associate professor (rate A, B or rate C) will expire if the applicant is employed as a clinical associate professor (research).

  Required qualifications 

  The qualification requirement for the clinical associate professor (research) is a master’s degree in medicine, specialist status as well as further teaching and research qualifications, for example PhD or doctorate and subsequently documented scientific production on an international level. In addition, there will be an emphasis on experience with scientific guidance, research administration and international research collaboration.

  The clinical associate professors (research) are also required to possess good interpersonal and communicative skills.

  Terms of employment

  A clinical associate professor (research) is paid in accordance with Aftale om kliniske lektorer af 11. februar 2024 mellem Uddannelses- og Forskningsministeriet, Foreningen af Speciallæger og Yngre Læger, Cirkulære om aftale om kliniske lektorer ved universiteter under Uddannelses- og Forskningsministeriet

  Salary and other terms and conditions of appointment are set in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and Akademikerne (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant professional organisations. The position is covered by the current Ministerial Order on the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

  Questions

  For further information please contact Deputy Head of Department of Clinical Medicine, Professor Lone Baandrup, lone.baandrup@regionh.dk 

  Foreign applicants may find this link useful: For international researchers at the University of Copenhagen – University of Copenhagen

  Application

  The application must be submitted in English and must include the following:

   	
• Application (Including motivations for applying for this position (Maximum 2 pages)) 	
• Curriculum vitae (Including information about external funding) 	
• A complete list of publications 	
• List of 5 publications to be considered in the assessment (Please note that we do not you to upload a copy of the 5 publications) 	
• Diplomas (Master’s and PhD and other relevant certificates) 	
• Self-declaration form (https://ikm.ku.dk/ansat/ansaettelser/dokumenter/self-declaration-form-klf.docx) 	
• Teaching portfolio (https://ikm.ku.dk/ansat/ansaettelser/dokumenter/template-teaching-portfolio.docx (English) or https://ikm.ku.dk/ansat/ansaettelser/dokumenter/skabelon-undervisningsportfolio.doc (Danish)) 	
• Research plan (3‐5 pages) 	
• Teaching plan   Application procedure 

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Appointments Committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment. The head of department  appoints an expert assessment committee in order to make an assessment of the selected applicants for the specific post. Selected applicants are notified of the composition of the committee and each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at jobportal.ku.dk.

  Please note that the applicant will be contacted if the assessment committee requires further documentation.

  The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

  The University of Copenhagen encourages all interested applicants to apply for this position.

  Please submit the application with the required attachments. Only online applications will be accepted. The closing date for applications is 23.59pm, Monday 30 November 2026.

  Interviews for this position will most likely be held in the month of March 2027.

Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for an Incident Manager to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists in our Incident Response domain.

About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company

Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.

Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.

Today, we employ around 440 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for an Incident Manager who wants to make a difference in our CSIRT.

CSIRT (Cybersecurity Incident Response Team)

Our Cybersecurity Incident Response Team (CSIRT) manages most of the large cybersecurity incidents in the Nordics. The team consists of dedicated experts in forensics, advanced infrastructure, and incident management, and works tirelessly to solve the most challenging technical situations. Together, we have rescued countless global organizations from cyber attacks and helped them get back to business with minimal impact.

The Role

As a Cyber Incident Manager, you are responsible for coordinating incident engagements from initial response through containment, forensic investigation, recovery, and post-incident activities.

You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams consisting of forensic investigators, recovery specialists, infrastructure experts, legal advisors, and customer stakeholders. At the same time, you will act as a trusted advisor to customer representatives throughout the incident lifecycle.

Your focus will be on driving progress, aligning priorities, coordinating stakeholders, and ensuring that response and recovery activities move forward efficiently. You will gradually be taking on increasing responsibility as you develop your leadership, stakeholder management, customer advisory, and crisis coordination capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and coordinate cybersecurity incident response engagements.

• Act as a primary point of contact for customers and stakeholders during incidents.

• Coordinate cross-functional teams consisting of technical and business specialists.

• Drive recovery efforts to minimize business disruption and downtime.

• Provide guidance and recommendations throughout the incident lifecycle.

• Support customers in strengthening resilience and preparedness after incidents.

• Contribute to the continuous development of Truesec incident response capabilities and methodologies.

Your Potential Background

We believe you have a background in cyber security, IT operations, managed services, consulting, technical account management, service delivery, project coordination, or a similar field.

You enjoy collaborating with both technical specialists and business stakeholders, bringing structure to challenging situations and helping teams to prioritize the work toward a common goal.

Required Skills

• Understanding how modern IT environments and services are operated and supported.

• Experience leading major incidents, service disruptions, or crisis situations.

• Experience advising senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

• Ability to build trusted relationships with technical specialists and business stakeholders.

• Strong problem-solving skills and a pragmatic mindset.

• Professional proficiency in English and Danish, both written and spoken.

Meritorious Experience

• Experience within cybersecurity incident response, digital forensics, SOC operations, or managed security services.

• Understanding of compliance, regulatory, legal, and information protection requirements.

• Background in consulting or customer-facing advisory roles.

• Experience with cloud security and hybrid IT environments.

• Knowledge of cyber risk management, business continuity, and resilience.

Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Danish citizenship or citizenship in another EU country. Language skills in English and Danish is required.

Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future

If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you'll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company - and learn from some of the best in their field.

So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

Product Security Engineer

**Enhance the Security of Future Endoscopy Solutions

**Are you passionate about cybersecurity and interested in protecting innovative medical technologies that help clinicians improve patient care?

We are looking for a Product Security Engineer to help build cybersecurity into the next generation of endoscopy systems and connected healthcare solutions.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing cybersecurity function and contribute directly to the security of products used by healthcare professionals worldwide.

In this role you will work closely with software, electronics, systems, quality, regulatory, and product development teams to ensure cybersecurity is integrated throughout the product lifecycle. You will have the opportunity to influence technical decisions, improve security practices, and make a tangible impact on both product security and patient safety.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of in-person collaboration and focused individual work. That's why this role is based in Augsburg or Ballerup and follows a hybrid working model, with three days per week in the office and two days working from home.

**Key Responsibilities

**As a Product Security Engineer, you will drive cybersecurity activities throughout the development and maintenance of advanced endoscopic visualization platforms.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Drive cybersecurity risk management activities for medical devices throughout the product lifecycle.

• Lead and facilitate threat modelling workshops, security assessments, and architecture reviews.

• Define, document, and maintain cybersecurity requirements for product development projects.

• Own vulnerability monitoring, assessment, prioritization, and remediation coordination across development teams.

• Manage Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) generation, analysis, maintenance, and governance activities.

• Investigate and drive resolution of cybersecurity issues identified during development, verification, and post-market surveillance.

• Identify opportunities to strengthen product security posture and proactively initiate improvement activities.

**Suggested candidate profile

• An educational background within Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

• Strong interest in product cybersecurity and secure product development.

• Experience working in a regulated industry is a great advantage; but medical device experience is not required.

• Hands-on experience with design control, requirements management, risk management, and traceability.

• Knowledge of compliance with global cybersecurity regulations and standards.

• Good understanding of networking fundamentals, operating systems (Linux), secure software development practices, and fundamental cybersecurity concepts.

• Experience with system integration and complex hardware/software/software interactions.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to balance technical depth with product-level decision-making.

• The ability to work independently, structure complex work, and proactively drive progress across many stakeholders.

• Comfortable navigating complex technical challenges and coordinating across multiple stakeholders.

• Excellent collaboration and communication skills in a global, cross-functional environment.

• Demonstrated ability to work independently, take ownership of deliverables, and drive activities to completion.

**This is more than a product security role

**You will help secure technologies that clinicians rely on every day to visualize, diagnose, and treat patients. Working within the Product Security Team, you will contribute to the development of products where cybersecurity directly supports patient safety, product reliability, and regulatory compliance. You will join a collaborative environment that values learning, innovation, and continuous improvement while helping establish cybersecurity as a key capability across the organization.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

The role

As our Revenue Operations Manager, you'll own the processes and data behind our sales organization: the sales process, definitions, forecasting and commissions.

This is an individual contributor role in our Revenue Operations team, reporting to the Global Director, Revenue Operations & Information Security. You'll be supported by the RevOps team and work closely with sales leadership and Finance. We're looking for around 5+ years of hands-on experience in VC or PE-backed companies.

What you'll do

Forecasting

• Define shared sales terms and metrics such as pipeline, stage probabilities, bookings, and new versus expansion business.

• Establish a forecasting baseline: forecast categories, submission rules and a first method for new business and expansion.

• Track forecast accuracy and refine the method as data quality improves.

• Build pipeline and forecast reports and dashboards in Salesforce.

• Set up a pipeline and forecast review cadence with sales leadership once the definitions are in place.

Sales process

• Own the sales process from qualified opportunity to closed deal, including stages, exit criteria and the hand-over to delivery and Finance.

• Set up territories, account ownership and rules for partner and cross-sell deals.

Commissions

• Help automate the commission process with the right tooling, from data capture to calculation and payout.

• Work with Finance and sales leadership on plan design and changes.

Sales systems

• Shape how Salesforce (including Revenue Cloud/CPQ) supports the sales process, and make hands-on changes where needed.

• Keep sales data clean with required fields, validation rules and deduplication.

• Automate manual steps in the sales process with workflows and AI.

• Work with CRM vendors and implementation partners, including evaluations, renewals, support and new functionality.

• Train and support sales reps on system and process changes.

Stack harmonization

• Bring each acquired sales team, starting with WoodWing, onto our shared sales process, pipeline stages, definitions and reporting.

• Move acquired sales reps onto group commission plans.

• Set account ownership and cross-sell rules between entities, and resolve duplicate accounts.

• Experience designing and rolling out sales processes

• Experience administering sales commissions

• Good understanding of sales metrics such as pipeline coverage, win rates, sales cycle and bookings

• Strong analytical skills in Excel or Google Sheets

Nice to have

• HubSpot experience, including migrating from HubSpot to Salesforce

• Salesforce Revenue Cloud or CPQ experience

• Experience implementing commission software

• Using AI in sales workflows

Soft skills

• End-to-end impact – work from sensor input and model development through to information presented to the user

• Industrial ML – turn novel ML technology into robust, efficient products for internal and customer use

• Develop machine-learning and data-science solutions for target detection in sonar acoustic data and imaging systems

• Identify structures and patterns in data from hydrophones

• Develop ML models and contribute to the ML infrastructure used in the software products

• Be an active member of a development team spanning software, mathematical modelling and dedicated embedded-processing hardware

• Propose improvements to ML models and infrastructure

• Help bring novel ML technologies into robust, industrialized products

• Keep current with relevant technologies and tools

• Interested in new technologies, industry challenges and in the products, use cases, customers and the marine domain
