• We always remember to have fun along the way, both in our day-to-day work and at our regular team events on site in our offices in Munich, Copenhagen, Odense, Lisbon and Prague, Buenos Aires and New York

Some of our benefits

ABOUT US

We are driven by our values #BeBrave, #BetterTogether, #LeadbyExample, #InnovateWithPurpose, #PassionForPrivacy, #GiveBack and #ComeAsYouAre. They show what we believe in and how we work. They help make our team special and guide us in everything we do. They're the heart of our company and inspire us to do our best every day.

We believe that our different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives are our greatest strengths — so we are committed to building with them as we foster innovation and drive our success.

We recognize that this is an ongoing journey. We commit to listening and to continuous learning, growth, and improvement. By embracing DEI principles, we will create a more just and equitable society, and we are proud to play our part in making this vision a reality.

We are #BetterTogether.

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

Head of HR Nordics

Milexia Nordics A/S

Do you want take responsibility for HR across Milexia Nordics’ international organisation and act as a trusted sparring partner to the Managing Director and the wider management team?

As Head of HR Nordics, you will set up the HR department for Milexia Nordics, define and implement suitable processes and structures to support the business. Your role includes responsibility for ensuring operational and legal compliance for the legal entities across the organisation. You confidently develop and mature HR processes, structures, and policies, and ensure strong alignment between local requirements and company-wide standards in Milexia Nordics.

A key part of the role is to be a close sparring partner to the Managing Director and the wider management team. This entails acting as a strategic, commercially minded sparring partner who offers support on recruitment processes, legal cases, as well as development of leadership capabilities and talent. The objective is to be perceived as a trusted, competent, and proactive problem-solver and business partner on all local HR matters, someone who can challenge their colleagues where appropriate, always in a respectful manner.

Tasks and responsibilities within the role will include, but not be limited to:

HR Operations, Processes and Compliance

• Take overall responsibility for HR across the international organisation – and translate business strategy to high-impact HR initiatives.

• Ensure that core HR processes operate efficiently and professionally across all locations.

• Oversee HR-related processes involving payroll, pensions, benefits, holidays, absence and employment conditions, working with the relevant internal and external providers.

• Maintain appropriate HR policies, documentation, GDPR compliance and confidential handling of employee data.

• Identify opportunities to improve and streamline HR processes, systems and ways of working.

• Provide relevant HR reporting and management information to support informed decisions on people, costs and organisational development.

Strategic HR- and Management Support

• Act as a trusted and qualified sparring partner to the Managing Director and the wider management team.

• Advice on organisational structure, recruitment, workforce planning, employee development, performance management and retention.

• Challenge management constructively and provide independent, well-founded HR advice when needed.

• Handle complex employee relations matters, conflicts, dismissals and other sensitive situations with professionalism and sound judgement.

• Contribute actively to building an organisation that supports business objectives and continued growth.

• Define and drive employer branding activities in collaboration with marketing and management team.

Recruitment, Talent and Development

• Support managers in recruiting the right people for Milexia Nordics’ international organisation.

• Develop professional approaches to onboarding, employee development, succession planning and talent retention.

• Help managers attract, develop and retain skilled and motivated employees.

• Establish a structured approach to performance reviews, employee objectives and ongoing development.

• Identify skills gaps and future organisational needs as the business evolves.

International HR and Employment Law

• Ensure that employment contracts, employee policies, HR processes and practices are handled professionally and in accordance with applicable local legislation.

• Have a strong understanding of European employment law and the key differences between the countries in which Milexia Nordics operate.

• Work with local legal advisers and external specialists whenever specific local expertise is required.

• Establish consistent HR standards across the organisation while respecting local legislation, cultures and working practices.

Commercially minded HR lead with broad HR experience in an international context

You have strong experience from a similar role in an international, small- or medium-sized commercial organisation, and in combining operational HR responsibilities with strategic business partnering and management support. Ideally, you have been instrumental in setting up an HR function before and enjoy a diverse workday with operational as well as strategic tasks and are able to balance and prioritise both soft and hard HR tasks. As a person you are outgoing, enjoy being the sparring partner for the management team and thrive with organisational development where you ensure that top talents are identified and nourished.

The opportunity

Founded in 2016, Mover is a Danish logistics technology company on a mission to change logistics for good, reducing waste and making people’s lives better.

Are you passionate about building great software products? Do you obsess over your customers? Are you interested in working with the latest state-of-the-art AI-driven development practices in order to invent and simplify? Would you like to have an outsized impact in a small Copenhagen B2B SaaS company, and make your mark on the Nordics last-mile logistics market? If so, Mover might be the right place for you.

We are currently brewing up new product ideas, and in need of strong product managers. We are looking for someone willing to take ownership of specific commercial goals and realize them with a great product. This is not a role for someone who wants to manage a backlog. We need a product leader who enjoys spending time with customers, challenging assumptions, making difficult prioritization decisions, and working closely with engineering and leadership to shape the future of our last-mile platform.

If that’s something for you, then please read on!

Role overview and responsibilities

As a Product Manager you will:

• Turn strategy into reality: Launch a new B2B SaaS product in the first 12 months.

• Take ownership and deliver results on revenue, gross profit and related commercial goals for your product.

• Lead a small product team in a matrix-style org structure (not a people manager, but a team leader).

• Use AI to its full potential - in the product development process, and in the product itself.

• Perform market research and help drive our continuous discovery process.

• Talk to customers. A lot. Both existing and prospects.

• Build long-term relationships with senior stakeholders and customers.

• Take a primarily data-driven approach to product development and product operations.

• Have a real, measurable impact on the daily lives of thousands of drivers across Europe.

Your mindset

• You are driven by purpose and want to contribute to our mission of changing logistics for good.

• You are driven, tenacious, and can work independently. You think big and insist on the highest standards. You have a bias for action and accomplish more with less. You listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have strong opinions and no issue voicing them. However, once a decision has been made, you commit wholly to the path forward.

• You can sell a vision to customers.

• What success looks like (12 months)

• You have successfully launched a new product.

About you

• We imagine you have 5+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, but we are also interested in equivalent qualifications from marketing, sales or other commercial functions, with relevant project management experience and customer obsession.

• Preferably experience in launching (not just operating) a new B2B SaaS product.

• The ability and curiosity to quickly learn a complex domain (last-mile logistics).

• The ability to navigate ambiguity and create clarity.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Danish and English.

• Experience working with cross-functional product teams.

• Understanding of software life-cycle processes: How software is built, maintained and scaled.

What we offer

• A high degree of responsibility from day one, working alongside experienced colleagues.

• A steep learning curve in a fast-moving technology company.

• Autonomy, trust, and support to do the best work of your career.

• An open, collaborative environment with talented peers across multiple functions.

• Aaaand, a great lunch, modern offices and a cool location at Islands Brygge in the center of Copenhagen…

Mover’s values

We move fast. We expect people to own problems end-to-end, not wait to be told what to do. You know best, so you need to bring a lot of creativity. We obsess over the people who use our software, from logistics planners to drivers, and we would rather ship a small improvement this week than a perfect one next year. We are direct and honest with each other, including about our own mistakes, and we hold a high bar for quality.

• 
Lead with integrity. We believe that integrity is a reciprocal value. It means treating others as we wish to be treated. With respect, honesty, and sound ethics

• 
Be accountable. We embrace freedom in decision-making, initiative, and actions while accepting full responsibility for outcomes and results

• 
Push boundaries. We challenge norms, innovate, and move fast to drive changes to continuously improve things for everyone affected by our products and services

• 
Play, as a team. We are serious without taking ourselves too seriously, and balance having fun with achieving great things, together

Interested? We would love to hear from you.

What we offer you

jobs.description:
Are you approaching the end of your studies and looking for a graduation project early 2027. Does deep dive into the protection of the primary equipment enabling transport of wind energy to shore excite you? Then we have the project for you.

The projects

Protection study

Today we apply state of the art, cutting edge protections of the primary equipment, 220/66kV transformers, shunt reactors, subsea cables etc. Functions like line differential protection, restricted earth fault protection, distance protection with fiber optic accelerations schemes and different mechanical protections.

But how well do the different protections cover the primary equipment?

Are all protections feasible, considering how often we statistically experience faults?

Grounding

Today the MV grid, connecting the wind turbines to the Offshore Sub Station is impedance grounded. This creates different problems and side effects that needs to be considered during engineering. Some primary equipment becomes expensive and hard to procure. Protection against earth faults becomes challenging because of the reduced fault current.

Investigate the benefits and disadvantages of isolated, impedance and effectively grounded MV grid.

How will the protections need to be set up?

What will the implications be on primary equipment, transformers, cables, wind turbines etc.

Your Profile & Qualifications

We image that you are studying to become an Electrical Engineer. As a person you are ambitious and result oriented. You have an analytical mindset and strive to find solutions for complex problems and at the same time you enjoy collaborating within a team. Furthermore, you have a strong interest in learning and taking on challenges.

To succeed in this position, we expect that you have the following qualifications:

• Interest in electrical systems.

• Focus on digitalization and innovation.

• Can communicate in English, both written and verbal.

• Flexible, committed, loyal and dedicated.

• Great communication skills.

Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.

Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.

We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis, so if you are interested, you must submit your application as soon as possible.

If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact Søren Borre Kreipke, Manager, HV Protection & Secondary at SOBK@semcomaritime.com

Flatpay is looking for an experienced Product Manager to join our Financial Services team. In this role, you'll help develop our customer-facing banking product, including the app that supports small and medium-sized businesses in their day-to-day financial activities. Hands-on product management experience with customer-facing apps is essential for this role.

You will work closely with engineers, designers, operations, commercial teams, and external partners to turn customer needs, business priorities, and technical requirements into clear product improvements. The role suits someone with product experience from a banking environment who can combine customer understanding, app expertise, and technical fluency.

**What You Will Work On

**

• Develop and continuously improve Flatpay’s banking product and customer-facing app for SMEs.

• Turn customer feedback, product and user data, and business needs into well-defined product improvements.

• Work closely with other product managers, designers, and engineers throughout product discovery, definition, delivery, launch, and iteration.

• Translate customer, business, operational, technical, and relevant regulatory requirements into clear product priorities.

**Who You Are

**You're proactive, structured, and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment. You take a hands-on approach and are willing to step into the details when needed. You can work independently, take ownership of your responsibilities, and move initiatives forward while keeping relevant colleagues informed and aligned.

You enjoy working closely with engineers, designers, and commercial teams, and you can turn complex requirements into practical product improvements. You combine customer focus with clear communication across different functions, and use evidence to make informed decisions.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager, Product Owner, or in a similar role.

• Demonstrated product management experience launching, improving, and scaling customer-facing apps.

• Strong technical fluency and the ability to work effectively with engineers on APIs, data flows, integrations, and technical trade-offs related to app development.

**Why Flatpay?

**Making life easier for SMEs is at the core of Flatpay’s work. As we continue to grow, our financial services help small and medium-sized businesses manage their finances and run their businesses more effectively. You'll help shape a banking product that is an important part of that experience.

Flatpay has more than 2,500 employees across seven markets. We value work-life balance, creativity, and collaboration, and you will join a supportive product environment with room to take initiative, learn, and improve how we serve our customers. Our Herlev office also offers an in-office gym, a fully equipped gamer room, free slush ice, and other ways to enjoy life at the office.

Reporting to the Product Director, you'll contribute to a banking product that supports Flatpay’s continued growth in financial services. This position is based in our Herlev office.

**If this sounds like the right next step for you, we would love to hear from you!

**Established in 2022 in Copenhagen with a commitment to transparency, we've streamlined card payments to small and medium-sized businesses. Our innovative pricing model eliminates hidden costs and fees, offering a simple flat rate for all cards with no monthly subscription for our point-of-sale and payment solutions.

Operating in Denmark, Finland, Germany, Italy, France, the United Kingdom, and the Netherlands, we're more than just a service provider; we are your trusted business partner.

We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our clients' evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary?

At Acodyne, you will help develop the software, high-power electronics, and robotic systems that bring our next generation of high-speed, heavy-lift cargo UAS to life, moving between code, schematics, the lab bench, and real flight hardware.

Your Role

You Will Work Closely With Our CTO And Engineering Team On The Electrical And Software Systems That Power And Control Our Aircraft. From Firmware To High-power Distribution, This Is As Real As Engineering Gets. You Will

• 
Develop and test embedded software and firmware for flight-critical and ground systems (C/C++, Python)

• 
Design, build, and test high-power electronics such as power distribution, battery systems, and motor drives

• 
Integrate sensors, actuators, and robotic/autonomous subsystems into the aircraft and ground equipment

• 
Develop tools for test automation, data logging, and analysis

• 
Bring up, debug, and validate hardware on the bench and during flight tests

• 
Document designs, code, and test results for certification purposes

**About You

**You enjoy writing code as much as holding an oscilloscope probe or a soldering iron. You're the type who builds things outside class and wants to take that to the next level. You likely:

• 
Are currently pursuing a degree in electrical engineering, software/computer engineering, robotics, mechatronics, or similar

• 
Have programming experience in C/C++ and/or Python

• 
Have a solid understanding of electronics and circuit design

• 
Enjoy hands-on lab work, prototyping, and debugging real hardware

• 
Are curious about UAVs, robotics, or high-performance systems

• 
Are proactive, independent, and eager to learn fast

**Nice To Have

**

• 
Experience with power electronics, high-voltage systems, motor control, or battery management systems (BMS)

• 
Experience with embedded platforms (STM32, ARM, etc.), RTOS, or communication buses (CAN, UART, SPI, I²C)

• 
Exposure to ROS, PX4/ArduPilot, or control and autonomy algorithms

• 
PCB design experience (KiCad, Altium, etc.)

**About Acodyne

**We are a UAS company developing heavy-lift, high-speed eVTOL UAS for defence and industrial logistics. We are currently 18 people, based at our workshop at Avedøre Airfield, and plan to double our team in the next year.

**About The Internship

**

• 
Duration: Full-time for 5–6 months, with start in January/February 2027.

• 
Time off: 2.08 vacation days per month + Danish public holidays.

• 
Location: Avedøre Flyveplads, workshop-based, approximately 45 minutes by public transport from Copenhagen city center.

• 
Compensation: DKK 6,000-8,000 per month before tax. Please note this is a contribution to living and transport. It will likely not cover full living costs. Interns are expected to supplement with grants or other funding.

• 
Visa: Acodyne is unfortunately not able to help obtain a work visa. It is expected that the candidate has a legal right to work in Denmark.

• 
Please note: The internship opportunity is intended for currently enrolled students who wish to gain relevant work experience as part of their studies. We particularly encourage applications from students who are able to use the internship as an integrated part of their degree programme, for example through ECTS credits, a project-based internship, or another formal study-related arrangement.

The Fabrication Support team at DTU Nanolab is seeking one to two Process generalist for permanent positions. 

As a Process Generalist in the Fabrication Support team, you will be working in a highly advanced cleanroom environment. In this role, you will support and advise students and researchers at DTU and external users on fabrication processes, as well as train users in the operation of state-of-the-art semiconductor processing equipment. You will also collaborate closely with industrial partners to realize their devices, designing and executing complete fabrication processes to meet customer requirements.

The job
A significant part of your working day will be spent in the DTU Nanolab cleanroom. We are looking for a person who already has substantial experience in advanced micro-fabrication in a cleanroom environment You should enjoy helping and teaching students and other facility users to operate advanced tools. You have great attention to detail and a structured approach to developing and fine-tuning fabrication processes.

Our expectations of you
We expect you to hold a Master's degree or PhD in Physics, Micro/Nanotechnology, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline with at least 3 years’ experience in semiconductor fabrication. We also expect that you are already skilled in essential nano- and microfabrication techniques such as

• UV lithography
• Thin film deposition
• Deep reactive ion etching
• Scanning electron microscopy
We also expect that you

• Can work independently on given tasks
• Will systematically document process development results
• Enjoy working on projects alone, but also in cooperation with other team members
• Are fluent in English
At DTU Nanolab, safety is a core value. We are therefore seeking candidates who are comfortable working in a highly safety-focused environment and who can meet the following physical and mental requirements:

• Comfortable wearing specialized personal protective equipment (PPE) when required.
• Able to respond promptly and appropriately in emergency situations, including evacuations.
• Capable of performing duties that involve extended periods of standing and movement.
• Confident working with potentially hazardous chemicals and gases while following established safety protocols and procedures.
What we offer in return
We offer an interesting and challenging job in an international environment. A job where you will work with state-of-the-art semiconductor fabrication equipment. The Technical University of Denmark is a leading university in Northen Europe, and our facility is among the largest and most advanced fair access facilities in Europe. Please notice that this is not a research position, it is a technical position with emphasis on user assistance and customer fabrication orders.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement for academic employees with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The position is a full-time position. Starting date is 1 January 2026 (or according to mutual agreement).

The workplace is DTU Lyngby Campus.

Application and contact
Please submit your online application no later than 15 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates. 

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Head of Fabrication Support, Maria Matschuk on 4525 5723 or mmat@dtu.dk.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Nanolab is the National Center for Nanofabrication and Characterization in Denmark and an open-access research infrastructure at the Technical University of Denmark (DTU). As one of Europe’s largest fair-access micro- and nanofabrication centers, it offers a large cleanroom and advanced electron microscopy facilities. DTU Nanolab supports cutting-edge research and small-scale production within MEMS/NEMS, photonics, and quantum technologies, covering nano- and microfabrication as well as advanced analysis of hard and soft matter. Since 2018, DTU Nanolab extended to provide expertise in soft matter from small molecule complexes to biological cells.

Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. Building keeps getting cheaper every quarter. What used to take a senior engineer a few weeks now takes an afternoon. The work that does not get cheaper is helping a real business absorb new technology, sequencing the rollout, and knowing when to slow down because something is starting to break under load.

At Heyra, we build operational AI: systems, workflows, and data platforms that live in production from day one. We work with companies that are moving quickly and need solutions that improve the way they operate.

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer. Someone who goes into a client, understands the operation, spots where the real optimisation potential sits, and pushes it all the way through to execution with a strong engineering team behind them.

The role sits between engineering and consulting without fitting cleanly into either. You need to be technical enough to understand data and AI at a deep level. Commercial enough to spot where the business value sits. Patient enough to sit with a manager who is genuinely worried about the tool you just put in front of them. And stubborn enough to stay around once the launch excitement fades and the real adoption work begins.

Most people are strong in one of those. Some in two. Almost nobody walks in with all four. That is exactly the profile we are looking for.

What you will work on

You will embed directly with clients to understand the operation and where the real value sits. You will drive adoption by sequencing rollouts, working with the people who have to use the tool, and staying through the unglamorous part. You will translate business needs into AI solutions that actually ship. And you will learn when to push, when to slow down, and when something is starting to break under load.

You work closely with engineers, data specialists, strategists, and designers in a company where the distance from thinking to building is intentionally small.

**Requirements

**Experience with management consulting, change management, or adoption of AI solutions in production. An understanding of software development, ML or data engineering. Coding with agents like Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. Working directly with clients and stakeholders. Owning delivery end to end, from a vague problem to a live, adopted solution.

Curiosity, taste and a builder mentality matter just as much to us as specific tools or years of experience.

Why Heyra

We believe consulting needs to be rewritten. We are building a consultancy designed for the agentic era. We design, build and operate AI products that change how enterprises work, from problem to prototype to production.

Heyra brings together people from engineering, strategy, product, startup and creative environments. We keep teams small, collaboration close and momentum high. We care deeply about craft, speed and building things that work in the real world.

People here care about what they build. Good ideas move quickly. New technology gets explored early. There is room to shape both the company and the way we work.

We are around 45 people today, and we are only just getting started.

If this sounds like your kind of work, send us a short note about yourself together with your CV. We care much more about curiosity, energy and the way you think than polished applications.

**Benefits

**

• Healthcare insurance

• Pension plan

• Parental leave

• Social gatherings

• New tech gear

• Central office

• Free lunch, coffee, snacks, and Friday beers

• Skill development

• Paid holiday

• Remote work allowed

• Pet friendly

Would you like to set the technical direction for Denmark's national, digitally sovereign supercomputing and cloud platform? DTU Computerome is looking for a Chief Technology Officer to lead the architecture, engineering and long-term technology strategy of a platform used by researchers, public institutions and industry across Denmark. 

About DTU Computerome 
DTU Computerome is a national High-Performance Computing (HPC) and secure cloud platform designed to support sensitive data processing and the hosting of advanced applications and services. 

The platform is developed and operated as a fully digitally sovereign infrastructure. Critical research workloads, sensitive data, and digital services for the public sector and Danish industry are hosted within a trusted, nationally controlled environment. 

Computerome functions as a general infrastructure and service provider, offering: 

• High-performance computing resources for complex workloads 
• Secure environments for processing sensitive and regulated data 
• Infrastructure for hosting research platforms, digital services and scientific applications 
• Flexible environments for innovation, experimentation and development of new digital solutions 
Users include research groups from all Danish universities, international research collaborations, public authorities and industry partners. Many rely on Computerome as a stable platform for long-running services, data platforms and research applications. 

The infrastructure includes a large-scale Linux-based HPC cluster, a 50 PB high-performance storage system, a custom-built secure cloud environment, and platforms for containerized applications, research services and data workflows. Computerome is physically located at DTU Risø, while the operations and development team is based at DTU Lyngby. 

The Job 
As CTO, you will own Computerome's technology strategy and platform architecture, and lead the engineering and DevOps organisation that operates and develops it. You will be part of Computerome's management team and work closely with the Director and COO on strategy, investments and partnerships. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

• Defining and owning the technology strategy and multi-year roadmap for the HPC, storage, network and cloud platform 
• Leading, developing and recruiting the DevOps and platform engineering teams, including the five new DevOps engineers currently being hired 
• Owning the overall platform architecture and making key design decisions across compute, storage, networking and cloud 
• Ensuring stable, secure and scalable operation, including incident management, on-call structure and service levels 
• Driving automation, Infrastructure-as-Code and modern DevOps practices across the organisation 
• Leading technical evaluation, requirement specification and vendor selection in procurements and tenders 
• Planning capacity, lifecycle and hardware refresh, and owning the technical side of investment cases and budgets 
• Representing Computerome technically towards users, partners, authorities and national and European infrastructure initiatives 
Strategic Focus Areas 
Computerome is growing from a research HPC facility into a broader national provider of sovereign compute, data and cloud services. As CTO you will shape how the platform meets that ambition. Key areas include: 

• Digital sovereignty: Designing an architecture built on open, European-controllable technologies that reduces dependence on non-European hyperscalers, and ensuring data portability and national control over critical workloads 
• AI and GPU infrastructure: Expanding capacity and services for AI, large-scale analytics and GPU-intensive research 
• Secure and regulated environments: Strengthening platforms for sensitive personal and health data, in line with GDPR, NIS2, ISO and relevant security standards 
• Cloud and platform services: Evolving the secure cloud, container and Kubernetes offerings so that public institutions and industry can host long-running services and products 
• Scalability and new capacity: Contributing technically to new datacenter capacity, energy efficiency and long-term infrastructure planning 
• Operational excellence: Building monitoring, observability, service management and processes that match the expectations of critical national infrastructure 
Your Profile 
We are looking for an experienced technology leader who combines deep infrastructure expertise with strategic overview and the ability to build strong teams. 

Required qualifications 

• A master's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience 
• At least 10 years of experience with large-scale IT infrastructure, of which several years in a technical leadership role 
• Proven experience leading engineering, DevOps or operations teams, including people management and recruitment 
• Deep knowledge of Linux-based infrastructure, virtualization and cloud platforms (e.g. OpenStack, Kubernetes) 
• Solid understanding of storage, networking and IT security architecture 
• Experience with automation, Infrastructure-as-Code and modern DevOps practices 
• Experience with technical procurement, vendor management and budget responsibility 
• Ability to translate technology into strategy and communicate clearly with management, users and partners 
• Fluency in English; Danish is an advantage 
It is an advantage if you also have experience with 

• HPC environments, job scheduling and parallel file systems (e.g. IBM Storage Scale) 
• AI workloads and GPU infrastructure at scale 
• Sensitive data environments and compliance (GDPR, NIS2, ISO 27001) 
• Public sector procurement, EU tenders or research infrastructure 
• European cloud and sovereignty initiatives 
• Datacenter design, power and cooling 
What We Offer 
We offer a key leadership role with real influence on how a national, digitally sovereign computing platform evolves. You will lead skilled colleagues in an international research environment where advanced infrastructure directly enables scientific discovery and digital innovation. 

At DTU we emphasize: 

• A high level of technical professionalism 
• Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development 
• The possibility to shape national digital infrastructure 
• A collaborative environment with highly skilled colleagues 
Salary and Appointment Terms 
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). You are employed as an Academic Officer, Senior Officer, Senior Executive Officer. In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): https://www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures 

The position is full-time and based at DTU Lyngby with regular presence at DTU Risø.

Application and Contact

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Mads Bager Hoffmann on mabho@dtu.dk

Join Pharmacosmos in a newly established role and take a leading scientific role in shaping the analytical development capabilities.

**Lead complex Analytical Development across a growing development pipeline

**As Principal Analytical Development Chemist at Pharmacosmos, you will serve as the Analytical Lead across CMC development programs, driving analytical development, characterization, control strategies, and regulatory readiness from early-stage development through commercialization to lifecycle activities.

In this high impact role, you will be responsible for driving analytical development and ensuring that robust analytical methods, specifications, stability strategies, and control frameworks are established to support successful product development, regulatory submissions, and commercial manufacturing. You will apply your scientific expertise to complex analytical challenges, including product characterization, impurity profiling, method development, method qualification, validation strategy, comparability assessments, and technical investigations, helping to de-risk development programs and accelerate progress.

Working closely with Drug Substance Leads, Drug Product Leads, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Quality Control, and external development partners, you will provide strategic guidance and scientific leadership across the organization. You will oversee analytical activities performed both internally and through CROs, CDMOs, and specialist laboratories, ensuring high-quality execution, sound scientific decision-making, and timely delivery of project objectives.

Beyond supporting individual projects, you will contribute to strengthening Pharmacosmos' analytical capabilities by advancing laboratory technologies, scientific best practices, and knowledge sharing across teams. As a trusted technical expert, you will mentor colleagues, influence key decisions, and help build a culture of scientific excellence, continuous improvement, and cross-functional collaboration.

**Highly skilled Analytical Development Chemist with strong project management capabilities

**We are seeking a highly qualified candidate with an MSc or PhD in Analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, or a related scientific discipline. You bring extensive experience from the pharmaceutical industry, typically gained over 10 years or more, and possess a strong track record within analytical development ideally across both drug substance and drug product development. You have in-depth experience with analytical characterization, method development, qualification, and transfer, as well as specification setting, stability programs, impurity characterization, and analytical control strategies. Experience working with CROs, CDMOs, external laboratories, and cross-functional CMC teams is essential, together with a solid understanding of regulatory requirements and CMC documentation. You are an established scientific leader who can independently drive complex analytical activities and influence decision-making through technical expertise and sound scientific judgment.

You are a scientifically driven and highly analytical professional who thrives in a dynamic and collaborative environment. You combine deep technical expertise with a pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset and are motivated by solving complex challenges and advancing pharmaceutical development programs. You work independently, take ownership of your responsibilities, and communicate complex scientific topics with clarity and credibility. Through strong collaboration and stakeholder engagement, you create alignment across functions and external partners while maintaining focus on quality, timelines, and business objectives. You are structured, proactive, and resilient, with a strong sense of integrity and accountability, and you enjoy sharing knowledge and contributing to a culture of scientific excellence and continuous improvement. Finally, you are fluent in English, both written and verbal.

**Play a crucial role in an exciting international growth journey

**This is your chance to embark upon a personal and organizational journey in a dynamic company where your know-how is greatly needed for the future development of Pharmacosmos. The recruitment process is carried out by Venaris Executive Search. For more information regarding the position, please reach out to Sr. Executive Search Consultant, Lars Nordlund, on +45 3123 3018. All requests will be handled confidentially. If this position is for you, do not hesitate to apply by uploading your CV - it is not necessary to include a cover letter.

Pharmacosmos

Pharmacosmos A/S is a global leader in carbohydrate chemistry and innovative treatments for iron deficiency and iron deficiency anaemia. jobs.occupation: Senior Sales Manager for Renewables Service, Location: DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen, DK - Aarhus
jobs.description:
Do you have a passion for building strategic customer relationships and turning complex opportunities into long-term business success? Are you motivated by helping accelerate the energy transition through offshore wind solutions? If so, this could be your next career opportunity. 

At Semco Maritime, we are looking for an experienced Senior Sales Manager to strengthen our Renewables Service business. You will play a key role in developing strategic sales opportunities, supporting key customer relationships, and securing service contracts for offshore wind assets in selected international markets. 

Your position 

As our new Senior Sales Manager, you will have end-to-end commercial ownership of strategic sales opportunities within the Renewables Division. Working closely with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, you will lead the external commercial journey from early opportunity identification and qualification through tender management, contract negotiation, award, and handover to project execution. 

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector. 

You will be accountable for building and converting a strong pipeline of strategic opportunities into profitable contracts while developing long-term relationships with selected key customers. You will shape winning commercial strategies based on customer needs, market dynamics, and Semco’s capabilities, and ensure that commercial priorities are aligned across relevant functions.

You will contribute to defining our commercial focus for selected customers and market segments, helping ensure that we invest our efforts where Semco Maritime has the strongest position to win. Your success will be measured by your ability to build strategic customer relationships, develop high-quality pipeline and convert complex opportunities into sustainable and profitable business.

Your place of work will be at our Global HQ located in Esbjerg, our office located in Copenhagen or our future office in Aarhus. The position is full-time, and you can expect to up to 30 travel days per year. 

Your tasks & responsibilities 
As our new Senior Sales Manager, you will take ownership of strategic sales opportunities throughout the entire commercial lifecycle.

Working closely with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, you will develop winning strategies, build strong commercial relationships, and identify growth opportunities across existing and new accounts. You will play a central role in shaping account strategies, developing customer-focused value propositions, and ensuring that commercial solutions are aligned with both customer needs and operational capabilities.

In addition, you will represent Semco Maritime in customer interactions and industry forums, contribute valuable market insights, and help strengthen our commercial processes and best practices across the organisation.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to: 

• Driving strategic sales opportunities from qualification through contract award and handover.
• Developing and executing winning strategies for key tenders and commercial opportunities.
• Building and maintaining strong relationships with strategic customers and supporting key account development.
• Leading customer negotiations in collaboration with technical, operational, legal, procurement, and finance stakeholders.
• Identifying and pursuing business growth opportunities, including cross-selling, upselling, and framework agreements.
• Ensuring high-quality commercial proposals, risk assessments, and governance approvals.
• Promoting a strong culture of safety, quality, compliance, and integrity in all commercial activities.

Your profile & qualifications 

We are looking for a commercially driven professional who thrives in a customer-focused environment and has a proven track record of managing complex sales opportunities - preferably from the wind industry. 

To succeed in this role, we imagine that you: 

• Have significant experience with complex B2B sales, opportunity and tender management, contract negotiations, and the development of winning strategies for strategic sales opportunities.
• Bring experience from offshore wind, renewable energy, maritime, technical service, or related industries.
• Have a strong understanding of customer decision processes, competitive positioning, value creation, and commercial risk management.
• Have experience with key account management, account planning, and building long-term customer relationships.
• Are comfortable coordinating cross-functional sales and bid activities involving multiple stakeholders.
• Possess strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills and work in a structured, proactive, and results-oriented manner.
• Communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing, and are willing to travel as part of the role. 

Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too. 

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.  

Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.
Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

_Be the person the project teams call before every big decision. Let AI do the heavy lifting, so you can spend your time where it counts: challenging the numbers and shaping the outcome.

_European Energy is a growing company in the renewable energy sector. We are a privately owned Danish company founded in 2004, with our headquarters in Copenhagen. We develop, construct, and operate solar (PV), onshore wind and hybrid BESS projects globally, as well as Power-to-X projects. We are present across the full renewable energy value chain from development to operations and asset management but are also very active in M&A to recycle capital into new activities. Our core values form the foundation of everything we do: In It Together, Trust and Courage, Ambition, Excitement, Inclusion, and Agility.**Your New Team

**FP&A owns the financial management framework within European Energy: the financial data warehouse, project controlling, budgets/forecasts including performance management, management reporting, group business plan, inputs to investment decisions and capital allocation. We are a team of 12, international and informal, and we already use AI every day. Now we are making AI the way we work, not a side tool. You report to Anders Lykke Jacobsen, VP, Head of FP&A.

**Your New Role

**You build, analyse, and solve. With modern tools and AI doing the heavy lifting, you bring the direction, judgement, and drive that turn numbers into decisions.

You are a sparring partner for the business, someone who points attention to what matters and helps get it solved.

**Your Responsibilities

**

• Build modern tools: dashboards, automations, and reusable AI workflows

• Anchor it all in stable models: budgets, forecasts, cost-to-complete

• Analyse performance across projects and the portfolio, and direct management’s attention to the variances, risks, and opportunities that matter

• Analyse business decisions from a financial perspective, identify issues and develop solutions with the business, and provide clear, actionable recommendations.

**Apply Now

**Reference: Anders Lykke Jacobsen, VP, Head of FP&A.

**The opportunity

**Founded in 2016, Mover is a Danish logistics technology company on a mission to change logistics for good, reducing waste and making people’s lives better. Are you passionate about building great software products? Do you obsess over your customers?

**Your mindset

**What Success Looks Like (12 Months)

**About you

**

• Preferably experience in launching (not just operating) a new B2B SaaS product.

• The ability to navigate ambiguity and create clarity.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Danish and English.

**What we offer

**

• A high degree of responsibility from day one, working alongside experienced colleagues.

• An open, collaborative environment with talented peers across multiple functions.

**Mover’s values

We obsess over the people who use our software, from logistics planners to drivers, and we would rather ship a small improvement this week than a perfect one next year. • Push boundaries. We challenge norms, innovate, and move fast to drive changes to continuously improve things for everyone affected by our products and services

• Play, as a team. We are serious without taking ourselves too seriously, and balance having fun with achieving great things, together

Interested? We would love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Professor within Microbial interactions in plant and environmental systems
 Department of Plant and Environmental Sciences
 Faculty of Science
 University of Copenhagen

  
 The Department of Plant and Environmental Sciences (PLEN); Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen invites applications for a position as full Professor within the area of microbial interactions in plant and environmental systems.

  Research and teaching at PLEN covers topics within Agriculture, Plant Science, Biotechnology, Biosolutions and Environmental Sciences, dealing with a wide range of subjects focusing especially on plants, soil, and microorganisms from molecules through organisms to populations and anthropogenic ecosystems. It is our vision to maintain and develop our position as one of the leading departments for plant science and the related areas based on excellent basic and applied research.

  The department hosts state-of-the art infrastructure and unique field research facilities, with many opportunities for collaborations across the department. The department is organised into four sections, and the appointed professor will be affiliated to the section of Environmental Sciences located at the Frederiksberg campus.

  The section of Environmental Sciences carries out world-leading research across diverse disciplines, including soil microbiology, chemistry, agrohydrology, ecotoxicology, to assess and mitigate human impacts on ecosystems. By combining measurements, experiments, and modelling, the section supports both basic environmental science and applied solutions for sustainable agriculture, climate mitigation, and clean soil and water. The section of Environmental Sciences conducts world-leading research covering environmental biology, chemistry, and ecosystem science. Focusing on agroecosystems and impacts on soil, water, and the atmosphere, the section connects fundamental discoveries to solutions for targeting climate impacts, microbial diversity, and toxicological challenges.

  The professor is expected to teach both at the BSc and MSc levels primarily in the Biotechnology and the Natural resources and Environmental Sciences programmes at the Frederiksberg Campus and to expand these regular teaching commitments to the new MSc in Biosolutions in Kalundborg.

  Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department.

  Description of qualifications needed

  The professorship is advertised within the area of microbial solutions for climate-friendly and sustainable production systems. Full exploitation of these solutions requires basic understanding of the complex interactions in the environment which shape microbial communities and their functions in soil and at the plant root interface.

  Hence, the appointed professor should have a broad knowledge of microbial ecology including microbial functioning under soil conditions, drivers for microbiome assembly as well as microbe-microbe and plant-microbe interactions of importance for soil and plant health. It is expected that the professor has a recognized international position in the field and contributes to the design and implementation of new methodologies within microbial ecology. The successful candidate is expected to drive research within:

   	
• Model system development for causality and mechanistic understanding of microbial functioning under natural soil conditions 	
• The microbial component of N and P nutrition in agricultural systems 	
• Drivers for root colonization and microbial assembly in agricultural systems 	
• Microbial functions of importance for soil health and functioning 	
• Microbial solutions for climate mitigation and sustainable plant production   The appointed professor is expected to cover teaching in existing courses both at the MSc and BSc levels in subjects related to microbiology, molecular genetics and biotechnology. Likewise, the appointed professor is expected to be a driver for the development of courses to ensure high-quality teaching in a constantly changing educational landscape. Supervision of BSc and MSc projects is expected on a regular basis. International candidates are expected to be able to contribute actively to teaching in Danish within 3-6 years, including supervision and assessment of students. Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required.

  The candidate should fulfil the following criteria:

   	
• PhD or similar in molecular biology, microbiology, biochemistry, or a related field 	
• Profound experience in the study of plant microbe-related issues in the context of sustainable agriculture 	
• An excellent publication record that includes corresponding-author, senior author and first author publications of relevance to the position and demonstrate an impact on the scientific field of microbial interactions related to soils, plants and the environment 	
• Proven leadership in an academic research environment and ability to guide an independent research group to achieve specific goals 	
• Extensive experience in the development, organization, restructuring, and management of courses at BSc and MSc levels, supported by a comprehensive teaching portfolio that documents pedagogic competences and ongoing skills development. 	
• Extensive experience with supervision of BSc, MSc, and PhD students, as well as postdocs 	
• A teaching portfolio that documents teaching experience and reflections on teaching skills 	
• Documented ability to obtain independent research grants from private and public foundations. 	
• A strong track record of successful external/international collaborations. 	
• Documented experience in organizational tasks such as departmental committees 	
• Experience with outreach activities and communication of research to the public and stakeholders via, e.g., popular science events, press releases, interviews, conferences etc 	
• Societal impact in terms of participation in appropriate stakeholder networks   Assessment of applicants will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered.

  General criteria apply to the appointment of professors at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.

  Please read more here: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5c_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-professors.pdf
 
 Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here

  
 Salary and employment conditions

  The position is open from 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Employment is as Professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.   There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

  Further information on the department is linked at http://www.science.ku.dk/english/about-the-faculty/organisation/. Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department Morten Petersen (morten.petersen@plen.ku.dk).

  
 Filing of application
 The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below. 

  Please include 

   	
• Curriculum vitae including information about external funding 	
• Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent) 	
• Research plan – description of current and future research plans 	
• Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines 	
• Complete publication list 	
• Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers    

  The deadline for applications is 8 November 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  Interviews will be held on 18 March 2027.

  Please refer to the following no. in future communication in this case: 211-0367/26-2K.

**Our Tech Stack: https://stackshare.io/companies/sedna

**About Sedna:

**Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising the operating system for shipping. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. As we continue to grow and innovate, we are looking for exceptional talent to join our journey and contribute to our mission of transforming the shipping industry .

You can find out more about us on our website: https://sedna.com/

**About the role

**This role focuses on contributing to the design, development, and evolution of Sedna’s VMS (Voyage Management System). It's a mature, highly specialised platform that shipowners, operators and charterers use to run chartering, voyage operations, cargo and freight/hire invoicing.

VMS has a Java backend exposing a REST API used by our own web client (React) and directly by customers' integrations. Data lives in Oracle, including a significant amount of business logic in PL/SQL. It runs on AWS and builds through GitLab CI/CD.

Sedna VMS is in use 24/7 by shipping companies worldwide. Customers run their daily operations and invoicing on it, so correctness, performance and reliability directly affect their business.

You will play a key part in raising standards and delivering new features. You'll take real ownership of features and of how they behave in production, on a product customers run their business on, and help shape how the platform evolves. You'll work with modern AI-assisted development tools as part of everyday engineering.

**How you’ll make an impact

****Engineering and feature development

**This role contributes to both backend and frontend development. Day-to-day responsibilities include understanding requirements, shaping technical approaches, writing code, and contributing to automated tests. Development work spans a mix of new features, improvements, and maintenance, driven by both customer and product needs.

**System architecture and modernisation

**The role includes participating in ongoing efforts to refine and modernise the platform. This involves contributing to technical upgrade work, improving system structure, and supporting longer-term architectural direction as the product grows. Opportunities exist to participate in design discussions and help shape solutions that improve system performance, reliability, and extensibility.

**Quality, testing, and delivery practices

**The team maintains a focus on software quality. We combine unit tests, API regression tests (Postman) and UI tests (Playwright) with peer code review on every merge request. Releases are built and tested through GitLab CI/CD. We're actively improving here: getting more of our test suites running automatically in CI and making them reliable. Engineers who want to drive that, will have room to do it.

**Collaboration with product and customer-facing teams

**The role involves close collaboration with product managers through refinement, planning, and solution discussions. Engineers also interact with Customer Support on cases that need engineering input, and, for larger projects, join customer conversations to validate technical approaches.

**Continuous improvement and documentation

**We treat documentation, including API references, design decisions and runbooks, as part of delivering a change. Much of VMS's knowledge still sits with experienced team members, and capturing it in written, searchable form is an active priority. We also reserve time for technical debt and internal improvements.

**In your first 90 days, you can expect

**

• Month 1: Build your understanding of Sedna’s architecture and our products. Get set up with the VMS codebase, your dev environment and the release process, and ship your first changes. Meet your team, product manager and key customer-facing colleagues. Learn the maritime workflows our customers depend on.

• Month 2: Take ownership of a well-scoped piece of work from refinement with product through to release. Contribute to design discussions, give timely and constructive code review feedback. Shadow the on-call rotation and get familiar with runbooks and production tooling.

• Month 3: Lead the technical approach on a complex feature or improvement within your team, working independently and raising risks and dependencies early. Join the on-call rotation. Contribute improvements to tests, runbooks or documentation based on what you found hard to learn, and support technical validation in a customer conversation where relevant.

**What we're looking for:

****Essential experience

**Candidates typically bring three+ years of professional engineering experience from a comparable environment. Experience working on production systems where quality and reliability are important. Familiarity with a JVM language (Java, Kotlin, Scala) or a similar backend language, React or another modern frontend framework. Strong SQL and relational database skills, ideally Oracle or PostgreSQL, including query performance. Experience supporting production systems: diagnosing incidents from logs and metrics. Prior on-call experience is a plus.

**Critical skills

**A strong grasp of building and maintaining features within a larger system is helpful. Confidence with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and code review workflows is expected. Clear thinking, good problem-solving ability, and the capacity to work with domain-heavy logic contribute to success in the role. Experience with enterprise or workflow-driven applications is an advantage.

**Traits and mindset

**Curiosity and a willingness to learn the maritime domain are appreciated. A collaborative working style, comfort sharing ideas in cross-functional settings, and the ability to work independently when needed all support strong performance. Adaptability is important as the product and architecture continue to evolve.

**Core competencies

**Systems thinking, ownership of outcomes, strong communication skills, and effective collaboration are central to this role. A motivation to create value for customers and contribute to a stable, evolving platform is essential.

**What’s In Store for You

**

• A strong team. You’ll join a global team of senior and staff engineers who set a high bar and will help level you up.

• A generous salary and benefits package (depending on experience) + private medical, equity, health and wellbeing benefits, home internet contribution

• Scalability challenges. You’ll be a part of evolving our VMS system as we further develop in to a product led company.

• Customer impact. Real customers use our products everyday, you'll see your work impacting real people.

• Collaboration & autonomy. Plenty of heads-down technical work, but also close partnership with product engineers and engineering leadership.

**Our Values:

**Finally, culture is important to us, so we also look for candidates who share our values:

**Stay Ahead, Stay Agile

**

• We don’t just adapt-we anticipate change and act with confidence.

• Curiosity, data, and customer insights help us stay ahead of the curve.

• We embrace challenges as opportunities and remain resilient under pressure.

• By staying open to new ideas and ways of working, we lead the future.

**Execute With Focus

**

• We turn strategy into action, delivering measurable results that matter.

• Every initiative counts-discipline and ownership drive business impact.

• We make smart decisions with speed, balancing pace and precision.

• Clear priorities keep us focused on what moves the needle.

**Work Together, Win Together

**

• Collaboration is our superpower-we succeed as one team, internally and with customers.

• We co-create solutions, seek feedback, and build the future of Sedna together.

• Strong relationships are built on trust, respect, and shared goals.

• By aligning across teams and with customers, we unlock greater impact.

**Build software at scale. Influence how we build it. Help shape the next generation of development at Dalux.

**Dalux is growing, and we are looking for experienced software developers who want significant technical ownership while continuing to build software hands-on.

You will work on products used by professionals around the world, contribute to architectural and technical decisions, and help us improve how we develop software – including how we use agentic AI to make capable developers more effective.

**Your role

**As an Experienced Software Developer, you will take ownership of complex product and technical problems from idea to production.

You will work in a product team with other developers, a Product Manager, and a Product Designer. We expect experienced developers to contribute beyond their individual tasks by making good technical decisions, improving our architecture and development practices, and sharing knowledge with others.

Your work can include:

• Owning complex features and technical problems end-to-end

• Designing scalable, maintainable solutions and contributing to architectural decisions

• Improving our codebase, tooling, developer workflows, and technical quality

• Driving or contributing to initiatives around DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure, architecture, or developer tooling

• Sparring with and mentoring other developers

• Working closely with Product Management and Design to understand problems and find the right solutions

• Bringing new ideas and technologies into Dalux when they can improve our products or how we build them

We expect experienced developers to have opinions, challenge existing solutions, and be comfortable having their own ideas challenged in return.

**Developing software with agentic AI

**We are significantly increasing our use of agentic AI in software development.

We use and explore AI across the development lifecycle – from understanding problems and navigating codebases to implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring, and review.

We are looking for developers who already use agentic AI as part of their development workflow. The specific tools matter less than how you use them: providing the right context and direction, critically evaluating the output, and knowing when to intervene or take a different approach.

Strong engineering fundamentals remain essential. AI can increase what a capable developer can achieve, but you remain responsible for the architecture, correctness, maintainability, and quality of the software you build.

At Dalux, you will help us take these ways of working further by experimenting, sharing what works, and helping establish effective practices for agentic software development.

**Technologies we work with

**Our platform is built on a distributed cloud architecture using AWS. Our primary technologies include:

• C# / .NET

• Angular / TypeScript

• GitHub Copilot

• MSSQL

• Elasticsearch

• AWS

• Optionally, Android / iOS development using .NET MAUI

You may also encounter parts of our C++ codebase.

Experience with our exact technology stack is useful, but strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to understand and improve complex systems matter more.

**Product development at Dalux

**Our developers do more than implement specifications.

Developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers work together to understand problems and find solutions that balance user value, usability, technical feasibility, business viability, and long-term technical health.

Our products are relied upon by professionals worldwide, making performance, stability, maintainability, and quality important parts of everyday engineering.

**Your background

**We expect that you:

• Have solid professional software development experience

• Have at least six months of practical experience using agentic AI as part of your software development workflow

• Hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or a related technical field

• Have strong software engineering fundamentals

• Are comfortable owning complex technical problems and decisions

• Can navigate and improve an established codebase and architecture

• Care about maintainability, reliability, performance, and quality

• Enjoy technical sparring and sharing knowledge with other developers

• Understand the trade-offs between short-term delivery and long-term technical quality

Experience with C#/.NET, Angular, or cloud development is useful, but we do not expect you to match every technology we use.

**What You Can Expect From Dalux

**Dalux is a software company at heart. As an experienced developer, you can expect:

• Significant ownership and real influence on technical solutions

• Skilled colleagues who enjoy technical discussion and constructive challenge

• Close collaboration between Engineering, Product Management, and Design

• Short paths from ideas to decisions and implementation

• Opportunities to improve engineering practices beyond your immediate product work

• An environment actively investing in agentic AI for software development

• High levels of trust and freedom in how you solve problems

All Dalux software development takes place in-house at our headquarters in Vibenshuset, Copenhagen. Working together in person is an important part of how we collaborate, share knowledge, and make decisions quickly.

**About Dalux

**Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard.

We build digital tools that make the construction industry smarter and more efficient. Using our own 3D BIM technology, we develop software used in more than 140 countries worldwide.

This is a key commercial role for a sales professional who knows the B2B software industry, understands how indirect sales work, and already has a strong network of potential partners.

You will play a central role in expanding Mercura's reach through established software partners such as VARs and other solution providers selling ERP, CRM, PIM, CAD and similar B2B software. The ideal candidate combines a proven sales track record with genuine industry relationships and the ability to turn those relationships into productive, long-term partnerships.

Your Responsibilities

• Identify, approach and recruit new partners.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with VARs, software resellers, solution providers and other relevant channel partners.

• Use your existing industry network to create qualified opportunities and accelerate market entry.

• Develop partner plans and go-to-market strategies that generate measurable pipeline and revenue.

• Own the partner sales cycle from initial engagement and qualification through agreement, activation and ongoing development and training.

• Work closely with Mercura's sales, marketing and implementation teams to enable partners and maximise joint opportunities.

• Develop partner relationships into sustainable, high-value sales channels rather than one-off referrals.

• Track partner performance, pipeline and revenue, and continuously identify opportunities for growth.

What We Are Looking For

• Proven B2B software sales experience with a strong track record of achieving commercial targets.

• Several years of experience in the software industry, ideally in partner sales, channel sales, indirect sales or a closely related role.

• An established network of relevant software partners, particularly in the German-speaking markets.

• Existing relationships with VARs or other organisations selling ERP, CRM, PIM, CAD or similar B2B software solutions.

• Strong business development and relationship-building skills, with the ability to open doors and build trust at senior level.

• A commercially driven, entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to work independently in a growing company.

• Excellent communication and negotiation skills.

• Fluent German and English, both written and spoken, is essential.

What We Offer

• A key position with direct influence on Mercura's growth and partner strategy.

• The opportunity to build and own a partner channel in important European markets.

• A young, ambitious team and a growing company with a clear competitive edge.

• A role with significant autonomy, responsibility and room to make an impact.
