jobs.occupation: PROJECT MANAGER FOR REAL ESTATE & FACILITY MANAGEMENT
jobs.description:
Project Manager for Real Estate and Facility Management

Join SAS on an Exciting Journey as a Project Manager for Real Estate & Facility Management

As Project Manager Real Estate & Facility Management at SAS, you will be responsible for leading and delivering real estate, workplace, refurbishment, and construction projects across Copenhagen and Copenhagen Airport. You will manage projects from concept and planning through execution and handover, ensuring delivery on time, within budget, and according to business requirements.

Working closely with SAS Head of Real Estate, service partners, landlords, airport authorities, consultants, contractors, and internal stakeholders, you will play a key role in developing and transforming SAS real estate portfolio.

The role acts as the primary project lead and local REFM representative in Copenhagen, serving as the central point of coordination between stakeholders, suppliers, airport authorities, and the wider REFM organization.

Challenges you will work on:

Project Management & Delivery

• Lead workplace, refurbishment, construction, and facility-related projects across SAS locations in Copenhagen and Copenhagen Airport.

• Manage project scope, schedules, budgets, risks, and stakeholder expectations throughout the project lifecycle.

• Ensure projects are delivered according to agreed timelines, budgets, quality standards, and business requirements.

• Prepare project plans, business cases, progress reports, and decision-making material for stakeholders and management.

Construction & Technical Projects

• Coordinate and manage consultants, architects, contractors, and other external project resources.

• Oversee construction activities, site inspections, and project implementation.

• Ensure compliance with Danish construction regulations, airport requirements, health and safety standards, and internal governance.

• Review technical solutions, drawings, project documentation, and contractor deliverables.

Stakeholder & Supplier Management

• Act as the primary local point of contact for project-related REFM activities in Copenhagen.

• Coordinate project activities with landlords, airport authorities, suppliers, consultants, and internal business stakeholders.

• Build and maintain strong relationships to ensure alignment, support, and successful project execution.

• Lead project meetings and communicate progress, risks, and decisions to relevant stakeholders.

Financial & Commercial Management

• Develop and manage project budgets, forecasts, and cost follow-up.

• Support procurement activities, tender processes, and contract negotiations.

• Monitor project costs and identify opportunities for value engineering and cost optimization.

• Manage project changes, variations, and commercial discussions with suppliers and contractors.

Portfolio Development & Workplace Improvements

• Support the development and execution of the REFM project portfolio in Copenhagen.

• Drive workplace improvements, office transformations, and facility upgrades that enhance employee experience and operational efficiency.

• Identify opportunities to improve space utilization, sustainability performance, and overall workplace functionality.

• Contribute to strategic real estate and facility initiatives across the SAS portfolio.

The Team

You will be part of the SAS Real Estate & Facility Management (REFM) organization, collaborating with colleagues across Scandinavia to develop and deliver workplace, facility, and real estate projects that support both employees and business objectives.

SAS REFM manages approximately 260,000 sqm of leased and owned space, overseeing workplace services, lease agreements, renovations, construction projects, facility operations, and stakeholder relations. Our ambition is to provide sustainable, cost-effective, and attractive workplaces while supporting SAS's strategic development and operational needs.

As part of a close-knit Scandinavian team, you will work across borders and functions, leading projects and contributing to the development of workplaces and facilities that support the future of SAS.

To be successful we believe you have

• 5+ years of experience within project management, construction, real estate, facility management, workplace development.

• Relevant education within Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, Real Estate, Facility Management, or equivalent.

• Proven experience managing construction, fit-out, refurbishment, workplace, or facility projects from planning through execution.

• Strong understanding of construction processes, project governance, procurement, and contract management.

• Experience managing contractors, consultants, suppliers, and multiple stakeholders simultaneously.

• Knowledge of Danish construction regulations, building standards, and health and safety requirements.

• Experience from an airport, transportation, logistics, property, or another complex operational environment is an advantage.

• Strong financial understanding with experience managing project budgets, forecasts, and cost control.

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills.

• A proactive, structured, and solution-oriented mindset with strong leadership capabilities.

• Excellent communication skills in English and Danish. Swedish is an advantage.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management tools.

• Ability to work independently while driving multiple projects in a dynamic environment.

• Proven relationship-building skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across all organizational levels.

• A high level of ownership, commercial awareness, and commitment to delivering results.

Why SAS?

Join a globally recognized and dynamic organization where your work has a direct impact on the daily experience of employees and visitors.

This permanent position in Copenhagen offers wellness programs, pension plans, staff discounts, and a supportive workplace culture that values collaboration, development, and continuous improvement.

Our Culture at SAS

At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travelers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you’ll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other's contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work. Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!

Additional information

•    Deadline for application: 10/11/2026. Please send us your CV as soon as possible, as interviews are conducted continuously, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Note that we are not able to handle any applications that are sent by email, due to GDPR regulations.

•    Position: Fulltime (100%) starting with a 3-month probation period

•    A valid Category B driver's license is required.

•    This position is based at our office at Copenhagen Airport, and you will be expected to work onsite. Remote work may also be an option, depending on the agreement made with your manager.

•    A background check will be conducted at the final stage of this recruitment process, as this role is security classified. If you are aware of any specific matters that may come up during this background check, we kindly ask you to be transparent about them during the recruitment process.

If you have questions about this position, you are welcome to contact Fredrik Jangendal, Talent Acquisition Specialist via email: fredrik.jangendal@sas.se. Please note that we cannot handle any applications that are sent by email due to the GDPR regulations.

SAS, Scandinavia's leading airline since 1946, operates from its principal hub at Copenhagen Airport (CPH), complemented by hubs in Oslo (OSL) and Stockholm (ARN). Our mission is to connect Scandinavia with the world and the world with Scandinavia. Each year, SAS serves more than 25 million passengers and transports 55 tons of cargo to 135 destinations across Europe, the USA, and Asia. With a passionate workforce of over 10,000 colleagues, we collaborate with partners and customers to drive transformative changes in aviation. We are committed to achieving net-zero emissions by 2050, embodying the visionary spirit of our founders: “To move from the old to what is about to come, is the only tradition worth keeping”. Innovation and societal progress are at the heart of everything we do. For more information, visit our website at www.flysas.com or follow us on social media for the latest updates and promotions.

jobs.occupation: Maternity Cover - Associate Category Manager, Indirect Spend
jobs.description:
Are you a proactive and results-driven professional eager to make a significant impact in the green energy sector? Semco Maritime is offering a unique, temporary opportunity for an Associate Category Manager to join our team for a minimum of 12 months maternity cover.

**Your position

**As an Associate Category Manager for Indirect Spend you will play a pivotal role in leading category strategies across various sectors including facility management, professional services, travel, and more. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in negotiating and driving cost efficiencies while promoting sustainable practices within the supply chain.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

Your workplace will be located at our Global Headquarters in Esbjerg, positioned at the heart of the Danish energy industry with stunning waterfront views. This is a full-time, temporary maternity cover for a minimum duration of 12 months.

**Your Tasks & Responsibilities

**As an Associate Category Manager, your primary responsibility will be to support our Group Support Functions, including HR, Marketing and IT, with strategic procurement and day-to-day purchasing activities. You will also manage indirect spend, with particular responsibility for facility management, including Travel.

• Group Support Functions: Partner with functions such as HR, Marketing and IT to understand their requirements and provide procurement support aligned with business needs.

• Contract Negotiation: Lead and support supplier negotiations to achieve competitive pricing and favourable terms and conditions.

• Purchase Order Management: Coordinate and issue purchase orders, follow up on invoice handling and help ensure compliance with the procurement-to-pay process.

• Cost Management: Maintain visibility of expenditure, support budget control and identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve commercial value.

• Indirect Spend and Facility Management: Manage relevant indirect spend categories, including facility management services, and support effective supplier performance and service delivery.

• Group Travel: Manage the travel category across the Semco Group, including supplier relationships, commercial agreements, cost optimisation and stakeholder support.

**Your Profile & Qualifications

**We are looking for an outgoing and positive individual who is passionate about indirect spend and wants to leave their personal mark on it. You have a proactive and organised approach to your work and are eager to enhance your skills within the department.

• Minimum experience of 2 years in Strategic Procurement or a related commercial field, experience in indirect spend is advantageous but not required.

• Excellent negotiation and relationship-building skills, capable of interacting effectively across diverse cultures and functions. Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize effectively.

• Positive, proactive, and a team player with the autonomy to operate independently.

• Fluent in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

**Welcome to Semco Maritime

**At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever, pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.

Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.

• Write tests, refactor, and improve the codebase as you go.

• Prototype approaches in real code before committing to them.

Raise the bar on quality

• Write maintainable, well-tested, production-grade code.

• Give thoughtful code reviews, with extra scrutiny on AI-assisted changes.

• Contribute to observability, reliability, security, and CI/CD practices in your team.

Design and decide

• Make pragmatic trade-offs between delivery speed and long-term health, and explain your reasoning.

Understand the product

• Connect your work to product outcomes and customer impact.

• Give technical input on scope and prioritization instead of just taking tickets.

• Work with product and design to keep our data handling compliant and transparent.

What we’re looking for

• 5+ years of professional experience shipping production software.

• A track record of owning a system or domain end to end.

• Evidence that you’ve raised a team’s engineering standards through mentoring and technical influence.

• Strong proficiency in modern full-stack development, for example TypeScript/Node.js, .NET and React.

• Deep hands-on experience with AI coding tools, and the judgment to review and stand behind their output.

• Solid grasp of API design, distributed systems and cloud-native architecture.

• Experience running services in production on a major cloud provider. Containers and Kubernetes are a plus.

• The ability to connect technical decisions to business outcomes and reason about cost and value.

• Pragmatic judgment and comfort with ambiguity.

Nice to have

• Experience in privacy, consent management or another regulated-data domain.

• Experience introducing or scaling AI-assisted development practices in a team.

How we work: AI-native by default

Usercentrics is pushing AI adoption across engineering, and we expect you to work this way from day one. You’ll direct AI coding agents and hold their output to the same bar as human-written code.

- Hybrid working, up to 3 remote days per week, plus workcation (work from abroad) per policy

ABOUT US

We are driven by our values #BeBrave, #BetterTogether, #LeadbyExample, #InnovateWithPurpose, #PassionForPrivacy, #GiveBack and #ComeAsYouAre.

We strive to create a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to reach their full potential. We are #BetterTogether.

jobs.description:
Account Manager till Sverige

I rollen som Account Manager får du ansvar för hela säljprocessen — från första kontakt till att avtalet är på plats. Du kommer både att boka möten, hålla kundmöten online och rådgiva potentiella kunder om hur Grow365.io kan skapa tillväxt i deras verksamhet.

Mötesbokning och kundmöten online

• 
Behovsanalys och rådgivning

• 
Uppföljning och closing

Löpande sparring med ledningen och teamet

Attraktiv provisionsmodell kombinerad med fast grundlön

Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter — både professionellt och personligt

En spännande roll i ett tillväxtorienterat företag

Professionell utrustning och grundlig onboarding

En stark arbetsmiljö med högt humör och högt tempo

Lön utan tak

Sociala och professionella aktiviteter under året

_**Would you like to shape the employee experience for more than 1,500 colleagues in Denmark while helping position Coloplast as an employer of choice for future talent?

The Role and Department

Our QC lab is growing in activities and looking to recruit an IT System Administrator to join our team onsite in Ballerup.

As IT system administrator at Genmab, you will provide administrative and developmental support to all our QC IT systems in our Quality Control Laboratory.

The laboratory is responsible for supporting Genmab’s innovative products by performing release and stability testing according to ICH guidelines. Systems are mainly the Labvantage Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS), but also the Empower Chromatography software and additional software controlling analytical equipment.

The role requires a detailed understanding of the LIMS and Empower systems used by QC and its maintenance requirements. The IT system administrator will own the system validation packages, the SOPs, and associated training packages.

The position requires compliance with regulatory requirements to cGMP. Unique to this position is the chance to define the way we work with laboratory IT systems at Genmab.

You will be joining a small team of ambitious and professional colleagues within related fields, who can help you settle into your role, and keep the spirit high while performing the important tasks for our laboratory. The laboratory is newly established, so expect a pioneering atmosphere, where you will help adjust the ways of working in an efficiency oriented direction. We expect you to be ambitious, motivated, self-driven, and to be able to make your colleagues shine in an environment of respectful and flexible collaboration.

You will report to the Associate Director of QC Support, Laboratory systems and Equipment.

Responsibilities

• Liaison between System Users, Application Managers (IT) & QA.

• Drives Business related aspects of system application operations, design, testing, and improvements.

• Manage user access administration and providing initial and on-going training for users.

• Responsible for practical aspects of maintaining the validated state of GxP systems.

• Ensure data integrity and compliance with company SOPs, requirement specifications, and cGMP regulations.

• Load and configure method templates in LIMS and Empower.

• Perform all aspects of QMS processes – Change Control, Deviations, CAPAs – for software used in QC lab.

• Report achievements and escalate issues.

Requirements

• 
It is expected that you have at least 5 years of documented professional experience working according to GMP in a QC setting

• 
You have a thorough understanding of the detailed requirements for Software Validation and are up to date with current trends

• 
Experience with qualification of analytical instruments is desirable as you will be the owner of the validation and qualification activities

• 
Experience in leading projects and driving cross-functional initiatives/stakeholders

DKK597.312,00---895.968,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

jobs.description:
Are you energized by shaping how a large IT organization works and equally motivated by making sure new ways of working are actually adopted?

“We have recent led our transformation from taking Arla IT & Digital from a plan-build-run operating model to a product-led organization. Our ambition with this change is to strengthen end-to-end product accountability, introduce more fit-for-purpose practices, improve cross-team transparency, and create common guidance and capability-building activities across IT & Digital,” says Head of Product IT, Kasper Duus.

**

How will you make an impact**

As Experienced IT Specialist in the IT Excellence team, you will take ownership of key transformation and continuous-improvement initiatives, moving between strategic thinking, practical design, stakeholder alignment and hands-on execution. Your key responsibilities will include

• Shape and improve our IT operating model and product-led ways of working, translating ambitions into our product lifecycle model, roadmaps, roles, and processes.

• Drive adoption and anchoring of change, ensuring new ways of working become part of everyday behaviors and continue to evolve after implementation.

• Lead cross-functional transformation initiatives, creating alignment across stakeholders, clarifying ownership, and turning complex challenges into actionable solutions.

• Use data, insights, and feedback to identify improvement opportunities, challenge existing practices, and help demonstrate progress and value.

• Enable leaders and teams to succeed with change through facilitation, capability building, clear guidance, and practical tools.

This is a maternity cover position of 12 months based in Aarhus.

What will make you successful

You bring solid experience within organizational transformation, operating-model development, change management, continuous improvement, management consulting, or a similar field.

You are comfortable translating ambition into action and have experience driving change from design through implementation and adoption. You combine a structured and analytical mindset with strong stakeholder-management and facilitation skills. We expect the ideal candidate brings

• 5+ years of experience with large-scale transformation initiatives

• Experience with or understanding of product-led IT organizations

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• Experience with organizational design, capability building, performance insights or agile/continuous-improvement practices is an advantage

Most importantly, you are pragmatic and hands-on. You are comfortable challenging existing thinking, navigating ambiguity, and creating momentum without relying on formal authority.

What do we offer?

You get the chance to shape how a large, Global IT organization works, at a time when the new operating model is being anchored. You will work with leaders and teams across Arla IT & Digital, see the direct impact of your work on everyday practice, and build experience that is valuable for your further career, in a team that cares about connecting strategy with execution.

Would you like to join us?

If you want to turn transformation ambitions into lasting change, then seize this exciting opportunity. Please apply as soon as possible, as we process applications on a continuous basis and will close the recruitment once the right candidate is found.

jobs.occupation: Drive Technical Excellence, Lead with Confidence, and Make an Impact as Team Lead for our Hardware Automation team
jobs.description:
Are you a technically strong and decisive leader who sets high standards, takes ownership, and drives results?
At Gram Equipment, we are looking for a Team Lead – Hardware, Automation who combines solid electrical engineering expertise with a strong leadership presence and the determination to make things happen.

We are looking for someone who is confident in their technical decisions, comfortable taking responsibility, and motivated by delivering high-quality results. Someone who brings structure, challenges the status quo when needed, and has the courage to set clear expectations and follow through.

In this role, you will lead our Hardware Team within the Automation department, ensuring that we deliver safe, reliable, and production-ready electrical hardware solutions.

This is a hands-on leadership position where you will combine technical expertise with team leadership. Approximately 80% of your time will be dedicated to technical and operational activities, while 20% will focus on leadership, planning, and employee development.
Your role – technical excellence meets strong leadership
As our new Team Lead, you will take responsibility for the daily coordination, technical quality, and performance of a team of six skilled employees in Denmark and one in Turkey.

You will be expected to provide clear direction, establish priorities, and ensure that decisions are translated into action. At the same time, you will remain actively involved in engineering activities, contributing your own technical expertise to complex challenges and important projects.

An important part of your role will be to drive standardization, increase automation of engineering processes, and identify opportunities for cost optimization, helping us create more efficient, scalable, and competitive hardware solutions.

You will work closely with colleagues across Automation, Engineering, Project Management, Procurement, and Production, where your ability to communicate clearly, challenge constructively, and stand firm on technical quality and safety will be essential.

You will report to the Global Head of Automation and play an important role in strengthening the performance and capabilities of our Global Engineering & Automation organization.
Your key responsibilities
• Lead with clarity and accountability: Set clear expectations, establish priorities, make decisions, and ensure that commitments are followed through.
• Drive technical execution: Take an active role in electrical design, panel engineering, component selection, BOM development, and technical problem-solving.
• Ensure high technical standards: Review and challenge electrical solutions, maintain compliance with safety requirements, and ensure consistent engineering quality and documentation.
• Drive standardization and engineering automation: Develop and implement standardized electrical designs, components, and documentation practices. Promote automated generation of electrical drawings to reduce manual engineering effort, improve consistency, and increase efficiency.
• Focus on cost optimization: Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities through smarter design solutions, component standardization, efficient engineering processes, and close collaboration with Procurement and Production, without compromising safety, quality, or reliability.
• Take ownership of planning and delivery: Allocate resources, monitor capacity and progress, address obstacles, and proactively manage delivery risks.
• Make sound technical decisions: Evaluate complex engineering challenges, balance quality, cost, safety, and delivery requirements, and make well-founded decisions, even under pressure.
• Develop and challenge your team: Provide constructive feedback, coach employees, encourage accountability, and support the development of technical competencies.
• Strengthen cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and panel builders to resolve issues and ensure effective project execution.
• Drive continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to improve standards, processes, tools, and working methods, and take the initiative to turn improvements into measurable results.What we are looking for
We are looking for an experienced electrical engineering professional with a strong technical foundation and a natural ability to take the lead.

You enjoy responsibility, have a structured and analytical approach, and are comfortable making decisions and standing behind them.

Ideally, you bring:

• A relevant technical or engineering background within electrical engineering, automation, or a related field.
• Solid experience with electrical design and panel engineering for industrial machinery.
• Strong knowledge of electrical safety, technical standards, and regulatory requirements, including CE and DS/EN/IEC 60204-1.
• Experience with electrical components, BOM structures, technical documentation, and engineering standards.
• A strong understanding of standardization and an interest in automated engineering processes, including automated generation of electrical drawings.
• A commercial mindset with the ability to identify cost optimization opportunities while maintaining technical quality and compliance.
• The ability to analyze complex technical challenges and make clear, well-founded decisions.
• Experience coordinating technical work, managing priorities, and ensuring delivery against commitments.
• Previous experience in technical leadership, team coordination, or people management, or demonstrated leadership potential combined with a strong desire to take responsibility.Your personality makes the difference
For this position, your personal drive and leadership approach are just as important as your technical qualifications.

We are looking for someone who brings a strong personality, clear direction, and high professional standards to the team.

You are likely to recognize yourself in the following:

• Decisive and confident: You are comfortable taking the lead, making decisions, and addressing challenges directly rather than waiting for others to act.

jobs.occupation: Operational Network Planner - Viby J or Krusaa
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about supply chain planning within an End-2-End perspective and motivated by making operational decisions that create value across the entire value chain? Do you thrive in a collaborative environment where customer focus, stakeholder management and data-driven decision-making go hand in hand? Then this could be the opportunity for you. We are looking for an Operational Network Planner for CBP Krusaa cluster.

“Joining the Krusaa Cluster Planning team, you will be part of planning the supply of speciality cheese products across a complex and dynamic supply chain. Working closely with Supply Chain, Commercial and Production, you will help connect customer demand with production and supply. If you thrive in an operational environment, enjoy collaborating across functions and want to make a real impact, this could be the opportunity for you” says Christine Carstensen, Supply Chain Network Planning Manager.

The role can be based either in Krusaa or Viby J. To support close collaboration with the planning team and production sites, colleagues based in Viby J are expected to spend a minimum of one day per week in Krusaa.

How you will make an impact

As an Operational Network Planner, you will play a key role within the Sales & Operations Execution (S&OE) horizon, ensuring that we deliver excellent service levels to customers while balancing production capacity, inventory levels and waste reduction across markets and warehouses.

You will join a highly collaborative planning team consisting of 6 Site Schedulers, two Operational Network Planners and one Component Planner, supporting five production sites. Working closely with colleagues across Supply Chain, Commercial and Production, you will help drive operational decisions that create value across the end-to-end supply chain.

Your key responsibilities will include

• Optimizing supply chain performance through root cause analysis and data-driven decisions.

• Monitoring relevant KPIs and implementing corrective actions to achieve targets.

• Conducting scenario planning to mitigate availability risks, reduce waste, and assess the impact of demand fluctuations on finished goods.

• Escalating unresolved short-term imbalances to global or local S&OE executive forums and key stakeholders.

• Leading proactive dialogue between Supply Chain and Commercial teams to solve complex issues.

• Identifying and contributing to optimization initiatives from an end-to-end perspective.

What will make you successful

You are an ambitious and structured professional with strong analytical skills and the ability to work across multiple functions. You thrive on collaboration and have a natural ability to engage with stakeholders from across the business.

You are motivated by change and actively contribute to the continuous improvement of ways of working and collaboration.

We imagine you

• Hold a relevant Bachelor's or Master's degree within Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Engineering, Business or a related field.

• Have experience within supply chain planning, logistics or manufacturing, preferably working within S&OE or short-term planning horizons.

• Are comfortable analysing data and using insights to support operational decisions.

• Communicate clearly and confidently with stakeholders across different functions and organisational levels.

• Are curious, proactive and motivated by continuous improvement and optimisation.

• Are able to communicate effectively both in Danish and in English

What do we offer?

An inclusive corporate culture that creates job satisfaction is important to us, and we prioritize giving our employees good development opportunities. We are looking for you who want to grow with us at Arla Foods!

Arla Foods has a collective agreement and always offers good and competitive working conditions. In addition, we have a high priority on safety and the working environment.

About Arla

We are Arla – a European dairy cooperative with over 19,000 employees and around 8,600 farmers. Our cooperative model creates a unique closeness to our farmers – the owners of Arla – and motivates us every day to deliver the very best for our farmers, colleagues, our milk, our consumers, and our environment.

Would you like to join us?

Please apply as soon as possible. We process applications on a continuous basis and close the position once the right candidate has been found.

If you have any questions, please contact Supply Chain Network Planning Manager, Christine Carstensen at +45 91 31 58 03.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

jobs.description:

At GetWhy, we’re on a mission to change the way brands understand people. We help the world's biggest brands get closer to their consumers—faster, smarter, and with a human touch - through breakthrough research powered by AI. Companies like Coca-Cola, Heineken, Unilever and more trust us to deliver consumer insights in hours, not weeks.

We are building an end-to-end AI-powered human insights platform, redefining the boundaries of qualitative research. To fuel our journey, we raised a $34.5M Series A investment from PeakSpan Capital in 2024, making it one of Denmark’s largest Series A rounds to date.

What the AI team does

We are dedicated to delivering high-quality AI products leveraging the latest tools and techniques and to serve them across our core products in a scalable way.

For this, we use classic machine learning for predictive models to deal with fraud detection, language classification, visual understanding and automating internal workflows. These make heavy use of video processing, speech-to-text and multilingual translations models and pipelines.

We also build a lot of functionality around state of the art LLMs. We treat off-the-shelf LLMs as future commodities and aim to benefit from their strengths while employing principled methodologies to build guardrails and fallback strategies for their weaknesses. We strive to achieve a deep understanding of prompt engineering, context management, and LLM behavior quirks (e.g., hallucinations, non-determinism, context management), by focusing on evaluation and observability through monitoring for latency, accuracy, and usage.

Who you are

We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join our growing stellar AI team. You will be responsible for all stages in the machine learning lifecycles across projects, from designing and defining data annotation steps to model training, validation and deployment.

**More Specifically, You Should Have These Minimum Qualifications

**

• At least 5+ years developing machine learning systems, in particular NLP models.

• Proficiency in Python, along with a solid understanding of data structures and algorithms, and the capability to write production-quality code.

• Significant experience working with LLMs at scale, Prompt Engineering and AI Agents.

• Solid understanding of LLM evaluation, dealing with hallucinations, inconsistent outputs, context management, conversational AI and voice technologies, including text-to-speech.

• Proven experience formulating hypotheses, conducting experiments, and analyzing results.

• Exceptional English skills, both spoken and in writing.

What you will do

• Build AI-powered features at scale using the latest advancements in LLMs.

• Research, prototype, and build advanced NLP/ML models to enable automated resolution of end-user problems.

• Design and conduct rigorous experiments and evaluations to enhance model accuracy and reliability.

• Refine prompts and tune hyper-parameters to maximize the performance of cutting-edge retrieval and generative AI systems.

• Work closely with researchers, engineers, and product teams to define feature scope and implementation strategies.

• Mentor junior team members and engage in collaborative learning with peers to promote knowledge sharing.

• Contribute to technical reviews and share expertise in ML methodologies and best practices

• Writing clean, maintainable, and well-structured code to meet delivery goals.

Click on the apply button and upload your resumé or LinkedIn profile. If we see a potential match, we’ll invite you for a conversation at our office to get to know you better and share more about our culture and this opportunity.

So, what are you waiting for? Hit the apply button and come join the next Danish unicorn.

Our operations team is looking for a Finance Manager who is tired of the status quo. You will work closely with our software engineers and operations team to help shape the future of finance in property management.

To be quite frank: if you currently work with bookkeeping in property management, you probably know the pain. Too much manual work, outdated systems, endless reconciliations, and processes built around software from another decade.

We want to change that. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to rethink and shape how bookkeeping and accounting workflows should work for our customers' property portfolio.

Right now is the best time to join because you’ll help define both the role and the systems behind it as we scale across the Nordics.

****What we do

****Property management is fundamentally broken. It’s held back by legacy software and linear scaling: more tenants equals more manual work.

We automate high-volume, low-value tasks like bank reconciliation, debt collection, and financial administration to remove unnecessary friction and human error from the rental experience.

Rumli is a seal of quality and trust in a messy market. After years of scaling our software to thousands of users, we are now rebuilding our entire stack from the ground up with AI as the foundation. We are moving from being a software provider to a full-service property manager.

We’re not just building the platform; we’re running it.

****You will

• Be a core part of the team: Work closely with operations and product to improve financial workflows and internal systems.

• Handle day-to-day bookkeeping: ensure our automations work as intended across reconciliation, vendor invoice management, payroll and financial administration for the properties we manage.

• Ensure financial accuracy: Manage balance sheet reconciliations, payments, VAT handling, and monthly, quarterly and yearly accounts.

• Help improve the system: Identify repetitive or inefficient workflows and help the product team decide what to automate next.

• Operate at scale: Use modern tools and automation to manage a portfolio size that would be difficult in a traditional setup.

• Support the business: Assist with designing the reporting, budgeting, on- and offboarding of new properties, and ad hoc finance tasks as we continue to grow.

****You may be a fit if you are

• From the field: You have experience with bookkeeping, accounting, or financial administration – ideally within property management or a related industry.

• Done with manual work and outdated processes: You’ve worked with legacy bookkeeping and already have opinions on how finance workflows could be smarter.

• Detail-oriented: You care about accuracy and structure without losing sight of the bigger picture.

• A systems thinker: You enjoy improving processes, not just following them.

• Comfortable with IT systems: You have worked with different software, like e-conomic, before and are quick at adopting new ones.

• Bilingual: You are fluent in Danish and comfortable working in English.

• Equipped with an entrepreneurial mindset: You’re comfortable taking ownership and working in a fast-paced startup environment.

****What you’ll get

****Almost everyone lives or works in a building someone else looks after, and how that is done has barely changed in decades. Rumli is rethinking it – and you'll be part of the team making it happen, backed by some of Denmark's leading investors. The distance from idea to action here is short, and impact gets noticed fast.

• Ownership of the company through our warrant program.

• An office in the heart of Copenhagen.

• Daily lunch, drinks and snacks at the office.

• Private health insurance.

• 30 days of paid holiday.

We're looking for people, not bullet points on a CV. Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. If this sounds like you and you want to build something that matters with people who care, we'd love to hear from you.

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**The Senior Associate Accounts Payable is responsible for ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely processing of supplier invoices and payments globally, safeguarding financial integrity and operational efficiency. The role delivers high-quality Accounts Payable execution, supports month-end and audit processes, and acts as a reliable point of contact for suppliers and internal stakeholders. As part of the Finance team, this position contributes to strong financial governance, VAT compliance, and continuous process improvement, supporting the company's scalability and commercial performance. The role is a full-time position and reports to the AP Manager.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Process and validate supplier invoices, ensuring accurate coding, proper approvals, VAT compliance, and high-quality data integrity.

• Manage supplier communication and vendor onboarding, resolving invoice and payment-related queries in a timely, structured, and service-oriented manner while coordinating effectively with internal stakeholders.

• Support month-end closing activities by ensuring Accounts Payable accuracy and timely reporting in line with internal controls and accounting standards.

• Contribute to audit processes by providing documentation, analysis, and reconciliation support to ensure compliance and transparency.

• Drive continuous improvement within Accounts Payable processes by identifying inefficiencies, enhancing controls, and supporting automation or standardization initiatives.

• Ensure adherence to company policies, financial controls, and regulatory requirements, maintaining strong governance within the AP function.

**KEY EXPECTATIONS

**In this role, you take ownership of your workload, manage moderately complex tasks, and help improve processes. You work independently, propose solutions, and adapt quickly when priorities shift. Your solid knowledge makes you a dependable contributor who helps drive team performance.

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

• Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

**ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

• Updating CRM systems (e.g., Dealcloud) with relevant data

• Communicating with investors, e.g. replying to emails, sending invitations to events and press releases

You

You have around 5 years of relevant experience in administrative or coordinating roles, preferably from a consulting firm, law firm, investment bank, large international company or a Ministry/Government Agency. You thrive in a high-paced work environment and are motivated, thorough, and resourceful, with a high level of professionalism and able to handle confidential material discreetly.

We look for the following in a candidate

• Solid knowledge of Office 365 applications

• Excellent communication and time management skills

• Ability to balance responsibilities in a busy environment across various projects with changing priorities

• Ability to grasp the big picture at the same time being thorough with a high attention to detail

• Ability to manage administrative processes and projects independently, at the same time enjoying sparring and collaborating with the team

• Resilient, service minded, proactive and with a positive can-do attitude

The process

Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

Building value that matters

CIP has built a prominent investment team capable of originating proprietary investment opportunities and executing projects and investments based on the team’s industrial background, large industrial network, and extensive experience in structuring, executing, and managing investments within energy infrastructure. In addition, CIP has 17 local project offices globally.

jobs.occupation: Quality Engineer, Automation and IT, at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
If you’re energized by quality, validation, and complex Automation and IT projects in pharma engineering, we’d love to hear from you!

**Who We Are

**We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

**About The Role

**We are looking for an AIT Quality Engineer to join our AIT Project Quality Management team. In this role, you will be responsible for planning, driving, and delivering validation and quality activities within complex Automation and IT projects in the pharmaceutical and life science industry.

You will work as part of multidisciplinary project teams and act as a trusted advisor on validation strategy, GMP compliance, quality risk management, and project quality execution from project initiation through to handover. The role combines hands-on technical validation expertise with project quality management responsibilities, ensuring that deliverables, quality expectations, timelines, and customer requirements are aligned throughout the project lifecycle.

Location Denmark - Kalundborg

Experience Minimum 5 Years

Department AIT Project Quality Management

**How You Might Spend Your Days

**As an AIT Quality Engineer, you’ll be:

• Leading CQV and validation activities for automation, IT, computerized systems, and equipment interfaces in GMP-regulated projects.

• Developing and reviewing validation documentation, including URS, FS/DS, SVP, IQ/OQ/PQ, risk assessments, test protocols, and summary reports.

• Executing qualification and testing activities while ensuring compliance with GMP requirements, industry standards, and customer expectations.

• Collaborating with customers, suppliers, and project teams throughout FAT, SAT, commissioning, validation, and handover.

• Managing validation risks, deviations, compliance issues, and mitigation actions across projects.

**Who You Are

**We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Able to work independently while building strong relationships with stakeholders.

• Comfortable balancing compliance, quality, timelines, and project risks.

• Eager to share knowledge and support the development of colleagues.

• Skilled at communicating complex validation topics in a practical way.

• Motivated by collaboration and delivering high-quality results in project environments.

**What You Bring To The Role

**In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• A B.Sc., M.Sc., or equivalent degree in engineering, IT, life sciences, biotechnology, pharmaceutical sciences, or a related field.

• Experience within CQV, validation, GMP, QA, or project quality management in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or life science industry.

• Hands-on experience preparing and reviewing validation documentation, including URS, FS/DS, SVP, IQ/OQ/PQ, risk assessments, and test protocols.

• Knowledge of GMP, GAMP 5, ISPE guidance, data integrity, quality risk management, and validation lifecycle management.

• Ability to advise customers and project teams on validation strategy, compliance risks, and quality-related decisions.

**Life at NNE

**NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer **here .

****Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

****Deadline of application is 27th November 2026

**Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Rebecca Larsen at +45 31 91 88 47.

**Please note:

**

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

**Fair hiring:

**At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

**Still searching for the right opportunity?

**If this position isn’t quite what you're looking for, but you know someone who would excel in this role, please share this job post. And don’t forget to explore our other exciting opportunities — your future role at NNE might be just around the corner! Visit our Career Site

jobs.occupation: Senior Embedded Software Developer within Real-Time Computer Vision
jobs.description:
Are you a skilled embedded software developer with a passion for cross-platform development for multiple SoC targets? Do you also enjoy turning sophisticated mathematics into high-performing and robust implementations? Do you thrive working with the best of the best in your field in a collaborative setting in the very heart of Copenhagen? If so, we have the opportunity for you!

3Shape is looking for a talented Senior Embedded Software Developer to join our Reconstruction Software Area. As a world leader in this domain, we have driven the field’s evolution for decades and are setting the future standard. This is your opportunity to thrive, learn and contribute to cutting-edge solutions used daily to improve dental health around the world.

You will be joining a collaborative and creative team of over twenty Computer Vision and Software professionals at the absolute forefront. You will team up with great system developers, signal processing experts and mathematicians, many of us with PhDs, forming one of the strongest 3D and computer vision teams in Denmark. Being the leader for decades means our problems yet to be solved and solutions yet to be created are the most challenging and rewarding ones. A challenge we address with collaborative efforts of great minds. In a nutshell, our team turns 2D sensor data into 3D and renders the resulting 3D model. The team has the complete ownership of the area spanning research, signal processing, product development, maintenance, tooling, and test automation. As a member of the Reconstruction Software Area, you will team up with one or more colleagues working on an initiative, which could be a longer-term research project or implementing a product improvement hitting the market near-term. In addition, you will act as a sparring partner on other initiatives and take part in our weekly educational sessions.

About us

At 3Shape we aim to advance dental treatment and diagnostics with advanced software and 3D scanners designed for dental professionals across the globe. Our purpose is to advance innovation in dentistry, continuously enhancing patient care and outcomes.

This role places you at the heart of our technological advancements within Product Creation, namely TRIOS & SCANNER SW, offering the chance to shape the trajectory of our innovative products and software applications.

What You’ll Do

• 
Build real-time 3D computer vision components in C++ and GLSL, targeting both ARM and x86 platforms.

• 
Write, test and benchmark your modules, and take ownership of their performance and accuracy.

• 
Help establish a clean, efficient cross-platform development setup (toolchains, testing, benchmarking and CI) that makes development on every target fast and enjoyable.

• 
Write and optimize demanding shader code for OpenGL and OpenGL ES.

• 
Accelerate CPU algorithms with SIMD (NEON and SSE/AVX), and hand-write intrinsics where the compiler falls short.

• 
Work closely with hardware engineers to get the most out of each target device.

• 
Have fun!

What We’re Looking For

• 
5+ years of professional C++ development on performance-critical applications.

• 
Solid experience with GPU programming in GLSL or a comparable shading language.

• 
Proven experience with streaming and tiling strategies for high performance on devices with limited cache.

• 
A deep understanding of how compiled code maps to the hardware (CPU pipelines, memory access patterns, caching and vectorization) on both ARM and x86.

• 
Experience in computer vision, ideally with registration, filtering and 3D data.

• 
An analytical mindset with attention to performance, scalability and maintainability, and a Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering or a related field.

• 
Curiosity, drive and intellect to understand challenging problems in depth.

Nice To Have

• 
Experience with VTK and its rendering pipeline.

• 
Experience with sparse volumetric data structures and signed distance fields (e.g., OpenVDB, voxel hashing).

• 
Cross-compiling with Clang and CMake, and testing ARM targets with QEMU.

• 
Experience with Eigen.

• 
Knowledge of existing libraries that can be used for cross-platform development.

• 
Experience with SLAM or 3D reconstruction.

What 3Shape Offers

• 
Attractive offices and R&D lab spaces in downtown Copenhagen close to Kgs. Nytorv, Nyhavn, and the Copenhagen Canals.

• 
Good work/life balance e.g., work from home policy for up to 2 days per week.

• 
An international environment with social, diverse, and highly skilled and collaborative colleagues - we are more than 35 nationalities in our DK based office

• 
An attractive healthcare package to keep you fit and well.

• 
Breakfast every day, and delicious and healthy lunch cooked by our private chefs.

• 
We provide a great social work environment with many optional activities and social clubs, ranging from wine & beer, board games, running to bicycle clubs.

• 
Purpose: Endeavor to improve dental patients on a global scale.

Staying true to our values and D&I efforts, we encourage all relevant applicants to apply, and we ask you NOT to add any photos or sensitive information (age, marital status, nationality) during the application process.

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

About us

3Shape started with a simple idea - to make 3D scanning better. First, we applied it to the hearing industry, then we succeeded in dentistry. Twenty years later, 3Shape has 2,000+ employees globally. With the help of dental professionals and amazing colleagues we’re creating award-winning scanning and CAD/CAM solutions to change dentistry together! Together, we contribute to a better world. Experience the everyday #lifeat3Shape across the globe on LinkedIn.

jobs.occupation: PhD positions in Algebraic Hardness and Applications (AHA) at IT University of Copenhagen
jobs.description:
The IT University of Copenhagen invites highly motivated individuals to apply for a PhD position starting in September 1, 2027, or soon thereafter. 

We invite applicants who want to contribute to the IT University's vision of creating and sharing knowledge that is profound and leads to ground-breaking information technology and services for the benefit of humanity. 

Job description
To be eligible to apply for these positions, the applicants are expected to have a good background and passionate interest in mathematics and computer science, demonstrated by having credited relevant courses such as Complexity Theory, Advanced Algorithms, Probability Theory, Real and Complex Analysis, Calculus, and Combinatorics. Or they may be demonstrated by results at the Olympiads of Mathematics or Informatics, or by publication in relevant internationally recognised conferences or journals.

Applicants need to be motivated for doctoral studies; should possess the ability to work independently and perform critical analysis; and additionally, have good levels of communicative abilities and English language skills. The working language of the group is English, and knowledge of English is also fully sufficient to navigate every-day research life in general.

General information
The IT University of Copenhagen (ITU) is a teaching and research-based university specializing in information technology (IT) and the opportunities it offers. The IT University has more than 160 full-time Faculty members. Research and teaching in information technology span all academic activities which involve computers including computer science, information and media sciences, humanities and social sciences, business impact and the commercialization of IT.

Research at the IT University of Copenhagen
Our research is organized through dynamic research groups, centers, hubs, and labs that promote collaboration across disciplines. These units explore complex challenges at the intersection of people, technology, and society, contributing both to fundamental insights and practical solutions. At ITU, we see research as a shared endeavor – open, critically engaged, and rooted in dialogue with academic communities, industry, and the public sector. We actively pursue international partnerships and networks, and our interdisciplinary approach ensures that our research not only advances knowledge but also generates impact beyond academia.

Teaching at the IT University of Copenhagen
ITU currently offers four BSc degrees, six MSc degrees and one professional master’s degree, spanning across these disciplines. ITU's educations are extremely sought after and produces qualified graduates who are in high demand from the job market.

Working at the IT University
Located in modern architecture, a 6-minute metro ride from the center of Copenhagen, the IT University offers an informal working environment, a varied everyday life, and a highly motivated, innovative, skilled, and diverse international faculty, with PhD degrees from more than 20 different countries. The IT University is an equal opportunity employer and prides itself in actively pursuing an improved gender balance among students and among faculty.

Working in Copenhagen
Copenhagen has a solid educational system, a rich cultural life, universal healthcare, good childcare, and well-functioning infrastructure. Copenhagen is consistently ranked among the world’s most livable cities according to the Economist Global Liveability Index. Living and working in Copenhagen will typically be a great experience for you and your family.

Salary and terms of employment
Appointment and salary will be in accordance with the Ministry of Taxation’s agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC) and job structure for academic staff at universities.

Qualification Requirements
The following qualifications are required:

• 
3-year programme: candidates should have an MSc (or equivalent)

• 
4-year programme: candidates should have a BSc and one year of university studies on Master level

 The applicants will be employed and enrolled at the ITU University for a period of 3 or 4 years depending on the university degree level of the applicant. 

Application
The application and all other documents ought to be in English and must include:

• 
A motivated application (cover letter), including a detailed description of your qualifications

• 
A full CV, including name, address, phone number, e-mail, previous and present employment and academic background

• 
Documentation of academic degrees (copy of degree certificates etc.)

• 
A statement of purpose, which provides evidence of independent thinking, novelty and originality, of the targeted research field matching the project description

• 
Documentation of English proficiency (see link below to the PhD Admission Requirements)

• 
Relevant scientific publications or/and master thesis written by the applicant (Not required but optional)

 Applications without the above-mentioned required documents will not be assessed.

Please read the guidelines for applicants carefully before filling in the application form. You can see the guidelines through this link. 

The applicant will be assessed according to the Appointment Order from the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation of 13 March 2012.

The IT University may use shortlisting in connection to the recruitment process. In case of shortlisting, the Chair of the hiring committee selects applicants for assessment in consultation with the hiring committee after the application deadline. All applicants are notified whether their application has been passed for assessment. The shortlisting of candidates for assessment is based on the criteria in the job posting. 

Further information
Questions about the positions can be directed to Professor Nutan Limaye, IT University of Copenhagen, nuli@itu.dk. Early contact with our faculty staff is encouraged.
Questions related to the application procedure may be directed to HR, hr@itu.dk.

Application procedure

You can only apply for this position through our e-recruitment system. Apply by pressing the button "Apply for position" in the job announcement on our website.

The IT University might upon request in the interview process contact 1-2 references.

Application deadline: December 1, 2026, at 23:59 CET.

Applications/enclosures received at ITU after the application deadline will not be taken into consideration. If you submit an application, it is your responsibility to ensure that it arrives before the deadline so please allow sufficient time for the upload of publications and other documents.

At The IT University of Copenhagen, we have an international environment and view diversity as a valuable resource. We are committed to ensuring an inclusive working environment for all our employees and encourage all qualified applicants, regardless of age, gender, religious affiliation, or ethnic background to apply for the position.

As ITU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

Are you passionate about creating structure, driving improvements, and turning ideas into scalable HR processes? Do you thrive in a role that combines operational excellence, project leadership, and innovation?

• 
Strong understanding of HR processes, employee lifecycle management, and HR compliance requirements.

• 
Experience identifying and implementing process automation and digital solutions, preferably including AI-enabled tools.

• 
Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate complex issues into practical solutions.

• 
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

• 
A structured and detail-oriented approach with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

• 
Fluency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

Key competencies:

You are highly organized, proactive, and solution oriented. You enjoy working with both strategic initiatives and hands-on operational tasks, and you can shift seamlessly between the two.

You possess strong project management skills and are comfortable navigating ambiguity, creating structure, and driving execution. You have a collaborative mindset and build trusting relationships across all levels of the organization.

To succeed in this role, we expect you to take ownership, demonstrate sound judgment, and continuously look for opportunities to improve the way we work.

Travel: 5-10 days per year

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, 2900 Hellerup

**We're looking for someone with at least five years of software development experience, including at least two in generative AI and agent-based applications, and a master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.

**

Relevant AI or cloud certifications are a plus. English is our corporate language; however, proficiency in one or more additional languages is a plus for this role.

**What We Offer

**You'll join a fast-growing team backed by Implement Consulting Group — nerdy by nature, genuinely curious about both technology and people, and serious about craft. You'll have real autonomy, a strong culture of learning, and meaningful AI challenges across industries.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the role once filled, so apply ASAP.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**About The Tech Collective

**The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement. We help organisations unlock the immense potential of data, AI and analytics, ensuring that they are fit for the digital future. Through co-creation and passionate advisory, we aim to make our clients’ data easy to handle and provide useful insights.

In our collective, you will find people with a combination of nerdiness and infectious energy. We are passionate about technology, but we also have a sincere interest in people.

Join us in this role where you’ll carry out specialised inspections, up-tower repairs, troubleshooting and other technical activities across different wind turbine sites and platforms. You’ll combine strong technical capability with a safety-first mindset, sound judgement and the resilience to work effectively while travelling internationally.

Welcome to Special Tasks & Inspections

You’ll be part of the ST&I Travel Technician team, where you and your colleagues will deliver specialist inspections, repairs, technical campaigns and turbine support across Ørsted’s wind turbine sites. As a team, we work in smaller groups across different regions and placing strong emphasis on safety, quality, teamwork and professional development. The role provides exposure to different turbine technologies and complex technical challenges, with opportunities to contribute field experience to improved tools, methods and ways of working.

You’ll play an important role in:

• Conducting turbine condition assessments, end-of-warranty, component and specialist inspections, producing accurate technical reports.

• Perform advanced diagnostic inspections, including endoscopic and stethoscope assessments.

• Carrying out up-tower repairs and support specialised mechanical and electrical activities, troubleshooting complex faults and identifying practical solutions.

• Working within Ørsted's ISO 17020 accredited inspection framework, ensuring compliance, quality and impartiality standards are maintained.

• Leading technical activities as a technical lead, team lead or client representative, collaborating closely with site teams, project teams, OEMs, contractors and technical specialists.

• Contributing to the development and improvement of tools, RAMS, AWPs, work instructions, testing activities and innovative ways of working.

• Championing a strong safety culture, sharing technical expertise, maintaining required competencies and authorisations, and challenging or stopping work where safe execution cannot be assured.

To succeed in the role, you:

• Hold a relevant technical qualification or equivalent hands-on experience, with strong knowledge of wind turbine technology, ideally gained on SGRE or Vestas platforms.

• Apply strong fault-finding and problem-solving skills to unfamiliar and complex technical challenges, developing safe, practical and professional solutions.

• Work independently, prioritising activities and making sound technical decisions when support is not immediately available on site.

• Adapt quickly to different sites, teams and cultures, building effective relationships and representing Ørsted professionally with internal and external stakeholders.

• Communicate clearly in English, producing accurate, structured technical reports and inspection documentation.

• Demonstrate a collaborative, hands-on approach while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality and professional conduct.

• Be resilient and adaptable, with the ability to undertake extensive international travel and secure the work permits, visas and travel authorisations required for offshore work in the UK, EU, US and Taiwan.

It's an advantage if you also have:

• Experience with endoscopic inspections, turbine condition assessments and component inspections.

• Experience supporting up-tower repairs, major component replacements, technical campaigns and testing activities.

• Relevant OEM authorisations, experience working under Wind Turbine Safety Rules, or within accredited inspection and quality frameworks.

• Strong IT skills, including digital inspection and reporting tools, and additional language capabilities such as German.

The position involves extensive international travel as part of a 14/14 rotation with 12-hour shifts. Assignments may involve unfamiliar sites, teams and working environments. There will also be situations where you are expected to work independently while abroad, while remaining connected to the wider ST&I team. Due to the international nature of the role, candidates must be able to obtain and maintain the necessary work permits, visas and travel documentation required for assignments across the UK, EU, US and Taiwan.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.

Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process.
