You thrive in a global environment, build strong relationships across diverse stakeholder groups and know how to bring people together around a shared creative direction.

We imagine you bring

• 
Significant experience, typically gained over 8+ years, in retail design, visual merchandising, spatial design, experiential design, or a related creative discipline.

• 
Experience creating retail experiences for premium, fashion, jewellery, lifestyle or other design-led brands.

• 
A strong portfolio demonstrating both conceptual thinking and executed work.

• 
Experience translating campaign or brand ideas into physical retail environments.

• 
Strong stakeholder management and presentation skills.

• 
Experience leading or mentoring creative teams.

• 
Knowledge of the end-to-end process from concept through production and implementation.

• 
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and related creative tools.

• 
Professional fluency in English.

What will make you stand out

A portfolio that demonstrates how you have transformed ideas into compelling physical experiences, connecting storytelling, product, space and customer interaction.

We're looking for someone who can combine creative vision, leadership and execution, bringing bold ideas to life at a global scale.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

You will join a global brand known for combining creativity, craftsmanship and innovation, helping shape inspiring customer experiences that connect people with the stories behind our jewellery. As part of Pandora's Campaign Creative team, you will have the opportunity to influence how our campaigns come to life in stores around the world, creating meaningful moments for millions of customers every day.

Do you want to be a part of the world’s leading jewellery company while putting your experience within Strategic Portfolio Management in Digital & Technology into use? If yes, then we might have an exciting opportunity for you!

You will be part of an exciting and growing business area and work in an international organisation of can-do spirited, passionate, and performance-driven people. We value flexibility, an energised atmosphere and treasure our informal, independent working style. You are trusted to deliver in a setting where answers are not already given but can be found in collaboration with others.

Join the Team Behind the Portfolio

In 2027, we continue to strengthen the larger Delivery & Planning team, a passionate team of thinkers, makers and doers focused on strategy development, portfolio management and delivery excellence across Pandora’s Digital & Technology, linking Pandora’s strategy to execution.

Our portfolio spans initiatives, projects and programmes delivered through agile and traditional methodologies. We work directly with business colleagues, senior stakeholders and digital teams to develop and maintain our portfolio strategy and governance framework, ensuring alignment with Pandora’s strategic priorities.

We are on a mission to provide leadership with clear insights on investments, capacity, risks and dependencies, and facilitate complex cross-domain decisions to mitigate risks and optimise for the best business outcomes.

As our new Interim Senior Manager, Portfolio Management, you will lead the Portfolio Management function and enable decision-making processes that help Pandora’s Digital & Technology portfolio deliver measurable business value.

This is a maternity cover role, expected to run for approximately nine months.

Help Write Our Next Chapter:

• Lead and develop a team of four, fostering a high-performance culture and continuous capability growth.

• Facilitate cross-domain discussions and shape options by providing insights, scenarios and recommendations that support informed decisions.

• Enable portfolio-level capacity planning and workforce alignment in partnership with Finance and HR.

• Develop and maintain the portfolio strategy and value-realisation framework, ensuring investments connect to strategic priorities and OKRs.

• Establish mechanisms for prioritising and planning technology initiatives and facilitate cross-portfolio alignment.

• Conduct portfolio analysis, including early risk identification, dependency management, conflict resolution and financial analysis.

• Maintain a strategic roadmap across the technology portfolio and provide continuous insights into portfolio health, progress and value realisation.

• Continuously optimise portfolio management processes, data and tools in collaboration with the Delivery Enablement team.

We would love if you could bring:

• At least seven years’ experience in Portfolio Management, Product Management or Project Management, supporting large and complex portfolios.

• A strong track record of leading and enabling teams, fostering high performance and capability growth.

• Proven experience engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, including presenting portfolio insights, scenarios and recommendations to leadership.

• A deep understanding of business models, strategic priorities and value drivers.

• The ability to collaborate effectively across Enterprise Architecture, PMO, Product Management and Engineering leadership.

• Experience delivering through both agile and waterfall methodologies.

• In-depth knowledge of technology development lifecycles and portfolio governance best practices.

• Experience in outcome-based planning and measurement, including OKRs.

• Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, as well as tools such as Confluence and Jira.

We know that great talent comes from different backgrounds and experiences. If this role excites you and you can see yourself bringing many of these skills to the team, we would love to hear your story.

Ready to Craft Your Next Career Chapter?

If you can see yourself bringing your expertise, making an impact and contributing to Pandora during this important period, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your application in English. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

The Additional Sparkle

You’ll be based at our Digital & Technology building at Havneholmen in Copenhagen, working alongside talented colleagues in an international and collaborative environment.

Our LEED Gold-certified building is designed to bring people together and provides a modern workplace where you can connect, collaborate and share ideas.

Let’s Craft the Incredible

Pandora is the world’s largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, helping people share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Pandora brings together craftsmanship, innovation and responsible business practices. Join us and bring your expertise, ideas and unique contribution as we continue to craft what comes next

It’s an exciting time to join Tactile. We're a diverse team of storytellers, puzzle enthusiasts, and casual mobile game creators. Our story began in 2008 in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, and since then, we have experienced continuous growth, establishing ourselves as one of the largest gaming companies in Denmark. In more recent years, we have been scaling fast, in large part thanks to the success of a little game called Lily’s Garden. Now we’re on a mission to solidify our position as one of the leaders in creating out-of-the-ordinary casual puzzle games.

With more than 350 talented individuals, we are a mix of over 50 nationalities and 43% women. We truly appreciate the richness of different experiences and perspectives that Tactilers bring to the game. This is why we foster a lean organisational culture, in which each individual is encouraged to take responsibility, be open, and grow in their own way. We pride ourselves on cultivating a studio environment that avoids crunch, fosters your skills regardless of your discipline, and provides a space for you to be creative alongside other passionate and invested storytellers.

🚀 Your role & impact:

We're currently growing our Core team and are on the lookout for another Product Designer to join our team of talented engineers.

The Core team builds the internal tools behind Tactile own LiveOps, Marketing and Data operations, the backbone of our studio. We're looking for a second Product Designer to join Joy and our engineers in designing business-critical tools that every team at Tactile depends on.

This role is based in our Copenhagen office.

How we design:

• Our tools are data-heavy: dashboards, large tables, complex filters, multi-step workflows. Static mockups can't show how they behave with real data, so we prototype first, in code. We use Claude Code and agentic workflows to build working prototypes, and those prototypes are what we hand off to developers. Figma is still where we sketch and brainstorm

• AI amplifies our design. It doesn't do design for us. It lets us take on complex workflows that used to get skipped because they took too much effort

• Quality is not up for debate. We know what good looks like, and we don't ship slop

• Our product design philosophies are inspired by Vercel, Linear and GitHub

This is roughly how we work today. It isn't strict, and we're open to what you bring. Here's a talk that captures our thinking.

Okay, let’s get a little bit more specific. Here’s what you’ll be doing on the day-to-day:

• Research, design and prototype interfaces for our internal tools, then hand working prototypes off to developers

• Work with your team who use our tools to simplify their workflows

• Use AI to explore, iterate and prototype efficiently, while you stay responsible for every design decision and not outsource creative thinking.

• Evolve and contribute to our design system and processes

• We don't have a big UX team, and that's on purpose. You'll work every day with Product Managers, Frontend and Backend engineers, Artists, Game Programmers. We believe good products come from working across disciplines, so we care about the end product, not design operations

What we’re looking for:

• Hands-on experience with technical B2B products: dashboards, tables, filters, dense interfaces

• You care more about the end product than about design process, and you thrive working across disciplines

• Comfortable contributing directly to projects via PRs to improve designs or UX without waiting for programmers to implement them

• Experience in designing with Claude Code or similar agentic tools

• Real openness to agentic workflows, without an "AI produces slop" mindset

• Comfort prototyping in code, or a strong drive to learn

• A sharp eye for high design craft, quality, and candour when something isn't good enough

You'll make us extra excited if you also have:

• Experience in using Figma/Figma Make or similar design tools

• Programmer background, comfortable diving into fronted code if necessary

• Know-how of shadcn, Untitled UI or similar SaaS UI libraries

What’s in it for you?

🌆 Beautiful office space with probably the best view in Copenhagen

🩺 Pension and private health insurance

💻 A chance to work with the latest tools and technology

📚 Opportunities for individual growth with development talks as well as workshops, books and courses

🌮 Daily, healthy organic breakfast and lunch prepared by our professional chefs in-house

🥳 Social activities, including game nights, book club, Friday bar and more

🔍 Free Danish lessons with our in-house Danish teacher

Our interview process

Submit your application via the fill-in form at the top of this page. This is the easiest and fastest way to get in touch with our recruiters. We foster an inclusive culture and accessible workplace and want to make sure we provide everyone with the same opportunities for success. This is why we encourage you to apply regardless of your gender, sexuality, age, nationality, neurodiversity or disability. We review applications based on competencies and experience, so please do tell us about your favorite projects and technologies.

After we review your application, you can expect to go through the following conversations:

☕ Introductory coffee chat, primarily to ensure that we’re aligned on the scope of the role and that all of your questions are answered.

🧪 In person technical interview (mix of design whiteboarding and designing with AI) with Joy, your future product design colleague, and Gab, Core Team Lead.

💜 The final conversation will be with your future team, to discuss if you’re aligned on values and ways of working.

We are thorough in our hiring process, as it's essential to us that we select new Tactilers carefully - just as it is vital to ensure that we are the right place for you.

We want to ensure you have a great candidate experience whilst in our recruitment process. We will do everything within reason to ensure that your interview takes place in an environment that fairly and accurately assesses your skills. If you need assistance or accommodation, please let us know.

We look forward to receiving your application! 👋

jobs.occupation: Senior Process Automation Engineer in DCS at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
Senior Process Automation Engineer in DCS, Novo Nordisk Engineering

Do you want to be a part of NNE’s all-time largest Process Automation team? We are looking for colleagues to join our fantastic company, where we have the aspiration of becoming best in class within Automation Solutions for Pharmaceutical Engineering.

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

You will be working in an enthusiastic Process Automation team with more than 80 colleagues in Denmark. Globally, the Process Automation team has more than 200 employees.

The Process Automation team works with consultancy, design & development, implementation and validation of Automation solutions for the Pharma and Biotech industries. Our work is project based, and currently we are looking into an exciting pipeline of large data driven, greenfield plants with modular/scalable designs.

We are skilled in a broad range of process areas within API production e.g. fermentation, recovery and purification, utility, and cleaning systems. And the solutions we provide to our customers are always based on a deep understanding of the customers’ production processes – and if standard components can’t do the job, we develop our own.

How you might spend your days

As a DCS Senior Process Automation Engineer, you’ll be:

• Advising customers on their application process solutions

• Design developing, programming, commissioning, qualifying, FAT, SAT, UAT and Handover of applications for Distributed Control Systems (DCS)

• Interacting with process experts and colleagues with expertise in surrounding systems and equipment like MES, Historian systems, instruments, production equipment etc.

• Developing and optimizing automation methods and strategies to meet our customers’ needs and sharing working knowledge with colleagues and partners

• Forming the basis of automation strategies and architectures to support our sister departments internationally and expand NNE’s Process Automation engagement

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you:

• Understand your colleagues’ individual and cultural difference

• Are aware of your surroundings and able to flag any concerns

• Are agile and able to prioritize urgent tasks

• Are team-oriented and able to collaborate on team projects

• Are reliable, curious and eager to learn

• Are appreciative of feedback, because it contributes to your growth

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• You have 6+ years or more of working experience and hold a degree as an engineer, ideally within electrical, automation, process or marine engineering

• You have 4 years or more of working experience with PCS/DCS Application development (for example ABB 800xA or ABB SattLine), working in GMP/GAMP environment or with execution of Automation projects

• Knowledge of batch production is valued

• You find the complexity of the GMP/GAMP environment exciting

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 13th December 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Christian Ljørring on +45 30 79 29 08 or Manager Rasmus Sølbeck Hansen +45 31 91 89 30

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

FPRT is a Danish-based defense technology company, part of the international Fire Point Group — a fast-growing ecosystem born out of Ukraine’s innovation and resilience. The group was founded by engineers and entrepreneurs who, during the first months of the full-scale war, decided to use their expertise to create advanced defense technologies — including long-range drones and precision systems.

About FPRT

FirePoint Rocket Technology is building a new advanced defence manufacturing facility in Denmark. As we grow towards 300+ employees, we are looking for a hands-on Payroll & HR Operations Specialist to establish reliable people processes and support our transition to a multi-shift production environment.

Reporting to the CHRO, you will work closely with Finance, managers and external payroll and benefits providers. This is an opportunity to shape HR operations from an early stage, not simply maintain existing processes.

What you’ll do

• Coordinate the monthly Danish payroll process, checking salaries, shifts, overtime, allowances and payroll data with our external provider.

• Own accurate time and attendance administration in WorkLinq, working with managers to resolve discrepancies.

• Manage essential HR administration, including contracts, employee changes, pension and benefits coordination, and offboarding.

• Keep employee records and HR systems accurate, organised and compliant with Danish requirements and collective agreements.

• Improve everyday HR processes and reporting as the workforce grows, supporting a potential future transition to in-house payroll.

What we’re looking for

• 3-5+ years of hands-on experience with Danish payroll and HR administration; manufacturing or shift-based experience is an advantage.

• Working knowledge of Danish employment, tax, pension and payroll practices, including collective agreements.

• Confidence using payroll, HR and time-registration systems; experience with WorkLinq or similar tools is welcome.

• Strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy and a practical, service-minded approach.

• Strong language skills in Danish and English, oral and written

Why join FPRT?

• Build scalable payroll and HR operations for a new high-tech manufacturing site.

• Have direct impact on the employee experience and how a growing company operates.

• Work with an international team on a project supporting European security and defence.

• Competitive compensation and a new facility in Vojens.

Interested? We would be pleased to hear from candidates who enjoy combining accurate execution with building better ways of working.

Practical Information

• Full-time position with an immediate start.

• Location: Vojens, Denmark.

• Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application as soon as possible.

• Temp-Team is assisting FPRT with this recruiment so during the initial phases of the recruitment process will be done by Temp-Team and all contact must go via Temp-Team.

Temp-Team

Temp-Team A/S is a national recruitment and staffing agency with eight local departments in Denmark. We have 45 years of experience within staffing and cover a wide range of industries. We focus on delivering high quality and a close personal contact to candidates and clients.

Temp-Team is a part of JuhlerGroup – an international group of recruitment agencies.

The position is based in Roskilde or Warsaw at BEC Financial Technologies' headquarters. The position is organizationally anchored in Service Integration & Security with reference to the Head of Projects & Continuity.

The Service Integration & Security area is responsible for ensuring robust, reliable, and compliant operations across BEC. We work closely with stakeholders across the organization to strengthen operational resilience, including business continuity, IT disaster recovery, crisis management, and risk governance.

As Business Continuity Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring that BEC can continue critical operations during and after disruptive incidents. You will drive the development, implementation, and maintenance of BEC’s continuity framework and collaborate across all domains, programs, and areas.

At BEC, we prefer to collaborate often in the office, while also offering the opportunity to work remotely on average up to 1 day per week.

Primary tasks and responsibilities include:

Continuity & resilience framework:

• Implementing and maintaining BEC’s business continuity management framework

• Maintaining governance for continuity-related processes (Business Continuity, IT Disaster Recovery, Crisis Management, Business Impact Analysis, IT redundancy, Backup & Restore)

• Developing and maintaining Business Continuity Plans (BCPs), Disaster Recovery Plans (DRPs), and Crisis Management Plans

• Defining and maintaining technical requirements for backup and restore processes, including backup scope, retention, encryption, immutability, recovery procedures, and restore validation

• Translating business impact and recovery objectives into technical IT disaster recovery requirements, dependencies, and recovery sequencing

• Defining and assessing redundancy requirements for critical infrastructure, applications, data, and third-party services, including identification of single points of failure and failover capabilities

• Ensuring compliance with relevant standards and regulations (e.g., ISO 22301)

Coordination & stakeholder engagement:

• Coordinating with stakeholders across 1st line, IT, and support functions to assess risks and define recovery strategies

• Collaborating with system owners, SMEs, and process owners to ensure alignment between business and IT recovery capabilities

Testing, exercises & continuous improvement:

• Facilitating continuity, IT disaster recovery, and crisis exercises (e.g., table-top tests and simulations)

• Planning and evaluating technical recovery tests, including backup restore tests, component and service failover, and end-to-end disaster recovery exercises

• Ensuring lessons learned from incidents and exercises are incorporated into the framework

• Driving continuous improvement of continuity capabilities.

Governance, reporting & insight:

• Delivering reporting and presentations on continuity readiness, and performance

• Supporting management with insights into operational resilience, and recovery capabilities

To succeed you will have:

• Experience working with business continuity, IT disaster recovery, or operational resilience

• Knowledge of continuity frameworks, BIA, BCP, DRP, and Crisis Management practices

• Solid technical understanding of enterprise backup and restore processes, including backup architecture, retention, replication, encryption, immutability, recovery validation, and common failure scenarios

• Experience reviewing or developing technical IT disaster recovery plans, including recovery architectures, system dependencies, recovery sequencing, and alignment with RTO and RPO targets

• Ability to assess redundancy and resilience designs across infrastructure, networks, applications, databases, and cloud services, and to identify single points of failure

• Capability to challenge technical solutions and document clear, testable recovery, backup, restore, and redundancy requirements in collaboration with architects, engineers, system owners, and service providers

• Experience facilitating workshops, or cross-organizational processes

• Stakeholder management skills and can collaborate across technical and business domains

• Structure, analytical skills, and ability to translate complex risks into clear actions

• A proactive approach and capability of driving initiatives across the organization

• Ability to communicate clearly in English, both written and spoken

It’s nice-to-have:

• Experience with enterprise backup platforms, storage technologies, high-availability solutions, infrastructure, or cloud recovery patterns

• Experience from the financial sector or a regulated IT environment

• Familiarity with IT Service Management processes

The role will offer:

• A key role in strengthening BEC’s operational resilience and continuity capabilities

• High visibility across the organization and interaction with senior stakeholders

• The opportunity to shape and evolve BEC’s continuity practices

• A collaborative environment with strong professional expertise

• A role with tangible impact on BEC’s ability to operate under disruption

Be your best self with BEC's benefits!

We offer a diverse range of benefits for our employees. Here are just a few of them.

• Professional development budget

• Healthy, varied lunch and fruit in the canteen

• Active staff associations: yoga, cycling, go-karting, games, bowling etc.

• Pension scheme

• Health and dentist insurance

• Referral bonus

What does the recruitment process look like?

• Send us your CV: We want to get to know you

• Screening call: Let's chat and see if we're a match

• Meet your future manager and team: See who you'll be working closely with.

• Personality and cognitive test: Let's learn more about you.

• Meet our talent partner and your future manager once more: Get feedback on your test results.

• Time to sign the contract: We're ready to welcome you to BEC!

If you have any questions related to the position, please contact Head of Projects & Continuity, Kim Bastholm on +45 61 56 76 10.

BEC is in the process of being acquired by our largest customer and co-owner, Nykredit, which is Denmark's largest mortgage provider and third-largest bank. We will become part of a new and larger organization called Nykredit Financial Technologies. In the transition phase, we are recruiting for roles that we expect to be highly needed in our future organization.

Application due: 12/11/2026

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world. Capgemini’s Global Insights & Data business line is a market leader in data, analytics, and cloud platforms across multiple industries, including financial services, life sciences, consumer products, utilities, and the public sector.

Your Role

As a Data Architect, you will work with leading organizations to design and govern enterprise-grade data architectures that enable analytics, reporting, operational data products, real-time processing, and AI-driven use cases. You will combine strategic architectural ownership with hands-on collaboration, translating business needs into scalable designs and ensuring alignment across platforms, teams, and standards.

As a key part of your activities, you will act as a trusted technical advisor, translate business and AI-use cases into scalable architecture designs, review data pipelines and models for alignment with standards, and contribute to documentation, design reviews, and architectural decision-making forums.

In this role you will play a key role in:

• Define and evolve enterprise data architecture including principles, standards, and reference models, ensuring consistent alignment across platforms, teams, and business objectives

• Design end-to-end data solutions and modern lakehouse architectures that support batch, streaming, real-time processing, and AI-driven use cases

• Lead event-driven and real-time data strategies, while ensuring that architectures are scalable, secure, and compliant with regulatory and governance requirements

• Establish and govern standards across data modeling, SQL, metadata, lineage, data quality, and security, while defining approaches for schema evolution, temporal data modeling, incremental processing, and resilient data pipelines

Your profile

• Extensive experience with enterprise data platforms, including several years in architecture-focused roles, designing solutions that support advanced analytics and AI use cases

• Strong understanding of modern data platform principles, including lakehouse architecture, event-driven and streaming patterns, and real-time processing strategies for analytics and AI applications

• Strong proficiency in SQL and data modeling patterns, including Star schema (Kimball), Data Vault, hybrid approaches, and temporal data models (e.g., SCD Type 2), with the ability to design models that support both traditional BI and AI/ML workloads

• Solid knowledge of data governance and compliance, covering metadata management, data lineage, quality, and audit requirements to ensure trusted and usable data across platforms

• Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Platform) combined with strong communication skills, enabling translation of complex technical concepts into clear architectural guidance for technical and business stakeholders

What we believe you will enjoy about working here

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you can shape your career, work with a diverse collective of experts, and help leading organizations unlock the value of data responsibly.

At Capgemini, you will:

• Work on enterprise-scale, mission-critical data platforms

• Influence data architecture standards across industries

• Balance innovation with regulatory and operational excellence

• Be a part of a collaborative culture that values innovation, entrepreneurship, and continuous learning

Application

If you are ready to take the next step in your career, leading organizations to design and govern enterprise-grade data architecture, we look forward to receiving your application.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

As part of our recruitment process, identity verification will be conducted through inspection of your ID card, and background checks may be carried out as require

Dalea · BioInnovation Institute, Copenhagen · Full-time

Starts when our funding round closes

Build full-stack AI agents for science, with freedom, room to be creative, and real ownership, in a lively startup in Copenhagen.

An AI agent is only as useful to a scientist as the data it can see and trust. Dalea gives research labs structured data with full provenance, and we want AI co-scientists that do real scientific work on top of it. You'll own the AI side of that.

What you'll own

• 
The agent harness and the framework for AI co-scientist agents, from architecture to the workflows they run.

• 
Our MCP integrations, which give agents access to lab data with a traceable record of what they do.

• 
Model choices: following the field, testing new models against what labs actually need, and adopting what works.

• 
How we evaluate AI quality.

• 
The infrastructure the AI runs on: inference, model serving and agent execution.

• 
Full-stack work wherever the AI needs deeper integration with the platform, and help elsewhere when the team needs it.

What you bring

Must-haves

• 
You've designed and built an LLM agent system used in production, and made the architecture decisions yourself.

• 
Strong full-stack TypeScript (React, Next.js or close equivalents), and you're comfortable in Python.

• 
You've owned the direction of a technical area, including a significant rework.

• 
You've shipped quickly in a small team or an early-stage product.

Nice to have (none of them required)

• 
MCP servers or clients, agent frameworks or harness tooling (open source counts)

• 
Tools for scientists, or a background in bioinformatics, computational biology or AI for science

• 
Mastra or another TypeScript agent framework

• 
Open-weight models, through inference APIs or self-hosting

• 
Kubernetes

• 
Systems where provenance or audit trails matter

You don't need lab or biology knowledge, a PhD or Danish. Hands-on, shipped work counts more than research or publications. If you match the must-haves, apply, even if you have none of the nice-to-haves.

Our stack

TypeScript, Next.js and React. Python for our MCP service. An agent harness built on Mastra. Docker Compose and Kubernetes, hosted on Scaleway.

How we work

Our dev team is the two founders plus up to three new developers, led by our CTO. We discuss progress and priorities closely and continuously, and we expect you to take part: share ideas early, argue for what you think is right, and change course when the evidence says so.

You won't need permission to fix what's broken, and what you build reaches production quickly. We work together at BioInnovation Institute 3–5 days a week. We're building the team and the way we work, and that happens best in person.

About Dalea

Dalea is a data management platform for biology and lab workflows. Experiments, structured data, samples and inventory sit in one place, with full data provenance. Everything a lab builds in Dalea can be packaged and shared, so we're building a GitHub for life science: labs publish and reuse each other's workflows instead of rebuilding them from scratch. We work with biotech startups, academic labs, pharma R&D and CROs.

Timing and our funding round

This position depends on our current funding round closing, which we expect in February/March 2027. We can make a conditional offer before then, and we'll be open with you about the timing throughout the process.

What we offer

• 
Salary: DKK 725,000–900,000 per year, depending on experience

• 
Warrants: under the Danish §7P scheme

• 
Pension: through ASE

• 
Location: BioInnovation Institute, Copenhagen, on-site 3–5 days a week. You'll need to live in the Copenhagen area or be willing to move here. We're happy to hear from people relocating within the EU.

• 
Language: English

•

Working at

Dalea

A data platform for life science research, where experiments, data and workflows stay structured, traceable and easy to share. Dalea is a data management platform for research in biotech, pharma and academic labs. Scientists keep experiments, structured data, samples and inventory in one place, with full data provenance, in tools that feel familiar to anyone coming from Excel and Word. Today, much of that work is scattered across spreadsheets, personal computers and paper notebooks. Results are hard to find and harder to trust, so teams often re-run experiments rather than track down the ones they’ve already done. In Dalea, everything a lab builds can be packaged and shared: templates, add-ons and whole workflows. Labs can publish, discuss and reuse each other’s work instead of rebuilding it from scratch. Think of it as a GitHub for life science. The same structured, traceable data is what lets AI agents work reliably on real lab data. Dalea is built for regulated research. It has a full audit log, 21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11 compliant infrastructure, and full provenance for everything that happens in the platform. It’s hosted in the EU. We’re a small team at BioInnovation Institute in Copenhagen, working with biotech startups, academic labs, pharma R&D teams and CROs.

Dalea · BioInnovation Institute, Copenhagen · Full-time·

Keep a Part 11 and Annex 11 compliant lab data platform secure, reliable and trusted, and own the infrastructure it runs on.

Our ISO 27001 certification and the controls behind it.

Hands-on security engineering: access control, encryption, logging and incident response.

Hands-on experience with ISO 27001 or SOC 2, or with GxP and regulated software (computer system validation, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11). One of the two is enough.

Kubernetes

TypeScript or Python

jobs.occupation: Senior Group Financial Controller with consolidation focus
jobs.description:
R30528 Senior Group Financial Controller with consolidation focus, GN

Do you want to make your financial knowledge count? Imagine a possibility where you will be responsible for financial excellence by supporting and further developing the finance function in a global organization.

The team you will be part of

As a Senior Group Financial Controller at GN, you will join Group Finance and take a central role in ensuring accurate, timely and high-quality consolidated financial reporting.

Working closely with local finance teams, Group controllers and external auditors, you will drive the consolidation process while helping to simplify, standardise and strengthen the Group’s closing and reporting set-up.

Your contribution is appreciated and your responsibilities will include:

Consolidation, closing and Group reporting

You will own and drive the monthly, quarterly and annual Group consolidation process, ensuring a robust, efficient and well-documented close.

You will:

• Lead and coordinate the Group consolidation process, from entity reporting to consolidated reporting

• Review reporting from Group entities and perform consolidation entries, including intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translation and other Group adjustments.

• Support the preparation of the consolidated financial statements

• Act as a on of the key point of contact for subsidiaries during the closing process, providing guidance on reporting and consolidation matters

• Support the transition of selected consolidation and reporting activities from external providers to an in-house Group Finance set-up

Process optimisation and reporting development

A key part of the role is to make the closing and reporting process faster, simpler and more reliable.

You will:

• Identify and drive improvements to closing, consolidation and reporting processes, including automation and standardisation opportunities

• Develop and maintain reporting packages in the consolidation system and process documentation

• Support the development and maintenance of consolidation and reporting systems and act as a key user where relevant

Financial controlling and collaboration

In close collaboration with other Group controllers, you will support the review and quality assurance of financial reporting from subsidiaries.

You will:

• Review and challenge selected financial information reported by subsidiaries

• Follow up on reporting issues, unusual developments and data-quality matters

• Contribute to the continued development of controls, governance and documentation within the Group reporting process

To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:

You are structured, proactive and analytical, with a strong sense of ownership and quality. You enjoy working with fixed deadlines, multiple stakeholders and continuous process improvement.

Moreover, you have a keen sense of quality, and you:

• Hold a master’s degree in finance, accounting, auditing, or a similar field

• Have several years of relevant experience from Group consolidation, financial reporting, or an international audit firm

• Have hands-on experience with consolidation processes and a good understanding of the flow from local entity reporting to Group reporting

• Have experience with financial reporting systems. Experience with systems such as OneStream, HFM or Microsoft Dynamics is an advantage

• Are comfortable working independently, driving tasks to completion and collaborating across functions and geographies

• Speak and write fluent English

We encourage you to apply

Even if you don’t match all the above-mentioned skills, we welcome your application if you think you have transferrable skills. We highly value a mindset and motivation that align with our core values, to not only ensure growth for you, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting invitation to interview.

How to apply?

To apply, use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than 19 November 2026. Applications are assessed on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to send yours.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.

Join us in bringing people closer

GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhance the senses of hearing and sight. We enable people with hearing loss overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses and provide great experiences for audio and gaming enthusiasts.

GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 7 years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience.

• Experience building business cases through workshops or product demos to business executives.

• Experience developing partnerships with technical stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists).

• Experience positioning and selling technical solutions in data management, analytics, infrastructure, or AI/ML.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience positioning modern cloud data platforms, lakehouses, real-time streaming, or GenAI platforms against legacy or other proprietary enterprise systems.

• Experience working with Global System Integrators, hyperscalers, or ISVs to co-sell and accelerate pipeline.

• Experience closing large-scale data and AI transformation deals within specific regulated or high-growth enterprise verticals (e.g., Financial Services, Healthcare/Life Sciences, Retail, or Manufacturing).

• Practical understanding of how modern cloud architectures, data governance (e.g., cataloging, lineage, compliance), and clean data estates enable AI and real-time analytics.

• Ability to communicate in English and Danish or Swedish fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

About The Job

As the Agentic Data Cloud Sales Specialists team, we work together with Field Sales Representatives (Account Managers), Customer Engineers, and our partners to help our customers modernize their operational and analytical data foundations on GCP. We enable them to transition to modern, unified cloud architectures that position data as the absolute foundation for AI success and power next-generation AI and intelligent applications. As a master of complex lakehouse solutions, data governance, and AI, you are the exact sales expert we need to translate technical capabilities into high-impact business outcomes.

You will be at the forefront of driving Google Cloud's most critical data and AI growth. In this role, you will drive growth by securing net-new greenfield logos and identify untapped, uncommitted workloads. You will partner with Field Sales Representatives, Customer Engineers, and Partners to execute joint Data+AI plays that establish long-term data platform standardization.

You are a master of value-selling. You will engage with line-of-business (LoB) leaders, CDO, CAIO, and CFO to discover critical pain points, build robust business cases (ROI/TCO reduction), and demonstrate the quantifiable business value of modernizing data estates on GCP.

Additionally, you will guide technical stakeholders and position Google Cloud's Agentic Data Cloud suite (BigQuery, Knowledge Catalog, Borderless Lakehouse, Spanner, AlloyDB) as the premium data intelligence platform for AI. You will present demos that showcase how unified, well-governed data foundations power secure, hallucination-free AI agents and real-time experiences.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Denmark: kr.860000 - kr.880000 (DKK) + 100% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

• Deliver against quota and achieve or exceed strategic business and growth goals. Drive net-new greenfield logos and workloads in existing accounts through proactive campaigns.

• Run complex, multi-threaded business cycles from initial discovery and value hypothesis to ROI business case creation and commercial close.

• Engage business leaders, Chief Data Officer, Chief Financial Officer, Chief Marketing Officer, Chief AI Officer, through value-selling, tying modern Data & AI capabilities to quantified business outcomes.

• Align cross-functionally with FSRs and partners to execute joint Data+AI plays, driving platform standardization and co-sell motions.

• Whiteboard modern architectures (BigQuery, Spark, Spanner, AlloyDB) to demonstrate how unified data foundations power high-performance, hallucination-free AI agents.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

**The Impact You'll Make

**Join Danfoss Power Solutions as our Director, BU Controlling (f/m/d) and help shape the financial performance and strategic direction of a global business. This role offers flexibility to be based at a Danfoss Power Solutions location within the European time zone, enabling close collaboration with business leaders and finance teams across our global organization.

Partnering closely with the VP of the Valves & Pumps (VPS) Business Unit, you will drive transparency across performance, profitability, and risk, turning financial complexity into actionable insights that support confident decision-making and **profitable growth.

**You will also help build and develop a high-performing global controlling community, strengthening financial capabilities across the organization while supporting business performance through coaching, governance, and matrix leadership.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Drive business performance through financial analysis, forecasting, and strategic planning that enables better decisions and profitable growth

• Challenge business and plant leaders with data-driven insights, helping identify opportunities, improve profitability, and mitigate risks

• Coach and develop controllers across a global matrix organization, strengthening capabilities and fostering a high-performing controlling community

• Provide clear visibility into financial performance, ensuring accurate reporting and transparency across key business metrics

• Strengthen financial governance, controls, and continuous improvement initiatives that support operational excellence and long-term value creation

**What We're Looking For

**

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline

• Proven track record of driving business performance through controlling, finance business partnering, or finance leadership within a manufacturing, industrial, or engineering environment

• Strong expertise in financial planning, forecasting, profitability analysis, performance management, and risk management

• Proven ability to influence and constructively challenge senior stakeholders while building trusted relationships across a global matrix organization

• Experience coaching and developing finance professionals, strengthening capabilities, and driving results through influence and collaboration

**What You'll Get From Us

**At Danfoss, you join a purpose-driven company committed to driving sustainable transformation and long-term growth. In this role, you will work closely with senior leaders and influence decisions that shape the direction and performance of a global business.

You will be part of a highly skilled, international finance community, with opportunities to influence senior stakeholders, contribute to global initiatives, and strengthen both people and organizational capabilities.

**Furthermore

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you're excited about combining financial leadership with real business impact, we'd love to hear from you. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Your perspective, experience, and ambition could be exactly what we're looking for.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

**Use your skills to revolutionize HR with Team Spirit and Innovation at NTT DATA

**Are you ready to be a part of a team that is reshaping the world of HR, making a real impact for our clients? As our new Employee Central consultant, you will get to combine leadership, technical expertise and business understanding with your genuine mentor mentality.

Our culture is laid-back yet professional, with room for a good laugh and a shared commitment to excellence. **Specifically, You Will

**Will you give us the opportunity to let you shine?

**Applicants are assessed continuously, so do not wait! Apply now and take the first step towards a fulfilling career with us at NTT DATA Business Solutions. We are excited to welcome you and see what we can achieve together.

**At NTT DATA Business Solutions, we believe our strength lies in our diversity. jobs.occupation: Følsgaard is looking for a Customer Relations & Order Manager – MarineTech
jobs.description:
Do you build the kind of customer relationships where trust makes the difference?

At MarineTech, we are looking for a Customer Relations & Order Manager who will take responsibility for a small portfolio of key customers and ensure an excellent customer experience from agreement to delivery.

This is not a traditional sales role focused on hunting for new business. Your success will come from knowing your customers, understanding their needs and business, and building strong, long-term relationships based on trust, reliability and professional advice.

Your role

You will be the customer’s primary point of contact and trusted advisor, working closely with colleagues, suppliers and partners to make sure everything comes together.

You will combine customer relationship management with hands-on responsibility for orders, forecasts and deliveries. This means staying close to your customers, anticipating their needs and ensuring that commitments are followed through.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

• Build, maintain and develop strong relationships with existing customers

• Act as the customer’s primary contact and advise on products, solutions and delivery options

• Manage orders from A to Z, including requirements, prices, terms, documentation and delivery

• Follow up on customer forecasts and coordinate internally to support material and delivery planning

• Coordinate closely with customers, suppliers and internal teams

• Proactively keep customers informed about quotations, orders, deliveries and deviations

• Maintain accurate customer, order and activity data in ERP and CRM

• Identify opportunities to further develop existing customer accounts

• Look forward to 10–15 travel days per year as an opportunity to meet customers, build stronger relationships and get closer to their business.

You probably have experience from B2B customer management, order coordination, sales or customer service. More importantly, you enjoy building relationships and creating a customer experience where people know they can rely on you.

We imagine that you:

• Have experience working with B2B customers and coordinating orders or deliveries

• Have a good commercial understanding and an interest in technical products and solutions

• Are comfortable working with ERP and CRM systems and structured follow-up

• Ideally have experience coordinating with suppliers, carriers and complex deliveries

• Communicate professionally in both Danish and English

As a person

You are outgoing and approachable and naturally create good relationships with customers and colleagues. You are service-minded without losing sight of the commercial perspective.

At the same time, you are structured and proactive. You take ownership, keep an overview when several things are happening at once, and make sure agreements and commitments are followed through to completion.

Why this role?

• help students operate the tools introduced in the course and

• Good command of English and Danish, both oral and written

• Familiarity with the course materials as well as the digital tools introduced: previous attendance of Digital Archives and Methods or equivalent is recommended.

jobs.occupation: Student Assistant as Administrative Assistant in Project Management Office at AU Herning
jobs.description:
The Project Management Office at AU Herning is looking for a student assistant to carry out various administration projects as they relate to various research projects, project administration, and course administration at AU Herning.

We are looking for a student assistant who can assist with the following tasks:

• Various administration tasks with the PMO team

• Administration work on different research grants, both within Denmark and the EU

• Daily administrative tasks using Microsoft Suite, Adobe, and other programs

• SOME management for international research projects

• Regular communication with international partners for research projects

• Regular administrative tasks such as data entry, data gathering, and testing interfaces.

• Assistant with planning and working events hosted by the department

Who we are looking for:

• You must be enrolled at AU Herning

• You must thrive in an environment where precision and accuracy is important, and you can stay focused and selfdirected on various tasks

• You have good analytical skills

• Have a good grasp on the English language

Who we are

BTECH is part of Aarhus BSS, Aarhus University – a top 100 university. Aarhus BSS has achieved the triple-crown AASCB, AMBA and EQUIS accreditations.

BTECH is located in the business-oriented and entrepreneurial city of Herning. The department excels in business, IT and engineering disciplines and emphasises the importance of company collaborations. We have around 1,200 students and close to 100 academic staff members. Each year, approximately 500 students are involved in company projects in more than 250 companies ranging from SMEs to leading multinationals. Our incubator Business Factory launches 10 new companies each year.

We influence society through business development and technology. For this reason, many research projects are conducted in close collaboration with industry on the basis of new data and new technologies. These projects are generously supported by the ERC, Horizon Europe, the Independent Research Fund Denmark and the Danish Industry Foundation, among others.

More information about BTECH is available here.

Further information

For further information about the position and the department, please contact Emily Tynes: tel. +45 4189 3353; email emily@btech.au.dk

If you need help uploading your application or have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Supporter, Charlotte Thomsen, tel.: +45 8716 5362; email: charlotte@au.dk.

Practical information

Starting date as soon as possible and no later than 1 December 2025.

The average number of working hours is 8 hours weekly.

The place of work is Birk Centerpark 15, 7400 Herning

It is a permanent position which means for as long as you are a student.

Application deadline

15 November 2026

Application

If you are interested in applying for the position, please send:

• A short motivated application

• CV

• Enrolment certification

Terms of employment

You will be employed as an hourly-paid student assistant under the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Organisations of Public Employees – Denmark (OAO-S Collective Agreement, State Sector), as well as the organisational agreement for clerical employees, laboratory technicians and IT staff (HK).

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

Aarhus University

Aarhus University is an academically diverse and research-intensive university with a strong commitment to high-quality research and education and the development of society nationally and globally. The university offers an inspiring research and teaching environment to its 37,000 students (FTEs) and 8,700 employees and has an annual revenue of EUR 1.106 billion. Employment is in accordance with the Ministry of Finance and SUL Finansministeriet og SUL (student instructors).

Aarhus University aims to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for everyone and strives for a culture where each individual can thrive and develop. The Faculty of Arts is one of Northern Europe’s most significant faculties for research and higher education in the humanities, theology and education. Are you ready to shape the tax function of an international shipping company?

Clipper is enhancing its internal tax capability as part of a continued focus on strengthening governance and decision support across the organisation. We are therefore looking for a dedicated and hands-on Tax Manager to be based at Clipper’s headquarters in Copenhagen.

Today, tax matters at Clipper are handled across Finance, Legal and external advisors. With increasing regulatory complexity and risk exposure, we are establishing a more formalized and proactive tax function. The Tax Manager will play a key role in building this capability and embedding robust tax governance across the organization.

You will report directly to the CFO and work closely with the Head of Legal & Corporate Affairs and Head of Controlling and external advisors.

What will be your responsibilities

You will be responsible for both strategic and operational tax matters across Clipper’s global activities. Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

• Establish and maintain Clipper’s tax governance framework, including a tax risk register and clear processes for identifying, assessing and managing tax risks.

• Review the tax implications of material transactions and challenge tax positions and advice from external advisors where relevant.

• Own and oversee transfer pricing policies, intercompany agreements, benchmarking and documentation.

• Monitor and manage cross-border tax matters, including withholding tax, freight tax and permanent establishment risks.

• Oversee compliance with Danish tonnage tax requirements, including calculations, documentation and relevant controls.

• Coordinate corporate tax, VAT and employment tax compliance and reporting across jurisdictions, ensuring timely filings and robust documentation.

• Advise on tax matters related to international employee mobility and contractor arrangements.

• Monitor relevant tax and regulatory developments, including OECD Pillar Two and environmental and emissions-related taxes, and assess their impact on Clipper.

• Act as Clipper’s internal tax expert and trusted sparring partner, advising management on tax implications of strategic and operational decisions.

What we are looking for

At Clipper, our employees shape our work environment, so bringing a positive attitude is essential.

• We imagine that you have a relevant educational background within finance, tax, business administration, law or similar, combined with solid experience in corporate and international tax.

• You have hands-on experience with tax governance and tax risk management, combined with strong knowledge of transfer pricing, cross-border taxation and international tax principles.

• You are comfortable working with external advisors while also challenging and validating tax positions when needed.

• You are structured and analytical, but also pragmatic and commercially minded.

• You enjoy taking ownership, working independently and turning complex tax matters into practical advice and solutions for the business.

• You communicate confidently across functions and levels of the organisation and are fluent in both Danish and English.

• Shipping experience, including knowledge of tonnage tax or other shipping-specific tax matters, is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Don’t meet every single requirement?

If you’re enthusiastic about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with each qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You could be the ideal candidate for this position, or for another opportunity with us.

What you will love about us

At Clipper, you will become part of a growing and professional work environment where we strive to be the best. We offer:

• A key role with significant influence on Clipper Bulk's tax framework and risk profile

• The opportunity to build and shape an internal tax function

• Close collaboration with senior management and exposure to strategic decision-making

• A welcoming and inclusive work environment with a variety of socal, sports, and cultural events throughout the year

• Attractive employee benefits, including pension, health, dental and critical ilness insurance

• Beautiful office facilities in Nordhavn, located near the metro with on-site paring, delicious lunch arangement and access to fitness facilities and a personal trainer.

Application and recruitment process

Please submit your CV and cover letter through our application portal by 22nd November 2026.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and interviews will be treated with full discretion.

The recruitment process consist of two interview rounds. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a first interview, while candidates progressing to the second round will be asked to complete a personality assessment beforehand. Confidential reference checks will be conducted for final candidates.

Learn more about Clipper at clipper-bulk.com, LinkedIn, and Instagram.

Clipper is an industry leader in dry bulk, an operator, a pool manager, and a specialist in steel services. We operate a modern fleet of approximately 120 handysize and supramax vessels, transporting a wide range of cargo from dry bulk to break bulk. Clipper is commercially headquartered in Copenhagen and employs a staff of around 100 onshore worldwide__. We are a global workplace built on five shared values: Dependable, Curious, Collaboration, Hands-on and Family. jobs.occupation: Better Nitrogen efficiency by improving Cow Resilience, Eating Dynamics, Breeding and Lifetime Efficiency
jobs.employer_name: Center for Kvantitativ Genetik og Genomforskning
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Quantitative Genetics and Genomics programme. The position is available from 1 March 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
Better Nitrogen efficiency by improving Cow Resilience, Eating Dynamics, Breeding and Lifetime Efficiency

Research area and project description
The Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics (QGG) holds a leading position in cattle breeding research, particularly in genetic studies on data generated by advanced phenotyping technologies such as the CFIT 3D camera system through industry collaboration with VikingGenetics. This state-of-the-art system enables large-scale, non-invasive measurement of feed intake, body weight, and milk production data in over 30,000 cows directly in their production environment. This PhD project will leverage this extensive phenotypic dataset generated by CFIT, in combination with feeding parameters and other phenotypes from the Danish Cattle Database, to develop genetic tools aimed at enhancing nitrogen efficiency, resilience, eating dynamics and feed efficiency. The goal is to develop novel genomic breeding values for nitrogen efficiency, while considering other important breeding goal traits (e.g., productivity, health, fertility) and other traits, such as resilience, eating dynamics and feed efficiency. The project will apply advanced statistical methods, artificial intelligence, and cutting-edge genetic models to support and enhance management and breeding decision-making by dairy farmers. This project offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the green transition in agriculture by breeding cows that are both more sustainable and economically viable for the future of Danish dairy farming. We encourage candidates finishing their MSc in summer 2027 also to apply.

Qualifications and specific competences
A relevant master’s degree (120 ECTS) in Animal Breeding
Experience with data handling softwares (e.g., R, SAS, Python, Unix Shell) and genetic softwares (e.g., DMU, BLUPF90, AIREML).
Background in working with Livestock data is an advantage.
The ability to speak and write English fluently is a prerequisite for the applicant.
Can speak and write English fluently is a prerequisite.

Place of employment and place of work
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics, C.F. Møllers Allé 3, 8000 Aarhus C., Denmark.

Contacts
Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:
• Associate Professor Bingjie Li, e-mail: bingjie.li@qgg.au.dk (main supervisor)
• Tenure Track Assistant Professor Rasmus Bak Stephansen, e-mail: rasmus.stephansen@qgg.au.dk (co-supervisor)For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:
• admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk 
How to apply
Please follow this link to submit your application.

Application deadline is 29 November 2026 23:59 CET.

Preferred starting date is 01 March 2027.

For technical reasons, you must upload a project description. Please copy the project description above and upload it as a PDF in the application.

Please note:
• Only documents received prior to the application deadline will be evaluated. Thus, documents sent after deadline will not be considered.
• The programme committee may request further information or invite the applicant to attend an interview.
• Shortlisting will be used, which means that the evaluation committee only will evaluate the most relevant applications.
Formalities and salary range
Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

jobs.occupation: Two 3-year Postdoc positions in Leadership Studies
jobs.description:
Copenhagen Business School invites applications for two vacant 3-year Postdoc positions in Leadership Studies, both based on a broad understanding of leadership as studies of both governance, organising and management. One Postdoc position will be affiliated with Department of Management, Society and Communication and the other with Department of Organisation. For more information about the two departments, please follow the links.

The two positions form part of CBS Executive Education’s Talent Programme (ETP). The ETP sets out to strengthen CBS’ leadership related research and education capacity within executive education and life-long learning. Expected starting date is 15 February 2027.

Examples of research areas that the Postdocs might cover:

• Leadership Studies with a particular focus on leadership practices and developments in the Nordic context
• Leadership Studies with a particular focus on life-long learning for working professions
The Postdoc positions are non-tenured positions, each for a three-year period with both research and teaching obligations.

To fulfill the research requirements of the positions, the applicants chosen are expected to be physically present on a regular basis and actively participate in the teaching and research activities of their respective Departments.

Qualifications

Applicants must hold a PhD or the equivalent. In assessing applications, particular emphasis will be placed on

• Research potential within different aspects of leadership studies in a Nordic context and within life-long learning for working professionals.
• Demonstrable experience with executive education and external engagement based on direct participation in executive education activities, including development and teaching of high-quality offerings in the executive education area.
• Demonstrable interest in developing and co-creating new educational formats that address changing learning and competence needs of relevance for life-long learning, in part by further developing CBS Executive Education’s collaboration with external partners and the CBS Executive Education Foundation.
• Professional proficiency in both Danish and English (written and spoken).
Copenhagen Business School has a broad commitment to the excellence, distinctiveness and relevance of its teaching and research programmes. Candidates who wish to join us should demonstrate enthusiasm for working in an organisation of this type.

The application must include:

• A summary of the candidate’s key abilities and qualifications.
• A complete, numbered list of publications (indicating titles, co-authors, page numbers and year) with an * marking of the academic productions to be considered during the review. A maximum of 5 publications for review is allowed. Applicants are requested to prioritise their publications in relation to the field of this job advertisement.
• Copies of the publications marked with an *. Only publications written in English (or another specified principal language, according to research tradition) or one of the Scandinavian languages will be taken into consideration)
• Information indicating experience in research management, teaching incl executive education, industry co-operation and international co-operation.
• Documentation of relevant, significant, original research at an international level.
• Transcript(s) and a full CV
Recruitment procedure

The Recruitment Committee will shortlist a minimum of two applicants; when possible five or more applicants will be shortlisted. The shortlisted applicants will be assessed by the Assessment Committee. All applicants will be notified of their status in the recruitment process shortly after the application deadline. 

The applicants selected for assessment will be notified about the composition of the Assessment Committee and later in the process about the result of the assessment.

Once the recruitment process has been completed each applicant will be notified of the outcome of their application.

For further information please contact: Head of Department MSC Dorte Salskov-Iversen tel.: +45 3815 3181, e-mail dsi.msc@cbs.dk.

For information on the recruitment process, please contact: jobcall.msc@cbs.dk

Appointment and salary will be in accordance with the Ministry of Finance’s agreement with the Central Academic Organisation.

Application: Application must be sent via the electronic recruitment system.

Application deadline: 19 November 2026

Copenhagen Business School must receive all application material, including all appendices (see items above), by the application deadline.

WE TRANSFORM SOCIETY WITH BUSINESS

CBS is a globally recognised business school with deep roots in the Nordic socio-economic model. Our faculty has a broad focus on societal challenges, and we have earned a reputation for high-quality disciplinary and interdisciplinary research and education.
We are located at Frederiksberg and have approximately 20,000 full and part-time students, 800 full-time faculty members, 200 PhD students and 700 administrative staff, and a full portfolio of bachelor, master, MBA/EMBA, PhD and executive programmes taught in English and Danish.
Our global profile carries the obligation to address critical challenges in our research and to develop the transformational capabilities of students, graduates and business leaders via our educational activities and opportunities for lifelong learning. Complex challenges call for joint action, and therefore our strategy focuses on strengthening current and starting new partnerships with other sciences, the business community, authorities and civil society.
CBS is working continuously on becoming a diverse and inclusive organisation, and we encourage all regardless of gender identity and expression, ethnicity, religious beliefs, LGBT+ identity, cultural background etc. to apply.Reach out to us if you need assistance in the application or recruitment process, if there is something we should know, or if as a person with disability you wish to make use of your preferential access.
