jobs.occupation: PhD Position in Energy Harvesting for Bio-Inspired Flying Robots
jobs.description:
The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics in Odense at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the Faculty of Engineering of the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a PhD position in energy harvesting for bio-inspired flying robots. The position focuses on developing energy-harvesting techniques that use the magnetic fields surrounding high-voltage power lines to support autonomous inspection of power lines. The starting date is 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.  

This is a three-year PhD position based at SDU’s campus in Odense, Denmark.

The section focuses on conducting research in digital and high-frequency electronics, embedded systems, control, and communication, utilizing cutting-edge reconfigurable computing and sensors. The aim is to develop next-generation electronics and computing solutions that solve technology-related challenges in fields such as autonomous robots, drones, IoT, smart grid, and healthcare.

The section contributes to our educational programmes in electrical engineering in Odense, offering Bachelor’s and Master of Science degrees in Electronics Engineering. Its activities span research, industrial collaboration, and education in electrical engineering and related areas.

The SDU campus in Odense comprises six faculties, bringing together academics and students in an environment that supports interdisciplinary research and a rich student life. Odense offers a vibrant robotics community, cultural activities, attractive residential areas, and green spaces along the river that runs through the city centre.

 

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated PhD candidate to join the FreeFly project, an ambitious research project focused on developing a bird-like flying robot for autonomous inspection of power lines. The PhD research will focus on energy harvesting to enable self-sustaining operation of this bio-inspired robotic platform.

Research Focus – Energy Harvesting for Bio-Inspired Flying Robots

You will investigate, analyse, and design novel energy-harvesting techniques that enable bio-inspired aerial robots to draw energy from the strong magnetic fields surrounding high-voltage power lines. Your research will contribute to the development of self-sustaining flying robotic systems, with the aim of enabling extended autonomous inspection missions.

General Responsibilities

As a PhD student on this project, you will:

• 
Conduct research on energy harvesting from the magnetic fields surrounding high-voltage power lines, contributing to the development of a self-sustaining, bird-like autonomous flying robot for inspection of power lines.

• 
Participate in teaching activities, including course planning and instruction in relevant subject areas.

• 
Collaborate closely with fellow PhD students, postdocs, and other members of the research group in a dynamic, interdisciplinary environment.

We are looking for a detail-oriented, self-driven candidate with a strong interest in energy harvesting and its application to bio-inspired flying robots. If you are motivated to contribute to innovative research in autonomous inspection of power lines, we encourage you to apply.

 

Required Qualifications

• 
A completed BSc and MSc in electronics, electrical engineering, physics, mechatronics, or a closely related discipline. Applicants in the final semester of their master’s programme are also encouraged to apply, provided they complete their MSc before the starting date and meet the applicable PhD admission requirements.

• 
Strong technical skills relevant to energy harvesting, particularly magnetic-field energy harvesting, electronics, and embedded hardware architectures.

• 
Demonstrated ability in academic writing, including preparing scientific reports, documentation, and research publications.

For further information about the position, please contact the Head of Digital and High-frequency Electronics section, Professor Emad Samuel Malki Ebeid, e-mail: esme@sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

• 
Motivated application that clearly explains the applicant’s interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages). 

• 
Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information, skills, along with any other relevant information, e.g. teaching experience, computational skills, relevant projects, etc.

• 
Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). Applicants in the final semester of their master’s programme are requested to submit transcripts from all completed semesters. 

• 
Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

• 
Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

• 
An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

• 
Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

• 
List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

• 
Up to three names and emails of researchers who can provide an informed reference letter at short notice. (Reference letters and other relevant qualifications may also be included.)

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 20, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.313 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

The preferred start date is from January 1, 2027. 

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

The position is open from January 1, 2027, and the starting date will be agreed with the successful candidate.

 

Job Content

The Assistant Professor will conduct research within energy harvesting for drones, robotic systems, and IoT applications, with a particular focus on enhancing power density and enabling long-term autonomous operation. The research will further address electromagnetic interference (EMI) mitigation and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) for electronic and robotic systems operating in extreme high-voltage environments, contributing to improved system reliability, safety, and performance in infrastructure inspection and maintenance applications.

The successful candidate is expected to develop and sustain a research agenda aligned with or complementing the section’s activities, establish an internationally recognized research profile, publish in high-impact journals and leading international conference proceedings, and actively contribute to securing external research funding from national and international sources. The role includes collaboration with academic colleagues and industrial partners and participation in national and international research activities.

The position includes planning, teaching, and developing Bachelor’s and Master’s-level courses in relevant areas of electronics and electrical engineering. The successful candidate will supervise Bachelor’s, Master’s, and PhD students, provide academic guidance, and contribute to a supportive and collaborative research and learning environment. The role also includes academic service at section and department levels and participation in relevant professional activities.

 

Required Qualifications

Applicants must hold a PhD degree in Electronics Engineering, Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field.

Applicants must document the following qualifications and experience:

• 
A strong research track record in electromagnetic energy harvesting, power conversion, or power management systems.

• 
Research experience in electromagnetic interference (EMI) mitigation and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) for operation in extreme high-voltage environments up to 500 kV.

• 
Experience in the design, development, and testing of drone systems.

• 
Experience in university teaching, course development, and supervision of engineering students, together with pedagogical and subject-specific skills appropriate to the position.

We are looking for a manager to head our Drug Product Development and Analysis Team, consisting of three Scientists and three Technicians reporting to the Head of Process Development. Apart from managing the team an important part of the role will be hands-on to review analytical results, maintain the analytical methods and drive the execution of the analytical tasks in the team.

Your tasks will include:

• Driving the daily operation of the team, setting the scientific direction, and ensuring the development of the team members

• Ensuring established analysis assays run smoothly and deliver high-quality data on time, while supporting the team in developing new assays to advance the department

• Communicating daily with the team and collaborating closely with Production, Quality Control, and R&D

• M.S. in Biotechnology, Human Biology, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, preferably with a PhD in protein chemistry or a related topic

• 3-5 years of relevant experience from the biotech industry or academia Previous experience with pharmaceutical analyses, e.g. chromatographic methods, particle methods and protein methods

• Previous experience with formulation development, statistical data analysis, and an understanding of protein chemistry

Success relies on strong teamwork, people skills, and the ability to engage in cross-functional dialogue. A proactive, calm, and positive attitude, combined with adaptability to new priorities, is beneficial. Good teamwork abilities are essential in a diverse, international department.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Data & AI Architecture, based in Copenhagen or London, to lead our team of four Data, AI and Solution Architects and serve as the design authority for Pandora’s Data & AI platform. This is a genuine dual role. You’ll set the architectural direction and standards, while remaining close enough to the technology to challenge, review and approve the designs that matter.

Our target architecture is Databricks, including Delta Lake, medallion patterns and Unity Catalog, while Azure Synapse and its conformed enterprise models continue to power a significant part of the estate across supply chain, commerce, manufacturing, corporate technology and omni-channel.

A critical part of the role is leading the transition to Databricks: shaping the target architecture, determining where ownership sits as the platform evolves, and ensuring existing solutions remain coherent and supported throughout the journey.

The role is approximately 60% architecture and 40% people leadership. You’ll lead and develop four architects, but this is not a role where technical accountability is delegated to the team. Both sides of the role are real, and you’ll be expected to lead both.

Scope and authority

• Design authority for Data & Analytics: approves data and AI solution designs, and can require rework, attach conditions to an approval, or withhold approval.

• Chairs the architecture review forum, setting its standards, cadence and quality gates, and deciding what requires review against what is already covered by an approved pattern.

• Resolves conflicting design positions across architects, lead engineers and delivery teams.

• Owns reference architectures, solution patterns, data contracts and architecture decision records — accountable for their adoption, not just their publication.

• Owns the team's roadmap, capacity allocation across workstreams, and budget, including engagement of external consulting resources.

• Translates and enforces the Data & AI architecture strategy set by the Global Director, and informs how it evolves.

Job Responsibilities

Architecture

• Set and enforce the standards for what is built on Databricks as the target architecture, what remains on Synapse for now, and what is retired — and on what evidence.

• Decide how data products are aligned: source-aligned versus domain-aligned versus consumer-aligned, where ownership and stewardship sit, and where a conformed enterprise model (CDM/RDM) serves better than distributed ownership.

• Review technical designs from solution architects and lead engineers against platform standards; give feedback that changes the design, not just documents it.

• Define and evolve reference architectures, solution patterns and data contracts so that quality is built in rather than inspected in.

• Lead design sessions with architects, engineering and business stakeholders on complex or contested problems.

• Oversee transitional architectures through to legacy decommission, maintaining business continuity and closing the parallel run.

AI architecture

• Set and enforce architecture standards for agentic systems: orchestration, tool and data access boundaries, evaluation, guardrails and observability.

• Set and enforce architecture standards for ML systems: feature reuse, training and serving topology, model lifecycle, and monitoring for drift.

• Approve AI solution designs with enough depth to arbitrate them on the technical merits, and in line with AI policy and applicable regulation.

Governance and regulation

• Embed privacy-by-design and personal data handling requirements into platform patterns, particularly across commerce and omni-channel.

• Maintain computational governance: data quality frameworks, contracts and lineage as platform capability rather than project effort.

Team leadership

• Line management for four architects: coaching, performance, career development, hiring.

• Establish ways of working — review process, documentation standards, quality gates — and hold the team to them.

• Represent architecture in leadership forums, steering committees and cross-functional planning.

• Keep architects hands-on and embedded with engineering teams; architecture produced at a distance from delivery does not land.

What you will have done by month 12

• A published and adopted standard for what is built on Databricks, with evidence of designs changed by it.

• A clear model for data product alignment and ownership, applied on live work rather than documented in isolation.

• An architecture review forum running to a predictable cadence, with a visible ADR record and a known path for challenging a decision.

• Approved agentic and ML reference patterns in use.

• At least one legacy component fully decommissioned, not just superseded.

• A development plan in place for each of the four architects, and any open roles filled.

Essential experience

• 5+ years designing and delivering production data platform solutions at enterprise scale, hands-on.

• At least 2 years line-managing technical specialists, including performance management, career development and hiring.

• Has held a design approval or architecture governance mandate, including declining designs and making that decision hold.

• Has led a platform migration or a parallel-run estate through to legacy decommission.

• Deep working knowledge of Databricks (Delta Lake, medallion, Unity Catalog) as a target architecture, plus enough Azure Synapse (star schemas, conformed models, dedicated pools) to govern what remains there, and pipeline orchestration with ADF or Databricks Workflows.

• Has designed source-aligned, domain-aligned and consumer-aligned data products, with a clear view of where distributed domain ownership beats a conformed enterprise model (CDM/RDM) and where it does not.

• Has implemented or governed a domain ownership model — data mesh or similar — including the federated governance and stewardship that makes it work.

• Has architected agentic and ML systems: orchestration, tool and data access boundaries, evaluation and guardrails; feature and model lifecycle, serving, and monitoring for drift.

• Has set architecture standards that others adopted — solution patterns, reference architectures and architecture decision records.

• Has implemented data quality frameworks, data contracts or computational governance in production.

• Holds an architectural position under delivery pressure, and judges well when to concede.

• Communicates architecture clearly to technical and business audiences, including solution designs, ADRs and data flow diagrams.

• Understanding of retail, manufacturing, finance or supply chain business processes and how data flows through a business.

Desirable

• Familiarity with EU AI Act obligations and enterprise AI governance.

Our customers are classified and cannot be disclosed, so your work will take place in secure environments, often in collaboration with Product teams, security teams and onsite at customer locations. As this is a newly established position, you will have the opportunity to help shape this role as it grows.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Analysing and preparing customer data for use in our established product

• Training, evaluating and refining machine learning models on customer data

• Integrating models and data-driven features that generate measurable value

• Exploring customer data to identify new opportunities for value creation

• Collaborating with security teams to ensure compliance with national classifications and profiles

Joining the team

You will join an organisation where you will be associated with multiple teams, part of our NSI business unit. We develop and maintain military-grade solutions that support a nation's most critical systems. The organisation is highly collaborative, organised around Products that make a difference.

If you are located in Aarhus, we are open to discussing a hybrid arrangement, but you should expect regular presence in Copenhagen (6–8 days per month).

Your qualifications

We are looking for a data scientist with hands-on experience applying machine learning to real-world data in production settings, who can work confidently in high-stakes, security-classified environments.

• Relevant technical education, Bachelor's or Master's, in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics or equivalent experience

• Documented experience with applied machine learning on real-world data

• Some hands-on experience with data science and machine learning in production settings

• Strong knowledge of Python, machine learning frameworks (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow), SQL and data processing tools

• Fluent Danish and English skills

• A strong security mindset and ability to work in high-stakes environments

Alongside this, we value:

• A collaborative and proactive work style

• Comfortable working independently and navigating ambiguity, particularly as this is a newly established role

• Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities

• Comfortable working onsite at customer environments when needed

Expect travel activity to our HQ in Aarhus and to customer sites, primarily in Copenhagen.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Copenhagen

When you join us in Copenhagen, you're not just getting a desk at one of the city's best locations - you are stepping into a workplace where community matters. Our Employees Club keeps things lively with monthly social events, and our office catering makes sure you are always well taken care of. Whether you are into casual games or just good company, you will find both at our foosball table or during our relaxed Friday bar gatherings.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Kasper Bach Klokker, Associate Director, NSI Operations.

**The Impact You'll Make

**As our Communication Coordinator, you’ll help bring our Digital and Lifecycle Services portfolio to life for colleagues, partners, customers, and end users around the world.

You’ll join the Digital & Lifecycle Services Communications team and contribute to strengthening the visibility of our service business through engaging visual communication, content, marketing materials, and events. Working across an international organization, you’ll have the opportunity to turn complex topics into clear and compelling communication.

This fixed-term role is available for one year and offers the opportunity to build hands-on experience across graphic design, communication, and service product launches in a global environment while contributing to solutions that support energy efficiency throughout the product lifecycle.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Work together with the Communication Manager to support daily internal and external communication activities, build content for thought leadership topics, and help with creation of focus business marketing narratives.

• Create engaging visual communication, including icons, visual concepts, posters, images, and other branded materials using Adobe tools.

• Develop content supporting marketing and communication activities across Digital & Lifecycle Services.

• Collaborate with global marketing teams to create and launch marketing materials such as sales presentations, fact sheets, product descriptions, and other communication assets.

• Contribute to our Service Partner Program, developing branded materials such as presentations, guides, fact sheets, visuals, and other supporting content.

**What We're Looking For

**We’re looking for someone who combines creativity with a structured approach and enjoys turning ideas into communication that is easy to understand and visually engaging.

**To Be Successful In This Role, You Bring

**

• Experience with graphic design, content creation, communication, or marketing and familiarity with design tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe InDesign, video editing skillset, or similar.

• A structured, hands-on approach and the ability to coordinate tasks and projects involving different stakeholders

• Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a matrix organization with international and cross-functional environment.

• Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken.

• Relevant education in communication, marketing, business, design, or a related field.

Experience with B2B marketing, business consultancy, campaigns, agency work, or service-related businesses would be an advantage, but it is not essential. Most importantly, you are curious, collaborative, and motivated to create communication that makes an impact.

**What You'll Get From Us

**You'll help engineer a better future by contributing to solutions that make a real difference around the world.

In this role, you’ll gain broad experience across visual communication, content creation, global marketing collaboration, and events, while working with colleagues and stakeholders across an international organization.

We'll support your career growth with mentoring, learning opportunities, and access to global career paths.

You'll have the flexibility, autonomy, and support you need to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

You'll be part of an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds are respected, valued, and empowered to succeed.

You'll receive a competitive rewards package that includes benefits such as an annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, health insurance, and more. As a global company, these benefits vary by country and contract.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you’re excited about combining creativity, communication, and collaboration to help make complex solutions clear and engaging, we’d love to hear from you.

You don’t need to meet every preferred qualification to apply. If this opportunity interests you and you believe your experience and perspective could add value to the team, we encourage you to apply.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

**Help hospitals deploy, operate and get the most from UNEEG software solutions

**_At UNEEG Medical, we are on a clear mission: improve epilepsy care and enhance patients' quality of life through objective, real-world EEG data. UNEEG EpiSight Solution, our sub-cutaneous EEG monitoring solution enables remote monitoring of brain activity in people with uncontrolled epilepsy and is already making an impact across Europe and the US. We combine the agility of a small company with the high standards of the medical device industry.

_**Your role and team:

**We are looking for an Application/IT Supporter who will be responsible for the technical deployment, support and ongoing operation of UNEEG's software solutions. You will help onboard new hospital customers, with a primary focus on the US market, while ensuring excellent service and operational continuity for our existing customers.

You will initially be part of Technology and later join the new Customer Enablement & Governance team. Working closely with the Project Lead, Customer Enablement & Governance, you will be the technical bridge between hospital IT teams and colleagues across Commercial, Clinical Operations and Technology. The role includes both remote and on-site support, and travel can be expected.

**Your main responsibilities will be:

**

• Plan, install, configure and test data transfer infrastructure solutions in hospitals

• Provide remote and on-site support for installations, upgrades, operation and troubleshooting

• Train hospital IT staff and system administrators to maintain deployed solutions effectively

• Monitor and maintain hospital servers, cloud clients and Microsoft Azure environments

• Troubleshoot networking, data communication, application and system performance issues

• Configure and manage virtual machines, containers and Kubernetes environments, and deploy patches and updates

• Document support cases and technical issues in Jira and collaborate with software developers on resolution and product improvements

• Maintain deployment procedures, troubleshooting guides and other technical documentation in line with healthcare IT and data security requirements

**You will thrive in this role if you:

**

• Are service-minded, outgoing and persistent, and enjoy working directly with customers

• Take ownership, follow up rigorously and solve problems before they arise

• Can manage several tasks at the same time while staying structured and attentive to detail

• Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Enjoy collaborating across commercial, clinical and software development teams

• Are flexible when customer needs occasionally require support across time zones or outside normal working hours

**Your background:

**

• An education as an IT Support Technician or Data Technician, ideally focused on infrastructure, or a relevant degree in software development, infrastructure or a related field

• Experience or strong interest in customer-facing technical service or IT support; newly educated candidates with the right mindset are also encouraged to apply

• Proficiency in Microsoft Azure, virtualization and container-based environments, including Kubernetes

• Knowledge of relational databases, such as SQL Server, and scripting

• Ability to troubleshoot networking, application and system performance issues

• Experience with defect tracking and monitoring tools, such as Jira, Prometheus, Grafana or Azure Monitor

• Fluent professional English, both written and spoken

**It will be an advantage if you have experience with:

**

• Healthcare IT, hospital environments or deployment in public-sector organizations

• Healthcare data standards, hospital IT security protocols or clinical trial workflows

• ITIL or similar service management methodologies

• Data protection and privacy requirements, including GDPR and HIPAA

• Supporting international customers in Europe or the US

• Relevant certifications, such as Microsoft Azure Administrator or Kubernetes Administrator

Applicants must be eligible to work in Denmark and possess a valid work and residence permit if applicable. At this time, we are unable to support work permit applications or sponsorships.

**What we offer:

**

• A key role in supporting secure and scalable customer solutions in a growing medical device company

• Close collaboration with skilled colleagues and international hospital stakeholders

• A workplace with great energy, social activities and a culture of togetherness

• A role based at our modern HQ in Allerød with good facilities and easy access

At UNEEG, your ideas matter, your work makes a difference, and your colleagues have your back.

**Who to contact:

**For more details about the job, please contact Senior Director, Technology, Kim Heegaard Hansen at +45 25 65 75 01.

**How to apply:

**Apply through our Careers site.

All applications must be in English and are treated confidentially. We screen applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

**About UNEEG Medical

**UNEEG Medical pioneers ultra long-term subcutaneous EEG monitoring to help physicians optimize treatment for epilepsy patients. Our UNEEG EpiSight solution provides objective insights into seizure burden, enabling more personalized care. We collaborate with leading institutions across Europe and the US to help patients regain control of their life. At UNEEG Medical, we are currently 40 dedicated people with diverse backgrounds. Our HQ is in Allerød with subsidiaries in the UK, Germany, Austria and the US. Our core values Togetherness, Integrity, and Dedication guide our work as we catalyze brain health therapy with real-world data.

_Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure investments? If so, come and join Copenhagen Energy Islands (CEI), a Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) subsidiary company exclusively dedicated to developing energy hubs globally. We are currently looking for a Director to join our team.

_**Team

**Energy hubs will be the next generation of energy infrastructure assets. They will be critical in enabling cost-efficient deployment of large-scale renewable energy to achieve energy security and to reach ambitious global decarbonization targets, while maintaining cost competitiveness of the energy system. Energy islands, or energy hubs, are multifunctional energy infrastructure projects, involving large-scale renewable energy production integrated with conversion technologies to deliver electrons and molecules to demand centers. Copenhagen Energy Islands (CEI) is a company dedicated to originating and developing these projects.

You will be working closely together with an experienced team in a high paced, dynamic environment. We bring experts together with backgrounds in commercial, regulatory, development, legal, consulting and financial careers, to name a few.

We are a strong, social, and multi-national team with a passion for making a difference. Our collective character can be described as creative, dedicated, resourceful and humble. We are excited to work on something that is complex and will enable a step-change for the renewable industry.

**Role

**As a Director you will supervise several teams that work on opportunities in a number of markets. You will oversee the activities in technical, commercial, stakeholder and financial workstreams; and you will drive our external relationships with partners, advisors, and (non-)governmental organizations.

Your responsibilities will be to:

• Maximize the CEI investment value of the energy hub opportunities you work on

• Coordinate development activities with workstream managers that form part of the project development team

• Build and mature the investment cases for the CEI project you work on

• Own the project financial model and ensure that the model is maintained and used consistently across the projects

• Be the CEI focal point for our (joint venture) partners

• Manage the processes related to joint ventures, fund raising, divestitures; including negotiation of agreements and transaction documents

• Develop insights and high-quality presentations for internal and external stakeholders

• Advise CEI leadership team regarding general corporate matters such as portfolio management and resource allocation considerations

• Support CEI fundraise activities, including managing certain workstreams

• Play an active role in origination of new project opportunities and develop in-depth understanding of target markets

• You will help to manage, train and develop the Managers, Associates and Analysts, and will contribute to the positive, professional and collegiate working environment

• Participate in our activities to grow the team, such as interviewing and ranking candidates.

**You

**The work environment at CEI is lean, stimulating and demanding, within a global context. We are therefore looking for a self-starting, collaborative, and high-performance professional with an entrepreneurial drive. You have 15+ years of relevant experience from project development or infrastructure investment organizations.

Moreover, you have a background in offshore wind, hydrogen, Oil & Gas or other energy development and track record in bringing complex investments successfully to Final Investment Decision.

Key qualifications include:

• Knowledge of regulatory environment in the energy sector, and familiar with stakeholder engagement practices to shape desired outcomes

• Corporate Development and M&A knowledge

• Experience in commercial negotiations

• Ability to contribute to the overarching logic of business case when dealing with senior leadership and to step into the detail when discussing project specific aspects

• Experience in rapidly growing teams and businesses as well as exposure to critical governance structures and processes in an international environment is preferable

• Team player with the confidence to exercise judgement appropriately, engaging with colleagues at all levels of seniority

• Advanced communication skills with fluency in written and spoken English

• Ability to work well under pressure and take on responsibility

• You are proactive, think ahead and stay hands-on.

It is the expectation that frequent presence in Copenhagen is necessary for success.

**The process

**Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

**Building value that matters

**Founded in 2012, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners P/S (CIP) is a global fund manager and leading investor in energy infrastructure. CIP builds value that matters by developing and constructing critical infrastructure projects that shape the future of energy.

Through its funds, CIP invests in power generation (solar and wind), energy storage, transmission and distribution, advanced bioenergy, low-carbon fuels and carbon capture.

With 15 funds currently under management, CIP is trusted by over 200 of the world’s largest and most sophisticated institutions, having raised EUR ~43 billion to date.

CIP has projects in more than 30 countries, with presence on the ground through a network of +2,300 professionals with extensive experience and knowledge within the fields of renewable energy project development and regulated infrastructure. In addition, CIP has a broad range of competencies within corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions, engineering, construction, project development, and project management.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, CIP operates from key locations across the globe, including offices in Hamburg, Munich, London, Amsterdam, New York, Tokyo, Melbourne, Luxembourg, Kuala Lumpur, Seoul, and Singapore. In addition, CIP has 17 local project offices globally.

For more information, visit www.cip.com.

jobs.occupation: Manager of Automation & IT Project Management at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
Manager of Automation & IT Project Management at Novo Nordisk Engineering

If you’re energised by leading people and complex technical projects and you thrive in a changing, multidisciplinary environment, we’d love to hear from you!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

We are looking for a Manager of AIT Project Management to join our AIT Project Management leadership team. As a team, we are working on some of the largest and most technically complex pharma projects in Denmark, using the latest technologies across Automation and IT.

Together with the AIT Project Management leadership team, you will lead and develop a department of 15 Project Managers delivering highly technical projects in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical environment. Your contribution will be important in ensuring high performance and employee wellbeing, while securing the right resources and competencies for our growing project portfolio.

You will work closely with Project Directors, customers, and Sales to support business development, follow up on new opportunities and ensure the right staffing across our projects. You will also contribute to creating a positive and engaging working environment across our wider team of more than 50 highly skilled Project Managers.

Our Project Managers bring experience across Process Automation, SCADA, PLC, IT/OT, PI, PAT, MES, and automated solutions. Project execution ranges from traditional PMP-based planning and execution to agile methodologies and the use of ADO, depending on the project area and customer requirements.

How you might spend your days

As a Manager of AIT Project Management, you’ll be:

• Leading, coaching, and developing a motivated team of Project Managers, ensuring high employee engagement and wellbeing

• Ensuring the right resources and competence mix are in place to support our growth strategy and project pipeline

• Working closely with Project Directors, customers, and Sales to support project delivery, business development, and new opportunities

• Strengthening Project Management processes within AIT and driving continuous improvements

• Supporting project execution and, when needed, taking on smaller assignments as a Project Manager

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• A supportive leader who listens, provides constructive feedback, and motivates others to succeed

• Committed to ongoing coaching and the wellbeing and development of your employees

• A team player who leads by example and collaborates effectively across different areas and levels

• A strong communicator with a positive, holistic, and analytical mindset

• Structured and effective in your work, with an open and engaging management style

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• You hold a bachelor's degree in engineering or a related technical discipline, or bring equivalent relevant experience

• You have at least four years of experience leading Project Managers and/or technical specialists

• You have a background as a Project Manager

• You have knowledge of the pharmaceutical industry

• You are fluent in written and spoken English and Danish

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 15th November 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Please contact VP of AIT Project Management Timme Traberg-Andersen +45 3079 9436.

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

jobs.occupation: Senior Project Manager – Clean & Industrial Utilities
jobs.description:
**Senior Project Manager – Clean & Industrial Utilities

****Location: Hillerød, Denmark

****Department: DPM Expansion – Future QC

**Are you ready to take ownership of a critical utilities workstream within one of Novo's largest quality control expansion projects?

Do you bring strong experience in clean or industrial utilities, combined with a practical understanding of commissioning, qualification and project delivery?

Are you motivated by the opportunity to influence a major Greenfield development, work with experienced engineering specialists and take responsibility for delivering complex technical systems?

If you enjoy combining technical knowledge with project leadership, stakeholder collaboration and practical problem solving, this could be an exciting next step in your career.

We are looking for a Senior Project Manager Clean & Industrial Utilities to join our DPM Expansion – Future QC programme in Hillerod, Denmark.

**The position

**As Senior Project Manager, you will take ownership of the commissioning and qualification planning and coordination for clean and industrial utility systems within our new Future QC facility.

The project represents an investment of approximately DKK 3 billion and involves the construction of a 42,000 m² quality control laboratory facility, the largest of its kind within Novo.

Working within a relatively lean and highly collaborative project organisation, you will have significant responsibility and the opportunity to make a direct impact on how critical utility systems are delivered, qualified and handed over to operations.

A central part of your role will be ensuring that commissioning and qualification activities are effectively planned, coordinated and aligned with construction milestones, equipment installation requirements and phased building handovers.

You will work closely with contractors, engineering specialists, validation colleagues, IT, equipment owners and other project stakeholders to manage technical dependencies, identify risks and ensure the successful progression of the utilities workstream.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Lead the planning and coordination of commissioning and qualification activities for clean and industrial utility systems.

• Work closely with the validation team to establish qualification strategies, timelines, vendor documentation requirements and appropriate levels of technical oversight.

• Work closely with the validation team to establish qualification strategies, timelines, vendor documentation requirements and appropriate levels of technical oversight.

• Coordinate with the main contractor, subcontractors and engineering specialists to ensure utility systems are delivered in accordance with project requirements and relevant standards.

• Manage interfaces and dependencies between utility availability, equipment installation, controlled shutdowns and phased building handovers.

• Review commissioning and qualification plans, identify potential technical or operational risks and coordinate appropriate corrective actions.

• Engage with equipment owners, IT, engineering and operational stakeholders to understand system requirements and ensure utility availability is aligned with their delivery schedules.

• Provide informed technical recommendations, support decision-making and escalate matters affecting cost, scope or programme timelines through established governance processes.

• Contribute to the successful handover of utility systems to the operational and maintenance organisations.

• Collaborate across the wider project team, supporting other critical workstreams where priorities and project needs require.

• This is a project manager position rather than a detailed engineering design role.

**Qualifications

**To succeed in this role, you will bring a strong technical foundation in utility systems, practical experience in regulated operational environments and the ability to manage complex engineering activities.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have developed their careers through technical, maintenance, facilities or operational engineering roles before progressing into project management.

**We Expect You To Have

**

• A relevant educational background in engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical industry experience.

• Strong technical experience in either clean utilities or industrial utilities, particularly piping related systems such as purified water, clean steam, heating, cooling, water distribution or compressed air.

• Demonstrable experience in equipment or systems commissioning, qualification and/or validation, including a sound understanding of controlled processes, documentation and operational requirements.

• Practical experience working within an operational plant, manufacturing facility or similarly complex technical environment, including exposure to maintenance activities, system start ups, shutdowns or equipment qualification.

• Proven experience coordinating engineering projects, technical workstreams, contractors or specialist service providers. Experience working within regulated or process driven industries where safety, quality, documentation and controlled operating procedures are essential.

• Strong planning, coordination and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and technical dependencies.

• The ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and spoken.

• Experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, biotechnology or other GMP regulated environments would be advantageous but is not essential.

• We also welcome relevant experience from industries such as food and beverage, chemical manufacturing, oil and gas, and engineering or EPC organisations, provided you bring the necessary utilities and qualification expertise.

• Experience across both clean and industrial utilities would be beneficial; however, strong expertise in either discipline is sufficient.

• Knowledge of Science and Risk-Based Validation (SRV), commissioning and qualification methodologies, and large-scale CAPEX or Greenfield projects would also be advantageous.

**About The Department

**

• You will join the DPM Expansion Future QC programme in Hillerod, where we are delivering a major new quality control laboratory facility to support Novo's expanding manufacturing capabilities.

• The programme involves the development of approximately 42,000 m² of new laboratory and supporting infrastructure, representing a significant investment in the future of our quality control operations.

• The project is currently progressing through construction, with commissioning, qualification and phased handover activities forming critical elements of the delivery programme.

• Our engineering organisation is relatively lean, bringing together specialists across utilities, validation, engineering, technical interfaces and other essential project disciplines.

• This structure provides an opportunity for individuals to take genuine ownership of their responsibilities, work closely with experienced colleagues and influence important technical and operational decisions.

We value collaboration, practical problem solving and the willingness to take responsibility. While you will lead your own workstream, you will also be part of a team that supports one another and responds flexibly as project priorities evolve.

Joining us means contributing to a technically challenging Greenfield project where your experience, judgement and decisions will make a visible difference.

**About You

**

• You are an experienced technical professional who combines a strong understanding of utility systems with the ability to plan, coordinate and deliver complex project activities.

• You understand what it takes to commission, qualify and operate technical systems in real world environments, and you appreciate the importance of controlled procedures, thorough planning and effective communication.

• You are comfortable working with experienced engineering specialists and contractors, asking the right questions, challenging assumptions constructively and bringing stakeholders together to find practical solutions.

• You take ownership of your responsibilities and are confident making recommendations, while recognising when issues require wider discussion or escalation.

• You are also adaptable and pragmatic.

• You understand that priorities can change within major construction programmes and are willing to support colleagues and other workstreams when needed.

• Above all, you enjoy being close to the technical and operational realities of a project and take pride in helping complex systems move successfully from construction through qualification and into operation.

**Why Novo

**At Novo, we don't wait for change. We drive it. Our commitment to defeating serious chronic diseases is built on more than a century of innovation, collaboration and a determination to make a meaningful difference to people's lives.

Joining our Future QC expansion programme offers the opportunity to contribute to a major investment in our manufacturing and quality control capabilities, while developing your experience within a global organisation undertaking complex engineering and expansion projects.

You will have the opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals, influence the delivery of a significant Greenfield development and contribute to infrastructure that will support our operations for years to come.

**Working at Novo

**Every day, we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with an unconventional spirit, a determination to innovate and a commitment to creating lasting change.

Working at Novo means joining a global healthcare company where talented people collaborate across disciplines, challenge established thinking and pursue solutions that can improve the lives of millions.

When you join us, you're not just starting a job you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

**Salary And Benefits

**The salary range for this position is DKK 742,600 to DKK 1,091,600 per year, depending on experience and qualifications.

**Incentives And Benefits

**Novo offers a competitive compensation package, including pension, bonus opportunities and a range of employee benefits designed to support your professional and personal wellbeing.

**What We Offer

**There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce.

We offer an environment where you can develop professionally, take on meaningful challenges and build your career within a global organisation committed to innovation and long term progress.

Our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind, supporting your professional development, wellbeing and work-life balance.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

At Novo, we're not chasing quick fixes we're creating lasting change for long term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives.

This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to explore new possibilities, challenge conventions and push the boundaries of what is possible.

Together, we're life changing.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

SENIOR MECHANICAL PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER

Join our product development team

Mechanical Product Development • Robust Design • Plastics • From Design To Production-ready Product

Location: Allerød, north of Copenhagen • Function: R&D / Product Development

Do you enjoy the engineering disciplines that turn a good mechanical design into a robust product design that works reliably in the real world?

Qufora is a growing, design-focused medical device company. We develop intuitive products that help people with chronic bowel disorders live a more fulfilled life.

We have a relatively small and flat organisation, which means short distances from idea to decision and from decision to action. You will be close to the products, the technical decisions and the people who make them—with the opportunity to influence both the engineering solutions and how we work.

The engineering role

This is a role for someone who enjoys the fundamentals of good mechanical engineering and knows how to combine them into robust design solutions. Understanding variation and sensitivity to design products that perform consistently despite real-world variation in components, materials, processes and use.

• Interface & mechanical design – create well-defined interfaces and mechanically sound solutions without unnecessary constraints or complexity.

• Tolerances & GPS/GD&T – translate functional needs into meaningful dimensions and tolerances, using tolerance stack-ups and statistical tolerancing where relevant.

• Mechanics & structural integrity – apply solid mechanics, engineering calculations and FEA where appropriate to understand loads, deformation, strength, fatigue and failure modes.

• Materials & plastics – select materials based on function, environment, manufacturing process and long-term product performance.

• DFM/DFA & injection moulding – develop designs that can be manufactured and assembled consistently and at the required quality, working closely with toolmakers, suppliers and Operations.

• Variation & statistical analysis – use data and statistical methods to understand variation, identify critical parameters and build robustness into the design.

You will not be placed in a narrow technical box. Depending on the challenge, you may move from CAD and tolerance analysis to material selection, supplier discussions, FEA, design reviews, verification results or solving a difficult mechanical problem in an existing product.

What you will do

You will take senior technical ownership of mechanical development activities, particularly in the later stages of product development.

You will:

• Develop and mature mechanical solutions from established concepts through detailed design, verification, design transfer and launch.

• Create high-quality 3D designs and clear, production-ready 2D drawings.

• Drive difficult mechanical issues to root cause and closure.

• Work hands-on with plastics, injection-moulded components, interfaces, tolerances, materials and robust design.

• Work closely with Operations, external manufacturers, suppliers and toolmakers to turn designs into stable, manufacturable products.

• Lead and coordinate mechanical engineering activities when several people or disciplines need to contribute.

• Help strengthen our mechanical engineering methods, standards and ways of working.

What we are looking for

You have a BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, Product Development or a similar discipline and at least 8 years of experience in mechanical product development.

Ideally, you bring several of the following:

• Strong mechanical design fundamentals and engineering judgement.

• Experience with plastic product design and injection moulding.

• Advanced 3D CAD and 2D drawing skills, preferably SolidWorks.

• Strong knowledge of ISO GPS/GD&T, tolerance analysis and robust design.

• Experience with DFM/DFA, materials, mechanics and preferably FEA.

• Experience taking products from detailed development through verification and into production.

• The ability to structure complex technical work and drive issues to completion.

Experience from medical devices or another regulated industry is an advantage, but first and foremost, we are looking for a strong mechanical product developer.

Why Qufora?

At Qufora, you will work broadly across mechanical engineering disciplines and follow products through the development process rather than being limited to one narrow area. You will be close to the products, colleagues and decisions, with the opportunity to influence both engineering solutions and how we work. And because we develop medical devices, your engineering decisions ultimately matter to people who rely on our products every day.

Application

Please apply through LinkedIn. Applications will be reviewed, and interviews held on an ongoing basis.

We have an exciting opportunity for a seasoned Logistics Procurement Category Manager to join the Group Procurement function at Royal Unibrew.

Are you a passionate procurement and supply chain professional with expertise in Logistics and a demonstrated track record of positively influencing across internal and external ecosystems to unlock end to end value and efficiencies to fuel sustainable growth?

As Group Category Manager – Logistics, you will report to the CPO and lead the development and execution of the Group Logistics procurement strategy across road freight including line-haul and last mile distribution, ocean freight, warehousing and related logistics services including pallets. You will combine strategic category leadership with hands-on execution, working closely with local market organisations,

The role will be based at our HQ in Faxe, Denmark.

**Main Responsibilities

**Strategy Development:

• Define and execute a multi-year procurement category strategy for Logistics that balances local execution with strategic priorities to support the group’s overarching goals.

• Leverage a strong external radar and category expertise to identify, evaluate and act on emerging opportunities and risks, i.e. external supplier landscape, commodities, industry best practices, digitalisation and automation and EU legislative environment.

**Category And Supplier Relationship Management

**

• Optimise category management processes, elevate sourcing and contract management processes, and build best practices with the market teams and stakeholders. Increase utilisation of eSourcing and development of digital tools to support cost modelling, benchmarking, and contract management.

• Develop supplier collaboration platforms with key suppliers across the group to unlock operational efficiencies, process enhancements, digital innovation, and to accelerate sustainability and circularity initiatives.

**Value Delivery, Efficiency And Business Partnering

**

• Deliver cost savings, supply chain efficiencies and carbon reduction targets. Establish ways of working with stakeholders to measure relevant KPIs, track initiatives, manage risk and deliver multiyear productivity plans.

• Ensure early engagement and alignment with relevant stakeholders on business strategy to maintain a fit for purpose and efficient logistics network driving optimal cost to serve to fuel sustainable business growth.

• Provide category leadership and inputs into on strategic projects, integration, and network optimisation.

• Streamline processes and drive digitalisation agenda.

**Ideal Candidate

**

• Bachelor’s degree. Professional CIPS qualification or similar will be considered.

• Min. 8 years of relevant procurement experience in logistics categories in an international or matrixed organisation. Nordics and CPG industry experience is a plus.

• Comprehensive knowledge of procurement processes, ERP systems, procurement tools and network modelling, including a strong data analytics skillset and commodity management experience.

• Excellent communication, gravitas and influencing skills to build relationships with senior stakeholders internally and externally.

• Team player with a service-oriented mindset but is also not afraid to challenge the status quo or be the critical friend when required.

• Project and change management - track record for initiating and embedding change.

• Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands on execution.

• Energised by challenges, white spaces, and complexity.

• Enthusiastic, solution-oriented approach.

• Passion for developing and coaching teams.

**What Success Looks Like

**Success in this role means creating a Logistics procurement organisation that is recognised as a strategic business partner, delivering measurable value beyond price reduction.

The successful candidate will establish strong Group category governance while enabling local ownership, build strategic supplier partnerships, increase data and digital maturity, strengthen resilience and sustainability, and continuously identify opportunities to improve the total cost, service and efficiency of Royal Unibrew's logistics network.

At Royal Unibrew, you'll find the industry's most dedicated, energetic, and experienced colleagues. Together, we build the best framework for a job that precisely matches your everyday life and career aspirations.

Royal Unibrew produces, markets, sells, and distributes quality beverages. We are a consortium of more than 35 breweries and beverage producers from across Denmark, known especially for our traditional, locally-rooted brands such as Faxe Kondi, Egekilde, Royal Beer, Ceres, and Odense Pilsner, as well as partner brands like Pepsi MAX and Heineken.

Today, we are the second-largest beverage company in Denmark. Our journey began in 1856, and we still maintain a strong commercial focus, a clear growth strategy, and an ambitious sustainability strategy - both domestically and internationally.

You'll have over 1500 colleagues in Denmark and more than 2700 colleagues outside the country, including in Finland, Italy, France, Norway, Canada, the Netherlands, and the Baltic countries.

With us, you'll be part of challenging the boundaries of sustainable production and distribution. You'll help ensure a diverse range of beverages that bring people together - on the dance floor, during the third half, or over a meal - all while contributing to strengthening Danish sports, music, and community life.

jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Project Manager with a background in medical device development? Do you enjoy leading complex development projects and coordinating work across internal teams and external development partners? In this role, you will lead a strategically important development project and work closely with a global and cross-functional team to ensure successful project execution from planning through delivery.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of in-person collaboration and focused individual work. That's why this role is based in Augsburg or Ballerup and follows a hybrid working model, with three days per week in the office and two days working from home.

**Key Responsibilities

**As Project Manager, you will:

• Lead a cross-functional development project through all phases of the product development process.

• Drive project planning, execution, follow-up, and reporting of scope, timeline, budget, risks, and key decisions.

• Coordinate activities across engineering disciplines and key stakeholders.

• Manage and maintain strong collaboration with external development partners and suppliers.

• Ensure project documentation and deliverables are completed in accordance with Ambu's quality system and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Create transparency, alignment, and engagement across the project team and stakeholder landscape.

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experience can be gained in many ways, and we understand that the perfect candidate cannot be defined on paper. However, you are likely to succeed in this role if you:

• Have experience leading the development of complex medical device hardware, including electronics, mechanics, embedded systems, and integration across disciplines.

• Have worked closely with external development partners and suppliers and understand how to manage outsourced development activities, technical deliverables, timelines, and risks.

• Have experience working with internal and external development teams across different regions, including Asian and European countries, and bring the cultural awareness needed to adapt ways of working and build effective collaboration across cultures.

• Are comfortable navigating a complex stakeholder environment and driving alignment across functions.

• Bring a structured and proactive approach to project execution and risk management.

• Have strong communication and leadership skills and enjoy working with international teams.

• Are fluent in written and spoken English.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**At Ambu, you will become part of an international organization with ambitious growth plans and a strong innovation agenda. We work in cross-functional teams and value collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement. You will have the opportunity to contribute to innovative healthcare solutions while developing your professional and personal capabilities in a dynamic environment.

Apply directly through our job portal. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for a Marketing Manager for a maternity cover of approximately 13 months to drive the customer-facing journey and category performance across our Kids department. From everyday essentials to seasonal collections, footwear and accessories, you will bring the category to life through engaging campaigns, inspiring content and a seamless shopping experience across our channels.

**What You Will Do

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• 
Develop and execute quarterly and yearly Kids marketing plans, aligned with commercial priorities and seasonal initiatives.

• 
Own the Kids front page and key landing pages, ensuring a strong and engaging digital shopping experience.

• 
Monitor traffic, engagement and category KPIs, using performance insights to evaluate results and optimize activities.

• 
Coordinate with Buying & Merchandising (B&M) on trading plans, product launches and brand exposure.

• 
Collaborate with CRM to develop engaging, high-performing email campaigns that support category priorities.

**We are looking for someone who combines a creative mindset with a strong commercial understanding and knows how to turn customer insights and category trends into engaging marketing activities.

**We Imagine That You Bring

**

• 
At least 3 years of e-commerce marketing experience, preferably within fashion, kidswear or retail

• 
Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple activities and deadlines

• 
A collaborative mindset and experience working across creative, commercial and technical teams

• 
Strong analytical skills and experience using tools such as Google Analytics and Qlik Sense

• 
An understanding of customer behaviour, seasonal trends and what drives performance in an online retail environment

• 
Fluency in English, our company language

**WHY BOOZT?

**At Boozt, creativity and commercial thinking go hand in hand. You will join a fast-paced, dynamic e-commerce business where you can take ownership, bring ideas to life and make a real impact. Working closely with colleagues across teams, you will gain valuable experience, build relationships and get to know a large organization with many different areas of expertise. And who knows where your Boozt journey might take you next?

**Apply today – we’re excited to learn more about you!

**_Only applications submitted in English will be considered.

_Important: Applicants must have the legal right to work in Denmark at the time of employment. Please note that this position does not include visa sponsorship or relocation support.

We review applications on an ongoing basis. You can read more about the process under **Recruitment.

****BOOZT PERKS

**

Great personal and internal career development opportunities

• 
A culture built on our values of trust, freedom, and responsibility

• 
Driven and passionate international colleagues

• 
A generous employee discount

In-house gym, onsite masseuse, and medical doctor

An amazing HQ in central Copenhagen – the iconic, energy-efficient Krystallen building, recognized for its architectural design and sustainability. Enjoy breathtaking city views and much more!

**Job Description

**If you want to take a leading role in shaping the IRB model landscape at a major Nordic bank, this is your opportunity. As Chief Data Scientist in our Risk Modelling and Analytics department, you will own complex modelling topics and help colleagues grow. You will work on models that matter, directly contributing to how Danske Bank manages credit risk.

**What you will be doing:

**You will join the LGD and CF development team within Risk Modelling and Analytics, a collaborative group that works across the full model development lifecycle. The team covers everything from understanding regulatory and business requirements and designing methodologies, through data sourcing and analysis, to building robust model solutions and supporting implementation, validation, and ongoing performance assessment. You will work closely with colleagues in Risk Management, Validation, IT and data teams, and the wider business, contributing to a culture where technical depth and clear thinking go hand in hand.

**More specifically, you will:

**

• Lead end-to-end development of IRB LGD and CF models, from data exploration to documentation.

• Take ownership of complex modelling challenges and contribute to key methodological decisions.

• Build robust, explainable, and regulatory-compliant models using statistical and machine learning techniques.

• Act as a technical sparring partner, sharing knowledge and supporting other Data Scientists.

• Contribute to regulatory dialogue and improve IRB modelling standards and practices.

**About you:

**

• Around five or more years of experience in data science, credit risk, or IRB model development.

• Strong experience in IRB model development, ideally including LGD and/or CF models.

• Skilled in writing clean, modular Python and SQL with good software engineering habits.

• Clear communicator, able to translate technical and mathematical concepts for diverse audiences.

• Collaborative and self-directed, comfortable taking ownership and sharing knowledge.

See all the benefits HERE.

If you're interested in this role and joining my team, feel free to contact me Justina Petkeviciute | LinkedIn and I will answer your questions! The application deadline is 10 November 2026.
