jobs.occupation: A position as postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the Research Unit of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. The position is limited to three years.
jobs.description:
A position as postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the Research Unit of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. The position is limited to three years. The starting date is 01 February 2027 or later by agreement and depending on the candidate’s preferences.

We are seeking a researcher with documented experience in epidemiological research who can independently plan studies, conduct analyses and write scientific papers. We are looking for a future colleague with a clear academic interest in women’s mental health and the motivation to develop their research in this field. Experience in psychiatric epidemiology is a distinct advantage.

The project

The position is funded by a grant from the Wellcome Trust through PROMIS, an international research project on women’s mental health during perimenopause. The project is in its initial phase and will draw on cohort data linked to national registers, in collaboration with researchers in the UK, the USA and Sweden.

The project investigates risk factors for the onset or recurrence of depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder and psychotic disorders during perimenopause. The work includes epidemiological studies of risk, the development and validation of prediction models, and studies of hormone therapy and mental health outcomes using target trial emulation.

Research tasks

The postdoc will work closely with Principal Investigator Professor Trine Munk-Olsen and the project’s data analyst and participate actively in the international research collaboration. The candidate will have considerable scope to shape research questions, the structure of individual studies, study designs and methodological choices within the framework of the project.

The main tasks are to:

• 
Plan and conduct epidemiological studies using register and cohort data, including preparing study protocols and analysis plans.

• 
Independently perform statistical analyses, interpret results and write scientific papers.

• 
Identify risk factors for mental disorders during perimenopause and contribute to the development and validation of prediction models.

• 
Contribute to studies using target trial emulation to investigate hormone therapy and mental health outcomes.

• 
Together with other project team members, contribute to applications for access to external datasets and to the maintenance, quality assurance, harmonisation and documentation of the datasets used.

• 
Participate in subprojects and undertake tasks within the international collaboration, including coordination, organising project meetings and following up on joint agreements.

The position will involve limited travel. It is primarily research-oriented. Teaching and supervision duties may be included, depending also on the candidate’s interests and preferences.

Expectations of qualifications

The applicant who is hired must have a Ph.D. degree in epidemiology, health sciences, biostatistics or data science with a strong focus on health. Candidates who have not yet completed their Ph.D. may apply if they expect to obtain the degree by the starting date. However, we envisage that, in addition to their Ph.D., the candidate will have at least 1–2 years of research-related experience, for example as a postdoc, research assistant or statistician.

The applicant must have the following qualifications:

• 
A clear academic interest in research on women’s mental health, including the relationships between reproductive life stages and mental disorders.

• 
First authorship of several scientific papers, including documented experience in epidemiological research based on register or cohort data.

• 
Documented experience with advanced epidemiological and statistical methods.

• 
Documented experience and competence in statistical programming, for example in R or Stata.

• 
A documented ability to independently plan studies, prepare study protocols, conduct analyses and write scientific papers.

• 
Good collaboration skills and the ability to take responsibility for tasks and contribute constructively to joint research projects.

• 
The ability to work systematically with data quality, documentation and the maintenance of research data.

• 
Fluency in written and spoken English.

The following would be an advantage but are not requirements:

• 
Experience in psychiatric epidemiology.

• 
Experience in the development or validation of prediction models.

• 
Practical experience with target trial emulation.

• 
Experience in international research collaborations.

• 
Written and spoken Danish, as Danish is the working language of the research unit.

Research environment

The position is based in the Research Unit of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, a growing, dynamic and collaborative research environment at the Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark. Our research group brings together expertise in psychiatry, psychology, epidemiology and public health. We offer a friendly, inclusive and interdisciplinary working environment where early-career researchers are supported in developing their academic and professional skills. The unit leads several major research projects focusing on perinatal mental health, child and adolescent psychiatry, and early intervention and prevention.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision –We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information please contact Professor Trine Munk-Olsen, e-mail: tmun@sdu.dk, phone: +45 24 46 62 97.

Application deadline

November 18, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET).

Interviews

Interviews are expected to take place in early December 2026.

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher in Mass Spectrometry and Proteomics Technology Development
jobs.description:
Applications are invited for a two-year postdoctoral position in mass spectrometry and proteomics technology development at the Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics (MBG), Aarhus University, Denmark.

The position is available in the Nielsen Laboratory, which focuses on developing advanced mass spectrometry-based technologies to understand regulatory protein states, post-translational modifications (PTMs), and cellular signalling.

We are seeking an ambitious and technically skilled researcher with demonstrated experience in developing, establishing, or optimizing mass spectrometry-based proteomics methodologies. Candidates should have a strong background in at least one area of proteomics technology development, including LC-MS/MS method development, chromatographic optimization, sample preparation, PTM analysis, or related analytical technologies.

The position offers an exciting opportunity to pursue innovative technology development while taking an active role in building and shaping a growing research group at Aarhus University.

Expected start date and duration of employment

The position is a two-year postdoctoral appointment with the possibility of extension.
The expected start date is 15 January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Job description
The successful candidate will join a growing research programme focused on developing advanced mass spectrometry-based proteomics technologies and applying these to fundamental questions in molecular and cellular biology.

Our research integrates state-of-the-art mass spectrometry, quantitative proteomics, analytical method development, peptide and protein chemistry, and PTM biology to investigate how regulatory protein states control cellular function.

A central objective of the position is to develop innovative analytical methodologies that expand the capabilities, sensitivity, robustness, and throughput of modern proteomics. Potential research directions include advanced LC-MS/MS acquisition strategies, quantitative PTM proteomics, chromatographic optimization, automated sample preparation, and novel approaches for studying protein regulation.

The position provides considerable scientific freedom to develop and pursue new technological ideas, with opportunities to establish independent research directions and translate methodological innovations into high-impact scientific publications.

As an early member of a newly established research group at Aarhus University, the successful candidate will also have a unique opportunity to actively contribute to the development of the laboratory's scientific activities, technological capabilities, and future research directions.

Primary responsibilities

• Develop, establish, and optimize innovative mass spectrometry-based proteomics methodologies.
• Design and independently drive research projects with a strong emphasis on analytical innovation and technological advancement.
• Explore and implement new approaches to improve proteomics sensitivity, quantitative accuracy, reproducibility, and analytical throughput.
• Develop and apply advanced proteomics technologies to investigate PTMs and regulatory protein states.
• Contribute to establishing new experimental workflows and analytical capabilities within the laboratory.
• Collaborate with national and international research partners across proteomics, analytical chemistry, and molecular biology.
• Communicate research findings through publications in leading international scientific journals and presentations at scientific conferences.
• Contribute to the scientific development and continued expansion of the research group, including mentoring junior researchers and developing new collaborative projects.
Your profile
Applicants must hold a PhD in proteomics, analytical chemistry, biochemistry, molecular biology, biotechnology, or a closely related discipline.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have demonstrated the ability to develop, establish, or substantially improve experimental and analytical methodologies, rather than solely applying established proteomics workflows.

Applicants must demonstrate significant hands-on experience and scientific contributions in at least one of the following areas:

• Mass spectrometry method development: Establishment or optimization of advanced LC-MS/MS acquisition methodologies, including data-independent acquisition (DIA), fragmentation strategies, instrument parameter optimization, or related approaches for improving analytical performance on modern mass spectrometry platforms.
• Liquid chromatography and separation technologies: Development and optimization of chromatographic methodologies for proteomics, including LC gradient design, peptide separation, nanoLC or microflow LC, improved peak capacity, or approaches to enhance sensitivity, robustness, and throughput.
• Proteomics sample preparation and workflow development: Development or substantial optimization of protein and peptide sample preparation methodologies, including automated or high-throughput workflows, digestion strategies, sample clean-up, enrichment techniques, or quantitative proteomics applications.
• Post-translational modification proteomics: Development and optimization of methodologies for PTM enrichment, characterization, or quantitative analysis, including phosphorylation, ADP-ribosylation, ubiquitination, or other regulatory protein modifications.
• Peptide and protein chemistry: Development of innovative approaches involving peptide or protein chemistry, chemical modification, affinity enrichment, selective capture, or related analytical strategies relevant to mass spectrometry-based proteomics.
• Innovative proteomics technologies: Development of other advanced analytical approaches, such as low-input or single-cell proteomics, alternative fragmentation techniques, novel sample processing technologies, or integrated analytical workflows.
Expertise in one of these areas is sufficient. Applicants are not expected to possess experience across all the listed technologies. We particularly welcome researchers with a strong technical specialization who are motivated to expand their expertise into complementary areas of proteomics technology development.

Demonstrated scientific achievements
A central selection criterion will be the applicant's demonstrated contribution to methodological development and technological innovation.

Applicants are expected to document relevant expertise through at least one first-author research publication in which they have made a substantial contribution to the development, establishment, or optimization of an analytical method or experimental technology.

In their application, candidates should identify the publication(s) most relevant to this requirement and briefly describe their personal contributions, the technological challenge addressed, and the methodological advances achieved.

Additional qualifications
Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage but is not required:

• Proteomics data processing, bioinformatics, quantitative data analysis, or systems biology.
• Advanced computational analysis of LC-MS/MS data, including DIA data processing and statistical evaluation.
• Mammalian cell culture, including experimental perturbations and cellular model systems.
• Handling and processing of biological tissues, clinical samples, or other complex biological materials.
• Development or implementation of laboratory automation and high-throughput experimental workflows.
• Protein biochemistry, molecular biology, or functional studies of protein regulation.
• Programming, scripting, or computational workflow development, including R or Python.
• Experience working across interdisciplinary projects involving analytical technology development and biological applications.
 
Personal qualifications
We are looking for a researcher who:

• Is scientifically ambitious, highly motivated, and driven by developing innovative solutions to challenging analytical problems.
• Demonstrates creativity, initiative, and a strong ability to translate scientific ideas into experimental advances.
• Takes ownership of research projects and has the determination to drive them from initial concept to publication.
• Enjoys solving technical challenges and continuously improving experimental methodologies.
• Thrives in a dynamic research environment where new ideas, technologies, and scientific directions are actively developed.
• Works independently while contributing positively to a collaborative and supportive research environment.
• Has strong scientific communication skills and an interest in developing an independent research profile.

Who we are
The position will be based in the Nielsen Laboratory at the Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics (MBG), Aarhus University.

Our research focuses on understanding how dynamic post-translational modification networks regulate protein function and cellular behaviour. We develop and apply innovative mass spectrometry-based technologies to characterize regulatory protein states and uncover fundamental mechanisms controlling cellular function in health and disease.

The laboratory builds on more than 15 years of internationally recognized research in regulatory proteomics, ADP-ribosylation biology, and mass spectrometry-based technology development.

We are currently establishing and expanding our research activities at Aarhus University, combining technological innovation with fundamental biological discovery.

Joining the laboratory at this stage provides a particularly attractive opportunity for a motivated researcher to help build a research environment, influence its technological development, establish new analytical capabilities, and contribute to defining future research priorities.

The group benefits from strong international scientific connections and an interdisciplinary research environment spanning molecular biology, genome stability, structural biology, enzymology, and advanced proteomics.

MBG provides an outstanding interdisciplinary research environment with state-of-the-art infrastructure and a strong commitment to scientific excellence.

More information:
https://mbg.au.dk

What we offer 
We offer:

• A unique opportunity to take an active role in establishing and shaping a growing proteomics research group at Aarhus University.
• Considerable scientific freedom to develop innovative technologies and pursue independent research ideas.
• Access to advanced mass spectrometry and proteomics research infrastructure.
• Opportunities to pioneer analytical workflows and establish technological capabilities with broad scientific applications.
• A research environment where technological innovation, scientific ambition, and independent initiative are strongly encouraged.
• Strong opportunities for high-impact scientific publications, international collaborations, and conference participation.
• Support for career development, scientific networking, and applications for independent research funding.
• Close interaction with national and international researchers working at the forefront of proteomics, PTM biology, and molecular biology.
• A collaborative and supportive environment that values scientific creativity, technical excellence, and intellectual curiosity.

Place of work and area of employment 
Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics, Aarhus University, Universitetsbyen 81, 8000 Aarhus C, Denmark.

Contact information
For further information, please contact:

Professor Michael L. Nielsen

Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics

Aarhus University

Email: mln@mbg.au.dk

Deadline
Applications must be received no later than 23 November 2026.

Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self. 

Formalities and salary range
Natural Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The construction sector is facing major challenges related to climate, resource consumption, and the way we design and build our cities and buildings.

Through research, education, and collaboration with industry and public-sector partners, we contribute to developing technological solutions that support a more sustainable built environment.

Our research and development activities are closely connected to the needs of industry and society, and many projects are carried out in collaboration with companies, public authorities, and other research environments. This ensures that the knowledge and technologies developed at the department are relevant in practice and create value beyond the university.

Education is a central part of the department’s identity. We offer Bachelor’s, Master’s, and PhD programmes in engineering and continuously work to improve the connection between research, teaching, and practice.

Across our programmes, students work with real-world challenges, current technologies, and sustainable solutions for the construction sector.

What we offer
We offer an innovative and collaborative teaching and research environment with close interaction between students, researchers, and industry partners. The department provides well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories, and access to shared technical facilities. We offer an interdisciplinary environment with national, international, and industrial collaborators. Our academic environment is built on collaboration, knowledge sharing, and professional dialogue. jobs.occupation: Experienced High Voltage Specialist wanted for Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst
jobs.description:
Do you have at least three years of high voltage experience? At Bravida, you will install circuit breakers, disconnectors and switchboards and help build substations. Here, you will put your experience to use on critical electrical infrastructure projects that help secure Denmark’s power supply and support the green transition.

On behalf of Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst, Career | a JKS Company is recruiting experienced High Voltage Specialists for projects across Zealand and Lolland-Falster.

Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst has secured the framework agreement with Energinet, becoming a regular supplier of high voltage installation work across Zealand and Lolland-Falster. With this agreement and a strong order book, Bravida is expanding the department. You will join the team responsible for building, expanding, refurbishing and maintaining the infrastructure that the power grid of the future relies on.

Installation and construction of high voltage installations
You will work at substations and other high voltage installations, putting your experience into practice. You will take responsibility for your own tasks and work alongside your team to deliver safe, high-quality work.

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Installing and replacing circuit breakers, disconnectors and other substation components

• 
Carrying out cable work and working on earthing systems

• 
Working on switchboards, electrical installations and dismantling tasks

• 
Contributing to the construction, refurbishment and maintenance of high voltage installations

• 
Carrying out quality assurance and maintaining documentation

Over time, you will also share your knowledge by helping apprentices and new colleagues get to grips with their tasks.

You bring solid high voltage experience and take responsibility
You are a qualified electrician or have an equivalent electrical qualification, with at least three years of hands-on experience in high voltage work. You are familiar with the tasks described and comfortable working independently. You take initiative, recognise what needs doing and understand that safety is integral to every task.

We are looking for someone who:

• 
Works independently and takes a structured approach

• 
Takes responsibility for the safety and quality of their work

• 
Is proactive, well-presented and works well with others

• 
Is physically fit and comfortable with hands-on work outdoors and at height

• 
Holds a category B driving licence and can provide a criminal record certificate

You must be able to communicate clearly in English and have a valid work permit for Denmark.

A company vehicle to take home and no on-call duties
At Bravida, you will join a team of skilled, dedicated technicians who take pride in their work.

You will work daytime hours with no on-call duties, normally five days a week. Start times depend on the project, and the working week can be discussed. The role is paid hourly, with pay based on qualifications, plus pension contributions and a flexible benefits allowance under the Danish “fritvalgsordning” scheme.

Who you are

Elsker du at arbejde i de sene dagstimer? Ja, så er du måske vores nye kollega i Fulfilment Operation.

I IKEA har Fulfilment Operation afdelingerne hver dag ansvaret for at varehuset er velopfyldt og klar til vores kunder, hvad end det handler om at tømme lastbilerne, hejse varer til højlageret eller ligge varer på plads på salgspladserne.

- Er struktureret, har evnen til at have overblik og fokus på orden

- Det vil være en fordel hvis du har et truckcertifikat, men dette er ikke et krav

A day in your life with us

As a Fulfilment Operation Co-worker, you play an important role in IKEA’s sales and customer satisfaction, ensuring that customers never leave empty-handed when shopping for home furnishings.

Your tasks will include:

• Stocking furniture and home accessories such as plates, sofas, lamps, etc., using pallet jacks, manual labor, and possibly forklifts/stackers

• Ensuring accurate inventory through daily counts

• Daily handover to our sales colleagues after operations

• Daily maintenance of the department, including tidying up

• Daily maintenance of machines.

Together as a Team

You’ll be part of an international team of both full-time and part-time employees, all working toward the same goal. We ensure efficient stocking in the store and provide great service to customers, even though we don’t have direct customer contact. We work closely with other departments, giving you experience in collaborating with many different people. We work at a fast pace but have a strong team spirit, supporting each other and working together. There’s room for you to be exactly who you are. We provide proper training so you can feel confident and competent in the role.

Apply now!

If you have any questions please contact our Fulfillment Operations Team Leader Anders Jensen (anders.jensen3@ingka.ikea.com). Please notice that we do not receive applications via e-mail but only through our recruitment portal.

Further information

• The position is for an average of 30 hours per week.

• Your working hours may vary depending on operational needs, primarily in the evening and night from 18OM-02.00AM

AM. You should expect to work every other weekend, both Saturday and Sunday. You can provide input for the work schedule.

• We offer various employee benefits such as health insurance, massage program, canteen, staff discount, partner discount schemes, annual gift, and bonus program.

jobs.description:
Analog IC Design Lead – Power Management

Lotus Microsystems is looking for a motivated and experienced Analog IC Design Lead – Power Management to join our team at our headquarters in Copenhagen. Join a DeepTech company at the forefront of innovation, where ideas move quickly from concept to reality in a collaborative startup environment.

Position Summary

We are looking for an experienced Analog IC Design Lead – Power Management to join our Engineering team. You will lead and contribute to the development of next-generation power converters for a wide range of applications.

You will work on state-of-the-art power management technology alongside a team with hands-on expertise in power electronics, IC design, and semiconductor process development. The role combines technical leadership with hands-on circuit design and close collaboration across disciplines.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide technical leadership for IC development projects and design activities.

• Design integrated power converters and monitoring circuits.

• Design analog and mixed-signal circuit blocks.

• Drive and coordinate IC design and layout activities, working closely with design and layout engineers.

• Simulate and verify circuits using transistor-level and system-level simulation tools.

• Contribute to silicon validation, characterization, and troubleshooting.

• Collaborate with engineers across IC design, power electronics, semiconductor processes, and system development.

Qualifications

• Master’s degree (or higher) in Electrical Engineering or a related field.

• At least 10 years of relevant IC design experience.

• Strong understanding of and hands-on experience with power converters, such as linear regulators, switched-inductor DC-DC converters, and switched-capacitor DC-DC converters.

• In-depth knowledge and hands-on experience in designing integrated power converters, gate drivers, and PWM control circuits.

• In-depth knowledge and hands-on experience in designing analog circuits, including comparators, amplifiers, current sensors, temperature sensors, bandgap references, and related building blocks.

• Experience with IC design environments and EDA tools, such as Cadence (preferred), Synopsys, and/or Mentor Graphics.

• Experience with technical leadership, project leadership, and/or technology leadership in previous IC development projects is a plus.

• Experience with power management ICs (PMICs) and DC-DC converter applications is a plus.

jobs.occupation: Chef / Cook – Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar, Kalundborg
jobs.description:
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar is looking for skilled and motivated Chefs / Cooks to join our established restaurant in Kalundborg, Denmark.

Our restaurant in Kalundborg is a well-run, busy operation with a proven concept, experienced ownership and a clear direction. Located right in the middle of Kalundborg's main pedestrian street, we are a lively, pulsing part of the town and a gathering place for its residents. Our purpose is to create a vibrant place for the people of Kalundborg, built on quality ingredients and good food. We are now strengthening our kitchen team and are looking for chefs who want to become part of a structured, professional kitchen and contribute to consistent, high-quality service every day.

Our concept is based on modern Danish cuisine with a Nordic twist, combined with well executed brasserie classics and a varied à la carte menu. We focus on quality ingredients, solid craftsmanship and seasonal cooking, with dishes that combine flavour, comfort and consistency. Our menu includes both classic meat dishes, such as pepper steak, pasta dishes and other popular brasserie favourites.

Alongside our à la carte service, we have a private dining and events room, which you will also be part of. It brings welcome variety to the daily kitchen work, with menus that differ from the standard à la carte and the chance to cook for parties, celebrations and special occasions.

You will be joining a business with an already proven concept, an organised kitchen and a strong operational foundation. The setup is stable and well prepared, giving you a secure framework in which to do great work and develop your craft. Here you also get the freedom to bring your own ideas to life. We are not a place where everything is dictated from above — our chefs and kitchen staff are given the room to develop dishes, contribute to the menu and put their own mark on the food.

We are a serious but friendly workplace with respectful leadership, an organised kitchen environment and a no-drama culture. We believe strong kitchens are built on structure, teamwork and professionalism.

We are looking for chefs / cooks who:
• Have experience working in a professional kitchen
• Can handle prep, mise en place and service in a structured way
• Have experience with à la carte service
• Care about quality, teamwork and consistency
• Thrive in a busy restaurant environment
• Can work independently and take responsibility during service

We offer:
• Full-time employment
• A fixed work schedule
• Weekend work is part of the position

• Five weeks of paid holiday
• Company apartment / accommodation available
• Help with relocation and settling in Denmark
• Possibility of support with moving costs and/or paid accommodation in the first month, by agreement
• Good working conditions in a structured and professional environment
• Staff meals

• A stable, established restaurant with a proven concept and an organised kitchen
• The freedom to develop your own ideas and contribute to the menu

The position is based in Kalundborg, Denmark, in the heart of the city's main pedestrian street. Kalundborg offers a local Danish atmosphere, a charming town centre and a good quality of life.

Language
English is required. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

As soon as possible / by agreement.

How to apply
Please send
• Your CV
• A short introduction about yourself
• Your earliest possible start date

For applications and questions, please contact:
Esbern Snare ApS
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar
Phone: +45 25 14 44 00

Imagine a future where you safeguard the stability and resilience of operational technology systems that underpin offshore and onshore renewable energy generation.

We offer a workplace culture where you´ll arrange with your people leader when you can work from home and from the office.

Join us in this role where you’ll take a leading role in monitoring, triaging, and resolving OT and SCADA incidents across global wind assets. You’ll coordinate incident response across disciplines, drive root cause analysis, and strengthen operational resilience to ensure safe, secure, and reliable energy production. As part of our 24/7 operational setup, you’ll also join an on-duty rotation for one week each month, giving you the opportunity to take ownership when it matters most and help keep our assets running safely and reliably around the clock.

Welcome to OT Guard & Service Management

You’ll be part of OT Guard & Service Management where you, together with your colleagues, will support offshore and onshore assets by ensuring stable, secure, and compliant OT and SCADA operations across regions and time zones. You’ll collaborate closely with control rooms, cybersecurity, engineering teams, and suppliers to manage incidents and maintain high operational standards.

As a team, we we collaborate closely, act with integrity, and share knowledge openly to deliver safe, resilient, and high‑performing operations, even in high‑pressure situations.

You’ll play an important role in:

• monitoring OT system health, security events, and operational alerts across wind assets, substations, and onshore facilities

• triaging and responding to OT and SCADA incidents in close coordination with control room, cybersecurity, and engineering teams

• performing root cause analysis and documenting preventive actions to reduce repeat incidents

• conducting remote diagnostics and coordinating field or supplier interventions when required

• maintaining accurate incident records, handovers, and runbooks to support 24/7 operations

• contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen system resilience, supplier performance, and operational standards.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have experience working with OT or SCADA systems in critical infrastructure environments, or equivalent experience

• understand industrial control system architectures and protocols, such as IEC 60870‑5‑104, Modbus/TCP, DNP3, OPC UA, or equivalent experience

• are confident troubleshooting networks, operating systems, and system integrations in complex OT landscapes

• communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across disciplines, regions, and suppliers

• remain structured and calm when handling incidents in changing operational conditions

• hold a degree in engineering, automation, computer science, cybersecurity, or equivalent experience.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

Shape the future with us

jobs.occupation: 2-year Postdoctoral Researcher in Abstractions for Quantum Software
jobs.description:
The Quantum Hub at University of Southern Denmark is seeking a postdoctoral researcher for a two-year post to conduct research on abstractions for quantum software. As quantum computing advances towards large-scale fault-tolerant devices, robust hardware-independent software abstractions are becoming increasingly important for bridging the gap between quantum algorithms and physical implementations, and for making quantum computing accessible to software developers. We welcome applicants strongly motivated to contribute to this growing field with expertise in one or more of the following areas:

* Quantum algorithms

* Quantum circuit synthesis and optimisation

* Gaussian boson sampling

* Topological quantum computing

* Quantum error correction

* Fault-tolerant quantum computing

* Quantum programming languages and programming abstractions, including LLM-assisted quantum programming

* Quantum intermediate representations

* Quantum compilation, including AI/ML-assisted compilation techniques

* Quantum software engineering

* Quantum software design and testing

* Developer tools and usability in quantum software

The targeted starting date of the position is 1 January, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Note: We are not permitted to directly contact your academic references, so please ensure their letters have reached us by the deadline.  The application requirements are detailed at the end of this advertisement.  

Requirements
The candidate must have a PhD degree in mathematics, physics or computer science. 

Situation of the position
The position at the SDU Quantum Hub, will be situated at the Department of Mathematics and Computer Science, Faculty of Science on the international campus in Odense, Denmark. SDU Quantum Hub is established with the ambition to create a highly international and interdisciplinary group within a broad spectrum of quantum research. Odense is a fast-growing international community with an open Scandinavian culture, affordable housing and living costs. 

Assessment
Shortlisting may be used. Shortlisted applicants will be assessed by an assessment committee. Applicants will be informed of their assessment by the faculty. As part of the overall assessment, the applicant may be called for interview.

Conditions of employment
The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. 

Information of salary rates can be found at: https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu/international-staff

For non-Danish candidates there is an optional researcher taxation scheme (see the link above).

jobs.occupation: Associate Professor in Public Health: Children and Young People
jobs.description:
At the National Institute of Public Health (NIPH), University of Southern Denmark (SDU), a position as Associate Professor in Public Health is hereby advertised with a focus on interdisciplinary, qualitative studies of children’s and young people’s health and well-being, commencing on 15 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

About your future research environment  

The National Institute of Public Health (NIPH) is part of the University of Southern Denmark and is located in Copenhagen. As a national public health institute, we conduct research to improve public health in Denmark and Greenland. At the same time, we contribute internationally to the development of knowledge, theories and methods in the field of public health.

We offer an inspiring research environment in the heart of Copenhagen with skilled and dedicated colleagues from diverse research and educational backgrounds. Here, you will have the opportunity for academic exchange and further development of your own research areas, as well as participation in national and international networks. The position is anchored in the research group Health Promotion and Interventions, which conducts research on interventions addressing public health issues and works with methodological and theoretical challenges related to the design and evaluation of intervention and implementation studies. Our research concerns children, young people and families, as well as vulnerable and disadvantaged groups, and takes place in a range of settings, including daycare institutions, primary and lower secondary schools, upper secondary education, the healthcare system, municipal services, supermarkets and local communities.  
You will actively participate in the daily activities of the research group and work closely with other researchers at NIPH.  

The duties include research, teaching and dissemination within the institute’s areas of expertise, including:  
- Children’s and young people’s health, well-being and everyday life
- The significance of digital media for children’s and young people’s lives and health
- Health promotion and implementation research in daycare institutions, schools and upper secondary education
- Interdisciplinary, practice-oriented research and development projects, including process evaluation
- Advanced qualitative methods, including ethnography, interviews, focus groups and child-centred approaches
- Teaching and supervision at bachelor’s and master’s level, including qualitative methods, children’s and young people’s health, and implementation
- Preparation of applications for external funding as well as project management and coordination
- Contributions to the further development of the research environment, including method development and research group activities
 
The following qualifications are highly valued:  
You have established yourself as a qualified researcher within qualitative methods, children’s and young people’s health, and intervention and implementation research, and you possess strong research and teaching qualifications at a high level. You have a relevant publication profile and extensive experience in disseminating research to researchers, practitioners, and other target groups. You have broad collaborative networks and experience in research collaboration with practitioners. As a person, you are dedicated and possess strong communication skills. You are able to build trusting relationships with students, colleagues, and external partners alike. As a teacher, you communicate up-to-date, relevant knowledge in an engaging, clear and understandable way, and as a supervisor you are skilled, inspiring, and supportive.  

Qualifications  
- A PhD degree in Public Health, Education, Sociology, Anthropology or a related field
- Experience with intervention and implementation research
- Documented experience in research on children’s and young people’s health
- A strong profile within qualitative research
- Experience in collaborating with practitioners, exchanging knowledge and disseminating research
- Experience in national and international research collaboration
- Documented teaching experience at university level and experience supervising students (e.g. bachelor’s or master's students)
- Proficiency in Danish and English at a high level, both orally and in writing
- Documented experience with scientific publications within relevant research areas
 

Further information regarding the position can be obtained from:  
Research Leader Susan Andersen,  mailto:suan@sdu.dk

Terms and conditions of employment  
Appointment as an Associate Professor is for a fixed term of three years, commencing on 15 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Appointment to the position will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for associate professor as described herein. Please check links for more information on salary (only available in Danish) and taxation.

The person employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a self-organiser.

The assessment and evaluation process
Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Please note that only shortlisted applicants will receive an assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. 
Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee and the shortlisted applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. The committee may request additional information, and if so, it is the responsibility of the applicants to provide the necessary material. Interviews and tests may form part of the overall assessment carried out by the appointment committee.  
Based on information from the entire recruitment process, the Head of Institute will decide which applicant is offered the position. 

The application

Applicants are encouraged to read the information "How to apply" before applying. 

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

• 
Motivated application

• 
Curriculum vitae

• 
Master’s degree and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (copy of original + verified English translation)

• 
Teaching portfolio

• 
Research plan, including an account of your own research and preferably a vision for future research 

• 
A complete list of publications

• 
Up to six of the most relevant publications. Please attach one PDF file per publication. In cases of co-authorship, a co-author declaration must be submitted as part of the PDF file.

• 
Reference letters/references may also be included

• 
A statement of other qualifications relevant to the position.

We request files in pdf-format no more than 5 MB per file. All pdf-files must be unlocked and allow merging and may not be password protected. Documents should not contain a CPR number (civil registration number) – in this case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

UPLOAD GUIDE: Motivated application shall be uploaded as ‘Cover letter’, Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded as ‘CV’. All other documents shall be uploaded as ‘Miscellaneous documents’.

If the application does not meet the requirements mentioned above, the faculty may reject your application without further notice. Applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated.

If you experience technical problems, please contact mailto:hcm-support@sdu.dk

Application deadline 18 November 2026 at 23.59 (CET) 

We recommend that as an international applicant, you take the time to visit Work in Denmark where you will find information and facts about moving to, working and living in Denmark, as well as the International Staff Office at SDU.  

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding society and therefore encourages all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.  

About SDU  
The University of Southern Denmark was founded to create value for and together with society. Whether our contribution comes in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education, or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by nurturing talent and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops, and recruits talented individuals. At the same time, we must ensure consistently high quality in all our activities, which can only be achieved with the right people.  
The university’s researchers, teachers, students, managers, and technical-administrative staff constitute the foundation of our success.

jobs.occupation: Jentas is looking for a technically proficient part-time graphic designer with AI experience
jobs.description:
The publishing house Jentas is looking for a part-time graphic designer with a razor-sharp eye for good visual craftsmanship and experience working purposefully and constructively with AI.

Would you like to work for a dynamic and innovative publisher? Do you know what a cover that grabs the reader’s attention looks like? Are you detail-oriented when creating graphic products but able to zoom out to the bigger picture when prioritising your tasks? Do you have experience using AI to work more efficiently and deliver even better results? And are you ready for new challenges and not afraid to find alternative solutions?

Then you may be the person we are looking for.

Jentas (part of Bonnier Books) is a small publishing house specialising in the translation of crime, thriller and feel-good fiction from English into a wide range of other European languages, including Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, Spanish, Finnish, Polish, German and more. With us, you will be part of a close-knit team of graphic designers, publishers and project developers, and your tasks will centre on graphic production and on developing and improving graphic workflows.

This will involve:

• Designing covers for Jentas’ many new releases, primarily within the thriller, crime and feel-good genres

• Typesetting and, where relevant, entering corrections from proofreaders etc.

• Ongoing optimisation of graphic workflows, including through the use of AI and new technical tools to strengthen efficiency and quality

• Ad hoc graphical tasks of a smaller nature, e.g. related to the publisher’s social media presence, attendance at book fairs and similar

We therefore envision that you…

• Are an Adobe suite power user and are familiar with other relevant graphic design programs

• Have experience with and an interest in new AI tools, both for use in the graphic work itself and for optimising graphic workflows

• Have a strong eye for composition, aesthetics, typography, contrast, imagery and more

• Are structured and detail-oriented, and thrive when working independently

• Can plan and prioritise your tasks and are able to both set and meet deadlines

• Are good at collaborating internally in a small team where cooperation, sparring and shared development are crucial, and are also able to communicate precisely and smoothly with external partners

• Feel comfortable communicating both verbally and in writing in English and, ideally, another European language, which may be Danish but does not have to be

We also expect that you…

• Ideally have at least 1–2 years of experience as a graphic designer

• Have experience with print production, preferably for book publishing

We expect to interview candidates on an ongoing basis and would like to receive your application as soon as possible, but no later than 10 November. The position will be filled once the right candidate has been found.

The position is a part-time role of 25 hours per week, based at the publisher’s address. Start date preferably 11 January or as soon as possible hereafter.

Workplace: Smallegade 46B, 1st floor, 2000 Frederiksberg

Please send your application, CV, portfolio and any references by email, with the subject line “Grafiker”, to Chief Graphic Designer Holger Lund at holger@jentas.dk. Feel free to write your application in Danish or English, whichever suits you best. See also www.jentas.dk for a Danish version of this job post.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Senior Business Process consultant - Viby DK
jobs.description:
Would you like to turn complex procurement processes into practical digital solutions that create measurable business value? And are you motivated by working at the intersection of business, process improvement and technology?

“As our new Senior Business Process Consultant, you will connect business needs with digital opportunities within Procurement. You will join our Digital S2C Excellence team, part of Procurement Data and Digital Excellence, where you will work across Procurement, business functions and digital teams to improve the way we work and help translate business requirements into effective processes and solutions”, says Anette Falk Bøgebjerg, Head of Data & Digital Excellence for Procurement.

How you will make an impact

Reporting to the Head of Digital S2C Excellence, you will play an important role in developing and improving Arla's source-to-contract and procure-to-pay processes. Combining process knowledge, data and stakeholder insights, you will identify improvement opportunities, help design solutions and support their implementation across the organisation.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

• Facilitate business process improvements and collaborate with stakeholders to define and document clear objectives, requirements and opportunities for improvement.

• Analyse process and performance data to identify trends, challenge existing ways of working and recommend improvements.

• Design process and digital solutions that support business priorities, working closely with Digital Business Consultants and relevant Procurement and business teams.

• Maintain high-quality process documentation, define and monitor performance metrics and ensure alignment with Arla's process framework.

• Support change management, stakeholder training and the successful handover of improved processes to operational teams.

What will make you successful

For this role, we are looking for someone with 2-3 years of Procurement category knowledge and preferably an understanding of Source-to-Pay processes.

You have a Master’s degree in Economics, Supply Chain, or a related field, are interested in how digital solutions and data can enable better ways of working, and you are comfortable turning business requirements and analysis into practical recommendations. LEAN background would be an advantage.

You do not need to know everything from day one. What matters is that you bring solid knowledge about source to contract processes and are motivated to develop your expertise further in a complex, international Procurement environment.

To succeed in the role, you:

• Approach complex challenges with curiosity and use data and critical thinking to understand problems and identify practical solutions.

• Build constructive relationships across functions and can communicate requirements and ideas clearly to different stakeholders.

• Take ownership of your work while actively collaborating with others to create improvements that work in practice.

As Arla is an international organisation, professional proficiency in English is required.

What do we offer?

You will become part of Digital S2C Excellence within Procurement Data and Digital Excellence in Aarhus. The team has adopted agile ways of working and you will work in an  environment where business expertise, data and digital capabilities come together to improve the way Procurement operates.

The position offers an opportunity to build your expertise in business process management and digital transformation while working with colleagues across functions and geographies. You will have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful improvements while developing your professional capabilities within a global organisation.

We are committed to professional development and creating a collaborative environment where colleagues share knowledge and support each other in delivering results. You will join a global, farmer-owned dairy cooperative working to create value for our customers, our farmer owners and the wider world.

Would you like to join us?

If you would like to combine your category experience and business process skills with data and digital solutions to help shape the future of Procurement at Arla, we would be pleased to hear from you. Please apply as soon as possible, as we will process applications on a continuous basis and close the recruitment once the right candidate is found.

For additional information about the position, please contact Head of Data & Digital Excellence, Anette Falk Bøgebjerg at anefb@arlafoods.com

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

Are you ready to take ownership of a Nordic service organisation and build a more integrated, efficient and customer-focused operation across Denmark and Sweden? Join Ramcon and play a key role in strengthening service performance, developing people and processes, and supporting profitable growth in a specialized Nordic LabTech and MedTech  business.

Ramcon is a leading Nordic distributor of advanced solutions within Life Science, Healthcare, Medical Technology, Chemistry and Industrial applications. Since 1988, the company has built its market position through strong supplier partnerships, deep technical expertise and long-term customer relationships. Today, Ramcon distributes its products and solutions in Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland and employs approximately 80 employees across Denmark and Sweden. The company operates from offices in Birkerød, Aarhus, Stockholm, and Gothenburg.

Lead and develop the Nordic service organisation

The Service Director Nordic will have overarching responsibility for Ramcon’s Nordic service business and will be a member of the Nordic Leadership Team. The position combines people leadership, operational management and business development, with full P&L responsibility for the service business and responsibility for translating strategic ambitions into efficient operations and measurable results.

With direct responsibility for the Danish service business and overarching leadership of the service organisations in Denmark and Sweden, the Service Director Nordic will work closely with local Service Managers and Service Leaders. The role is responsible for building a stable, scalable and customer-focused Nordic service organisation, while strengthening collaboration with Sales, customers, suppliers and other stakeholders.

Key responsibilities include:

• Operational and direct leadership and development of the Nordic service organisation

• P&L responsibility, budgeting and performance follow-up for the Nordic service business

• Leadership and support of local Service Managers and Service Leaders in daily operations and long-term planning

• Standardisation and continuous improvement of service processes across Denmark and Sweden and preparation for local service presence in Norway and Finland

• Resource coordination and effective utilisation of service capacity across the Nordic organisation

• Development, implementation and follow-up of relevant KPIs

• Overarching responsibility for service contract sales and contract renewals

• Strengthening collaboration between Sales and Service and supporting customer-focused commercial execution

• Development of strong relationships and proactive communication with customers and suppliers

• Supporting digitalisation and automation of service workflows

Nordic leadership with operational impact

The Service Director Nordic will play a central role in developing Ramcon’s service organisation into a more integrated Nordic function. Success in the position requires the ability to combine strategic perspective with hands-on operational leadership while creating clear priorities, accountability and collaboration across countries and functions.

The position offers significant influence on how Ramcon delivers service to customers and organises its Nordic resources. The Service Director Nordic will lead an experienced organisation consisting of service engineers, service leadership and service coordination in Denmark and Sweden and will contribute directly to the company’s continued growth and operational development.

Your profile

The ideal candidate is an experienced service leader with a proven track record of creating results through people, structure and disciplined execution in a technical B2B environment. You understand the commercial importance of a high-performing service organisation and can balance customer needs, quality, resource utilization and financial performance.

Furthermore, the successful candidate is expected to have:

• Experience in leading service teams across multiple locations

• Strong people leadership capabilities and experience in developing managers and specialists

• Experience with P&L responsibility, budgeting, KPIs and performance management

• A structured approach to process improvement, resource planning and operational excellence

• Commercial understanding and experience with service agreements, contract sales or renewals

• The ability to build trust and collaboration across customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders

• A pragmatic and action-oriented leadership style combined with a strategic Nordic perspective

Experience from Life Science, Diagnostics, Laboratory Solutions, Medical Technology or another specialised technical service environment would be considered very beneficial.

About the job

At Saxo, we believe access to global capital markets should be simple and accessible. As Senior Legal Counsel, you will play a key role in supporting Saxo's continued growth, innovation and strategic ambitions.

Reporting to the General Counsel, you will provide trusted legal advice across a broad range of business initiatives, regulatory developments, corporate matters, commercial activities, governance matters and strategic projects. Working closely with stakeholders across our offices in both Denmark and abroad, you will help ensure that legal considerations enable business success while maintaining the highest standards of governance, integrity and regulatory compliance.

This role combines strong legal expertise with stakeholder management and business partnership. As Senior Legal Counsel, you will act as a trusted advisor across Saxo, providing pragmatic legal guidance and partnering with stakeholders at all levels of the organisation to navigate legal complexity and support informed decision-making.

Responsibilities

As Senior Legal Counsel, you will:

• Provide strategic legal advice to key stakeholders across Saxo.

• Support commercial, corporate, governance and regulatory matters affecting the business.

• Advise on marketing activities, customer communications, commercial partnerships and strategic business initiatives.

• Partner with business stakeholders to ensure legal risks are appropriately identified and managed.

• Support product development, business expansion initiatives and corporate projects.

• Contribute to effective legal governance frameworks and decision-making processes.

• Collaborate closely with Compliance, Risk Management, Internal Audit and other control functions.

• Manage relationships with external counsel and legal service providers.

• Monitor regulatory developments and support the implementation of relevant legal and regulatory requirements.

• Contribute to the continuous development of the Legal function and strengthen its role as a proactive business partner.

Your profile

You are an experienced legal professional with a strong legal foundation and a proven ability to navigate complex business challenges in a highly regulated environment.

You bring solid legal expertise, sound commercial judgement and the credibility to serve as a trusted advisor to stakeholders across the organisation. You are comfortable balancing legal risk with business priorities and have a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach to legal advisory.

To succeed in this role, you will preferably have:

• A master's degree in law or an equivalent legal qualification.

• Solidlegal experience preferably gained either within the financial services industry or at a leading law firm advising clients in regulated sectors.

• Understanding of the legal and regulatory framework governing financial institutions and financial markets.

• Experience advising business stakeholders on legal matters in relation to strategic initiatives and commercial matters.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex legal matters into practical business advice.

• A proactive, commercially minded and collaborative approach.

Beyond your technical legal capabilities, you are a trusted business partner who builds strong relationships across the organisation and enables informed decision-making while maintaining a high standard of legal governance and integrity.

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

Für das Hotel Hesselet wird ein Kellner gesucht.

Möchten Sie dazu beitragen, ein neues Restauranterlebnis im Hotel Hesselet zu eröffnen? Am 1. März 2027 eröffnen wir das Restaurant Hi – ein neu erbautes Pavillonrestaurant im Hotel Hesselet, das als exklusives kulinarisches Universum mit offener Küche, einladendem Ambiente und einem starken Fokus auf Gastfreundschaft, Kultur und ganzheitliche Erlebnisse geschaffen wurde.

Das Hotel Hesselet liegt an einem der schönsten Orte Fünens. Direkt dort, wo der Wald auf das Meer trifft und man die Brücke zwischen Seeland und Fünen sehen kann. Das Hotel befindet sich in Nyborg, das im Mittelalter der Treffpunkt des Königs mit den wichtigsten Persönlichkeiten des Reiches war. Heute ist das Hotel ein Ort der Begegnung, an dem Gastfreundschaft zur Geborgenheit wird.

Das Hotel ist nach dem Wald benannt, in dem es liegt. Hesselet bedeutet „Ort, wo die kleinen Haselnusssträucher wachsen“. Wir sind stolz darauf, zu Dänemarks beliebtesten Strandhotels zu gehören und bemühen uns, all unseren Gästen ein außergewöhnliches Erlebnis zu bieten – egal ob sie bei uns übernachten, speisen oder an einer Konferenz teilnehmen.

Das Hotel Hesselet verändert sich – und ist in guten Händen

Im Jahr 2024 wurde das Hotel Hesselet vom Carama Family Office übernommen, das eine klare Vision verfolgt: die Seele von Hesselet zu bewahren und gleichzeitig das Hotel für zukünftige Gästeerlebnisse weiterzuentwickeln – ohne dabei die Geschichte und die Wärme des Ortes zu beeinträchtigen.

Die neuen Eigentümer haben mit einer behutsamen Renovierung der Hoteleinrichtungen, des Restaurants und der Außenanlagen begonnen. Es wird sowohl in das Ambiente als auch in die Mitarbeiter investiert – mit einem starken Fokus auf Professionalität, Wohlbefinden und erstklassigen Service.

Das Ziel ist ambitioniert, aber klar: Das Hotel Hesselet soll zu den attraktivsten Hotels Dänemarks zählen – sowohl für Gäste als auch für Mitarbeiter. Hier soll man die besondere Ruhe, Qualität und Atmosphäre spüren können, für die Hesselet seit 1967 bekannt ist – in einer zeitgemäßen und modernen Interpretation.

Möchten Sie dazu beitragen, exzellenten Service und großartige Gästeerlebnisse zu bieten?

Wir suchen einen Kellner, der Teil eines kompetenten Teams werden möchte, in dem stolze Traditionen, hohe Qualität und eine gute Atmosphäre Hand in Hand gehen.

Als Teil unseres Servicepersonals arbeiten Sie in unserem Restaurant, in Veranstaltungsräumen und bei Konferenzen.

Sie werden ein wichtiger Bestandteil des Gästeerlebnisses sein – vom Frühstück und Mittagessen bis zum Abendservice und besonderen Veranstaltungen.

Wir bieten:

• Ein starkes, engagiertes Team mit tollen Kollegen und einem Fokus auf Zusammenarbeit

• Ein Arbeitsplatz mit hohem Serviceniveau und vielen Stammkunden

• Möglichkeit zur beruflichen Weiterentwicklung und Übernahme von Verantwortung

• Ein abwechslungsreicher Alltag mit alltäglichen Gästen, Partys und Treffen

• Eine fantastische Lage und ein Haus mit Seele und Geschichte

Wir erwarten von Ihnen Folgendes:

• Er ist ein Kellner und legt großen Wert auf guten Service und Gastfreundschaft.

• Behalten Sie den Überblick, bleiben Sie ruhig und lächeln Sie – auch wenn es mal hektisch zugeht.

• Ist flexibel und kann Termine einhalten

• Blüht in Teamarbeit auf, kann aber auch selbstständig Verantwortung übernehmen.

• Ich interessiere mich für Wein, Essen und Gästeerlebnisse.

Arbeitsumfeld

Im Hotel Hesselet pflegen wir eine herzliche, familiäre und freundschaftliche Atmosphäre – sowohl unter Kollegen als auch gegenüber unseren Gästen. Wir sind überzeugt, dass die besten Ergebnisse durch echte Zusammenarbeit, gegenseitige Präsenz und Interesse entstehen.

Wir erwarten von Ihnen, dass Sie Ihre Persönlichkeit, Ihre Energie und Ihr Engagement einbringen – sowohl in Ihrer Arbeit als auch im Umgang mit Kollegen und Gästen. Im Gegenzug bieten wir Ihnen ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem wir uns gegenseitig unterstützen und als Team zusammenarbeiten, wobei Wohlbefinden und Erfolg gleichermaßen im Fokus stehen.

Wir arbeiten intensiv daran, einen der besten Arbeitsplätze der Branche in Dänemark zu schaffen – und als Teil unseres Serviceteams werden Sie Teil eines engagierten und dynamischen Unternehmens mit ambitionierten Zielen und hoher Professionalität. Wir bieten gute Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, ein gesundes Arbeitsumfeld und viel Raum, um mit den Aufgaben zu wachsen.

Gehalt und Konditionen

Gehalt nach Qualifikation. Zusätzlich bieten wir Altersvorsorge, Krankenversicherung und weitere Beschäftigungsbedingungen gemäß Tarifvertrag und gegebenenfalls weiterer Vereinbarung. Es handelt sich um eine Vollzeitstelle mit frühestmöglichem Eintrittstermin oder nach Vereinbarung.

Senden Sie Ihre Bewerbung und Ihren Lebenslauf an unseren Restaurantleiter Rasmus Weimar unter rasmus@hesselet.dk – am besten so bald wie möglich, da wir laufend Vorstellungsgespräche führen.

Sollten Sie Fragen zur Stelle haben, können Sie ihn gerne direkt unter der Telefonnummer (45) 65 31 30 29 kontaktieren.

Klingt das nach etwas, von dem Sie gerne hören würden? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, von Ihnen zu hören.

Do you want to build intelligent software that powers the future of sports coaching? Are you passionate about transforming raw data and AI model predictions into meaningful, real-world metrics for professional American football players? Then come and join our ambitious and collaborative product team!

Data is revolutionizing sports. Join our team to play.

This is a great opportunity to join our growing New Sports team within our Tracking Department. Our team is responsible for the development of the firmware for our American football products. We are developing cutting-edge solutions that leverage deep learning, classic computer vision, machine learning, and signal processing algorithms to deliver product features. Through our market leading radar and computer vision-based tracking technology, we are building products used by some of the best athletes in the world.

Example projects we are working on:

• 
Detecting and tracking objects, such as balls, players, and clubs, across several different sports

• 
Optical flow for determining ball flight characteristics

• 
Calibration between radar and camera data for drawing tracks in broadcast television

• 
Human pose tracking for analyzing athlete performance

Are you our new colleague?

Our ideal candidate is specialized the area of computer vision and machine learning. You will be joining a team of specialists within these fields and together we strive to remain the best in the world at what we do. Your responsibilities will include development of new and existing products and core processes based on your experience and skills.

In the new sports team we value teamwork and openness. Therefore, we expect you to enjoy working with other highly motivated colleagues and help provide a good working environment. Develop advanced DL, ML, classic computer vision, algorithms.

• 
Write production ready code, with emphasis on deployment, monitoring and supportability

• 
Design and execute experiments to acquire and prepare datasets for algorithm development

• 
Develop and extend tooling for computer vision development. This can include data visualization, annotation and debugging

Develop appropriate system architecture for edge-based and server solutions

• 
Collaborate with engineers within Vision & AI and the tracking department to produce high quality cutting edge systems

Job requirements

Master’s Degree or Ph.D. in computer vision, machine learning, computer science, mathematical modelling, or equivalent

• 
3+ years of practical experience in implementing and deploying computer vision systems, with a proven track record of successful project execution and system optimization

• 
Strong software development and programming skills within Python and C++

• 
Experienced in computer vision techniques, including object detection, video tracking, and image analysis, as well as deep learning and convolutional neural networks in machine learning

• 
You have an entrepreneurial mindset and thrive on taking an idea from concept to a polished implementation.

Nice to haves:

Experience with or knowledge of image acquisition, camera calibration

Preferably experience with or knowledge of video formats and camera hardware, drivers and low-level software

Working in a fast-paced, team-based environment also demands a certain degree of self-planning, as well as the ability to work independently. Highly skilled colleagues

World class office facilities

International environment with more than 35 nationalities in our HQ

Social activities
