Director, Platform Engineering – Accelerate the SaaS transformation behind one of the world’s leading media platforms

Do you thrive at the intersection of organizational leadership, platform engineering, and SaaS transformation? Are you motivated by building teams and shared capabilities that enable other engineers to move faster, operate with greater autonomy, and deliver at scale?

At Stibo DX, we are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering to lead a strategically important engineering domain and drive our transition toward SaaS.

The role

As Director of Platform Engineering, you will lead three global teams responsible for Cloud Platform, Print Platform, and Content Delivery. Together, these teams provide shared platform foundations, deployment capabilities, gateway infrastructure, APIs, and supporting services used across the Cue media enterprise platform.

Your primary mission is to accelerate the SaaS transformation. You will develop the domain into a coherent platform-engineering organization that provides standardized, reusable, and self-service capabilities, enabling application teams to deploy and operate their services without the Platform Engineering organization becoming a central delivery bottleneck.

A central part of the role is to establish clear organizational boundaries between Platform Engineering, application teams, SRE, and Operations. You will help shape a model in which Platform Engineering provides the shared foundation and developer enablement, while application teams remain accountable for the behavior, reliability, and operational outcomes of the services they build.

You will also lead the organization through this transition. Stibo DX is building toward a SaaS-first future while continuing to support self-hosted and hybrid customers. The role therefore requires someone who can balance the target state with pragmatic migration paths, preserving customer value while steadily reducing complexity and fragmentation.

Reporting directly to the CTO and serving both as a member of the Development Leadership Team and the company-wide Senior Leadership Team, you will lead a domain of 14 people and contribute to the continued development of both your domain and the wider engineering organization. The role can be based at any of our Stibo DX offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Hamburg, Oslo, or Málaga.

Key responsibilities

You will lead and develop a distributed engineering organization while creating the structure, capabilities, and momentum required to scale Stibo DX’s SaaS transformation. The role combines organizational leadership, platform strategy, developer enablement, and operational discipline, and requires close collaboration with Product Management, Architecture, SRE, Operations, and other engineering leaders.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Lead and develop the distributed Cloud Platform, Print Platform, and Content Delivery teams.

• Build a coherent platform-engineering organization with a shared mission, clear ownership, and strong execution.

• Accelerate the SaaS transformation by translating strategic direction into platform capabilities, adoption paths, and measurable outcomes.

• Provide standardized, reusable, and self-service capabilities that enable application teams to deploy and operate services independently.

• Treat the platform as a product, with clear internal users, priorities, adoption measures, and feedback loops.

• Establish clear boundaries between Platform Engineering, application teams, SRE, Operations, and Architecture.

• Drive platform adoption with the other Development leaders while keeping application migration and operational ownership within the application domains.

• Balance development of the target SaaS platform with pragmatic transition paths for self-hosted and hybrid customers.

• Build a culture of trust, accountability, constructive challenge, continuous improvement, and company-first leadership.

The ideal candidate

You are first and foremost an experienced engineering leader. You know how to create clarity, build effective teams, and translate strategic direction into coordinated execution across a complex engineering domain. You have successfully led distributed engineering teams in an international environment and bring experience from a customer-facing SaaS company or an organization transitioning toward SaaS delivery models.

You understand that developer enablement is how platform engineering scales. You know where a central platform team should build reusable capabilities, where it should provide standards and guardrails, and where application teams must retain ownership. You measure success through adoption and autonomy, not through the amount of work centralized in the platform organization.

You bring sufficient technical depth in platform engineering and SaaS to engage credibly with senior engineers and architects, understand trade-offs, ask incisive questions, guide the overall direction, and recognize whether teams are progressing toward a coherent and scalable platform. You are not expected to be hands-on or to act as the chief platform architect. Your role is to create the conditions for strong technical decisions and hold the organization accountable for sustained progress.

You are a strong people leader known for building trust, developing talent, and creating an environment where accountability, ownership, and continuous learning thrive. You communicate clearly, collaborate naturally across organizational boundaries, and contribute to the success of the wider company rather than focusing only on your own area.

Relevant experience

• Proven leadership experience from platform engineering, cloud-native engineering, developer platforms, or a closely related area.

• Experience leading multiple distributed engineering teams through organizational and technological change.

• Experience with customer-facing SaaS products and the organizational changes required to support SaaS-first delivery models.

• Broad understanding of platform engineering, internal developer platforms, self-service, AWS, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, APIs and gateways, observability, security, reliability, and cloud economics.

• Experience modernizing an established software platform while continuing to support legacy, self-hosted, or hybrid customer environments.

• A demonstrated ability to strengthen adoption of shared platforms and improve autonomy for application teams.

• Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to align across engineering, product, architecture, and operations.

• Fluency in English, spoken and written.

Interested?

Please apply through LinkedIn. We review applications as they are received and encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview. The position will remain open until we have found the right candidate.

If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Chief Technology Officer Jesper Broni Andersen by email at jba@stibodx.com. We look forward to hearing from you.

Help us empower storytellers across the globe

Stibo DX is the global leader in digital transformation for media enterprises. Our platform and services help automate complex content production and enable omnichannel delivery for some of the world's most ambitious and successful media organizations.

We are a global and dynamic team of over 200 employees based in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Atlanta, Hamburg, Oslo, and Málaga, combining creativity and innovation with the stability of a long-standing organization.

Stibo DX is part of the Stibo Software Group, the second-largest Danish-owned software group. Our roots trace back to the Stibo Foundation, which has a 228-year history and a rich legacy that supports our continued growth.

Read the Stibo DX story and about working at Stibo DX.

Do you enjoy understanding how things work, spotting inefficiencies and finding better ways to solve problems? Would you like the software you build to matter in real time? Then you might be our next Student Software Developer.

At Nitor Energy, software isn’t a support function – it’s at the core of how we trade. You’ll join our software team and help build the tools and systems that traders and analysts use every day. You’ll get meaningful responsibility early, support from experienced developers and hands-on exposure to a fast-moving business, with the opportunity to grow into a full-time role.

Direct collaboration. No middlemen.

We believe the best solutions are built by people who understand the problem firsthand. That’s why we work without unnecessary handoffs or translation layers: developers talk directly to traders, analysts and the colleagues who use what they build.

As a student, you’ll be part of these conversations, learning to ask good questions, test ideas, get feedback quickly and see the impact of your work.

What you’ll be doing

• Build and improve internal trading systems, analytical tools, dashboards and alerts alongside experienced developers.

• Integrate, process and make market data available from external vendors.

• Take on well-scoped development tasks, from understanding requirements to implementation, testing, review and deployment.

• Work directly with traders and analysts to understand their workflows, gather feedback and iterate on solutions.

• Learn what it takes to build reliable, maintainable software – including shared data models, traceability, performance and system operations.

• Explore approved AI-assisted development tools responsibly and verify the code and outputs you use.

What we’re looking for

• You’re studying for a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, with no more than a year remaining, and are interested in a potential full-time future at Nitor.

• You have good programming fundamentals and a practical, curious approach to solving problems.

• You’ve had exposure to some of our stack – C# (.NET/ASP.NET Core), TypeScript/React, Microsoft SQL, Azure or Python – or are motivated to learn it. You don’t need experience with all of them.

• You enjoy working with others, communicate openly, ask for help when needed and learn from feedback.

• You take responsibility for your tasks, follow through and look for ways to make things better.

What we offer

• Meaningful tasks from day one with close mentoring, regular feedback and room to grow.

• A chance to learn the energy trading domain while contributing to business-critical systems.

• A young, ambitious and social environment where developers, analysts and traders work closely together.

• Competitive pay and a modern office in central Aarhus, right by Dokk1 and the light rail.

• Catered lunch from Meyers, social events and weekly sports activities, including the Nitor running club.

Expected start date: As soon as possible.

Please note that we review applications on a rolling basis and may close the position early if we find the right candidate.

Nitor Energy is a fast-growing energy trading company, that has swiftly transitioned from start-up to scale-up within just a few years. We’re experiencing rapid growth, offering limitless opportunities for learning and development. We’re proud of who we are and excited about what we’re building for the future together. Our employees thrive on challenges and are motivated by the potential that lies ahead.

Our unique culture integrates traders, coders, and analysts into cohesive teams, creating a well-rounded approach to our success. We believe in a balanced work-life dynamic and foster a vibrant, engaging atmosphere where our employees can excel in every aspect.

jobs.occupation: Saab Danmark A/S - Chief Product Officer
jobs.description:
Saab Danmark is entering an exciting phase of growth and transformation. We are looking for a Chief Product Officer (CPO) who can define direction, drive execution, and lead the evolution of our products, technology, and product organization. You will play a key role in strengthening our product platform, advancing our digital capabilities, and positioning Saab Danmark for sustainable long-term growth.

Reporting to the CEO and serving as a member of the Danish Management Team, you will hold overall responsibility for Saab Danmark's Product Organization, including Product Management and Product Development across Software, Hardware, Systems Engineering, and Testing.

As CPO, you will play a pivotal role in shaping Saab Danmark's next chapter. While ensuring successful delivery across an active project portfolio, you will lead the transition towards a stronger product-centric approach, where a scalable core platform enables future innovation, customer solutions, and digital services.

This role requires a leader who can combine strategic vision with operational excellence, create followership across the organization, and unite technology, product development, and business priorities into one coherent direction.

Key responsibilities

• 
Define, maintain, and drive the overall product, technology strategy in alignment with Saab’s vision, business objectives, and future market opportunities.

• 
Develop and execute a product roadmap that balances short-term delivery commitments with long-term product and technology investments.

• 
Lead and develop the Product Organization through Product Management, Software, Hardware, Systems Engineering, and Testing leadership teams.

• 
Strengthen Product Management capabilities and ways of working, ensuring clear ownership of product strategy, portfolio priorities, roadmap decisions, and customer value creation across the organization.

• 
Drive the evolution towards a more software-defined, cloud-enabled, and service-oriented product architecture, translating emerging technologies and digital trends into sustainable customer value.

• 
Ensure alignment between customer needs, business priorities, technology development, and product investments.

• 
Establish and strengthen the core product platform, enabling future customer solutions to be delivered through configuration, extension, and scalable reuse rather than repeated customization.

• 
Foster organizational effectiveness, accountability, and execution across the full product lifecycle.

• 
Build an aligned and high-performing leadership team by creating clarity, strengthening leadership capabilities, and fostering commitment to a shared direction across experienced technical leaders and specialist disciplines.

• 
Ensure clear prioritization of resources and development initiatives across competing demands.

• 
Safeguard the long-term direction, architecture, and integrity of Saab Danmark’s product portfolio.

• 
Foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, learning, and ownership.

• 
Contribute actively to company strategy and decision-making as a member of the company Management Team.

What you bring

You are an experienced product and technology leader with a strong track record from Product Management, Software Engineering, Product Development, or similarly complex technology-driven environments.

You have successfully led organizations through growth, change, and transformation and know how to create results through clear direction, strong leadership, and effective collaboration.

You are comfortable operating at both strategic and operational levels and have demonstrated the ability to translate ambitious visions into tangible business outcomes.

Ideally, you bring:

• 
Experience from software-centric or software-defined product environments where product strategy, engineering excellence, and customer value creation are closely connected.

• 
Strong experience with Product Management, product strategy, roadmap management, and portfolio prioritization.

• 
A solid understanding of modern software development practices, platform thinking, and cloud technologies.

• 
Experience leading product, platform, cloud, or digital transformation initiatives and translating strategic ambitions into measurable organizational and business outcomes.

• 
Experience balancing the demands of ongoing customer deliveries with the long-term development of scalable products, platforms, and capabilities.

• 
The ability to balance operational delivery with long-term capability building.

• 
A strong commercial mindset combined with a deep appreciation for technology and innovation.

• 
The ability to navigate competing priorities and make clear decisions in complex environments.

• 
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to create alignment across diverse functions and leadership levels.

• 
Experience building trust, credibility, and followership in organizations with highly experienced technical leaders and specialists.

• 
Curiosity about emerging technologies and their potential impact on products, services, and business models.

In addition, you must be able to obtain and maintain the security clearance required by Danish Defence Intelligence Service for this position. This typically requires candidates to have resided within a NATO or EU member state for the past seven years.

Who you are

You are a pragmatic leader who combines strategic thinking with operational discipline.

You create clarity in complex environments, make priorities visible, and build followership through professional credibility, sound judgement, and consistent leadership. You are comfortable leading experienced managers and specialists and create alignment and commitment around a shared direction.

Why Saab Danmark?

This is an opportunity to play a defining role in shaping the future of Saab Danmark. You will influence the direction of our products, contribute to company strategy, and help position Saab Danmark for its next stage of growth.

If you are motivated by building great products, shaping organizational direction, and creating lasting business impact, this is an opportunity to play a key role in Saab Danmark's continued development and growth.

For further information about the position, please contact Flemming Klovborg, LOHFF | THORNING Partner at +45 4314 4202. All inquiries will be handled with complete confidentiality.

Applications should be submitted through the application link.

About Saab Danmark A/S

Saab in Denmark is part of the Saab Group with headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden. At the same time, Saab Danmark is an independent legal company with a flat organisational structure. Our main business area is delivering integrated communication solutions to military markets in Denmark and abroad.

You can find further information about Saab’s integrated communication solution TactiCall, at www.saab.com/naval.

jobs.occupation: AIV Planner - help turn spacecraft assembly into a scalable production flow
jobs.description:
In our Satellite Assembly, Integration, and Verification Team, you will be at the center of planning how spacecraft are assembled, integrated, tested, and tracked. You will translate complex AIV activities into executable production flows and system structures, while coordinating the interfaces that make the flow work in practice. If you combine strong systems understanding with structure, initiative, and a drive to build better solutions, this is your opportunity to shape how we manufacture satellites.

About the Position as AIV Planner

As AIV Planner, you will own the planning framework supporting spacecraft assembly and verification. You will establish and maintain production flows, routings, and planning data in our ERP system while coordinating activities across AIV, production, project management, and logistics to ensure efficient execution.

You will play a key role in developing scalable planning processes, improving digital ways of working, and connecting future ERP and MES capabilities to the needs of spacecraft production. Your experience and ideas will directly influence a more controlled, digital, and scalable production flow.

Responsibilities include:

You will ensure that spacecraft build plans are translated into controlled and executable work in our operational systems, while aligning the interfaces needed for reliable AIV execution.

Production Planning and System Execution

• Create and maintain AIV routings, production orders, planning parameters, and relevant production master data in the ERP system.

• Translate engineering structures and AIV plans into practical production sequences with clear dependencies, revisions, effectivity, and material requirements.

• Monitor order progress and data quality, resolve planning issues, and help establish the ERP system as the operational source of truth for spacecraft build execution.

Cross-functional Planning and Material Flow

• Coordinate with Electronic Production, Project Management, AIV, engineering, warehouse, and other planners to align readiness, priorities, materials, and handovers.

• Coordinate AIV inventory and material flow, including allocation, kitting, shortages, transfers, returns, and controlled movement of hardware.

Configuration, Change, and Improvement

• Maintain configuration and traceability in the ERP system, including correct parts, revisions, serial numbers, routings, effectivity, material movements, and as-built status.

• Assist the ECR/ECO process by identifying affected routings and production orders, supporting change-impact assessment, and implementing approved changes in the ERP system with the required traceability.

What you bring

At GomSpace, it’s not just your technical skills that matter - your character is also important. We value individuals who bring a positive, proactive attitude and can build trust across cultures. The ideal candidate will be comfortable taking ownership in an environment that is still being built, combining a strong systems understanding with practical knowledge of production flows and the ability to quickly learn new tools and processes.

You likely:

• Have minimum 3 years of experience in production planning, working with ERP, MES, or similar operational systems. Experience with IFS is a strong plus, but not mandatory.

• Practical understanding of production flows, routings, production orders, material availability, sequencing, and master data.

• Ability to understand system relationships and translate engineering and operational inputs into a clear, executable production flow.

• Experience with configuration management, revision control, serial-number traceability, and as-built records.

• Ability to coordinate across multiple interfaces and turn incomplete or changing inputs into a structured plan.

• Strong drive, ownership, and a solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to establish and improve processes rather than only operate existing ones.

• Clear written and verbal communication in English.

Here’s why you’ll love working with us:

At GomSpace, we’re on a mission to shape the future of space – one mission at a time. Here, you’ll be part of something bigger than just a project or a product. You’ll help build systems that connect people, enable science and expand humanity’s reach beyond Earth.

We believe the best results come when talented people are trusted, supported, and inspired to push boundaries together.

• Be part of a global company making a real impact in the space industry

• Get freedom under responsibility from day one – and grow with us

• Join a dynamic, full-service environment where no two days are alike

• Work across borders and build a strong international network

• Be part of a culture where collaboration beats competition – and milestones are celebrated together

Join our mission

You are welcome to send your application in Danish or English. Interviews will be conducted on a continuous basis. Apply for the job by following the link below.

If you have any questions with regard to the position do not hesitate to contact: Simon Holt Olsen, Head of AIV, shol@gomspace.com.

Workplace will be at our premises at Langagervej 6, Aalborg, Denmark and it is expected that most of the time is in the offices.

As part of our recruitment process, employment requires you to complete a background check conducted by an authorized third-party provider in accordance with applicable legislation.

At GomSpace WE MAKE SPACE YOURS

GomSpace is a globally leading designer, integrator and manufacturer of high-end nano and microsatellites for customers in the academic, government and commercial markets. Our positions of strength include systems integration, small satellite subsystems and advanced miniaturized radio technology. At the core of our mission are our core values: Be helpful, communicate openly and frequently, and show true leadership.

Our international team is devoted to understanding our customers’ requirements and delivering high quality. We are listed in Stockholm (GOMX), headquartered in Denmark and have subsidiaries in Sweden, Singapore, France, North America and Luxembourg. We have more than 300 employees servicing customers in more than 60 countries. Learn more on www.gomspace.com

Join us in shaping the future of space exploration!

Application deadline:

As soon as possible

jobs.description:

Shape the Future of Dairy

Do you enjoy finding the biggest commercial opportunities, improving customer journeys, and turning data into initiatives that drive measurable growth? Keep reading!

At Limepack, E-commerce is at the heart of how we acquire and convert customers across Europe. As we grow, we see significant potential to improve the customer journey and webshop performance across our markets, while becoming much better at what happens after the first purchase: building stronger relationships, increasing repeat purchases, and growing customer lifetime value.

With our current E-commerce Manager going on maternity leave, this role has a unique starting point. You’ll initially take ownership of E-commerce growth and customer journey optimisation, but this is not simply a 10–12 month maternity cover. The role is designed to evolve with you: over time, your focus will shift towards becoming Limepack’s Loyalty Lead, taking long-term ownership of Post-Purchase, CRM & Lifecycle.

This is a role for someone who combines commercial thinking with strong execution. You’ll use data to identify where the biggest opportunities are, set priorities, and drive initiatives across teams, taking responsibility for turning ideas into measurable results.

📋 Your responsibilities and impact

Your focus will evolve as you grow into the role: starting with E-commerce and gradually taking ownership of Loyalty, CRM, Email and Lifecycle.

• Grow E-commerce performance: Own and improve webshop conversion, customer journeys, AOV and revenue across markets. Identify the biggest opportunities and turn them into scalable improvements.

• Lead and collaborate across our tech setup: For the first 10–12 months, you will lead Alexander, our UX/Frontend Developer, who will report to you, while you report to our CCO. You will also work closely with our two Backend Developers and external partners to bring initiatives from idea to implementation.

• Turn data into priorities: Use customer and commercial data to understand where we should focus, build a clear roadmap, and follow up on the KPIs that matter.

• Drive projects from idea to impact: Lead high-impact initiatives across teams, create clear ownership, and make sure the right people and resources come together to deliver on time.

• Build for scale: Look beyond one-off improvements and create solutions that can work effectively across Limepack’s European markets.

• Build our Loyalty engine: After 10-12 months, own and improve the customer journey beyond the first purchase across Post-Purchase, CRM, Email and Lifecycle. Build stronger customer relationships, increase repeat purchases and grow customer lifetime value.

What success looks like: Within your first 12 months, you’ll aim to increase webshop conversion by 30%, help deliver our 2027 E-commerce revenue target of 40M in new business, and establish clear ownership and priorities for Loyalty. Longer term, you’ll drive improvements in repeat purchase rate, CLV and lifecycle revenue, including increasing first-to-second-purchase retention from 40% to 50%.

👉 Who you are

• You think commercially: You naturally look for the opportunities that will have the biggest impact on revenue and customer value, rather than simply working through a list of tasks.

• You are analytical and curious: You enjoy digging into data, understanding what customers are doing, and using those insights to decide what to improve next.

• You make things happen: You take ownership from opportunity to execution, create structure around projects, and follow through until the result is delivered.

• You are always looking for a better way: You enjoy improving customer journeys, processes and systems and think about how solutions can be scaled rather than solving the same problem repeatedly.

• You are strong across teams: You’re comfortable driving projects through people you don’t directly manage, aligning different stakeholders, and creating clarity around priorities and ownership.

🎓 Your experience

To succeed in this role, you should bring a strong combination of E-commerce experience, commercial thinking, analytical skills and project ownership.

• You have 3–5 years of relevant experience, ideally in E-commerce, digital growth, CRO, CRM, lifecycle marketing, or a similar commercially focused role.

• You have owned E-commerce performance and can point to measurable commercial results you personally helped create.

• You have hands-on experience with CRO and customer journey optimisation and know how to turn insights into improvements.

• You are strong with data, prioritization and project management, and are comfortable coordinating initiatives across multiple teams and stakeholders.

• Experience with CRM, lifecycle, retention or multi-market E-commerce is a strong advantage.

🚀 Who We Are

Limepack is a profitable Copenhagen-based European scale-up making custom-branded takeaway packaging accessible to businesses of all sizes. Since 2018, we’ve expanded across 14 countries by partnering with European manufacturers to offer faster, more affordable, and more sustainable packaging solutions.

We’re growing fast: we’ve been named a Børsen Gazelle four years in a row for exceptional revenue growth (Limepack.com/growth), and our ambition is to triple revenue over the next three years.

Today, we’re a team of 33 people, including 14 remote colleagues. We put a lot of emphasis on building a great place to work, and we’re proud to be a certified Happy Workplace (Limepack.com/happy). 🚀

💚 We offer:

• A full-time position based in Copenhagen with flexibility to work from home.

• A competitive salary based on experience.

• 6 weeks of paid time off, pay during sick days, and generous paid parental leave.

• The opportunity to take ownership of an important commercial area and grow from E-commerce ownership into leading Limepack’s Loyalty, CRM & Lifecycle agenda.

Software Engineer, Technical Department, Cavendish Hydrogen, Herning

Are you ready to help advance the transition to clean mobility? At Cavendish Hydrogen, we are driven by a clear and vital mission: accelerating the global transition to zero-emission heavy-duty transportation. As a dedicated hydrogen fueling company, we design, deliver, and service cutting-edge hydrogen refueling stations (HRS) for customers across Europe, North America and Asia.

To support our growing international operations, we are looking for a curious, adaptable, and solution-oriented Software Engineer to join our Technical Department within Operations at our headquarters in Lind, Herning. In this role, you will contribute to the reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of our hydrogen refueling solutions, helping customers around the world transition to sustainable transportation.

About the job

As our Software Engineer you will connect our global field operations with our in-house software and innovation teams. You will be responsible for ensuring our customers’ hydrogen fueling stations perform safely, reliably, and efficiently across the globe. You will join an agile and collaborative Technical Department comprising of seven skilled colleagues. The team supports service technicians, project managers, and international customers.

Our software architecture is fully developed in-house. You will work closely with Application Engineering and the R&D Software Team to troubleshoot operational issues, implement software adjustments, and optimize live systems.

Key responsibilities and tasks

Operational support & advanced troubleshooting

• Provide software expertise to field service technicians, project teams, and global customers.

• Analyze machine telemetry, logs, and system data to identify operational issues.

• Conduct Root Cause Analyses (RCA) of software- and control-related incidents and coordinate corrective actions.

• Prioritize, manage, and escalate complex technical software challenges to relevant engineering teams.

Software adjustments & minor feature improvements

• Define, test, and deploy operational software adjustments, bug fixes, and site-specific parameter configurations.

• Implement urgent software updates while maintaining code integrity and alignment with the R&D Software Team.

• Translate field observations into clear specifications, user stories, and feature requests.

Remote commissioning support & knowledge sharing

• Support remote commissioning, factory testing, and system energization of new stations from our test facilities in Lind.

• Connect the Technical Department with Application Engineering and the R&D Software Team to support effective knowledge sharing and problem-solving.

About you

You may be a recent graduate ready to begin a career in green technology or an experienced engineer seeking meaningful industrial impact. Because our software is developed in-house, curiosity, structured problem-solving, and a willingness to learn are more important than experience with specific third-party tools.

Educational Background: You have a degree in Software Engineering, Automation & Control, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Relevant practical experience or an equivalent technical background is also welcome.

Interest in in-house software architecture: You are motivated to understand how software interacts with complex physical equipment including valves, compressors, cooling systems, and high-pressure gas controls.

PLC and automation experience: Experience with PLC programming in Structured Text under IEC 61131-3 is beneficial. Familiarity with Beckhoff TwinCAT 3 is an advantage but not a requirement.

Analytical approach: You are comfortable analyzing data and diagnostic logs and use a structured approach to root-cause investigation.

International flexibility: you can occasionally adjust your working hours to collaborate with colleagues and partners in North American or Asian time zones.

Language and communication: You communicate confidently in written and spoken English, our corporate language.

What we offer

Structured onboarding and mentoring: Experienced software and service engineers who will guide you through our software architecture and station design. Certified Beckhoff TwinCAT training may also be provided where relevant, and you will receive ongoing support from the R&D Software team.

Meaningful impact: Your work will help improve the uptime of commercial hydrogen refueling stations and keep zero-emission fleets operating.

Modern facilities in Lind: You will work in modern facilities with advanced test bays, a high-quality lunch canteen, an active staff association, and health insurance.

Flexibility & work-life balance: Your primary workplace and team will be based in Lind, with flexible working arrangements available.

No regular travel: You will support international remotely, without the need for frequent business travel.

Collaborative culture: You will join an informal and open workplace where questions, knowledge sharing, and autonomy are encouraged.

Apply now

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Curious to learn more?

For technical or role-specific questions, please contact Kim Hehlert, Technical Department Manager at +45 26 31 31 33.

For questions about the recruitment process, please contact Elsebeth Haarup Rasmussen, Head of HR, at +45 22 77 76 13.

Location: Lind, 7400 Herning, Denmark

Cavendish Hydrogen A/S is an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of background.

Would you like to help ensure stable and innovative IT solutions across our European production sites?

As an IT Consultant, you’ll become part of our global IT Service & Support Team and play a key role as a liaison between users, the business, and IT. The position combines day-to-day IT support with technical consulting, implementing new solutions, and participating in projects across our European production sites.

About the position

You are a dedicated and technically skilled IT Consultant who can translate business needs into effective and well-functioning IT solutions. You will also play a key role in providing professional IT support and ensuring a high-quality user experience in both production and office environments.

Your primary focus will be our factories in Sweden (Helsingborg), Denmark, Germany, Poland, Spain, and Lithuania. Together with your colleagues, you’ll participate in a rotation program where you’ll serve as the local IT contact and technical specialist at our production sites.

You’ll have a broad network of contacts within the organization and work closely with users, from production staff to colleagues in the offices. That’s why we’re looking for someone who thrives on dialogue and collaboration, can work independently, and is able to build strong relationships across the organization.

The position is based in Gråsten and involves travel to our other European locations.

Primary tasks

You will serve as an IT technical advisor for the organization, and your primary responsibilities will include:

• Support, troubleshooting, and consulting regarding IT systems, hardware, software, and networks

• Implementation and rollout of new IT solutions, technologies, and workstations

• Supporting business-critical applications, production-related systems, and IT services

• Participating in IT projects, standardizing solutions, and documenting processes

• Collaborating with colleagues and vendors to translate business needs into stable and well-functioning IT solutions

Personal profile

We envision that you have experience in a role such as IT Support Specialist, IT Administrator, IT Consultant, or similar, where you have worked extensively with the operation, support, and implementation of IT solutions.

You have developed a broad technical understanding and thrive on translating business needs into stable, efficient, and user-friendly IT solutions.

We’d like you to have experience with:

• Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Windows clients, Windows Server, and Active Directory

• Networking, infrastructure, and general operations of IT environments

• IT support, troubleshooting, and user administration

• Documentation, standardization, and implementation of IT solutions

• Support for business-critical systems in production and operational environments where high availability and quality are essential

• Collaboration with users, vendors, and colleagues across the organization

We also expect you to:

• Have a relevant education, such as a degree in computer technology, IT support, or equivalent

• Communicate fluently in Danish and English, both verbally and in writing. Knowledge of German is a plus

• Be willing to travel to our European locations for an average of approximately 50% of your working hours

• Be willing to participate in a formalized 24/7 on-call schedule

• Thrive on working closely with the business and building strong relationships with users

• Work independently, take responsibility, and see your tasks through to completion

We offer

• An exciting and varied position with a high degree of independence and responsibility

• The opportunity to work across a broad range of IT support and modern cloud technologies

• A strong professional environment focused on development, collaboration, and knowledge sharing

• An attractive compensation package including a pension and health insurance, as well as a cafeteria plan and employee activities

• The job involves travel to the aforementioned locations in Europe

Process

Please upload your application and resume at https://bhj.com/career/vacant-jobs/ as soon as possible, as we review applications on an ongoing basis.

Please direct any questions about the position to Allan Kjærgaard, IT Services & Support Manager, alkj@bhj.dk, tel. 7435 1218.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Medical Writer, Regulatory, Quality & Clinical Reporting, Søborg, Denmark
jobs.description:
This role is an exciting opportunity to blend scientific expertise with impactful communication, helping shape innovative healthcare solutions at a globally leading company like Novo Nordisk!

Your new the role

This is a permanent position in Medical Writing. In this role, your main responsibility will be to drive the preparation of complex clinical documents and act as a project manager. More specifically, you are expected to lead tasks such as:

• Plan, develop, and oversee high-quality regulatory and clinical documents in line with business needs and timelines.

• Prepare key documents such as study protocols, informed consent forms, investigator’s brochures, clinical summaries, and paediatric plans.

• Develop briefing packages and responses to health authority questions.

• Represent Clinical Reporting in cross-functional project teams, providing guidance on document planning, requirements, and optimal data presentation.

• Collaborate across Medical & Science, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, and Pharmacovigilance to ensure accurate, complete, and scientifically sound reporting.

We are globally oriented and you will work in close collaboration with colleagues in cross-functional teams in both Denmark and abroad. The position is office-based in Søborg, Denmark.

Your new department

You will join us in Clinical Reporting, the medical writing function at Novo, currently comprising around 200+ medical writers worldwide. We are part of Novo Development and anchored together with Regulatory and Quality functional areas. Development is responsible for managing clinical drug development and submissions to health authorities worldwide, from the early development phases to market authorisation. Our supportive culture drives business transformation, and we value continuous learning, being bold, and striving for simplicity.

Clinical Reporting covers all clinical drug development projects across therapy areas. Our main focus is to use our scientific expertise to drive clear and impactful communication on the conduct and outcome of clinical trials, and our main task is to communicate clinical data in a clear and concise manner.

Your skills and qualifications

To succeed in this role, we expect you to have:

• A Master’s degree within natural sciences (MSc., MSc. Pharm. or equivalent), preferably supplemented with a PhD and/or relevant experience in the pharmaceutical industry.

• A track record of driving complex tasks from start to end, navigating a multidisciplinary stakeholders’ landscape.

• A high level of expertise in communicating scientific information, with the ability to tailor such information to meet diverse objectives.

• The ability to improve processes and to promote the sharing of better practices.

• A good understanding of clinical development, regulatory processes and requirements, and clinical documents.

• Full proficiency in spoken and written English.

On a personal level, you are a clear communicator who adapts easily to a changing environment with tight deadlines. You are strategic, proactive and have excellent planning and coordination skills with the competency to drive and engage teams. You are a collaborative team player, that effectively manage various stakeholders and can reach consensus. You are detail-oriented and structured, while being pragmatic and not afraid of challenging the status quo. Furthermore, you have a positive can-do attitude and a good sense of humour.

Working at Novo NordiskEvery day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with an unconventional spirit, a rare determination, and a constant curiosity. For over 100 years, this unordinary mindset has seen us build a company unlike any other. One where a collective passion for our purpose, mutual respect, and a willingness to go beyond what we know delivers extraordinary results.

What We Offer

At Novo Nordisk, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary:  For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000.00 to 956,900.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Deadline

15th Nov 2026.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

You do not need to attach a cover letter; please include a few sentences about your motivation in your CV. Kindly refrain from adding a photo to your CV to ensure a fair recruitment process.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

About Userlink

Userlink runs AI agents in production at several hundred Nordic webshops, including Bahne, XL-BYG, Coolshop and Bygma. The agents handle the customer dialogue before and after the purchase, and every conversation ends up as structured data on demand and purchase barriers. The team is based in Odense.

The product and the direction

Today we sell chat. Email is rolling out now, and phone and social follow. On top of that we are building the brain: a system that brings together every signal about a webshop and its customers, understands why people buy, and why they do not, and acts on it while the buyer is still on the page. The effect is measured against a control group, so the shop can see what it means for revenue.

That moves the sale from a customer service tool to a conversation about growth, and revenue per customer can become several times what it is today.

The role

Ownership of new business, partners and existing customers in one place. You run the process from first contact to signature, find out what works and write the sales process the rest of the company will follow.

The partner channel has to be built. Agencies and platform partners need to be found, judged realistically and sold alongside until they can do it on their own.

Growth in the existing customer base is part of it, especially as email, phone and the brain roll out, measured against clear monthly and quarterly targets.

Price, pitch, customer profile and process are yours. They change when they do not work, and the team is built as the numbers allow. Denmark is home turf, but we already have customers and partners in DACH and the Netherlands, and those markets grow from here.

Decisions are made on arguments, not titles. Ideas get challenged regardless of where they come from, and the best one wins.

Why founding

About Userlink

Userlink runs AI agents in production at several hundred Nordic webshops, including Bahne, XL-BYG, Coolshop and Bygma. The agents handle the customer dialogue before and after the purchase, and every conversation ends up as structured data on demand and purchase barriers. The team is based in Odense.

The brain

The agents are the arms. The next layer is a system that brings together every signal about a webshop and its customers: conversations on chat, email, phone and social, on-site behaviour, orders, returns and reviews.

The system identifies the moments where a sale is won or lost and intervenes while the session is still live. It scores answer coverage per product and closes the gaps, quantifies objections and unmet demand, and traces returns back to the expectation that broke.

Learning happens across all webshops, more than six million visits a month, where patterns become visible that no single shop has the traffic to see. Every intervention is measured against a control group. The patterns are shared, the data stays with each shop.

The hard problems are retrieval and evaluation of LLM output at scale, data isolation when patterns are shared across customers, latency in real-time flows, and attribution that holds up under scrutiny.

The stack

Java with Spring Boot, React and MongoDB, with language models and vector search on top. Moving the backend to C# and .NET is under consideration.

The role

Technical ownership of the platform: architecture, code quality, operations, security and prioritisation, combined with hands-on development every day. Standards for review, testing, monitoring and releases, and recruiting the next developers.

Do you want to take ownership of one of the most strategic and visible programmes in Danish digital health? As Project Director, you will lead a comprehensive, product-strategic initiative for our electronic patient record (EPR) product, which has the potential to become the foundation for international growth. Sounds exciting? Then seize the chance now!

Systematic Healthcare – a coherent healthcare system

Systematics’ healthcare solutions are used by more than 200,000 users in, among others, Denmark, Norway, Sweden, the Netherlands, the UK and New Zealand. Our EPR solution is the core system in a hospital and has been developed in close collaboration with our customers.

Experienced Project Director with ownership, impact and business understanding

As Project Director, you will have overall responsibility for one of Systematics’ most strategic initiatives: an extensive, long-term, product-strategic programme for our EPR product. The programme is closely linked to the EPR solution used in Western Denmark today and is characterised by high complexity, both internally and externally, with many stakeholders including our customers.

The role is not only about delivering on time, price, scope and quality - as our new Project Director, you help create the framework for the program and ensure that both our customers and Systematic realise the expected benefits.

You are the programme’s single point of accountability towards both the steering committee, our customers management and the management in Systematic.

The programme is run as a virtual organisation across tracks such as development, product management, customer projects, implementation and operations. You have no direct reports and therefore create results through influence, trust, clear direction and strong governance. You report to the Vice President for the area and work closely with our customers, Product Management and the leadership of the EPR area.

Your primary tasks will include:

• Owning the programme plan, budget and business case, and ensuring a coherent solution and the expected benefits over the programme’s lifetime.

• Establishing and driving the programme’s governance and acting as the programme’s primary representative towards customer and Systematic management, including preparing and presenting decision papers.

• Actively owning and protecting the scope: challenging new requirements, driving priorities and ensuring an effective change management process.

• Owning the roadmap, schedule, milestones, budget and resource plan, and ensuring proactive risk management with timely escalation to the steering committee.

• Ensuring delivery in accordance with the agreements and leading changes and negotiations together with our Sales and Legal teams and the Vice President.

• Managing a complex stakeholder landscape, internally and externally, including customers and their regional top management, political decision-makers, clinical leadership, partners and internal units, and ensuring that the product roadmap is aligned with the programme’s commitments.

• Building and leading the virtual programme organisation across tracks and departments by setting direction, removing obstacles and being an ambassador for culture and collaboration. At the same time, you support the organisational change that the programme entails

You will be based at our office in Aarhus and can expect customer meetings around Denmark. Your success is measured by whether the programme delivers within the agreed time, price, scope and quality, and whether the benefits of the business case are realised. An important success criterion is the trust of customers and management in the programme.

Your competencies and qualifications

We envision that you have 10–15 years of experience in programme and project management, several of them with large, complex IT programmes of similar complexity: multi-year, with several parallel tracks, many stakeholders and organisational interfaces. You hold a master’s degree, for example in engineering, IT or economics, and ideally a certification in programme management, such as PMI PgMP or Axelos MSP.

In addition, we expect that you:

• Have experience from the IT industry and with public customers, large public contracts and politically governed organisations. Experience from the healthcare sector is a significant advantage.

• Have been responsible for budget, business case and contractual commitments, including negotiating changes with customers.

• Have experience reporting to executive management and steering committees, leading in matrix or virtual organisations without formal line authority, and taking part in organisational change.

• Have a strong understanding of business and finance, as well as experience in contract and risk management.

• Speak Danish as your native language and are fluent in English.

As a person, you:

Take ownership: You act as the owner of the programme, not as an administrator of plans and reports, and you have the courage to say no and make difficult prioritisations.

Lead through influence: You create commitment and results without formal authority.

Have executive presence and political awareness: You are credible at executive level and communicate complex topics clearly and in a balanced way.

Are commercial and customer-minded: You balance customer value with Systematic’s interests and understand the importance of our customers’ work for patients and clinicians.

Are structured, proactive and resilient: You create overview, make decisions on an incomplete basis, and keep your energy and calm throughout a long, high-paced programme.

Are demanding and inclusive: You create an open and honest environment where people are heard and their work is recognised.

jobs.occupation: PhD fellowship on Street-level Bureaucracy of Regulatory Implementation for AI
jobs.description:
The Human Centered Computing Section at the Department of Computer Science, Faculty of Science at the University of Copenhagen invites applicants for a PhD fellowship on Street-level Bureaucracy of Regulatory Implementation for AI.

  The start date is expected to be 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.
  

  The position

  This doctoral position is part of REGULAIRE (Regulatory Learning for the Governance of Transformative Technologies) is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Network bringing together 15 doctoral candidates at ten European universities to study how regulation can learn and adapt in situations where technologies, risks, and expectations change quickly. Its projects examine how regulators sense emerging problems early, how balanced interventions encourage learning without overcorrection or underreaction, how such interventions alter institutional capacities, and how feedback can be institutionalised so that insights travel across organisations and jurisdictions.

   

  Project description

  The PhD student’s research is expected to conduct in-depth qualitative studies of how EU digital regulation (e.g., AIA, DSA) is technically and organisationally implemented in SMEs developing AI-related technologies. The goal is to map developers’ translation of regulatory guidance into product and service design and compares implementation strategies across sectors. This project offers a focused route into human-centred computing, sociotechnical research and the study of regulation in practice. You will join an international cohort, receive supervision across institutions and take part in three residential summer schools, methods workshops, monthly paper development seminars and joint work with regulators, standardisation bodies and international organisations. Every project includes a planned three-month intersectoral secondment.

  The PhD student to be recruited in this call is expected to define their PhD project within the scope of the overall project and collaborate with the larger project team.

   

  Description of the scientific environment

  The position will be within the Human Centered Computing section (HCC). The Human Centered Computing section is a highly interdisciplinary group that conducts research within the areas of Human-Computer Interaction, Computer Supported Cooperative Work, Ubiquitous and Pervasive Computing, Digital Fabrication and related fields. Our section aspires to be a top research environment that bridges technology, theory, and empirical studies. The Human Centered Computing research environment at the University of Copenhagen is internationally leading, as evidenced by it’s ranking as second in Europe according to CSRankings. Further information about research at the Department is available here: https://di.ku.dk/english/research/ .

  This position will be co-supervised by Irina Shklovski (email: ias@di.ku.dk) and Naja Holten Møller (email: naja@di.ku.dk) at the University of Copenhagen in the Department of Computer Science, Human-Centered Computing section. The PhD will be conducted in collaboration with Joris Van Hoboken, Professor of Information Law, with special emphasis on Law and Digital Infrastructure at the Institute for Information Law (IViR), Faculty of Law, University of Amsterdam

   

  Who are we looking for?

   	
• Applicants should hold a MSc degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Data Science, HCI, Critical Data Studies, STS, Law and Policy or a related field. 	
• Good written and oral English skills are a requirement. 	
• Previous scientific publications (if any) and relevant work experience is encouraged 	
• Applicants must be willing to engage in international mobility, including the planned secondment and network-wide activities   The ideal candidate would have an educational background or prior work experience in technology development, prior experience in qualitative research and fieldwork in organisations, and some understanding of European regulatory and policy concerns around AI systems.
  

  The PhD programme

  You can undertake the PhD programme as:

  A three year full-time study within the framework of the regular PhD programme (5+3 scheme), if you already have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish Master’s degree.

  Getting into a position on the regular PhD programme 

  Qualifications needed for the regular programme
 To be eligible for the regular PhD programme, you must have completed a degree programme equivalent to a Danish Master’s degree (180 ECTS/3 FTE BSc + 120 ECTS/2 FTE MSc) related to the subject area of the position, i.e. HCI or CS. For information of eligibility of completed programmes, see General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database.

  Additional qualifications for the MSCA PhD 

  REGULAIRE is funded by the European Commission’s Marie Skłodowska-Curie programme and to be eligible for this funding you must meet the following criteria:

   	
• You must not have resided or carried out your main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Denmark for more than 12 months in the 3 years immediately prior to your recruitment; 	
• You must work on the project full-time.   Please ensure that this information is clear on your CV. Researchers can be of any nationality.

   

  Terms of employment in the regular programme 
 Employment as a PhD fellow is full time, on site in Copenhagen, and for maximum 3 years.

  Employment is conditional upon your successful enrolment as a PhD student at the PhD School at the Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen. This requires submission and acceptance of an application for the specific position formulated by the applicant.

  Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. The position is covered by the Protocol on Job Structure.

   

  Responsibilities and tasks in the PhD programme

   	
• Carry out a research project with increasing autonomy from your supervisors 	
• Collaborate with researchers both within the research group, and with external project partners 	
• Author scientific papers aimed at high-impact venues 	
• Participate in the research and training activities with the REGULAIRE network 	
• Disseminate research nationally and internationally 	
• Attend PhD courses on general skills development such as academic writing, as well as relevant specialised courses such as REGULAIRE summer and winter schools 	
• Conduct a change of scientific environment in the form of a secondment with a relevant standards organisation and an extended visit with one of the REGULAIRE academic partners 	
• Write and defend a PhD thesis on the basis of your project    

  We are looking for the following qualifications:

   	
• Professional qualifications relevant to the PhD position 	
• Relevant educational background 	
• Relevant publications 	
• Relevant work experience 	
• Other relevant professional activities 	
• Good written and oral English language skills    

  Application and Assessment Procedure

  Your application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

  Please include: 

   	
• Cover Letter detailing your motivation and background for applying for this PhD position; 	
• Research Statement detailing your desired research focus and goals for the PhD studies within the scope of the specified position. The research statement should demonstrate your independent thinking by outlining a concrete research direction within technology governance you wish to explore, including: specific research questions you aim to address, preliminary ideas on methodological approaches you would employ, connections to existing literature, and the potential impact and applications; 	
• Curriculum vitae including information about your education, experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position; 	
• Original diplomas for Bachelor’s and Master’s degrees and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorized English translation if issued in another language than English or Danish. If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted; 	
• Publication list (if available); 	
• Names and contact details of three references.    

  Application deadline: 

  The deadline for applications is November 22, 23:59 GMT +1. 

  We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

  The further process 
 After the deadline, a number of applicants will be selected for academic assessment by unbiased expert assessors. You will be notified about whether your application will be selected for assessment.

  The assessors will assess the qualifications and experience of the shortlisted applicants with respect to the above-mentioned research area, skills and other requirements. The assessors will conclude whether each applicant is qualified. The assessed applicants will have the opportunity to comment on their assessments. You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  Interviews with selected candidates are expected to be held in December

   

  Questions

  For specific information about the PhD fellowship, please contact ias@di.ku.dk  

  General information about PhD study at the Faculty of SCIENCE is available at the PhD School’s website: https://www.science.ku.dk/phd/.

  The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the surrounding community and invites all regardless of personal background to apply for the position.

jobs.description:
**JOIN PAYCHEX EUROPE

**At Paychex Europe, we simplify payroll, HR and workforce management for businesses across Europe. We believe great results come from people who take ownership, share knowledge, challenge the status quo and treat colleagues and customers with honesty and respect. These behaviors shape our culture and reflect the values we live by: Integrity, Respect, Partnership, Curiosity, Accountability and Service.

When you join our team, you can make a mark by helping us deliver solutions that make work easier for businesses and their employees.

**Lead Integration Developer (.NET / APIs / Cloud) for Emply

**We're modernising the platform behind our rapidly growing HCM product, Emply People. As our Lead Integration Developer, you'll define the technical direction for APIs and integrations while helping evolve the platform towards a cloud-native architecture.

As a senior team member, you will be involved in hands-on coding, design, development, customization, configuration, testing, and deployment of enterprise software solutions. Additionally, you will mentor and coach colleagues while making key technical decisions, combining hands-on development with technical leadership.

Emply People is a flexible HR solution for small and medium-sized businesses, supporting the full employee journey, from recruitment and onboarding to performance, time and absence management, and offboarding.

We're transitioning to modern technologies including microservices, containerisation and serverless architectures. You'll play a key role in this transformation from an integration perspective, helping build a more scalable, efficient and agile platform.

We're looking for a Lead Developer with strong hands-on experience building enterprise-grade integrations using the .NET stack.

**What You Will Do

**Besides your daily role in Emply, you'll be part of a team of seven Lead Developers across Paychex. You'll work closely with our Architect, Product Owner/Specialist, Scrum Master, and development teams in Poland and Ukraine to design, develop, and support our browser-based product within an agile Scrum framework.

**As Lead Integration Developer, You'll Be Responsible For

**

• Defining integration architecture in collaboration with the Architect.

• Owning integration patterns and standards.

• Designing scalable APIs and integration services.

• Improving technical implementations, simplifying the codebase, and promoting coding best practices.

• Improving reliability, performance, and observability.

• Guiding the migration towards cloud-native services.

• Mentoring developers and raising engineering standards.

• 10+ years of proven experience designing and developing enterprise applications.

• Experience modernising legacy codebases and working with non-functional requirements such as security, performance, and scalability.

• Strong ownership of architecture and the ability to drive critical technical decisions.

• Hands-on experience with C#/.NET, MS SQL, Hangfire, REST, and GraphQL.

• Experience with API/interface modelling using OpenAPI.

• Strong understanding of integration, including enterprise integration patterns, synchronous vs. asynchronous integration, and related trade-offs.

• Experience with Domain-Driven Design (DDD).

• Experience with Git and development tools such as Azure DevOps and Jira.

• A proactive approach, with the ability to work independently and take ownership.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts in clear business terms and act as a technical sparring partner and mentor to other developers.

We work closely across teams and encourage a social culture, believing that working together socially makes tackling challenges more enjoyable. You will work in our Østerbro office, in a team that cares about its members and enjoys a good laugh. In short, you’ll experience plenty of learning and exciting challenges in a great work environment.

Emply is part of Paychex Europe, a leading provider of HCM solutions. Paychex Europe is growing rapidly and expanding into the European market, constantly seeking passionate talent to join them on this exciting journey. Find out more at www.emply.com.

For questions about the role, please do not hesitate to contact Jacob Borella jborella@paychex.eu. Applications are reviewed continuously, and we look forward to meeting candidates who are excited about this opportunity.

jobs.occupation: System Architect (senior specialist) - Drive the architecture of next-generation medical device plat
jobs.description:
System Architect (senior specialist) – Drive the architecture of next-generation medical device platforms

This is not a software architecture role.

At Coloplast, we develop and manufacture physical medical devices used by millions of people worldwide. As a Senior System Architect, you will help define the architectural foundations of future product families and platforms, enabling innovation, scalability, and efficient product development across generations of products.

You will shape how platforms are structured to support reuse, new technology, portfolio growth, manufacturability, and long-term business value together with other R&D disciplines.

Working at the intersection of product development, manufacturing, quality, and systems engineering, you will balance user needs, product performance, regulatory requirements, risk, and platform strategy to create robust and scalable architectural solutions. Your work will ensure that future products are built on well-defined architectural foundations that enable both innovation and efficient execution.

Join a team shaping the future of R&D

You will become part of our Requirements Engineering Team within the Centre of Excellence in R&D.

The team consists of highly skilled specialists within Requirements Engineering and Systems Architecture, working with our processes and platforms.

We support development projects across the organization and continuously strengthen how systems development is conducted in a regulated medical device environment.

Design architecture that enable innovation

As our new Senior System Architect, you will be responsible for defining and maintaining system architectures related to the products and product families for one of our Chronic Care business areas, serving as the architectural lead.

Working closely with product teams and stakeholders across R&D, you will transform business needs, user needs, stakeholder requirements, and technical opportunities into architecture decisions that balance innovation, manufacturability, regulatory compliance, risk, cost, and long-term scalability.

Specifically, you will:

• 
Define and drive the platform strategy for a dedicated business area, enabling scalable product families, reusable platform assets, and accelerated delivery of future products.

• 
Drive architectural decomposition into system capabilities, subsystems, interfaces, and architectural building blocks.

• 
Establish and maintain architecture documentation and system structures.

• 
Define system boundaries, interfaces, and allocation of functionality across the system.

• 
Identify opportunities for platform reuse, standardization, modularization, and scalability.

• 
Facilitate architectural trade-offs across business, technical, manufacturing, quality, regulatory, and user perspectives.

• 
Provide architectural guidance that ensures alignment between product architecture, platform strategy, manufacturing, quality, and development activities.

• 
Support the understanding of the systems architecture discipline and the synergies to other development disciplines through close collaboration with key stakeholders across R&D and beyond

Strong architecture experience within complex product development

You combine strong systems thinking with the ability to navigate complexity and create practical solutions.

You enjoy collaborating across disciplines and are comfortable influencing decisions without having formal management responsibility. You are motivated by solving real development challenges and helping teams make sound architecture decisions. You take initiative and focus on opportunities and solutions rather than constraints.

What we expect from you:

• 5+ years of experience working with Systems Architecture, Systems Engineering, or development of complex multidisciplinary products.

• Experience defining system architecture and driving technical decisions in product development programs.

• Strong understanding of systems thinking and Systems Engineering principles.

• Experience working across multiple engineering disciplines.

• You thrive both when driving tasks independently and when working closely with colleagues to achieve shared goals

• Proven ability to influence stakeholders and create alignment across functions.

• Experience from regulated industries such as medical devices, life science, aerospace, defence, industrial automation, robotics, or similar.

• Understanding of requirements engineering, risk management, verification, and validation.

• Experience with modular architectures, platform development, and reusable solutions.

• Strong communication skills and ability to explain complex topics to a broad stakeholder audience.

• Experience defining system boundaries, interfaces, and reusable architectural building blocks that support platform-based product development.

• Motivated by both shaping long-term architectural direction and contributing to successful day-to-day product delivery.

You might also bring

• Experience from medical device development.

• Knowledge of ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 62304, IEC 62366, or similar standards.

• Experience with technology roadmaps and long-term architecture planning.

• Experience working with external development partners.

• Experience with architecture modelling approaches and tools.

Please note: Seniority level will be determined based on your experience (specialist or senior specialist)

Why join us?

This is a unique opportunity to influence some of Coloplast's most important development programs while helping establish platform-based development as a key capability across R&D.

You will work with highly skilled colleagues, contribute directly to products that improve people's lives, and play a vital role in enabling future innovation through strong system architecture.

Interested?

If you would like to know more about this position, please contact Head of Requirement Engineering, Centre of Excellence, R&D, Stine Renberg at +45 49113320. We continuously review applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The position will remain open until a suitable candidate is found.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Visit us on Coloplast.com..

Watch the film. Follow us on LinkedIn.

Are you motivated by ownership, technical excellence, and continuous development? If so, Netcompany is looking for a Senior Network Engineer to help drive and evolve our data center and enterprise network infrastructure.

Responsibilities and technologies

Netcompany Operations is a well-established operations organization responsible for everything from business- and mission-critical application operations to infrastructure management across two modern data centers.
