jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral position in computational modeling of visual perception
jobs.description:
The Department of Psychology, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a fully funded postdoctoral position in computational modeling of visual perception. The position is available for up to 36 months and is part of a project led by Dr. Gregory Scott Francis that is supported by the SDU Department of Psychology. The starting date is March 15, 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Research environment

The postdoc will be affiliated with the Research Unit of Health and Cognitive Psychology. The position is at the SDU Esbjerg campus but will also involve interaction with staff at the SDU Odense campus. 

Project description

A basic process of the visual system is to monitor the location and characteristics of objects in a scene, and the multiple object tracking (MOT) paradigm has identified many fundamental aspects of this process. With a rich literature of empirical results, this paradigm is ready for theoretical development, which this project intends to pursue using an integrate-and-fire neural network model known as LAMINART. A key aspect of the model is the ability to select/segment visual objects, which may explain how people can (seemingly) effortlessly track multiple objects in a dynamic visual scene. 

The successful candidate will be required to design, program and analyze an integrate-and-fire neural network model of visual perception. Good programming (Python) skills are required along with a good understanding of empirical methods and ways to connect empirical findings with model behavior. The position also involves teaching duties.

The project involves collaboration with Prof. Søren Krogh Andersen, also at SDU.

Qualifications

Ideally, applicants for the position should satisfy the following requirements:

• 
PhD level in psychology, cognitive (neuro)science, vision science, or a related field

• 
Research experience as evidenced by conference contributions and peer-reviewed journal articles in a field related to the offered position

• 
Expertise in visual attention and perception

• 
Strong analytical skills, including the ability to design, implement, and analyze complex experiments

• 
Be willing and able to teach for the Department of Psychology

• 
Prior experience with neural network modeling is a plus

• 
Prior experience with cognitive modelling is a plus

• 
Good command of statistics

• 
Good command of Python (or similar programming languages and a willingness to learn)

• 
Very good command of the English language in spoken and written form

• 
Some knowledge of the Danish language is a plus

Candidates who are about to obtain these qualifications are also encouraged to apply. 

Contact information

For further information about the position, please contact Dr. Greg Francis, SDU (email: gfrancis@health.sdu.dk; phone: +45 65 50 16 98), or Professor Søren Krogh Andersen (email: skandersen@health.sdu.dk; phone: +45 65 50 49 57)

Application deadline

The application deadline is November 08, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. CET.

Salary and terms of employment

The base salary for a postdoctoral researcher is DKK 36,877.42, with an additional job structure supplement of DKK 5,230.75. This brings the total monthly salary to DKK 42,108.16.

The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application

Applications must be in English and submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". 

Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

• 
A letter of motivation (max. 1 page)

• 
A detailed CV

• 
Master and PhD degree certificates, if available

• 
A complete and numbered list of publications 

• 
Three scientific publications (or preprints) considered to be most important for the advertised position (please note that one file per publication must be submitted)

• 
Contact details of at least two university supervisors or employers who can provide references

If you experience technical problems, you must contact hcm-support@sdu.dk.

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application. 

Incomplete applications and applications received after the application deadline will not be considered. 

Shortlisting of applications may be used in the initial selection process.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

SYBO is part of the Miniclip family and known for the widely popular game, Subway Surfers - the most downloaded mobile game in the world, with over four and a half billion downloads. Located in the heart of Copenhagen, we aim to create playful moments that inspire our fans to care.

• Design, develop and validate compelling application proof points that demonstrate customer value and differentiate AAK’s solutions.

• Lead lower-complexity product development projects while supporting Scientists on more complex, medium- and long-term innovation programmes.

• Translate new products and technologies into customer demonstrations, application evidence, technical documentation and materials that support successful commercialisation.

• Support regional teams with complex application and processing challenges through troubleshooting, technical guidance, customer workshops, factory trials and evaluations.

• Strengthen the Confectionery Centre of Excellence by developing application methods, evaluation protocols, best practices, technical tools and knowledge resources.

• Deliver AAK Academy training and technical learning programmes while supporting the development of the CCF Customer Innovation Network and wider technical capabilities.

• Analyse customer innovation projects and market developments to identify recurring needs, application gaps, future proof points and opportunities for new product development.

• Represent AAK within the wider confectionery ecosystem through relationships with suppliers, equipment manufacturers and industry experts, while supporting technology scouting and competitive benchmarking.

• Contribute to intellectual property activities, including technical evidence, application validation and competitive differentiation where relevant.

**About You

**

• MSc or PhD in Food Science, Food Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline.

• 8–10+ years of relevant industry experience within chocolate, confectionery, specialty fats or related food applications.

• Recognised expertise in Chocolate & Confectionery Fats, including formulation, fat functionality, ingredient interactions and processing technologies across applications such as chocolate, compounds, fillings, spreads and caramel.

• Proven experience in application development, product development, scale-up, customer trials and commercialisation.

• Ability to translate customer needs, market trends and technical knowledge into differentiated application solutions and compelling customer value.

• Experience working across global, cross-functional organisations, connecting technical experts and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

• Strong troubleshooting, process optimisation and communication skills, with a passion for knowledge sharing, capability building and mentoring.

• Experience with innovation processes, technology scouting, competitive benchmarking or intellectual property activities is an advantage; fluent in English and willing to travel internationally.

**In return AAK offers

**

• Join a pioneering company in specialty oils and fats, driving innovation and sustainability.

• In AAK you can work across 25+ countries, gaining international exposure and collaborating with a diverse team.

• AAK invests in your development with training, mentorship, and clear career paths.

• You will contribute to a greener world with AAK's sustainability-focused approach.

• Join a diverse and inclusive workplace that values every individual's perspective and talents.

**Contact and information

**For further information about the position, please contact Emily Lumb, Talent Acquisition Specialist: emily.lumb@aak.com

**About AAK

**Everything AAK does is about Making Better Happen™. We specialise in plant-based oils that are the value-adding ingredients in many of the products people love to consume. We make these products better tasting, healthier, and more sustainable.

At the heart of AAK’s offer is Customer Co-Development, combining our desire to understand what better means for each customer with the flexibility of our production assets and deep knowledge across multiple industries, including Chocolate and Confectionery, Bakery, Dairy, Plant-based Foods, Special Nutrition, Foodservice and Personal Care.

Our 4,000 employees support close collaboration with customers through 25 regional sales offices, 15 dedicated Customer Innovation Centers, and more than 20 production facilities worldwide. Headquartered in Malmö, Sweden and listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, AAK has been Making Better Happen™ for more than 150 years.

**Help shape quality and protect lives through vaccines

**Are you an experienced QA Specialist who can navigate complexity, influence stakeholders, and create progress in a dynamic manufacturing environment?

At Bavarian Nordic in Kvistgaard, we develop and manufacture life-saving vaccines that protect people around the world.

We are looking for a QA Specialist to join our QA Drug Product team and help strengthen quality, compliance, and continuous improvement across our manufacturing operations.

**Your role

**As a QA Specialist, you will work closely with Production and other functions to provide clear quality direction, resolve complex issues, and ensure that critical activities progress in a compliant and timely manner.

You will manage a varied portfolio of operational QA activities, investigations, and improvement initiatives, often with competing priorities and deadlines. You must therefore be able to maintain an overview, make sound risk-based decisions, and drive activities through to completion.

This is an individual-contributor role without formal people-management responsibility. You will lead through expertise, credibility, and influence, building alignment while maintaining an independent QA position.

You will report to the Head of QA Drug Product and join a skilled and collaborative team committed to quality excellence, knowledge sharing, and patient safety.

**Your Responsibilities

**As a QA Specialist, you will:

• Provide clear QA direction and trusted advice to Production and cross-functional stakeholders

• Review and approve Deviations, CAPAs, Change Controls, batch documentation, SOPs, and other GMP-relevant records within your delegated authority

• Perform QA oversight of Drug Product manufacturing and support timely product disposition

• Lead the resolution of complex quality issues and investigations

• Apply quality risk management to identify pragmatic and compliant solutions

• Represent QA in cross-functional projects, forums, and improvement initiatives

• Identify quality and compliance risks and ensure timely escalation and follow-up

• Support inspection readiness and represent QA during inspections, audits, and other significant compliance activities

• Improve quality processes, standards, and ways of working

• Share knowledge and contribute to a strong and proactive quality culture

**What You Bring

**We expect you to have:

• A relevant degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Engineering, or a related discipline

• Typically, five or more years of relevant QA experience within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or vaccine manufacturing

• Strong knowledge of GMP, Process Validation, QMS, and applicable regulatory expectations

• Experience leading complex quality activities, investigations, or cross-functional projects

• A broad understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes and cross-functional dependencies

• The ability to manage several priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously

• Strong risk-based decision-making and problem-solving skills

• Professional proficiency in English and Danish is a requirement

**How You Work

**You establish credibility through your expertise, judgement, and consistent delivery. You communicate clearly and diplomatically, listen to different perspectives, and build commitment without relying on formal authority.

You remain calm and effective when priorities change, constructively challenge decisions when quality or compliance may be at risk, and move activities forward even when the situation is complex or information is incomplete.

**About The Team And Department

**You will join a competent and supportive QA Drug Product team. The team currently consists of six colleagues and will grow to seven with this hire. The group represents a healthy mix of experienced QA specialists, fostering collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous development.

You will also become part of our QA Operations department, comprising approximately 40 employees across sites in Kvistgaard, Denmark, and Munich, Germany. The department is characterized by close cross-site collaboration, a strong quality mindset, and a shared commitment to delivering safe and compliant products to patients.

**Why join Bavarian Nordic?

**At Bavarian Nordic, your work will contribute directly to the development and production of life-saving vaccines. We offer:

• Meaningful work with an impact on patients and global health

• A collaborative, inclusive, and international working environment

• A broad role with significant cross-functional interaction

• Opportunities for professional and personal development

• Competitive salary, pension, health insurance, bonus opportunity, and employee benefits

• Flexible working arrangements combining on-site and remote work, depending on the activities involved

• Access to our canteen, staff club, fitness benefits, EV charging stations, and convenient transportation options

**For us, it is all about improving and saving lives together

**We are a fully integrated vaccine company focused on the development, manufacturing, and commercialization of life-saving vaccines, and one of the largest pure-play vaccine companies in the world. You will be part of a global team of more than 1600 dedicated employees with diverse backgrounds and viewpoints, who are bound together by our commitment to protect lives every day.

**Are you ready to join us in our mission?

**If this sounds like the next step in your career, we would love to hear from you.

We look forward to receiving your application together with your CV. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

_Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

_Bavarian Nordic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

For more information, visit _www.bavarian-nordic.com

**Overview

**Corti is the frontier lab for clinical-grade AI, building world-leading models and infrastructure for the realities of healthcare.

Our technology powers healthcare’s most ambitious software, from EHR vendors and virtual care platforms to the health systems that care depends on. We work with builders ranging from fast-moving startups to global healthcare enterprises, helping them bring clinical AI into real-world care.

Healthcare is full of problems where AI has to do more than simply work. Clinicians are overwhelmed by documentation. Coding errors, backlogs and denials cost health systems billions. And the specialist expertise patients need is not always available when they need it.

The short version

A venture-backed Danish medical imaging company is hiring its first dedicated AI/ML scientist. The company has a CE-marked product already in clinical use and is now building the next generation of diagnostic tools on top of the imaging data that product generates.

This is not a role where you inherit a dataset and a backlog. The data largely does not exist yet. Part of this job is going out to hospitals, working alongside clinicians, and finding out whether the data they hold actually contains the answer to the question they are asking. The other part is turning that into methods and working prototypes.

If you want a clean pipeline and a defined problem, this is the wrong role. If you want to define the problem, it is close to ideal.

The company

Venture-backed, Danish, around 40 people, with offices in Copenhagen. The technology is PET-based functional imaging that produces quantitative measurements rather than pictures alone — the ability to put a number on physiological function, not just describe what an image looks like.

The first product is CE-marked and in clinical use, with a pivotal trial running and a regulatory submission planned in the United States. Quantification is the core of the company’s value: it is what competitors do not offer, and it is the thing this role is hired to extend.

The company is named at first conversation. We have not put it in writing here.

The mission

The imaging data is the future product line. Today the company measures blood flow in the heart. The question is what else the same data can answer – in cardiology, in neurology, and beyond – and what methods are needed to get there.

You are hired to answer that. You will be the company’s dedicated AI/ML voice, joining a software team of eight and reporting to the Head of Software. You will work across R&D, clinical development, quality and regulatory.

Concretely, the first twelve months look like this:

• Building working relationships with clinicians and technicians at partner hospitals, in Denmark and nearby

• Getting into clinics and understanding how the scans are actually acquired and read

• Identifying which data holds real signal — and being honest when it does not

• Running studies and projects alongside hospital doctors

• Building prototypes that show whether a method works

Success at six months is measured in relationships and prototypes, not in shipped features.

What you will actually do

• Invent, prototype and mature algorithms for extracting clinically meaningful information from PET data

• Translate clinical and scientific questions into testable algorithmic solutions

• Build the pipelines around the work — acquisition, quality control, processing, visualisation, presentation of findings

• Go to hospitals. Observe workflows. Ask clinicians what they need and validate that your assumptions survive contact with clinical reality

• Evaluate emerging methods and tools, and shape which directions the company invests in

• Support the AI/ML dimension of medical device compliance as methods mature toward product — CE-marking and FDA

Travel is roughly two to three days per month, primarily within Denmark and southern Sweden.

Who we are looking for

Essential

• Demonstrable AI/ML development experience — applied, and with something you can point to and say “I built that”

• A software engineering and algorithm background, hands-on with PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX or Keras, and disciplined about testing and version control

• Experience with data collection, selection, integration and quality control, and preparing datasets for training

• Comfort starting from a rough idea rather than a specification

• Someone who wants to be in the room with clinicians. This role does not work from a desk — you need to be willing to initiate conversations with doctors and technicians, ask uncomfortable questions, and keep asking

• Roughly three to eight years of relevant experience. A PhD, or a PhD plus postdoc, counts — provided the work was applied and you have built things

Strongly preferred

• Medical imaging: DICOM, and work on 3D or 4D volumetric data — segmentation, registration, classification or quantification. PET, MR or X-ray all count

• PET-specific knowledge — reconstruction, attenuation and scatter correction, tracer kinetics, quantification. Genuinely valuable, genuinely not required on day one. The company expects to teach this

• Medical device software or SaMD experience — IEC 62304, quality systems, verification and validation, CE-marking or FDA

• A background in healthcare, medtech, diagnostics or another regulated field

Education

Computer science, biomedical engineering, medical physics or similar is typical. Proven capability substitutes for credentials.

Relocation

Candidates relocating to Denmark will be considered.

What this is, honestly

The genuine appeal. This is the company’s first and only AI/ML hire. Nobody has done this before you, there is no established way of working to inherit, and the direction the company takes on AI is the direction you argue for. It is an unusual amount of ownership for someone at this level, and it is the main reason to take the role.

What you should weigh. You will be the only AI/ML person among eight developers. There is no in-house peer to review your methods and no senior imaging-AI person to learn from — the clinical and scientific expertise sits with the company’s hospital collaborators and advisors rather than inside the building. Some people find that liberating. Others find it isolating, and it is worth being honest with yourself about which you are before you apply.

The other thing to weigh is the data. It is early. Expect to spend real time on access, agreements, site visits and data quality before you spend it on model architecture.

We are searching for a skilled and experienced post doc with specific interest in investigating early myeloid disease, clonal haematopoiesis, metabolism and obesity.

Our research/The group

The focus of the Grønbæk group is Translational Haematology. The group is affiliated with Biotech Research and Innovation centre (BRIC), University of Copenhagen and Rigshospitalet (Central Copenhagen University Hospital).

Our overall aim is to understand the molecular mechanisms of haematological cancers and based on this; to design, develop and implement novel, scientifically based, clinical trials, with a strong focus on epigenetic therapies. This is done by bridging between clinical research at Rigshospitalet and the basic cancer biology research at BRIC, and in international collaborations with, among others, the Van Andel Research Institute, Michigan, USA and the Nordic MDS study group.

Our location at the Copenhagen Biocentre/BRIC provides optimal conditions for interaction with the basic scientists at BRIC. The group currently consists of 14 scientists, MD/scientists and students, one clinical research coordinator, 1 research nurse and 2 biomedical laboratory scientists.

The project: Deciphering the Mechanistic Links Between Obesity, Clonal Haematopoiesis and Myeloid Neoplasms.

The current position is part of a joint project ‘Deciphering the Mechanistic Links Between Obesity, Clonal Haematopoiesis and Myeloid Neoplasms’ together with Professor George Vassiliou, Cambridge Stem Cell Institute, University of Cambridge, United Kingdom funded by a ‘Molecular Mechanisms Linking Obesity and Cancer (MMLOC)’ grant from the Novo Nordisk foundation, which supports collaborative research projects with the purpose ‘t_o reverse-translate clinical observations into mechanistic studies that will increase our understanding of how obesity impacts carcinogenesis’.

Obesity is a global health issue linked to increased risk of cancer, including blood cancers such as myeloid neoplasms (MN). Many MN arise from clonal haematopoiesis (CH)—the abnormal expansion of blood stem cell clones carrying somatic mutations. Haematopoietic stem cells interact with bone marrow adipose tissue (BMAT), which increases with obesity, which may fuel CH growth and progression to MN. Epidemiological and genetic studies already suggest obesity accelerates CH, but the underlying mechanisms remain unclear.

This project integrates large-scale population data, clinical trials, and mechanistic mouse studies to investigate these links and explore preventive or therapeutic strategies.

Your job

The project focuses on translational analyses of live frozen human cells from patient bone marrow (BM)/(BMAT) and blood samples from completed and ongoing clinical trials. We are searching for a skilled post doc who is very interactive and enjoys collaborations with other scientists – including younger scientists and clinician scientists.

Your tasks will include:

• Process of live frozen patient material from clinical trials including isolation of defined cell populations, and quality control for downstream omics

• Perform in-house molecular techniques which may include Proteomics, PCR, ddPCR, and library/sample preparation for RNA-seq, ATAC-seq and DNA methylation analyses

• Coordinate genomic, transcriptomic, lipidomic, metabolomic analyses with our internal and external collaborating laboratories and take the lead on designing relevant sub-studies, integrating and interpreting the data

• Help establish the practical and regulatory framework for these collaborations, including material transfer and data-sharing agreements

• Participate in grant and manuscript writing

• Present at local and international meetings

• Introduce lab techniques to new lab members and students

• Collaborate with both scientists and clinicians

Start: February 1st, 2027

Duration: 2 years

Profile

We expect you to be a highly motivated and highly ambitious, independent scientist with the following qualifications: •

• A PhD in Life Sciences with a preferred focus on haematology

• A strong background in mechanisms of normal and malignant haematopoiesis and molecular haematology techniques

• Comprehensive lab skills in molecular and cellular biology techniques, including work with primary human cells and cryopreserved patient material

• Experience with genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, lipidomics, metabolomics and ability to analyse and interpret such data

• Experience with running projects across research groups

• Strong publication and presentation record in peer reviewed journals and international conferences

• Excellent written and spoken English skills

• Very collaborative

• Good social skills

Place of employment

The workplace is at the Bartholin Institute which is part of Rigshospitalet, University of Copenhagen. The Bartholin Institute is located at Copenhagen Biocentre/BRIC, close to the centre of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and a number of core facilities (animal unit, flow cytometry, in vivo imaging, NGS, etc.) shared between the research groups at BRIC (www.bric.ku.dk) and the neighbouring Finsen Laboratory. We have weekly journal clubs, data clubs, seminars with invited speakers and a young researchers club ASAP and our own PhD programme, MoMeD.

Terms of employment

The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of two years. The starting date is 01.02.2027 or after agreement.

Salary, pension and other conditions of employment are set in accordance with the Agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant organisation. Currently, the monthly salary starts at 39,900 DKK/approx. 5,300 EUR (August 2026 level). Depending on qualifications, a supplement may be negotiated. The employer will pay an additional 18,07 % to your pension fund.

Foreign and Danish applicants may be eligible for tax reductions, if they hold a PhD degree and have not lived in Denmark the last 10 years.

The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025

Questions

For further information regarding the position, please contact Professor Kirsten Grønbæk, kirsten groenbaek@regionh.dk; phone + 4535456086 / +4525211598.

Foreign applicants may find this link useful: www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility).

Application

The application must include the following documents/attachments – all in PDF format:

1. Motivated letter of application (max. one page).

2. CV incl. education, work/research experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position.

3. A certified/signed copy of a) PhD certificate and b) Master of Science certificate. If the PhD is not completed, a written statement from the supervisor will do.

4. List of publications.

Recommendation

Furthermore, the applicant should provide two letters of recommendation or two references. To be taken into consideration, the letters must be signed by the supporting person on paper with institutional letter head and in PDF-format.

Application deadline 15 November 2026, 23.59pm CET.

We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications 3 of 4 or letters of recommendation that do not live up to the above-mentioned requirements.

The further process

After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor. Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/

The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

Are you passionate about life science and want your legal expertise to support innovation from early development through clinical trials to commercial product supply? Do you have experience within drafting, reviewing, and negotiating contracts that directly support innovation and scientific advancement?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Senior Legal Counsel (R&D).

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease portfolio. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a passionate Senior Legal Counsel to join our growing team. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment, collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results.

• Act as a key legal partner to Product Supply and Quality, supporting agreements such as commercial supply and manufacturing-related contracts, and advising on legal matters arising in day-to-day supply chain operations.

Furthermore, you have:

• Proven expertise in drafting, reviewing, and negotiating a wide range of complex contracts in the pharma industry.

• Solid experience supporting Product Supply and Quality, including drafting and negotiating commercial supply and manufacturing agreements.

• Experience supporting Chemistry, Manufacturing and Controls (CMC), including agreements with CMOs/CDMOs for CMC development and manufacturing activities, is an advantage.

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

jobs.occupation: Senior Contract Management Specialist (Senior Contract Counsel)
jobs.description:
**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**The Senior Contract Management Specialist / Senior Contract Counsel (CM) is a key role in the Contract Management team, which is part of Legal & Compliance. The CM supports all SimCorp offerings, including on-premises, SaaS, Professional Services and BPaaS. The CM is responsible for drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and executing various contracts with clients, as well as providing legal advice and guidance on contract and commercial matters. The CM also ensures that the contracts are compliant with the law and the business objectives, and that SimCorp performs its obligations under the Contract Assurance & Performance framework.

The CM works closely with the Legal team, Customer Success Management, Service Delivery Management, Project Management Office, and other internal stakeholders to understand the business and technical requirements, and to align the contracts with the best practices and standards of SimCorp. The CM also collaborates with Client Services to monitor and optimize the commercial performance and quality of the contracts.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**The CM is involved in the entire contract lifecycle, from the pre-contractual phase and support to Customer Success Management, to the onboarding project, to the contract change management, to the obligation management and quality assurance, to the exit handling.

The CM also manages and maintains together with the team the contract repository and the contractual database and supports the further implementation of contract management processes and relevant tools within SimCorp, including the upcoming Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) Platform.

The CM will be part of a self-organizing and cross-functional team that delivers value to the clients and the business.

As a CM, some of the daily or weekly tasks that you can expect are:

• Drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and executing client contracts, and ensuring that they are aligned with the legal, commercial and technical requirements

• Business partnering through legal advice and guidance on contract and commercial matters, and resolving contract-related issues and disputes

• Supporting the Customer Success Management, the Service Delivery Managers, the Project Managers, and other internal stakeholders with contract and legal interpretations

• Monitoring and optimizing the commercial performance and quality of the contracts, and collaborating with the business on commercial management

• Supporting the obligation management and quality assurance process, and ensuring that SimCorp performs its obligations under the Contract Assurance & Performance framework

• Supporting the exit handling process, and assisting with drafting termination notices and handling contractual obligations related to the exit strategy

• Participating in weekly status meetings

• Learning and developing new skills and competencies related to contract management and legal matters

**What We Value

**

• A law degree or a relevant degree in contract management, contract administration, or business administration, with a focus on commercial law

• 5+ years of experience in contract management, contract administration, or as a legal counsel, preferably in the SaaS, Outsourcing or IT industry

• Knowledge of contract and commercial law, as well as the legal and regulatory aspects of SaaS and cloud services

• Knowledge of Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) is an advantage

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Co-Pilot/Claude, and in contract management software and tools

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken

• Experience working in a collaborative team that values teamwork, humor, and good communication

• The CM is expected to have solid communication and presentation skills, as well as solid analytical and problem-solving abilities. The CM should be able to work on their own initiative and as part of a team, and to handle multiple tasks and projects in a fast-paced and demanding environment. The CM should also have a high level of professionalism and integrity, and a customer-oriented and self-starter mindset

**Benefits

**Attractive salary is essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.

Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact MadhuraPangarkjar], Senior Talent Acquisition Partner at madhura.pangarkar@simcorp.com If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**WHO WE ARE?

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide bеst-іn-clаss solutions to our clients.

Job Description

We're looking for an experienced cyber and information security consultant in the GRC domain who has hands-on experience building automation and/or agentic tools into their work.

What you'll do

We're scaling our GRC services team, a team dedicated to making governance, risk, and compliance of cyber and information security more efficient, effective, and valuable to organisations. We do this by automating processes through software and agentic tools, and by defining tasks, inputs, and outputs more clearly than is currently the norm.

As our client list grows, we need someone who can deliver GRC consulting from day one and open up new paths to delivery by developing and implementing our own tools and automations.

This role is open to being shaped by your own passions and talents, whether that's software development, sales and marketing, or deep industry knowledge.

In this role, you'll definitely be:

• 
Helping companies implement and comply with laws, standards, and frameworks like NIS 2, ISO 27001, and the CIS Controls

• 
Driving projects independently and managing senior stakeholders

• 
Influencing decisions on cyber and information security at some of Denmark's leading companies and public institutions

Depending on your experience and interests, you may also be:

• 
Developing your own client networks

• 
Programming and deploying your own agentic software tools

• 
Performing technical cybersecurity tasks in client environments

• 
Building new services from the ground up, targeting industries or problems you understand uniquely well

What you'll bring

You may be a great fit for this role if you have delivered GRC consulting for at least three years, ideally across several clients at once. On top of that, you should have:

• 
Automated GRC tasks with software and LLMs, refining the output until it beats human work in at least some aspects

• 
Driven the delivery of software products in collaboration with developers

• 
Gotten up to speed on new regulatory requirements under tight deadlines

• 
Fought the least valuable and most dull parts of GRC work while defending the value of good GRC against sceptics and cynics

The ideal candidate must be fluent in English – Danish is a plus, but not required – and we value a relevant master's degree or equivalent hands-on experience.

To fit in at The Tech Collective, you should:

• 
Thrive among diverse colleagues, from highly technical security professionals to energetic commercial profiles whose common language is a mix of humour, sarcasm, and passion

• 
Know how to break down and structure complex assignments, and enjoy sharing your knowledge with your team

• 
Bring a startup mentality that helps drive the innovation and ingenuity of our GRC services

This role is based in Copenhagen. We combine remote work with meaningful in-person work, and you should expect to be physically present at our office or with clients most of the time.

What we offer

On top of a competitive salary and bonus package, we offer the chance to join a unique team of experts and enthusiasts in your field. Our expectations are matched by our willingness to invest in your development, whether through training, conferences, or the opportunity to pursue research in areas you're passionate about.

How to apply

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply ASAP, as the role will close once filled.

Please submit your CV and a short motivation. If you've built tools, automations, or agentic workflows you're proud of, make sure to include a link or short description as we'd love to see them.

For questions, reach out to:

• 
Niklas Rendboe — nire@thetechcollective.eu · +45 27 14 55 56

• 
Úlfur Sonjuson — ulso@thetechcollective.eu · +45 25 53 19 98

The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement Consulting Group. We're passionate about technology, and we have a genuine interest in people. We aim to make a positive difference in the consulting industry because we believe the ability to create change with impact and purpose is a prerequisite for success in a turbulent world. We're rapidly expanding our Cyber Tech Services team, and we're excited to meet people who want to build the future of GRC at the intersection of business and technology.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

Head of Global Visual Merchandising

GANNI Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark

2 weeks ago 168 applicants

**ARE YOU READY TO SHAPE HOW GANNI COMES TO LIFE ACROSS EVERY PHYSICAL CUSTOMER TOUCHPOINT? WE ARE LOOKING FOR A COMMERCIAL, CREATIVE, AND HANDS-ON LEADER TO DRIVE OUR GLOBAL VISUAL MERCHANDISING STRATEGY.

****Your Mission & Responsibilities Ahead Of You

**As Head of Global Visual Merchandising, you will play a key role in bringing the GANNI brand to life across our global retail network. Acting as the bridge between Creative and Commercial, you will translate seasonal creative direction into visual merchandising concepts that strengthen the customer experience, support commercial performance, and ensure a consistent brand representation across all physical customer touchpoints.

Working closely with Creative, Retail, Wholesale, Buying, Marketing, and Product teams, you will develop global visual merchandising standards while supporting markets in delivering best-in-class execution. This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution - project management, stakeholder collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**Responsibilities ahead of you:

**Global Visual Merchandising Strategy

• Develop and continuously evolve GANNI's global visual merchandising strategy across all physical customer touchpoints.

• Translate seasonal creative direction into commercially effective visual merchandising concepts and execution.

• Act as the bridge between Creative and Commercial to ensure visual merchandising aligns with both brand identity and commercial priorities.

• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure consistent execution across the business.

Brand Representation & Customer Experience

• Develop global VM guidelines, seasonal playbooks, execution decks, and visual standards.

• Ensure consistent brand representation across Retail stores, Wholesale, Department Stores, Concessions, Showrooms, Pop-ups, and Events.

• Lead the visual merchandising direction for seasonal launches, campaigns, collaborations, and key commercial moments.

• Ensure VM standards are executed consistently across all markets while allowing relevant local adaptations.

• Create engaging customer experiences that support both the brand and commercial objectives.

Commercial Performance

• Partner closely with Retail, Wholesale, Buying, Merchandising, and Marketing to maximise commercial performance through visual merchandising.

• Use retail KPIs and commercial insights to continuously improve customer experience and sales performance.

• Support product sell-through through effective product presentation, storytelling, customer flow, and merchandising principles.

• Monitor store feedback and customer behaviour to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Global VM Community & Capability

• Support and develop GANNI's global network of field Visual Merchandising resources and Retail VM Ambassadors.

• Develop training programmes, tools, and best practices that strengthen VM capabilities across markets.

• Coach regional VM resources and retail teams to ensure consistent execution.

• Foster collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning across the global VM community.

**Showrooms & Physical Brand Experience

**

• Lead the visual merchandising strategy across global showrooms during seasonal sell-in periods.

• Ensure collections are presented in a commercially effective, inspiring, and customer-focused way.

Cross-Functional Projects

• Lead global VM projects from concept through implementation.

• Support new store openings, refurbishments, showroom projects, retail concepts, and pop-up activations.

• Collaborate closely with Creative, Marketing, Retail, Wholesale, Buying, Merchandising, Product Development, and Retail Operations.

• Continuously identify opportunities to simplify VM processes and improve ways of working across markets.

**Must Have Requirements

**

• 5–8 years of experience within Visual Merchandising in fashion, lifestyle, or premium retail.

• Experience developing and implementing visual merchandising strategies across multiple markets and sales channels.

• Strong understanding of how visual merchandising influences customer behaviour, supports commercial performance, and creates a consistent customer experience.

• Experience creating global VM guidelines, seasonal toolkits, showroom concepts, and visual standards.

• Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work across Creative and Commercial functions.

• Excellent project management and organisational skills.

• Strong communication and presentation skills.

• Fluent in English.

• Willingness to travel internationally.

**THE GANNI WAY

**We're looking for someone who combines creativity with commercial understanding and enjoys working across functions to bring ideas to life.

You are a hands-on leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys turning creative concepts into clear, practical solutions. You build strong relationships, communicate with confidence, and naturally collaborate across teams and markets.

You have a curious mindset, continuously look for opportunities to improve, and understand how strong visual merchandising can strengthen both the customer experience and business performance.

We are looking for a true GANNI ambassador - someone who shares our values of Openness (ready to evolve, honest not perfect), Optimism (you never stand still, just dance!), Authenticity (you march at your own beat!), Accountability (no excuses, you make an impact) & Responsibility (make small changes, see big differences).

The GANNI culture is based on a learning and results-driven mentality, where everyone is united by a common purpose of (hack)the fashion system!

GANNI is a state of mind - more than a way of dressing and we love to change the usual practice in everything we do. We are confident and capable of anything! So prepare yourself to be comfortable with the uncomfortable and hacking the system together with our amazing VM team!

**WHAT ELSE?

**

• Based in Copenhagen.

• Global role with regular international travel.

• Opportunity to shape the future of GANNI's global visual merchandising strategy and execution across Retail, Wholesale, Showrooms, and other physical customer touchpoints.

• Lead and develop a global VM team while working closely with colleagues across Creative and Commercial functions.

**DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

**At GANNI, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds - regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, racial identity, religious belief, disability status, or personal expression.

We believe that diversity drives creativity and innovation, and we are dedicated to building a team that reflects the world around us.

To support unbiased hiring, we kindly ask you not to include your photo, age, or marital status in your CV - we’re only interested in why you’re a great fit for the role.

**BE BOLD AND JOIN OUR GANNI COMMUNITY!

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel motivated to join our team and become a part of the GANNI community.

We will be interviewing candidates continuously and kindly ask you to send your application and CV as soon as possible. Please use the “Apply for position” button.

**MORE GANNI GOODIES

**You will be working out of our unique GANNI house located in the beautiful City Center of Copenhagen on top of the Bremerholm flagship store. Besides our amazing and colorful new office facilities, we are also proud of our inhouse GANNI kitchen that offers healthy and sustainable food cooked by our passionate in-house chef.

Do you also feel energized by super smooth Operations and a beautiful CI/CD setup? Do you eat Kubernetes and Azure for breakfast? And do you thrive in a sometimes-unpredictable environment where you jump in and save the day? Then we believe we have something great to offer.

We are looking for an experienced Azure, Kubernetes, and CI/CD Engineer to help elevate our SaaS operations and internal deployment processes to the next level.

Key about your role

We aim to take Operations to the next level by onboarding more skilled human power (you) and using your expertise to refine and modernize our existing Azure setup. The goal is to make it more elegant, clean, and scalable.

As a central figure in the infrastructure everyone depends on, communication and collaboration will be a natural part of your work. You will provide ad hoc support to colleagues and customer representatives, contributing directly to the stability and growth of our platform.

We work with two layers of deployments:

• Platform deployments: Low frequency (around once per month), planned well in advance.

• Customer component deployments: Higher frequency (around once per week), shorter planning horizon.

Both typically take place outside normal office hours. For these, you will be compensated with time off from your regular schedule. Deployments usually last about 15 minutes, with occasional on-call backup needed for unforeseen issues (fortunately, rare).

Your work will revolve around three main areas as follows:

Key responsibilities:

• 
Environments: Refining and improving the setup of our internal and external environments in a beautiful Kubernetes architecture in Azure.

• 
CI/CD: Configuring, maintaining and continuously improving our entire CI/CD universe.

• 
Operations: Participate actively in operations tasks, maintenance windows, deployments, and incident debugging.

Together with the small operations team, ensure our platform runs smoothly 24/7.

There is a lot more behind the Platform than a simple list of tools can show. Instead of giving you a long inventory, we would rather have an informal conversation where we can explore the details together.

Key about your Team

Our team, named Obex, is a business unit of Keylane, employing around twenty-five awesome developers, business analysts and a few other professions. Our main product is our Obex Platform, a SaaS solution for financial advisory used by advisors in a variety of pension funds and banks.

We are proud that finances of an estimated two million Danes have been through our software. The Obex Platform is developed in close collaboration with our customers, resulting in a product that users truly appreciate.

In Obex we care for each other. Thriving is top priority. You will feel that atmosphere as soon as you enter.

Our organization is flat, the best argument wins, not the highest title. We do things because they make sense. If something stops making sense, we stop doing it, whether that’s a process, a line of code, or a piece of architecture. We aim for the best solutions, not for rigid conformity.

We believe in mutual elasticity: We go the extra mile to support you, each other, and our customers. And we expect the same spirit in return. Together, we share responsibility for keeping the Obex machine running smoothly.

There’s much more to tell about our way of working, our culture, and our social side (fun activities and parties included), but let’s save that for a chat, either online or over a great cup of coffee.

Questions?

If you have any further questions regarding this position, please reach out to the hiring manager Rasmus Amossen via mail to rasmus.amossen@keylane.com.

When you have any general questions about Keylane or want to have a quick chat before applying, just reach out to Talent Acquisition Specialist Thomas Thomsen via mail to thomas.thomsen@keylane.com.

Requirements

Experience?

• You are fluent in Kubernetes, have solid experience with Azure services, virtual network configuration, and Azure DevOps.

• You know your way around log and performance monitoring tools and have a passion for clean, well-architected systems.

• You are not content with things merely working, you want them to work beautifully.

• Our platform uses .NET on the backend, React with Typescript on the frontend, and Aspire for local development orchestration. Experience with these technologies is a plus.

• There is a lot more behind the Platform than a simple list of tools can show. Instead of giving you a long inventory, we would rather have an informal conversation where we can explore the details together.

Using AI

• You are interested in using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Codex as part of the software development lifecycle. For example, to explore solutions, understand unfamiliar code, generate or improve code and tests, refactoring, troubleshoot issues, document solutions and support code reviews;

• You understand that AI-generated code and suggestions must be critically evaluated, tested and reviewed. You take ownership of the quality, security, correctness and maintainability of the code you deliver;

Other

Please send your application with CV via our website. Applications are evaluated continuously

A criminal record and reference check are part of the application process. Each employee within Keylane must follow training on information security and irrespective to the role basic information security responsibilities apply.

Benefits

• A flat and informal organization with a professional and supportive working environment

• A profit share

Are you ready for a Keylane career? At Keylane, we are transforming the insurance and pensions industry with innovative SaaS solutions. At Keylane, your journey with us is about more than just a job – it's about growth, fulfilment, and a sense of belonging. Join us in shaping the future of the insurance and pension industry while enjoying an enriching and vibrant workplace.

Ready to embark on this special adventure? Visit our careers page to explore our open positions and be a part of something special.

Karo Healthcare, a dynamic and growing personal-care retail company, is all about making smart choices for everyday healthcare. With a wide-ranging portfolio across seven categories, including medical products, we own and sell over 80 brands in about 90 countries. Our portfolio includes such brands as E45, Pevaryl, Lamisil, Nutravita, Decubal, and many others. Our core belief in empowering people to make intelligent health decisions drives our growth strategy, blending organic expansion and M&A.

Join us at Karo Healthcare on our exciting journey. We're currently looking for a Key Account Manager, Pharmacy for our office in Copenhagen.

What’s in it for you?

This is a high-impact commercial role where you will take real ownership of key pharmacy partnerships, influence how our brands win in-store, and work closely with Sales, Marketing, E-commerce and external partners. You’ll join a fast-moving international business where ideas turn into action quickly and where there is plenty of room to shape the role, grow your commercial expertise and make a visible impact.

Benefits

• Opportunity to create, grow, and encourage

Karo Healthcare has a Diverse & Inclusive environment. We are looking for qualified candidates irrespective of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, religion, national origin, disability or age.

Our purpose is to offer smart choices for everyday healthcare and we are passionately working towards realising our vision of Karo becoming a pan-European leader in everyday healthcare. With this ambitious growth strategy, we are constantly scouting for new talents to join our existing dynamic and high-paced Karo team. Embracing diverse perspectives and backgrounds is a part of our identity, and an equal representation of women and men in management positions. At Claimlane, we're looking for a problem solving focused Product Designer. You'll spend most of your time talking directly to customers to understand how they work through their problems today, then shape and validate the right solution with the team and finally design the solution. This is a problem-solving role first, design second.

You will enjoy this role if you are curious, work fast, and appreciate the opportunity to have a huge impact on our product.

About Claimlane

Claimlane is a rapidly growing B2B SaaS scale-up. We fix complex claims and returns processes for top retailers and brands like Matas, Coolshop, Black Diamond, and Tonies.

We're looking for A-players who want to make a difference and grow with the business. We value a strong positive attitude, a high sense of ownership, and long-term thinking. Attitude beats talent.

We want to build a billion-dollar business, and part of that is building a team with billion-dollar potential.

The Role

You will spend the majority of your time solving problems, not producing designs & screens. That process starts with talking directly to customers and the team, mapping out how customers work through a problem today, and building a clear, written definition of how to build a better solution for them. Only once the problem is deeply understood do you shape a solution, and even then, you validate it with real customer feedback before treating it as done and ready to be designed.

You will work in close collaboration with product and engineering from day one, and you will rapidly take on more independence as you build context. Within your first month, you will be solving smaller problems on your own. Within three months, you will independently own problem definition and design for solutions end to end.

This is a junior-to-mid-level role built for fast growth. You do not need years of product design experience, but you do need to be an exceptional problem solver who is comfortable getting close to customers, curious about how things actually work, and eager to grow into a stronger product designer along the way.

Key Responsibilities

• Talk directly to customers and the team to deeply understand problems and map them out.

• Turn ambiguous problems into clear, written problem definitions before shaping a solution.

• Design and ship solutions for working closely with engineering & customer facing team.

• Run customer and user-testing conversations and turn findings into concrete product improvements or new solutions.

• Gather feedback on shipped work and use it to shape the next iteration.

• Take on progressively larger and more ambiguous problems as you build context and trust with product and engineering.

Requirements

• Exceptional problem solver who structures ambiguous situations into a clear definition before jumping to a solution.

• Comfortable talking directly to customers and mapping out their workflows to understand a problem from the ground up.

• Strong visual and UX sense, able to turn a well-understood problem into clean, modern, and readable designs.

• Clear communicator who can explain design decisions and trade-offs in handoffs to engineering, including edge cases.

• Quick learner who picks up new tools, product domains, and feedback fast.

• Balances speed and quality, knowing when good enough is the right call to keep the team moving.

• Low-ego, high-energy collaborator who works transparently and takes feedback well.

Bonus Points If You Have Experience With

• Running customer interviews or user research independently.

• Working directly with engineers on technical constraints and trade-offs.

• Working in B2B SaaS or scale-up environment.

• Figma and modern design tooling.

Location and Compensation

Our office is in Nørrebro, Copenhagen, and this is an in-office role. Our team enjoys coming in, and everyone has the flexibility to shape their workday around their lifestyle.

Our compensation package is competitive, and we offer an attractive warrants and stock program.

If you're a positive, ambitious person who wants to build real problem-solving muscle as a product designer, Claimlane will be the right vehicle for you, and we'd love to welcome you. Don't waste time, apply now! 🚀

Hiring Process

• Intro Call: A 15 to 30 minute conversation to see if we click.

• Culture Interview: A 1 to 2 hour deep dive into values, mindset, and team fit.

• Problem-Solving Case: A 1 to 3 hour session working through a real customer problem, from understanding it to proposing a solution. No polished mockups required. We're flexible if you prefer another format, so feel free to shine in your own way.

• Team Meetup: A 30 minute chance to say hi to the team.

• References: A final check before we make things official.

Apply on LinkedIn or send your resume to asl@claimlane.com. We review candidates on an ongoing basis. Sending a 60 second video introducing yourself will move you to the top of the stack, though it's not required.

**About The Job

**You’ll be joining a high-performing and rapidly expanding team of engineers at one of Denmark’s fastest-growing companies. Together, we’re building and scaling the internal platforms that power our growth—including CRM system, sales tools, and operational software used daily and enabling our commercial organization to operate efficiently at scale as we continue our European expansion.

This is an opportunity to be part of a company that has grown from startup to unicorn at record speed. As we continue to expand into new markets and serve an ever-growing customer base, you’ll work on challenges that come with operating products at scale. You’ll have significant ownership, the freedom to drive technical decisions, and a direct impact on the solutions used by businesses every day. As we grow, so will your opportunities to develop your skills, take on new responsibilities, and help shape the future of commerce across Europe.

What you'll do

• Design and deliver scalable, maintainable, and high-quality solutions that drive business impact

Who you are

Why Flatpay?

You’ll help build and scale our internal platform, creating tools that empower teams across Flatpay and shape the future of how we operate, and scale our products.

We offer an inclusive environment where engineers are trusted with ownership and encouraged to make an impact. Our engineering teams work together from our Copenhagen office. We believe that close collaboration, quick feedback loops, and solving problems side-by-side help us build better products, move faster, and create a stronger engineering culture. We also provide plenty of perks including free slush ice, an on-site gym, a fully equipped gamer room, and much more. If you are ready to be part of this exciting journey, we would love to hear from you today.

Established in 2022 in Copenhagen with a commitment to transparency, we've streamlined card payments to small and medium-sized businesses. Our innovative pricing model eliminates hidden costs and fees, offering a simple flat rate for all cards with no monthly subscription for our point-of-sale and payment solutions.

Operating in Denmark, Finland, Germany, Italy, France, the United Kingdom, and the Netherlands, we're more than just a service provider; we are your trusted business partner.

We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our clients' evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary?

About the job

Are you at the start of your career and ready to help shape Saxo's balance sheet analytics, risk frameworks, and treasury decision-making through data, modelling and quantitative analysis?

We are looking for a talented and motivated Quantitative Risk Analyst to join our Market & Treasury Risk team within Risk Strategy & Treasury. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of treasury, risk management, quantitative modelling, and strategic decision-making.

Our team plays a central role in shaping Saxo's earnings profile and balance sheet risks, including liquidity risk, interest rate risk, FX risk and capital risk. We develop and maintain the analytical frameworks, models and methodologies that support balance sheet optimisation, risk management and senior management decision-making across the organisation.

As part of the team, you will contribute to the development of quantitative models, risk metrics as well as analytical tools used to assess earnings, funding, liquidity and market risks. You will work closely with colleagues across Treasury, Finance, Risk, Trading and Technology, gaining broad exposure to the management of a modern international bank.

This role is particularly well suited to professionals in the earlier stages of their career looking to build deep expertise in treasury, risk management and quantitative analysis within an international banking environment.

Responsibilities

As our new Quantitative Risk Analyst, you will:

• 
Develop and enhance quantitative models, methodologies, and risk measures relating to liquidity risk, interest rate risk, FX risk, and capital management.

• 
Build analytical models, dashboards, and reporting solutions that provide insights into earnings, funding, liquidity, and risk exposures.

• 
Perform quantitative analysis of balance sheet developments, business initiatives, and market events to support risk and treasury decision-making.

• 
Contribute to the automation and improvement of risk analytics using modern analytical tools and programming languages.

• 
Assist in the development and validation of methodologies used for risk measurement, forecasting, and scenario analysis.

• 
Collaborate with stakeholders across Treasury, Finance, Risk, Trading, Secured Finance, and Technology to deliver scalable analytical solutions.

• 
Support the preparation of analysis and material for senior management, risk committees, and regulatory interactions.

• 
Support the ongoing development of analytical frameworks such as Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP), Value of Client Funds (VCF), stress-testing methodologies, and balance sheet optimisation tools.

Your profile

This role is ideally suited to candidates with around 4-5 years of relevant experience who are looking to further develop their quantitative, analytical, and banking expertise while taking on increasing responsibility and ownership. We are also open to exceptional candidates with fewer years of experience if they bring highly relevant expertise and a strong foundation within the areas covered by the role.

You have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy solving complex problems through data, modelling, and quantitative analysis. You are curious, detail-oriented, and motivated by understanding how financial and business decisions impact earnings, risk, and balance sheet performance.

You are comfortable working with data, challenging assumptions, and developing practical solutions while collaborating with both technical and business stakeholders.

In addition, we expect that you:

• 
Hold a relevant master's degree in finance, economics, mathematics, engineering, physics, computer science or a related quantitative discipline.

• 
Have experience with Python, SQL, R, AI/ML tools, or similar analytical and programming technologies

• 
Possess strong quantitative and analytical skills, with experience working with complex datasets and modelling frameworks.

• 
Enjoy developing models, analytical tools, and scalable solutions to support business decision-making.

• 
Have an interest in financial markets, banking, treasury or risk management.

• 
Communicate clearly and explain analytical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to have:

• 
Experience with liquidity risk, FTP, IRRBB, market risk, stress testing, or capital management.

• 
Knowledge of banking products, financial markets, or asset and liability management.

• 
Experience with data visualisation, automation, or large-scale data analysis.

• 
Familiarity with regulatory frameworks applicable to banks and financial institutions.

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!
