**About The Role

**We are looking for an experienced financial-crime leader to be our registered MLRO / Hvidvaskansvarlig (HVL

• 7, stk. 2) for Monta Pay ApS under our EMI license and to lead Financial Crime Prevention (FCP) across Monta, group-wide for the Danish/EEA EMI plus UK and US compliance as those markets scale. The role is registered with Finanstilsynet, so the appointment is subject to a fit & proper assessment as a change of key function holder.

Monta Pay ApS holds an Electronic Money Institution (EMI) license, granted by Finanstilsynet in April 2026. We are now migrating our financial services from Monta ApS to Monta Pay ApS, with go-live planned for Q2 2027. This is the moment the AML/FCP framework moves from build to live operation, and you will own it.

This is a high-profile, senior role. You sit at the centre of our financial-services compliance strategy as we scale, "directly exposed to the fire." You must balance obligations against resources with a risk-based approach, communicate complex issues clearly to senior leaders and the Board, and run your work-streams with strong, solution-oriented project management. In return, you have an outsized impact on how Monta builds and operates financial services compliance, and direct exposure to decision-making at a fast-growing scale-up.

You report day to day to Nick Skovsen, COO of Monta Pay ApS, with direct, independent access to the CEO and executive management of Monta Pay ApS and to its Board and Governance, Risk & Compliance Committee.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Registered MLRO / Hvidvaskansvarlig: Act as the statutory AML-responsible person for Monta Pay under the EMI license. Approve AML/CTF policies and high-risk customer relationships escalated by the first line (PEPs, and business involving high-risk third countries). Receive internal escalations, decide on and file SARs/STRs with the FIU, and be the primary AML contact for Finanstilsynet.

• Own the Financial Crime Prevention framework: Steward Monta's FCP model (our nine-pillar "FC9" framework) covering AML/CFT, sanctions, fraud, and anti-bribery & corruption. Propose the risk appetite and risk-based approach for Board approval and monitor against it, and keep the framework effective and proportionate to our activities, customer types (B2B & B2C), and transaction flows.

• Fraud, transaction monitoring & customer due diligence: Own the frameworks for fraud prevention, transaction monitoring, and KYC/KYB (CDD/EDD, PEP and sanctions screening) across onboarding and the lifecycle (EU and US). Set the rules, thresholds and procedures the Financial Operations team runs in the first line, and assure their quality and effectiveness.

• Sanctions & screening: Set the screening standards (lists, thresholds, re-screening frequency) and assure the quality of first-line alert handling.

• Policy suite, risk assessment & governance: Maintain the AML/CFT policy suite in the Centralised Policy Register (with version control and Board-approval tracking), and own the Business-Wide Risk Assessment (BWRA) and the AML risk assessment underpinning the framework.

• Regulatory reporting: Deliver AML and payments regulatory reporting (for example Section 99 Payment Act, KPSD, AML/CTF returns) and ensure CESOP readiness.

• Technology, controls & assurance: Work with Product and Engineering on case management, screening and monitoring tooling and AI/automation, oversee AML-relevant third parties, and run the internal-controls framework (monitoring, QA, remediation).

• Training, culture & Board liaison: Build AML/FCP training and a strong compliance culture, and advise Senior Management and the Board GRC Committee on financial-crime risk, regulatory change, and performance.

• Build and lead the team: Build out and lead the second-line FCP/AML team as volumes grow post go-live.

What You’ll Walk Into (first 6 to 12 months)

• The foundations are in place; the job is to make them operational for go-live.

• On AML: everything required to obtain the EMI license has been submitted and approved. The remaining gap is operational readiness, and that is the focus: embedding the framework in day-to-day operations and rolling it out with our customers and with colleagues across Monta.

• On FCP: This role brings centralised ownership and direction, consolidating what already exists, formalising it into clear Standard Operating Procedures, and training the relevant teams on them ahead of go-live.

• Concrete early priorities include standing up transaction monitoring and fraud detection, locking v1.0 of the policy suite (Sanctions, PEP, EDD, Outsourcing, and the Sanction-Screening and SAR/STR filing SOPs) into the Centralised Policy Register, building the regulatory-reporting data structure and CESOP readiness, finalising KYC/KYB (EU + US), and securing your Finanstilsynet fit & proper approval ahead of go-live. A structured focus-areas plan accompanies this role.

**Requirements

**

• Minimum 3 years (ideally 5+, given this is a registered key-function role) of relevant experience in the prevention of money laundering and terrorist financing, ideally in a licensed EMI, payment institution, bank, or regulated fintech. Comparable experience in public authorities, AML consulting, or other AML-regulated sectors (for example gaming/gambling) will also be considered.

• Strong, current understanding of Danish AML law (Hvidvaskloven) and the EU framework (AMLD/AMLR, EBA guidelines), plus sanctions regimes. Awareness of the incoming EU AML package (AMLR + AMLD6, applying July 2027) is a plus.

• Eligibility to pass a Finanstilsynet fit & proper assessment. Prior approval in a fit & proper / key-function role at an EU financial institution is a strong advantage.

• Hands-on experience with fraud prevention and transaction monitoring, and with the underlying tooling (KYC/KYB, screening, monitoring, case management). Data literacy and comfort with AI/automation are a plus.

• Experience across risk controls, compliance, the payments area, credit management, or lines-of-defence leadership. Fintech/scale-up experience is a plus.

• Strong communication skills, autonomy, and sound decision-making, with the ability to build from a blank page and then scale a function and team.

• Analytical and investigative skills to detect patterns and anomalies in financial transactions and to investigate suspicious activity.

• Danish speaking, or willing to learn (the role is regulator-facing).

• Relevant education (economics, mathematics, law, or financial-sector training) is a plus.

• No prior convictions or legal issues that would make the candidate unfit for the role, particularly offences related to financial crime, fraud, money laundering, or other criminal activities undermining trust and integrity.

_If this sounds like you, we look forward to receiving your application.

_Why Monta

• Impact, not easy mode — your work matters, and you’ll feel it every day.

• Ownership from day one — we don’t micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• The grind is real — priorities shift, and flexibility is sometimes needed to get things across the finish line. But so are the rewards: impact, growth, and a team that has your back.

• The people are extraordinary — talented, driven, and fun to work with. You’ll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure

**What We Offer

**

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life’s big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you’re at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

**Please send us your application in English.

**To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you’ll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don’t accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won’t agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Your role combines hands-on development with broader technical leadership. You will work closely with Application Architects to help define and communicate technical direction, translate architectural principles into practical solutions and promote consistency across our application landscape.

• 
Design, develop, and maintain robust applications using C# and .NET, while promoting consistent standards, code quality, maintainability and operational stability

• 
Contribute to improving system architecture by identifying areas for technical refinement, refactoring, or modernization

• 
Collaborating across the organization, represent Application Development by collaborating with Product Owners, Delivery Management, testers, Quality Management and other departments

• 
Set and communicate technical direction with Application Architects, translating architectural principles and business needs into practical solutions and Architecture Decision Records

• 
Connect technical expertise across teams and applications, enabling collaboration on dependencies, common challenges and reusable solutions

• 
Support operational excellence by helping diagnose and resolve production issues and continuously optimize existing systems

• 
Share knowledge and technical expertise supporting colleagues’ professional development and help strengthen development practices across the team. This role does not include formal line-management responsibilities

Technology Stack:

• 
Primary languages and frameworks  C#, .NET, SolidJS, JavaScript/TypeScript, Functional programming, Python

• 
Architecture, design patterns & integrations  Clean Architecture, SOLID, Event-driven Architecture, Message-driven Architecture, REST APIs

• 
Databases & storage Relational databases (SQL Server), NoSQL databases (MongoDB), GridFS, S3

• 
Infrastructure & Platform (on-prem)  Kubernetes (on-prem), Docker, Rancher, Prometheus/Grafana, ArgoCD, NginX

• 
Tooling and collaboration  Git, Visual Studio, VS Code, JetBrains Rider, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines

Collaborative Attitude: You will be working closely with our team of Application Architects, shaping architectural decisions for supporting maintainable, scalable and robust systems

• 
Technical Foundation: A degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field

• 
Proven Expertise: Minimum 5 years’ experience as full-stack developer in C# for the .NET platform. Experience providing technical guidance, facilitating technical decisions, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating development activities is a definite plus.

• 
Nice to have: Experience working with functional programming, Clean Architecture principles, Azure DevOps, Kubernetes and Scrum processes

• 
Energy Sector Knowledge: Familiarity with the power systems domain is a plus but not required

If you do not tick all the boxes, but think you could be a good match, don’t hesitate to apply for this position.

You will join a diverse organization of 23 nationalities, where inclusivity is celebrated, with more than 30% women on board (and a commitment to improving this balance). We are located in Copenhagen Towers office in Ørestad, with the flexibility to balance on-site and remote work 2 days a week.

Please apply online (in English) no later than 15/11-2026. Interviews will be held on a rolling basis up until the right candidate has been found.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.

Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking an energetic and passionate Medical Director to join our team. As a member of the Ascendis Pharma team, you will play a crucial role in driving the design, safety monitoring, and data analysis within the Endocrine and Rare Disease Medical Sciences area. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment, collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results.

You will join the Clinical Development team, being part of the Endocrine & Rare Disease Medical Sciences organization. You will report directly to the VP of Clinical Science who is based in the US. You will be based in Hellerup together with the Danish team.

Since you will join a team based in different time zones, you must be available for evening meetings. This position also may require occasional international travel.

Your key responsibilities will be

• Contribute to formulation and implementation of the Clinical Development Plan

• Leverage medical expertise and hands-on clinical experience to promote relevance and rigor of the development program

• For clinical trials: design, provide overall oversight, and support site and subject retention

• Serve as a Medical Monitor for clinical trials, ensure study integrity, and track accumulating safety and efficacy data

• Provide leadership to teams of medical monitors and study teams

• Ensure successful completion of trial-related documents (including clinical trial protocols, investigator brochures, medical monitoring plans, site training materials, clinical study reports, health authority responses, standard operating procedures, etc.) with cross-functional team members

• Ensure study integrity, and track accumulating safety and efficacy data

• Analyze, evaluate, interpret, and report clinical data

• Anticipate and solve complex drug development problems

• Contribute to regulatory strategy

• Contribute to drafting and reviewing of clinical documents, manuscripts, presentations, and regulatory submissions

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of relevant science, medical information, good clinical practices, and regulatory guidance

• Collaborate with—and serve as a clinical research resource for—cross-functional colleagues (e.g. in clinical operations, statistics, regulatory affairs, medical affairs, health economics outcomes research, commercial, finance) to optimize product development

• Contribute to (and may be asked to represent the clinical development department in) corporate strategic and organizational initiatives

• Cultivate relationships with investigative sites, clinical consultants, and key opinion leaders to represent the interests of the company

• Assist in portfolio management and commercial activities as needed

• Complete assigned tasks thoroughly, accurately, and on time

• Adhere to rigorous ethical standards

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold an M.D. degree and preferably also a Ph.D. degree. You have hands-on experience treating patients.

Furthermore, you have:

• At least 5-7 years of industry experience (other relevant experience e.g., post-graduate experience in the clinical and/or academic realms may also be considered on a case-by-case basis).

• Strong track record of scientific and clinical inquiry

• Possess excellent communication skills (written and oral)

• Demonstrate sound judgement in terms of handling complex, confidential, and regulated information

Key competencies:

You have a proven ability to learn quickly, even in fast‑paced environments.

You take ownership of your work, lead by example, and collaborate effectively with colleagues across the organization. You are trusted by others for your sound judgment and discretion, particularly when handling confidential, sensitive, or regulated information.

To succeed in the position, we expect you to be comfortable working with complex instructions, managing multiple priorities, and consistently maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

Travel: 20-30 days per year

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, 2900 Hellerup, Denmark

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

A note to recruiters:

We do not allow external search party solicitation. Presentation of candidates without written permission from the Ascendis Pharma HR team (specifically from: Talent Acquisition Partner or Human Resources Director) is not allowed. If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged.

Are you ready to use your advanced knowledge of media strategy and programmatic buying to drive commercial impact across our largest clients and grow your leadership skills at the same time?

We are looking for an experienced specialist to help lead our programmatic offering out of Aarhus. If you want to combine deep media expertise with client strategy and a commercial outlook, while honing your leadership skills, this could be your next step!

Driving client strategy, commercial activities and a team of specialists

As a Director in our programmatic team, you will take ownership of media planning and strategy on some of our largest clients. You will actively drive the commercial growth of our department while shaping our programmatic offering. Joining a collaborative team of 10 specialists, you will also expand your leadership skills by taking on the day-to-day management of a couple of our specialists in Aarhus.

You can look forward to:

• 
Client lead: Leading client strategy and maintaining a close dialogue with both internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment between strategy, business objectives, and campaigns.

• 
Commercial growth: Contributing to the continuous development of s360’s programmatic offering, as well as actively driving commercial projects and pitches from a programmatic and media strategy perspective.

• 
Team leadership: Sharing your expertise and acting as a senior sparring partner to support and guide team members, as well as being the formal manager for a couple of the team members in Aarhus.

Join our programmatic team

You’ll be joining a dynamic team of motivated specialists working across markets, platforms and media channels. We are a team of 10 across Aarhus and Copenhagen, working closely together, continuously pushing the boundaries of our offering. We are a tight knit team and we are regularly doing social events, both as a whole team across offices and as teams in each of the two locations.

Shape the role with your expertise

We are looking for a professional who can combine a deep specialist knowledge with an urge to drive cutting edge media strategy with a consultative mindset. You are ready to lead client relationships, drive complex engagements, and play an active role in strengthening our team and commercial offering.

To the role you will bring:

• 
Programmatic experience: You bring approximately 5 years of solid experience working with programmatic advertising spanning media planning, ad ops, execution in various ad-tech platforms (GMP experience preferred) and commercial pitching.

• 
Cross-channel and -media: You have experience across different platforms and channels within digital advertising. Experience with traditional offline media is considered a plus.

• 
Client management: You have experience in a client-facing role and recognise the absolute importance of cultivating strong, trusted client relations.

• 
Team mindset: You are a collaborative team player with high ambitions for both your personal development and the growth of the team around you.

What it's like working at s360

At s360, you will be part of a Marketing and AI consultancy, working alongside more than 330 skilled colleagues across 10 offices in 8 countries. While our shared mission is to help brands and retailers grow, we are equally committed to fostering a strong culture, defined by collaboration, drive, and continuous development. We believe that our culture and ways of working are key to delivering long-term, meaningful results.

As a part of our team, you can look forward to:

• 
Skilled colleagues: Collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry and be part of an ambitious team with deep expertise across all key digital disciplines.

• 
Top-tier clients: Work with some of the biggest brands in the world on solving their most complex and interesting commercial problems.

• 
Growth journey: Join one of the fastest-growing marketing and AI consultancies in Europe with the ambition of becoming the best in the world.

• 
International environment: With 10 offices across 8 countries, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with people from diverse cultures around the world.

• 
Career acceleration: Get individual career plans to influence your own professional path and contribute to shaping the company’s future.

• 
Continuous development: A learning culture where people strive to become 1% better every day, supported by advanced training and knowledge sharing.

We’d love to hear from you

Does this sound like the right fit for you? Then don’t hesitate to apply or reach out to Senior Director & Head of Mads Hantho at +45 30911567 or mhh@s360digital.com.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and hire as soon as the right candidate is found, so please send your CV and application as soon as possible. All inquiries are treated confidentially.

jobs.occupation: Excellence & Engagement Manager - Health, Safety & Security
jobs.description:
Do you want to be a valued part of a global team that works passionately every day to ensure employees at DFDS go to work for DFDS and return safely and unharmed home to their loved ones? If this excites you then look no further and come join us.

About The Role  Be part of the movement - and play your part.   As Excellence & Engagement Manager in the Global Health, Safety & Security Team, you will be part of the continuous strengthening of DFDS’ health, safety and security culture. This is a new global role, and we expect you to participate in shaping and developing it. We anticipate that you will contribute by developing, implementing and continuously improving the frameworks, standards, tools, learning processes, communications and engagement activities that enable a strong Health, Safety & Security (HSS) performance across DFDS landside operations.

You will be responsible for ensuring consistent and effective deployment of group-wide HSS initiatives across DFDS operations area, supporting operational teams in anchoring safe and secure behaviors. The role works closely with the HSS Business Partners, other operational stakeholders and senior management to strengthen organizational learning, capability, culture and performance.

The role reports directly to the Global Director for HSS, and you will be based at our Global Headquarters in the port of Copenhagen. The role requires on-site presence.

What kind of exciting challenges can you expect to meet in this role?:  **Role

**As Excellence & Engagement Manager - HSS you will get the opportunity to influence and develop the role but the initial areas we expect you to cover are:

• Develop, coordinate and monitor global HSS initiatives.

• Develop, coordinate and maintain global HSS culture-building activities, campaigns and engagement programs aiming to strengthen safe and secure behaviors.

• Maintain and continuously improve our HSSEQ Management System.

• Develop, implement and continuously improve a Managers Toolkit on HSS.

• Manage Performance Monitoring and Improvement related to HSS in close collaboration with HSS Business Partners.

• Develop and coordinate DFDS’ organizational learning processes on HSS, ensuring learnings from incidents, audits etc. are translated into practical improvements and shared across the organization.

• Support leadership teams in understanding and applying HSS frameworks, standards and improvement methodologies.

• Build strong working relationships with operational leaders, local HSS teams, and functional stakeholders.

About You We think that the strongest teams are built on diversity and inclusivity. Contrasting opinions, varied skills and strong characters bring out the best in us all. With this in mind, we think that you are passionate about health, safety & security, have excellent interpersonal and communication skills, are a good listener and can digest large amounts of information and convert it into actions.

You Are Structured, Self-supporting And Capable Of Both Prioritizing And Multitasking In a Demanding Environment. Moreover, We Imagine That The Ideal Candidate Brings

• Ability to think strategically, translating HSS strategy into practical solutions and measurable business outcomes.

• A passion for building a strong HSS culture through engagement, communication and leadership influence.

• Experience in developing and implementing standards, frameworks and management systems within operational environments.

• Natural collaboration skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence without direct authority.

• Strong organizing skills, bringing structure, governance and consistency to complex initiatives.

• Capability to operate between strategy and execution, balancing long-term objectives with day-to-day deliveries, in a global corporate function.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, good listening abilities, and the ability to digest large amounts of information and convert it into actions.

• A self-driven approach, with the ability to prioritize and multitask in a demanding environment.

**Furthermore, You Have

**

• A degree in business, organizational development, safety or security management, or related field.

• Proven experience (5+ years) within safety or security related functions in a global or matrixed organization.

• Experience in shipping, logistics, or industrial sectors is highly desirable.

• Strong understanding of safety/security culture principles and organizational behavior is an advantage.

• Excellent presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

• Knowledge of or certification in change management methodologies is a plus.

• Project management certification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) is an advantage.

• Proficiency in English (oral and written) as English is corporate language.

• Proficiency in Microsoft 365 suite.

• Experience in utilizing AI tools is an advantage.

Working at DFDS  Join the movement and grow with us.  While you’re with us, we want you to develop and move yourself on. We’ll encourage you to challenge yourself to acquire new skills and perspectives.

At DFDS, we promote a great workplace with a diverse and vibrant community. At our Copenhagen headquarters, we enjoy a modern workspace with award-winning facilities, different work zones, own game room, fitness facilities, canteen and a café with a rooftop terrace with a beautiful ocean view, all just 5 minutes from the nearest train & metro station.

Are we a match? Then what are you waiting for? Apply Now.   If you think your personality, skills, experience and aspirations match this role, we’d love to hear from you. Send us your resume as soon as possible as we’re keen to meet potential candidates on an ongoing basis.

Is there something you need to know, we haven’t covered here, please do not hesitate to reach out to Global Director HSS (Landside) Steffen Conradsen on sconr@dfds.com.

Please note that response times may be slightly longer than usual due to the autumn holiday period and business travel activities within the hiring team, however, rest assured that we will get back to you at earliest convenience.

We look forward to hearing from you.   This recruitment process is managed by the DFDS Talent Acquisition team. We kindly ask external recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting us regarding this opportunity.

Manager, GTM Systems & Innovation

Hybrid (minimum of 2-3 days a week from the office)

**

Shape the Future of Privacy**

Usercentrics is a global leader in data privacy and privacy-led marketing solutions. We believe there is no need for a trade-off between growth and privacy compliance. Our vision is to unlock the potential of data privacy to empower a thriving digital ecosystem. We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise. Our customers build trust with their users through improved transparency and control to drastically improve marketing and monetization, while achieving full privacy compliance.

**About the Role

**Revenue Operations is the horizontal backbone behind Usercentrics' three go-to-market motions — Self Serve, Sales Led, and Partner Led. As we scale, our Salesforce ecosystem and wider GTM tech stack need a single owner who can turn ambitious business requirements into governed, scalable systems. As Manager, GTM Systems & Innovation, you'll lead a team spanning Salesforce administration and GTM engineering, and you'll be the one deciding how AI-native automation gets built into our GTM workflows. You'll partner closely with other Revenue Operations teams, the broader GTM organization, and stakeholders across Finance and Product to translate business requirements into efficient, reliable systems.

**Responsibilities

**> Own CRM architecture and governance end-to-end, ensuring Salesforce supports Self Serve, Sales Led, and Partner Led without compromising on data integrity.

> Set the roadmap and standards for the wider GTM tech stack, tying every major investment to a clear business outcome - pipeline quality, forecasting reliability, or support efficiency - not just tool delivery.

> Lead and grow a small team spanning Salesforce administration, Salesforce architecture, and GTM engineering, keeping the team focused on high-impact initiatives tied to clear business outcomes, and acting as the final technical decision-maker on system changes.

> Drive AI-native workflows and automation across GTM - from propensity and churn scoring models to workflow automation - that reduce manual work, increase seller and CS productivity, and improve the customer experience.

> Own attribution and data hygiene practices, partnering closely with BI on the underlying data infrastructure and pipeline.

> Drive adoption and value realization of the systems you build, partnering with GTM Enablement to make sure new capabilities actually change day-to-day behavior, not just go live.

> Continuously evaluate GTM tooling and market trends, bringing investment recommendations to the VP of Revenue Operations based on expected business impact and ROI.

Requirements

Experience

> 5+ years of experience in RevOps, Salesforce administration and GTM systems, with real ownership of architecture-level decisions.

> Experience managing a technical team in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

Technical Skills

> Deep, hands-on Salesforce expertise (architecture, automation, integrations).

> Practical experience with tools like n8n, Clay, and Outreach, and with AI-assisted workflows in a revenue context.

Operating Skills

> Strong data instincts: comfortable owning attribution, data hygiene, and governance across a growing tech stack.

> Confident operating independently and making system decisions without needing to escalate every call.

> Comfortable being the technical backstop for a Solution Architect, Administrator, and Engineer, without needing to do the hands-on build yourself day to day.

Benefits

Include:

> Development Budget for every employee: 800,- EUR / year

> Job-related Language Courses (English, German, Czech, Spanish etc.): 350,- EUR / year

> Hybrid working policy and the possibility to take a workcation (90 days per year from a European country

> Online yoga sessions

> Massages

> Headspace App

> Events - Team Buildings, happy hours, parties/get togethers, occasional company covered breakfasts/lunches, in/across offices, online/in person etc

> Gifts - We celebrate life & work milestones at UC (work anniversaries, new born babies and similar)

> Snacks, fruits, coffee and drinks in the office

Joining Usercentrics means becoming part of a fast-growing, diverse and international team of tech enthusiasts and entrepreneurially-minded who build our success story together

Company culture is important to us - we strive to continuously develop a positive, vibrant and inspiring environment that enables everyone to thrive both personally and professionally

Get involved! We have plenty of initiatives and love to see people from all department enthusiastically participating and shaping our future together in different cross-department projects

Your work-life balance is important to us too - we offer flexible working hours, hybrid working and the possibility of workcations (in accordance with our company policy)

We always remember to have fun along the way, both in our day-to-day work and at our regular team events on site in our offices in Munich, Copenhagen, Odense, Lisbon, New York and Buenos Aires or online

You are the most valuable asset to our company which is why we’re happy to offer awesome benefits like our personal development budget, job-related language courses and a lot more (depending on your location) to focus on your well being

Usercentrics is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

More about Usercentrics

Usercentrics logo

Visit website

Join Usercentrics and be part of our diverse international team. Contribute to a positive, collaborative environment where we value wide-ranging skills, knowledge, and perspectives. We hire talented individuals with varied backgrounds, providing them space to grow and make a difference in the world of data privacy and in Usercentrics’ story.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**Why this role is important to us

**Group IT keeps SimCorp running. The same discipline we bring to our clients' investment operations is applied to our own enterprise platforms. Workday and Salesforce are at the center of how we manage our people and client relationships.

As Senior Director, Enterprise Applications, you will own the strategy, governance, and operational health of Workday and Salesforce across the organization. You will serve as the primary accountable leader for these platforms, partnering closely with business functions to ensure secure, compliant, and reliable operations through your leadership team and subject matter experts.

This is a senior leadership position with high visibility across Group IT, P&C, and Sales, providing direct influence over the evolution of two of SimCorp's most business-critical enterprise platforms.

You will step directly into a strategic and business-critical transformation initiative: the migration of financial processes and data from Workday to SAP S/4HANA, with a planned go-live in January 2027. Success in this role requires the ability to quickly engage in data mapping, integration planning, stakeholder alignment, and cross-functional execution from day one.

**The organization consists of:

**

• 5 individual contributors reporting directly to the role

• 2 managers reporting directly to the role

• 29 employees in total across the Enterprise Applications area

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Define and own the multi-year strategy, roadmap, and operating model for Workday and Salesforce, aligning platform capabilities and investments with business priorities and growth objectives

• Establish and chair platform governance forums with P&C, Sales, Customer Success, and other key stakeholders to prioritize enhancements, integrations, releases, and investment decisions

• Ensure the stability, performance, security, and availability of Workday and Salesforce through effective release management, testing, monitoring, and change control practices

• Oversee the end-to-end integration landscape across Workday, Salesforce, SAP S/4HANA

• Manage strategic relationships with software vendors, implementation partners, and managed service providers, including contracts, licensing, and commercial oversight in partnership with Software Asset Management

• Own platform security and access governance, including role design, segregation of duties, periodic access reviews, and compliance with internal control requirements

• Partner closely with Information Security, Risk, Compliance, and Internal Audit teams to ensure effective controls, timely remediation activities, and adherence to GDPR and other regulatory requirements

• Drive continuous improvement and adoption of platform capabilities to increase business value, operational efficiency, and user experience across the organization

**What We Value

**

• 10+ years of leadership experience in enterprise applications, with deep expertise in Workday and Salesforce, or solid hands-on experience in one platform combined with demonstrated leadership responsibility for the other

• 5+ years of people management experience leading teams of platform owners, administrators, business analysts, or related application specialists

• A proven track record of establishing and operating governance models for enterprise platforms in a global, regulated, or financial services environment

• Solid understanding of enterprise integration architectures.

• Experience managing SaaS vendors, software licensing, commercial agreements, and strategic partner relationships

• Solid knowledge of data privacy, risk, and security frameworks, including GDPR, SOC 2, and ISO 27001

• Effective stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively at both executive and technical levels

• Workday and/or Salesforce certifications are considered an advantage

**Benefits

**Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work and work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. And opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we provide custom paths for professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**For Poland Location

**Compensation ranges are being disclosed at the initial stage of candidate engagement.

Visit our career pages to learn more about working at SimCorp: www.simcorp.com/career

**Next steps

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually.

**Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.

**At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Join IO Interactive’s Finance team at our Copenhagen Studio as Finance Director and play a key role in shaping the financial direction of a multi-studio, multi-entity games company. You will lead the Finance function, drive the automation of the finance processes, and act as the CFO's trusted partner and second-in-command. Responsible for the day-to-day leadership of Finance while providing strategic, financial, and commercial guidance that supports IO Interactive's continued growth across all studios.

If you are a strategic finance leader who combines commercial understanding with strong technical expertise, we would love to meet you.

**Please note that our finance team is primarily based in Copenhagen, and we would love local leadership; this position requires you to be on-site at our Copenhagen studio.

****What You Will Do

****Finance Leadership

**

• Lead the day-to-day Finance organisation across IO Interactive's global studios.

• Manage, drive, mentor, and develop Finance team members while building a high-performing and collaborative function.

• Drive the ongoing project of full automation of the finance process

• Act as the CFO's right-hand and trusted sparring partner on both operational and strategic matters.

• Ensure strong financial governance, controls, compliance, and scalable finance processes across the organisation.

**Financial & Business Leadership

**

• Own budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning across all studios and entities.

• Provide strategic financial insight and recommendations to the CFO and senior leadership team.

• Translate financial and operational performance into clear actions and business recommendations.

• Support decision-making related to investments, headcount planning, studio growth and organisational development.

• Partner with Production, Commercial, Technology and Corporate leadership on financial performance and business priorities.

• Drive performance management through meaningful reporting, KPIs and financial analysis.

**Controlling & Governance

**

• Upscale and improve Financial and Business controlling.

• Oversee Accounting, Financial Controlling and Business Controlling activities across the organisation.

• Ensure accurate management reporting and financial visibility across studios, projects and functions.

• Oversee external audits, statutory compliance, and financial risk management.

• Support finance transformation, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Who You Are

**

• Significant experience in a senior Finance leadership role.

• Strong background across Accounting, Financial Controlling and Business Controlling.

• Experience leading and driving Finance teams in a complex international organisation.

• Strong commercial mindset with the ability to influence strategic business decisions.

• Experience partnering with executive stakeholders and senior leadership teams.

• Excellent understanding of financial reporting, governance, planning, and performance management.

• Strong leadership skills and ability to operate as a trusted advisor.

**We would love it if you had

**

• Experience working in the gaming industry.

• Previous experience in an audit firm earlier in your career.

• Experience supporting multi-studio, multi-entity, or international organisations.

• Experience with ERP transformations

• Experience with Unit4 or similar ERP systems.

• Experience with Prophix or similar systems.

• Accounting qualification such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CMA or equivalent.

**Who We Are

**IO Interactive is an independent video game development and publishing company with studios in Copenhagen, Malmö, Barcelona, and Brighton. As the creative force behind some of the most talked-about multiplatform video games in the last decade, we are committed to creating unforgettable characters and experiences—powered by our award-winning, proprietary Glacier technology.

IOI is a studio that values in-person collaboration. Being together helps us focus our collective energy on our immediate goals. For us, being both in-office as well as connected across our studios helps us integrate our teams faster, strengthen relationships, and improve knowledge-sharing. We believe that the more time we spend together, the more quality and progress we achieve for our games and players.

We know that to achieve those goals, we need courage, talented people, and a great working environment—and we do our utmost to have all of that. Across our multiple studios, we’re working on several projects. Crucially, though, we’re all one team. We value the work and impact that each person brings to the table, and we actively encourage new ideas whilst listening to your insights along the way.

With more than 50 nationalities, we know that everyone is different, and we are proud to have a reputation for being a friendly workplace with highly talented people.

IO Interactive is an independent video game development and publishing company with studios in Copenhagen, Malmö, Barcelona, Brighton and Istanbul. As the creative force behind some of the most talked-about multiplatform video games in the last decade, we are dedicated to creating unforgettable characters and experiences – all powered by our award-winning proprietary Glacier technology.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**Are you a highly motivated, accurate, and detail-oriented person with a passion for numbers? Are you eager to learn and grow in the accounting field? If so - we have an amazing opportunity for you!

We are looking for a junior accountant to join our growing Accounting team. As a junior accountant, you will be responsible for booking supplier invoices and handling finance-related emails.

We value teamwork and believe in the strength of collaboration. You will work closely with a group of committed young professionals who are passionate about what they do, eager to improve processes, and happy to help each other when needed. You will have the chance to learn and develop your skills in a supportive and collaborative environment. We have a great team spirit that is also shown across the Boozt organization.

If you want to work and grow within accounting and enjoy working in a fast-paced changing environment, then you may be the person we are looking for.

**What You Will Do

**

• Bookkeeping and processing of supplier invoices related to inventory purchases

• Daily follow-up of deliveries against purchase orders and inventory systems

• Assist with daily administrative tasks such as handling finance-related emails

• Communication with suppliers regarding delivery status, discrepancies, and invoice matters

• Collaboration with procurement, warehouse, and logistics teams to resolve delivery and invoice-related issues

• Responsibility for identifying inefficiencies in current processes and proposing improvements

**YOUR PROFILE

**To be successful in this role, you have attention to high-quality detail and accuracy. You are eager to learn and grow in the accounting field. Your approach to problem-solving is proactive and innovative. You are a positive, responsible, and structured person who thrives on collaboration. You can work in a fast-paced environment.

• Bachelor's degree or a degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, along with work experience, is considered an advantage.

• Excellent communication skills, both oral and written

• Fluent in English - Boozt corporate language

**Apply today – we’re excited to learn more about you!

**_Only applications submitted in English will be considered.

_Important: Applicants must have the legal right to work in Denmark at the time of employment. Please note that this position does not include visa sponsorship or relocation support.

We review applications on an ongoing basis. You can read more about the process under **Recruitment.

****BOOZT PERKS

**

• Great personal and internal career development opportunities

• A culture built on our values of trust, freedom, and responsibility

• Driven and passionate international colleagues

• A generous employee discount

• Healthy and delicious breakfast and lunch, top-quality coffee, and fresh fruit available all day

• In-house gym, onsite masseuse, and medical doctor

• An amazing HQ in central Copenhagen – the iconic, energy-efficient Krystallen building, recognized for its architectural design and sustainability. Enjoy breathtaking city views and much more!

**A LITTLE BIT ABOUT US

Siteimprove helps organisations make their digital content accessible to everyone. Our accessibility products scan entire web estates and document libraries, find the barriers that stop people using them, and increasingly fix those barriers automatically. The work is measured in public: our customers are universities, health systems, government agencies and Fortune 500 companies who have legal deadlines to meet and auditors to satisfy.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead one of our two accessibility product teams. You will own the delivery, quality and technical direction of a cross-functional team of engineers working alongside a Product Manager and a Designer, and you will be accountable for what that team ships and for how the people in it grow.

This role sits at a genuine inflection point. We are moving from finding accessibility problems to explaining and fixing them, and we are rebuilding how we develop software around AI agents that write, test and review code under human direction. We need a leader who is credible in the code, fluent in modern AI-assisted development, and able to coach a team through that change without trading away quality or the well-being of the people doing the work.

What we will be doing

• Own delivery for your team. Turn a product roadmap into a sequenced, realistic plan, keep commitments honest, and be the person who says early and clearly when something will not land.

• Lead the people. Hold regular one-to-ones, give direct and useful feedback, run performance and growth conversations, and build a team where engineers at different levels can do their best work. Recruit, onboard and retain.

• Stay hands-on enough to be credible. Read and review code and designs, take part in architectural decisions, and pair with engineers when it helps. You are not expected to carry a full delivery load, but you are expected to understand the system well enough to challenge a design and to know when an estimate is wrong.

• Coach the team in AI-assisted development. Raise the whole team's effectiveness with AI tooling: how to decompose a problem so an agent can take it, how to write a prompt and a specification that produce reviewable work, and how to review agent-generated code properly rather than approving it on sight.

• Set the standards for how AI-generated work is accepted. Define with your engineers how such work is reviewed, tested, secured and documented before it merges, and hold the line that a human is always accountable for what ships.

• Partner with Product and Design as equals. Work with your Product Manager on outcomes, scope and sequencing, and make the technical trade-offs visible so the three of you decide together.

• Work across teams. Depend on and contribute to Platform, AI and other product teams. Much of what your team needs will be built elsewhere, and much of what it builds will be consumed elsewhere.

• Protect engineering health. Hold a deliberate balance between roadmap delivery, compliance obligations, customer-reported defects and technical debt, and make that balance explicit rather than letting it be decided by whatever is loudest.

• Own quality and operational responsibility. Testing, accessibility conformance of our own products, security and vulnerability remediation, incident response and the reliability of what your team runs in production.

• Adjust your working hours to overlap with the United States. This role reports to a manager on the US Pacific coast and partners with colleagues across the US. You will regularly take meetings in the late afternoon or early evening Central European Time, and we will protect the rest of your week in return.

• Travel may be required; a valid passport is required

• Perform other duties as assigned

What we will require of you

• Engineering management experience. Several years leading software engineering teams as their direct manager, including hiring, performance management and developing engineers at more than one level. You have owned delivery for a team over a sustained period, not just a project.

• A real software engineering background. You have built and shipped production software yourself and can still read a pull request, follow a design discussion and form your own view. We will talk about systems you have built.

• Depth in at least one of our core languages, and comfort across the rest. Our services are written mainly in C# and .NET, TypeScript and JavaScript, Go, Rust and Python. You do not need all of them; you do need to be genuinely strong in one and unafraid of the others.

• Modern cloud and delivery practice. AWS, containers and Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, continuous integration and deployment pipelines, observability and on-call practice.

• Practical use of AI in the software lifecycle. You have personally used AI coding assistants and agents on real work, you know where they help and where they mislead, and you have opinions about how their output should be reviewed. Experience helping other engineers adopt them is what sets this role apart.

• Strong partnership with Product. A track record of working with Product Managers and Designers as a peer, shaping scope rather than receiving it.

• Clear written and spoken English, and the ability to explain a technical trade-off to a non-technical audience.

• Willingness to work a shifted day. Regular overlap with US Pacific time, and occasional travel.

What we will love about you

• Digital accessibility knowledge. Familiarity with WCAG, assistive technology, or the accessibility conformance and reporting that regulated customers require. If you do not have it, you must be willing to learn it properly — it is the product.

• Experience in a compliance or regulated environment, such as FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001 or a public-sector authorisation, and comfort working inside an audited change process.

• Open-source stewardship. We build and maintain an open-source accessibility rules engine, and experience running a public project and its community is valuable.

• Experience leading a distributed or multi-site team, including working effectively with contractors and vendor partners.

• Having introduced AI-assisted development to an organisation, including the governance, measurement and change management that goes with it.

• Danish language skills are a nice-to-have and are not required; our working language is English.

What you'll love about us

We’re building the next generation of AI-powered content intelligence, helping organizations unify accessibility, SEO/AEO, analytics, and content performance into one platform. If you’re energized by solving complex problems, working cross-functionally, and contributing to a product with real-world impact, we’d love to connect.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral research in plant regulatory genomics and artificial intelligence
jobs.employer_name: Center for Kvantitativ Genetik og Genomforskning
jobs.description:
The Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics (QGG) at Aarhus University, Denmark, invites applications for a two-year postdoctoral position in plant regulatory genomics and artificial intelligence, starting 1 April 2027.

You will design new sequence-to-expression deep learning models that predict gene expression from DNA sequence in plants, using new experimental datasets generated in the project. The position includes a 6- to 12-month research stay at Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory (CSHL), USA, combining plant genomics expertise at Aarhus with AI expertise at CSHL.

This is an opportunity to advance the state of the art in AI for plant biology while working across two leading research environments. For more information, feel free to reach out to Guillaume Ramstein (QGG) and Peter Koo (CSHL).

Expected start date and duration of employment

This is a 2-year position from April 1st 2027, or as soon as possible.

Job description

You will advance the field of artificial intelligence applied to regulatory genomics, as part of the GRASP project funded by the Independent Research Fund Denmark. In this project, you will leverage new training sets, build novel deep learning architectures and define dedicated learning objectives, to learn the effects of genetic variants on gene expression.

The position will focus on data science and genomics in a model plant species, Brachypodium distachyon. You will work at the cutting edge of AI in biology and propose new solutions to predict the effects of regulatory variants in plant genomes, which remains an open research problem in plant genomics. 

These activities will be carried out in close collaboration with the Koo lab, a leading group in AI and regulatory genomics at Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory (CSHL), USA. As part of this collaboration, the position will include a 6- to 12-month research stay in the Koo lab.

Your profile

Applicants should hold a PhD in computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field, or expect to complete it before the start date. They should have research experience in deep learning.

Applicants are expected to have published in international peer-reviewed journals, preferably on topics related to AI and genomics. Experience in developing new deep learning techniques (model architectures or learning objectives) is especially relevant to this position. 

Good communication skills in English are required, as well as the ability to work in an interdisciplinary team of AI experts, computational geneticists, and plant biologists.

Who we are

The Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics (QGG) is a major center for research and education in quantitative genetics and genomics at Aarhus University (http://www.qgg.au.dk/en). We conduct basic and applied research in animal, plant, and human genetics. Our focus areas include quantitative genetics, artificial intelligence applied to agriculture and medicine, population genetics, and integrative genomics. Research within QGG is characterized by a very close synergy between method development and application on practical problems across species, in collaboration with industry partners. QGG is an international research center with about 70 employees and visiting researchers from over 15 nations. QGG works in teams and strives for an excellent working environment, in which we value self-leadership, open communication, and commitment to diversity and inclusion.

What we offer

The succesful candidate will be offered:

• A 6- to 12-month research stay in the Koo lab at Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory (CSHL), USA, providing international experience and the opportunity to work across two leading labs in plant genomics and AI.
• Computational ressources, including the GenomeDK high-performance computing cluster, with growing capabilities such as high-memory nodes and state-of-the-art GPUs.
• An interdisciplinary interdisciplinary environment, in which the candidate will be able to exchange across research fields (machine learning, bioinformatics, biology, and quantitative genetics) and applications (plant biology, agriculture, and biomedicine).
• A research environment characterized by collaboration, professionalism, commitment to diversity and inclusion, and success in mentoring and supervision.
• A healthy work-life balance.
Place of work and area of employment

The primary place of work is C. F. Møllers Allé 3, 8000, Aarhus (Denmark), and the area of employment is Aarhus University with related departments.

The position will also include a 6- to 12-month research stay at 1 Bungtown Rd, Cold Spring Harbor, NY 11724, United States. The time and duration of the research stay may be negotiated with the supervisors Guillaume Ramstein and Peter Koo.

Contact information

For further information, please contact:

• Tenure-Track Assistant Professor Guillaume Ramstein, +45 42 52 12 66, ramstein@qgg.au.dk
• Associate Professor Peter Koo, +1 516 367 5520, koo@cshl.edu
Deadline

Applications must be received no later than November 20th, 2026.

Om Aarhus Universitet

Aarhus Universitet er et fagligt bredt og forskningsintensivt universitet med høj kvalitet i uddannelse og forskning, og et stærkt engagement i samfundsudviklingen nationalt og globalt. Universitetet tilbyder et inspirerende uddannelses- og forskningsmiljø for 37.500 studerende og 9.000 medarbejdere med en årlig omsætning på 8,9 mia. kr. Læs mere på www.au.dk

•    Planning and performing laboratory tests according to approved procedures, instructions, and test methods

•    Documenting test activities and results accurately and in accordance with quality requirements

•    Reviewing and evaluating test results, including basic statistical analysis and interpretation of data

•    Supporting ongoing production with laboratory testing

•    Contributing to investigations related to unexpected or non-conforming test results

•    Supporting test verification and transfer activities

•    Participating in equipment-related activities, including maintenance, calibration, qualification, and troubleshooting

•    Writing, reviewing, and updating laboratory procedures, test methods, and work instructions

•    Supporting change control, corrective and preventive actions, and audit activities

•    Participating in daily stand-up meetings and contributing to task prioritization and workflow

•    Ensuring that laboratory activities are carried out in compliance with environmental, health, and safety requirements

•    Contributing to continuous improvement of laboratory processes, workflows, and ways of working

You can expect a role with both routine and non-routine laboratory activities. You will have the opportunity to build a broad network across the organization and gain experience with quality assurance at several stages of a product’s lifecycle.

Bring quality and reliability to every laboratory task

To succeed in this position, you work carefully and systematically and understand the importance of accurate documentation and data integrity. You take responsibility for your tasks, follow established procedures, and

communicate clearly if you identify unexpected results, quality risks or challenges.

You enjoy working both independently and as part of a team. As priorities may change depending on production and project needs, you are flexible and able to organize your work accordingly.

We imagine that you:

•    Are a qualified Laboratory Technician or have a comparable laboratory education

•    Have experience with practical laboratory work, preferably within quality control, quality assurance, production, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or another regulated industry

•    Have a strong quality mindset and a structured approach to documentation

•    Have knowledge of basic statistics and experience evaluating and presenting laboratory data

•    Are able to write and maintain procedures, test methods, and work instructions

•    Are comfortable working according to procedures, test methods, and quality requirements

•    Have experience with laboratory equipment and general laboratory practices

•    Are curious, solution-oriented, and willing to learn new methods and technologies

•    Work well with colleagues from different professional backgrounds

•    Communicate clearly and professionally

•    Are comfortable using digital systems for laboratory documentation and data handling

•    Are fluent in Danish and able to communicate in English

Experience from the medical device industry, working under Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) requirements, or using a Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Interested?

If you would like to know more about the position, please contact Lotte Stoklund, Team Manager, QA Lifecycle Laboratory, at dklst@coloplast.com

We will invite candidates for interviews continuously, so we encourage you to submit your CV with a short description of your motivation for applying as soon as possible. The position will remain open until a suitable candidate is found.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Visit us on Coloplast.com.

Job Description

We are looking for a Business Consultant who is motivated by creating solutions that make a real difference for our many clients. You will have the opportunity to work across industries, applying your expertise to help some of Denmark’s most exciting companies develop and strengthen their business.

Responsibilities

At Netcompany, we pride ourselves on a culture built around high agility, low hierarchy, fast decision-making, and strong team spirit.

We develop solutions for a wide range of clients, from smaller private companies to large-scale public sector projects. Regardless of the project size, you as a Business Consultant will make a noticeable impact together with some of the industry’s most talented colleagues.

We are looking for a Business Consultant with a strong and well-documented interest in digitalisation to support initiatives related to user involvement, training, benefits realisation, process optimisation, and change management. Your work will be tied to our large-scale projects across both the public and private sectors.

As a Business Consultant, you will help ensure that Netcompany’s IT projects are successfully anchored within our clients’ organisations and business processes. You will also play a key role in making sure users have the right capabilities and readiness, so that both users and the organisation are fully prepared when new solutions go live.

The role is diverse and dynamic. Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Preparing user guides and training materials, as well as conducting user training sessions.

• Performing analyses and reporting on organisational change readiness.

• Mapping processes and facilitating workshops with clients.

• Defining benefits tracking models and preparing communication plans.

About you

You actively seek understanding by asking questions and encourage learning through curiosity and dialogue. Deadlines do not intimidate you and you are willing to go the extra mile when needed. To succeed in this role, you:

• Are either a recent graduate or have a few years of experience — ideally working at the intersection of IT, business, and organisation, for example as an IT project manager or consultant.

• Have an interest in IT and digitalisation.

• Hold a relevant master’s degree, such as Cand.merc., Cand.it., Cand.scient., or similar.

• Have strong written and verbal communication skills and are fluent in both Danish and English.

Continue developing with us

Join an inclusive community

**Responsibilities

**

Our Controls and Thermal Management division combines heat exchanger expertise with technologies for refrigeration, cooling and air conditioning, serving customers across HVAC, refrigeration and industrial applications.
