jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher in Computational Proteomics and Machine Learning
jobs.description:
Department of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, University of Southern Denmark
Location: Odense, Denmark
Duration: 2 years, with the possibility of a 1-year extension
Starting Date: 1 January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter

Project Description
We invite applications for a postdoctoral position at the interface of computational proteomics, machine learning, and mass spectrometry. The successful candidate will join a pioneering research program focused on peptide ionization and fragmentation in LC-MS/MS, with the aim of developing new computational approaches for peptide fragmentation analysis.

The project centers on large-scale, experimentally curated tandem mass spectrometry datasets and the development of new computational strategies for fragmentation analysis under analytically underexplored conditions. It relies on modern machine learning approaches to model fragmentation behavior, support spectral interpretation, and enable future advances in peptide identification workflows.

The position is embedded in the Protein Research Group (PRG) at the University of Southern Denmark, an internationally recognized environment in proteomics and biological mass spectrometry. The postdoctoral researcher will work in close collaboration with experimental colleagues generating high-quality tandem MS data for computational development.

Research Environment and Collaborative Structure
The Protein Research Group comprises eight PI-led teams and more than 50 researchers and students, offering a highly interactive and interdisciplinary research environment. The successful candidate will play a central role in the computational arm of the project and will collaborate closely with experimental researchers developing new mass spectrometric methods and generating large-scale fragmentation datasets.

The position offers substantial scientific independence and the opportunity to help shape a new research direction at the intersection of machine learning, peptide chemistry, and proteomics.

Responsibilities
The postdoctoral researcher will be expected to:

• 
Develop computational and machine learning workflows for large-scale analysis of tandem mass spectrometry data 

• 
Contribute to the structuring, curation, and quality control of large experimental MS/MS datasets 

• 
Build data-driven models for peptide fragmentation analysis using experimentally generated spectra 

• 
Integrate relevant variables such as peptide sequence, precursor charge state, collision energy, and peptide modifications into computational frameworks 

• 
Evaluate model performance using suitable similarity, quality, and generalization metrics 

• 
Contribute to the extension of computational models toward chemically and biologically relevant peptide classes, including selected post-translational modifications 

• 
Investigate how computational models may help reveal fragmentation trends and chemically meaningful patterns in large-scale MS/MS datasets 

• 
Work independently on model development, implementation, and computational problem solving, while interacting closely with experimental researchers in the group 

• 
Contribute to reproducible and well-documented computational pipelines, data structures, and analysis workflows 

• 
Disseminate findings through peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations, and open scientific resources where relevant 

Required Qualifications
Applicants must have:

• 
A PhD in computational proteomics, bioinformatics, machine learning, computer science, chemometrics, analytical chemistry, or a closely related field 

• 
Strong experience in machine learning and/or deep learning applied to complex scientific datasets 

• 
Demonstrated ability to independently develop computational solutions, including model design, implementation, evaluation, and documentation 

• 
Proficiency in Python and relevant machine learning/data science frameworks 

• 
Experience with data preprocessing, curation, and quality control for large and complex datasets 

• 
A strong analytical mindset and the ability to work independently on computational research problems 

• 
Interest in working at the interface of computation, chemistry, and mass spectrometry 

Desirable Qualifications
The following qualifications will be considered an advantage:

• 
Experience with mass spectrometry-based proteomics, computational mass spectrometry, or peptide fragmentation-related data analysis 

• 
Experience with neural network architectures relevant for sequence-based prediction tasks 

• 
Experience with model interpretability, explainable AI, or feature analysis in scientific machine learning 

• 
Interest in peptide chemistry, gas-phase ion behavior, or post-translational modifications 

• 
Experience with reproducible workflows, FAIR data principles, and scalable computational pipelines 

• 
Ability to collaborate effectively across computational and experimental disciplines 

What We Offer
A unique opportunity to work at the intersection of proteomics, mass spectrometry, and machine learning on scientifically ambitious and methodologically innovative research 

• 
The opportunity to develop computational methods for experimentally generated high-quality tandem mass spectrometry data 

• 
A central and independent role in shaping the computational direction of a new research effort 

• 
Close collaboration with experimental researchers working on peptide ionization, fragmentation, and advanced LC-MS/MS method development 

• 
A strong interdisciplinary research environment with expertise spanning proteomics, biological mass spectrometry, peptide chemistry, and data analysis 

• 
Access to state-of-the-art mass spectrometry platforms and large in-house datasets 

• 
An international and collaborative research culture with opportunities for scientific development, publication, and conference participation 

• 
Competitive salary and benefits according to Danish collective agreements, including pension and support for international candidates where relevant 

About the Protein Research Group
The Protein Research Group at SDU is internationally recognized for pioneering work in biological mass spectrometry, peptide and protein chemistry, gas-phase chemistry, and proteomics. Research in the group spans fundamental analytical chemistry, method development, structural biology, post-translational modifications, and translational applications in biomedicine and biotechnology.

Located in Odense, the group offers an open, collaborative, and ambitious research environment with a strong emphasis on scientific rigor, interdisciplinary exchange, and long-term platform building. The successful candidate will join a setting in which computational and experimental researchers work in close interaction.

Application deadline: 16. November 2026 at 23:59 hours local Danish time. 

Please see the full call, including how to apply, on www.sdu.dk

Can you inspire and develop experienced project managers while improving project and portfolio performance? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

To further strengthen our project leadership and support the development of Transportation in Denmark, we are looking for a Vice President, Head of Projects. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of approximately 15 experienced multidisciplinary project managers, while taking direct responsibility for selected strategic projects. You will also have portfolio responsibility for medium-sized and smaller projects led by project managers across the organisation. You will report to the Senior Vice President, Transportation, in Denmark.

You will play a central role in connecting project delivery, portfolio performance, and strategic priorities. The portfolio comprises approximately 350 projects, from large multidisciplinary projects to smaller single-discipline assignments across key transportation disciplines. As a member of the Transportation leadership team, you will contribute to the strategic and operational development of the business.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

• Lead and develop a team of multidisciplinary project managers, ensuring clear priorities and high-quality delivery across the portfolio.

• Act as project manager on selected strategic projects, with responsibility for scope, schedule, risk, commercial performance, and client satisfaction.

• Oversee and develop a portfolio of approximately 350 projects, ensuring governance, resource allocation, risk management, financial control, and profitable delivery.

• Improve commercial performance by identifying risks and opportunities early, leading contract and client negotiations, and balancing quality, customer value, and profitability.

• Advance project management excellence across Transportation by developing ways of working and promoting collaboration and knowledge sharing across projects and disciplines.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

The first step to success in this role is your ability to combine strong project management expertise with commercial understanding, stakeholder engagement, and people leadership. You thrive in complex environments where collaboration, cross-team coordination, and professional credibility are essential. You are committed to developing project managers, strengthening project delivery, and creating long-term value for our customers.

On top of that, you will have:

• A degree in civil engineering or other relevant education.

• Extensive project management experience from large multidisciplinary infrastructure projects in Denmark.

• A commercial mindset and solid understanding of portfolio performance, contracts, negotiations, risk, client relations, and financial results.

• Experience developing project management competences and ways of working across teams or portfolios.

• Fluent written and verbal communication skills in Danish and English.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Work location

The position is based in Lyngby or Aarhus, Denmark, with regular travel across our offices.

Want to know more?

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key.

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

Do you want to work on some of the largest Oil & Gas projects in the Danish sector of the North Sea? Have you been looking to join a company in growth with many opportunities for employment and great job security? Do you also want to have more time for your private life?
Then you are the one we have been looking for!

We are looking for welders for offshore work in the Danish sector. Throughout the year we will be adding 250 more workers to our manpower pool.

Your position
We offer you a unique opportunity to join Semco Maritime during our largest growth phase yet. You will be working in a turn based 2:2 or a 2:3 which means you will spend 2 weeks offshore and the 2 to 3 following weeks at home. That also means you will have a work/life balance most people will be envious of, because during the 2 weeks of the rotational period that you are home you can dedicate yourself fully to your family, your hobbies, and your passions.

Your tasks & responsibilities
Together with your team you will be playing a key part in ensuring the quality of our costumers’ offshore assets.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

• Carrying out daily tasks related to welding and pipefitting
• Assisting the mechanical team if needed
• Helping out the other teams when necessary
Qualifications
We imagine that you are good at teamwork and that you work with attention to detail. Furthermore, you should be comfortable with routine tasks and working with predefined processes and guidelines. It is important that you possess a safety-first mindset.

To be successful in this position we expect that you have the following qualifications:

• Educated/trained welder, smith, mechanic, pipefitter or similar
• Experience with welding processes 141, 111, 136
• Availability to pass site tests
• Preferably have offshore experience

Welcome to Semco Maritime
We offer you an interesting and challenging job in an international organization, where we strive to provide innovative and sustainable solutions globally.

There are opportunities for personal and professional development within the job. Furthermore, Semco Maritime is in growth so there are job opportunities for permanent employment.

There are both permanent positions and long duration project positions available.

We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis, so if you are interested, you must submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.
If you have any questions for the position, contact Stine Jessen at +45 79 16 66 66.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company dedicated to projects in the energy sector. For 40 years, we have been facilitating design, fabrication, service and maintenance of our customers’ assets, providing comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects. From turnkey engineering solutions to outsourcing of manpower and delivery of components, systems and solutions – we make sure our customers and partners in the energy sector experience safe and cost-efficient solutions. Semco Maritime has approx. 1,900 employees and branches in Denmark, Norway, United Kingdom, Germany, Singapore and the US. For further information, please see www.semcomaritime.com.

jobs.description:
Would you like to play a key role in leading and coordinating test activities where testing and quality are critical to advanced software solutions? Apply your expertise in a complex and specialized engineering environment. Come and join us!
 We are facing an exciting future with considerable growth and demanding changes, as we deliver advanced technologies and mission critical solutions for the defense and aerospace industry. Our systems provide security for people on land, at sea and in the air. Therefore, we are looking for Test Manager to become part of this journey and contribute to our overall purpose – securing people through advanced technology.
 
Your role in our team
 As our new Advanced Test Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our advanced software solutions within the R&D Defense Test Management department. You will be part of the Test Management team, working closely with experienced test engineers across R&D.
With a strong understanding of systems engineering, verification and validation processes, you will be responsible for securing product quality through strategic test planning, team leadership, test execution, test automation, and close collaboration with stakeholders.
 There is an increasing focus on CI/CD and multiple levels of test automation, which forms an important part of the role and is carried out in close cooperation with software developers, system engineers, fellow testers, and other technical specialists.
 The Test Management department is located across our offices in Lystrup and Søborg, and we expect you to work onsite as it is required for the role.
 
How you will make a meaningful contribution
 Your responsibilities will cover a wide range of testing activities to ensure the quality and reliability of our software solutions. Your key responsibilities include:
·         Plan, monitor, and control the integration and verification of the system
·         Responsible for the Verification Master Plan
·         Point of contact for the verification effort
·         Plan and drive in all test activities and ensure that the system meets the required standards and specifications
·         Support the integration of automated tests with the CI-CD pipeline
·         Contribute to a Test Community of Practice: Engage with other test enthusiasts to share knowledge, best practices, and continuously improve testing methodologies and processes
·         Continuously Improving Ways of Working: Participate in process improvement initiatives to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of testing activities
 
Bring your world class expertise into play
You are fluent in English both in writing and verbal at a professional level. Danish is an advantage but not a requirement. Moreover, we are also looking for a new colleague with the following qualifications:
·          You hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree within Software Engineering or a similar field of study
·         You are certified in software testing principles (ISTQB, TMAP, or similar)
·         You have solid experience with planning and leading test activities in software development
·         You have experience with testing complex systems
·         You have knowledge of software development and an understanding of the fundamentals of software testing and the concepts of system engineering, verification and validation
·         You understand agile development methods (Scrum) and project-oriented processes as well as test automation frameworks and tools 
 
As a person, you have a strong enthusiasm for testing and engineering, motivated by contributing to software solutions that enhance safety through advanced technology. You thrive in complex and specialized environments and maintain a structured, composed approach in fast-paced and demanding situations. With strong communication and leadership capabilities, you are able to lead the test effort effectively while promoting collaboration across teams.
We are an international company representing world-class expertise, delivering complex and high-tech products. We value our colleagues and our meaningful contributions to securing people through advanced technology. You will also experience that we have a strong focus on your development, teaching you useful new competences and further strengthening current ones, both professionally and personally. Our company culture is autonomous and engaging, and we acknowledge the importance of flexibility in a great working environment.
When joining Terma, we promise that you will experience: Great people, challenging tasks, world-class expertise, and meaningful contribution in your daily work.

At Terma, we prioritize the well-being of our employees, ensuring they are well taken care of. Joining our team comes with a multitude of perks designed to enhance your social life, cultural experiences, and health.
 
International Environment: Explore great teamwork and professional sparring with colleagues around the world.

If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, influencing multidisciplinary teams, and continuously improving the way engineering is performed - this could be the right opportunity for you.

Therefore, we are looking for Systems Engineer to become part of this journey and contribute to our overall purpose – securing people through advanced technology.
 
Your role as part of the team
As a Systems Engineer within Maritime Projects, you will play a key role in defining technical solutions for some of our advanced defense systems. You will take ownership of technical decisions within assigned system areas while ensuring alignment with the overall system architecture. Throughout the product lifecycle, from early concept and proposal work to development, integration, verification, and customer delivery, you will drive systems engineering activities and help shape the best overall solutions.

Technical skills matter, but your mindset matters even more. If you combine strong technical capabilities with curiosity and a modern systems engineering mindset, you could be a great addition to our team. You thrive when collaborating across disciplines, can simplify complexity and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and know when to focus on details while maintaining a system-level perspective. Most importantly, you are motivated by finding the best solution for the complete system rather than a single discipline.
 
How you will make a meaningful contribution
In this role, you will contribute to a range of tasks across your area of responsibility. Your key responsibilities include:
·         Translating customer needs into clear, robust, and achievable technical solutions and identifying technical risks, assumptions, and dependencies early
·         Collaborating across engineering disciplines and stakeholders to ensure integrated system designs
·         Acting as technical owner for one or more system areas, ensuring technical consistency across software, hardware and operational requirements
·         Defining/supporting system architecture, requirements engineering, trade studies, and technical decision-making
·         Contributing to proposal work, engineering estimates, and technical planning
·         Helping improve engineering processes, methods, and collaboration across the organization.
 
Bring your expertise into play

·         Experience within maritime, aerospace, defense, or other safety-critical industries is an advantage, but more important is your ability to understand complex systems and collaborate across disciplines

·         Experience with technical leadership, proposal development, defense standards, Linux, and relevant industry standards such as MIL-STDs is an advantage.
Most importantly, we believe diverse experiences add value to our team and organization. Therefore, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the above requirements.
As we are an international organization, it is important that you are fluent in English both in writing and verbal at a professional level.
 
Let’s secure people through advanced technology
When joining Terma, we promise that you will experience great people, challenging tasks, and opportunities to make an impact on your daily work. Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, and open knowledge sharing, supporting your development along the way. Learning is part of everyday work, supported by colleagues at all stages of their careers – from students just starting out, to colleagues who have been part of Terma for decades.

We are all Terma - diverse in skills and equal in value. That is why we encourage all individuals to apply and are committed to ensuring that every employee has equal opportunities to succeed and feel respected and valued within our organization. jobs.occupation: Associate Consultant, Netcompany Application Services (Swedish speaking)
jobs.description:
At Netcompany, we’re looking for recent graduates with a bachelor’s degree who want a challenging, social, and fast-developing start to their career as an Associate Consultant. Do you want to help build some of Denmark’s most complex and business-critical IT solutions — in a role where software development, project management, and close client collaboration shape your everyday work?

The Associate Consultant role exists across both Application Services and Consulting. The main difference lies in how you work with clients and solutions, and which setup fits your interests best — either a more project-oriented environment (Consulting) or a more long-term, team- and solution-driven setup (Application Services).

Responsibilities & Technologies

As an Associate Consultant, you’ll help translate client needs into the right technical solutions. We use the technologies that best fit the project and the client, so it’s important that you enjoy working with new and varied technologies and domains while continuously developing your skill set.

A large part of our projects are based on web technologies such as Angular or React, combined with Java or C# on Java or .NET platforms. We also work with several enterprise platforms including Microsoft, Salesforce, IBM, Oracle, Adobe, Snowflake, Guidewire, and more.

As an Associate Consultant, you’ll contribute across the full software development lifecycle with a strong technical focus. Your tasks and responsibilities will vary from project to project and evolve over time, but your day-to-day work will typically include:

• Building and developing frameworks and integrations

• Implementing features in the user interface

• Configuring and developing extensions for enterprise platforms

• Automating business processes, for example through batch jobs

• Developing tools and scripts for large-scale data migrations

You’ll join a team with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and areas of expertise — what we all have in common is a strong technical mindset and a shared ambition to build the best possible IT solutions together.

Our projects include some of Denmark’s most innovative and mission-critical IT initiatives across the public and private sectors, meaning you’ll help shape and improve everyday life for a large part of society.

About you

We expect you to hold a bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field. To succeed in this role, you:

• Are a recent graduate or have a few years of experience — the most important thing is your motivation to take your IT career to the next level

• Have solid technical skills within object-oriented programming

• Have a foundational understanding of software development and a strong willingness to grow your competencies

• Think analytically, show initiative, and work in a structured way

• Full professional proficiency in Swedish and English (written and spoken) is a must. As you will be working closely with Danish clients and colleagues, you should be able to communicate and collaborate effectively in a Danish work environment.

Continue your development with us

At Netcompany, we invest heavily in both your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you’ll be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development journey and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure both professional growth and personal well-being, while also giving you insight into the many career paths available as you gain experience.

You’ll also take part in our training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you’ll have access to courses and seminars covering everything from technologies to client management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that the content is highly relevant and directly connected to your professional development. This prepares you for a wide range of responsibilities and continuously strengthens your expertise throughout your career with us.

Become part of an inclusive community

At Netcompany, community matters. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture built on collaboration, trust, and knowledge sharing, where there is always room for sparring and support.

As part of our culture and values, all employees — regardless of background, identity, or experience — are treated with respect and understanding and given equal opportunities to grow and thrive.

You’ll also have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from different cultures and nationalities, as we are an international company with offices across multiple countries.

We offer an environment where collaboration happens across teams and projects, combined with a wide range of social and professional events that help you expand and build your network early in your career.

Apply now

Upload your CV and application through our recruitment system via the link. If you still have questions, feel free to contact us at hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, religion or belief, political opinion, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require adjustments or additional support during the recruitment process, please contact our recruitment team at  reasonableadjustmentsdk@netcompany.com  for assistance.

**Product Management At Dalux – Built On Real Construction Experience

**Dalux continues to grow rapidly, and we're looking for a Product Manager with something particularly important for our Field product: deep knowledge of how construction actually happens on site.

Dalux Field is used every day by contractors, subcontractors, site managers, quality managers, safety professionals, and other construction professionals around the world.

To continue improving these products, we want even more real-world construction experience within our Product organization.

You might already be working in Product Management or construction technology. But you might also currently be a Site Manager, Construction Manager, Project Manager, BIM/VDC Manager, Digital Construction specialist, or similar and be interested in using your industry experience to improve the digital tools used across construction.

For this role, deep construction knowledge and a strong product mindset are more important than previous Product Manager experience.

**Your responsibilities will include:

**

• Product Discovery: Identify and understand problems experienced by construction professionals and turn them into product opportunities.

• Customer Insights: Spend time with customers and users to understand how work is actually performed on construction sites – not just how processes are supposed to work.

• Domain Expertise: Bring practical construction knowledge into Product and Development and challenge assumptions about real-world workflows.

• Feature Ownership: Lead new capabilities from initial problem discovery through development, release, and validation with users.

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with developers, Product Designers, and fellow Product Managers to translate complex construction processes into simple digital experiences.

• Product Prioritization: Balance customer needs, strategic opportunities, technical feasibility, and business impact when deciding what we should build.

• Product Strategy: Help shape the future direction of Dalux Field and identify where technology can fundamentally improve how construction work is performed.

**About You

**Unlike many Product Manager positions, we don't require you to already be an experienced Product Manager .

What we care deeply about is your understanding of construction.

We believe you:

• Have significant practical experience from construction projects, preferably working close to the construction site.

• Understand the everyday workflows of contractors, subcontractors, site managers, and other on-site stakeholders.

• Have experience with areas such as quality assurance, inspections, defects, health & safety, site coordination, documentation, progress, or similar construction processes.

• Understand the difference between how construction processes are designed and how people actually work on site.

• Are passionate about improving construction through digitalization.

• Are curious, analytical, and naturally interested in understanding why problems occur rather than simply accepting existing processes.

• Can communicate effectively with both construction professionals and technically oriented colleagues.

• Are comfortable taking ownership and making decisions.

• Communicate fluently in English, written and spoken.

Previous Product Management or software-development experience is an advantage, but not a requirement.

If you have spent years using construction software and regularly found yourself thinking "surely there must be a better way to do this" , this might be an opportunity to help build that better way.

**What To Expect At Dalux

**At Dalux, you'll join a product-driven company where ideas quickly become reality and where you'll have a direct impact on the products we build.

We offer:

• A collaborative and informal work environment with flat hierarchies

• High ownership, trust, and the freedom to drive initiatives

• Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international team

• A central Copenhagen office, flexible work hours, and no dress code

• Monthly social events and an active community

• Attractive benefits including health insurance, lunch, fitness facilities, and free parking

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

**Ready for the next step?

**We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your resume and application as soon as possible.

**About Dalux

**Founded in 2005, Dalux is a Danish Contech company revolutionizing the construction industry with innovative software built on geometric processing and 3D computer graphics.

Over the past years, we’ve grown by 40% annually and now have over 900 employees across 50+ offices in more than 25 countries. All product development takes place in our Østerbro, Copenhagen office, where we focus on building the future of construction technology. We place great value on our strong social community and close collaboration with colleagues, which is why we primarily work from our Copenhagen location.

**Application deadline:

**As soon as possible

**About The Role

**Would you like to be part of an ambitious Compliance team where you play a key role in ensuring that Saxo meets its regulatory obligations within financial and non-financial risk areas?

If so, this may be the right opportunity for you at Saxo.

You will join the Prudential Oversight team within Group Compliance, Saxo's second line of defence function, based at our headquarters in Hellerup. Our team oversees compliance risks across a broad range of areas, including the financial risk areas of capital, market risk, liquidity and credit risk, as well as non-financial risk areas such as ICT, operational risk, model risk, data governance and strategy, supporting the business in meeting regulatory requirements, market standards and internal policies.

Your primary responsibility will be to conduct compliance oversight and monitoring across the financial risk areas of capital, market risk, liquidity and credit risk as well as non-financial areas such as operational risk, model risk and strategic risks in relation to policies, procedures, segregation of duties, limits, calculations, samples, controls, etc.

However, if you are curious about the other areas covered by the team, we will help you develop your skills and knowledge within these areas.

As a team, we balance professionalism with a sense of humour and maintain an informal atmosphere where people enjoy coming to work.

**Responsibilities

**

• Perform compliance risk assessments

• Provide advice and compliance opinions to the business on managing compliance risks and regulatory requirements

• Conduct compliance monitoring activities

• Contribute to regular compliance reporting to senior management of the bank

• Participate in developing the bank’s compliance framework

• Interact with the business across organisational levels and seniority

**Your profile

**We are looking for a colleague with experience from working with one or more prudential risk areas, who is motivated to develop deeper expertise in these areas.

**Further We Expect You To Have

**

• At least 2 years of relevant experience from the financial sector, preferably within compliance, risk management, audit, finance, credit or another relevant first-line function

• A relevant educational background within economics, finance, accounting, audit or similar

• Interest in prudential risk areas such as capital, liquidity, market risk, credit risk, model risk, strategic risk, operational risk areas, governance, and internal controls

• Familiarity with regulatory requirements such as CRR/CRD, Basel guidelines, EBA/ESMA guidelines, the Executive Order on Management and Control of Banks and other relevant Danish financial regulation is an advantage

Moreover, we are looking for someone who is detail-oriented, can work independently while taking an active role in teamwork and enjoys collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders across the entire organisation.

It is an advantage if you thrive in an environment with constant change, bring a positive and curious mindset to work, and do not buy into the word ‘cannot’.

You must possess strong stakeholder management skills and use your communication skills to ensure positive collaboration and progress in joint tasks. We are looking for a colleague who always brings a positive attitude when liaising with the business.

Please note! International applicants are encouraged to apply. To help us understand your circumstances, we kindly ask candidates currently based outside Denmark to include a brief summary of their relocation plans and expected timeframe for relocating to Denmark.

**We get curious people invested in the world

**When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

**How To Apply

**Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

jobs.description:
**Who We Are

**Oliver Wyman is a global management consulting firm. We work with clients through their most defining moments, combining deep industry knowledge, specialized expertise, and the power of perspective to help them adapt, grow, and thrive.

We believe diverse perspectives make the work stronger. Our consultants bring different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking to help solve complex problems and create lasting impact for clients, colleagues, and communities.

At Oliver Wyman, we are proud of the values that we aspire to live by. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

**What You Will Do

You’ll help teams understand client strategic challenges while helping develop the next generation of consultants.

**You will:

**

• Frame hypotheses, identify key business questions, and direct quantitative and qualitative research to generate insights.

• Apply structured problem-solving and analytical thinking to solve complex business issues.

• Develop high-quality client deliverables, including presentations, analysis, workshops, models, and discussions that help move projects forward.

• You’ll have the opportunity to work across our industries and capabilities, with the flexibility to specialize early or explore different areas before choosing a path.

• You’ll likely have the chance to travel within your home market and internationally. No two weeks are ever the same.

• Manage and coach junior team members, fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performing team environment.

• Build trusted relationships with clients through clear communication and effective stakeholder management.

**Why join us?

****You can be your best here

**At Oliver Wyman, you will find meaningful work, talented people, and a culture built on trust, support, and growth.

**Create solutions that have impact

**

• Work on challenging projects that help clients solve complex problems, make better decisions, and create meaningful impact.

• Have the opportunity to work across different industries, capabilities, and cultures, contributing to work that has lasting impact for clients, industries, and society.

• Be part of teams that measure success not just by deliverables, but by the difference created together.

**Develop as a leader

**

• Lead workstreams and develop expertise that colleagues and clients seek out.

• Mentor junior consultants while continuing to build your own leadership capabilities.

• Take ownership of client relationships and increasingly complex engagements.

**Learn and grow without limits

**

• Continue developing specialized expertise through challenging projects and formal learning opportunities.

• Collaborate with industry specialists and global experts across Oliver Wyman.

• Build a sustainable career supported by coaching, mentoring, and continuous professional development.

• You’ll have support around you as you grow, including a dedicated buddy, a career advisor, your talent manager, and communities that help you find your place.

**Thrive in a vibrant and inclusive culture

**

• Work with genuine colleagues who stand by their beliefs, collaborate across differences, and support one another.

• Be part of an open, inclusive, and down-to-earth culture where diverse perspectives strengthen the work.

• Connect with colleagues through employee resource groups, office communities, and social activities.

**Experience Rewards That Work For You

**

• We believe in flexibility, including hybrid working, and in helping colleagues build sustainable careers.

• Over time, you’ll have access to opportunities, programs, and experiences designed to help you perform, grow, and thrive — including non-profit fellowships, sabbaticals, and externships.

• Enjoy competitive local benefits designed to support your well-being, development, and life outside of work.

**Who can apply?

**We are looking for top-performing professionals who are passionate about solving complex business problems, enjoy developing high-impact content, and are excited to build a long-term career at a leading strategy consulting firm characterized by sustained double-digit growth, an entrepreneurial spirit, and a strong focus on culture and career sustainability.

**Required Qualifications

**

• 3+ years of relevant experience in a top-tier strategy consulting firm.

• Experience serving clients within Banking and Financial Services, Finance and Risk, Restucturing, Insurance, Logistic, is highly advantageous.

• Undergraduate or advanced degree in STEM, Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline from a leading university.

• Outstanding analytical and quantitative problem-solving capabilities with the ability to structure ambiguous business problems.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively across different audiences and seniority levels.

• Demonstrated experience working collaboratively in cross-functional, fast-paced environments.

• Proven ability to deliver results under pressure while managing multiple priorities.

• Fluent business English and another Scandinavian language

• Willingness to travel internationally as client needs require.

**Nice to have

**

• Data analytics, advanced quantitative modelling, or data science capabilities.

• CFA or equivalent professional certification.

• MBA or Master's degree from a top-tier university.

**What we're looking for?

**Successful candidates demonstrate:

• Intellectual curiosity and structured problem solving.

• Strong ownership and accountability.

• Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

• An inclusive leadership style and commitment to developing others.

• Adaptability, resilience, and entrepreneurial thinking.

• A collaborative mindset with the ability to work respectfully across diverse teams and cultures.

**How to apply?

**Please submit your CV, cover letter, and academic transcripts. If you would like to find out more information about Oliver Wyman, please visit our website.

**What to expect during the interviews process?

**At Oliver Wyman, we want you to shine in your interview. Our process is designed like our work environment — it’s challenging, exciting, and fun.

With a mix of conversational and case interviews, our approach not only helps us to get to know you better, understanding your strengths and interests, but it also enables you to learn more about our people and our business..

Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is looking for a technically qualified and commercially focused Key Account Manager for its sales of high quality cast iron solutions.

THE POSITION

In order to consolidate and expand our sales activities, we need to strengthen our sales team by recruiting a qualified Key Account Manager.

You will be given responsibility for strategically important customers, all of which are market-leading OEMs or system providers, including those in the truck sector. Your role will be to expand and enhance the sales turnover among existing customers, while at the same time cultivating new customer relationships. A significant part of the role also involves making sustained efforts to secure up-to-date framework agreements and contracts in addition to communicating customer requirements and expectations.

The sales process consists of offering to produce the customers’ cast iron components. Once the items are being produced, the sales work will involve continuously negotiating and adjusting the sales prices of the individual components, as well as negotiating and maintaining other commercial conditions. These conditions include packaging, logistics solutions, framework agreements for quality and delivery, and aftermarket terms.

Your normal working day will vary from administrative tasks at the office in Holstebro, where you will work closely with Production, the Production Engineering Department (PED), Business Controlling and other company stakeholders. You will also be responsible for planning and conducting your external customer visits, primarily in Europe where you can expect up to around 50 days’ travelling per year. You will also help with and prepare data and presentations for sales meetings and trade fair attendance, as well as continuously reporting to Sales Management.

As part of a cross-organisational partnership, you will familiarise yourself with the customers’ projects and thus become the most important link of the contact between the customer and your colleagues across the entire organisation.

When out visiting customers with a view to sales, you will always have a ‘One Stop Shop’ cast iron solution to call upon. By this, we mean that BIRN is able to cast, machine, assemble and surface-treat the products so that they can be delivered directly to the customer’s production line or application without further processing. This is both efficient and sustainable.

Are you looking to combine your technical curiosity and skills with a strategic responsibility for sales and long-term customer relationships in an international industrial group? If so, you may be the person we are looking for as a Key Account Manager.

YOUR DUTIES

You will be given a central role in the sales organisation, with your work including the following:

·       Responsibility for and the continued development of a portfolio of four to six major strategic customers in Europe, primarily in Scandinavia. You will be responsible for a turnover of at least € 25 million

·       Building up long-term relationships with the customers’ stakeholders in the fields of purchasing, development, quality and logistics

·       Technical and commercial advice during the customers’ development and project phases

·       Planning and conducting customer visits, contract and price negotiations and major framework agreements

·       Ongoing budget monitoring, forecasts and sales reports at customer level

·       Searching for, analysing and developing new customer potentials and market segments

·       Close internal collaboration with production engineering, quality, controlling and finance

·       Participation in sales and strategy activities across the organisation

The position involves some travel, primarily in Europe.

QUALIFICATIONS

We expect you to have the following:

·       Extensive advanced technical training/experience, ideally supplemented with commercial skills, e.g. engineer, marine engineer or equivalent. A skilled trade background, supplemented by commercial training or experience, is another option

·       Experience of technical sales, project sales or Key Account Management; alternatively, you will have been recently trained and have the right level of drive. The start date will be adapted to suit the right candidate

·       The ability to thrive in an outward-facing role with extensive customer contact, and to plan your day-to-day work independently

·       The ability to work in a structured manner on CRM, budgets, documentation and monitoring. You will need to be skilled in using digital tools, for processing both text and numbers

·       The ability to communicate without difficulty in English and, preferably, also in Danish – and, ideally, in the other Scandinavian languages

·       The technical flair and ability to get to grips with the customers’ business and applications

·       A passenger car driving licence and a valid passport with no travel restrictions

At a personal level, you will be skilled in relationships, persistent and curious, with the motivation to create value through collaboration based on trust and a high level of professionalism.

WHAT WE OFFER

You will become part of Vald. BIRN A/S, a solid and internationally represented industrial enterprise with strong values and a high degree of professionalism. In addition, you will receive:

·       A central, independent role with a high level of influence on customers, sales and commercial development

·       A strong professional environment with close collaboration across the Group

·       Thorough on-boarding and training in products, markets and the organisation

·       Good opportunities for both professional and personal development

·       Attractive terms and conditions of employment, including a pension scheme and health insurance

·       A good canteen scheme and active staff association

·       An informal work environment that focuses on well-being, responsibility and sustainability

ABOUT THE BIRN GROUP

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is the Group Headquarters of one of Northern Europe’s largest foundry Groups. We supply highly processed cast iron components to the truck industry and others, as well as industrial hydraulics and machine components. Sustainability, the circular economy and responsibility are integral parts of our DNA. The Group employs around 750 staff, of which around 480 are in Holstebro.

APPLICATIONS

If you have any questions about the position or the BIRN Group, please feel free to contact Group CSO Peter Frost Jepsen on tel. +45 3016 0160 or Group HR Manager Morten Madsen on tel. +45 3016 0115.

Please note that we are processing applications on a continuous basis and will close the position once we have found the right candidate. As mentioned above, the start date can be adjusted to suit the right candidate. Please submit your application via our recruitment system, which you will find at [insert link]. Candidates who proceed to a second interview can expect to complete a personality profile as part of the process.

We would encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity or age, to apply for the position.

RØGHUS is looking for an organized and reliable Kitchen Manager to join our growing team in Flyverbyen, Amager.

ABOUT RØGHUS

RØGHUS is a Danish catering and food truck company with a love for food made with smoke and fire.

We are best known for traditional American BBQ and authentic Mexican-inspired food, but most importantly, we believe in making great food from scratch, using quality ingredients and taking pride in the craft behind everything we serve.

For us, RØGHUS is about more than food. It is about hospitality, creating great experiences and treating customers, colleagues and partners with respect. We are an ambitious company, but we also want RØGHUS to be a place where people enjoy coming to work and feel responsible for what we create together.

Currently, our business consists of catering and our food truck, and we are looking for the right person to take responsibility for the day-to-day organization of our kitchen.

As our Kitchen Manager, you will be responsible for keeping the kitchen organized and running smoothly.

• 
Overall organization of the kitchen

• 
Cleaning routines and making sure our hygiene standards are maintained

• 
Staff scheduling

• 
General kitchen maintenance and keeping equipment and work areas in good condition

• 
Purchasing and ordering ingredients, supplies and other necessary goods

• 
Keeping track of stock and helping ensure that we have what we need for upcoming catering jobs and food truck events

• 
Helping create structure and good routines in a growing company

• 
Working closely with the rest of the RØGHUS team

Previous experience from a professional kitchen or a similar position is appreciated, but it is not a requirement.

Position: Kitchen Manager

We look forward to hearing from you — and hopefully welcoming you to RØGHUS.

jobs.occupation: Carbon flux and particle export along the land-ocean continuum in Greenland’s coastal ocean
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Ecoscience programme. The position is available from 01 February 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Research area and project description:

Applications are invited for a PhD fellowship within the Center for Ice-Free Arctic Research (CIFAR) and the Department of Ecoscience at Aarhus University.

Rapid warming is increasing freshwater inputs to the Arctic Ocean from melting glaciers, ice sheets, and altered precipitation patterns. Additionally, sea ice cover is rapidly declining. These changes are transforming the structure and functioning of the Arctic coastal ocean. CIFAR aims to understand how the complex interplay between ice melt, terrestrial runoff, and changing ocean conditions affects Arctic coastal ecosystems and their functioning across spatial and temporal scales.

Fjord systems are a critical interface between the cryosphere, the terrestrial environment and the coastal ocean. They act as important sites of carbon transformation, burial and export, yet we still have a limited understanding of how ongoing freshening will influence these processes. Increasing terrestrial runoff delivers large quantities of particles, minerals and organic carbon to coastal waters, while simultaneously altering water-column structure, particle synamics, and marine primary production.

The overall aim of this PhD project will be to determine how carbon is transformed and transported along the land-ocean continuum in Greenland fjords, and how changes in freshwater inputs influence carbon fluxes and particle export in coastal waters.

The project will investigate interactions between terrestrial organic carbon, marine-produced carbon and mineral particles, with a particular focus on understanding which components of the carbon pool are retained, transformed or exported from the water column. Although much of the terrestrial carbon entering Greenland's coastal systems is transported in particulate form, freshwater runoff also supplies dissolved organic carbon that can be highly bioavailable and rapidly processed within coastal ecosystems. Understanding the fate of these different carbon pools is therefore essential for predicting how Greenland's coastal carbon cycle may respond to continued freshening.

The student will have the opportunity to combine field observations from Greenland with laboratory and analytical approaches to investigate the sources, composition, transformation and export of carbon and particles. The precise scientific focus will be developed together with the student and the wider CIFAR research team.

Qualifications and specific competences:

Applicants to the PhD position must hold a master’s degree and have demonstrated interest and background in biogeochemistry, for example through a bachelor’s or master’s thesis, research project, internship, or other relevant research experience.

• Skills in data analysis and programming, using R, Python, or other relevant programming languages and analytical tools.

• Ability and willingness to work collaboratively within an interdisciplinary and international research environment.

• Good written and oral communication skills in English.

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be an advantage, but is not required:

• Marine or aquatic biogeochemistry

• Organic carbon analyses

• Particle dynamics, sedimentation or particle export

• Geochemical or stable-isotope approaches

• Processing and analysis of environmental or oceanographic datasets

• Fieldwork in marine, coastal or Arctic environments

We particularly encourage applications from candidates who are scientifically curious and interested in developing their own ideas within the broader aims of the project.

Place of employment and place of work:

The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is C.F. Møllers Alle 3, 8000 Aarhus and Frederiksborgvej 399, 4000 Roskilde; Denmark.

Contacts:

Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:

• Christian Lønborg, c.lonborg@ecos.au.dk (main supervisor)

• Johnna Marchiano Holding, johnna@ecos.au.dk (co-supervisor)

For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:

• admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk

How to apply:

Application deadline is 01 December 2026 at 23:59 CET.

Preferred starting date is 01 February 2027

Please make a project description (½-4 pages). The project description should describe your ideas and research plans for this specific project. If you wish to, you can indicate an URL where further information can be found.

Please note:

• Only documents received prior to the application deadline will be evaluated. Thus, documents sent after deadline will not be considered.

• The programme committee may request further information or invite the applicant to attend an interview.

• Shortlisting will be used, which means that the evaluation committee only will evaluate the most relevant applications.

Formalities and salary range

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Are you passionate about building software that powers real-world manufacturing and drives the digital transformation of global production? Then join our mission to pioneer smarter water solutions that reduce energy use and improve lives.

As our new Full-Stack Software Developer, you'll be designing, developing, and maintaining full-stack applications for Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) that support critical production processes across Grundfos's global manufacturing sites. You'll be part of a diverse, supportive and inclusive culture, that celebrates our differences and puts people first by fostering growth, well-being, and a sense of belonging.

What you will be doing

As a key part of the Manufacturing IT team, you'll create impact by building scalable, integrated software solutions that connect enterprise systems with shop-floor operations, enabling smarter and more efficient production worldwide.

Your main responsibilities include:

• Design, develop, and deploy full-stack applications using .NET, C#, React, and MS SQL on local servers or Azure Cloud services

• Build APIs and backend services for system integration, including SAP and shop-floor automation equipment using industrial protocols such as OPC UA

• Collaborate with production engineering, IT, and infrastructure stakeholders to translate business needs into reliable, maintainable software solutions

• Maintain and enhance CI/CD pipelines and automation scripts for build, test, and deployment workflows

• Ensure code quality through peer reviews, unit/integration testing, and adherence to coding standards within an agile SCRUM team

• Provide mentorship and technical guidance to associate developers while contributing to architectural discussions and continuous improvement

What makes you a great fit

Above all, you're a skilled full-stack developer with strong .NET and React experience, a solid grasp of system integration patterns, and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical peers and domain experts in a fast-paced agile environment.

We'd also imagine that you are/have:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field

• 3+ years of full-stack development experience with .NET, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and MS SQL

• Solid understanding of software engineering principles and patterns (e.g., SOLID), RESTful APIs, and web application frameworks

• Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and scripting (e.g., PowerShell)

It's a plus if you also:

• Experience with Siemens Opcenter Discrete MES platform development and configuration

• Familiarity with ERP systems (especially SAP) and/or shop-floor integration using industrial protocols (OPC UA, MQTT)

• Experience with Azure Cloud services and containerized deployments

Why you'll love working here

Day to day, you can look forward to:

• A working environment built around your needs, with flexible hours, home working opportunities and parental support.

• Annual bonuses, health insurance and a strong focus on well-being activities.

• Three days' additional paid leave for volunteering.

• On-demand training and structured development programmes to support your growth.

Valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from all abilities, experiences, and backgrounds. As part of our commitment to a safe and compliant hiring process, final candidates may be required to undergo a background check, subject to applicable local laws and regulations.

Join Grundfos, apply today!

About Grundfos

Grundfos is one of the world’s leading water technology companies with more than 19.000 employees in 60+ countries all over the world. Our skills commit us to pioneering solutions to the world’s water and climate challenges and improve the quality of life for people. We dare to do things that others cannot or dare not do, as we believe innovation is not only a business opportunity, but an obligation. And what really matters to us is not short term profit, but the impact we make. By becoming part of our united powerful team, you too can drive this change no matter your role.

An inclusive team

We believe that the key to a work environment, where employees thrive and grow, is our ability to celebrate and value our differences in background, experiences and perspectives. In our recruitment process we welcome all professional people without consideration of age, colour, gender identity, national origin, physical or mental disability, ethnicity or religion.

What Makes Us, Us  Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**Our Accounting team is growing and we are looking for more team members to join. If you are curious, collaborative and enjoy taking initiative this could be a great place to work. You do not need to have all answers from day one. What matters to us is that you are open to learning, willing to try and comfortable to step into new challenges.

At SimCorp, we support some of the largest financial institutions in the world to be successful by simplifying their investments, accounting and operations.

Accounting is a unit within SimCorp’s Product Division which delivers all rules and calculation methods in order to provide our clients with a legally binding subledger for all supported asset classes.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Develop and maintain features in the Accounting product areas.

• Contribute across the entire development lifecycle - from requirements analysis and design to implementation, test automation, documentation, and ongoing support.

• Collaborate closely with teammates, Product Managers, and Architects to deliver high-quality and secure solutions.

• Create, document and maintain test cases and automated tests to cover the features’ acceptance criteria (system, integration, unit etc.)

• Uphold engineering best practices and contribute to continuous improvement.

• Learn deeply about our Accounting domain and understand how our products support customer outcomes.

• Be open to feedback, mentorship, and knowledge sharing in your team.

**Your Skills

**Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learn the rest.

• Confident in software engineering fundamentals, including algorithms and data structures.

• Willingness to learn and work with in-house tools and frameworks, especially the APL programming language.

• Proficiency in at least one object-oriented or functional programming language (C# is a benefit).

• Familiarity with modern engineering tools and practices, including CI/CD and trunk-based development.

• Experience working with relational databases and SQL.

• Readiness to work in a complex accounting domain, dealing with financial and investment-related instruments.

• Good English skills (upper-intermediate or higher), both written and spoken.

• Experience with cloud technologies and fintech domain is a plus.

**What Is It Like To Work Here

**SimCorp plans work in an agile manner, using 4 planning intervals (PI’s) per year, each consisting of 5 sprints of 2 weeks each, followed by a 3-week Innovation and Planning sprint, which can be used for mastering skills in various areas, or more freely investigating ideas with prototypes. It is important that our people learn and grow constantly, and SimCorp invests a lot to foster the continuous learning environment to support people on their journeys.

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

**Benefits

**An attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential components of any employment package. At SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. In addition to the traditional benefits, we promote an effective work-life balance, including flexible work hours and a hybrid workplace model. As a large organization, we offer a wide range of career opportunities, with an individualized approach to professional development to support the career path you wish to pursue.

**NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible. We process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.** At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
