• Specifying, searching and implementing of new advanced equipment.

• Modelling and statistical analysis using tools such as Python, T-SQL, JMP, VBA and LabVIEW

Depending on your particular skills the role could include responsibility for one of our semiconductor production equipments or processes (e.g. SEM, ICP, AFM, wafer dicing, bonding, DUV Lithography)

What you bring

We are looking for someone who is both technically strong and a great team player. That is:

• Hands-on experience in nanofabrication, free-space optics or automating workflows or processes.

• A deep curiosity and problem-solving mindset regarding process development and optimization.

• A proactive and determined attitude – you take initiative and drive projects forward.

• A structured and analytical approach to troubleshooting and quality assurance.

• A collaborative mindset – you thrive in a diverse, international environment and value teamwork.

• Strong communication skills – fluency in English is required, as well as willingness to learn Danish.

Ideally you also have

• An understanding of volume production.

• Experience with statistical modelling.

• Some project management experience.

What we offer

• A workplace where your ideas matter – and where you will see them come to life

• A culture where everyone contributes to a shared goal – and takes pride in the result

• A friendly, respectful work environment with regular social events

• Flexible working hours

• Competitive salary and benefits (details can be discussed during the interview)

Ready to make a difference?

If you believe you are the right candidate for the position, please click ‘Apply for this position’ below to send your CV and cover letter. We are looking to recruit as soon as possible but will keep the positions open until we have found the right candidates. If you want more information about the positions, please call Lars Bo Madsen on +45 6079 0130 or email lbm@ibsen.com.

We look forward to welcoming you to our team!

About Ibsen Photonics

Ibsen’s core technology is optical transmission gratings and grating based spectrometers, which we design, manufacture and supply to customers worldwide. Our spectrometers find their way into medical devices and scientific instruments used in sustainable energy, industrial, pharmaceutical, life sciences, security, and many other applications.

We work closely with our customers to create value adding solutions, sharing our extensive technical knowledge in an open and honest work environment with a flat “Scandinavian” hierarchical structure.

You will join a rapidly growing company employing 85 people at our facility just north of Copenhagen, and realising a turnover of more than 150 MDKK in 2023. We work actively with the UN’s Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and strive to make our business fully sustainable.

Ibsen Photonics is majority owned N. Foss & Co. A/S, a world leader in analytical solutions for the agricultural industry, with an annual turnover of 2.5 Billion DKK and more than 1.800 employees.

jobs.occupation: Specialistläkare/överläkare inom kardiologi till Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital i Slagelse, Danmark
jobs.description:
Om du är på jakt för nya utmaningar på jobbet och funderar på att jobba i Danmark är kardiologen på Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital i Slagelse ett självklart val.

Här kan du vara med och påverka framtidens hjärtmedicin och samtidigt få möjlighet att utveckla och leda ditt eget specialområde.

På hjärtmedicinska avdelningen (Medicin 2) kommer du som specialistläkare att spela en central roll för den kliniska verksamheten och yrkesområdets utveckling. Du kommer att arbeta i nära samarbete med avdelningens övriga specialistläkare, chefer och andra professioner för att skapa smidiga och sammanhängande patientförlopp.

Yrkesmässiga utmaningar och ett flexibelt arbetsliv

Som specialistläkare hos oss får du inte bara en tjänst. Du får möjlighet att styra inriktningen inom ett eller flera specialområden, om du har ambitionen och intresset för det.

Du får

• möjlighet att ta ansvar för och utveckla ett helt eget specialområde inom exempelvis ischemi, arytmi, hjärtklaffssjukdomar eller bilddiagnostik i form av ekokardiografi, hjärt-CT och hjärt-MR

• möjlighet att delta i forskningen vid avdelningen

• möjlighet att ingå i en högspecialiserad miljö med engagerade kollegor

• ett nära samarbete med övriga professioner och en hög grad av kollegialt utbyte.

Dessutom kan vi anpassa tjänsten så att den passar dina behov. På Medicin 2 lägger vi stor vikt vid att skapa balans mellan arbete och fritid, och vi prioriterar stort inflytande och ansvar.

Om dig

Vi tror att du

• är specialistläkare i kardiologi, eller är på väg att bli det

• fokuserar på att utveckla vårdkvaliteten och förbättra patientförloppet

• trivs i en miljö där man både för ett nära samarbete och arbetar självständigt

• bidrar till en aktiv och god arbetsmiljö

• har ett intresse för kvalitet, utbildning och eventuellt forskning

• kommunicerar öppet och konstruktivt.

Om oss

Vår avdelning bedriver verksamhet i två olika lokaler i Næstved respektive Slagelse, som ligger 30 km från varandra.

I Slagelse består avdelningen av två vårdavdelningar med 24 respektive 20 sängplatser. Därutöver har vi en hjärtmottagning samt det vårdmässiga ansvaret för en hormonmottagning.

I Næstved består avdelningen av ett trombos- och koagulationscentrum, en hjärtmottagning samt det vårdmässiga ansvaret för en hormonmottagning. Utöver detta rymmer lokalerna även ett diagnostiskt centrum.

Vi är för närvarande 12 specialistläkare inom kardiologi samt specialistläkare inom avdelningens övriga specialistfunktioner.

Vi ansvarar för undervisningen av medicinstudenter från Köpenhamns universitet.

Därför ska du välja Midt- och Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- och Vestsjællands Hospital fokuserar vi på yrkeskompetens, samarbete mellan professioner, kvalitet, utbildning och forskning.

Specialister spelar en central roll både för den kliniska verksamheten och för den ämnesspecifika utvecklingen, och du blir en del av en miljö med hög grad av specialisering, tydliga ambitioner och goda möjligheter att påverka utvecklingen inom ditt specialistområde.

Vi erbjuder en arbetsplats där fokus ligger på vårdkvalitet, kontinuitet i patientförloppet och förutsättningar som främjar såväl kliniskt arbete som utbildning och forskning.

Din huvudsakliga arbetsplats kommer att vara i Slagelse som har goda transportförbindelser med bland annat Odense, Köpenhamn och övriga Själland.

Är du redo för nästa steg?

Vill du vara med och utveckla kardiologin på Midt- og Vestsjælland? Då ser vi gärna att du hör av dig.

Mer information

Om du vill ha mer information om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta tillförordnad chefsläkare Roman Sykulski på tel. +45 56 51 41 34 eller chefsjuksköterska Camilla Vest på tel. +45 93 56 84 89.

Villkor, lön och anställning

Du kommer att ingå i ett jourteam med bakjoursansvar från ditt eget hem i egenskap av överläkare och ha jour utanför arbetsplatsen i egenskap av specialistläkare.

Vi har omfattande erfarenhet av att hitta flexibla lösningar som möjliggör ett hållbart arbetsliv, så kontakta oss gärna för ett förutsättningslöst samtal om vilka möjligheter som finns.

Den professionella bedömningen av sökanden kommer att baseras på sökandens uppgifter om sina egna kompetenser i förhållande till de sju läkartjänsterna. Om du söker en tjänst som överläkare kommer en professionell bedömning att genomföras som kommer att vara avgörande för din kvalifikation som överläkare.

Anställningen sker enligt avtalet mellan Danske Regioner och YL/Overlægeforeningen, beroende på vilken tjänst som söks, och är villkorad med att det finns en tillfredsställande børneattest (utdrag ur belastningsregistret som visar om en person dömts för sexualbrott mot barn under 15 år).

Vi önskar tillsätta tjänsten senast eller enligt överenskommelse.

Hjälp med flytt och undervisning i danska

Om du vill flytta till Danmark i samband med anställningen erbjuder vi kostnadsfri, professionell hjälp med flytt och bosättning nära sjukhuset eller eventuellt i Köpenhamn. Du får hjälp med allt från att hitta boende till registrering och eventuella medföljande familjemedlemmar.

En viktig del av arbetet som specialistläkare är kommunikationen mellan läkare och patient. För patientsäkerhetens skull kräver därför Region Sjælland att våra specialistläkare ska ha kunskaper i danska språket på en tillfredsställande nivå. Vi tillhandahåller därför en språklärare för privatundervisning så att du så snabbt som möjligt kan kommunicera med dina patienter på en nivå där ni förstår varandra.

Det innebär att vi förväntar oss att du är inställd på att lägga tid på att lära dig danska, både i tal och skrift.

Se mer om vad vi erbjuder i form av hjälp här

Rekryteringsprocessen

När vi har mottagit din ansökan kommer vi att bedöma om dina kvalifikationer matchar det vi söker, och du kommer initialt att bjudas in till en intervju via Teams. Om båda parter är intresserade av att fortsätta dialogen kommer du att bjudas in till ett rekryteringssamtal på sjukhuset, där du får träffa avdelningens ledning och personal samt vår HR- och språkkonsult.

Ansökningstid

Vi kommer att granska ansökningarna till tjänsten löpande, så vänta inte för länge med att ansöka.

Verksamhetsområde

Den 1 januari 2027 slås Region Själland och Region Hovedstaden samman och bildar Region Østdanmark till följd av sjukvårdsreformen. Ditt verksamhetsområde kommer att vara Region Østdanmark, inklusive alla tillhörande organisatoriska enheter.

Läs mer om vad verksamhetsområdet innebär på Region Østdanmarks webbplats.

Om Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital arbetar vi varje dag för att främja ett hälsosamt liv genom förebyggande åtgärder och behandling inom ramen för en samordnad hälso- och sjukvårdsinsats. Som sjukhus förenar vi psykiatri och somatik. Vårt mål är att patienter och medborgare ska få bra och trygg vård av hög kvalitet.

Som medarbetare blir du en del av ett innovativt, kompetent och organisatoriskt stabilt sjukhus där vi gör skillnad för de människor som behöver oss. Lärande och utveckling är en del av vardagen och sker i professionella sammanhang med ett gemensamt ansvar. Det sker även mellan olika avdelningar.

Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital betjänar ett upptagningsområde med cirka 230 000 invånare. Vi har 766 vårdplatser och cirka 5 000 anställda fördelade på 20 avdelningar, däribland 16 somatiska och psykiatriska avdelningar.

Vi erbjuder en gedigen forskningsmiljö med 13 professorer och en stark yrkesmässig utbildningsmiljö, där vi varje år välkomnar cirka 2 700 studenter, elever och läkare som deltar i vidareutbildning.

Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.

Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.

Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital arbejder vi hver dag for at fremme det sunde liv ved at forebygge og behandle i en sammenhængende sundhedsindsats. Som hospital forener vi psykiatri og somatik. Vores mål er, at patienter og borgere oplever gode og trygge forløb af høj kvalitet.

Som medarbejder bliver du en del af et nytænkende, fagligt og organisatorisk robust hospital, hvor vi gør en forskel for de mennesker, der har brug for os. Læring og udvikling er en del af hverdagen og sker i fagligt forpligtende fællesskaber. Også på tværs af afdelinger.

Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital dækker et opland på ca. 230.000 borgere. Vi har 766 sengepladser og er omkring 5.000 ansatte fordelt på 20 afdelinger, herunder 16 somatiske og psykiatriske specialer.

Vi tilbyder et solidt forskningsmiljø med 13 professorer og et stærkt fagligt uddannelsesmiljø, hvor vi hvert år byder cirka 2.700 studerende, elever og læger i videreuddannelsesforløb velkommen.

Oplysninger om lønniveau kommer fra kapa.ai

Oplysninger om dette lønniveau kommer fra kapa.ai. Din faktiske løn vil være baseret på dine kompetencer og din erfaring – tal med din rekrutteringskonsulent for at høre mere.

Grundlønsniveau

100.000,00 US$/år - 150.000,00 US$/år

Kapa makes technical knowledge instantly accessible through AI assistants. As a software engineer you will work across the stack on the Kapa systems that answer thousands of developer questions per day. Check out Docker’s documentation (https://docs.docker.com) for a live example of what Kapa is (look for the “Ask AI” button).

**In This Role, You Will

**

• 
Work directly with the founding team and our research engineers.

• 
Scale the infrastructure that powers the Kapa RAG engine (Python).

• 
Experiment with new features in the Kapa analytics platform (React + Python).

• 
Work on the client integrations which are used to deploy Kapa for our customers (React + Python).

• 
Give Kapa access to new kinds of data (Python).

• 
Maintain our React SDK.

**You May Be a Good Fit If You Have

**

• 
A degree in computer science, machine learning, mathematics, statistics or a related field.

• 
3+ years of software engineering experience working on complex systems in both backend and frontend.

• 
An affinity for machine learning, deep learning (including LLMs) and natural language processing.

• 
The ability to work effectively in a fast in a environment where things are sometimes loosely defined.

• 
This is neither an exhaustive nor necessary set of attributes. Even if none of these apply to you, but you believe you will contribute to kapa.ai, please reach out.

jobs.occupation: Project Manager for strategic property projects
jobs.description:
Project Manager for strategic property projects

Would you like to use your project management expertise to deliver property projects that make a difference?

Copenhagen Contractors A/S is a Danish company operating internationally. We value agility, teamwork and a flat organisational structure in which employees take initiative and adopt a hands-on approach. We are looking for a Project Manager to support the planning, management and delivery of projects across national and international markets.

Copenhagen Contractors A/S is a subsidiary of Copenhagen Group A/S. The company operates within the defense sector and delivers complex projects and turnkey solutions for major national and international clients, including the United Nations and the Danish Armed Forces.

We are currently working on several property development projects, with further projects in the pipeline. You will primarily be involved in national projects, with occasional international assignments, while being based at our headquarters in Nordhavn, Copenhagen.**

About the role**

You will become a key member of a newly established Real Estate department within a well-established company. The department will consist of approximately four colleagues: you, the Head of Real Estate, an Architect and a Project Developer.

You will work on a diverse range of projects, ranging in size from approximately 300 to 15,000 m². These include defense-related developments, offices, residential projects and water-related construction projects. We work with temporary, semi-permanent and permanent structures, although the majority of our projects involve permanent construction.

As Project Manager, you will be responsible for driving projects from initial ideas and concepts through planning, pricing, design and construction to final delivery. You will coordinate internal and external stakeholders and help ensure that projects are delivered in accordance with agreed objectives, timelines, budgets and quality requirements.

We believe in short decision-making processes. You will therefore experience a high degree of autonomy and minimal unnecessary administration. In return, we expect you to take initiative, demonstrate ownership, and have the confidence and ability to make decisions and drive projects forward.**

Your profile**

We imagine that you:

• Have +5 years of experience within project and construction management.

• Have a practical understanding of the construction process and appreciate the relationship between functionality, buildability, quality and cost.

• Are structured, pragmatic and solution-oriented and are comfortable coordinating consultants, contractors and other project stakeholders.

• Have a strong network among consultants and main contactors in the Danish market.

• Are motivated by autonomy, responsibility and the opportunity to influence projects rather than by rigid processes and traditional management structures.

• Have an entrepreneurial approach and enjoy taking initiative, making decisions and assuming responsibility for new areas.

• Are fluent in both Danish and English, in writing and in speech. English is the company’s official working language.

Could this be your next opportunity?

You can submit your application through our website, and if you would like to learn more about the role, you are always welcome to contact:

**Head of Real Estate

Lars Bramsen

**Phone: +45 2116 8959

Email: labr@cphgroup.com

Job Description

Would you like to be part of exciting and challenging projects within the IT world? Do you dream of having the opportunity to contribute to some of Denmark’s most business-critical IT solutions? Then we have the ideal student job for you.

At Netcompany, we are looking for a student who wants to take part in our innovative projects. Here, you will have the chance to influence our solutions while working alongside some of the industry’s most skilled colleagues, who will inspire you and support your learning.

Responsibilities and technologies

As a student assistant with us, you will be given responsibility from day one and become an important part of one of our teams. You will experience how your work directly contributes and creates value in the solutions we deliver to our clients. A student position with us gives you the opportunity to take on challenging tasks on equal footing with our full-time consultants.

We follow a well-established methodology from identifying client needs to implementing and rolling out solutions. You will therefore gain hands-on experience with developing IT systems from start to finish. You will primarily work on IT solutions and service-oriented architectures based on .NET and Java technologies, typically within maintenance, development and testing. The role provides the opportunity to put many of the skills gained during your studies into practice.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Developing functional and technical designs for system components.

• Programming tasks across all layers of the system.

• Configuration and development of extensions for standard platforms.

• Automation of business processes.

About you

We are looking for a student who can work approximately 16 hours per week. We are flexible during exam periods, but availability is expected in the lead-up to project deadlines and other key milestones. To succeed in this role, you:

• Are in the final year of your bachelor’s degree or have started a master’s degree in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field.

• Have some experience with object-oriented programming and familiarity with languages such as C# .NET and/or Java.

• Are highly motivated and eager to develop your skills.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

Retire the ERP

Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our Smart Financial Platform gives modern, global companies superpowers - automated accounting, real-time reporting, and financial flows that move at the speed of the business.

We build with our customers, ship fast, and obsess over craft. In a short time, Light has gone from idea to the operating core for leading companies like Lovable, Legora, and Fuse Energy.

We're an early team defining a new software category. Think engineers who love debits and credits, designers who care about reconciliation states, and operators who treat finance as a product. If you're excited to modernise how companies run money, you're in the right place.

Backed by world-class investors including Balderton and Atomico and advised by industry titans, we're building category-defining products with the freedom to ship ambitiously and own outcomes. Come help us make Light the global default for next-gen finance.

About the Role

You'll sit at the heart of our Customer function and work with our most important customers. You’ll make sure they understand the value Light brings them and drive renewals and upsell.

Your customers are Financial Controllers, Finance Directors and CFOs at fast-growing multinational SaaS and tech companies. Senior, technical, time-poor. They expect you to keep up, to tell them straight when something won't work, and to make their team the hero.

We’re a young company, and we’re just starting to renew contracts. In parallel, we’re deploying Agentic Customer Engineers who help our customers make the most of Light. While they re-design customer workflows and deploy agents, you’ll own the stakeholders, the adoption, and the commercial in this motion. There's no set playbook yet. You'll write it, and we'll help.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Own existing customer relationships and drive adoption, renewal and upsell

• 
Ensure that Controllers, Finance Directors, and CFOs see the value Light brings

• 
Make finance the hero - help them do their best work and get recognition for it

• 
Partner two-in-a-box with Agentic Customer Engineers to help customers make the most of Light and our suite of AI agents

• 
Spot an engagement going sideways before the customer does, and fix it

• 
Feed what you learn back into the playbook the team is building

Experience & Qualifications

• 
5+ years owning customers in account management, customer success, consulting, or a commercial delivery role - with outcomes you can point to

• 
You hold your own with a CFO. You can talk multi-entity finance, ROI, and adoption without flinching, and you know when to push back

• 
You've driven adoption and expansion, not just kept accounts warm and sent QBRs

• 
You bring structure to messy, ambiguous engagements - clear plans, sharp prioritisation, and the judgement to know which details matter

• 
You've owned accounts and driven outcomes

• 
You use AI tools daily and have specific opinions on where they help and where they don't

• 
Fluent English; additional European languages a plus

• 
Bonus #1: Finance or accounting background

• 
Bonus #2: Experience in a forward-deployed, solutions-led, or professional-services model focused on renewals and upsell, ideally in the context of AI

You'll probably struggle here if

• 
You need a big support team, a mature playbook, and a manager on call to operate - this is a founding role with limited scaffolding

• 
You can't give a concrete example of telling a senior customer "no" and making it stick

• 
You love the status quo - this job is about change more than maintenance

• 
You've used ChatGPT once and weren't impressed - we go all in on AI at Light

The good stuff

In addition to being part of a great team and working in a really fun and innovative environment, we offer:

💸 A competitive salary + potential stock options

🏝 Generous package of paid annual leave + public holidays

🥳 Regular socials and company off-sites (last time was in Piemonte, next time is in Provence)

🚀 A huge opportunity for career growth as you'll help shape a market-defining motion

The famous last words

Working at Light means you're embarking on an exciting journey to reshape the future of multinational financial operations. Our cheat-code is that we've built something like this before - and are now doing it again, only better. Our goal is to make global finance effortless and empower companies to make informed decisions.

Join the rocket ship while it's taking off 🚀

Light is the new way to run multinational finances for modern technology companies. Run AR, AP, expenses, bookkeeping, and financial reporting automatically across all your entities — without the chaos of multiple systems. Crafted and built by the designers and engineers behind world-class companies like Spotify, X, AWS, Klarna, Google and Shopify, we empower multinational finances with a joyful user experience like no other.

About the job

Chainalysis is the cryptocurrency ghostbusters, pioneering in the blockchain analysis space. Identifying high-risk activities on the blockchain, playing a central role in ensuring cryptocurrencies are used for a legitimate purpose. Ultimately, Chainalysis is building trust in blockchains.

The Chainalysis engineering team solves large scale, technically complex data problems by ingesting, transforming and supporting nearly 1TB of data per day across multiple blockchains serving public and private sectors internationally. Our industry is evolving at a rapid pace and our job is to build a flexible platform that will allow us to adapt accordingly.

Software Engineers are at the epicenter of that mission by building and scaling the data pipelines, infrastructure and applications our customers rely on every day to stop crime, reduce financial risk and prevent financial loss.

In This Role You Will

• Be part of an Student Developer cohort from September 2026 - February 2027, working with a specific team and benefiting from local mentors

• Collaborate with experienced engineers, product managers, and designers to solve real-world problems, features that demystify crypto data, facilitate collaboration between customers in their investigations, improve our data pipelines and workflows, and more

• Develop and deploy high quality code using modern frameworks and technologies within AWS and GCP such as lambdas, Kafka, S3, Java, Typescript, Databricks, etc.

• Debug production issues and participated in a blameless post-mortem process to make our systems stronger

To Achieve Success In This Role You Have

• Customer-centric mindset to ship performant, scalable and well-tested code to production

• A strong sense of urgency and solid working engine

• Computer Science degree (or similar technical degree) in progress with an expected graduation date during 2027

• Demonstrated applications development or data engineering experience from previous internships, work experience, coding/startup competitions, open source contributions or publications

• Participated in code and architecture reviews at internships or open source projects

• Used or been exposed to React/Angular, Kafka, Spring boot and Postgres

• Strong interest in learning about cryptocurrencies from some of the most knowledgeable people in the field

About Chainalysis

Blockchain technology is powering a growing wave of innovation. Businesses and governments around the world are using blockchains to make banking more efficient, connect with their customers, and investigate criminal cases. As adoption of blockchain technology grows, more and more organizations seek access to all this ecosystem has to offer. That’s where Chainalysis comes in. We provide complete knowledge of what’s happening on blockchains through our data, services, and solutions. With Chainalysis, organizations can navigate blockchains safely and with confidence.

You belong here.

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

About the company

Do you want to take a central role in shaping how a high‑tech defense company secures reliability, compliance and world‑class product integrity on a global scale? As the new QHSE Director at Sky Watch, you will own and continuously evolve the company’s Quality and HSE foundation, ensuring that our products, processes and teams operate at a consistently high and predictable standard across the entire value chain.

You will be responsible for safeguarding Sky-Watch’s Quality Management System, driving compliance with AS9100, ISO 9001 and AQAP, and enabling stable, scalable execution in an increasingly demanding international defense environment. Through strong cross functional leadership and data driven governance, you will strengthen decision making, reduce operational risk, accelerate execution stability and help deliver a dependable customer experience built on safety, performance and traceability.

Joining Sky‑Watch means stepping into a fast‑growing scale‑up where reliability is a strategic differentiator — and where your expertise will directly influence both day‑to‑day operations and the company’s ongoing global growth journey.

You will report directly to the CEO, including direct leadership responsibility for the QA Manager and dotted line leadership of the QC Manager.

In this role, you act as a trusted advisor to the Executive Management Team, providing clear, fact based recommendations on quality, risk and compliance, and contributing actively to strategic decision‑making at enterprise level.

Your key responsibilities include:

• QHSE Strategy & Policy

• Sky‑Watch QMS (AS9100 / ISO 9001 / AQAP)

• Quality Governance & Risk Management

• Digital QHSE & Data Governance

• Continuous Improvement & NCR / CAPA

• Supplier Quality Requirements & APQP / PPAP

• Manufacturing Quality & QC oversight

• Audits & Compliance

• Health, Safety & Environment (in collaboration with the Health & Safety

• Organization / AMO)

• People Leadership & Cross‑functional Collaboration

To succeed in this role, you hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing or a related technical field, combined with at least 10 years of experience in global Quality/QHSE leadership within regulated, high‑tech industries with full value chain such as defense, aerospace or equivalent.

You have demonstrated strong results in defect reduction, execution stability and QMS maturity, and you bring hands on experience with MRB, concessions, PPAP and supplier audits. You possess deep knowledge of AS9100, AQAP and ISO 9001 requirements and are comfortable working with lifecycle product safety in a regulated environment.

You work confidently with structured problem‑solving and quality methodologies such as RCA, FMEA, Control Plans and capability analysis, and you are experienced in configuration and document control to ensure consistency and traceability. In addition, you bring strong digital QHSE literacy, using data governance, dashboards and digital adoption to create transparency, support sound decision making and drive continuous improvement across the organisation.

You are based within approximately one hour’s driving distance from Støvring and are willing to travel around 20–30 days per year.

As a person, you take ownership of your responsibilities and bring energy and commitment to your work. You are proactive and structured, balance strategic thinking with hands‑on execution, and remain calm and focused in a fast‑changing environment. With a strong analytical and curious mindset, you are able to translate complex quality, risk and compliance topics into clear, actionable messages that create understanding, alignment and strong buy‑in across senior leadership and the wider organization. You work collaboratively across functions, build trust with key stakeholders, and act as a credible role model for quality, integrity and professional judgement.

Are you the new QHSE Director at Sky‑Watch in Støvring? If so, please submit your application and CV as soon as possible. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity or religion.

**Basware. Now it all just happens.

Do you want to work with modern tools and processes within software quality assurance? Are you passionate about building reliable software through testing and automation? Are you ready for an educational internship in an international green-tech company?

Here is what your role entails

As our Quality Assurance Intern, you will help establish and improve quality assurance processes, standards, and testing practices across our software solutions. You will contribute to evaluating and enhancing testing methodologies, ensuring that quality is embedded throughout the software development lifecycle. You will also be involved in the design, implementation, and maintenance of automated tests to improve efficiency, reliability, and test coverage.

During your internship, you will gain hands-on experience with:

• Jira and Xray for requirements, issue, and test management.

• C# and xUnit for automated testing.

• Playwright for UI and end-to-end test automation.

• API testing and validation of backend services.

• Test case design and test strategy.

• Exploratory, regression, and end-to-end testing.

• Agile development processes and collaboration in cross-functional teams.

You will be involved in all phases of the projects, from idea to finished product, giving you valuable insight into different aspects of software development and quality assurance. You will start with simpler tasks to become familiar with the team, product, and technologies, and gradually take on more advanced responsibilities as your knowledge and confidence grow throughout the internship. By the end of the internship, you will have gained practical experience designing test cases, testing APIs and user interfaces, working with automated tests, and contributing to the quality of real-world software solutions used by customers around the world.

Meet your future team

You will join a collaborative and supportive global team of 40 dedicated colleagues. Together, we work to ensure that Kamstrup’s web applications remain robust and efficient whether that means developing new features, solving UI-related issues, or improving overall performance. We value teamwork, continuous learning, and a positive work environment. In our team, we grow by supporting one another, tackling challenges together, and celebrating each other’s successes.

Did you know? Our team ships code and memes. Our internal chat is approximately 70% software development questions, 20% deployment updates, and 10% carefully curated memes.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for a motivated student who is eager to apply their theoretical knowledge in a practical setting and contribute to the development of high-quality software at Kamstrup.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are studying Computer Science, Software Engineering or a similar field, and have a strong interest in Quality Assurance

• Can work independently, but also value teamwork and professional sparring with your colleagues

• Are structured, take responsibility for your tasks, and are not afraid to take initiative or seek solutions

• Bring a proactive mindset and a desire to learn and grow in a professional environment

In addition, it is a requirement that you are fluent in English – both spoken and written. Danish is not a requirement.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Besides the best program, we also offer:

• The internship is paid if your place of study allows it

• Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

The applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, but you can expect a response within six weeks. Any details about the internship will be individually agreed upon. However, the internship is expected to run from the beginning of February 2027 until the end of June 2027.

Kamstrup is located in Stilling south of Aarhus, and bus number 200 takes you right to the door.

If you have any questions to the internship position, please contact Quality Assurance Manager, Nora Gomez Pascual, on phone: +45 89 93 10 00.

Do you have a strategic and commercial mindset and do you have experience in portfolio optimization and marketing management of Consumer Healthcare brands? Then you might be our new Global Portfolio & Marketing Manager

About the job

As our Global Portfolio & Marketing Manager, Consumer Healthcare you will have two main objectives: 1) Maintain a healthy, commercially relevant and optimized Consumer Healthcare Portfolio across categories and markets, and 2) Drive and own one of our global Consumer Healthcare categories across markets in accordance with the business objectives and the commercial strategy.

The role ensures strong day-to-day portfolio management across categories and markets. This requires strong analytical skills and a solid commercial understanding combined with an ability to ensure stakeholder management along the value chain. Furthermore, the role ensures category ownership of a specified global Consumer Healthcare category (e.g., Allergy) which includes maintenance and development of the category through marketing initiatives, launch of new products, best-practice sharing across markets as well as continuous performance follow-ups.

Your key responsibilities:

• Define and drive yearly cross-country strategy plan for the given Consumer Healthcare category

• Ensure cross-country marketing initiatives and best-practice sharing to support the growth journey

• Further build the product pipeline in close collaboration with the Business Development team

• Portfolio analysis across the full Consumer Healthcare portfolio to identify optimization opportunities in accordance with the commercial strategy

• Owning and driving pruning processes in collaboration the global- and local marketing teams

• P&L responsibility for the given Consumer Healthcare category

• Manage advertising & promotion budget securing investment in projects that drive the best ROI

• Manage relationships with stakeholders across the value chain, local marketing teams as well as external stakeholders such as creative agencies

In this role you will report to Director, Global Marketing, Malene Reimers. Please note that this position is a parental cover lasting 12 months, but we expect to extend the position following the maternity cover to support our growth journey.

Who are you?

The ideal candidate brings a relevant educational background and minimum 5 years of experience from a somewhat similar position within an international consumer-focused organization, preferably in the Consumer Healthcare sector.

We are looking for a candidate with strong analytical skills, solid commercial understanding and great communication skills. You have a structured and well-organized approach and can manage complex projects effectively, while your analytical competencies enable data-driven decision-making and clear recommendations.

As a professional, you work independently and have successfully managed product portfolios and led brands or categories. Additionally, you have exceptional stakeholder management skills and experience working in a matrix organization as this role requires collaboration across diverse teams and functions.

Lastly, you must be an empathetic team player with good interpersonal skills.

Who are we?

The position sits within the Global Marketing team, and you will report to the Global Marketing Director, Consumer Healthcare. We are a small professional, and ambitious team which includes senior marketing professionals. Our culture is characterized by openness, a strong can-do-attitude and great team spirit.

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

Job location

The position can be located at our headquarters in Odense or office in Søborg.

Join Ambu’s global procurement transformation as a Project Sourcing Manager, where you will primarily drive sourcing activities in new product development (NPD) and key sourcing projects, while also contributing to category management to ensure continuity, scalability, and long-term value.

You will operate at the intersection of innovation, cost, technology, and supply risk, helping Ambu bring life-saving solutions to market with strong and competitive business cases.

This role combines hands‑on project sourcing with selected category responsibilities, offering the opportunity to influence both near‑term delivery and long‑term procurement value.

You will be based at Ambu’s HQ in Ballerup, Denmark, as part of Global Direct Procurement team, reporting directly to the Director of Direct Procurement.

**The role

**As Project Sourcing Manager you will be leading sourcing activities across NPD, sourcing and technology development projects, ensuring the right materials, technologies, and suppliers are selected to support innovation, quality, sustainability, and robust financial outcomes.

Alongside this, you will take on selected category responsibilities linked to:

• Categories where you act as sourcing lead on multiple projects

• Post‑industrialization consolidation and supplier strategy execution

• Close alignment and handover with Global Category Managers

You will collaborate closely with R&D, Quality, Global Supply Chain, Operations and Finance, acting as procurement’s commercial and sourcing point of contact throughout the product lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Lead end‑to‑end sourcing in NPD, sourcing, and technology development projects, from early concept through ramp‑up and handover to operations.

• Drive supplier and material selection, make/buy decisions, and sourcing strategies aligned with project milestones and governance.

• Lead RFI/RFQ/RFP activities for project‑specific sourcing and negotiate commercial, contractual, and supply agreements.

• Enable early supplier involvement (ESI) to support design‑to‑cost, design‑for‑manufacturability, and innovation access.

• Own and validate procurement inputs to business cases, including cost drivers, CAPEX, lead time, and lifecycle considerations, while challenging assumptions to secure competitive solutions

• Proactively identify and mitigate supply, capacity, and technology risks, ensuring compliance with quality, regulatory, and sustainability requirements.

• Contribute to selected category initiatives by supporting supplier strategy execution, consolidation, and structured handover from project to category sourcing.

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you have:

• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Procurement, Business, or similar.

• 3–5 years of experience in procurement, with strong exposure to project sourcing and/or NPD environments.

• Solid experience working in cross‑functional project teams, preferably with R&D and product development.

• Strong skills in supplier and material selection, cost modeling, negotiations, and contract execution.

• Hands‑on experience running RFI/RFQ/RFP processes, cost breakdowns, and supplier comparisons.

• Strong analytical capabilities and the ability to translate complexity into clear sourcing recommendations.

• Excellent project management, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills.

• A proactive, structured, and ownership‑driven mindset with strong business focus.

• Ability to operate effectively in a dynamic, fast‑paced global environment.

• Experience in additional Direct Procurement categories is considered an advantage.

Please note: The internal job title for this role will be Strategic Procurement Manager, Direct Procurement.

**Strategic Sourcing Manager to drive Category Management at RTX A/S

**_Would you like to help shape the future of Strategic Sourcing in a global technology company? At RTX, we are strengthening our Category Management approach and are looking for a Strategic Sourcing Manager who can combine analytical insight, commercial judgement and technical curiosity to create measurable value across our supply base.

_**About RTX

**RTX is a global technology company that designs, develops and manufactures advanced wireless communication solutions for customers within Enterprise, Healthcare and Professional Audio.

Headquartered in Nørresundby, Denmark, RTX employs more than 300 people across Denmark, Hong Kong, Romania and the US. We work closely with global technology brands, delivering customized solutions from concept and development through production and full product lifecycle management.

Our combination of deep technical expertise, global partnerships and in-house development capabilities enables us to turn complex wireless technologies into reliable solutions that create value for our customers and their end users.

**What We Offer

**Strategic Sourcing at RTX is entering a new phase. We are moving from a more project-oriented sourcing setup to a structured Category Management approach, and you will play an important role in that development.

You will join a small and experienced Global Sourcing team with significant influence on priorities, methods and sourcing strategies. Working closely with Engineering, R&D and Operations, you will have the opportunity to shape how RTX works with categories, suppliers, cost optimization and supply resilience going forward.

You will report to the Director, Global Sourcing and be based at our headquarters in Nørresundby.

**Your Responsibilities

**You will be responsible for selected sourcing categories and develop strategies based on spend analysis, market insight, supplier performance and business requirements. A central part of the role is to identify opportunities across products and projects and translate them into sourcing initiatives that improve cost, competitiveness and supply security.

You will work closely with technical stakeholders when evaluating components, alternative solutions and second-source opportunities, while also strengthening RTX’s commercial position towards suppliers and EMS partners. Your key responsibilities include:

• Develop and implement category strategies based on spending, market and supplier analysis.

• Identify and execute cost reduction opportunities through bundling, standardization and supplier consolidation.

• Develop second-source and dual-source solutions to reduce supply risk.

• Work with Engineering and R&D on alternative components and technical specifications.

• Build market and supplier intelligence to support sourcing decisions and negotiations.

• Negotiate strategic prices, contracts and commercial terms.

• Strengthening collaboration with EMS partners and contribute to the development of a more focused partner setup.

• Support initiatives that improve long-term delivery performance and supply resilience.

**Your Qualifications

**We are looking for a sourcing professional with strong analytical capabilities, commercial understanding and an interest in technology.

You may already have solid experience within Category Management and Strategic Sourcing, or you may come from an electronics or manufacturing environment where you have worked strategically with suppliers and components. The exact combination is less important than your ability to understand the business, challenge existing solutions and drive initiatives over time. We expect you to:

• Have experience in Strategic Sourcing, Category Management, procurement or supplier management.

• Be confident working with spend analysis, market data and sourcing strategies.

• Have experience from a manufacturing or technology-driven environment, preferably involving electronics, components or EMS partners.

• Understand the interaction between sourcing, Engineering and R&D.

• Have strong negotiation skills and experience with contracts, suppliers and cost optimization.

• Be analytical, structured and able to turn complex information into clear recommendations.

• Be persistent and comfortable driving initiatives that require alignment across several stakeholders.

• Communicate professionally in English and Danish in an international environment.

A relevant degree within Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering or a related field is an advantage, but practical experience, mindset and your ability to create results are equally important.

**Application and Contact Information

**Guldbrandsen & Lythje is handling the recruitment process. If you have any questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact Partner Dan Lythje at +45 93 84 84 49 or Partner Lise Guldbrandsen at +45 20 67 67 57. Applications should be sent to: Strategic Sourcing Manager to drive Category Management at RTX A/S - Guldbrandsen & Lythje ApS

We work with ideas, concepts, and new solution spaces – turning them into structured opportunities for product development. Our team brings together backgrounds in design, strategy, business, and engineering – a mix of thinkers, doers, and prototype builders.

About Octarine Bio

Octarine Bio is a Copenhagen-based company pioneering a new generation of sustainable, bio-based colourants. We engineer nature-inspired colours that deliver the performance, stability, and safety profile required for demanding industrial applications while decoupling colour from fossil-based chemistry. PurePalette™ is supplied as a formulated product, ready to use in textiles, plastics, paper, and more.

Designed for drop-in integration and targeting price parity with conventional colourants, PurePalette™ lets customers adopt a more sustainable solution without compromising cost, quality, or scalability.

The Role

As a Technical Sales Manager, you will own the commercial relationships that take PurePalette™ from sample to qualified supply. You will identify and develop new customers across multiple regions and application segments. You will guide customers through the full sales process, from the technical evaluation that industrial colourants require — sampling, trials, and qualification on their own equipment — to supply agreement execution.

This is a hands-on role in a company at an early commercial stage. You will work closely with technical and commercial teams to understand customer needs and bring learnings in the field into product selection and development. As volumes grow, you will also help build the order fulfilment and logistics processes that reliable supply depends on.

We are looking for someone who is comfortable holding technical conversations with engineers and commercial conversations with purchasing managers, and who is motivated by building something new.

Key Responsibilities

• Identify, qualify, and develop new customers & key accounts across target markets and regions

• Manage sample and trial programmes from first request through to qualification on customer equipment

• Present PurePalette™ to technical and commercial audiences, from process engineers to purchasing and sustainability teams

• Understand customer applications and requirements, and work with R&D and application scientists to match them to the right formulation

• Prepare quotations and proposals, and negotiate supply agreements

• Build and maintain relationships with customers, distributors, and partners

• Maintain accurate opportunity and account information in the CRM

• Represent Octarine Bio at trade shows and industry events, and feed market and competitor intelligence back to the business

• Deliver on revenue and growth targets, and help shape our commercial strategy

Qualifications & Experience

Required

• 5+ years in technical sales, business development, or application support in an industrial B2B setting

• Strong ability to deliver a technical sales presentation, to hold a credible technical conversation and to translate it into a commercial one

• Willingness to travel for customer visits and trade shows

• Professional fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage

• Curious, proactive, well organized, and comfortable owning a sales pipeline

Preferred

• Experience in colourants, pigments, dyes, inks, coatings, or textile chemicals

• Familiarity with how industrial customers qualify a new raw material — sampling, trials, and regulatory or restricted substance screening

• Experience selling a novel or sustainability-positioned product into cost-sensitive markets

• Working knowledge of the operational side of sales, e.g., order fulfillment, warehousing, shipping, and export documentation

Why work with us

Octarine Bio is located in central Copenhagen – one of Europe’s most liveable cities – in a country world-renowned for its exceptional quality of life and work-life balance. As a biosolutions scale-up, our team members have a high degree of autonomy, and their decisions and daily work have a direct, measurable impact on the company’s success. We offer a competitive salary and an international, collaborative working environment.

How to apply

Please submit to stephanie@octarinebio.com your CV along with a short cover letter explaining your relevant technical and commercial experience and why you would like to join Octarine Bio.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply early.

**Summary

**At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. The Creativity Apps team needs your help shaping the next generation of creative editing tools by working on state-of-the-art technologies to surprise and delight creative pros and enthusiasts alike. You’ll be working with the world-class teams behind Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, iMovie, and GarageBand to create next-generation tools for creators!

**Description

**We're looking for a Performance Tooling Engineer to own the tooling and automated tests that keep our products fast, efficient, and correct. Your mission is to catch regressions before they ship, across latency, memory, power/thermals and functionality, by building the test harnesses, benchmarks, and CI infrastructure that make regressions visible, reproducible, and actionable.

The systems you build will run continuously across our device fleet and become the safety net our engineering team relies on. If you enjoy turning "it feels slower" into a hard number on a dashboard with a bisected culprit commit, this is for you.

**Responsibilities

**

• Design, write, and maintain automated tests that detect performance regressions (latency, memory footprint, power consumption, etc.) and functional regressions.

• Build and operate CI pipelines and tooling that run these tests reliably across a fleet of hardware devices.

• Create dashboards, alerting, and triage tooling that surface regressions early and help engineers root-cause them quickly, e.g. automated bisection, historical trend tracking.

• Partner with cross-functional teams & leadership to define meaningful performance goals and acceptance criteria.

• Continuously improve test coverage, execution speed, flakiness, and the developer experience of running and interpreting tests.

**Minimum Qualifications

**

• Very strong problem-solving and coding skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Experience building and maintaining CI systems.

• Solid understanding of performance measurement fundamentals: how to benchmark reliably, control for noise, and reason about latency, memory, and power/thermal metrics.

• Experience writing automated tests and the tooling/frameworks around them.

• Proven track record of integrating AI tools to enhance both personal productivity and team workflows.

**Preferred Qualifications

**

• Experience developing for Apple platforms (iOS/macOS), with working knowledge of Swift.

• Familiarity with the Apple development toolchain: Xcode, Instruments, and related profiling and testing.

• Experience with GPU programming and image processing systems (Metal, OpenCL, CUDA or similar).

• Experience with regression testing across many hardware devices, e.g., device labs, device farms, or fleet-based test automation.

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.

jobs.occupation: Product Manager – AI | Shape the Future of Construction Tech with Dalux
jobs.description:
**Product Management at Dalux – Bringing AI into the Construction Industry

**Dalux continues to grow rapidly, and AI is creating entirely new possibilities for how construction professionals find information, understand complex project data, automate repetitive work, and make decisions.

We're looking for an AI Product Manager to help turn those possibilities into products that create real value for our users.

As an AI Product Manager at Dalux, you'll operate at the intersection of customer needs, rapidly evolving AI technology, and business strategy. You'll work closely with Product Design, AI engineers, developers, and other Product Managers to identify where AI can meaningfully improve construction workflows – and equally importantly, where it cannot.

Building AI products is different from traditional software development. Outputs are probabilistic, quality needs continuous evaluation, and product decisions involve trade-offs between accuracy, latency, cost, scalability, and user trust.

You'll help us navigate those trade-offs and establish how we build great AI products at Dalux.

**Your responsibilities will include:

**

• AI Product Discovery: Identify and validate problems where AI can create meaningful value rather than applying AI for its own sake.

• Customer Insights: Work closely with users and internal domain experts to understand construction workflows and identify opportunities for AI-powered improvements.

• Evaluation & Quality: Define what "good" looks like for AI features and establish evals, quality metrics, test cases, and feedback loops.

• AI Safety & Trust: Consider hallucinations, uncertainty, guardrails, failure modes, explainability, and user trust throughout product development.

• Feature Ownership: Lead AI-powered features from early experimentation and prototyping through delivery, evaluation, and continuous improvement.

• Technical Collaboration: Work closely with AI engineers and developers on model capabilities, context, architecture, latency, scalability, and cost.

• AI Product Strategy: Follow developments in models and AI technology and help determine which technological advances create meaningful opportunities for Dalux.

**About You

**We are looking for someone who combines strong product thinking with a solid understanding of modern AI.

You don't need to be an AI engineer, but you need enough technical understanding to make informed product decisions and have meaningful discussions with the engineers building these systems.

We believe you:

• Have experience building or managing customer-facing AI/ML products.

• Understand concepts such as LLMs, RAG, embeddings, context, agents, evals, and guardrails.

• Understand the fundamental difference between building deterministic software and probabilistic AI experiences.

• Can translate rapidly evolving technical capabilities into valuable user experiences.

• Are comfortable defining and measuring quality where traditional acceptance criteria are insufficient.

• Think critically about when AI is – and isn't – the right solution.

• Can balance user value, model quality, latency, scalability, and cost.

• Communicate fluently in English, written and spoken.

Experience with B2B SaaS is an advantage.

Experience with construction technology is welcome but not required. We have deep construction expertise within Dalux – for this role, we are particularly interested in adding strong AI product expertise to our organization.

**What To Expect At Dalux

**At Dalux, you'll join a product-driven company where ideas quickly become reality and where you'll have a direct impact on the products we build.

We offer:

• A collaborative and informal work environment with flat hierarchies

• High ownership, trust, and the freedom to drive initiatives

• Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international team

• A central Copenhagen office, flexible work hours, and no dress code

• Monthly social events and an active community

• Attractive benefits including health insurance, lunch, fitness facilities, and free parking

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

**Ready for the next step?

**We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your resume and application as soon as possible.

**About Dalux

**Founded in 2005, Dalux is a Danish Contech company revolutionizing the construction industry with innovative software built on geometric processing and 3D computer graphics.

Over the past years, we’ve grown by 40% annually and now have over 900 employees across 50+ offices in more than 25 countries. All product development takes place in our Østerbro, Copenhagen office, where we focus on building the future of construction technology. We place great value on our strong social community and close collaboration with colleagues, which is why we primarily work from our Copenhagen location.

**Application deadline:

**As soon as possible

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**At SimCorp, we build products that power investment management and financial institutions worldwide. We support some of the largest financial institutions in the world to be successful by simplifying their investments, accounting and operations.

Investment Operations is a product area within SimCorp’s Product Division, which delivers functionality enabling the operations users to be highly efficient. It also offers full STP and automation capability for the workflows and processes seamlessly across the product areas and the financial institutions workflows.

As part of our Investment Operations Product Area, you will contribute to the development of enterprise products within this product area. You will collaborate with colleagues from Ukraine, Poland, Denmark and Germany, while gaining deep expertise in applied finance and modern software engineering practices.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**As a Lead Full-Stack Software Engineer, you will:

• Provide technical leadership in design, development, and testing.

• Define and own test architecture and quality strategy at team level.

• Balance active coding (C#, Angular, APL) with guiding automation initiatives

• Drive adoption of automation-first practices across the team.

• Ensure high-quality delivery by monitoring coverage, test metrics, and quality KPIs.

• Mentor and coach engineers in development, automation, and testing skills.

• Represent QA/Dev combined approach in cross-team forums.

• Collaborate with stakeholders (POs, TLs, architects) to align technical and quality goals.

• Conduct in-depth root cause analysis for complex defects and ensure preventive actions

• Advocate for and implement improvements in tools, CI/CD pipelines, and engineering processes.

• Continuously assessing and improving engineering processes, recommending new tools and technologies to enhance productivity and software quality

• Represent the team in technical forums and contribute to cross-team knowledge exchange.

**What We Value

**

• We are looking for an engineer who has demonstrated leadership abilities

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.

• 8+ years of experience in software engineering with combined Dev/QA responsibilities.

• Expertise in .NET / C# and working knowledge of Angular.

• Known for impactful leadership, resulting in improved efficiency and project success among engineering teams

• Extensive background in test automation (E2E, API, Integration) and test strategy

• Solid experience in architecting and developing enterprise-scale applications.

• Extensive knowledge of Cloud and On-Prem infrastructures (Microsoft Azure experience)

• Deep expertise in CI/CD pipelines and tools (Git, TeamCity, Azure DevOps).

• Thorough understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and Domain-Driven Design

• Familiarity with XP practices (TDD, pair programming, continuous integration).

• Experience with relational databases (SQL).

• Readiness to learn APL, developing new features and debugging existing functionality, with full support from our team throughout the learning process.

• Proficient English communication skills (Upper-Intermediate or higher), both written and spoken

• Ability to mentor, motivate, and guide a team toward technical excellence and efficient delivery

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience with Azure or similar cloud platforms.

• Background in FinTech or capital markets.

• Knowledge and experience in the financial domain, fintech, derivatives (options, futures, swaps, etc.) is an advantage.

**Benefits

**Competitive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, at SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide an excellent work & life balance: flexible work hours, a hybrid workplace model. On top of that, we have IP sprints where you have 3 weeks per quarter you can spend on mastering your skills as well as contributing to the company development. There is never just only one route - we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process.

To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

**WHO WE ARE?

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

We’re looking for a senior full-stack engineer with a strong interest in building AI-first products who enjoys owning problems end-to-end – from vague client needs and early hypotheses to production-grade systems that actually get used.

**What You’ll Do

**You’ll join The Tech Collective (our Data & AI hub, specifically), where we help organisations design, build, and operationalise data- and AI-driven solutions.

This role is tailor-made for a systems thinker and builder – someone who has shipped real products, taken responsibility for technical direction, and is motivated by creating pragmatic solutions that combine data, software, and AI.

You’ll work closely with experienced AI specialists who bring deep model and ML expertise, while you focus on building robust products and software around those capabilities.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

• End-to-end solution ownership: designing and implementing full-stack applications from early concepts and prototypes to scalable, production-grade systems, including architecture decisions across frontend, backend, data, and cloud

• Modern full-stack development: building high-quality frontend and backend services, applying sound software engineering principles, and using AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully and critically

• AI-enabled product building: collaborating with AI specialists to integrate LLMs, retrieval pipelines, and agentic patterns into real products, and translating AI potential into solutions that make sense for organisations

• Data and systems thinking: designing data models, reasoning about distributed systems and trade-offs, and implementing event-driven or real-time features where they add value

• Observability and evaluation: experience setting up the right observability and eval tooling to establish traceability and iteratively improve on products

• Cloud, delivery, and collaboration: deploying and operating solutions in cloud environments, balancing speed, robustness, and security, and working closely with clients and stakeholders to create tangible business impact

**What You’ll Bring

**We’re looking for someone with an AI builder mentality and 5+ years of hands-on full-stack experience, who is comfortable owning applications end to end – from frontend and backend to data and deployment.

You don’t need to tick every box, but you should recognise yourself in most of the following:

• Strong full-stack foundation: solid skills in TypeScript and/or Python, with experience building and shipping production systems

• Mentoring experience: helping other developers through technical sparring and code reviews

• Outward curiosity: actively seeking to understand client problems in detail and working in close collaboration with them to solve them

• Ownership and leadership: a track record of building substantial solutions from scratch (e.g., startup, scale-up, or personal ventures), taking responsibility for outcomes, and leading technical direction without relying on formal authority

• System-level thinking: the ability to reason about architecture, data flows, trade-offs, and failure modes across the stack, and to make pragmatic decisions in ambiguous contexts

• Critical technical judgement: a keen eye for identifying weaknesses in existing architectures and tech stacks, and knowing where and how to improve them

• Communication and collaboration: the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders, work across disciplines, and learn from – and share knowledge with – others in the team and across Implement

• Tool agnostic: capable of choosing the right tool for the job

**What We Offer

**We offer a role with technical ownership and influence, working in a 20-person team that feels much closer to a nerdy startup than a large corporation – while being firmly backed by Implement Consulting Group.

You’ll gain exposure to a wide range of data- and AI-driven problems across industries, all within a culture built on trust, curiosity, humility, resilience, and impact. You’ll also have great freedom to shape your own role, deepen your expertise, and grow in exactly the direction that motivates you.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? Apply ASAP.

**About The Tech Collective

**The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement Consulting Group. We aim to make a positive difference in the consulting industry, believing that the ability to create change with impact and purpose is a prerequisite for success in a global and turbulent world.

We’re expanding our team and look forward to meeting talented people who are curious about a career in information systems and management consulting at the intersection of business and technology.
