o Bachelors degree in Education / Early Childhood Education is mandatory.

o 2-3 years’ early years teaching experience in Nursery/kindergarten is required.

o Demonstrable experience in Positive Behaviour Management is required.

o Certification in Montessori or equivalent demonstrable experience in implementation of Montessori pedagogy will be an added advantage.

Personal Qualities:

o Creative and truly passionate to work with children while being extremely patient and caring.

o Can engage and extend the children’s learning through play.

o Sound written and verbal communication skills.

o Great team player while can also work independently

o Person who is culturally sensitive and thrives in truly international environment

o Enthusiastic and flexible to share tasks typical for a small but dynamic organisation

Salary and benefits: We offer highly competitive salary, pension and benefits within international childcare sector in Denmark, in accordance with collective agreements.

Work-visa: Work visa can be sponsored for the right candidate (non-EU candidate needs to have Bachelors degree in education / early childhood education to qualify for work visa sponsorship)

Interviews will be conducted as we receive applications. Please note that due to high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for interview process.

Join a world of energy as MFT Energy’s new Student Risk Analyst

Are you curious about how risk is managed in one of the fastest-moving industries in the world? At MFT Energy, we are looking for a Student Risk Analyst who wants to gain hands-on experience working with data and risk management in a dynamic energy trading environment.

The role as a Student Risk Analyst:

You will join our Finance, Risk & Treasury department, where you will be part of our Risk team working alongside experienced colleagues with deep industry expertise. The team works closely with stakeholders across the trading organization to provide transparency on the company’s overall risk profile and support informed decision-making.

In a business characterized by rapidly changing market conditions and significant volatility, the Risk team helps ensure a responsible balance between risk and return across all our trading activities.

In this role, you will work with a wide range of datasets, including trade data and market price data that form the foundation of our risk calculations. Through this work, you will contribute to maintaining reliable risk data and develop a strong understanding of how risk management supports a modern energy trading company.

The position offers a steep learning curve in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same.

Your key responsibilities:

• Working with large trade and market price datasets to ensure the quality of risk calculations

• Developing data quality checks within our in-house data models

• Improving existing tools and developing new solutions (primarily using SQL, Power BI, Power Automate, and Power Apps)

• Automating tasks related to reporting, data processing and analysis

• Supporting the risk business partners with daily ad hoc tasks and analysis

• Gaining exposure to different types of risks including liquidity, market, credit and operational risk

Your qualifications and personal skills:

• Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Economics, Finance, Mathematics or a similar field.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Ability to work independently and take initiative

• Coding skills are a plus but not required. The most important thing is an interest in learning, as much of the data work will involve SQL

• Interest in energy markets and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment

• Curious and open-minded approach to learning and problem-solving

Working in MFT Energy

At MFT Energy, we combine a startup mindset with the strength of a global organization. We believe in empowering individuals to make data-driven decisions in a fast-paced environment. We are around 200 employees working out of our headquarters in Scandinavian Center, Aarhus C, and from our international offices in Türkiye, Australia, New York, Singapore, Japan, and several remote colleagues working from all over the world.

We offer:

• A 15–20-hour student position with flexibility to plan your working hours around your studies

• A role where you will take ownership of your tasks while working closely with experienced colleagues who are always ready to support and spar with you

• An international and fast-moving environment where things develop quickly and you will continuously learn new things

• A strong student community and plenty of social activities, such as CrossFit, running club, Friday bars, team events, and more

• A culture where we enjoy celebrating both big and small successes - and luckily, we have many reasons to do so

Make the most of your talent! Join us!

If you think there is a fit between the role and your aspirations, we will be looking forward to receiving your application with a short cover letter and CV. For questions, please write to career@mft-energy.com.

Deadline: We will be screening and interviewing candidates on an ongoing basis.

Start date: As soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: International Construction Manager Wanted at DK TØMRER
jobs.description:
International Construction Manager Wanted at DK TØMRER

Do you have an international degree in construction management, architectural technology, civil engineering, building engineering, or a related field – and are you looking to develop your career in the Danish construction industry?

DK TØMRER is looking for a motivated and well-organised International Construction Manager to help manage and coordinate our construction projects across Zealand.

We are a growing construction company working on both large-scale contracts and ongoing construction and renovation projects. We are therefore looking for someone who can help ensure structure, quality, coordination, and progress across our construction sites.

Your Responsibilities

As a Construction Manager, your responsibilities will include:

• 
Daily coordination and follow-up on construction sites

• 
Planning and coordination of employees and subcontractors

• 
Quality assurance and photographic documentation

• 
Monitoring schedules, deadlines, and project progress

• 
Ordering materials and coordinating deliveries

• 
Communicating with project managers, main contractors, and other project partners

• 
Reviewing drawings, specifications, and other project documentation

• 
Registering and managing additional works and variations

• 
Participating in construction and project meetings

• 
Monitoring health and safety, quality standards, and site safety

About You

We are looking for someone with a degree in Construction Management, Architectural Technology and Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Building Engineering, or a similar field, preferably obtained outside Denmark.

For us, the most important thing is not where you obtained your education, but that you have a solid understanding of construction, are willing to take responsibility, and are motivated to learn and develop within the Danish construction industry.

You work in a structured manner, are able to maintain an overview in a busy construction-site environment, and communicate effectively with both tradespeople and project management.

jobs.occupation: Terminal Worker Wanted for Night Shift in Greve
jobs.description:
Do you thrive on night work, fixed routines, and physical tasks? Then you might be the one we are looking for to join the night shift at a terminal in Greve.

At our client’s terminal in Greve, logistics and distribution of parcels and goods are handled daily. Parcels are received, sorted, and forwarded into the distribution network to ensure they efficiently reach their recipients.

The night shift consists of approximately 20 employees who work closely together in a busy environment. There is a strong team spirit, with colleagues from different backgrounds and levels of experience contributing to a positive and supportive working atmosphere.

The work is routine-based and requires focus and structure. Your tasks will include:

• 
Opening pallets and placing parcels on conveyor belts

• 
Scanning parcels at the sorting line

• 
Sorting parcels into the correct cages according to assigned numbers

• 
Ensuring a stable and efficient sorting flow

The work is performed standing up and is physically demanding. You must be prepared for repeated lifting, frequent movement, and handling parcels that can be quite heavy.

We are looking for someone with a strong work ethic who thrives in physically demanding work and structured routines. You work efficiently and can maintain a steady pace, even during the early morning hours when energy levels are tested. At the same time, you are able to stay focused on repetitive tasks and take initiative if there are pauses in operations, for example by cleaning up or handling other practical tasks. Experience from similar work is an advantage but not a requirement. The most important qualities are reliability, a sense of responsibility, and readiness to take initiative.

You will be employed in a temporary position with the possibility of permanent employment if the match is right and there is an ongoing need. Working hours are typically from 11:00 PM to 6:30 AM, starting Sunday night and finishing the week Saturday morning. The hourly wage is DKK 190.96 in accordance with the collective agreement, plus night shift supplements.

Does this sound like the right opportunity for you? Then send your application today, we look forward to hearing from you.

Help shape how technology and AI create value for Danske Bank. Technology and AI are increasingly shaping how Danske Bank delivers value to customers, supports colleagues and executes on its strategic ambitions. As our new experienced Strategy Consultant, you will help senior leaders navigate complex choices by providing perspectives, analyses and recommendations that support both current priorities and future strategic ambitions.

Join a newly established team transforming how Danske Bank communicates with customers. As Chief Business Consultant, you will shape our digital transformation agenda, improve customer experience, and reduce communication costs through data-driven insights and strategic execution.

Company Profile

Light means life and quality of life. Our employees in 50 countries are committed to making light better, more efficient, and more beautiful. Our corporate culture, rooted in the OSRAM tradition, is characterized by strong team spirit, initiative, and entrepreneurial freedom. This is a time full of opportunities. Are you ready to join us on this exciting journey? Then apply now!

A well-rounded and varied role in a dynamic company

The position

The Engineering Excellence Manager, reporting to the Head of Engineering, centralises all Engineering support functions to ensure excellence is intrinsically built into how Engineering operates across a global and evolving, multi-site Engineering environment, from mission and satellite system design to satellite operations

Methods

Enable effective use of AI in both engineering design (what we build) and engineering methods, processes, and operations (how we work)

• 
Drive adoption of DFMAT and modularity principles with a strong focus on practical application and measurable impact

Configuration Management & Interfaces

• 
Establish and own Engineering Configuration Management as a technical discipline, including baselines, interfaces, change control, and traceability, aligned with projects, PMO governance, and company-wide Configuration Management plan

• 
Own and maintain the structure and lifecycle of technical orders towards procurement and Product production for internal and third-party products, ensuring technical clarity, readiness, and alignment with PMO and delivery needs

• 
Ensure Engineering compliance with space and quality regulations, protocols, standards, and relevant certifications (e.g. ISO, NIS2), embedding compliance into Engineering processes, tools, and daily practices in coordination with company-wide quality and assurance functions

•

Leadership Support & Execution

•

Act as Chief of Staff to the Head of Engineering, providing direct support across synthesis, preparation, coordination, and sustained follow-up of complex topics and leadership decisions, ensuring Engineering operates coherently as a system

Establish dashboards, reporting, and operational cadence, and prepare clear, executive-level material for internal and external forums.

• 
Drive execution by ensuring initiatives are implemented, adopted, measured, and continuously improved

Build, lead, and develop a high-performing Engineering Excellence team, defining roles, priorities, and ways of working, and scaling the function as the company and Engineering grows

Criteria of Success

Successful projects

Strategic and technical leadership

Skills

Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or equivalent qualificationSound business acumen, translating strategic intent into operational systems and day-to-day execution

Leadership presence and interpersonal effectiveness, with the capacity to influence without direct authority and operate credibly across functions

Proud of your work – including the work of your team

Thrilled for creating business value

Structured

Strategic and innovation driven mindset

English on a high level – oral and written

Education

Contact and location

The company

GomSpace is a globally leading designer, integrator and manufacturer of high-end nano and microsatellites for customers in the academic, government and commercial markets. Our positions of strength include systems integration, small satellite subsystems and advanced miniaturized radio technology. At the core of our mission are our core values: Be helpful, communicate openly and frequently, show true leadership and act for customer value.

Our international team is devoted to understanding our customers’ requirements and delivering high quality. We are listed in Stockholm (GOMX), headquartered in Denmark and have subsidiaries in Sweden, Singapore, France, North America and Luxembourg. We have more than 200 employees servicing customers in more than 60 countries.

Our mission: “We make Space Yours”

From our first CubeSat innovations to enabling entire constellations, we’ve been driven by one mission: to empower nations, businesses, researchers, and visionaries to claim their place in space.
With cutting-edge small satellite technology, we break down barriers – making access to space smarter, faster, and more affordable.
Today, we’re not just building satellites – we’re building opportunities. We’re not just enabling missions – we’re enabling dreams by helping and guiding our customers in fulfilling their space ambitions. Whether you’re a startup launching your first satellite, an ambitious government deploying national strengths or an established enterprise building a global network “We make space Yours. Accessible, Affordable, Useful.

It’s YOURS to explore, YOURS to innovate, and YOURS to reach.

With more than 19 years of experience in the market and a track record of multiple successful missions accomplished, we have developed profound knowledge and competencies within Radio Technology, Cubesat Platforms, Project Management as well as Innovation. We provide the solutions that enables our customers to succeed in their business - whether this is a product, a subsystem, support or a full customized solution. We deliver these projects based on our strong in-house portfolios of established products and rich capabilities.

In short GomSpace is

• 
An innovative and international listed company headquartered in Aalborg

• 
International in the daily working style - English is the corporate language

• 
Growing, there are a lot of big projects kicking off, it’s an exciting time to join

• 
Flexible. We constantly challenge what works best for the teams – the project management is based on internationally recognised standards and teamorientated approaches

• 
Customer focused: We have respect for our customers

• 
People focus: We believe success is all about “people and culture”

About the position

Solvexis Consult is looking for an experienced Electrical Supervisor for a construction project in Fredericia.

You will be responsible for supervising and coordinating electrical and instrumentation activities on site, ensuring that installations are completed safely, correctly and according to the agreed schedule and quality requirements.

The position requires close cooperation with contractors, subcontractors, engineering partners, the commissioning team and the client.

Responsibilities

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• 
Supervising electrical and instrumentation installation activities on site.

• 
Coordinating the daily work of electrical contractors and subcontractors.

• 
Participating in project, coordination and progress meetings with the general contractor, subcontractors and client.

• 
Monitoring installation progress and identifying delays, technical constraints and supply-chain challenges.

• 
Supporting the contract-management process, including progress evaluation, change orders and potential commercial impacts.

• 
Providing technical E&I support and working closely with the client’s commissioning team.

• 
Inspecting the installation and testing of LV distribution panels, DCS panels, BMS panels, solenoid panels and associated electrical equipment.

• 
Ensuring that drawings, documentation and other project deliverables are provided on time.

• 
Reviewing installation and testing schedules and reporting issues or risks to the relevant project leads.

• 
Coordinating the safe execution of energisation and LOTO activities in accordance with project procedures and required authorizations.

• 
Conducting QA walk downs and identifying quality issues, incomplete work and deviations.

• 
Coordinating and supporting punch-list close-out before and after mechanical completion.

• 
Ensuring that work is carried out in accordance with project HSE requirements, quality standards and approved procedures.

• 
Maintaining clear progress records and communicating status, risks and required actions to project stakeholders.

Qualifications and experience

We expect that you have:

• 
A relevant electrical qualification, such as electrician, electrical technician, electrical engineer or equivalent.

• 
Proven experience supervising electrical installations on construction or industrial projects.

• 
Practical knowledge of LV installations, electrical testing, energisation and LOTO procedures.

• 
Experience working with electrical panels and control systems.

• 
The ability to read and understand electrical drawings, schematics, specifications and project documentation.

• 
Experience with QA inspections, walk downs, punch lists and system handover.

• 
Strong coordination and communication skills.

• 
A structured and safety-conscious approach to your work.

• 
Professional working proficiency in English.

Experience with DCS and BMS installations, commissioning activities or large multidisciplinary projects will be an advantage.

What we offer

At Solvexis, you will be supported by a professional organization throughout your assignment. We provide structured onboarding, administrative support, documentation assistance and regular follow-up, allowing you to focus on delivering high-quality work for the project.

You will join a technically demanding project with close cooperation across contractors, engineering, commissioning and client teams.

Employment terms will be agreed based on your qualifications, experience and the conditions of the assignment.

Application

Please apply through our recruitment portal and upload your CV in English.

About ViroGates

ViroGates A/S is a Danish in-vitro diagnostics company listed on Nasdaq First North Growth Market Copenhagen. The company’s mission is to shift healthcare from reactive treatment to proactive prevention through high-accuracy diagnostic tools that enable earlier intervention and better decision-making.

ViroGates’ proprietary suPARnostic® product portfolio is based on the suPAR biomarker, providing clinically validated insights into chronic inflammation and overall health risk. The technology is used across acute care and clinical triage, with a growing focus on preventive health, longevity, and wellness.

Executive Summary

ViroGates A/S is seeking a Product-/QA Specialist to combine product management of its suPARnostic® portfolio with management of the company's quality management system as the company scales. The role suits an experienced IVD or medical device professional who can balance speed of execution with regulatory rigour while safeguarding product quality and patient safety.

Key Responsibilities

Product Management

• Drive product management of new and existing suPARnostic® products, including leading R&D projects and improving existing products

• Maintain technical product documentation, including IFUs

• Act as the primary contact to the contract manufacturer

• Provide product‐related sales support and customer training, and forecast consumables

Quality Management System & Regulatory Compliance

• Act as ViroGates’ Co-Management Representative and process owner for the quality management system

• Maintain and continuously improve the QMS in line with ISO 13485 and applicable regulatory requirements (IVDR)

• Control of documents and records

• Plan, conduct and support internal and external audits

• Verify and oversee product storage and shipping/transport conditions (temperature monitoring, deviation/excursion handling, review of transport and storage stability data)

Risk, Vigilance & Post-market Surveillance

• Risk management and change control

• Handle nonconformities, CAPAs and complaints, including review and trending

• Manage vigilance and reporting to authorities

• Post‐market surveillance and related processes

Management Reviews, Training & Supplier Quality

• Prepare and participate in management reviews

• Own training processes across the organisation

• Manage supplier quality

• Contribute to management reporting on quality and product performance

Candidate Profile

Experience & Expertise

• Relevant degree within life sciences, biotechnology, biomedical engineering, bioanalytical or a similar field

• Minimum 5 years’ experience from the IVD or medical device industry, including product management and/or R&D

• Documented experience as a QA Specialist / Management Representative and solid working knowledge of ISO 13485 and IVDR

• Hands‐on experience with core QMS processes (document control, audits, CAPA, complaints, risk management and post‐market surveillance) and with technical product documentation and IFUs

• Strong cross‐functional collaboration skills

Personal Attributes

• Structured, detail‐oriented and quality‐minded

• Able to balance speed of execution with regulatory compliance

• Pragmatic and hands‐on, comfortable operating in a lean, fast‐moving organisation

• Able to work across R&D, Sales & Marketing and external partners

Practical Requirements

• Fluent in English (written and spoken); Danish is an advantage

• Based at or able to work from ViroGates’ HQ in Birkerød

• Willingness to travel up to 15 days per year

Organisation & Ways of Working

ViroGates operates with a lean organisation and a small, engaged team; the role reports directly to the QA & Product Manager. The culture is characterised by constructive collaboration, open dialogue and a strong focus on execution discipline. This role suits someone who enjoys end-to-end ownership rather than a narrow, siloed function.

Why Join ViroGates

• Opportunity to work with both product and quality for a differentiated biomarker platform with strong clinical validation and multiple commercial applications

• High degree of influence relative to organisation size, with direct access to management and decision‐making

• A pivotal, cross‐functional role at a listed diagnostics company entering the fast‐growing longevity and preventive health markets

• Collaborative, non‐hierarchical working environment with an entrepreneurial mindset

jobs.occupation: Mid Level Backend Engineer - Financial Services
jobs.description:
About Monta

Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you’ll do well with us.

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully — and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people — sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You’ll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

The Role

We're looking for an Engineer to join our Financial Services team, the team responsible for every euro that flows through Monta's platform. This is a hands-on individual contributor role where you'll own delivery of meaningful pieces of our financial systems and grow your expertise in the domain, helping us scale reliably as we expand across Europe.

Financial Services is at an inflection point. Our transaction volume is growing fast and already processes millions of euros each month. We're building the next generation of our financial infrastructure, including new billing models and compliance capabilities to support expansion into new EU markets. The problems are hard, the stakes are real, and the work matters.

We need someone who takes ownership of what they build. You'll own medium-sized projects from design through to production, working independently within your team and delivering quality outcomes.

You should also be someone who has embraced AI as a core part of how you work. We use Claude Code extensively across the Financial Services team for everything from writing and reviewing code to designing systems and exploring financial domain problems. We expect you to be an advanced AI user who actively finds new ways to leverage these tools to move faster and think better.

This Is What You Will Achieve

• 
Help rebuild Monta's financial backbone. You'll contribute to the new invoicing system that every customer will use, owning meaningful slices of the new infrastructure.

• 
Power EU expansion. You'll build features within our compliance infrastructure (e-invoicing, fiscalization, VAT) that enables Monta to enter new European markets.

• 
Strengthen the money flow. You'll improve the reliability and scalability of payment processing, reconciliation, and withdrawal systems across a rapidly growing transaction volume.

What You’ll Do

• 
Deliver core parts of the new invoice system. Build features within the new invoicing architecture that supports multiple billing models and financial flows, owning your slice end-to-end and contributing to design discussions.

• 
Build and scale compliance infrastructure. E-invoicing across European markets. Fiscalization integrations. A VAT engine that handles the complexity of cross-border EV charging.

• 
Improve payment flows from card to payout. Card payments, automated reconciliation, withdrawal reliability, and working capital management.

• 
Collaborate across Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, and Product to deliver new billing and commercial models. You won't work in a silo.

• 
Build for systems that must be right. Every euro must be traceable from summary down to line item. You'll write code with auditability, correctness, and scale in mind, and contribute to design discussions for new components.

• 
Grow with the team. Contribute through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing, and help onboard new joiners as you grow into the domain.

What We’re Looking For

• 
Solid backend engineering experience. You've built and shipped production systems and you write clean, maintainable code. Java/Kotlin preferred, but strong engineers from other stacks are welcome.

• 
Some exposure to financial systems is a plus. Billing, invoicing, payment processing, or similar domains where correctness matters — but we'll help you grow the depth.

• 
A sense of ownership. You take responsibility for what you ship, follow it through to production, and flag issues early rather than waiting to be asked.

• 
Comfortable asking questions and learning fast. Regulatory and financial domains have a lot of nuance — you bring curiosity and a willingness to dig in.

• 
Curiosity about financial infrastructure. Invoicing, VAT, compliance, payment flows. You don't need to be a domain expert on day one, but you're eager to go deep.

• 
Advanced AI adoption. You already use AI tools daily in your engineering workflow and you're always looking for new ways to apply them. You don't just accept suggestions, you prompt deliberately, iterate on output, and integrate AI into how you design, build, and debug.

• 
Strong collaboration and communication skills. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, finance, legal, and product. You build alignment fast and communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders.

Bonus:

• 
Experience with EU financial regulations, e-invoicing standards, or fiscalization

• 
Experience with payment service providers or payment infrastructure

• 
Familiarity with event-driven architectures (Kafka) or high-throughput data processing

If the mission excites you but your experience isn't a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway. We care about potential, not perfection.

AI at Monta Engineering

AI is central to how we build software at Monta. It's not a side experiment. It's embedded in our daily work and we expect every engineer to be a power user.

Tools we use daily:

• 
Claude Code for writing, reviewing, and refactoring code, exploring domain problems, and building internal tooling

• 
Claude / Gemini for research, design thinking, and documentation

• 
Notion AI for docs, knowledge management, and meeting notes

• 
AI-enhanced testing and monitoring

Adcendo ApS is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark. We are developing a pipeline of first-in-class antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) targeting cancers with high unmet medical needs. Led by a team of industry veterans with a strong track record in advancing ADCs and biologics, Adcendo combines novel targets, optimized linker-payload technologies and a rational development strategy to bring next-generation cancer therapies to patients.

We are looking for a dedicated Sr. Scientist, CMC – mAb Manufacturing to join our CMC team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing the monoclonal antibody manufacturing process across our pipeline projects. You will work closely with internal stakeholders, CMC project management, QA and external CDMOs to ensure robust development, manufacturing and regulatory readiness of our mAb-based drug substance activities.

This position requires strong scientific and technical expertise within biopharmaceutical development and manufacturing, particularly monoclonal antibodies, as well as solid experience working with external manufacturing partners in a GMP-regulated environment.

The role

As Sr. Scientist, CMC – mAb Manufacturing at Adcendo, your responsibilities will include:

• Development of mAb manufacturing process development across projects in collaboration with CMC PM and CDMO

• Vendor selection, oversight and evaluation of CDMOs within mAb manufacturing

• Coordination of scientific and technical work associated with mAb manufacturing within pipeline projects

• Author and review appropriate CMC sections of IND and BLA submissions

• Review of GMP/GDP out of specifications (OOS), deviations, change controls, complaints and distribution in collaboration with QA

• Review of validation protocols, validation strategies, risk assessments such as FMEA

• Review and approve mAb process development. manufacturing documentation and other technical reports to support regulatory filings

• Review stability data and establish shelf life in collaboration with QA

Qualifications and experience

Our ideal candidate has solid experience from a similar role within biopharmaceutical development and manufacturing. You have a strong understanding of CMC development in a biotech or pharma setting and are comfortable working in a dynamic environment with multiple projects, external partners and stakeholders across geographies.

You bring both scientific depth and a pragmatic, collaborative mindset, enabling you to make sound decisions while maintaining high quality and attention to detail.

We expect that you have:

• Relevant academic background in sciences as a Pharmacist, Biochemist, Chemist or Engineer and experience with development of biopharmaceutical products

• At least 5 – 10 years relevant industry experience

• Working in a GMP environment and have experience in pharmaceutical development e.g. manufacturing or analytical development and project management.

• Deep experience within development and manufacturing of monoclonal antibodies, establishment of cell banks, upstream and downstream processing.

• Experience within tech transfer of manufacturing processes

• Experience within lates stage development, process validation and BLA filings

• Management of external relationships and outsourced contract manufacturing organizations

• Excellent collaboration skills

As a person, you are structured, quality-focused and proactive. You thrive in a growing biotech company where priorities may evolve, and you are motivated by contributing to the development of innovative therapies for patients with high unmet medical needs.

Other details

• The position is full-time and comes with the expectation of significant on-site presence at our Copenhagen offices

• Approximately 10–20 travel days per year are expected

• The Sr. Scientist, CMC – mAb Manufacturing reports to the Executive Director, CMC Project Management

Working at Adcendo

At Adcendo, we are on a mission to develop breakthrough antibody-drug conjugate therapies for cancers with high unmet medical needs. Our work is guided by a patient-centric, science-driven approach and powered by a passionate team committed to quality, performance and innovation.

We believe great science happens in a culture of collaboration, respect and transparency. At Adcendo, you will find cross-functional teamwork, opportunities to grow and the balance needed to thrive both personally and professionally.

How to apply

If you thrive in an international environment and have strong experience with mAb manufacturing from Pharma or Biotech, we encourage you to apply and join us at this exciting time for Adcendo.

To apply, please submit your CV including a short motivation for applying for the job. If you have any questions regarding this position, please send them to f.cetinkaya@aims-germany.com. Please read about Data Privacy for job applicants on our website: www.adcendo.com.

Join us in shaping an emerging biotech company and the future of cancer treatment.

Adcendo – Designed for Precision. Developed for Life.

About FLOWVISION A/S

FLOWVISION A/S is a Danish engineering company founded in 2006, specialized in designing and delivering advanced emission abatement systems for combustion-based power plants worldwide. Since 2021, the company has been part of AXENS GROUP, while continuing to operate as an independent business with its own organization, commercial responsibility, and market-facing role.

The company operates in an international EPC environment and delivers technically advanced solutions to customers within the energy, oil & gas, and industrial sectors across multiple global markets. FLOWVISION collaborates closely with major international players and is recognized for its strong technical know-how, high-quality standards, and ability to solve complex engineering challenges.

Today, FLOWVISION employs around 20 highly skilled specialists, creating a strong concentration of technical competencies and deep industry expertise. This gives the company the agility and close collaboration of a small expert team, combined with the backing and broader industrial context of being part of Axens.

FLOWVISION offers a flat organizational structure, short decision-making processes, and a collaborative culture where openness, knowledge sharing, and teamwork are essential parts of everyday life.

The company is currently experiencing significant growth and a strong order intake, creating attractive opportunities for professionals who want to influence both project execution and the continued development of the business.

The position

As E&I Engineer, you will become part of FLOWVISION's highly specialized engineering environment and play a central role in the electrical and instrumentation execution of technically advanced international projects.

You will work closely with Project Management, Mechanical Engineering, Process Engineering, Supply Chain, QHSE, workshops, suppliers, and external engineering partners. Your responsibility is to ensure that electrical designs, components, documentation, and technical interfaces are correct, practical, cost-effective, and ready for fabrication, installation, and inspection.

The role combines detailed engineering with practical project execution. You will work from customer specifications and standards through design, procurement, supplier clarification, fabrication support, FAT, and final documentation. A particularly important part of the role is specifying and selecting electric motors and associated electrical equipment for FLOWVISION's systems.

This is not a PLC programming position. However, you need a sound understanding of control systems, instrumentation, signal exchange, I/O architecture, software logic, and control philosophy. Some PLC programming experience will be an advantage when reviewing interfaces and supporting project execution.

The position is ideal for someone who enjoys turning complex specifications into clear requirements, making sound technical decisions, and following issues through to completion.

Key responsibilities

Electrical and instrumentation project execution

·   Review customer RFQs, technical specifications, standards, and requirements, identifying clarifications, risks, assumptions, and consequences for price, schedule, and execution.

·   Translate customer requirements and agreed project scope into clear electrical and instrumentation requirements for suppliers and external engineering partners.

·   Prepare and maintain electrical diagrams, I/O lists, cable lists, datasheets, logic diagrams, bills of materials, and component specifications.

·   Specify and select electric motors and related components based on process duty, performance, electrical data, operating conditions, applicable standards, ATEX requirements, cost, and delivery time.

·   Design junction boxes and define cables, glands, terminals, and associated electrical hardware.

·   Coordinate electrical interfaces with mechanical and process disciplines, including cable routing, instrument connections, signal exchange, and control system interfaces.

·   Identify, resolve, and document technical issues, deviations, and design changes with consistency and traceability throughout the project lifecycle.

Supplier, procurement, and workshop coordination

·   Prepare technical purchase requirements and support procurement RFQs and purchase planning.

·   Review supplier quotations, drawings, datasheets, quality documentation, and technical deviations against project requirements.

·   Coordinate technical clarifications with suppliers and subcontractors, consolidate comments, manage revisions, and ensure closure of open actions.

·   Act as the day-to-day E&I contact for workshops and fabrication partners, responding to technical questions and resolving practical installation issues.

·   Participate in inspections, pre-FAT, FAT, and commissioning support, and follow up on punch items, deviations, and non-conformities.

·   Contribute to practical, standardized, and cost-effective E&I solutions based on lessons learned from fabrication, FAT, and commissioning.

Qualifications

We expect you to have:

·   A relevant technical background, for example as an Electrical Engineer, Automation Engineer, Automation Technologist, Marine Engineer, Electrical Technician, Industrial Electrician, or similar. Practical industrial E&I experience is more important than a specific academic title.

·   Hands-on knowledge of electrical installations for industrial machinery, automation systems, control panels, or process plants.

·   Documented experience specifying and selecting electric motors. This is essential.

·   Experience using EPLAN or another relevant ECAD system and the ability to read, review, and technically assess electrical drawings and software logic.

·   A good understanding of instrumentation, I/O systems, control interfaces, and process control philosophy.

·   Experience from project-based engineering, machinery construction, process plants, maintenance, workshops, fabrication, or EPC-type environments.

·   Familiarity with relevant standards such as EN, IEC, UL, and NFPA, together with experience of or strong understanding of ATEX requirements.

·   Experience working with controlled documentation, revisions, BOM structures, and document management systems.

·   Strong English communication skills, written and spoken. Danish is considered an advantage.

Your personal profile

You are analytical, highly structured, and able to maintain a clear overview across several parallel projects. You enjoy reading specifications and standards and converting them into practical, commercially sound requirements. You are curious and eager to learn, but your desire to understand the details never comes at the expense of progress and delivery.

You take ownership, make decisions, and follow tasks through to completion. In dialogue with suppliers and colleagues, you communicate honestly and directly while remaining constructive and respectful. You are comfortable challenging technical input and can be persistent when you know that a requirement or solution is correct.

Most importantly, you combine attention to technical quality with a sharp awareness of cost, deadlines, manufacturability, and the practical realities of installation and commissioning.

Practical information

·   Location: FLOWVISION A/S, Odense, Denmark

·   Reporting line: Chief Operating Officer (COO)

·   Travel activity: Limited and dependent on projects, including supplier visits, FAT, installation, and commissioning support

What we offer

FLOWVISION offers a unique opportunity to become part of a highly specialized and growing international engineering company where technical know-how and collaboration are the core drivers of success.

We offer:

·   A key technical role with visible impact on international engineering projects.

·   The opportunity to work with advanced E&I solutions across the full project lifecycle.

·   A strong concentration of specialist competencies and close collaboration across disciplines.

·   Excellent opportunities for professional and personal development as the company continues its growth and professionalization journey.

·   A high degree of responsibility and influence on engineering solutions, supplier coordination, project execution, and ways of working.

·   A flat organization with fast decision-making and close collaboration across the company.

·   A versatile and dynamic workday characterized by openness, cooperation, flexibility, and humor.

·   Office location in Odense with international exposure and limited travel activity.

FLOWVISION is a company where highly skilled people work closely together to deliver complex solutions to global customers - and where the right person will have the opportunity to make a visible impact on both projects and the future development of the business.

Join a world of energy as MFT's new student trader for the intraday power market

Are you our next student trader, and are you ready to learn the specifics of the intraday power trading? Join our ambitious intraday trading team of experienced colleagues, who strive to be the best and find the edge in the market every day, all day.

The job as a student trader

As a student trader, you will play a vital role in our trading team, assisting with trading and ensuring that all operational processes run smoothly. You’ll take part in developing and executing trading strategies and continuously analyzing market trends to identify profitable opportunities. You will be responsible for monitoring real-time data, making quick decisions, and collaborating with our full-time traders to ensure we seize the right market opportunities. This role offers an excellent opportunity for growth and development in the energy-trading industry.

We do not expect you to have experience in energy trading, but you should have a deep desire to learn and be interested in trading. If you have grit and hunger, we promise tailored training from some of the industry’s best traders and guarantee a fun work environment, a steep learning curve, and a unique career opportunity within intraday trading.

The work hours will mainly be evening shifts on weekdays and weekend shifts, which should fit well with your studies. Weekends might include night shifts.

Your key responsibilities

• Covering a student position (at least 15 hours per week on average) as part of a shift schedule in our high-performing intraday team – we trade 24/7, 365 days a year

• Daily trading and optimization of trading positions

• Continuously monitoring fundamental data such as solar and wind generation to take positions in a split second

• Continuous risk evaluation

• Always question the status quo

• Share insights to optimize and rethink the way we trade

Your qualifications and personal skills

• Currently studying a bachelor's or master’s degree in economics, finance, mathematics, or related degrees

• An interest in financial markets, stock trading, sports betting, or similar

• Have a competitive mindset and the ability to make informed decisions in a fast-paced environment, with the next deadline always coming up

• The ability and interest to learn about complex systems and methods quickly

• A positive and competitive person with grit, and at the same time, a great team player

• Can be direct with your colleagues and be able to receive direct constructive feedback

• Most importantly, a result-oriented mindset, always striving to be the best

Working in MFT Energy

At MFT Energy, we combine a startup mindset with the strength of a global organization. We believe in empowering individuals to make data-driven decisions in a fast-paced environment where collaboration, innovation, and entrepreneurial thinking are the cornerstones of our success. We are around 200 employees working out of our headquarters in Scandinavian Center in Aarhus C, and from our international offices in Turkey, Australia, USA, Singapore, Japan, and several remote colleagues working from all over the world.

We offer

• A fast-paced, global environment where entrepreneurial thinking is celebrated

• A people-centered leadership approach with a flat organizational structure

• Great employee benefits and a strong focus on employee wellbeing

• A high degree of autonomy and the freedom to make an impact

Make the most of your talent and join us!

jobs.description:
Product Manager for Mobile Command and Control Products

Channel your experience as an army officer into developing products that make a difference in the field. As part of Systematic’s Defence Product Management team, you will help shape the future of our SitaWare Mobile Command and Control products – developed for soldiers by someone who understands the job from the inside.

The role

Reporting to the Director of Product Management, you will join the product management team and collaborate closely with the Business Product Manager for our mobile C2 products. Together, you will help define the vision and strategy for our SitaWare Mobile Command and Control products. A core element of your role will be day-to-day guidance of the development team as a subject matter expert, ensuring that what we decide to build is implemented in a way that works effectively for soldiers in the field.

In short, you can look forward to:

• taking ownership of daily guidance of the development team, translating agreed features into implementation that works for soldiers in the field – ensuring user satisfaction

• using your subject matter expertise to define and manage the vision and strategy for enhancing and expanding our mobile command and control products

• serving as the voice of the customer and end user when implementing product enhancements

• providing the sales team with the necessary product knowledge, sales collateral and assistance in connection with special customer visits, and representing Systematic at conferences and trade shows

• being part of change control boards, helping prioritise defects and change requests based on what matters most to soldiers in the field

Joining the team

It is a team that cares about creating solutions that genuinely work for the people using them – if that is what drives you too, then you will feel right at home.

Your qualifications

Ideally, you will bring several years of experience from the armed forces – perhaps as an officer, company commander or in a signals or communications role – or from working closely with defence organisations. As a result, you will have first-hand insight into military operations, command and control at battalion level and below, and how systems are introduced and used in the field. That operational perspective will enable you to understand the end user and contribute relevant expertise to the development of our mobile C2 products.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• the ability to turn operational insight and understanding of end-user needs into clear product requirements that development teams can act on

• a collaborative approach and the confidence to provide subject matter expertise across product management, development and sales teams

• strong written and verbal communication skills, with fluency in English and the confidence to present to larger audiences and to represent Systematic at customer presentations, user forums and conferences

We are also looking for someone who:

• is self-motivated and energetic, with a genuine drive to make a difference for the people who use the products you will help to build

• has a sense of curiosity and is well organised, with the ability to set priorities and keep pace with a growing product area

This role will involve approximately 20–30 days of travel a year, visiting customers, Systematic offices and events.

jobs.occupation: Project Manager – Lead the Journey from Concept to Production
jobs.description:
Are you a decisive, technically grounded project manager who thrives on turning complex ideas into real, manufacturable products?

Do you enjoy connecting people, creating direction, and driving progress in environments where engineering excellence matters? This is your opportunity to take a central role in shaping how we bring innovative electronics products to market — faster, smarter, and better.

Your Role

You will join our project management team in BU Product, currently consisting of three Project Managers, and report to the Head of Engineering, BU Product. The Engineering function includes Project Managers, two Team Leads and approximately 45 engineers working across different technical disciplines.

BU Product is responsible for developing and maintaining the standard products in our portfolio – the building blocks used to create our satellites. We work closely with our Product Managers, who define the portfolio and product roadmap. From there, our responsibility is to turn the roadmap into reality, taking product development from the initial phases through development and industrialization to running production.

As Project Manager, you will lead engineering projects across multiple teams and disciplines and manage several development streams simultaneously. You will create direction and momentum across engineering, operations and suppliers, ensuring that plans, dependencies and risks are visible and actively managed.

You will also support Product Owners in the early scoping of projects and work closely with the Product Engineering Manager on project status, escalations and corrective actions.

Your tasks include:

• Manage end-to-end project execution by translating requirements into structured development plans and ensuring progression from concept through to manufacturable solutions

• Develop and maintain cross-team project plans that align priorities, dependencies, timelines and deliverables across engineering, operations and supplier interfaces

• Facilitate concurrent engineering by engaging relevant disciplines early and supporting effective cross-functional decision-making

• Monitor project progress, maintain risk visibility and initiate timely corrective actions to address deviations, constraints or delays

• Coordinate with suppliers and internal stakeholders to support on-time delivery of critical parts and alignment with project commitments

• Contribute to developing and implementing a fit-for-purpose product development model that strengthens time-to-market, scalability and continuous improvement across BU Product

What You Bring:

You’re an experienced project manager with a strong engineering foundation and a solid understanding of what it takes to move complex electronics and software products from concept to manufacturable reality. You know that successful project management is as much about people as it is about plans. You communicate clearly across technical and non-technical stakeholders, ask the right questions, follow up proactively and bring different disciplines together around a shared direction.

You likely:

• Hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics Engineering or equivalent

• Have 5+ years of experience within electronics and software product development

• Bring documented experience leading technical development projects

• Understand and practice concurrent engineering principles

• Excel at creating structure and enabling effective cross-functional collaboration

Who you are:

• Helpfulness – you support teams, ask purposeful questions and pursue the answers you need

• Open communication – you communicate transparently and proactively and follow through

• True leadership – you take ownership, act with integrity and drive progress with confidence

• Structure & clarity – you create overview and direction in a dynamic environment

• Human insight – you listen, understand different perspectives and turn input into clear conclusions

Here’s why you’ll love working with us:

At GomSpace, we’re on a mission to shape the future of space – one mission at a time. Here, you’ll be part of something bigger than just a project or a product. You’ll help build systems that connect people, enable science and expand humanity’s reach beyond Earth.

We believe the best results come when talented people are trusted, supported and inspired to push boundaries together.

• Be part of a global company making a real impact in the space industry

• Get freedom under responsibility from day one – and grow with us

• Join a dynamic, full-service environment where no two days are alike

• Work across borders and build a strong international network

• Be part of a culture where collaboration beats competition – and milestones are celebrated together

Join our mission

At GomSpace WE MAKE SPACE YOURS.

GomSpace is a globally leading designer, integrator and manufacturer of high-end nano and microsatellites for customers in the academic, government and commercial markets. Our positions of strength include systems integration, small satellite subsystems and advanced miniaturized radio technology. At the core of our mission are our core values: Be helpful, communicate openly and frequently, and show true leadership.

Our international team is devoted to understanding our customers’ requirements and delivering high quality. We are listed in Stockholm (GOMX), headquartered in Denmark and have subsidiaries in Sweden, Singapore, France, North America and Luxembourg. We have more than 200 employees servicing customers in more than 60 countries. Learn more on www.gomspace.com

Anne Katrine Windfeld

akwi@gomspace.com

Healper a game-changing booking platform that matches people with mental health issues such as depression, anxiety, and addiction with the psychologist who fits their needs. Problem: The cumbersome booking of the wrong psychologist In Denmark, mental disorders account for 25% of the disease burden and cost society 55 billion DKK annually with more than 2,000 people receiving therapy from a psychologist every day. Further, too many individuals do not receive timely help as they cannot cope with the draining 5-hour process it takes to find and book a psychologist. At the same time, U.S. experience shows that only 20-40% of people find a psychologist they trust and have 'chemistry' with. This is tragic, as just one bad experience can cause a client to completely drop out of or postpone his/her therapy. The ineffective booking process and the risk of a poor patient-therapist match mean that many people continue to struggle with mental illness who could otherwise be treated. This has major consequences for individuals whose mental illness markedly impairs their quality of life, but also largely affect their family and friends. Furthermore, this is a major problem for society, which is negatively impacted by lost labor and growth and must shoulder the high costs associated with mental illness. Solution: A simple approach to booking the right psychologist Healper is a friendly guide and a booking platform that matches clients with psychologists. We have designed a comfortable, simple, and transparent user journey, that takes the client by the hand and helps him/her through therapy to mental health. Clients fill out a short questionnaire and are then matched with the best results from our database of more than 1,700 psychologists. Here, we find the psychologist who can statistically give the best treatment. Clients are presented with a prioritized list of three psychologists along with the reasons for the match. From this list, clients can choose which psychologist they like best, book a session, and pay. The platform continuously facilitates feedback from clients and their psychologists to improve the processing and precision of the matches.

About the position

Solvexis Consult is looking for an experienced Lifting & Rigging Subject Matter Expert (SME) to support a major construction project.

As the project’s technical specialist for lifting and rigging, you will help ensure that lifting activities are properly planned, reviewed and executed safely. You will provide specialist guidance to the project team, contractors and subcontractors and support compliance with applicable legislation, project procedures and recognized industry practice.

The role requires extensive practical and technical experience with lifting operations on large construction or industrial projects.

Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Acting as the project’s subject matter expert for lifting, rigging and crane-related activities.

• 
Developing, reviewing and maintaining project procedures and minimum requirements for lifting operations.

• 
Reviewing lift plans, risk assessments, method statements and supporting technical documentation.

• 
Assessing routine, non-routine, complex and critical lifting operations.

• 
Reviewing crane selection, load charts, lifting radius, capacity utilization and equipment configuration.

• 
Verifying load information, including weight, dimensions, center of gravity and lifting points.

• 
Reviewing rigging arrangements, lifting accessories and equipment selection.

• 
Assessing crane positioning, ground conditions, outrigger loads and required ground support in cooperation with the relevant engineering disciplines.

• 
Ensuring that exclusion zones, communication methods and responsibilities are clearly defined before lifting begins.

• 
Confirming that lifting equipment and accessories have valid certification, inspections and identification.

• 
Reviewing the competence and documentation of crane operators, riggers, signalers, lifting supervisors and other personnel involved in lifting operations.

• 
Supporting contractor and subcontractor evaluations related to lifting competence and performance.

• 
Participating in planning meetings, constructability reviews, pre-lift meetings and toolbox talks.

• 
Conducting site inspections and audits of lifting and rigging activities.

• 
Identifying unsafe conditions, procedural deviations and technical risks and ensuring that these are addressed.

•

jobs.description:
OJ Electronics is growing, and we are looking for a project manager who ensures the successful execution of our product development projects within electric floor heating, where we develop thermostats and related digital solutions. The projects focus strongly on software development and coordination across several scrum teams, while also bringing hardware, mechanics, testing, certification and production together into one strong overall solution.

You join our team of project managers, who work across our business areas. In this role, you have key responsibility for leading the software part of development projects from the first specification through to a market-ready solution. The role requires a strong overview, as you manage the project while also creating the right framework for effective execution within and across several software and scrum teams.

You are the driving force who brings employees, scrum teams, internal specialists and external partners together throughout the execution phase. You create clarity around goals, dependencies, decisions and deadlines, enabling the teams to focus on delivering value and quality.

Your main responsibilities are to:

• Work closely with project managers, product managers, system architects and technical leads on scope, priorities and specifications

• Plan, budget and follow up on projects covering both traditional project deliverables and agile software deliverables

• Coordinate dependencies, capacity and progress across several software and scrum teams

• Ensure effective collaboration between software, hardware, mechanics, testing, certification, production and other relevant functions

• Lead the project team, set a clear framework and provide sparring on priorities, risks and challenges

• Ensure structure, decision support and documentation throughout the project

• Communicate regularly with stakeholders and report progress in relation to scope, timeline, risks and budget.

Your qualifications

You have a relevant technical and/or project management background and experience leading development projects in an environment where software plays a central role. In addition, you:

• Have experience with project management in product development, preferably involving a combination of software, electronics, testing and industrial production

• Understand agile software development and have experience coordinating across scrum teams

• Create overview, structure and progress in complex projects with many dependencies

• Have strong drive and the ability to bring several teams together around a shared goal

• Communicate clearly and effectively at all organizational levels – from development teams to top management

The role requires physical presence at our location in Sønderborg and is therefore not suitable for either remote or hybrid work.

What we offer

We offer an exciting role in a dynamic environment, where you influence the development of products and solutions within electric floor heating. You join a team of skilled and experienced project manager colleagues, with room to use your abilities and pursue your own ambitions.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis until we find the right candidate, so please do not hesitate to send us your application today.

About OJ Electronics

Founded in 1964 and headquartered in Sønderborg, Denmark, OJ Electronics produces electronic controls for underfloor heating and HVAC controls and drives. Our products are available through partners and distributors worldwide, and we have subsidiaries and sales offices in key markets, including the United States and Poland. About NOVENCO® Building & Industry A/S

Engineering a Greener and Safer World

At NOVENCO, we create ventilation solutions that deliver high energy efficiency with minimal environmental impact. Our mission is clear: provide sustainable systems with low life-cycle costs that meet – and consistently exceed – customer expectations.

Reliability for Life Safety

Innovation Since 1947

Team Lead, Software Development - Trading & Monitoring

Do you have experience leading developers – and are you more motivated by making a team succeed than by writing the code yourself? Then you may be our new Team Lead for Trading & Monitoring.

Who we are

Eurowind Energy is a global and leading developer, owner and operator of energy parks. Based in Denmark, we operate in 16 countries around Europe and in the USA, and we are continuously growing our project portfolio. We believe in a future of renewable energy, and we have an ambitious plan of becoming the next generation’s “Power Major”. Based on a full value chain from greenfield project development to energy trading, more than 700 team members are dedicated to creating a greener future fueled with nothing but renewable energy!

We are looking for an experienced Team Lead to join our Trading & Monitoring team in IT Software. Based at our headquarters in Hobro, you will have people responsibility for five developers who build and operate the platforms behind Eurowind’s energy trading and the monitoring of our parks.

Your role

This position is deliberately shaped differently from our two other team lead roles. Where they are “playing coaches” with their weight on the technical side, this one is dedicated to people and to the framework the team works within. You do not need to write code to succeed here – you need to build a team that does.

• People leadership of five developers: regular 1:1s, feedback, development plans and career paths

• Allocating tasks and areas of responsibility within the team, matching both the team’s deliverables and each individual’s skills and development goals

• Ownership of team culture, wellbeing and day-to-day ways of working

• Conflict handling within the team – you mediate between team members rather than only holding the conversations 1:1

• Recruitment and onboarding of new colleagues, together with HR and your manager

• Approving holiday and absence, and proposing salary changes within HR’s framework

• Identifying and removing blockers and delivery risks – yourself, or by escalating

• Acting as the link between the team and the wider organisation, including Trading and Commercial

• Sparring with the Product Owner, Scrum Master and architect on planning, estimation and prioritisation

You work closely with the team’s Product Owner and Scrum Master, who own what gets built and how we work respectively. Technical ownership is shared with the team’s senior developers and our architect – so you can stay focused where you make the biggest difference.

You own the how

We lead through direction and frameworks rather than close supervision. We agree the mandate and the expectations, and from there you decide the route.

• Significant autonomy in execution and real influence over how your team works

• A department with written, clarified roles (Manager, Product Owner, Scrum Master, architect and Team Lead)

• Two experienced team lead colleagues to spar with, and a steady leadership rhythm of syncs and 1:1s

• Flexible working hours and the option to work from home

• Lunch scheme, coffee, tea and fruit, discount agreements and a bonus scheme

• An international environment with colleagues in 16 countries, where English is a natural part of everyday work

You will report to Senior Manager of Software Development, Daniel Otkjær, and become part of the leadership group in IT Software.

Who tends to thrive in this role

What matters most to us is demonstrated experience leading people. We are looking for someone who:

• Has several years of people management experience, ideally with developers or other specialists

• Has experience with 1:1s, feedback and development conversations – and with mediating when conflicts arise between colleagues

• Has been involved in recruitment and onboarding

• Understands agile software development and how a development team delivers

• Communicates clearly and creates direction and psychological safety in a team

• Is comfortable making decisions and standing by them

• Is fluent in Danish and English, written and spoken

A technical background – for example as a developer, tech lead or architect – is a clear plus, but not a requirement. Familiarity with energy trading or the energy sector is likewise an advantage, but something you can readily learn with us.

Please note that this role requires a clean criminal record.

Renewable energy is our future. And so are our people!

At Eurowind Energy we do our best to create a culture where everyone is valued and feels at home. You will notice this in your everyday work life, where you have the freedom to speak up and where your voice means something to us. We know that when you grow, we grow. Therefore, we strive to support you in what you believe is right and in your personal and professional development. We offer you an exciting job in an energetic and international environment. And we promise you: the wind is never standing still.

Developing, operating and managing wind and solar parks is not just pure business for us. It is a way to view the world. And with this worldview comes a genuine ambition to be one of the leading developers in Europe. Because creating a future run entirely on green energy matters to us.

We manage our own portfolio of projects and at the same time, we perform technical and financial management of projects. We have throughout many years experienced sustained economic growth in the number of developed projects and companies in management. And we continue to expect this. Simply because it is in our nature to keep developing – projects, companies and our people.
