jobs.occupation: Specialistläkare i neurolog til Midt- og Vestsjællands hospital Slagelse, Danmark
jobs.description:
Nyinrättad tjänst med inriktning mot akutsjukvård och samarbete med Rigshospitalet

Vi utökar vår specialistläkargrupp vid Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital i samband med uppbyggnaden av en ny akutneurologisk verksamhet. Du kommer att ha stort professionellt inflytande över vår kommande akutvårdsverksamhet och kommer att ingå i ett nytt, nära samarbete med Rigshospitalet.

Varför ska du välja oss?

• Skapa framtidens akutvård: Du kommer att ha en central roll i uppbyggnaden och lanseringen av vår kommande akutneurologiska verksamhet (exklusive trombolys).

• Nytt samarbete med Rigshospitalet: Samarbetet öppnar dörrar för branschöverskridande samverkan, kunskapsutbyte och forskning. För den som är intresserad finns dessutom möjlighet till attraktiva deltidsanställningar (t.ex. en dag i veckan på RH).

• Nya yrkesområden från och med den 1 januari 2027: Till följd av hälso- och sjukvårdsreformen tar vi över den specialiserade rehabiliteringen från kommunerna, vilket ger spännande möjligheter till yrkesmässig utveckling.

• Utrymme för din subspecialisering: Oavsett om ditt intresse ligger inom MS, rörelsestörningar, huvudvärk, demens, epilepsi eller rehabilitering anpassar vi ramarna så att du kan fördjupa dig inom ditt område.

• En stark forskningsmiljö: Vi fokuserar på multisjuka patienter och har en egen professor i neurologi, vars forskning främst är inriktad på multipel skleros.

Din profil

Du är specialistläkare i neurologi – och är antingen nyutexaminerad och vill utvecklas eller en erfaren kollega som söker nya utmaningar.

Vi tror att du:

• brinner för det tvärvetenskapliga samarbetet och vill bidra till kvaliteten på den nya akutmottagningen

• anser att ett nära professionellt samarbete mellan olika sjukhus är värdefullt

• ser stort värde i klinisk vägledning och handledning av våra yngre läkare

• är beslutsam, flexibel och bidrar aktivt till vår goda arbetsmiljö och vår pionjäranda.

Vardagen och uppgifterna

Vår avdelning tar hand om patienter på huvudfunktionsnivå i Slagelse (sjukhusavdelning för fas II-rehabilitering, främst stroke, samt specialistkliniker) och i Næstved, där vi driver Center for Neurorehabilitering (CNN) som har en regionfunktion.

Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer att omfatta

• arbete vid vår öppenvårdsmottagning, våra specialkliniker eller den tvärvetenskapliga minneskliniken (i samarbete med geriatriker, psykiatriker och neuropsykologer)

• handledning av yngre läkare samt deltagande i det tvärvetenskapliga samarbetet mellan olika kliniker.

• jouransvar: specialistläkarna sköter för närvarande bakjourstjänstgöringen på plats fram till kl. 21.00, varefter de har beredskapsjour från hemmet (primärjour finns på plats dygnet runt).

Om avdelningen

Neurologin ingår i en samlad avdelning (Medicin 3 och Avdelningen för fysioterapi och arbetsterapi), där vi har ett nära och välfungerande samarbete med geriatriken. Vi lägger stor vikt vid yrkesmässigt utbyte inom en läkargrupp som präglas av god kollegial sammanhållning och en vilja att utveckla yrket.

Praktisk information och ansökan

• De sju läkarrollerna: Din ansökan ska förhålla sig konkret till de sju medicinska kompetensområdena och innehålla så utförlig dokumentation som möjligt.

• Intressen: Om du har särskilda önskemål gällande subspecialisering eller är intresserad av en delad tjänst med Rigshospitalet, får du gärna ange detta i din ansökan.

Vill du veta mer?

Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta överläkare Benedikte Wanscher på mobilnummer +45 93 57 62 51 eller via e-post till bewa@regionsjaelland.dk för ett konfidentiellt samtal om tjänsten utan förpliktelser.

Villkor, lön och anställning

Anställningen sker enligt avtalet mellan Danske Regioner och YL/Overlægeforeningen, beroende på vilken tjänst som söks.

Det kan finnas möjligheter till anställning enligt ”skatteordningen for højtlønnede” (innebär att du som utländsk specialist, forskare eller högavlönad får en betydligt lägre och förenklad inkomstskatt i Danmark under en begränsad period) för sökande som uppfyller villoren för detta. Läs mer här

Tjänsten ska tillsättas så snart som möjligt.

I din ansökan eller ditt CV ska du hänvisa till de sju läkartjänsterna och ange om du söker en tjänst som specialistläkare eller överläkare. Om du har några särskilda intressen eller önskemål angående tjänsten får du gärna beskriva dessa i din ansökan.

Bifoga relevant dokumentation.

Hjälp med flytt och undervisning i danska

Om du vill flytta till Danmark i samband med anställningen erbjuder vi kostnadsfri, professionell hjälp med flytt och bosättning nära sjukhuset eller eventuellt i Köpenhamn. Du får hjälp med allt från att hitta boende till registrering och eventuella medföljande familjemedlemmar.

En viktig del av arbetet som specialistläkare är kommunikationen mellan läkare och patient. För patientsäkerhetens skull kräver därför Region Sjælland att våra specialistläkare ska ha kunskaper i danska språket på en tillfredsställande nivå. Vi tillhandahåller därför en språklärare för privatundervisning så att du så snabbt som möjligt kan kommunicera med dina patienter på en nivå där ni förstår varandra.

Det innebär att vi förväntar oss att du är inställd på att lägga tid på att lära dig danska, både i tal och skrift.

Se mer om vad vi erbjuder i form av hjälp här

Rekryteringsprocessen

När vi har mottagit din ansökan kommer vi att bedöma om dina kvalifikationer matchar det vi söker, och du kommer initialt att bjudas in till en intervju via Teams. Om båda parter är intresserade av att fortsätta dialogen kommer du att bjudas in till ett rekryteringssamtal på sjukhuset, där du får träffa avdelningens ledning och personal samt vår HR- och språkkonsult.

Ansökningstid

Vi kommer att granska ansökningarna till tjänsten löpande, så vänta inte för länge med att ansöka.

Verksamhetsområde

Den 1 januari 2027 slås Region Själland och Region Hovedstaden samman och bildar Region Østdanmark till följd av sjukvårdsreformen. Ditt verksamhetsområde kommer att vara Region Østdanmark, inklusive alla tillhörande organisatoriska enheter.

Läs mer om vad verksamhetsområdet innebär på Region Østdanmarks webbplats.

Om Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital arbetar vi varje dag för att främja ett hälsosamt liv genom förebyggande åtgärder och behandling inom ramen för en samordnad hälso- och sjukvårdsinsats. Som sjukhus förenar vi psykiatri och somatik. Vårt mål är att patienter och medborgare ska få bra och trygg vård av hög kvalitet.

Som medarbetare blir du en del av ett innovativt, kompetent och organisatoriskt stabilt sjukhus där vi gör skillnad för de människor som behöver oss. Lärande och utveckling är en del av vardagen och sker i professionella sammanhang med ett gemensamt ansvar. Det sker även mellan olika avdelningar.

Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital betjänar ett upptagningsområde med cirka 230 000 invånare. Vi har 766 vårdplatser och cirka 5 000 anställda fördelade på 20 avdelningar, däribland 16 somatiska och psykiatriska avdelningar.

Vi erbjuder en gedigen forskningsmiljö med 13 professorer och en stark yrkesmässig utbildningsmiljö, där vi varje år välkomnar cirka 2 700 studenter, elever och läkare som deltar i vidareutbildning.

Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.

Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.

Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital arbejder vi hver dag for at fremme det sunde liv ved at forebygge og behandle i en sammenhængende sundhedsindsats. Som hospital forener vi psykiatri og somatik. Vores mål er, at patienter og borgere oplever gode og trygge forløb af høj kvalitet.

Som medarbejder bliver du en del af et nytænkende, fagligt og organisatorisk robust hospital, hvor vi gør en forskel for de mennesker, der har brug for os. Læring og udvikling er en del af hverdagen og sker i fagligt forpligtende fællesskaber. Også på tværs af afdelinger.

Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital dækker et opland på ca. 230.000 borgere. Vi har 766 sengepladser og er omkring 5.000 ansatte fordelt på 20 afdelinger, herunder 16 somatiske og psykiatriske specialer.

Vi tilbyder et solidt forskningsmiljø med 13 professorer og et stærkt fagligt uddannelsesmiljø, hvor vi hvert år byder cirka 2.700 studerende, elever og læger i videreuddannelsesforløb velkommen.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Hardware Engineer: Lead the integration of the hardware that powers ambitious satellite missions
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Hardware Engineer to drive the integration, technical ownership, and continuous improvement of the hardware platforms that enable GomSpace's satellite missions.

You will join our Satellite Systems Business Unit in Aalborg and play a central role in supporting satellite missions from proposal and electrical design through assembly, integration, testing, and delivery to customers worldwide. You will work closely with hardware designers, systems engineers, AIV engineers, manufacturing teams, and project managers while helping shape the future development of our hardware engineering capabilities.

Your Role

As experienced Hardware Engineer, you will act as the technical lead for the integration of electrical hardware and GomSpace products into satellite platforms.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Own the technical integration of GomSpace products into nanosatellite and microsatellite missions.

• Serve as a product expert for GomSpace hardware platforms, interfaces, functionality, configuration, and performance.

• Drive technical troubleshooting and root-cause analysis during development, integration, testing, and customer projects.

• Lead the integration and verification of new GomSpace products and third-party hardware within satellite platforms.

• Define electrical interface solutions, schematic-level designs, harness concepts, and supporting hardware required for mission integration.

• Coordinate prototyping, validation, documentation, and manufacturing introduction activities for new hardware solutions.

• Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior and mid-level engineers.

• Support technical decision-making and trade-off analyses across customer programmes and internal developments.

• Contribute to process improvements, engineering standards, and product maturity initiatives across the organisation.

• Support proposal activities and customer discussions by providing credible technical solutions, effort estimates, and engineering input.

• Prepare technical documentation and communicate effectively in English, including technical reports, specifications, procedures, and interactions with international stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like

In the initial phase, success means:

• Becoming a recognised technical expert on GomSpace's hardware portfolio.

• Successfully leading hardware integration activities on active customer missions.

• Resolving complex technical issues through systematic troubleshooting and engineering analysis.

• Building strong working relationships with Satellite Systems HW Team, Products HW Team, AIV, Manufacturing, and Systems Engineering.

• Supporting the growth and development of less experienced engineers.

Over time, you will be recognised as a trusted technical authority for hardware integration and product implementation, driving engineering excellence and helping scale GomSpace's hardware capabilities as our missions and teams continue to grow.

What You Bring

You are an experienced hardware engineer who enjoys solving technically demanding challenges and transforming complex products into reliable space systems.

You likely bring:

• An MSc or BSc in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.

• 10+ years of experience in hardware design, hardware integration, electronics development, verification, or systems integration.

• Strong knowledge of digital electronics, embedded hardware, and microcontroller-based systems.

• Experience with hardware communication interfaces and buses, including RS485/-422, CAN, SPI, I²C, USB, Ethernet, Spacewire, or similar.

• Experience in schematic capture and hardware development using tools such as Altium Designer or equivalent.

• Understanding of PCB design principles, EMC-, grounding- and shielding considerations, manufacturing processes, and product industrialisation.

• Experience with electrical integration, harness design, laboratory testing, and troubleshooting.

• Practical understanding of power systems, communication systems, and embedded electronics.

• Experience working with multidisciplinary engineering teams and complex technical projects.

• Knowledge of space systems and ECSS standards would be a strong advantage.

• Experience leading technical activities, mentoring engineers, or coordinating engineering teams would be considered a significant benefit.

Who You Are

You are pragmatic, technically curious, and motivated by solving challenging engineering problems.

You are known for:

• Technical leadership – providing direction and guidance without necessarily having formal authority.

• Systems thinking – understanding how individual hardware components contribute to mission success.

• Problem solving – methodically analysing issues and driving them to resolution.

• Collaboration – building strong relationships across engineering disciplines.

• Ownership – taking responsibility for delivering results.

• Mentorship – helping colleagues develop and grow.

• Customer focus – understanding that engineering excellence is measured by mission success.

• True leadership – setting standards, building trust, and enabling others to perform at their best.

Why Join Us

You will play a key role in delivering some of Europe's most ambitious nanosatellite and microsatellite missions, working at the intersection of product development, systems engineering, and customer delivery.

This position offers the opportunity to influence technical decisions across multiple programmes, shape future hardware capabilities, and grow into broader technical or people leadership responsibilities as both the team and business continue to expand.

Join our mission

We encourage you to send your application in English. Interviews will be conducted on a continuous basis. If you have any questions regarding the position, please do not hesitate to contact:

Kelly Antonini

Systems Engineering and Hardware Manager

klan@gomspace.com

Workplace: Langagervej 6, 9220 Aalborg East, Denmark. Salary and start date will be individually negotiated.

As part of our recruitment process, employment requires you to complete a background check conducted by an authorized third-party provider in accordance with applicable legislation.

We kindly draw your attention to the fact that we do not receive applications and resumes via e-mail or by personal appearance. This is to protect and show consideration for your personal information. Apply for the job by following the link below.

About GomSpace

GomSpace is a globally leading designer, integrator and manufacturer of high-end nano and microsatellites for customers in the academic, government and commercial markets. Our positions of strength include systems integration, small satellite subsystems and advanced miniaturised radio technology. At the core of our mission are our values: Be helpful, communicate openly and frequently, and show true leadership.

Our international team is devoted to understanding our customers’ requirements and delivering high quality. We are listed in Stockholm (GOMX), headquartered in Denmark and have subsidiaries in Sweden, Singapore, France, North America and Luxembourg. We have more than 200 employees servicing customers in more than 60 countries.

Learn more on www.gomspace.com

At GomSpace WE MAKE SPACE YOURS.

Join us in shaping the future of space exploration!

As soon as possible

jobs.occupation: Experienced Systems Engineer – Architecting Nanosatellite & Microsatellite Systems (DK/LU)
jobs.description:
Do you want to own the technical integrity of a mission from "blank sheet" to flight-ready hardware?

GomSpace is seeking a Lead Systems Engineer to drive our next generation of Nanosatellite and Microsatellite missions. We are looking for a technical visionary who thrives on solving complex system trade-offs for both bespoke single-satellite missions and scaling constellation architectures. In this role, you will navigate the newest market developments, helping our customers transition from initial technology demonstrators to operational fleets.

Since 2007, GomSpace has developed and delivered satellites to customers across more than 60 countries worldwide through technological innovation and the efforts of our highly skilled team.

You will have the chance to be part of an international and dedicated team committed to providing exceptional and innovative small-satellite solutions to customers in the global market. Your objectives will be aligned with your personal development goals, and you will be given the autonomy to lead others towards the same direction.

About the Job

As a Lead Systems Engineer in the Satellite Systems Business Unit, you are the technical heart of the mission. You aren’t just managing requirements; you are architecting the system and ensuring its physical realization. You will bridge the gap between customer vision and engineering execution, guiding teams through the full development lifecycle. You will have the autonomy to make high-impact technical decisions across a diverse portfolio, ensuring exceptional performance for single spacecraft and emerging constellation projects.

Responsibilities include:

• Defining and Architecting end-to-end missions, scaling designs from high-performance single satellites to repeatable constellation architectures.

• Driving the full development lifecycle, from proposal response and mission analysis to design, assembly, integration, and testing (AIT).

• Serving as the Technical Authority in front of the customer, translating complex needs into robust system specifications and verifiable requirements.

• Process Excellence: Designing and implementing value-added engineering processes that maintain high quality without sacrificing the speed required in an agile "New Space" environment.

• Leading and Mentoring project systems teams to solve the industry’s toughest challenges in power, thermal, and high-precision pointing.

• Managing complex interfaces and risk profiles, ensuring seamless integration between payload, bus, and launch providers.

Your profile

You are a driven and dedicated professional with a strong focus on delivering high-quality, advanced solutions. You thrive in collaborative and agile environments.

• Proven Experience: Significant years in a Lead or Senior Systems role within the space industry. Experience taking a satellite through the full "design-to-test" lifecycle is essential.

• Process Champion: You have a deep understanding of where to focus effort in the engineering process. You are skilled at implementing streamlined workflows that add genuine value and encourage team adoption in fast-paced environments.

• The "System" Thinker: You understand how a single component change can affect mission-level link budgets, thermal margins, or mass properties.

• Cross-Disciplinary Communicator: Comfortable discussing software configurations with developers, high-speed data links with RF engineers, structural margins with mechanical leads, etc.—everything that goes into a satellite solution.

• Leadership through Action: You foster a culture of helpfulness and open communication, leading by example in both technical depth and professional integrity.

This position is based in Denmark (Aalborg) or Luxembourg (Esch-sur-Alzette). The expected travel activity is 15 -40 days per year, and we are highly receptive to international applicants.

Qualifications:

• MSc-level (or higher) engineering education in aerospace, systems, software, electrical engineering, or related fields.

• Mastery of ECSS/NASA standards, with the ability to tailor these processes to be effective and agile.

• Expertise in systems engineering principles, including requirements management, architecture, and system-level verification and testing.

• Proficiency in mission analysis tools (e.g., STK, GMAT) for coverage, revisit, and orbital analysis.

• Demonstrated ability to design and drive engineering processes that improve team efficiency and product reliability.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify, assess, and mitigate technical risks in space missions or projects.

• Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.

Why choose GomSpace?

• Growth: Providing leadership within a leading space-industry company where innovation and advanced technologies are used to make a positive societal impact.

• Impact: Working alongside passionate, skilled, and international colleagues, driven by curiosity about “New Space” opportunities.

• Culture: Operating in a dynamic and cooperative culture with transparent communication and multidisciplinary teams.

• Network: Learning and growing through the company’s global network of locations and partnerships.

• International: Being part of project work based on international standards and team-oriented approaches.

JOIN OUR MISSION

Please send your application in English. Interviews will be conducted on a continuous basis. If you have any questions regarding the position do not hesitate to contact: Evan Helmeid, Systems Engineering, evhe@gomspace.com

Workplace will be at our premises at Langagervej 6, Aalborg, Denmark, or 1 Boulevard du Jazz, Esch-sur-Alzette, Luxembourg. Salary and start date will be individually negotiated.

jobs.occupation: Accounting & Reporting Advisory – Assistant Manager to Senior Manager
jobs.description:
Company Description

With more than 3,000 employees, Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, Technology and Transformations.

Join our growth journey with our Accounting & Reporting Advisory team (ARA)

You will become a part of our Accounting & Reporting Advisory team (ARA), an ambitious group dedicated to creating value by advising on complex accounting and external reporting needs. This includes conversion to IFRS, preparation of IFRS financial statements in connection with conversions or improvements, technical accounting analyses and issues, solving general accounting problems, improvement of financial reporting processes and control environments, and various M&A accounting services.

The Accounting & Reporting Advisory team is a component of our Assurance Offerings department that specializes in advising CFO’s and finance functions on, amongst others, projects within accounting, ESG reporting & assurance, optimisation of financial processes, digital solutions as well as complex IFRS analysis and implementation projects.

In Assurance Offerings, we foster a culture that accommodates everyone, irrespective of their life situation. We place great importance on well-being and development, striving to create an environment where each talent can leverage their strengths and competencies.

Job Description

As part of our team, you will lead and participate in client projects using your specialised accounting knowledge and the Deloitte Toolkit. We are looking for candidates on a manager level who are capable of leading projects with up to five team members, being responsible for scoping projects in cooperation with clients and project partners, as well as supporting and advising clients’ corporate accounting and reporting teams.

We work with assistance and advice within:

• General assistance regarding IFRS (ad hoc questions or short/long-term temporary tasks)

• Supporting clients in optimizing their financial reporting processes, ensuring timely, efficient and quality external reporting

• Assisting clients with consolidations and system implementation, improving their close processes and financial data flows from source to report

• Practical assistance/advice on finance, accounting and reporting

• Conversions to IFRS

• Supporting the clients specialised finance function with analysing and documenting the accounting treatment of proposed or actual transactions

• Assistance with the due diligence process in connection with business transactions (e.g., selected accounting areas, preparation of memos, preparation of due diligence material)

• Accounting assistance after company acquisition to support subsequent integration

• Treasury accounting including design and implementation of hedge accounting and processes and controls supporting clients running an effective hedge accounting setup

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

Qualifications

• You are curious about accounting and accounting issues. You see opportunities and solutions, ask good questions to explore the framework, and create the best results. You see challenges as an exciting opportunity to bring your talent into play and are prepared to learn and solve often complex tasks from scratch.

• You have experience in the field. You have minimum 5 years of experience from a similar job within finance or accounting, e.g., auditor, finance manager, accounting manager, or consultant in a related area.

• You are a positive and independent team player. You take ownership of tasks and do not shy away from new challenges. You value and embrace diverse perspectives and collaborate to create security and trust among your colleagues and clients.

• You have a relevant master's degree in finance, accounting, or auditing.

• Fluent in English – Fluent in Danish is an advantage.

Additional Information

Do you want to be part of our team?

Click "I am interested" above if you are ready to be part of our team.

Send your application, CV, and a transcript of your latest education along with other relevant documents. We process applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we recommend that you send your application as soon as possible.

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact Amalie Andersen, Senior Manager, at +45 28 92 66 04.

At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team's success.

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position, regardless of age, gender (gender identity or expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide a consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

Spirii is looking for a Senior Backend Software Engineer.

If you are passionate about cloud software development, team collaboration, and creating outstanding backend code, join Spirii's fantastic growth journey to lead the way for a sustainable future.

Spirii develops and provides world-class charging products and digital solutions to customers with electric cars. Our Digital Development department is proud to drive a listen, learn, and lead culture that allows us to constantly improve our ways of working, including how we adopt AI to raise the quality and speed of our engineering.

As a Senior Backend Software Engineer in our Payments team, you will help enhance the backbone of the Spirii platform that turns charging data into accurate invoices, credit memos, and payouts. It's a domain where correctness and financial data integrity are non-negotiable. You will report to an Engineering Manager and work closely with CPH and near-shore colleagues, as well as Finance and partner teams.

What You Will Do

Together with your team, you will be responsible for:

• 
Designing, building, and maintaining scalable, secure backend services and cloud-native queue-based pipelines (Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript) that power data ingestion, processing, and invoice generation at high throughput.

• 
Ensuring data quality through correct aggregation and safe handling of late or updated records.

• 
Building and maintaining integrations with internal services and our ERP system.

• 
Significantly contributing to architectural decisions and solution design for cloud-native, distributed, event-driven systems on AWS.

• 
Driving automated testing and observability to protect billing correctness and catch data discrepancies early.

• 
Mentoring other engineers and raising the technical bar of the team through code review, pairing, and constructive feedback.

• 
Operating independently on ambiguous, cross-team problems with minimal oversight.

• 
Using AI coding assistants and agentic workflows to accelerate development and automate repetitive tasks while helping the team adopt AI safely in a financially sensitive codebase.

Who You Are

• 
Like to explore innovative technologies, including AI tools and agentic workflows, and continuously expand your skills.

• 
Ambitious and execution-focused, with strong ability to balance functional and non-functional requirements when designing solutions.

• 
A proven track record of taking end-to-end ownership of complex backend systems and actively maintaining operational awareness.

• 
Skilled at breaking down complex, ambiguous initiatives into vertical slices that deliver value incrementally; you default to shipping in small, regular batches rather than big-bang releases.

• 
Comfortable working in Agile, cross-functional teams (backend, frontend, Finance, partners), and an active participant in creating an open, collaborative environment.

• 
Excellent English communication skills and the ability to interact with all levels of the organization, internally and externally with partners/customers.

Qualifications

• 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

• 
7+ years of professional software development experience.

• 
Extensive hands-on experience designing and scaling production backend systems, including having designed event-driven, queue/job-based architectures.

• 
Strong experience building TypeScript or JavaScript (Node.js, NestJS) microservices on cloud platforms such as AWS.

• 
Experience leading design discussions, mentoring engineers, or acting as a technical point of contact for a team or domain.

• 
Hands-on experience with test-driven development, test automation, integration and load testing.

• 
Strong SQL and data-modelling skills, with the discipline needed for financially accurate, auditable data.

• 
Experience integrating external and internal IT systems, and solid API design.

• 
Experience with developing secure software is a plus.

• 
Knowledge of Redis and NoSQL databases is an advantage.

• 
Experience working with or integrating ERP systems (e.g. Microsoft Business Central) is an advantage.

• 
Experience with billing, payments, invoicing, or other financial/transactional systems is a strong plus.

• 
Hands-on experience using AI assistants and/or agentic workflows to improve engineering productivity is a plus.

Benefits

It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work-life balance.

• 
Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

• 
Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

• 
Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days (5 weeks + 5 extra) and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.

• 
Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.

• 
Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.

Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.

Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.

Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.

About Spirii – Who We Are

Spirii is a full-service e-Mobility provider, which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii has recently celebrated its six-year anniversary as a founded company; however the people in Spirii have extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, as well as the development of future transport and energy systems.

We are looking for a Domain Architect to join our Business Engagement and Platform Solutions team, where you will take domain ownership of the application and platform architecture and drive alignment across our architecture practices.

Your key responsibilities

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

IT Turn competing IT demands into priorities teams can deliver. In this hands-on role with Group IT Strategy at Systematic, you will connect delivery realities with leadership decisions. Working closely with teams and leadership, you will help shape our evolving portfolio and capacity capability, clarifying what we can commit to, what comes next and what must wait.

The job

Group IT (GRIT) supports Systematic’s business units with infrastructure, systems, integrations, applications and governance. Our Plan-Build-Run model combines sprint-based development, stage-gate projects and Kanban operations to manage and improve services. As IT Portfolio & Capacity Manager, you will connect these delivery models into a trusted view of delivery, commitments and available capacity.

This is a hands-on role, reporting is a part of it, but not all of it. You will work with project managers, delivery teams, architects and leadership, and turn portfolio realities into clear priorities, capacity views, dependencies, risks and delivery expectations. You will move between portfolio decisions with the CIO and GRIT leadership and detailed reviews of project plans or Jira data with delivery teams, challenging commitments, dependencies and capacity assumptions. Your insight will help leadership decide what to prioritise, take on next or defer.

In addition to that, some of your key tasks will be to:

• Create a decision-ready portfolio view across stage-gate projects, sprints and Kanban, keeping commitments, dependencies and decisions visible across Plan-Build-Run.

• Connect demand, commitments and capacity to test delivery feasibility, assessing new demands with the Enterprise Architect and Director of Group IT Strategy.

• Investigate Jira and other delivery data, resolving gaps and inconsistencies with colleagues to establish a trusted portfolio picture.

• Validate progress, plans, dependencies and capacity assumptions directly with project managers and delivery teams, challenging commitments beyond status reports.

• Prepare and facilitate leadership discussions on portfolio priorities, making the impact on existing work, dependencies and capacity clear and following through on decisions and actions.

• Improve portfolio processes and tooling, using automation and AI to reduce manual administration and strengthen transparency and decision support.

Joining the team

The portfolio and capacity management model you will work with is still evolving, and you will play an important role in shaping it. Our ambition is not to build a large administrative PMO. We want a lightweight and trusted portfolio capability that gives us transparency across demand and delivery, helps us make realistic commitments, and enables us to adjust priorities as our capacity and business needs change.

You will become part of the GRIT Strategy team, a small team working across strategy, Enterprise Architecture, portfolio and project management to keep Group IT focused on the right priorities and strengthen the connection between planning and execution. Reporting to the Director of Group IT Strategy, you will take over a running portfolio process from an interim consultant and work closely with project managers, Enterprise Architecture and GRIT leadership.

The team is based in Aarhus. If you are located in Copenhagen, we are open to discussing a hybrid arrangement, but you should expect regular presence in Aarhus, approximately 6–8 days per month.

Your qualifications - most importantly, you understand how work actually gets delivered in an IT organisation.

You have worked close enough to technology delivery to understand the interaction between demand, projects, agile teams, dependencies, capacity and operational commitments. You understand that different teams may plan and deliver work differently, and you are able to create transparency across that complexity without trying to force everything into one delivery model. Your background could be in IT portfolio management, technology delivery, programme management, IT transformation or a PMO role closely integrated with IT delivery. The exact title matters less than your ability to understand delivery and turn fragmented information into a portfolio that can be actively managed. We expect you to have experience with several of the following:

• Experience from portfolio management, IT delivery, programme management, technology transformation or a similar role within an IT organisation.

• A practical understanding of project-based delivery, Scrum/sprint-based delivery and Kanban, and the ability to navigate between these ways of working.

• Experience creating portfolio or capacity views across multiple teams, projects or delivery models.

• The analytical ability to connect demand, capacity, dependencies, commitments and delivery.

• The willingness and ability to work hands-on with the underlying data rather than relying on a separate PMO or reporting organisation to produce it for you.

• Practical experience with Jira or similar delivery management tools.

• Strong analytical capabilities using Excel, Power BI or comparable tools to investigate data and create useful management views.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to turn complex delivery information into clear choices and trade-offs for senior stakeholders.

• Curiosity about how AI and automation can reduce manual portfolio administration and improve decision support.

• Fluent English. Danish is an advantage.

You are structured, curious and persistent

When the portfolio picture is unclear, you do not simply wait for someone to produce another status report. You look into the underlying information, talk to the people involved, challenge assumptions and work out what is actually happening. You enjoy creating order from complexity and are comfortable moving between strategic discussions and delivery detail. You also have the confidence to challenge when things do not add up. If commitments exceed available capacity, dependencies have been overlooked or different sources tell different stories, you make that visible and help the organisation resolve it.

At the same time, you are pragmatic. You understand that perfect data rarely exists in a fast-moving IT organisation and know how to create sufficient transparency to enable decisions without turning portfolio management into bureaucracy. You thrive as a senior specialist who takes ownership of your domain and leads through sound judgement, structure, collaboration and follow-through.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

The position is in the R&D Hardware department, working closely with all hardware teams – mechanics, optics, electronics, and certification – as well as our close colleagues in embedded software, tracking algorithm teams, supply chain, manufacturing engineering, and production.

The workplace for this position is at our HQ in Science Park DTU in Hørsholm.

Your key responsibilities are

• 
Lead the hardware project group together with the Product Owner(s), developing next-generation hardware for golf and other sports applications.

• 
Translate customer and business needs into clear technical requirements and hardware architecture.

• 
Collaborate with stakeholders across Management, Business Development, Tracking, and Manufacturing to align priorities and ensure progress.

• 
Turn technical requirements into actionable tasks, manage resources and dependencies, and maintain the overall hardware project plan.

• 
Represent Trackman in technical discussions with suppliers, including specifications, quality issues, and expectations.

• 
Communicate project status, progress, risks, and key obstacles clearly to management and other stakeholders.

Coordinate international product certifications, including CE, FCC, and UL, together with the Certification team.

• 
Identify and manage hardware risks related to areas such as product quality, obsolescence, suppliers, and certifications.

Job requirements

Are you our new colleague?

We’re looking for an experienced project manager with a strong hardware engineering background who can bridge technical complexity, business needs, and collaboration. Ideally, you bring:

• 
Several years of project management experience in hardware product development, preferably with RF systems.

• 
Experience with complex projects across mechanics, electronics, RF, and embedded software.

• 
Strong understanding of requirements management, design verification, and product industrialization.

• 
Solid business acumen and the ability to translate diverse user needs into robust product solutions.

Experience with project management methodologies and Agile principles, ideally bringing complex electronics products to market.

Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach, knowing when to listen, challenge, and take the lead.

Who is Trackman

Trackman is a privately-owned company founded in 2003. The company has experienced consistent high growth driven by a market-leading sports ball tracking technology based on radar and vision tracking, sustained by a strong desire to innovate.

Trackman designs, develops, and produces all of our technology from start to finish in-house under one roof.

Trackman’s 12,500 m² state-of-the-art CO₂-neutral headquarter is located in Science Park DTU in Hørsholm.

The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

Are you passionate about finding new drug opportunities? Do you love understanding disease biology to guide the best possible drug design? Are you a seasoned professional and looking for the next step?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Associate Director, Product Innovation.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and expanded portfolio. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

Ascendis Pharma is expanding our Product Innovation department and searching for an Associate Director to help drive the future pipeline and the company’s growth towards 2030 and beyond.

The Product Innovation department’s primary objective is to conduct analysis and propose new potential products for the company pipeline. With Patients in mind, new lead finding is based on thorough analysis which typically includes disease biology, unmet medical need, market assessment, competitive intelligence, FTO and assessment of path to FiH. With “Science” as a fundamental corporate value, analysis is rooted in a deep biological understanding of the disease, available (pre)clinical data, Mode of Action across modalities/lines of treatment and the impact a given molecular design/TPP will achieve. As a critical function to building Ascendis Pharma’s future, the Product Innovation department has high exposure to executive management and works closely with adjacent functions.

The Associate Director Product Innovation will play a critical role in Ascendis' success in Endocrinology Rare Disease as well as novel therapeutic areas. She/He will be the driving force behind providing high-quality analysis and pitch decks which enable value-oriented and informed decision-making by the EMT. By gathering, analyzing, and transforming data into concise, actionable ideas, you will play an important role in shaping the future pipeline.

You will be joining the Product Innovation team and report directly to Steffen Nyegaard, Director, Product Innovation who is based in Hellerup_. You will also be based in Hellerup.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Identification of new drug candidates and indications of interest

• In-depth analysis of diseases, treatment guidelines, competitive environment, how different MoA will affect the disease pathology, market and patents into final reports

• Act as strategic thought partner across different functions and teams, e.g. supporting early research projects or conducting deep-dive analytics to support key business decisions

• Staying current in relevant fields and tracking news widely (e.g., scientific literature, analyst reports, regulatory documents) and share findings with key stakeholders

• Establish processes, structures, and templates when necessary to support Ascendis' growth

Qualifications and Skills:

You have a PhD in life sciences and preferably post doctorial experience from a leading university or group. The ideal candidate has significant experience in lead finding and drug development and knows how to leverage their knowledge into actionable outcomes. The candidate possesses a strong biological profile, which enables them to quickly learn and understand novel biological systems, identify critical issues and unmet needs, and generate analyses with high level take-home and next-step recommendations.

Ideally**, you have:**

• 5 years of industry experience from Pharma or biotech within research or BD

• A strong biological profile with documented track record from the apex of the field

• Significant work experience with the different functions within the pharma value chain

• Experience in the use of public and private databases (e.g. Patsnap, Cortellis, Globaldata, Evaluate or similar)

• The ability to synthesize complex information to both high scientific and layman levels and present it in a clear, actionable manner

• English at a professional level, both written and spoken, and you master MS Office

Key competencies:

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

You are passionate about science, love learning and have a deep understanding of disease biology

To succeed in this role, we also expect you to demonstrate strong stakeholder management and communication skills, high personal and scientific integrity and the ability to navigate complex environments.

HELP BUILD DENMARK'S FUTURE HYDROGEN INFRASTRUCTURE

Ballerup / Egtved

Denmark is undergoing a historic transformation of its energy system. As the owner and operator of Denmark's electricity and gas transmission infrastructure, Energinet plays a pivotal role in developing the solutions that will support the country's transition to a greener energy future.

One of Energinet's most ambitious projects is the establishment of the Danish Hydrogen Backbone – Denmark's future national hydrogen transmission infrastructure, designed to connect the production, consumption and export of green hydrogen. The project will play a vital role in both Denmark's and Europe's green transition and represents one of the country's most complex energy infrastructure projects today.

We are now looking for an experienced Senior Electrical Engineer to play a key role in this landmark project. Beyond contributing to the successful delivery of the Danish Hydrogen Backbone, we are looking for someone who is motivated by the opportunity to become a long-term part of Energinet and help shape Denmark's critical energy infrastructure for years to come.

Lead electrical engineering in a landmark energy infrastructure project

As part of the Engineering department in Gas Transmission, you will serve as the Electrical Engineering Discipline Lead for the Project Danish Hydrogen Backbone project.

You will play a key role in the development of the electrical systems for the project's hydrogen stations, where hydrogen will be received, regulated and transported safely. Acting as a key technical authority, you will contribute throughout the entire project lifecycle, from detailed design and technical clarification to construction, commissioning and handover to operations.

You will join a multidisciplinary project environment, working closely with specialists in Instrumentation, SCADA, Process Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Technical Safety and Asset Management, as well as Energinet's international EPCM partner and other external consultants.

This role offers a unique opportunity to influence the technical solutions in a project where quality, safety and long-term reliability are critical to success.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• 
acting as the Electrical Engineering Discipline Lead throughout the design, construction and commissioning phases

• 
reviewing and approving technical solutions, drawings and engineering documentation

• 
defining technical requirements and documentation standards

• 
ensuring robust electrical solutions, including power supply systems, UPS, control panels, EMC, cable segregation, earthing and lightning protection

• 
contributing to transient studies, emergency shutdown (ESD) strategies, Cause & Effect philosophies and system integrity

• 
participating in FAT, SAT, commissioning and site supervision activities

• 
ensuring compliance with applicable legislation, industry standards and ATEX requirements

You bring experience from large-scale and technically complex process or energy facilities

We are looking for an experienced Senior Electrical Engineer who has a proven track record of working on large-scale technical infrastructure projects and thrives in multidisciplinary environments where engineering disciplines, regulatory requirements and multiple stakeholders must come together.

Do you know what separates a backlog a team can build from and a backlog a team has to decode? We are looking for an experienced Product Owner who wants backlog craftsmanship to be the centre of the job — across three software teams building the platforms that run Eurowind's energy parks and energy trading.

Who we are

Eurowind Energy is a global and leading developer, owner and operator of energy parks. Based in Denmark, we operate in 16 countries around Europe and in the USA, and we are continuously growing our project portfolio. We believe in a future of renewable energy, and we have an ambitious plan of becoming the next generation's "Power Major". Based on a full value chain from greenfield project development to energy trading, more than 700 team members are dedicated to creating a greener future fueled with nothing but renewable energy!

We are looking for an experienced Product Owner to join our IT Software department. Based at our head office in Hobro, Denmark, you will have your home base in our Automation & Masterdata team — and you will be the Product Owner who owns the backlog itself across all three of our software teams.

The backlog is yours, across three teams

IT Software runs three development teams — Trading & Monitoring, Automation & Masterdata, and Explore & Interact — with more than 15 engineers between them. We have deliberately split product ownership across three people with different centres of gravity rather than one generalist per team. One of your two Product Owner colleagues also holds the Scrum Master role and owns how we work: ceremonies, flow and continuous improvement. The other also holds project management and owns delivery towards the business: timelines, dependencies and stakeholder commitments. You will own the third piece — the backlog itself.

Your day-to-day home is the Automation & Masterdata team, where six developers and a team lead build the automation, data and masterdata foundation the rest of the business relies on. But because a backlog standard is only worth something if it is the same everywhere, your work will touch stories in all three teams.

Work reaches you from two directions. Larger projects and initiatives come in through our IT Portfolio Manager, who owns intake and demand at portfolio level, so a good share of what lands in the backlog arrives already framed and prioritised at a high level. The rest comes straight from the business, often as a half-formed idea from someone who knows their own domain far better than they know software. Turning both kinds into work a team can pick up is where you make the difference.

• Own the backlog as the single source of truth — capture, structure and maintain epics, stories and bugs so the teams always know what is next and why

• Refine feature requests into clear, testable items with acceptance criteria that hold up when development starts

• Set and maintain a shared standard for how work is written across the three teams, so a story reads the same whether it originates in Trading, Automation or Explore

• Make priority and scope calls together with your two Product Owner colleagues, the team leads and our solution architect

• Partner with our IT Portfolio Manager on larger projects and initiatives, and handle direct requests from the business for everything else

• Work with stakeholders across Operations, Trading, Commercial, BI and GIS to turn business needs into work the teams can act on

• Support release readiness — approve completed items and help stakeholders understand what is coming

• Keep Jira and Confluence trustworthy, so progress, dependencies and blockers are visible without anyone having to ask

• Help shape how we use AI in product work — we are currently building Claude skills that support user story intake and refinement, and this role has a real say in how far we take that

You will not be doing this in isolation. The three of you meet weekly with the team leads and our architect, and you will have a direct line to the developers whose week your backlog shapes.

Clear boundaries, real ownership

We lead with direction and mandate rather than detailed instruction. You will get the expectations and the boundaries agreed up front, and from there you decide how the work gets done. That only works if the roles around you are clear — which is why we have written down and agreed what the Manager, Product Owner, Scrum Master, Solution Architect and Team Lead each own, so you know where your decisions start and where they hand over.

• Real mandate over the backlog across three teams, and genuine influence on how the department works

• Two Product Owner colleagues, a Scrum Master, a solution architect and three team leads to spar with — this is not a role where you are the only one thinking about product

• A department leaning into AI in practice rather than in theory — we use it daily and are actively building Claude skills for user story intake and refinement, with the ambition of taking the mechanical part of backlog work off your plate so you can spend your time on the judgement calls

• A department in the middle of building its platforms, so what you shape now will still be visible in a few years

• Flexible working hours and the option to work from home

• Lunch scheme, coffee, tea and fruit, discount agreements and a bonus scheme

• An international environment with colleagues in 16 countries, where English is a natural part of everyday work

You will report to Daniel Otkjær, Senior Manager, Software Development, and become part of the leadership group in IT Software.

Required competencies and skills

This is a senior position. Because the standard you set reaches every story in three teams, we are looking for someone who has done product ownership before and knows what a well-written backlog is worth on a busy week. We put weight on the following:

• Several years of experience as a Product Owner in a software environment, ideally across more than one team or product

• Demonstrated experience with backlog management, refinement and writing acceptance criteria that survive contact with development

• Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps or similar tools; Confluence is an advantage

• Openness to working with AI as part of the job is a clear advantage, and hands-on experience using it for intake, refinement, documentation or stakeholder work is even better

• The ability to hold a shared standard across teams through clarity and collaboration rather than formal authority

• Comfortable moving between audiences — you can talk to a trader, an operations specialist and a developer on the same day and meet each of them where they are

• Structured in your approach, and at ease when priorities shift at short notice, which they will in a company growing in several directions at once

• Fluent in English in speech and writing; Danish is an advantage

• Knowledge of energy trading or the renewable energy sector is a plus, but something you can learn with us

A formal certification such as CSPO or SAFe Product Owner is a plus, but not a requirement — what matters most is what you have actually run.

Please note that this role requires a clean criminal record. A security clearance may become relevant later in the employment, but it is not required in order to apply.

This is a unique opportunity to shape Spirii's data infrastructure from an early stage — establishing standards for ingestion, orchestration, and data reliability as we scale.

Your Responsibilities

Pipeline & Ingestion

• 
Design, build, and maintain scalable ELT pipelines that bring data from product backends, third-party services, and operational systems into Amazon Redshift.

• 
Own ingestion reliability: monitoring, alerting, and incident response for pipeline failures.

• 
Evaluate and improve orchestration tooling and scheduling.

Data Platform & Infrastructure

• 
Evolve Spirii's data platform architecture: storage, compute, access control, and cost optimisation in Redshift.

• 
Implement and maintain infrastructure-as-code practices for data workflows (Terraform/CDK or similar).

• 
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for data infrastructure and transformations.

Data Quality & Governance

• 
Implement data quality checks, freshness monitoring, and anomaly detection across ingestion and transformation layers.

• 
Work with Analytics Engineers and domain teams to define and enforce data contracts and schema standards.

• 
Ensure GDPR-compliant data handling: PII identification, access control, and data retention policies.

Collaboration & Stakeholders

• 
Partner with Engineering and Product teams to instrument events correctly at the source — schemas, identifiers, and change management.

• 
Collaborate with Data team to ensure the analytics layer is built on reliable, well-modelled foundations.

• 
Contribute to a strong data culture by creating and enhancing documentation, runbooks, data lineage, discoverability and incident response capabilities.

About You

• 
You care deeply about data reliability and building pipelines that teams can depend on.

• 
You're hands-on: you build, test, and ship pipelines and infrastructure improvements yourself.

• 
You think of data pipelines as products — you care about uptime, observability, and the downstream consumers who depend on them.

• 
You're pragmatic: you know when to engineer robustly and when to keep things lean.

• 
You collaborate well across teams and communicate clearly about trade-offs and status.

Qualifications

• 
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

• 
3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related role with a strong data focus.

• 
Strong SQL skills and solid experience building production data pipelines.

• 
Hands-on experience with a modern data warehouse (Redshift preferred; BigQuery/Snowflake/Databricks also relevant).

• 
Experience with orchestration tools (Apache Airflow or similar).

• 
Proficiency in Python for data work (pipeline scripts, transformations, tooling).

• 
Solid understanding of ELT/ETL concepts, including incremental loading, CDC, and idempotency.

• 
Familiar with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK, or similar).

• 
Familiar with data governance concepts: access control, PII handling, GDPR-minded practices.

Nice to Have

• 
Experience with data observability tooling.

• 
Experience with event/data contract patterns in product analytics (schemas, versioning, instrumentation).

• 
Experience with finance data and/or subscription/transaction domains.

• 
Experience with dbt (understanding of transformation layer and how it interfaces with pipelines).

• 
Machine learning infrastructure experience is a plus, but not required for this role.

Benefits

It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work-life balance.

• 
Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

• 
Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

• 
Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days (5 weeks + 5 extra) and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.

• 
Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.

• 
Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.

• 
Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.

• 
Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.

• 
Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but fluent English language skills are required.

About Spirii – Who We Are

Spirii is a full-service e-Mobility provider, which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii has recently celebrated its six-year anniversary as a founded company; however the people in Spirii have extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, as well as the development of future transport and energy systems.

Spirii is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Spirii strives to create an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of age, gender, race, sexual/religious orientation, or disability.

This is a unique opportunity to become part of a forward-looking finance team and play a key role in shaping the commercial direction of Europe’s leading region in Hartmann. jobs.occupation: Product Owner for backup and recovery service
jobs.description:
Product Owner (Manager Role) for global backup and recovery service

Do you have hands-on experience owning or managing backup and disaster recovery services in an enterprise environment, including RPO, RTO and retention requirements?

For one of our clients, a large Danish company within the Life science & Pharma industry, we are seeking an experienced Product Owner for backup and recovery with leadership experience. You will become part of a dynamic and challenging environment characterized by high ambitions and a corresponding level of complexity. You will take part in shape the future of enterprise backup technology and safeguard the data that enables life-changing treatments to reach millions of patients.

Backup, and recovery

As Product Owner, you’ll lead and own the product vision, roadmap and backlog for the organization’s backup technology. You’ll take an active leading role and you’ll combine deep technical expertise in backup and cloud technologies with strong stakeholder management to ensure our service meets business continuity, compliance and operational objectives while driving continuous improvement and value delivery.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Maintaining the product vision, strategy and roadmap for the IT Backup Service, aligned with business continuity, security and compliance goals

• Owning the product backlog by writing, prioritizing and refining user stories, acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements (RTO, RPO, retention, encryption, etc.)

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams and key stakeholders to ensure seamless service delivery and continuous improvement

• Defining and monitoring KPIs for the backup service to drive performance and reliability

• Ensuring compliance with regulatory and internal backup policies, including data residency, retention, encryption and audit capability

• Managing incident response involvement for major backup/recovery incidents, leading post-incident reviews and implementing preventive measures

• Communicating roadmap, status, risks and outcomes to senior management and stakeholders in clear, executive-level language.

Your skills & qualifications

We’re looking for a Product Owner who can bridge technical depth with strategic vision, stakeholder engagement and leadership of the area.

You’ll bring with you:

• Expertise in people leadership

• Strong technical background in backup and recovery technologies, with solid understanding of RPO/RTO, retention schemes, backup architecture, snapshots, replication and restore workflows

• Proven experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager or Technical Lead for infrastructure or platform services in an enterprise environment

• Demonstrated ability to translate technical detail into executive-level communication and vice versa, ensuring clarity across all organizational levels

• Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to balance competing priorities and build consensus across diverse teams

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal

Experience working within regulatory and compliance frameworks (e.g., GDPR, SOX) in enterprise IT environments is a plus.

Apply now

• Brian Ranvits on +45 2048 0548

• Christoffer Bjørk Petersen on +45 2080 1638

Do you thrive in a role where you are close to the pulse of the business and work directly with executive management? Are you able to ensure an efficient and structured workday while respecting all business priorities? If so, you now have a unique opportunity to bring your professionalism into play and act as a trusted Executive Assistant to the CEO and the rest of the executive team at Norican in Taastrup.

Your role and responsibilities

As an Executive Assistant, you will occupy a key role as the central focal point, setting the direction for management's administration and creating structure. Working within a dynamic team of executives, you will act as the primary point of contact for both internal and external stakeholders globally.

In this position, execution and discretion are priority areas and are seen as a crucial discipline where high quality is paramount. This means your day-to-day work will offer significant professional variety through a wide range of administrative and coordination tasks. In this role, you will act as a gatekeeper, create clarity, and ensure smooth daily operations for the executive management team

Your most important task is to ensure that executive management's visions are effectively supported. You will do this by:

• Managing and prioritizing the CEO's calendar according to the annual business wheel, with a focus on allocating time for strategic meetings and urgent matters

• Acting as the primary liaison and local ambassador, ensuring seamless communication between the executive management, and all internal and external stakeholders

• Planning and organizing meetings, gathering input, and managing logistics

• Handling global travel logistics for the executive team, including flights, hotels, transportation, visa applications, and travel expense reports

To succeed in the role

To succeed in this role, it is crucial that you can maintain oversight and act as a trusted partner to the executive management team. Your success will be measured by the CEO always being well-prepared, meetings being flawlessly organized, and your ability to intuitively anticipate needs before executive management asks. Therefore, you must be able to communicate clearly, exhibit exceptional discretion with confidential information, and handle stakeholders at all levels. You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and remain resilient and calm even when deadlines approach and pressure rises.

We hope that you will bring:

• A minimum of 5–10 years of documented, successful experience as a PA/EA supporting C-level management

• A relevant educational background, such as a BA in Business Administration, or equivalent solid experience

• Excellent communication skills, fluent proficiency in English (written and spoken), and strong IT and MS Office capabilities

• Experience navigating complex global travel logistics and an understanding of cross-cultural differences

• A proactive, highly service-minded, and independent approach with a strong "can-do" attitude

Why you should join Norican?

In this role, you will play a crucial part in enabling the executive management team to succeed in driving Norican’s ambitious agenda and continued growth. You will be close to the heart of the business while becoming part of a professional, informal, and down-to-earth culture, where people work closely together, trust each other, and focus on making things happen. Professionally, you will benefit from a direct reporting line to the CEO and hold a central position that ensures the executive team’s continuous efficiency both locally and globally.

Want to know more? Ready to apply?

Ready to learn more and ready to apply?

We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. We will process your application confidentially, and it will only be shared with your prior consent. About Norican

NORICAN. Shaping Industry.

We are Norican, a global industrial group designing, building and supporting best‑in‑class machines and technologies for metal formation and surface treatment.

Bringing together five leading brands - DISA, Simpson, StrikoWestofen, Wheelabrator and Monitizer – we deliver one connected solution across the production process, supported by full‑service expertise and digital solutions.

Across green sand molding, die casting, sand preparation, melting, transport and dosing, and surface treatment, we help manufacturers improve performance and transform production across a wide range of industries. We build lifetime quality and long‑term partnerships by combining the strengths of our legacy brands to lead the industry through innovation, sustainability and profitable growth.

Are you driven by network architecture, cloud connectivity, and designing solutions that connect infrastructure and business needs? Do you thrive in a role where architectural responsibility, Azure, and complex stakeholder landscapes go hand in hand? Then we would very much like to hear from you.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Solution Architect – Network to join our Infrastructure & Platform team in Middelfart. The role centers around a growing focus on internal network architecture, where strong competencies are needed to ensure scalable, secure, and cloud‑enabled network solutions across the organization.

As Senior Solution Architect, you work holistically with our IT landscape and take architectural responsibility for network design across both on‑prem and cloud environments, with Azure as a central platform. You act as the link between business needs, project management, vendors, and internal IT functions, ensuring that network and cloud solutions are aligned with architecture principles, roadmap, and governance requirements.

Your responsibilities

Your responsibilities include:

• Designing and owning network architecture across on‑prem and Azure environments, with a clear focus on cloud connectivity, scalability, and security.

• Ensuring tight alignment between network architecture and cloud initiatives, making Azure an integrated and visible part of the overall infrastructure design.

• Addressing a growing complexity and demand within the network area by defining robust, future‑proof solutions that support business growth.

• Working closely with project managers on task definition, prioritization, and architectural guidance to ensure solutions are delivered as intended.

• Collaborating with vendors and partners, ensuring that requirements, architecture, and expectations are clearly defined and adhered to.

• Ensuring that network architectures meet security, compliance, and governance requirements in close collaboration with Cybersecurity.

• Staying up to date on network and cloud technologies and sharing architectural knowledge across the organization.

Your profile

You are an experienced solution architect with deep expertise in networking and a solid understanding of cloud platforms – especially Azure. You understand how architectural decisions within the network domain impact cloud capabilities, operations, and business outcomes.

We expect that you bring:

• Strong experience with network architecture in enterprise environments.

• Hands‑on experience with and solid understanding of cloud networking concepts.

• Experience working in hybrid infrastructures, connecting on‑prem and cloud environments.

• The ability to translate business needs into clear, robust architectural solutions.

• Experience collaborating across stakeholders, vendors, and technical teams.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex architectures to both technical and non‑technical audiences.

About you

You thrive in an architectural role with responsibility and influence, and you are motivated by creating long‑term, sustainable solutions. You are comfortable challenging existing designs and driving architectural improvements where needed, always with a business perspective in mind.

Ready to apply?
