Description

Are you passionate about rare endocrine diseases and advancing medical innovation? Do you have experience within Medical Affairs and enjoy translating science into meaningful impact for patients and healthcare professionals?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Global Medical Scientist.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease portfolio. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a passionate Global Medical Scientist to join our Global Medical Affairs organization. In this role, you will act as a subject matter expert within rare endocrinology and support the development and execution of global medical strategies across Ascendis Pharma’s growing portfolio. You will work closely with colleagues across Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Commercial, Market Access, and local affiliate teams to ensure alignment and successful implementation of global initiatives.

You will be joining the Global Medical Office and report directly to the Senior Global Director, Global Medical Office. The position is based at our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Support the development and execution of global medical strategies, medical narratives, and strategic imperatives across the Ascendis Pharma portfolio.

• Generate and communicate medical insights related to disease areas, treatment landscapes, competitive developments, and unmet patient needs.

• Support global medical education initiatives, congress activities, advisory boards, and engagement with key external stakeholders, including KOLs, patient advocacy groups, and medical societies.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to support evidence generation activities, including real-world evidence, observational studies, and Phase IV programs.

• Partner closely with local medical teams to ensure alignment and execution of global medical strategies and tactics.

Qualifications and Skills

You hold an advanced scientific degree such as MD, PhD, PharmD, or equivalent, and have at least 5 years of experience within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, preferably in Medical Affairs.

Furthermore, you have:

• Strong experience interpreting, communicating, and applying clinical data in a scientific and strategic context.

• Experience working within endocrinology, rare diseases, or other specialized therapeutic areas.

• Solid understanding of Medical Affairs, drug development processes, and global pharmaceutical compliance requirements.

• Proven ability to build trusted partnerships and work effectively in a complex global matrix organization.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage both internal and external stakeholders.

Key competencies

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

To succeed in this role, we also expect you to be scientifically curious, collaborative, and able to translate complex medical information into actionable insights. You are proactive, relationship-oriented, and comfortable navigating a dynamic international environment.

Travel: Approximately 20% international travel.

Office: Copenhagen, Denmark or the US, Princeton

Apply now

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform – applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website.

Are you a skilled Artificial Intelligence (AI) Engineer with experience across the full AI solution lifecycle, from model development and training to deployment and operation at scale? You’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of AI at JYSK by helping accelerate AI adoption across the organization. As part of a high-performing, agile AI Engineering team, you’ll contribute to our strategic ambition of integrating AI into business processes across the company. If you’re passionate about technical innovation and enjoy solving real-world business challenges with AI, we’d love to hear from you!

• A collaborative, open-minded environment with opportunities to engage across all organisational levels.

You can read more about our department here.

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Has 5+ years of industry experience in software engineering, designing and implementing AI solutions at scale using Python.

• Has a strong foundation in machine learning algorithms, with experience spanning both discriminative and generative models applied to structured data, natural language, and vision.

• Has experience developing, deploying, operating, and monitoring AI models in production at scale, preferably on Google Cloud Platform (or equivalent experience with Azure or AWS and a willingness to work with GCP).

• Has hands-on experience in one of the following areas: Building AI agents at scale integrated with advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. Pre-training, fine-tuning, or post-training large language models (LLMs). Developing and deploying state-of-the-art generative AI solutions for computer vision in real-world environments.

Internship Landscape Architect / Urban Planner

Aarhus/Aalborg/Copenhagen

Internship Duration: 2 February 2027 to 25 June 2027

Do you want to work for an Architecture firm with sustainability at the heart of its strategy? Can you contribute with solutions from your academic studies? Are you currently studying to be a Landscape Architect/Urban Planner? Then, join us to shape a sustainable and liveable world.

About us

Arkitema was established in 1969 making us one of Denmark's oldest architectural firms. Today, we are well positioned in Scandinavia with offices in Denmark, Norway and Sweden.

In our markets we provide wide range of competencies in our areas of expertise. We cover sectors and disciplines like healthcare, industry, transformation, landscape and residential construction.

Since 2019 Arkitema has been part of COWI, one of Scandinavia’s leading engineering and consultancy companies. Together with customers, partners and colleagues, we shape a future where people and societies grow and flourish. We do that by co-creating more sustainable and beautiful solutions that improve the quality of life for people today and many generations ahead.

Create Solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

As an intern at Arkitema, you will be part of a design team in one of Scandinavia's largest and leading architectural firms, where you will work with experienced architects, construction architects, urban planners and engineers to solve a wide range of professionally relevant tasks.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• To use your academic knowledge of architectural fundamentals to contribute to our projects

• Gain valuable experience in the field of architecture and construction

Also, you will be included in a team and assigned an experienced colleague as a mentor who will guide you throughout your internship. We carry out architecture primarily throughout the Nordic region but also other parts of the world within the areas of; Housing, Learning, Business, Health, Urban, Culture and Infrastructure. Therefore, our assignments range from small preservation-worthy residential neighborhoods to complex super hospitals, bridges and cultural centers.

As an intern, you will have the opportunity to be involved in drawing the first lines, registering old building masses, supervising construction sites on ongoing projects, or modeling and detailing the many complex buildings. Our professional span will give you a broad understanding of the design profession and in-depth knowledge of the workflows in the construction industry.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners, or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

On top of that, you’ll have:

• Actively pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree within Urban/Landscape Architecture field or similar.

Job Description

Do you want to take senior hands-on technical ownership of how mission-critical data centers are designed, expanded, and handed over for operation?

GlobalConnect is expanding data center capacity across the Nordics and Northern Europe. To support this growth, we are strengthening our Large Projects organization with a Data Center Designer based in Taastrup.

This is a senior specialist role at our highest specialist level. You will act as a technical authority across large data center projects, influence design direction, challenge key technical decisions, and help shape more consistent ways of working across countries.

The role is a hands-on role. You will work directly with layouts, power and cooling concepts, system architecture, technical documentation, supplier designs, commissioning readiness, and operational handover. This is not a technician or installation role, but you should enjoy getting close to the technical solution and being present in the data center environment.

What you need to succeed

• Hands on experience with data center infrastructure or other mission-critical environments, such as energy, pharma, industrial facilities, or similar

• Strong understanding of cooling systems and power infrastructure in mission-critical environments

• Proven hands-on experience with alarm and monitoring systems, including system architecture and integration with critical infrastructure such as power, cooling, and security

• Ability to interpret, review, and challenge engineering drawings, technical documentation, specifications, supplier designs, and system architecture choices

• Fluent English. Danish or another Nordic language is an advantage

About the role and the team

You will join a small, senior, and specialized team working across Denmark, Sweden, Norway, and Germany. The team works closely across borders and is building a more consistent pan-Nordic approach to data center design, expansion, and operational readiness.

In Denmark, this role closes an important capability gap. You will bring deep technical design expertise into a setup that already has strong project management capability. You will work closely with Project Managers, Sales, Procurement, external consultants, vendors, customers, and Operations.

A key part of the role is to act as a trusted technical advisor. You will help translate customer needs into technically sound solutions, challenge assumptions when needed, and ensure that design choices support long-term reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability.

What you’ll be working on

• Act as technical authority within large data center projects, from early concept through commissioning, acceptance, and handover

• Own and challenge system-level design decisions across power, cooling, controls, alarm and monitoring systems, security, and building interfaces

• Review layouts, airflow concepts, cooling capacity assumptions, power distribution principles, single-line diagrams, and supplier designs

• Develop and review technical requirements, specifications, scopes of supply, risk assessments, and design documentation

• Support FATs, site inspections, commissioning activities, acceptance testing, and operational handover

• Strengthen standardisation, repeatable technical solutions, and design quality across projects and countries

Who we are looking for

You are a senior mechanical technical specialist who enjoys working with complex systems, high expectations, and decisions that have long-term operational impact.

You are confident in your technical judgement and comfortable challenging designs, suppliers, consultants, customers, and internal stakeholders when the solution needs to be improved. You can explain complex technical choices clearly and help others understand the trade-offs between reliability, cost, schedule, scalability, and operational readiness.

You enjoy working close to the physical technical solution. You are comfortable reviewing drawings, questioning assumptions, calculating capacity, discussing design alternatives, and explaining why a solution will work in practice.

To succeed in this role, you should also be motivated by building trust across teams. The role requires close collaboration with Sales, Projects, Operations, vendors, and customers, especially where expectations, technical reality, and operational needs must be aligned.

Design the systems that guide satellites in orbit for new ambitious missions

We are seeking an experienced AOCS/GNC Engineer to design, develop, and validate attitude determination, orbit control, and autonomous navigation solutions for small satellite missions. In this role, you will develop guidance and control strategies across diverse and demanding mission profiles — from VLEO drag-dominated regimes to deep-space trajectories and asteroid proximity operations.

You will join our Advanced Missions global team, developing next-generation AOCS/GNC concepts while collaborating closely with GomSpace's established AOCS team in Aalborg — who built and flew the AOCS for the Juventas CubeSat on ESA's Hera mission and are currently developing full 6-DoF GNC for the Llevant (RAMSES) asteroid rendezvous mission.

**

Your Role**

As AOCS/GNC Engineer, you will own the attitude and orbit control design for advanced mission proposals — from requirements definition and algorithm design through high-fidelity simulation and hardware-in-the-loop validation.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Design and implement AOCS/GNC algorithms for attitude determination, control, and autonomous navigation across diverse mission profiles.

• Develop guidance and orbit-control strategies tailored to SSA, VLEO drag-dominated regimes, and deep-space trajectories.

• Model and simulate spacecraft dynamics, environmental disturbances, and sensor/actuator performance for mission-specific scenarios.

• Validate algorithms through high-fidelity simulations, Monte-Carlo analyses, and hardware-in-the-loop setups.

• Collaborate with systems, propulsion, and mission design teams to define control requirements and ensure end-to-end stability and performance.

**

What Success Looks Like**

In the initial phase, success means:

• Understanding GomSpace's AOCS product portfolio (GSW-600 reaction wheels, Auriga/Twinkle star trackers, STIM300 IMU, AOCS Flightcore software).

• Delivering your first AOCS sizing and mode analysis for a mission proposal and setting up a reusable MATLAB/Simulink simulation environment.

• Establishing working relationships with the Aalborg AOCS team and communicating AOCS trade-offs clearly to non-AOCS stakeholders.

Over time, you will be recognised for owning end-to-end AOCS/GNC design for advanced mission proposals, developing and maintaining GNC strategies across multiple mission regimes, and achieving successful Monte-Carlo validation campaigns that demonstrate algorithm robustness.

**

What You Bring**

You are an AOCS/GNC specialist with deep analytical rigour and a passion for solving complex spacecraft dynamics and control challenges across unconventional mission profiles.

You likely bring:

• An MSc or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, Astrodynamics, Control Systems, Applied Mathematics, or a related field. A PhD focused on GNC, spacecraft dynamics, or autonomous navigation is a strong plus.

• 3–5+ years of experience in AOCS/GNC algorithm design, simulation, and validation for spacecraft missions.

• Experience with attitude determination (gyro-stellar estimators, EKF/UKF), 3-axis control (sliding mode, PD/PID, LQR), and momentum management.

• Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink for spacecraft dynamics modelling and Monte-Carlo analysis.

• Experience with C/C++ implementation of flight algorithms and familiarity with AOCS sensors and actuators (star trackers, IMUs, reaction wheels, magnetorquers, RCS thrusters).

• Exposure to ESA/ECSS project lifecycle and AOCS design reviews (PDR, CDR) is highly valued.

**

Who You Are**

You combine deep mathematical rigour with creative engineering intuition. You are energised by the challenge of designing control solutions for missions that push the boundaries of what nanosatellites can do.

You are known for:

• Analytical depth — AOCS/GNC demands mathematical precision, and you deliver it.

• Creative problem solving — developing novel control strategies for unconventional mission profiles.

• Collaborative communication — translating complex dynamics and control concepts into clear requirements for systems and propulsion teams.

• Self-driven initiative — comfortable with ambiguity in early-phase mission design.

• Execution discipline – ensuring commitments are met in demanding environments.

• Customer focus – ensuring focus on customer’s success.

• True leadership — taking ownership of your domain and driving technical excellence.

**

Why Join Us**

You will play a key role in shaping future space missions at their most decisive stage. This position offers the opportunity to work closely with leading institutional customers, influence mission architectures from the start, and contribute to programs with long-term strategic impact.

**

Join our mission**

GomSpace is a globally leading designer, integrator and manufacturer of high-end nano and microsatellites for customers in the academic, government and commercial markets. Senior Process Automation Engineer in DCS, Novo Nordisk Engineering

Do you want to be a part of NNE’s all-time largest Process Automation team? We are looking for colleagues to join our fantastic company, where we have the aspiration of becoming best in class within Automation Solutions for Pharmaceutical Engineering.

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

You will be working in an enthusiastic Process Automation team with more than 80 colleagues in Denmark. Globally, the Process Automation team has more than 200 employees.

The Process Automation team works with consultancy, design & development, implementation and validation of Automation solutions for the Pharma and Biotech industries. Our work is project based, and currently we are looking into an exciting pipeline of large data driven, greenfield plants with modular/scalable designs.

We are skilled in a broad range of process areas within API production e.g. fermentation, recovery and purification, utility, and cleaning systems. And the solutions we provide to our customers are always based on a deep understanding of the customers’ production processes – and if standard components can’t do the job, we develop our own.

How you might spend your days

As a DCS Senior Process Automation Engineer, you’ll be:

• Advising customers on their application process solutions

• Design developing, programming, commissioning, qualifying, FAT, SAT, UAT and Handover of applications for Distributed Control Systems (DCS)

• Interacting with process experts and colleagues with expertise in surrounding systems and equipment like MES, Historian systems, instruments, production equipment etc.

• Developing and optimizing automation methods and strategies to meet our customers’ needs and sharing working knowledge with colleagues and partners

• Forming the basis of automation strategies and architectures to support our sister departments internationally and expand NNE’s Process Automation engagement

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you:

• Understand your colleagues’ individual and cultural difference

• Are aware of your surroundings and able to flag any concerns

• Are agile and able to prioritize urgent tasks

• Are team-oriented and able to collaborate on team projects

• Are reliable, curious and eager to learn

• Are appreciative of feedback, because it contributes to your growth

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• You have 6+ years or more of working experience and hold a degree as an engineer, ideally within electrical, automation, process or marine engineering

• You have 4 years or more of working experience with PCS/DCS Application development (for example ABB 800xA or ABB SattLine), working in GMP/GAMP environment or with execution of Automation projects

• Knowledge of batch production is valued

• You find the complexity of the GMP/GAMP environment exciting

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 13th December 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Christian Ljørring on +45 30 79 29 08 or Manager Rasmus Sølbeck Hansen +45 31 91 89 30

Please note:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

Company Description

With more than 3,000 employees, Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, Technology, and Transformations.

About the team

Deloitte’s ServiceNow department is looking for an experienced Enterprise Service Management Advisor and Solution Architect to join our A-team of ServiceNow advisors. As a Manager in our ServiceNow department, you will serve as a trusted advisor for our clients, guiding them on their digitalization journey. In this role, you will work with industry leading professionals, guiding clients through end-to-end digital transformation initiatives and driving complex enterprise-wide service modernization.

As a trusted advisor, you will play a key role in identifying and pursuing strategic business opportunities while leading the design and implementation of innovative ServiceNow solutions. You will collaborate with clients to transform IT, HR, Finance, Risk, and core business functions into streamlined, service-based organizations. This involves assessing the client’s needs, translating business requirements into tailored technology solutions, and providing strategic and best practice advisory. You will oversee the full project lifecycle, ensuring seamless execution from strategy to deployment, while providing thought leadership and industry insights that shape best practices.

Success in this role requires a deep understanding of enterprise service management, strong leadership in project execution, and the ability to build long-term client relationships based on trust and value creation. By delivering impactful solutions and driving meaningful business outcomes, you will help position Deloitte as the premier partner for digital transformation.

• Providing strategic advisory for some of the largest ServiceNow clients in Denmark and the Nordics.

• Engaging proactively with clients, advising on solution and problem scoping across the organization to ensure alignment with business objectives.

• Designing comprehensive solutions, including technical design using design thinking methodologies to ensure alignment with ServiceNow’s Enterprise Service Management capabilities and best practices.

Qualifications

You have the following skills and experience:

• A minimum of 5 years of experience working with ServiceNow or other digitalization platforms.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Hands-on experience leading end-to-end transformation projects in areas such as IT, HR, Finance, Risk or core business operations.

• Experience with IT Project Management and have the ability to oversee complex implementations and drive successful outcomes.

• Demonstrated consulting experience or prior experience as a Platform Owner, showcasing your ability to advise and lead clients through transformation initiatives.

• Familiarity with process frameworks such as Lean, TBM, ITIL or other methodologies relevant to your area of expertise.

• You must have the right to live and work in Denmark.

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can contribute to our team’s success**.**

What we offer you:

At Deloitte, we provide an environment where you can grow, innovate, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the ServiceNow field. Joining our team means becoming part of a dynamic and supportive workplace that values both professional and personal development.

• You will work alongside experts in the ServiceNow field, gaining insights and knowledge from top professionals in the field.

• You will experience a culture of continuous growth, where feedback and learning opportunities empower you to advance at your own pace.

• You will enjoy the flexibility of a hybrid work environment, allowing you to balance work and personal commitments in a way that suits you the best.

• You will gain access to ServiceNow certifications in the areas that interest you, enhancing your expertise and career prospects.

Additional Information

Do you want to be part of our team?

Click the "I am interested" button above if you are ready to join our team.

Send your CV and cover letter. In your cover letter, please describe your motivation and answer these following questions:

• ServiceNow Experience: Can you detail your hands-on experience with ServiceNow, including specific modules and functionalities you have worked with? Please provide examples of complex implementations or customizations you have led.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide a consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

Are you an experienced project professional who excels at building structure, driving consistency, and elevating project execution?

To support our growth and expanding portfolio of projects, we are strengthening our focus on the Project Management Office (PMO). You’ll get a key role in developing, maintain, train, and educate on the processes, methodology, and tool chain used in project execution.

Your Role

As PMO Lead, you will report to the Head of Projects & Delivery. You will become responsible for all aspects of our best-practice project execution and will be deeply involved in improving and developing our methodologies.

The PMO standardizes project practices, supports project managers and project teams, and represents a highly operational function.

The PMO ensures alignment with business goals by supporting Business Management and provides oversight across the project portfolio. The PMO spans governance, methodology, reporting, process development, and process control. The PMO leads the development of methodologies used during the scale-up of the organization – and may potentially evolve into the competence center for Project Management.

Your tasks include:

• Governance & Standards: Define, maintain, and continuously improve PM methodologies, templates, and best practices, ensuring compliance with processes, quality standards, and stage-gate governance.

• Project Monitoring & Reporting: Monitor project performance across scope, schedule, budget, and risks, and consolidate insights into portfolio dashboards and KPIs for leadership decision-making.

• Resource & Capacity Support: Support resource allocation and forecasting with Team Leads and Project Managers, identify bottlenecks, and help optimize utilization across the project portfolio.

• Support & Enablement: Enable Project Managers through coaching, training, and hands-on support with documentation, planning, tools, and evaluation of new project opportunities.

• Risk, Issue & Change Management: Support structured identification and handling of risks, issues, and changes, including escalation processes and decision forums.

• PMO Development: Drive continuous improvement of PMO methodologies and capabilities to support faster, more scalable, and predictable project delivery aligned with business growth.

The PMO Lead role is highly central to harmonizing and further professionalizing our project execution capability. Running activities according to standards, ensuring quality in execution, and ensuring predictability and repeatability will be key elements of our success. This work will happen in close collaboration with the Engineering Excellence Manager. Furthermore, the PMO Lead will act as the deputy to the Head of Projects & Delivery when required.

Short- and Long-Term Success

• Establishing clear structure and ownership of PMO processes and methodologies

• Delivering consistent, high-quality reporting and portfolio visibility

• Building trust and strong collaboration with project managers and key stakeholders

Longer term, you’ll take ownership of maturing the PMO into a scalable capability that supports faster, more predictable project execution, while acting as a competence center for project management across the organization.

What You Bring

You’re an experienced project professional with a strong knowledge of project, program, and portfolio management methodologies, and governance frameworks. You have the ability to design, implement, and continuously improve processes, standards, and tools. You have a strategic and analytical mindset that makes it possible to align project execution with business objectives.

• Have 3+ years of PMO or similar experience

• Have 5+ years of project management experience

• Preferably, have a technical background as an engineer or equivalent higher education

• Balance supportive guidance with governance and control responsibilities

• Have the experience to drive change and ensure adoption of new processes and ways of working

Who You Are

You’re not just defining processes - you ensure they are used, understood, and create value. You take ownership of execution and help teams succeed through clarity, structure, and support.

You bring:

• Strong organizational awareness and ability to manage cross-functional complexity

• Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, and communication skills

Electronics and EMS are key focus areas, but you will also support additional technical procurement categories as required to ensure stable operations.

Your tasks include:

Do you enjoy working across technical, commercial, and project domains to shape competitive and executable solutions? To strengthen our work with bids and proposals, we are looking for a Project Capture Manager who will assume a pivotal role in delivering winning proposals.

Your Role

The Project Capture Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end development of customer proposals, ensuring alignment between technical, commercial, legal, and business stakeholders. The role bridges technical solution design, program planning, cost estimation, and commercial governance to deliver high-quality, competitive, and compliant proposals.

Your tasks include:

• Proposal Coordination & Governance: Coordinate and synchronize proposal activities across technical teams, Sales, and Business Management, acting as the central point of contact and remain engaged through to contract signature, working with Legal & Contract Managers to ensure that technical solutions, assumptions, schedules, and resource commitments are robust, realistic, and executable, challenging them where required.

• Proposal Content Development: Contribute to key proposal sections including execution approach, governance, milestones, and risks, while developing schedules and ensuring content is consistent, compliant, and aligned with requirements.

• Business Alignment: Align proposal activities with bid strategies and business priorities, ensuring support for commercial objectives, risk appetite, and long-term goals.

• Cost, Price & Estimation: Lead and support estimation activities, validating scope, assumptions, and risks, and ensuring a solid and traceable foundation for cost and pricing in collaboration with Sales and Business Management.

• Process & Standardization: Drive standardization and continuous improvement of proposal processes, templates, tools, and methodologies in collaboration with PMO and Capture teams.

• Proposal Capability Development: Strengthen proposal practices and methodologies to improve quality, efficiency, scalability, and alignment with organizational growth.

The Project Capture Manager is a highly central and important role in delivering professional and competitive proposals and is therefore key to the successful capture of new projects. You’ll work closely with:

• Engineering Capture Manager

• Sales Managers, Business Development, and Solution Managers

• Legal & Contract Managers

• PMO & Project Management

• Senior Business Management

Short- and Long-Term Success

In the first 6–12 months, success means:

• Delivering structured, high‑quality proposals aligned with customer and business requirements

• Establishing strong collaboration across engineering, sales, and business stakeholders

• Creating clear and reliable project plans, cost estimates, and proposal content

Longer term, you’ll take ownership of maturing proposal capabilities across the organization, improving consistency and competitiveness, and contributing directly to winning complex projects and driving business growth.

What You Bring

You are a structured and commercially aware professional with a balanced approach to competitiveness, risk, and execution quality, supported by expertise in cost estimation, pricing, and risk assessment. You have a demonstrated ability to coordinate and align technical, commercial, legal, and business stakeholders, and to lead structured end-to-end bid processes covering timelines, deliverables, and dependencies.

You likely:

• Have a technical background (e.g., engineering or equivalent) combined with a business or commercial education, enabling a strong commercial mindset and solid technical and project understanding.

• Have solid experience in project or program management, including planning, governance, and execution.

• Ideally, have proven experience in proposal, bid, or capture management within complex, cross-functional environments, including development of high-quality, competitive, and compliant proposals.

• Can contribute to proposal content such as execution plans, schedules, and risk frameworks.

• Have experience with process standardization and continuous improvement, ideally in collaboration with a PMO.

Who You Are

You’re not just coordinating proposals - you are the person who makes the proposals coherent, competitive, and executable. You understand the importance of alignment, quality, and realism in securing new business.

You bring:

• Strong negotiation, customer communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with a high attention to detail and quality.

• The ability to manage multiple deadlines and perform effectively under pressure in a dynamic environment.

• Helpfulness: You support stakeholders and ensure alignment across teams

• Structure and clarity: You create clear overviews, timelines, and deliverables across complex bids

You’re analytical, detail‑oriented, and able to operate under pressure while maintaining quality and overview. You enjoy working in a dynamic environment where priorities shift—and where your work directly contributes to winning new business.

Are you a strategic leader with deep expertise in offsets and defense procurement? Do you want to shape GomSpace’s role as a trusted partner for defense primes and governments worldwide?

As our Offset Business Development Director, you will take ownership of driving our growth in the offset segment by identifying, developing, and securing key opportunities and partnerships. You will build a global network of defense primes and governmental stakeholders, helping them meet their offset obligations using GomSpace’s portfolio of innovative products and solutions.

This is a role where strategic insight, relationship-building, and execution come together to create real impact in complex and dynamic markets.

Your Role and Responsibilities

In this role, you will lead, and coordinate business development activities related to offsets, acting as the go-to expert internally and externally. You will translate national offset policies and political objectives into actionable business strategies and drive collaboration across internal teams to align resources and priorities.

Your tasks will include:

• Leading the development and implementation of offset and industrial cooperation strategies that support long-term growth.

• Building and maintaining strong relationships with defense primes, governments, institutions, and political stakeholders in target markets.

• Translating national policies and political targets into meaningful offset projects that gain governmental traction.

• Developing and executing capture strategies for RFPs and offset financing aligned with GomSpace’s commercial goals.

• Collaborating closely with product, engineering, and business development teams to tailor offerings and create competitive advantage.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a results-oriented, strategic thinker who thrives in complex defense environments and can navigate diverse stakeholder landscapes with diplomacy and influence.

You will bring:

• Proven experience in defense or space business development, especially with offsets and government procurement processes.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with a strong customer and value proposition focus.

• An established network within defense primes and governmental organizations, ideally across multiple regions.

• Sufficient technical understanding to align customer needs with GomSpace’s portfolio of solutions.

• Fluency in English; additional language skills such as Spanish or Arabic are a strong advantage.

Are you ready to leverage your expertise to grow GomSpace’s business and strengthen our position as a partner of choice in the global defense ecosystem? We’d love to hear from you.

Why Join Us?

As Offset Business Development Director, you’ll not only grow our business – you’ll shape the way GomSpace engages with the world’s most strategic players. You’ll operate on a high-impact level, developing offset strategies that fuel technological advancement and build sovereign capabilities across key markets.

We offer an international, mission-driven environment where innovation, purpose, and execution go hand in hand. You’ll collaborate with experts across the company – from BD and engineering to solutions and strategy – to create offset offerings that deliver real, measurable impact.

If you're ready to turn complex regulations into strategic growth and build alliances that stretch across sectors and borders, we’d love to hear from you.

• Generate a substantial share of your pipeline through proactive and personalised outbound prospecting across phone, email, LinkedIn and other relevant channels.

• Manage opportunities created through your own outreach, BDR-booked meetings and qualified inbound leads.

• Identify and engage key decision-makers, including C-level stakeholders, across multiple industries.

• Build compelling business cases and deliver tailored product demonstrations that clearly connect Trustpilot’s solutions to the prospect’s needs.

• Navigate more complex sales processes involving multiple stakeholders, commercial negotiations and higher-value solutions.

• Use your initiative and commercial judgement to prioritise opportunities and manage your sales funnel effectively.

• Maintain accurate pipeline management and forecasting in Salesforce.

• Develop your capabilities for continued growth within Mid-Market and Enterprise SaaS sales.

Who you are:

• Fluent in French, with strong English skills.

• 3 years of experienced in full-cycle B2B sales, including outbound prospecting, qualification, discovery, demonstration, negotiation and closing.

• Proven track record in SaaS or Tech sales, with consistent quota achievement.

• Comfortable generating your own opportunities and maintaining a high level of outbound activity.

• Experienced in selling higher-value solutions to mid-market businesses and managing several stakeholders throughout the sales process.

• Confident in engaging with senior and C-level decision-makers and adapting your approach to the French business environment.

• Strong discovery and consultative selling skills, with the ability to translate business challenges into clear commercial value.

• Able to manage a varied pipeline while prioritising the opportunities most likely to progress and close.

• Competitive, resilient and motivated by achieving and exceeding targets.

• A proactive self-starter with the ambition to grow a career in Mid-Market and Enterprise SaaS sales.

• Knowledge of e-commerce, digital marketing or online reputation management is a plus.

What's in it for you:

• A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you

• Competitive compensation package + bonus

• 25 days holiday per year, with an extra 5 days holiday allocated after your 1 year anniversary (prorated)

• Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community

• Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist

• Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health

• Central office with  a laid-back vibe and constant buzz of different languages being spoken everywhere you go It’s complete with a coffee bar, canteen, and table tennis and has a wide variety of refreshments available - you can opt-in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price

• Employee discounts to restaurants and shops

Genmab is seeking an experienced Senior Clinical Drug Supply Manager to join our Global Clinical Drug Supply in Copenhagen. The role requires candidates to be within commuting distance of our office locations to work according to our hybrid work arrangement. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality clinical trial supplies for both early and late-stage trials.

As a Senior Manager, Global Clinical Drug Supply, you will play a pivot role supporting the development and execution of clinical drug demand forecasts and supply plans to ensure uninterrupted delivery of clinical development products across Genmab’s pipeline. Your responsibilities will include managing the demand planning and supply planning of clinical supplies. This role will partner closely with cross-functional clinical development and CMC teams to maintain accurate forecasts, support supply strategy execution, and contribute to the operational success of clinical programs. The Senior Manager will apply strong analytical, communication, and planning skills to ensure reliable clinical supply while contributing to continuous process improvement across GCDS.

As a Senior Clinical Drug Supply Manager, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring efficient delivery of high-quality clinical trial supplies for both early and late-stage Genmab clinical trials worldwide.

The ideal candidate possesses an understanding of cGMP and a strong commitment to delivering high-quality work, demonstrating a proactive approach and willingness to go the extra mile to ensure the best outcome for patients.

This position is hybrid and requires you to be in the office 60% of the time.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Demand Planning & Forecasting

• Support the development, maintenance, and updates of clinical drug demand forecasts across assigned studies and programs.

• Collaborate with, CTT, and Finance to collect inputs and ensure forecasts reflect current enrollment trends, protocol changes, and assumptions.

• Manage the demand planning discussions as part of the Clinical Project Supply Team (CPST) and support forecasting activities within the CSIOP process.

• Identify potential demand risks and escalate issues in a timely manner, recommending mitigation actions where appropriate.

• Prepare demand plan summaries, enrollment updates, and cost forecasts to support program planning and operational reviews.

Supply Strategy & Execution

• Coordinate clinical supply–related planning activities, ensuring alignment between forecasted needs, study timelines, and supply availability.

• Support the execution of clinical supply chain sourcing strategies using third-party providers, in collaboration with Clinical Operations and Supply Leads.

• Contribute to communication of GCDS Planning Strategy within Global Clinical Teams, ensuring supply planning assumptions are clearly understood.

• Track supply readiness and highlight risks or gaps that could affect clinical trial continuity.

Supplier & Stakeholder Management

• Support Supplier Relationship Management activities by tracking supplier performance metrics and helping identify improvement opportunities.

• Build collaborative working relationships with cross-functional partners (Clinical Operations, CTT, CDM, Regulatory, CMC, QA, and Finance) to enable timely and accurate supply planning.

Budget & Cost Optimization

• Support budget development activities by preparing supply planning inputs and cost forecasts aligned with program needs.

• Monitor budget performance and identify variances, working with senior team members to implement cost-effective solutions.

Governance & Continuous Improvement

• Provide planning updates and forecasting insights to support governance forums (IRC, CTT, Asset Meetings).

• Ensure consistent use of supply chain processes, tools, and systems by adhering to established standards and contributing feedback for enhancements.

• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on advancing forecasting accuracy, operational efficiency, and collaboration across GCDS.

Quality & Regulatory Compliance

• Ensure demand planning and supply–related activities comply with GxP, regulatory standards, and Genmab quality expectations.

• Maintain accurate, audit-ready documentation for demand forecasts, planning assumptions, and supply updates.

• Support identification and resolution of compliance gaps and contribute to corrective and preventive actions as needed

• Adhere to the Genmab Quality Management System

Qualifications

•    Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Pharmaceutical Sciences, Life Sciences, Healthcare, or Supply Chain Management).

•    Minimum 8+ years of experience in clinical drug supply forecasting, supply planning, and demand planning

•    Demonstrated stakeholder management skills, both internally and externally.

•    Experience working with vendors and CMOs for clinical trial supplies will be an advantage.

•    Solid knowledge of GDP and GMP. Knowledge of GCP will be an advantage.

•    Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to excel in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

•    Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

•    Highly organized with a structured, process-oriented mindset that supports continuous improvement.

•    Ability to prioritize effectively while maintaining a high level of quality and compliance.

•    Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work both independently and within global teams.

•    Results-driven and goal-oriented, committed to contributing to Genmab’s success.

The Team

You will join a highly competent team focused on demand planning and supply planning on clinical supplies, collaborating closely with the Global Clinical Drug Supply Execution team. Together with the Global Clinical Drug Supply Systems team and Global Clinical Drug Supply Manufacturing team, these four functions form the Global Clinical Drug Supply department. We foster a supportive, international, and fast-paced work environment centered on collaboration, excellence, and a can-do attitude to achieve results.

DKK687.888,00---1.031.832,00

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. Job description

Trackman is the leading brand in its field, trusted by elite athletes worldwide. We’re growing and looking for a Senior Full Stack SDET who is passionate about quality engineering and excited to help test and improve world-class sports technology products.

This senior, full-stack quality engineering role spans backend API testing and frontend (Windows and web) application testing. You’ll combine strong automation skills with the ability to define end-to-end quality strategies across the Trackman ecosystem—from radar data pipelines to TM Performance Studio used by athletes and coaches worldwide.

You’ll join an international team and help elevate quality practices by mentoring peers, partnering closely with developers, product owners, and UI/UX designers, and championing a quality-first approach throughout the development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Design, build, and maintain robust test automation frameworks for both backend APIs (REST/GraphQL), web applications and Windows desktop applications

• 
Architect end-to-end test strategies covering integration, system, performance, and regression testing

• 
Lead test planning and review sessions within Agile/Scrum ceremonies alongside developers and product owners

• 
Drive quality across the full stack: from data ingestion APIs and cloud services through to client-facing Windows/Web applications

• 
Define and enforce test coverage standards, reporting metrics, and quality gates within CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)

• 
Explore and implement AI-assisted testing techniques — including AI-generated test cases, intelligent test prioritisation, and anomaly detection — to increase testing efficiency and coverage

• 
Mentor and guide junior QA engineers and SDETs across the team

• 
Collaborate with DevOps and platform engineers to embed testing earlier in the development pipeline (shift-left)

• 
Participate in design reviews and contribute to technical architecture discussions from a testability perspective

• 
Conduct exploratory and risk-based testing to uncover edge cases beyond automated suites

Job requirements

The Ideal Candidate

• 
Holds a relevant degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent (bachelor's level minimum)

• 
Has 5+ years of experience in quality engineering or SDET roles, with proven seniority in at least two of: backend API testing, desktop/Windows application testing, or test framework architecture

• 
Is highly proficient in C# for test automation, with strong understanding of object-oriented design principles.

• 
Has hands-on experience with API testing tools and frameworks (e.g., RestEaze, Postman, Playwright, SpecFlow, or similar)

• 
Has experience testing Windows/Web based applications and understands UI automation frameworks

• 
Is experienced with Azure DevOps or equivalent CI/CD platforms for pipeline integration and test reporting

• 
Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to diagnose complex, cross-layer defects

AI & Emerging Technologies

• Has experience with and understands how AI and machine learning concepts can be applied within a quality engineering context

It Will Also Be a Plus If You Have

• 
Experience in the gaming or sports technology industry

• 
Knowledge of radar, computer vision, or sensor data systems

• 
Golf knowledge or broader sports interest — you don't need to be a pro, but a genuine passion for sports helps!

We Offer

• 
A senior, high-impact role in which you will directly shape Trackman's quality engineering culture and practices

• 
The chance to work with and test the world's leading sports tracking technology, trusted by elite athletes across golf, baseball, and football

• 
A collaborative, cross-functional team with 40+ highly skilled colleagues from more than 35 nationalities

• 
Exposure to cutting-edge technology — radar, computer vision, real-time data, and AI — in a unique product domain

• 
An open, informal, and ambitious company culture where great ideas are heard and innovation is encouraged

• 
Continuous learning and growth opportunities as Trackman scales

• 
Social activities and a vibrant team culture

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. Vejstrup

Can you see yourself working in a well-established Application & Control department with competent and motivated colleagues? Can you envision yourself designing solutions that create safety and security in every type of braking application where large forces or special conditions apply?

Then you might be the next engineer to join the team at Svendborg Brakes.

Develop innovative brake solutions for demanding applications

Together with your competent colleagues in the Application & Control Department, you will be involved in projects related to customer-specific applications. These applications must function in environments such as underwater turbines, submarines, elevators, or at high altitudes in the mountains of Tibet. The applications are diverse and offer plenty of design challenges.

Based on specifications and timelines, projects are led by a Project Manager. This allows you to focus on the technical aspects of the projects as well as managing your own project timeline. Your tasks will include:

• 
Technical adjustments of the core product and components for braking systems

• 
Design and construction of braking systems and components, including hydraulic systems

• 
Leading and ensuring the execution of testing these designs in the test center and production facilities

• 
Preparing technical documentation, including drawings and bills of materials (BOMs)

• 
Participation in development projects, including new material types and customer-specific projects.

Your typical workday will be a mix of independent work and a cross-functional collaboration, as solutions are often found through interdisciplinary collaboration. Among other things, you will work closely with a technical designer who supports you by creating technical documentation.

Svendborg Brakes has its own hydraulic manufacturing and test center, where designs can be tested and where customers visit to follow the project progress. This means you will be able to see your projects through from start to finish.

You are passionate about engineering and intelligent hydraulic systems

We are looking for an engineer with a strong passion for engineering and hydraulics. You have both an interest in and experience with mechanical design, hydraulics, and electrical control systems, and you are motivated by continuously developing your skills. You most likely hold a degree in mechatronics or mechanical engineering and have at least three years of professional experience.

You take a structured approach to your work and maintain a strong overview of tasks and processes. You understand that respecting specifications and timelines leads to the best results and strongest collaboration. You communicate effectively with people from different professional backgrounds and interact effortlessly with both customers and colleagues across departments.

In addition, you are fully comfortable communicating in English, both verbally and in writing.

Do you want to join the team?

At Svendborg Brakes, you will experience a flat organizational structure and an informal culture, where you have the freedom to plan your own workday and the projects you are involved in. You will also be part of a close cross-functional collaboration, where colleagues complement each other across projects with their individual areas of expertise.

Svendborg Brakes’ willingness and motivation to explore new technologies - as one of the world leaders in this field - is evident throughout the company. In other words, you will join a team with high level of expertise and a strong dedication to continuous development. This gives you a unique opportunity to develop your skills based on your interests and motivation.

jobs.description:
The Position:

The UNFPA Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU) is seeking candidates for its newly established Supply Chain Internship Roster 2026. These internship opportunities are on-site at SCMU’s office in the UN City headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark.

SCMU offers specialized functional streams aligned with its operational needs, including:

• Data & Analytics

• Logistics & Supply Chain

• Procurement & Business

• Humanitarian Supplies

• Supply Chain & Customer Service

• Governance, Risk & Compliance

• Communications

• Human Resources

• Information and Communications Technology (ICT)

• Administration & Business

To ensure effective team integration and maximize the value of the internship, candidates must be logistically and financially prepared to undertake full-time, on-site work in Copenhagen for the duration of the internship.

How you can make a difference:

UNFPA is the lead UN agency for delivering a world where every pregnancy is wanted, every childbirth is safe and every young person's potential is fulfilled.  UNFPA’s strategic plan (2026-2029), reaffirms the relevance of the current strategic direction of UNFPA and focuses on three transformative results: to end preventable maternal deaths; end unmet need for family planning; and end gender-based violence and harmful practices. These results capture our strategic commitments on accelerating progress towards realizing the ICPD and SDGs in the Decade of Action leading up to 2030. Our strategic plan calls upon UN Member States, organizations and individuals to “build forward better”, while addressing the negative impacts of the Covid-19 pandemic on women’s and girls’ access to sexual and reproductive health and reproductive rights, recover lost gains and realize our goals.

The UNFPA Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU) is self-funded and was made operational in January 2022. It is tasked with ensuring that UNFPA is able to effectively and efficiently support the delivery of life-saving reproductive health products and other programme supplies to the end user when and where they are needed. To achieve this, it is important to strengthen the capacity of governments and implementing partners to ensure coordination, end-to-end visibility and accountability on all supply chain and logistics management related activities, in particular for programme supplies, across all UNFPA programmes.

In a world where fundamental human rights are at risk, we need principled and ethical staff, who embody these international norms and standards, and who will defend them courageously and with full conviction.

UNFPA is seeking candidates that transform, inspire and deliver high impact and sustained results; we need staff who are transparent, exceptional in how they manage the resources entrusted to them and who commit to deliver excellence in programme results.

Eligibility:

Educational requirements

a. Be enrolled in a first university degree programme (such as bachelor’s degree or equivalent) and have completed one full academic year;

b. Be enrolled in a postgraduate degree programme (such as master’s programme or higher);

c. Have recently graduated with a university degree as defined above and, if selected, must start the internship within one-year of graduation; or

d. Be enrolled in a postgraduate professional trainee programme and undertake the internship as part of this programme.

Other eligibility requirements

e. Demonstrate interest in the field of development;

f.  Demonstrate written and spoken proficiency in at least one of the working languages of the United Nations (English or French) and fluency in the official language (Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian or Spanish) of the UNFPA office; and

g. Demonstrate ability to adapt to new environments and to establish and maintain good working relations with individuals of different cultural backgrounds.

An individual whose father, mother, son, daughter, brother or sister is a UNFPA staff member is not eligible for an internship with UNFPA.

Required Competencies:

Values:

• Exemplifying integrity,

• Demonstrating commitment to UNFPA and the UN system,

• Embracing cultural diversity,

• Embracing change

Core Competencies:

• Achieving results,

• Being accountable,

• Developing and applying professional expertise/business acumen,

• Thinking analytically and strategically,

• Working in teams/managing ourselves and our relationships,

Financial Support:

Interns who do not receive financial support from an outside party (such as an academic institution, university, government) are eligible to receive a stipend as a contribution towards living expenses. The stipend is based on the intern’s agreed place of work, which may be different from the duty station of the hiring office in cases of remote arrangements. The stipend is normally paid in local currency at the end of each month.

UNFPA Work Environment:

UNFPA provides a work environment that reflects the values of gender equality, diversity, integrity and healthy work-life balance. We are committed to ensuring gender parity in the organization and therefore encourage women to apply. Individuals from the LGBTQIA+ community, minority ethnic groups, indigenous populations, persons with disabilities, and other underrepresented groups are highly encouraged to apply. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to applicants with disabilities upon request, to support their participation in the recruitment process. UNFPA promotes equal opportunities in terms of appointment, training, compensation and selection for all regardless of personal characteristics and dimensions of diversity. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion is at the heart of UNFPA's workforce - click here to learn more.

Disclaimer:

UNFPA does not charge any application, processing, training, interviewing, testing or other fee in connection with the application or recruitment process and does not concern itself with information on applicants' bank accounts.

jobs.occupation: Communications Student Assistant – Partnerships, Advocacy and Communications Team
jobs.description:
About ICARS    The International Centre for Antimicrobial Resistance Solutions (ICARS) is an independent international organisation established by the Danish Government to support low- and middle-income countries in developing evidence-based and context-appropriate solutions to antimicrobial resistance (AMR). Working across the One Health spectrum, ICARS collaborates with governments, research institutions and global organisations to bridge research, policy and implementation.    About the role   We are looking for a Student Assistant to join our Partnerships, Advocacy and Communications Team. This is a great opportunity for a student interested in digital communications, creative media, data management and global health and development. You’ll support our day-to-day activities and help communicate ICARS’ work on AMR in LMICs.   We’re looking for someone with strong technical skills who also takes initiative to bring fresh ideas to the team. Alongside delivering assigned tasks, you will be encouraged to suggest improvements and take ownership of agreed activities, with support and feedback from colleagues.      Key responsibilities    Website management:    	
•  	Maintain and update content on ICARS’ WordPress website, keeping it accurate, accessible and user-friendly.  	    	
•  	Track website performance using analytics tools and suggest improvements based on the findings.  	    	
•  	Proactively identify outdated content, gaps and opportunities to better showcase our work.  	   Graphic design & visual content:    	
•  	Create engaging infographics, social media graphics and report layouts that align with ICARS’ brand.  	    	
•  	Help develop templates and designs for reports and presentations, bringing fresh ideas for communicating complex information clearly.  	    	
•  	Video editing & multimedia:  	    	
•  	Edit videos for ICARS’ social media, presentations and events.  	    	
•  	Support video production and identify opportunities to turn existing footage into useful, engaging content.  	   Social media support :    	
•  	Support ICARS’ LinkedIn presence through content creation and community engagement.  	    	
•  	Keep an eye on relevant conversations, project updates and sector developments, suggesting timely stories and opportunities for ICARS to contribute.  	   Internal communications support:    	
•  	Maintain our internal SharePoint, including keeping our media library organised and up to date.  	    	
•  	Support colleagues with designing clear, engaging PowerPoint slides and formatting Word documents.  	   Press Office and external communications support:    	
•  	Assist with event promotion and Mailchimp newsletter creation.  	    	
•  	Monitor our communications mailbox, respond to routine enquiries and coordinate with colleagues on requests from stakeholders, including regional and national press.  	    	
•  	Flag relevant media and communications opportunities for the team to consider.  	   Data and stakeholder information management:    	
•  	Support the team in entering and maintaining accurate, up-to-date data and contact information in ATLAS, our CRM system.  	    	
•  	Other tasks related to deliverables of the Partnerships, Advocacy and Communications Team.   	      Desired profile    We are seeking an organised and curious student who enjoys both developing ideas and getting things done in a pro-active and structured manner. You take the initiative to find information, ask useful questions and suggest practical next steps. You can work independently, recognise when to seek guidance and lead tasks through to completion, while keeping colleagues informed. You are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly, and you bring strong digital fluency, technical skills and the ability to pick up new tools with ease.   Required qualifications:    	
•  	Currently studying for a Master’s degree in IT, Media Studies, Marketing, Graphic Design or a related field.  	    	
•  	Proficiency in WordPress and basic website management.  	    	
•  	Experience using MS Office, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint.  	    	
•  	Experience with graphic design tools, such as Canva or Adobe Creative Suite.  	    	
•  	Basic video editing skills, using Premiere Pro, Final Cut or similar software.  	    	
•  	Strong organisational skills, working in a structured manner and with attention to detail.  	    	
•  	Ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks.  	    	
•  	Ability to identify opportunities, propose ideas and take responsibility for delivering agreed tasks.  	    	
•  	Strong written and verbal communication skills in perfect and fluent English, including the ability to adapt content for different audiences.  	   Preferred qualifications:    	
•  	Knowledge of Google Analytics, or a willingness to learn.  	    	
•  	Experience using CRM platforms (Dynamics 365)  	    	
•  	Skills and interest in drafting technical and scientific communication material.  	      What we offer     	
•  	Hands-on experience: Contribute to drafting communications material, external stakeholder management and partnerships, developing your skills through practical work and feedback.  	    	
•  	Impact: Help communicate solutions to one of the world’s most critical global health and development challenges, with space to contribute your own ideas and see them put into practice.  	    	
•  	Flexible working hours: Our working hours between 8 am and 5 pm with accommodation of your academic schedule.  	    	
•  	International environment: Work alongside experts and colleagues from diverse backgrounds in a global organisation.  	   If you enjoy turning ideas into action and want to use your communications skills to support global health, we would love to hear from you!      Terms of employment   The position as student assistant will be covered by the terms of the collective agreement between The Danish Finance Ministry and the Organisation of Public Employees (OAO-S-Fællesoverenskomsten) and the organizational agreement between The Danish Finance Ministry and the Organisation for Salaried Employees HK/Stat (Organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere (HK)), according to chapter 6 in the agreement concerning hourly paid employees.   The successful candidate is enrolled at graduate level in a Danish University with at around two years of studies remaining. They will predominantly work from the ICARS HQ office, based at the Statens Serum Institut in Copenhagen, Denmark.      Application and recruitment process     Press “apply for the position” and submit your CV along with a cover letter outlining your suitability for the role and motivation for applying.     We would like to receive your application by 20 November 2026 and expect to conduct interviews 24-27 November 2026.   For questions about the role, please contact Communications Officer Chloe Modvig-Cole (checo@icars-global.org) and for other questions about the position you may contact Head of Partnerships and Global Relations Theresa Hogenhaug (tcah@icars-global.org). We are committed to cultivating a fair and healthy environment, where everyone can be themselves and thrive. We are happy to discuss flexible working options for all roles. We work to ensure that our recruitment processes are as inclusive as possible to everyone. This includes adjusting for people who have a disability or long-term condition.   We look forward to hearing from you!
